div.head: vedotpattyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vedotpattimadhyāyaṃ ‘vedotpattināmādhyāyaṃ’ iti, ‘vedotpattiṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ’ iti ca pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
atha khalu bhagavantamamaravaramṛṣigaṇaparivṛtamāśramasthaṃ kāśirājaṃ divodāsaṃ dhanvantarimaupadhenavavaitaraṇaurabhrapauṣkalāvatakaravīrya(ra)gopurarakṣitasuśrutaprabhṛtaya ūcuḥ ||3||

bhagavan! śārīramānasāgantubhirvyādhibhirvividhavedanābhighātopadrutān hārāṇacandrastu ‘śārīramānasāgantusvābhāvikaiḥ’ iti paṭhati sanāthānapyanāthavadviceṣṭamānān vikrośataśca mānavānabhisamīkṣya manasi naḥ pīḍā bhavati, teṣāṃ sukhaiṣiṇāṃ rogopaśamārthamātmanaśca prāṇayātrārthaṃ prajāhitahetorāyurvedaṃ śrotumicchāma ihopadiśyamānam, atrāyattamaihikamāmuṣmikaṃ ca śreyaḥ; tadbhagavantamupapannāḥ smaḥ śiṣyatveneti ||4||
tānuvāca bhagavān- svāgataṃ vaḥ; sarva evāmīmāṃsyā adhyāpyāśca bhavanto vatsāḥ ||5||

iha khalvāyurvedaṃ nāmopāṅgamatharvavedasyānutpādyaiva ‘nāma yadupāṅgaṃ’ iti, ‘āyurvedamaṣṭāṅgamupāṅgamatharvavedasya’ iti ca pā. prajāḥ ślokaśatasahasramadhyāyasahasraṃ ca kṛtavān svayambhūḥ, tato'lpāyuṣṭvamalpamedhastvaṃ cālokya narāṇāṃ bhūyo'ṣṭadhā praṇītavān ||6||
tadyathā- śalyaṃ, śālākyaṃ, kāyacikitsā, bhūtavidyā, kaumārabhṛtyam, agadatantraṃ, rasāyanatantraṃ, vājīkaraṇatantramiti ||7||

div.ab: athāsya pratyaṅgalakṣaṇasamāsaḥ ‘athāsya pratyaṅgalakṣaṇaṃ samāsenopadekṣyāmaḥ’ iti, ‘pretyekāṅgalakṣaṇasamāsaḥ’ iti, ‘pratyekamaṅgalakṣaṇasamāsaḥ’ iti ca pā0|8|

tatra, śalyaṃ nāma vividhatṛṇakāṣṭhapāṣāṇapāṃśulohaloṣṭāsthibālanakhapūyāsrāvaduṣṭavraṇāntargarbhaśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ ‘pūyāsrāvagarbhaśalyoddharaṇārtha’ iti, ‘pūyāsrāvāntargarbhaśalyoddharaṇārtha’ iti ca pā., yantraśastrakṣārāgnipraṇidhānavraṇaviniścayārthaṃ ca (1) |8|
śālākyaṃ nāmordhvajatrugatānāṃ śravaṇanayanavadanaghrāṇādisaṃśritānāṃ vyādhīnāmupaśamanārtham (2) |8|
kāyacikitsā nāma sarvāṅgasaṃśritānāṃ vyādhīnāṃ jvararaktapittaśoṣonmādāpasmārakuṣṭhamehātisārādīnāmupaśamanārtham (3) |8|
bhūtavidyā nāma devāsuragandharvayakṣarakṣaḥpitṛpiśācanāgagrahādyupasṛṣṭacetasāṃ śāntikarmabaliharaṇādigrahopaśamanārtham (4) |8|
kaumārabhṛtyaṃ nāma kumārabharaṇadhātrīkṣīradoṣasaṃśodhanārthaṃ duṣṭastanyagrahasamutthānāṃ ca vyādhīnāmupaśamanārtham (5) |8|
agadatantraṃ nāma sarpakīṭalūtāmūṣakādidaṣṭaviṣavyañjanārthaṃ ‘… lūtāvṛścika...’ iti pā vividhaviṣasaṃyogopaśamanārthaṃ ca (6) |8|
rasāyanatantraṃ nāma vayaḥsthāpanamāyurmedhābalakaraṃ rogāpaharaṇasamarthaṃ ca (7) |8|

ab.seg: vājīkaraṇatantraṃ nāmālpaduṣṭakṣīṇaviśuṣkaretasāmāpyāyanaprasādopacayajanananimittaṃ ‘viśuṣkaṃ granthībhūtatayā viśeṣeṇa śuṣkamiva, kṣīṇaṃ vyādhyādibhiḥ svamānāddhīnaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ praharṣajananārthaṃ ca (8) ||8||
evamayamāyurvedo'ṣṭāṅga upadiśyate; atra kasmai kimucyatāmiti ||9||
ta ūcuḥ- asmākaṃ sarveṣāmeva śalyajñānaṃ mūlaṃ kṛtvopadiśatu bhagavāniti ||10||
sa uvācaivamastviti ||11||
ta ūcurbhūyo'pi bhagavantam- asmākamekamatīnāṃ matamabhisamīkṣya suśruto bhagavantaṃ prakṣyati, asmai copadiśyamānaṃ vayamapyudhārayiṣyāmaḥ ||12||
sa uvācaivamastviti ||13||
vatsa suśruta! iha khalvāyurvedaprayojanaṃ- vyādhyupasṛṣṭānāṃ vyādhiparimokṣaḥ, svasthasya rakṣaṇaṃ ‘svāsthyarakṣaṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca ||14||
‘āyurasmin vidyate, anena vā''yurvindanti’ ityāyurvedaḥ ||15||
tasyāṅgavaramādyaṃ pratyakṣāgamānumānopamānairaviruddhamucyamānamupadhāraya ‘āgamapratyakṣānumānopamānaiḥ’ iti pā.||16||

etaddhyaṅgaṃ prathamaṃ, prāgabhighātavraṇasaṃrohādyajñaśiraḥsandhānācca | śrūyate hi yathā- “rudreṇa yajñasya śiraśchinnamiti, tato devā aśvināvabhigamyocuḥ- bhagavantau naḥ śreṣṭhatamau yuvāṃ bhaviṣyathaḥ, bhavadbhyāṃ yajñasya śiraḥ sandhātavyamiti | tāvūcaturevamastviti | atha tayorarthe devā indraṃ yajñabhāgena prāsādayan | tābhyāṃ yajñasya śiraḥ saṃhitam” iti ||17||
aṣṭāsvapi cāyurvedatantreṣvetadevādhikamabhimatam, āśukriyākaraṇādyantraśastrakṣārāgnipraṇidhānāt sarvatantrasāmānyācca ||18||
tadidaṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ vṛttikaraṃ ceti ||19||
brahmā provāca tataḥ prajāpatiradhijage, tasmādaśvinau, aśvibhyāmindraḥ, indrādahaṃ, mayā tviha pradeyamarthibhyaḥ prajāhitahetoḥ ||20||
bhavati cātra- ahaṃ hi dhanvantarirādidevo jarārujāmṛtyuharo'marāṇām | śalyāṅgamaṅgairaparairupetaṃ prāpto'smi gāṃ bhūya ihopadeṣṭum ||21||

asmiñchāstre pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣa ‘… puruṣaśabdena ceha sāmānyena prāṇivācinā'pi prakaraṇānmanuṣyarūpa eva puruṣa ucyate| yato ‘mānavānabhisamīkṣya’ ityādinā tathā ‘tasyopakaraṇamanyat’ ityādinā narajātirevātra puruṣo'dhikṛtaḥ| sāmānyaśabdo'pi prakaraṇādviśeṣe vartata eva| ... tasmādevambhūta evātra puruṣa ucyate, na punaścetanādhātumātrarūpaḥ prāṇimātrarūpo vetyāha- tasmin kriyate| ... kutaḥ punastasminneva kriyā na punarhastyaśvādāvapi prāṇimātre ityāśaṅkāyāṃ hetugarbhaṃ viśeṣaṇamāha- so'dhiṣṭhānamiti| sa eva narajātiḥ puruṣo yasmādihāyurvedavidheyacikitsārūpāyāḥ kriyāyāstathā kriyāphalasyāsyārogyāderadhiṣṭhānamāśrayo na tu gajādiḥ, tasmāttasminneva kriyā| atha kathaṃ gajādayo vṛkṣādayaśca nāsyādhiṣṭhānamityāśaṅkā, tataḥ praśnaḥ- kasmāditi| tadatra pradhānatvena nara evādhikārīti darśayannāha- lokasya dvaividhyādityādi| lokadvaividhyena naravyatiriktasya sthāvarajaṅgamasya yasmānnaropakaraṇatvaṃ, narastūpakāryaḥ, tasmānnara eva pradhānatvādadhiṣṭhānamiti prakaraṇārthaḥ| pradhānanaravivecanārthamuktadvaividhyaṃ vibhajate- sthāvaro jaṅgamaśceti| ... dvividhatāvivaraṇaprastāvāccikitsopayuktaṃ prakārāntareṇa dvaividhyamāha- dvividhātmaka evāgneyaḥ saumyaśca| dvividha ātmā agnīṣomarūpaḥ svabhāvo yasya sa tathā| pṛthivyādiguṇotkarṣatayā pañcātmakatvamapi bhavatītyāha- pañcātmako veti| ... jaṅgamaprabhedaṃ varṇayituṃ jaṅgamaprakārānāha- tatretyādi| evaṃ prapañcite loke tasya pradhānatvamāha- tatra puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ tasyopakaraṇamanyaditi| anyat paśvādi vṛkṣādi ceha śāstre naropakaraṇatayā pratipādanīyaṃ, ... api ca nara eva dharmārthakāmamokṣasādhakatayā upadeśānuṣṭhānakṣamatayā ca viśeṣeṇopakāraviṣayamadhikaroti| ... so'dhiṣṭhānamiti pratijñātamardhamitaralokopakaraṇīyatayā vyavasthāpitaṃ nigamanena punardarśayati- “tasmāt puruṣo'dhiṣṭhānamiti” iti bhānumatyāṃ cakraḥ| “atrāyamāśayaḥ- manuṣyādhikārakamidaṃ śāstraṃ, manuṣyaloke ca caturvidha eva bhūtagrāmaḥ, tatra ca manuṣyasañjñakaḥ puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ, tadupapannaṃ tasyādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ, dvividhe tu loke ‘buddhimatsu narāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ’ (ma. 1/16) iti manūkteḥ manuṣyāṇāmeva prādhānyamiti tasyādhiṣṭhānatvenoktirnāsaṅgatā” iti hārāṇacandraḥ ityucyate | tasmin kriyā, so'dhiṣṭhānaṃ; kasmāt? lokasya dvaividhyāta ‘tadvidheyatvāt’ iti gaṇanāthasenasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ; loko hi dvividhaḥ sthāvaro jaṅgamaśca; dvividhātmaka evāgneyaḥ, saumyaśca, tadbhūyastvāt; pañcātmako vā; tatra caturvidho bhūtagrāmaḥ saṃsvedajajarāyujāṇḍajodbhijjasañjñaḥ ‘svedajāṇḍajodbhijjajarāyujasañjñaḥ’ iti pā.; tatra puruṣaḥ pradhānaṃ, tasyopakaraṇamanyat; tasmāt puruṣo'dhiṣṭhānam ||22||
tadduḥkhasaṃyogā vyādhaya ucyante ||23||
te caturvidhāḥ- āgantavaḥ, śārīrāḥ, mānasāḥ, svābhāvikāśceti ||24||

div.ab: teṣāmāgantavo'bhighātanimittāḥ |25|
śārīrāstvannapānamūlā vātapittakaphaśoṇitasannipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ |25|
mānasāstu krodhaśokabhayaharṣaviṣāderṣyābhyasūyādainyamātsaryakāmalobhaprabhṛtaya icchādveṣabhedairbhavanti |25|

ab.seg: svābhāvikāstu kṣutpipāsājarāmṛtyunidrāprakṛ(bhṛ)tayaḥ ||25||
ta ete manaḥśarīrādhiṣṭhānāḥ ||26||
teṣāṃ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanāhārācārāḥ samyakprayuktā nigrahahetavaḥ ||27||
prāṇināṃ punarmūlamāhāro balavarṇaujasāṃ ca | sa ṣaṭsu raseṣvāyattaḥ; rasāḥ punardravyāśrayāḥ; dravyāṇi punaroṣadhayaḥ | tāstu dvividhāḥ- sthāvarā jaṅgamāśca ||28||

tāsāṃ sthāvarāścaturvidhāḥ- vanaspatayo, vṛkṣā, vīrudha, oṣadhaya iti | tāsu, apuṣpāḥ apuṣpā iti puṣpāṇāmatisūkṣmatayā puṣpādhārakarṇikayā ācchāditatvācca adṛśyapuṣpā ityarthaḥ phalavanto vanaspatayaḥ, puṣpaphalavanto vṛkṣāḥ, pratānavatyaḥ stambinyaśca vīrudhaḥ, phalapākaniṣṭhā oṣadhaya iti ||29||

jaṅgamā khalvapi caturvidhāḥ- jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjāḥ | tatra paśumanuṣyavyālādayo jarāyujāḥ, khagasarpasarīsṛpaprabhṛtayo'ṇḍajāḥ, kṛmikīṭapipīlikāprabhṛtayaḥ svedajāḥ, indragopamaṇḍūkaprabhṛtaya udbhijjāḥ ||30||
tatra sthāvarebhyastvakpatrapuṣpaphalamūlakandaniryāsasvarasādayaḥ prayojanavantaḥ; jaṅgamebhyaścarmanakharomarudhirādayaḥ ||31||
pārthivāḥ suvarṇarajatamaṇimuktāmanaḥśilāmṛtkapālādayaḥ atra pārthiveṣu muktāyāḥ pāṭho'nārṣaḥ pratibhāti, muktāyāḥ śuktyākhyajalacaraprāṇijanyatvāt||32||
kālakṛtāḥpravātanivātātapacchāyājyotsnātamaḥśītoṣṇavarṣāhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanādayaḥ saṃvatsaraviśeṣāḥ ‘kālaviśeṣāḥ’ iti pā.||33||
ta ete svabhāvata eva doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaprakopapraśamapratīkārahetavaḥ prayojanavantaśca ||34||
bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- śārīrāṇāṃ vikārāṇāmeṣa vargaścaturvidhaḥ | prakope ‘caye kope śame caiva’ iti pā. praśame caiva heturuktaścikitsakaiḥ ||35||
āgantavastu ye rogāste dvidhā nipatanti hi | manasyanye śarīre'nye teṣāṃ tu dvividhā kriyā ||36||
śarīrapatitānāṃ tu śārīravadupakramaḥ | mānasānāṃ tu śabdādiriṣṭo vargaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ||37||

evametat puruṣo vyādhirauṣadhaṃ kriyākāla iti catuṣṭayaṃ samāsena vyākhyātam | tatra puruṣagrahaṇāt tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādiruktastadaṅgapratyaṅgavikalpāśca tvaṅmāṃsāsthisirāsnāyuprabhṛtayaḥ, vyādhigrahaṇādvātapittakaphaśoṇitasannipātavaiṣamyanimittāḥ sarva eva vyādhayo vyākhyātāḥ, auṣadhagrahaṇāddravyarasaguṇavīryavipākānāmādeśaḥ, kriyāgrahaṇāt snehādīni cchedyādīni ca karmāṇi vyākhyātāni, kālagrahaṇāt sarvakriyākālānāmādeśaḥ ||38||
bhavati cātra- bījaṃ cikitsitasyaitatsamāsena prakīrtitam | saviṃśamadhyāyaśatamasya vyākhyā bhaviṣyati ||39||
tacca saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ pañcasu sthāneṣu | tatra sūtranidānaśārīracikitsitakalpeṣvarthavaśāt saṃvibhajyottare tantre śeṣānarthān vakṣyāmaḥ ||40||
bhavati cātra- svayambhuvā proktamidaṃ sanātanaṃ paṭheddhi yaḥ kāśipatiprakāśitam | sa puṇyakarmā bhuvi pūjito nṛpairasukṣaye śakrasalokatāṃ vrajet ||41||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vedotpattirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
athātaḥ śiṣyopanayanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāmanyatamamanvayavayaḥśīlaśauryaśaucācāravinayaśaktibalamedhādhṛtismṛtimatipratipattiyuktaṃ tanujihvauṣṭhadantāgramṛjuvaktrākṣināsaṃ prasannacittavākceṣṭaṃ kleśasahaṃ ca bhiṣak śiṣyamupanayet | ato viparītaguṇaṃ nopanayet ||3||

upanayanīyaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ ‘upanayanīyastu brāhmaṇaḥ’ iti pā. praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu praśastāyāṃ diśi śucau same deśe caturhastaṃ caturasraṃ sthaṇḍilamupalipya gomayena, darbhaiḥ saṃstīrya ratnapuṣpalājabhaktairdevatāḥ ‘puṣpairlājabhaktai ratnaiśca’ iti pā. pūjayitvā viprān bhiṣajaśca, tatrollikhyābhyukṣya ca dakṣiṇato brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayitvā'gnimupasamādhāya, khadirapalāśadevadārubilvānāṃ samidbhiścaturṇāṃ vā kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ (nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthamadhūkānāṃ) dadhimadhughṛtāktābhirdārvīhaumikena vidhinā sapraṇavābhirmahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sruveṇājyāhutīrjuhuyāt, tataḥ pratidaivatamṛṣīṃśca svāhākāraṃ kuryāt, śiṣyamapi kārayet ||4||
brāhmaṇastrayāṇāṃ varṇānāmupanayanaṃ kartumarhati, (rājanyo dvayasya, vaiśyo vaiśyasyaiveti;) śūdramapi kulaguṇasampannaṃ mantravarjamanupanītamadhyāpayedityeke ||5||

tato'gniṃ triḥ pariṇīyāgnisākṣikaṃ śiṣyaṃ brūyāt- kāmakrodhalobhamohamānāhaṅkārerṣyāpāruṣyapaiśunyānṛtālasyāyaśasyāni hitvā, nīcanakharomṇāśucinā kaṣāyavāsasā satyavratabrahmacaryābhivādanatatpareṇāvaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ, madanumatasthānagamanaśayanāsanabhojanādhyayanapareṇa bhūtvā matpriyahiteṣu vartitavyam; ato'nyathā te vartamānasyādharmo bhavati, aphalā ca vidyā, na ca prākāśyaṃ prāpnoti ||6||
ahaṃ vā tvayi samyagvartamāne yadyanyathādarśī syāmenobhāgbhaveyamaphalavidyaśca ||7||

dvijagurudaridramitrapravrajitopanatasādhvanāthābhyupagatānāṃ cātmabāndhavānāmiva svabhaiṣajaiḥ pratikartavyam, evaṃ sādhu bhavati; vyādhaśākunikapatitapāpakāriṇāṃ ca na pratikartavyam; evaṃ vidyā prakāśate mitrayaśodharmārthakāmāṃśca prāpnoti ||8||
bhavataścātra- kṛṣṇe'ṣṭamī tannidhane'hanī dve śukle tathā'pyevamahardvisandhyam ‘kṛṣṇetare’ iti pā.| akālavidyutstanayitnughoṣe svatantrarāṣṭrakṣitipavyathāsu ||9||
śmaśānayānādyatanāhaveṣu ‘… dhvavanāhaveṣu’ iti pā. mahotsavautpātikadarśaneṣu | nādhyeyamanyeṣu ca yeṣu viprā nādhīyate nāśucinā ca nityam ||10||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śiṣyopanayanīyo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||

div.head: adhyayanasaṃpradānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'dhyayanasampradānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

prāgabhihitaṃ saviṃśamadhyāyaśataṃ pañcasu sthāneṣu | tatra sūtrasthānamadhyāyāḥ ‘ślokasthānaṃ’ iti pā. ṣaṭcatvāriṃśat, ṣoḍaśa nidānāni, daśa śārīrāṇi, catvāriṃśaccikitsitāni, aṣṭau kalpāḥ, taduttaraṃ ṣaṭṣaṣṭiḥ ||3||
vedotpattiḥ śiṣyanayastathā'dhyayanadānikaḥ | prabhāṣaṇāgraharaṇāvṛtucaryā'tha yāntrikaḥ ||4||
śastrāvacāraṇaṃ yogyā viśikhā kṣārakalpanam | agnikarma jalaukākhyo hyadhyāyo raktavarṇanam ||5||
doṣadhātumalādyānāṃ vijñānādhyāya eva ca | karṇavyadhāmapakvaiṣāvālepo vraṇyupāsanam ||6||
hitāhito vraṇapraśno vraṇāsrāvaśca yaḥ pṛthak | kṛtyākṛtyavidhirvyādhisamuddeśīya eva ca ||7||
viniścayaḥ śastravidhau pranaṣṭajñānikastathā | śalyoddhṛtirvraṇajñānaṃ dūtasvapnanidarśanam ||8||
pañcendriyaṃ tathā chāyā svabhāvādvaikṛtaṃ tathā | avāraṇo yuktasenīya āturakramabhūmikau ‘āturakramamiśrakau’ iti pā.||9||
miśrakākhyo ‘bhūmibhāgo’ iti pā. dravyagaṇaḥ saṃśuddhau śamane ca yaḥ | dravyādīnāṃ ca vijñānaṃ viśeṣo dravyago'paraḥ ||10||
rasajñānaṃ vamanārthamadhyāyo recanāya ca | dravadravyavidhistadvadannapānavidhistathā ||11||

sūcanāt sūtraṇāccaiva savanāccārthasantateḥ ‘sandhānāccarthasantateḥ’ iti pā.| ‘saraṇāccārthasantateḥ’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| ‘saraṇaṃ pratītārthagatilabhyamānaṃ, yathā- ‘auṣadhagrahaṇāddravyarasa-guṇa-vīrya-vipākānāmādeśa’ iti, atra, hi auṣadhaṃ rasādīn pratyākhyāya na bhavatīti rasādilābhaḥ’ iti tatkṛtavyākhyā| ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhyāyaṃ sūtrasthānaṃ pracakṣate ||12||
vātavyādhikamarśāṃsi sāśmariśca bhagandaraḥ | kuṣṭhamehodaraṃ mūḍho ‘mūḍhavidradhyaḥ’ iti pā. vidradhiḥ parisarpaṇam ||13||
granthivṛddhikṣudraśūkabhagnāśca granthivṛddhibhagnaśūkakṣudrāśca’ iti pā. mukharogikam | hetulakṣaṇanirdeśānnidānānīti ṣoḍaśa ||14||
bhūtacintā rajaḥśuddhirgarbhāvakrāntireva ca | vyākaraṇaṃ ca garbhasya śarīrasya ca yatsmṛtam ||15||
pratyekaṃ marmanirdeśaḥ sirāvarṇanameva ca | sirāvyadho dhamanīnāṃ garbhiṇyā vyākṛtistathā ||16||
nirdiṣṭāni daśaitāni śārīrāṇi maharṣiṇā | vijñānārthaṃ śarīrasya bhiṣajāṃ yogināmapi ||17||
dvivraṇīyo vraṇaḥ sadyo bhagnānāṃ vātarogikam | mahāvātikamarśāṃsi sāśmariśca bhagandaraḥ ||18||
kuṣṭhānāṃ mahatāṃ cāpi maihikaṃ paiḍikaṃ tathā | madhumehacikitsā ca tathā codariṇāmapi ||19||
mūḍhagarbhacikitsā ca vidradhīnāṃ visarpiṇām | granthivṛddhyupadaṃśānāṃ tathā ca kṣudrarogiṇām ||20||
śūkadoṣacikitsā ca tathā ca mukharogiṇām | śophasyānāgatānāṃ ca niṣedho miśrakaṃ tathā ||21||
vājīkaraṃ ca yat kṣīṇe sarvābādhaśamo'pi ca | medhāyuṣkaraṇaṃ cāpi svabhāvavyādhivāraṇam ||22||
nivṛttasantāpakaraṃ kīrtitaṃ ca rasāyanam | snehopayaugikaḥ svedo vamane savirecane ||23||
tayorvyāpaccikitsā ca netrabastivibhāgikaḥ | netrabastivipatsiddhistathā cottarabastikaḥ ||24||

nirūhakramasañjñaśca tathaivāturasañjñakaḥ | dhūmanasyavidhiścāntyaścatvāriṃśaditi hārāṇacandrastu ‘agryāḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘agryāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ, agryatvaṃ tu rukpratīkārarūpamukhyakarmārthakatvāt’ iti vyākhyānayati smṛtāḥ ||25||
prāyaścittaṃ praśamanaṃ cikitsā śāntikarma ca | paryāyāstasya nirdeśāccikitsāsthānamucyate ||26||
annasya rakṣā vijñānaṃ sthāvarasyetarasya ca | sarpadaṣṭaviṣajñānaṃ tasyaiva ca cikitsitam ||27||
dundubhermūṣikāṇāṃ ca kīṭānāṃ kalpa eva ca | aṣṭau kalpāḥ samākhyātā viṣabheṣajakalpanāt ||28||

div.ab: adhyāyānāṃ śataṃ viṃśamevametadudīritam ‘saviṃśamadhyāyaśata...’ iti pāṭhāntaram|29|

ataḥ paraṃ svanāmnaiva tantramuttaramucyate ||29|| adhikṛtya kṛtaṃ yasmāttantrametadupadravān | aupadravika ityeṣa tasyāgryatvānnirucyate ||30|| sandhau vartmani śukle ca kṛṣṇe sarvatra dṛṣṭiṣu | saṃvijñānārthamadhyāyā gadānāṃ tu prati prati ||31|| cikitsāpravibhāgīyo vātābhiṣyandavāraṇaḥ | paittasya ślaiṣmikasyāpi raudhirasya tathaiva ca ||32|| lekhyabhedyaniṣedhau ca chedyānāṃ vartmadṛṣṭiṣu | kriyākalpo'bhighātaśca karṇotthāstaccikitsitam ||33|| ghrāṇotthānāṃ ca vijñānaṃ tadgadapratiṣedhanam | pratiśyāyaniṣedhaśca śirogadavivecanam ||34|| cikitsā tadgadānāṃ ca śālākyaṃ tantramucyate |35|

ab.seg: navagrahākṛtijñānaṃ skandasya ca niṣedhanam ||35||
apasmāraśakunyośca revatyāśca punaḥ pṛthak | pūtanāyāstathā'ndhāyāḥ śītapūtanamaṇḍikā ||36||
naigameṣacikitsā ca grahotpattiḥ sayonijā | kumāratantramityetacchārīreṣu ca kīrtitam ||37||
jvarātisāraśoṣāṇāṃ gulmahṛdrogiṇāmapi | pāṇḍūnāṃ raktapittasya mūrcchāyāḥ pānajāśca ye ||38||
tṛṣṇāyāśchardihikkānāṃ niṣedhaḥ śvāsakāsayoḥ | svarabhedacikitsā ca kṛmyudāvartinoḥ pṛthak ||39||
visūcikārocakayormūtrāghātavikṛcchrayoḥ | iti kāyacikitsāyāḥ śeṣamatra prakīrtitam ||40||
amānuṣaniṣedhaśca tathā''pasmāriko'paraḥ | unmādapratiṣedhaśca bhūtavidyā nirucyate ||41||
rasabhedāḥ svasthavṛttaṃ yuktayastāntrikāśca yāḥ | doṣabhedā iti jñeyā adhyāyāstantrabhūṣaṇāḥ ||42||
śreṣṭhatvāduttaraṃ hyetattantramāhurmaharṣayaḥ | bahvarthasaṅgrahācchreṣṭhamuttaraṃ vā'pi paścimam ||43||
śālākyatantraṃ kaumāraṃ cikitsā kāyikī ca yā | bhūtavidyeti catvāri tantre tūttarasañjñite ||44||
vājīkaraṃ cikitsāsu rasāyanavidhistathā | viṣatantraṃ punaḥ kalpāḥ śalyajñānaṃ samantataḥ ||45||
ityaṣṭāṅgamidaṃ tantramādidevaprakāśitam | vidhinā'dhītya yuñjānā bhavanti prāṇadā bhuvi ||46||
etaddhyavaśyamadhyeyam, adhītya ca karmāpyavaśyamupāsitavyam, ubhayajño hi bhiṣag rājārho bhavati ||47||
bhavanti cātra- yastu kevalaśāstrajñaḥ karmasvapariniṣṭhitaḥ | sa muhyatyāturaṃ prāpya prāpya bhīrurivāhavam ||48||
yastu karmasu niṣṇāto dhārṣṭyācchāstrabahiṣkṛtaḥ | sa satsu pūjāṃ nāpnoti vadhaṃ carcchati ‘cārhati’ iti pā. rājataḥ ||49||
ubhāvetāvanipuṇāvasamarthau svakarmaṇi | ardhavedadharāvetāvekapakṣāviva dvijau ||50||
oṣadhyo'mṛtakalpāstu śastrāśaniviṣopamāḥ | bhavantyajñairupahṛtāstasmādetān ‘etau’ iti pā. vivarjayet ||51||
snehādiṣvanabhijño yaśchedyādiṣu ca karmasu | sa nihanti janaṃ lobhāt kuvaidyo nṛpadoṣataḥ ||52||
yastūbhayajño matimān sa samartho'rthasādhane | āhave karma nirvoḍhuṃ dvicakraḥ syandano yathā ||53||

atha vatsa! tadetadadhyeyaṃ yathā tathopadhāraya mayā procyamānaṃ- atha śucaye kṛtottarāsaṅgāyāvyākulāyopasthitāyādhyayanakāle śiṣyāya yathāśakti gururupadiśet padaṃ pādaṃ ślokaṃ vā; te ca padapādaślokā bhūyaḥ krameṇānusandheyāḥ, evamekaikaśo ghaṭayedātmanā cānupaṭhet; adrutamavilambitamaviśaṅkitamananunāsikaṃ suvyaktākṣaramapīḍitavarṇamakṣibhruvauṣṭhahastairanabhinītaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ nātyuccairnātinīcaiśca svaraiḥ paṭhet | na cāntareṇa kaścidvrajet tayoradhīyānayoḥ ||54||
bhavataścātra | śucirguruparo dakṣastandrānidrāvivarjitaḥ | paṭhannetena vidhinā śiṣyaḥ śāstrāntamāpnuyāt ||55||
vāksauṣṭhave'rthavijñāne prāgalbhye karmanaipuṇe | tadabhyāse ca siddhau ca yatetādhyayanāntagaḥ ||56||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'dhyayanasampradānīyo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
athātaḥ prabhāṣaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
adhigatamapyadhyayanamaprabhāṣitamarthataḥ kharasya candanabhāra iva kevalaṃ pariśramakaraṃ bhavati ||3||
bhavati cātra- yathā kharaścandanabhāravāhī bhārasya vettā na tu candanasya | evaṃ hi śāstrāṇi bahūnyadhītya cārtheṣu mūḍhāḥ kharavadvahanti ||4||

tasmāt saviṃśamadhyāyaśatamanupadapādaślokamanuvarṇayitavyamanuśrotavyaṃ ‘…ślokārdhaśloka…’ iti pā. ca; kasmāt? sūkṣmā hi dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākadoṣadhātumalāśayamarmasirāsnāyusandhyasthigarbhasambhavadravyasamūhavibhāgāstathā pranaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇavraṇaviniścayabhagnavikalpāḥ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyatā ca vikārāṇāmevamādayaścānye viśeṣāḥ sahasraśo ye vicintyamānā vimalavipulabuddherapi buddhimākulīkuryuḥ kiṃ punaralpabuddheḥ, tasmādavaśyamanupadapādaślokamanuvarṇayitavyamanuśrotavyaṃ ‘… ślokārdhaśloka…’ iti pā. ca ||5||
anyaśāstropapannānāṃ cārthānāmihopanītānāmarthavaśātteṣāṃ tadvidyebhya eva vyākhyānamanuśrotavyaṃ, kasmāt? na hyekasmin śāstre śakyaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāmavarodhaḥ kartum ||6||
bhavanti cātra- ekaṃ śāstramadhīyāno na vidyācchāstraniścayam | tasmādbahuśrutaḥ śāstraṃ vijānīyāccikitsakaḥ ||7||
śāstraṃ gurumukhodgīrṇamādāyopāsya cāsakṛt | yaḥ karma kurute vaidyaḥ sa vaidyo'nye tu taskarāḥ ||8||
aupadhenavamaurabhraṃ sauśrutaṃ pauṣkalāvatam | śeṣāṇāṃ śalyatantrāṇāṃ mūlānyetāni nirdiśet ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne prabhāṣaṇīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
athāto'gropaharaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘karmaṇāmagre upaharaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ yantraśastrādīnāṃ tānyagropaharaṇāni, tānyadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyo'gropahaṇīyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
trividhaṃ karma- pūrvakarma, pradhānakarma, paścātkarmeti; tadvyādhiṃ pratyupadekṣyāmaḥ ||3||
asya tu śāstrasya śastrakarmaprādhānyācchastrakarmaiva tāvat pūrvamupadekṣyāmastatsambhārāṃśca ||4||
tacca śastrakarmā'ṣṭavidhaṃ; tadyathā- chedyaṃ, bhedyaṃ, lekhyaṃ, vedhyam, eṣyam, āhāryaṃ, visrāvyaṃ, sīvyamiti ||5||

ato'nyatamaṃ karma cikīrṣatā vaidyena pūrvamevopakalpayitavyāni bhavanti, tadyathā- yantraśastrakṣārāgniśalākāśṛṅgajalaukālābūjāmbavauṣṭhapicuprotasūtrapatrapaṭṭamadhughṛtavasāpayastaila- tarpaṇakaṣāyālepanakalkavyajanaśītoṣṇodakakaṭāhādīni, parikarmiṇaśca snigdhāḥ sthirā balavantaḥ ||6||

tataḥ praśasteṣu tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatreṣu dadhyakṣatānnapānaratnairagniṃ viprān bhiṣajaścārcayitvā, kṛtabalimaṅgalasvastivācanaṃ laghubhuktavantaṃ prāṅmukhamāturamupaveśya ‘prāṅmukhatvamāturasya pratyaṅmakhatvaṃ vaidyasya ca pūrvāhṇaviṣayamityāhuḥ, ālokena śastranipātasthānanirīkṣaṇasukaratvāt, tenāparāhṇe viparyayaṃ vidyāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, yantrayitvā ‘śastrapātapīḍayā calanenānyatra śastrāghātaśaṅkānivāraṇārthaṃ yattrayitveti’ iti catraḥ, pratyaṅmukho vaidyo marmasirāsnāyusandhyasthidhamanīḥ pariharan, anulomaṃ ‘anulomaṃ yathākramaṃ, kramastvatrānantaramupadeṣṭavyaśāstrāpekṣo vicārāpekṣaśca, tena yathāyogamiti tātparyārthaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ śastraṃ nidadhyādāpūyadarśanāt ‘āpūyadarśādityanena pūyaprāptyanantaraṃ śastrapraṇidhānaṃ niṣedhayati’ cakraḥ, sakṛdevāpaharecchastramāśu ca; mahatsvapi ca pākeṣu dvyaṅgulāntaraṃ ‘dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ veti āyatatvena pākapramāṇāpekṣayā vikalpanīyaṃ, na tu gāmbhīryeṇa| śastraṃ nidadhyādāpūyadarśanādityanenaiva tadupalabdhreḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘aṅguladvayamathavā'ṅgulatrayamantarīkṛtya punaranyavraṇaṃ kuryānna tvāsannam’ ityaruṇadattaḥ| ‘dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vā’ iti pā. tryaṅgulāntaraṃ vā śastrapadamuktam ||7||

tatrāyato viśālaḥ samaḥ suvibhakto nirāśraya atra ‘nirāśrayaḥ’ iti padaṃ hārāṇacandro na paṭhati iti vraṇaguṇāḥ ‘vraṇaguṇā iti vraṇe kartavye śothaguṇāḥ, atra śotho'pi vraṇahetutayā vraṇa ityucyate’ iti cakraḥ||8||

bhavataścātra- āyataśca viśālaśca suvibhakto nirāśrayaḥ ‘nirāśraya iti aṅgulyā'vamardanenonmūlitāśeṣapūyāśrayaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| prāptakālakṛtaścāpi ‘prāptakāle pākakāle kṛtaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vraṇaḥ karmaṇi śasyate ||9||
śauryamāśukriyā śastrataikṣṇyamasvedavepathu śastrataikṣṇyaṃ tu paramārthataḥ śastraguṇo'pi vaidyāyattatvādvaidyaguṇatvenoktam| asammohaśca vaidyasya śastrakarmaṇi śasyate ||10||

ekena vā vraṇenāśudhyamāne nā'ntarā ‘nāntareti samīpe hi kṛto vraṇo'pārthako bhavatīti madhyanikaṭārthayornikaṭārthasyaivāntarāśabdasya nañartha-na-śabdena samāsānmadhye dūre vetyarthaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ buddhyā'vekṣyāparān vraṇān kuryāt ||11||
bhavati cātra- yato yato gatiṃ ‘yato gatāṃ gatiṃ’ iti vāgbhaṭe pāṭhaḥ| ‘yato doṣagatiṃ’ iti pā. vidyādutsaṅgo yatra yatra ca | tatra tatra vraṇaṃ kuryādyathā doṣo na tiṣṭhati ||12||

tatra bhrūgaṇḍaśaṅkhalalāṭākṣipuṭauṣṭhadantaveṣṭakakṣākukṣivaṅkṣaṇeṣu tiryak cheda “tiryak chindyāllalāṭabhrūdantaveṣṭakajatruṇi| kukṣikakṣākṣikūṭauṣṭhakapolagalavaṅkṣaṇe|| anyatra chedanāttiryak sirāsnāyuvipāṭanam” (sū. a. 29) iti vāgbhaṭaḥ uktaḥ ||13||
(candramaṇḍalavacchedān pāṇipādeṣu kārayet | ardhacandrākṛtīṃścāpi gude meḍhre ca buddhimān) ||14||
anyathā tu sirāsnāyucchedanam, atimātraṃ vedanā, cirādvraṇasaṃroho, māṃsakandīprādurbhāvaśceti ||15||

mūḍhagarbhodarārśo'śmarībhagandaramukharogeṣvabhuktavataḥ ‘kenacidatrārśobhagandarāvapi paṭhyete, tadayuktaṃ, cikitsite tayoḥ śastrakarmaṇaḥ prāgbhojanavidhānādevatadarthānuvādinā vāgbhaṭenāpyapaṭhitvācca’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘arśodhikāre tvanilapraśamanārthaṃ ‘snigdhamuṣṇamalpamannaṃ dravaprāyaṃ bhuktavantaṃ’ iti vacanaṃ tu tathābhojanaṃ darśayatīti na virodhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ karma kurvīta ||16||

tataḥ śastramavacārya,śītābhiradbhirāturamāśvāsya, samantāt paripīḍyāṅgulyā, vraṇamabhimṛdya(jya), prakṣālya kaṣāyeṇa protenodakamādāya ‘udakaṃ vraṇāntargatamaniḥsṛtaṃ prakṣālanodakaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, tilakalkamadhusarpiḥpragāḍhāmauṣadhayuktāṃ nātisnigdhāṃ nātirūkṣāṃ vartiṃ vikeśikāmityarthaḥ praṇidadhyāt; tataḥ kalkenācchādya, ghanāṃ kavalikāṃ dattvā, vastrapaṭṭena badhnīyāt; vedanārakṣoghnairdhūpairdhūpayet, rakṣoghnaiśca mantrai rakṣāṃ kurvīta ||17||
tato guggulvagurusarjarasavacāgaurasarṣapacūrṇairlavaṇanimbapatravimiśrairājyayuktairdhūpayet | ājyaśeṣeṇa cāsya prāṇān samālabheta ||18||
udakumbhāccāpo gṛhītvā prokṣayan rakṣākarma kuryāt; tadvakṣyāmaḥ- ||19||
kṛtyānāṃ pratighātārthaṃ tathā rakṣobhayasya ca | rakṣākarma kariṣyāmi brahmā tadanumanyatām ||20||
nāgāḥ piśācā gandharvāḥ pitaro yakṣarākṣasāḥ | abhidravanti ye ye tvāṃ brahmādyā ghnantu tān sadā ||21||
pṛthivyāmantarīkṣe ca ye caranti niśācarāḥ | dikṣu vāstunivāsāśca pāntu tvāṃ te namaskṛtāḥ ||22||
pāntu tvāṃ munayo brāhmayā divyā rājarṣayastathā | parvatāścaiva nadyaśca sarvāḥ sarve ca sāgarāḥ ||23||
agnī rakṣatu te jihvāṃ prāṇān vāyustathaiva ca | somo vyānamapānaṃ te parjanyaḥ parirakṣatu ||24||
udānaṃ vidyutaḥ pāntu samānaṃ stanayitnavaḥ | balamindro balapatirmanurmanye matiṃ tathā ||25||
kāmāṃste pāntu gandharvāḥ sattvamindro'bhirakṣatu | prajñāṃ te varuṇo rājā samudro nābhimaṇḍalam ||26||
cakṣuḥ sūryo diśaḥ śrotre candramāḥ pātu te manaḥ | nakṣatrāṇi sadā rūpaṃ chāyāṃ pāntu niśāstava ||27||
retastvāpyāyayantvāpo romāṇyoṣadhayastathā | ākāśaṃ khāni te pāntu dehaṃ tava vasundharā ||28||
vaiśvānaraḥ śiraḥ pātu viṣṇustava parākramam | pauruṣaṃ puruṣaśreṣṭho brahmā''tmānaṃ dhruvo bhruvau ||29||
etā dehe viśeṣeṇa tava nityā hi devatāḥ | etāstvāṃ satataṃ pāntu dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi ||30||

svasti te bhagavān brahmā svasti ‘svasti nāradaparvatau’ iti pā. devāśca kurvatām | (svasti ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate te candrasūryau ca svasti nāradaparvatau) | svastyagniścauva vāyuśca svasti devāḥ sahendragāḥ ||31||
pitāmahakṛtā rakṣā svastyāyurvardhatāṃ tava | ītayaste praśāmyantu sadā bhava gatavyathaḥ ||32||
iti svāhā | etairvedātmakairmantraiḥ kṛtyāvyādhivināśanaiḥ | mayaivaṃ kṛtarakṣastvaṃ dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi ||33||
tataḥ kṛtarakṣamāturamāgāraṃ praveśya, ācārikamādiśet ‘evamāhāravihārau kartavyāvityupadiśet| ācāraśabdena caratergatibhakṣaṇārthatvādāhāro'pi labdhaḥ’ cakraḥ||34||
tatastṛtīye'hani vimucyaivameva badhnīyādvastrapaṭṭena; na cainaṃ tvaramāṇo'paredyurmokṣayet ||35||
dvitīyadivasaparimokṣaṇādvigrathito ‘vigrathito granthirūpaḥ samyaganaṅkurita iti yāvat’ cakraḥ vraṇaścirādupasaṃrohati, tīvrarujaśca bhavati ||36||
ata ūrdhvaṃ doṣakālabalādīnavekṣya kaṣāyālepanabandhāhārācārān vidadhyāt ||37||

na cainaṃ tvaramāṇaḥ sāntardoṣaṃ ropayet; sa hyalpenāpyapacāreṇābhyantaramutsaṅgaṃ ‘utsaṅgaṃ pākāvadāraṇādibhiḥ kroḍavannimnaṃ kṛtvā, vikaroti vikṛtatvena pariṇamati’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ kṛtvā bhūyo'pi vikaroti ||38||

bhavanti cātra- tasmādantarbahiścaiva suśuddhaṃ ropayedvraṇam | rūḍhe'pyajīrṇavyāyāmavyavāyādīn vivarjayet | harṣaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ cāpi yāvat ‘yāvadāsthairyasambhavāt’ iti pā. sthairyopasambhavāt ||39||
hemante śiśire caiva vasante cāpi mokṣayet | tryahāddvyahāccharadgrīṣmavarṣāsvapi ca buddhimān ||40||
atipātiṣu rogeṣu necchedvidhimimaṃ bhiṣak | pradīptāgāravacchīghraṃ tatra kuryāt pratikriyām ||41||
yā vedanā śastranipātajātā tīvrā śarīraṃ pradunoti jantoḥ | dhṛtena sā śāntimupaiti siktā koṣṇena yaṣṭīmadhukānvitenā ||42||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'gropaharaṇīyo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
athāta ṛtucaryamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kālo hi nāma (bhagavān ‘bhagavān’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate ) svayambhuranādimadhyanidhanaḥ | atra rasavyāpatsampattī jīvitamaraṇe ca manuṣyāṇāmāyatte ‘manuṣyāṇāmiti atrādhikṛtatvānnirdeśaḥ, tena paśvādīnāmapi jīvitamaraṇe kālādhīne jñeya’ cakraḥ| sa sūkṣmāmapi kalāṃ hārāṇacandrastu ‘sūkṣmāmapi kalāṃ līyate’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca- ‘sūkṣmāmapi kālāṃśaviśeṣaṃ līyate śliṣyati kālasya sarvabhūrtasaṃyogitvāt’ iti na līyata iti kālaḥ, saṅkalayati kālayati vā bhūtānīti kālaḥ ||3||

tasya saṃvatsarātmano ‘saṃvatsaraḥ ātmā svarūpaṃ yasya tasya mahākālasya saṃvatsararūpeṇa vyavahārapathārūḍhasyetyarthaḥ|’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ bhagavānādityo gativiśeṣeṇākṣinimeṣakāṣṭhākalāmuhūrtāhorātrapakṣamāsartvayanasaṃvatsarayugapravibhāgaṃ karoti ||4||

tatra laghvakṣaroccāraṇamātro'kṣinimeṣaḥ, pañcadaśā'kṣinimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhā, triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalā, viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ kalādaśabhāgaśca, triṃśanmuhūrtamahorātraṃ, pañcadaśāhorātrāṇi pakṣaḥ, sa ca dvividhaḥ- śuklaḥ kṛṣṇaśca, tau māsaḥ ||5||

tatra māghādayo dvādaśa māsāḥ, dvimāsikamṛtuṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti; te śiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣāśaraddhemantāḥ | teṣāṃ tapastapasyau śiśiraḥ, madhumādhavau vasantaḥ, śuciśukrau grīṣmaḥ, nabhonabhasyau varṣāḥ, iṣorjau śarat, sahaḥsahasyau hemanta iti ||6||

ta ete śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāścandrādityayoḥ ‘candrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvāt kledanaśoṣaṇādinā candrādityayoḥ śītoṣṇādiprabhedakaratvāt| śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāḥ atiśītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāstrayo mandaśītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāstraya iti ṣaḍṛtavo dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ ca dve ayane bhavata iti yojanā| na tu candrādityayoḥ kālavibhāgakaratvādayane dve bhavataḥ, candrasyāyanakartṛtvenānabhidhānāt| ...idamatrāvadheyaṃ- dvādaśarāśyātmakasya rāśicakrasyārdhaṃ karkaṭādidhanuḥparyantaṃ rāśiśaṭkaṃ krameṇa dakṣiṇāvanataṃ, tatra sthita ādityo yadā svagatyā prācīṃ gacchannapi kiñcitkiñcittiryaggatyā dakṣiṇāmayate sa kālo dakṣiṇāyanam| tathā makarādimithunaparyanntaṃ rāśiṣaṭkaṃ krameṇottarāvanataṃ, tatra sthita ādityo yadā prāgvaduttarāmayate sa kāla uttaramayanam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ kālavibhāgakaratvādayane dve bhavato dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ ca | tayordakṣiṇaṃ varṣāśaraddhemantāḥ; teṣu bhagavānāpyāyate somaḥ, amlalavaṇamadhurāśca rasā balavanto bhavanti, uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balamabhivardhate | uttaraṃ ca śiśiravasantagrīṣmāḥ, teṣu bhagavānāpyāyate'rkaḥ, tiktakaṣāyakaṭukāśca rasā balavanto bhavanti, uttarottaraṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ balamupahīyate ||7||
bhavati cātra- śītāṃśuḥ kledayatyurvīṃ vivasvān śoṣayatyapi | tāvubhāvapi ‘vāyorubhayārthakartṛtvaṃ yogavāhitayā jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ saṃśritya vāyuḥ pālayati prajāḥ ||8||

atha khalvayane dve yugapat saṃvatsaro bhavati | te tu pañca yugamiti sañjñāṃ labhante | sa eṣa nimeṣādiryugaparyantaḥ kālaścakravat parivartamānaḥ kālacakramityucyata ityeke ‘eke iti rasabalādijanakaśiśirādyṛtukramavādinaḥ’ iti cakraḥ||9||

iha tu varṣāśaraddhemantavasantagrīṣmaprāvṛṣaḥ ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti, doṣopacayaprakopopaśamanimittaṃ; te tu bhādrapadādyena dvimāsikena vyākhyātāḥ; tadyathā- bhādrapadāśvayujau varṣāḥ, kārtikamārgaśīrṣau śarat, pauṣamāghau hemantaḥ, phālgunacaitrau vasantaḥ, vaiśākhajyeṣṭhau grīṣmaḥ; āṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau prāvṛḍiti ||10||

tatra, varṣāsvoṣadhayastaruṇyo'lpavīryā āpaścāpraśāntāḥ ‘āpaścāprasannāḥ’ iti pā. kṣitimalaprāyāḥ, tā upayujyamānā nabhasi meghāvatate jalapraklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ prāṇināṃ śītavātaviṣṭambhitāgnīnāṃ ‘śītavātaviṣṭabdhāgnīnāṃ’ iti pā. vidahyante, vidāhāt pittasañcayamāpādayanti; sa sañcayaḥ śaradi praviralameghe viyatyupaśuṣyati paṅke'rkakiraṇapravilāyitaḥ paittikān vyādhīñjanayati | tā evauṣadhayaḥ kālapariṇāmāt pariṇatavīryā balavatyo hemante bhavantyāpaśca praśāntāḥ snigdhā atyarthaṃ gurvyāśca, tā upayujyamānā mandakiraṇatvādbhānoḥ satuṣārapavanopastambhitadehānāṃ ‘satuṣāropastambhitadehānāṃ’ iti pā. dehināmavidagdhāḥ snehācchaityādgauravādupalepācca śleṣmasañcayamāpādayanti; sa sañcayo vasante'rkaraśmipravilāyita īṣatstabdhadehānāṃ dehināṃ ślaiṣmikān vyādhīñjanayati | tā evauṣadhayo nidāghe niḥsārā rūkṣā atimātraṃ laghvyo bhavantyāpaśca, tā upayujyamānāḥ sūryapratāpopaśoṣitadehānāṃ dehināṃ raukṣyāllaghutvācca ‘raukṣyāllaghutvādvaiśadyācca’ iti pā. vāyoḥ sañcayamāpādayanti; sa sañcayaḥ prāvṛṣi cātyarthaṃ jalopaklinnāyāṃ bhūmau klinnadehānāṃ dehināṃ śītavātavarṣerito vātikān vyādhīñjanayati | evameṣa doṣāṇāṃ sañcayaprakopaheturuktaḥ ||11||
tatra varṣāhemantagrīṣmeṣu sañcitānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ śaradvasantaprāvṛṭsu ca prakupitānāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kartavyam ||12||

tatra paittikānāṃ vyādhīnāmupaśamo hemante, ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ nidāghe, vātikānāṃ śaradi ‘ghanātyaye’ iti pā., svabhāvata eva; ta ete sañcayaprakopopaśamā vyākhyātāḥ etadanantaraṃ ‘cayaprakopopaśamā doṣāṇāṃ hi dvayorapi| sandhau sādhāraṇa vatsa bhaviṣyadvartamānayoḥ|| ṛtusandhau tu doṣāṇāṃ cayādyāḥ parikalpanāḥ| evamprakārā vyākhyātā vidhiṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param|| hrāsayedalpaśo'bhyastaṃ vartamānartukaṃ vidhim| bhaviṣyadṛtukaṃ cāpi yatetābhyāsakāraṇāt|| yāvantaṃ hrāsayetpūrvaṃ tāvantaṃ sa bhajetparam| syū rogāstyāgasevābhyāṃ sahasā'sātmyasambhavāḥ|| vahnipraṇāśavaiṣamye syātāṃ cāsātmyasevanāt| tasmādyathoktamabhyasyedṛtusandhau vidhiṃ naraḥ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate ‘kvacitpustake||13||

tatra, pūrvāhṇe vasantasya liṅgaṃ, madhyāhne grīṣmasya, aparāhṇe prāvṛṣaḥ ‘prāvṛṣeṇyaṃ’ iti pā., pradoṣe vārṣikaṃ, śāradamardharātre, pratyuṣasi haimantamupalakṣayet; evamahorātramapi varṣamiva śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇaṃ doṣopacayaprakopopaśamairjānīyāt ||14||
tatra, avyāpanneṣu ṛtuṣvavyāpannā oṣadhayo bhavantyāpaśca; tā upayujyamānāḥ prāṇāyurbalavīryaujaskaryo bhavanti ||15||
teṣāṃ punarvyāpado'dṛṣṭakāritāḥ, śītoṣṇavātavarṣāṇi khalu ‘khalu’ iti kvacitpustake na paṭhyate viparītānyoṣadhīrvyāpādayantyapaśca ||16||
tāsāmupayogādvividharogaprādurbhāvo marako vā bhavediti ||17||
tatra, avyāpannānāmoṣadhīnāmapāṃ copayogaḥ ||18||

kadācidavyāpanneṣvapi ṛtuṣu kṛtyābhiśāparakṣaḥkrodhādharmairupadhvasyante janapadāḥ, viṣauṣadhipuṣpagandhena vā vāyunopanītenākramyate yo deśastatra doṣaprakṛtyaviśeṣeṇa kāsaśvāsavamathupratiśyāyaśirorugjvarairupatapyante, grahanakṣatracaritairvā, gṛhadāraśayanāsanayānavāhanamaṇiratnopakaraṇagarhitalakṣaṇanimittaprādurbhāvairvā ||19||
tatra, sthānaparityāgaśāntikarmaprāyaścittamaṅgalajapahomopahārejyāñjalinamaskārataponiyama- dayādānadīkṣābhyupagamadevatābrāhmaṇaguruparairbhavitavyam, evaṃ sādhu bhavati ||20||
ata ūrdhvamavyāpannānāmṛtūnāṃ lakṣaṇānyupadekṣyāmaḥ ||21||
vāyurvātyuttaraḥ śīto rajodhūmākulā diśaḥ | channastuṣāraiḥ savitā himānaddhā jalāśayāḥ ||22||
darpitā dhvāṅkṣakhaṅgāhvamahiṣorabhrakuñjarāḥ | rodhrapriyaṅgupunnāgāḥ puṣpitā himasāhvaye ||23||
śiśire śītamadhikaṃ vātavṛṣṭyākulā diśaḥ | śeṣaṃ hemantavat sarvaṃ vijñeyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ budhaiḥ ||24||
siddhavidyādharavadhūcaraṇālaktakāṅkite | malaye candanalatāpariṣvaṅgādhivāsite ||25||
vāti kāmijanānandajanano'naṅgadīpanaḥ | dampatyormānabhiduro vasante dakṣiṇo'nilaḥ ||26||
diśo vasante vimalāḥ kānanairupaśobhitāḥ | kiṃśukāmbhojabakulacūtāśokādipuṣpitaiḥ ||27||
kokilāṣaṭpadagaṇairupagītā manoharāḥ | dakṣiṇānilasaṃvītāḥ sumukhāḥ pallavojjvalāḥ ||28||
grīṣme tīkṣṇāṃśurādityo māruto naiṛuto'sukhaḥ etadanantaraṃ ‘avermadāvaho'tyartha kevalaṃ rāsabhoṣṭrayoḥ’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate kvacitpustake| bhūstaptā saritastanvyo diśaḥ prajvalitā iva ||29||
bhrāntacakrāhvayugalāḥ payaḥpānākulā mṛgāḥ | dhvastavīruttṛṇalatā viparṇāṅkitapādapāḥ ||30||

prāvṛṣyambaramānaddhaṃ paścimānilakarṣitaiḥ etadanantaraṃ ‘kurvadbhiścātakān hṛṣṭān haṃsānmānasagāminaḥ| bhīmasantamase sāyaṃ pathi durgamakardame|| jaghanodvahanaklāntāḥ pramṛṣṭāsāramaṇḍanāḥ| taḍitprabhāhṛtālokanimīlannayanotpalāḥ|| garjitadhvaninā trastahṛdayāścābhisārikāḥ| mecakaprotasaṅkāśairmedhairuccāmbubhūṣaṇaiḥ|| jitahaṃsāvalīkāntibalākāpaṅktisāritaiḥ| kekāgarjavala(garbhagalo)dgrīvanṛtyadbarhiṇavīkṣitaiḥ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate kacitpustake| ambudairvidyududdyotaprasrutaistumulasvanaiḥ ||31||
komalaśyāmaśaṣpāḍhyā śakragopojjvalā mahī | kadambanīpakuṭajasarjaketakabhūṣitā ||32||
tatra ‘tato varṣāsu’ iti pā. varṣāsu nadyo'mbhaśchannokhātataṭadrumāḥ ‘nadyambhaḥ pūrodbhagnataṭadrumāḥ’ iti pā.| vāpyaḥ protphullakumudanīlotpalavirājitāḥ ||33||
bhūravyaktasthalaśvabhrā bahuśasyopaśobhitā | nātigarjatsravanmeghaniruddhārkagrahaṃ ‘niruddharkṣagrahaṃ’ iti pā. nabhaḥ ||34||
babhruruṣṇaḥ śaradyarkaḥ śvetābhravimalaṃ nabhaḥ | tathā sarāṃsyamburuhairbhānti haṃsāṃsaghaṭṭitaiḥ ||35||
paṅkaśuṣkadrumākīrṇā nimnonnatasameṣu bhūḥ | bāṇasaptāhvabandhūkakāśāsanavirājitā ‘…pakvaśasyavirājitā|’ iti pā.||36||
svaguṇairatiyukteṣu viparīteṣu vā punaḥ | viṣameṣvapi vā doṣāḥ kupyantyṛtuṣu dehinām ||37||
haredvasante śleṣmāṇaṃ pittaṃ śaradi nirharet | varṣāsu śamayedvāyuṃ ‘nirharedvāyuṃ’ iti pā. prāgvikārasamucchrayāt ||38||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne ṛtucaryā nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
athāto yantravidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

yantraśatamekottaram; atra hastameva pradhānatamaṃ yantrāṇāmavagaccha, (kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ‘nanvanantaramupayantreṣu paṭhiṣyamāṇo hastaḥ kathaṃ pradhānatama iti pṛcchati- kiṃ kāraṇamiti, uttarayati- yasmāditi’| iti hārāṇacandraḥ|| ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustakeṣu na paṭhyate ? yasmāddhastādṛte yantrāṇāmapravṛttireva) tadadhīnatvādyantrakarmaṇām ||3||

tatra, manaḥśarīrābādhakarāṇi śalyāni; teṣāmāharaṇopāyo yantrāṇi atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “nānāvidhānāṃ śalyānāṃ nānādeśaprabādhinām| āhartumabhyupāyo yastadyantraṃ, yacca darśane|| arśobhagandarādīnāṃ, śastrakṣārāgniyojane| śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāṃ, tathā bastyādikarmaṇi| ghaṭikālābuśṛṅgaṃ ca jāmbavauṣṭhādikāni ca’- iti| (vā. sū. a. 25)||4||
tāni ṣaṭprakārāṇi; tadyathā- svastikayantrāṇi, sandaṃśayantrāṇi, tālayantrāṇi, nāḍīyantrāṇi, śalākāyantrāṇi, upayantrāṇi ceti ||5||

tatra caturviṃśatiḥ svastikayantrāṇi yāni yantrāṇi madhye kīlabaddhatvāduddhāṭitāni svastikākārāṇi jāyante tāni svastikayantrāṇi| ‘svastikamiva svastikaṃ| dakṣiṇasya bāhorvāme gamanaṃ, vāmasya dakṣiṇe iti svastikatā’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ, dve sandaṃśayantre, dve eva tālayantre ‘dve eva tālayantre’ ityevakāreṇāsya dvitvāyogavyavacchedāttatsannidhāvaniyamena dvitvenopadiṣṭasya sandaṃśayantrasya bahutvamapyurarīkurvanti| ata eva śāstramidamanuvadatā vāgbhaṭena ‘kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau’ ityādinā catvāri sandaṃśayantrāṇyupadiṣṭāni| evaṃ coddeśe sandaṃśayantrāṇīti nānupapannaṃ, tadgatabhedena bahutvāt| tālayantrāṇīti bahuvacanaṃ tu nakṣatreṣu phalgunīproṣṭhapadānāmivānyatarasyāṃ bhūmni viṣayatvādityavaśyaṃ vaktavyaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, viṃśatirnāḍyaḥ, aṣṭāviṃśatiḥ śalākāḥ, pañcaviṃśatirupayantrāṇi ||6||
tāni prāyaśo lauhāni bhavanti; tatpratirūpakāṇi vā tadalābhe ||7||

tatra, nānāprakārāṇāṃ vyālānāṃ vyālamukhasādṛśyaṃ tu svastikayantrāṇāṃ mukhāntarbhāga eva jñeyaṃ, na tu bāhyato'pi mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ mukhairmukhāni yantrāṇāṃ prāyaśaḥ ‘prāyaśograhaṇādvinā'pi vyālamukhasādṛśyaṃ nāḍīyantrādīni bhavantīti darśayati, vyālamukhasādṛśyaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇasvastikayantrāṇāmeva| anyayantradarśanāditi anyayantradarśanaṃ tu vinā'pi sārūpyaṃ śāstravacanaṃ vṛddhopadeśaṃ vā prāmāṇikakṛtamidaṃ yantramiti kṛtvā yantrakaraṇaṃ prayojayatīti hetvantaraṃ bhavati’ iti cakraḥ sadṛśāni; tasmāttatsārūpyādāgamādupadeśādanyayantradarśanādyuktitaśca kārayet ||8||
samāhitāni yantrāṇi kharaślakṣṇamukhāni ca | sudṛḍhāni surūpāṇi sugrahāṇi ca kārayet ||9||

tatra svastikayantrāṇi- aṣṭādaśāṅgulapramāṇāni, siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣvṛkṣadvīpimārjāraśṛgālamṛgairvārukakākakaṅkakuraracāsabhāsaśaśaghātyulūkacilliśyena- gṛdhrakrauñcabhṛṅgarājāñjalikarṇāvabhañjananandīmukhamukhāni ‘... bhṛṅgarājāñjalīkakarṇāvabhañjana...’ iti pā., masūrākṛtibhiḥ kīlairavabaddhāni masūrākṛtibhiḥ kīlairiti masūrākāraprāntaiḥ kīlairityarthaḥ| tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ- “masūrākāraparyantaiḥ kaṇṭhe baddhāni kīlakaiḥ”- iti, mūle'ṅkuśavadāvṛttavāraṅgāṇi ‘vāraṅgaṃ grahaṇasthānam’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ| ‘vāraṅgaḥ khaḍgādimuṣṭau’ iti śabdārthacintāmaṇiḥ| ‘āvṛttavāraṅgāṇi bhugnavāraṅgāṇi’ iti cakraḥ, asthividaṣṭaśalyoddharaṇārthamupadiśyante ‘teṣāṃ siṃhavyāghrabhujaṅgamakarādimukhāni dṛśyavāraṅgeṣu prayojayet, itareṣu tu vraṇākārānurodhena kaṅkakākakurarādimukhāni’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe (sū. a. 34) vṛddhavāgbhaṭaḥ||10||

sanigraho'nigrahaśca ‘sanibandhano'nibandhanaśca sandaṃsau’ iti hastalikhatapustake pāṭha upalabhyate, vṛddhāvāgbhaṭe'pi “sanibandhano nirnibandhanaśca sandaṃśau dvau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ”- ityeva paṭhyate sandaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ, tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyugataśalyoddharaṇārthamupadiśyete vṛddhavāgbhaṭe sandaṃśadvayamadhikamuktam| yathā- “tathā'nyaḥ sandaṃśaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulo'rdhāṅgulavistṛto vakradvibāhuraṅguliprāntasamāgamākṛtiḥ sūkṣmaśalyākṣipakṣmavraṇādhimāṃsaharaṇe| tadvacca mucuṇḍī, sā tu ṛjuślakṣṇā sūkṣmadantā saktadvibhujā mūle rucakanaddhā valayapīḍanācchinnārmaśeṣagambhīravraṇādhimāṃsaharaṇe’ (aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahaḥ, sūtrasthānam, adhyāyaḥ 34)- iti||11||

tālayantre tālapadaṃ ca loke gartavācakaṃ hradavācakaṃ vā dṛṣṭam- yathā bhīmatālādipade| ‘matsyatālavaditi matsyacakravadekatālamanavabaddhe śalye, dvitālaṃ tu avabaddhe śalye’ iti cakraḥ| ‘matsyagalatālakavat’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe - dvādaśāṅgule matsyatālavadekatāladvitālake, karṇanāsānāḍīśalyānāmāharaṇārtham ||12||

nāḍīyantrāṇi ‘nāḍīvanmadhyaśuṣirāṇi nāḍīyantrāṇi’ iti cakraḥ - anekaprakārāṇi, anekaprayojanāni, ekatomukhānyubhayatomukhāni ca; tāni srotogataśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ, rogadarśanārtham, ācūṣaṇārthaṃ, kriyāsaukaryārthaṃ ceti; tāni srotodvārapariṇāhāni, yathāyogadīrghāṇi ca | tatra bhagandarārśovraṇabastyuttarabastimūtravṛddhidakodaradhūmaniruddhaprakaśasanniruddhagudayantrāṇyalābūśṛṅgayantrāṇi bhagandarayantrādīnāṃ tantrāntaroktalakṣaṇādikaṃ, pratikṛtiḥ, samprati pāścātyaistadarthaṃ vyavahriyamāṇayantraiḥ saha sādṛśyādikaṃ ca tatra tatraiva darśayiṣyāmaḥvraṇabastiyantralakṣaṇaṃ vṛddhavāgbhaṭe evaṃ paṭhyate| yathā- “nāḍīvraṇaprakṣālanābhyañja nayantre ṣaḍaṅgule bastiyantrākāre mukhato'karṇike mūlamukhayoraṅguṣṭhakalāyapraveśasrotasī mūle nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī ca”- iti copariṣṭādvakṣyāmaḥ vṛddhavāgbhaṭe tvetāni nāḍīyantrāṇyadhikānyuktāni| yathā- “kaṇṭhaśalyadarśanārthaṃ nāḍīṃ daśāṅgulāyatāṃ pañcāṅgulapariṇāhām| dvikarṇasya tu vāraṅgasya saṅgrahārthaṃ tricchidramukhāṃ nāḍīṃ tatpramāṇataḥ kuryāt, tathā catuṣkarṇasya pañcacchidramukhām| śalyanirghātanīṃ tu padmakarṇikākāraśīrṣāṃ dvādaśāṅgulāṃ tryaṅgulasuṣirām||13||

śalākāyantrāṇyapi nānāprakārāṇi, nānāprayojanāni, yathāyogapariṇāhadīrghāṇi ca; teṣāṃ gaṇḍūpadasarpaphaṇaśarapuṅkhabaḍiśamukhe ‘sarpaphaṇamukhe dve’ iti ekaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamaparaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamiti bhedena sarpaphaṇamukhasya dvaividhyaṃ jñeyaṃ| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “ubhau teṣāṃ ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṅgalau| vyūhane'hiphaṇāvakrau”- (sū. a. 26) iti‘śarapuṅkhamukhe dve’ iti ekaṃ daśāṅgulamaparaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamiti bhedena śarapuṅkhamukhasya dvaividhyaṃ jñeyam| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “dvau daśadvādaśāṅgulau| cālane śarapuṅkhāsyau”- iti‘baḍiśamukhe dve’ iti svānatanātyānatabhedena baḍiśamukhasya dvaividhyaṃ jñeyam dve dve, eṣaṇavyūhanacālanāharaṇārthamupadiśyete hārāṇacandrastu ‘gaṇḍūpadaśarapuṅkhasarpaphaṇabaḍiśamukhe dve dve’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyāti ca- ‘eṣaṇādikarmaiṣāṃ yathāyogameva bodhyaṃ na tu yathāsaṅkhyam’ iti; masūradalamātramukhe ‘masūradalamātramukhe dve’ iti ekamaṣṭāṅgulamaparaṃ navāṅgulaṃ| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “srotobhyaḥ śalyahāriṇī|| masūradalavakre dve syātāmaṣṭanavāṅgule”- iti dve kiñcidānatāgre srotogataśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ; ṣaṭ kārpāsakṛtoṣṇīṣāṇi atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣāḥ śalākāḥ ṣaṭ pramārjane| pāyāvāsannadūrārthe dve daśadvādaśāṅgule|| dve ṣaṭsaptāṅgule ghrāṇe, dve karṇe'ṣṭanavāṅgula”- iti, pramārjanakriyāsu; trīṇi darvyākṛtīni khallamukhāni, kṣārauṣadhapraṇidhānārthaṃ atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “aṣṭāṅgulā nimnamukhāstisraḥ kṣārauṣadhakrame| kanīnīmadhyamānāmīnakhamānasamairmukhaiḥ”- iti|| ‘khallamukhānīti khallamauṣadhamardanapātramiva mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni tathoktāni’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ; trīṇyanyāni atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānāṃ kṣāre'gnau ca pṛthak trayam|| yuñjayāt sthūlāṇudīrghāṇām”- iti jāmbavavadanāni, trīṇyaṅkuśavadanāni, ṣaḍevāgnikarmasvabhipretāni; nāsārbudaharaṇārthamekaṃ kolāsthidalamātramukhaṃ khallatīkṣṇauṣṭhaṃ “nāsetyādinoktamapyagnikarmasvabhipreyate| yaduktaṃ “kolāsthidalatulyāsyā nāsārśo'rbudadāhakṛt (vā. sū. a. 25)” iti” hārāṇacandraḥ; añjanārthamekaṃ kalāyaparimaṇḍalamubhayato mukulāgraṃ; mūtramārgaviśodhanārthamekaṃ mālatīpuṣpavṛntāgrapramāṇaparimaṇḍalamiti vāgbhaṭe karṇaśodhanaṃ, garbhaśaṅkuḥ, antravardhmaśalāketi śalākāyantratrayamadhikamuktam| yadāha- “karṇaśodhanamaśvatthapatraprāntaṃ sruvānanam”- iti| tathā “nato'gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkuriti smṛtaḥ| aṣṭāṅgulāyatastena mūḍhagarbhaṃ haret striyāḥ”- iti| tathā- “śalākāmantravardhmani| madhyordhvavṛttadanḍāṃ ca mūle cārdhendusannibhām” iti| antravardhmaśalākā aprāptaphalakośāyāmantravṛddhyāṃ dāhārthamupayujyate| yathoktaṃ cikitsite (a. 19) ‘tatra yā vaṅkṣaṇasthāṃ tāṃ dahedardhenduvakrayā’ iti||14||
upayantrāṇyapi- rajjuveṇikāpaṭṭacarmāntavalkalalatāvastrāṣṭhīlāśmamudgarapāṇipādatalāṅgulijihvā- dantanakhamukhabālāśvakaṭakaśākhāṣṭhīvanapravāhaṇaharṣāyaskāntamayāni kṣārāgnibheṣajāni ceti ||15||
etāni dehe sarvasmin dehasyāvayave tathā | sandhau koṣṭhe dhamanyāṃ ca yathāyogaṃ prayojayet ||16||

yantrakarmāṇi tu- nirghātanapūraṇabandhanavyūhanavartanacālanavivartanavivaraṇapīḍanamārgaviśodhanavikarṣaṇāharaṇāñchanonnamana- vinamanabhañjanonmathanācūṣaṇaiṣaṇadāraṇarjūkaraṇaprakṣālanapradhamanapramārjanāni ‘vartanaṃ bhagnāsthyādīnāṃ yathāyathaṃ sthāpanaṃ, cālanaṃ galādāvavabaddhāsthiśalyādīnāmapanayanaṃ, vivartanaṃ parāṅmukhībhūtasyāsthyāderapavartanam, āñchanamatikṣiptasyāsthnaḥ kuñcitasya vā'ṅgulyāderāyamanaṃ, bhañjanaṃ śalyakarṇāderāpothanaṃ khaṇḍanaṃ vā, dāraṇaṃ viṣasaṃhitānāmasthnāṃ dvidhākaraṇam, ṛjukaraṇaṃ kuñcitasya gātrasya bandhanādinā saralīkaraṇam’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ caturviṃśatiḥ ||17||
svabuddhyā cāpi vibhajedyantrakarmāṇi buddhimān | asaṅkhyeyavikalpatvācchalyānāmiti niścayaḥ ||18||
tatra, atisthūlam, asāram, atidīrgham, atihrasvam, agrāhi, viṣamagrāhi, vakraṃ, śithilam, atyunnatam, mṛdukīlaṃ, mṛdumukhaṃ, mṛdupāśam, iti dvādaśa yantradoṣāḥ ||19||
etairdoṣairvinirmuktaṃ yantramaṣṭādaśāṅgulam | praśastaṃ bhiṣajā jñeyaṃ taddhi karmasu yojayet ||20||
dṛśyaṃ siṃhamukhādyaistu gūḍhaṃ kaṅkamukhādibhiḥ | nirhareta śanaiḥ śalyaṃ śāstrayuktivyapekṣayā ‘śalyaṃ svastikayantraistu nirhareta bhiṣagvaraḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||21||
ni(vi)vartate sādhvavagāhate ca śalyaṃ nigṛhyoddharate ca yasmāt | yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhi(vi)kāri caiva ||22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||

div.head: śastrāvacāraṇīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śastrāvacāraṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

viṃśatiḥ ‘ekaviṃśatiḥ śastrāṇi| tadyathā- maṇḍalāgrārdhamaṇḍalakarapatra...’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| vāgbhaṭe (sū. a. 26) sarpāsyaṃ, liṅganāśavyadhanī śalākā, kūrcaḥ, khajaḥ, karṇapālīvyadhanaṃ, karṇavedhanī ceti ṣaṭśastrāṇyadhikānyuktāni| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni kramaśo yathā- ‘sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇāśaśchedane'rdhāṅgulaṃ phale’ iti| ‘tāmrī śalākā dvimukhī mukhe kuruvakākṛtiḥ| liṅganāśaṃ tayā vidhyet’| sarvavṛttāstāścaturaṅgulāḥ| kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ| saṃyojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane’, tāḥ sūcyaḥ| ‘ardhāṅgulamukhairvṛttairaṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ| pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāttena haredasṛk’| ‘vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam’| ‘bahalāyāśca śasyate| sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī’ iti | ‘sūcīkūrco vṛttaikamūlo'gre sunibaddhasaptāṣṭasūcikaḥ kuṣṭhaśvitrendraluptasuptādiṣu| khajastvardhāṅgulāyatāṣṭakaṇṭakamukhastāmro lauho vā nāsābhyantaragataśoṇitamokṣārthaḥ| karṇavyadhanaṃ tryaṅgulāyatamaṅgulaśuṣiraṃ ghanaṃ yūthikāmukulāgram” (vṛ. vā. sū. 34)| karṇavyadhanaṃ śuṣirabhāge bheryākṛti iti induḥ śastrāṇi, tadyathā- maṇḍalāgrakarapatravṛddhipatranakhaśastramudrikotpalapatrakārdhadhārasūcīkuśapatrāṭīmukha- śarārimukhāntarmukhatrikūrcakakuṭhārikāvrīhimukhārāvetasapatrakabaḍiśadantaśaṅkveṣaṇya iti ||3||

tatra maṇḍalāgrakarapatre ‘ardhamaṇḍalāgramaṇḍalāgrakarapatrāṇi cchedane lekhane ca’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ syātāṃ chedane lekhane ca, vṛddhipatranakhaśastramudrikotpalapatrakārdhadhārāṇi chedane bhedane ca, sūcīkuśapatrāṭī(ṭā)mukhaśarārimukhāntarmukhatrikūrcakāni visrāvaṇe, kuṭhārikāvrīhimukhārāvetasapatrakāṇi vyadhane sūcī ca, baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścāharaṇe, eṣaṇyeṣaṇe eṣaṇe iti apāṭite'vidīrṇe vā vraṇaśothe bhedanapūrvakameṣaṇe tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhī eṣaṇī syādityarthaḥ| pāṭitānāṃ vidīrṇānāṃ vā vraṇānāmeṣaṇe tu yantrādhyāyapaṭhitā gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī eva prayujyate| ānulomye tu prathamayavapatramukhī syāditi jñeyam| ‘anye punaḥ eṣaṇīnāṃ tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhatva-prathamayavapatramukhatva-gaṇḍūpadamukhatva-bhedādbahutvaṃ, tena ‘eṣaṇyaḥ eṣaṇe’ iti bahuvacanaṃ paṭhanti’ iti cakraḥ| “ānulomye teṣāmeva (bhagandarādīnāṃ) chedānukrame, ta eva hyeṣaṇyanusāriṇā śastreṇa yathākramamāmūlaṃ chidyante, vakṣyati ca “eṣaṇīṃ dattvā śastraṃ pātayet” iti hārāṇacandraḥ ānulomye ca, sūcyaḥ sīvane; ityaṣṭavidhe karmaṇyupayogaḥ śastrāṇāṃ vyākhyātaḥ “śastrāṇi tu ṣaḍviṃśatirbhavanti| tadyathā- dantalekhanamaṇḍalāgravṛddhipatrotpalapatrādhyardhadhāramudrikākartarīsarpavaktrakarapatrakuśapatrāṭāmukhāntarmukhaśarārimukhatrikūrcaka- kuṭhārikāvrīhimukhaśalākāvetasapatrārākarṇavyadhanasūcīsūcīkūrcakhajaiṣaṇībaḍiśanakhaśastrāṇi ceti| tatra trayamādyaṃ lekhane, vṛddhipatrādīni trīṇi pāṭane, catvāri bhedane, maṇḍalāgrādīnyaṣṭau chedane, kuśapatrādīni pañca pracchāne, kuṭhārikādīni ṣaṭ vyadhane, teṣāmārāvrīhimukhe bhedane chedane ca, sūcyaḥ sīvane, sūcīkūrcaḥ kuṭṭane, khajo mathane, eṣaṇyeṣaṇe bhedane ca, baḍiśo grahaṇe, nakhaśastramuddharaṇe chedyabhedyalekhyapracchāneṣu ca| iti dvādaśavidhe śastrakarmaṇyupayogaḥ” iti (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34)||4||

teṣāmatha yathāyogaṃ ‘teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ grahaṇaṃ karmasu| eṣa śastragrahaṇasamāsaḥ| vṛddhipatraṃ tu’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| ‘yathāyogamiti yathā bhedyādi śastrakarma yuktaṃ yogyaṃ bhavati tathā śastragrahaṇaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ grahaṇasamāsopāyaḥ karmasu vakṣyate- tatra vṛddhipatraṃ vṛntaphalasādhāraṇe bhāge gṛhṇīyāt, bhedanānyevaṃ sarvāṇi, vṛddhipatraṃ maṇḍalāgraṃ ca kiñciduttānena pāṇinā lekhane bahuśo'vacāryaṃ, vṛntāgre visrāvaṇāni, viśeṣeṇa tu bālavṛddhasukumārabhīrunārīṇāṃ rājñāṃ rājamā(pu)trāṇāṃ ca trikūrcakena visrāvayet, talapracchāditavṛntamaṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ vrīhimukhaṃ, kuṭhārikāṃ vāmahastanyastāmitarahastamadhyamāṅgulyā'ṅguṣṭhaviṣṭabdhayā'bhihanyāt ‘viṣṭabdhayeti stambhanābhivardhitavegayā’ iti cakraḥ, ārākarapatraiṣaṇyo mūle, śeṣāṇi tu yathāyogaṃ ‘yathāyogamiti yathā samyagyogaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare| tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhairgṛhṇīyāt susamāhitaḥ|| visrāvaṇāni vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakena ca| talapracchannavṛntāgraṃ grāhyaṃ vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe|| mūleṣvāharaṇārthāni kriyāsaukaryato'param”- (vā. sū. a. 26) iti gṛhṇīyāt ||5||
teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa prāyeṇeti vacanādāgamametattantramāgamāntaraṃ ca śastrākārābhidhāyakaṃ darśayati’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyātāḥ ||6||

tatra nakhaśastraiṣaṇyāvaṣṭāṅgule ‘cakrastu ‘nakhavardhanyeṣaṇyau’ iti paṭhati vyākhyāti ca- ‘vardhanī chedanī, ‘vṛdhu’ chedane, ityasmāt sādhyam’ iti| “nakhaśastramaṣṭāṅgulamekato'śvakarṇamukhamanyato vatsadantamukhaṃ sūkṣmaśalyoddhṛtau” (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34) ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe, sūcyo vakṣyante, (pradeśinyagraparvapradeśapramāṇā ‘mudrikāyāṃ nibaddhaṃ syādvṛddhipatrasalakṣaṇam| dvyaṅgulaṃ mudrikāśastraṃ kṣurasaṃsthānameva ca” iti bhānumatyāṃ bhālukiḥ| mudrikāśastraṃ vāgbhaṭe'ṅguliśastramiti nāmnā paṭhyate| tallakṣaṇaṃ yathā- ‘kuryādaṅguliśastrakam| mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ phale tvardhāṅgulāyatam| yogato vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā samam|| tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| sūtrabaddhaṃ galasrotorogacchedanabhedane”- iti| “aṅgulīśastrakaṃ mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ vṛddhipatramaṇḍalāgrādhyardhadhārānyatamatulyārdhāṅgulāyatadhāraṃ pradeśinīprathamaparvapramāṇāparṇavṛttamudrikaṃ dṛḍhasūtrapratibaddhaṃ kaṇṭharogeṣu prayujyate” (vṛ. vā. sū. a. 34) ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe mudrikā, daśāṅgulā ‘prastutāni śastrāṇi vyākhyāya, anantaramupayogitvenānupekṣyatvāccharārimukhāvāntarabhedabhinnaṃ śastrāntaramupadiśati- daśetyādinā| kartarī romādicchedārthaḥ śastraviśeṣaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ śarārimukhī sā ca (yā sā) kartarīti kathyate) | śeṣāṇi tu ṣaḍaṅgulāni ||7||
tāni sugrahāṇi, sulohāni, sudhārāṇi, surūpāṇi, susamāhitamukhāgrāṇi, akarālāni, ceti śastrasampat ||8||

tatra vakraṃ, kuṇṭhaṃ, khaṇḍaṃ, kharadhāram, atisthūlam, atyalpam, atidīrgham, atihrasvam, ityaṣṭau śastradoṣāḥ | ato viparītaguṇamādadīta, anyatra karapatrāt; taddhi kharadhāramasthicchedanārtham ||9||

tatra vṛddhavāgbhaṭe tu ‘dhārā punaśchedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānāmardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī’- iti paṭhyate dhārā bhedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānāmardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī, chedanānāmardhakaiśikīti ||10||

baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścānatāgre | tīkṣṇakaṇṭakaprathamayavapatramukhyeṣaṇī (gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī atraiṣaṇīlakṣaṇe ‘gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī ca’ iti pāṭho'nārṣaḥ, gaṇḍūpadākāramukhyā eṣaṇyā dhārārahitatvena śastratvābhāvāt| tasmādgaṇḍūpadākāramukhī eṣaṇī yantrameva, tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhī prathamayavapatramukhī ceti dvividhameva eṣaṇīśastram| ‘atra śastre baḍiśaṃ paṭhyate yantre ca, ubhayatrāpi cāharaṇaṃ karma kartavyaṃ, tathā eṣaṇyapi śastre yantre ca paṭhyate, eṣaṇaṃ ca ubhayatrāpi karmoktaṃ, tat kathamanayorbhedaḥ ...paraṃ yantrakarmāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śarīrahiṃsāvyatirekeṇa kriyamāṇaṃ jñeyaṃ| śastrakarmāharaṇameṣaṇaṃ ca śarīrahiṃsāyuktaṃ, śastraṃ hi śarīrahiṃsakamiti ‘śasu’ hiṃsāyāmiti dhātvarthādapi bhavati| tena yatrāharaṇe eṣaṇe vā śarīrāvayavahiṃsā tacchastrakarma, śarīrahiṃsakaṃ tu yantrakarma, anenaiva ca karmabhedena yantraśastrayorapi bheda iti paśyāmaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| hārāṇacandrastu ‘baḍiśaṃ dantaśaṅkuścānatāgre tīkṣṇakaṇṭaprathamayavapatramukhe, eṣaṇī gaṇḍūpadākāramukhī’ iti paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- “śaṅkuḥ kīlaka iveti śaṅkuḥ, dantaśodhanaḥ śaṅkurdantaśaṅkuriti śākapārthivāditvādrūpasiddhiḥ| ānatāgraṃ baḍiśamānatāgraśca dantaśaṅkurityānatāgre ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena’ iti klībaśeṣaḥ| te punastīkṣṇakaṇṭakaprathamayavapatramukhe ityanvayaḥ| tathā ca tīkṣṇakaṇṭakamukhaṃ baḍiśaṃ prathamayavapatramukhaśca dantaśaṅkurityarthaḥ| atra gaṇḍūpadākāramukhatvena śastrābhāve'pyeṣaṇyāḥ śastratvena vyapadeśaḥ praṇidhānadoṣācchatravatkāryakarī bhavatītyākhyātuṃ, ato'vahitenaiṣā praṇidheyeti” ca) ||11||

teṣāṃ pāyanā nirvṛttānāṃ śastrāṇāṃ (agnitaptānāṃ) tatkṣaṇāddravadravyeṣu nirvāpaṇaṃ pāyanā’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ trividhā kṣārodakataileṣu | tatra kṣārapāyitaṃ śaraśalyāsthicchedaneṣu, udakapāyitaṃ māṃsacchedanabhedanapāṭaneṣu, tailapāyitaṃ sirāvyadhanasnāyucchedaneṣu ||12||

teṣāṃ niśānārthaṃ ślakṣṇaśilā māṣavarṇā; dhārāsaṃsthāpanārthaṃ ‘dhārāsampādanārthaṃ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ śālmalīphalakamiti vāgbhaṭe śastrasaṃsthāpanārthaṃ śastrakośo'pyuktaḥ| yathā- “syānnavāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ| kṣaumapatrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ| vinyastapāśaḥ susyūtaḥ sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ| śalākāpihitāsyaśca śastrakośaḥ susañcayaḥ”- iti| ‘sāntarāṇi savyavadhānāni, ūrṇāsthāni śastrāṇi yasmin sa sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ’ ityaruṇadattaḥ||13||
bhavati cātra- yadā suniśitaṃ śastraṃ romacchedi susaṃsthitam | sugṛhītaṃ pramāṇena tadā karmasu yojayet ||14||
anuśastrāṇi tu tvaksārasphaṭikakācakuruvindajalaukognikṣāranakhagojīśephālikāśākapatrakarīrabālāṅgulaya kuruvindaḥ ‘kurunda’ iti prasiddho'tikaṭhinaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣaḥ iti ||15||

div.ab: śiśūnāṃ śastrabhīrūṇāṃ śastrābhāve ca yojayet | tvaksārādicaturvargaṃ chedye bhedye ca buddhimān ||16|| āhāryacchedyabhedyeṣu nakhaṃ śakyeṣu yojayet | vidhiḥ pravakṣyate paścāt kṣāravahnijalaukasām ‘paścādagnikṣārajalaukasām’ iti pā.||17|| ye syurmukhagatā rogā netravartmagatāśca ye | gojīśephālikāśākapatrairvisrāvayettu tān ||18|| eṣyeṣveṣaṇyalābhe tu bālāṅgulyaṅkurā hitāḥ |19|

ab.seg: śastrāṇyetāni matimān śuddhaśaikyāyasāni tu | kārayet karaṇaprāptaṃ karmāraṃ karmakovidam ||19||
prayogajñasya vaidyasya siddhirbhavati nityaśaḥ | tasmāt paricayaṃ kuryācchastrāṇāṃ grahaṇe ‘śastrāṇāmāditaḥ’ iti pā. sadā ||20||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastrāvacāraṇīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||

athāto yogyāsūtrīyamadhyāyaṃ “kartavyakarmaṇaḥ samyagyogāya tatsadṛśakarmābhyāso yogaḥ, tena yogāya prabhavatīti yogyā| prabhavatītyarthe taddhitaḥ, strītvaṃ svabhāvāt maitrīvat| tasyāḥ sūtraṃ yogyāsūtraṃ| tadadhikṛtya kṛto granthastaṃ tathā” iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

adhigatasarvaśāstrārthamapi śiṣyaṃ yogyāṃ kārayet | snehādiṣu chedyādiṣu ca karmapathamupadiśet | subahuśruto'pyakṛtayogyaḥ ‘yogāya samyagyogāya prabhavatīti yogyaḥ, tadviruddho'yogyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ karmasvayogyo bhavati ||3||

tatra, puṣpaphalālābūkālindakatrapusai(so)rvārukarkārukaprabhṛtiṣu chedyaviśeṣān darśayet, utkartanāpakartanāni ‘utkartanaparikartanāni’ iti pā. copadiśet; dṛtibastiprasevakaprabhṛtiṣūdakapaṅkapūrṇeṣu bhedyayogyāṃ; saromṇi ‘saromṇītyanena lekhyasyānulomakartavyatāṃ sūcayati, pratilome hi lekhye rujāprādurbhāvo raktātipravṛttiśca’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ carmaṇyātate lekhyasya; mṛtapaśusirāsūtpalanāleṣu ca vedhyasya; ghuṇopahatakāṣṭhaveṇunalanālīśuṣkālābūmukheṣveṣyasya; panasabimbībilvaphalamajjamṛtapaśudanteṣvāhāryasya; madhūcchiṣṭopalipte śālmalīphalake visrāvyasya; sūkṣmaghanavastrāntayormṛducarmāntayośca sīvyasya; pustamayapuruṣāṅgapratyaṅgaviśeṣeṣu bandhanayogyāṃ; mṛduṣu māṃsakhaṇḍeṣvagnikṣārayogyāṃ; mṛducarmamāṃsapeśīṣūtpalanāleṣu ca karṇasandhibandhayogyām; udakapūrṇaghaṭapārśvasrotasyalābūmukhādiṣu ca netrapraṇidhānabastivraṇabastipīḍanayogyāmiti ||4||
bhavataścātra- evamādiṣu medhāvī yogyārheṣu yathāvidhi | dravyeṣu yogyāṃ kurvāṇo na pramuhyati karmasu ||5||
tasmāt kauśalamanvicchan śastrakṣārāgnikarmasu | yasya yatreha sādharmyaṃ tatra yogyāṃ samācaret ||6||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yogyāsūtrīyo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||

athāto viśikhānupraveśanīyamadhyāyaṃ “viśikhā'tra karmamārga ucyate, taduddiśyānupraveśanaṃ| yadi vā viśikhā rathyaiva, tasyāṃ cikitsārthamanupraveśanam” iti cakraḥ| “praśastavartmāparaparyāyo'pi viśikhāśabdo'trāturāvāsavartmamātre pravartate, gamakatvāt” iti hārāṇacandraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

adhigatatantreṇopāsitatantrārthena dṛṣṭakarmaṇā kṛtayogyena śāstraṃ nigadatā ‘śāstrārthaṃ nigadatā’ pā. rājānujñātena ‘niṣpannena vaidyena prajāpālake rājñi ātmā guṇato darśanīyaḥ, tato rājñā parīkṣya vaidyaḥ prajārakṣārthamanumantavya eṣa dharmaḥ| aniṣpannavaidyaguṇāścikitsāṃ kurvāṇo lokāpakārakatayā rājñā śāsanīyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ nīcanakharomṇā śucinā śuklavastraparihitena chatravatā daṇḍahastena sopānatkenānuddhataveśena sumanasā kalyāṇābhivyāhāreṇākuhakena bandhubhūtena bhūtānāṃ susahāyavatā vaidyena viśikhā'nupraveṣṭavyā ||3||

tato dūtanimittaśakunamaṅgalānulomyenāturagṛhamabhigamya, upaviśya, āturamabhipaśyet spṛśet pṛcchecca | tribhiretairvijñānopāyai rogāḥ prāyaśo veditavyā ityeke; tattu na samyak, ṣaḍvidho hi rogāṇāṃ vijñānopāyaḥ, tadyathā- pañcabhiḥ śrotrādibhiḥ praśnena ceti ||4||

tatra śrotrendriyavijñeyā ‘śabdendriyavijñeyā’ iti pā. viśeṣā rogeṣu vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyādiṣu vakṣyante- ‘tatra saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchati’(sū. a.26) ityevamādayaḥ, sparśanendriyavijñeyāḥ śītoṣṇaślakṣṇakarkaśamṛdukaṭhinatvādayaḥ (sparśaviśeṣā ‘sparśaviśeṣāḥ’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate ) jvaraśophādiṣu, cakṣurindriyavijñeyāḥ śarīropacayāpacayāyurlakṣaṇabalavarṇavikārādayaḥ, rasanendriyavijñeyāḥ pramehādiṣu rasaviśeṣāḥ, ghrāṇendriyavijñeyā ‘gandhendriyavijñeyā’ iti pā. ariṣṭaliṅgādiṣu vraṇānāmavraṇānāṃ ca gandhaviśeṣāḥ, praśnena ca vijānīyāddeśaṃ kālaṃ jātiṃ sātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balamantaragniṃ ‘dīptāgnitāṃ’ iti pā. vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ pravṛttimapravṛttiṃ kālaprakarṣādīṃśca viśeṣān | ātmasadṛśeṣu hārāṇacandrastu ‘ātmāsadṛśeṣu’ iti paṭhati vyākhyāti ca- “nanvātmano hīnendriyatve kā gatirityāha- ātmāsadṛśeṣvityādi| ucitāparaparyāyo'yaṃ sadṛśaśabdaḥ ‘sadṛśaṃ same ucite’ iti medinī| tataścātmāsadṛśeṣu ātmano'nuciteṣu ayukteṣu hīneṣvati yāvat, vijñānābhyupāyeṣu vijñānopāyeṣvindriyeṣu satsvityarthaḥ, tatsthānīyairāturāvāsasthaiḥ puruṣairjānīyāt tāṃstānindriyavijñeyān viṣayān bhiṣagityarthaḥ| ‘ātmasadṛśeṣu’ iti prāmādikaḥ pāṭhaḥ” iti| “tribhiretairvijñānopāyairdīrghāyuṣo'lpāyuṣaśca veditavyāḥ| tatra dṛṣṭvā śarīropacayāpacayau varṇavikṛtiṃ chāyāṃ cāturasya bhiṣagjānīyāt, spṛṣṭvā śītoṣṇādīn sparśaviśeṣān viparītāviparītān jvaraśophādiṣu, pṛṣṭvā deśaṃ kālaṃ jātisātmyamātaṅkasamutpattiṃ vedanāsamucchrāyaṃ balābalamagniṃ vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāmapravṛttiṃ pravṛttiṃ ceti” iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vijñānābhyupāyeṣu tatsthānīyairjānīyāt ||5||
evamabhisamīkṣya sādhyān sādhayet, yāpyān yāpayet, asādhyānnaivopakrameta, parisaṃvatsarotthitāṃśca vikārān prāyaśo varjayet ||6||

bhavati cātra- mithyādṛṣṭā mithyetyādi|- dṛśiratra pratyakṣaparaḥ, pañcendriyavijñānādhikārāt| tadayamarthaḥ- mithyādṛṣṭā yāthātathyenāvijñātāḥ, durākhyātāḥ samyaṅnākhyātāḥ, duḥparimṛṣṭāḥ duṣpṛṣṭhāḥ| pūrveṇaivopalbdhe punarduṣparimṛṣṭeti viśeṣaṇaṃ hriyā jugupsayā vā alpīyaso'pyavayavasya parimṛśyatve'parihāryatvamāviṣkartumityāhuḥ, siddhe satyārambho niyamāyeti nyāyāt” iti hārāṇacandraḥ vikārā hi durākhyātāstathaiva ca | tathā duṣparimṛṣṭāśca mohayeyuścikitsakam ||7||

tatra sādhyā api vyādhayaḥ prāyeṇaiṣāṃ duścikitsyatamā bhavanti | tadyathā- śrotriyanṛpatistrībālavṛddhabhīrurājasevakakitavadurbalavaidyavidagdhavyādhigopakadaridrakṛpaṇakrodhanānāmanātmavatāmanāthānāṃ ca; evaṃ nirūpya cikitsāṃ kurvan dharmārthakāmayaśāṃsi prāpnoti ||8||

bhavati cātra- strībhiḥ sahāsyāṃ saṃvāsaṃ parihāsaṃ ca varjayet | dattaṃ ca tābhyo nādeyamannādanyadbhiṣagvaraiḥ dattaṃ tābhyo na gṛhrīyādannādanyadbhiṣak sadā| vedotpattiḥ śiṣyadīkṣā dānamadhyayanasya ca| prabhāṣaṇaṃ cāgraharamṛtucaryā tathaiva ca| yantraśastrāvacāraṃ ca yogyāsūtrīyameva ca| viśikhānupraveśaṃ ca daśakaḥ pramamo mataḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viśikhānupraveśanīyo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||

div.head: kṣārapākavidhyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣārapākavidhimadhyāyaṃ pacanaṃ pākaḥ, vidhiravacāraṇaṃ, kṣārasya pākavidhī yatra taṃ kṣārapākavidhim vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śastrānuśastrebhyaḥ kṣāraḥ pradhānatamaḥ, chedyabhedyalekhyakaraṇāt tridoṣaghnatvādviśeṣakriyāvacāraṇācca ‘chedyādikartṛtvaṃ kṣārasya bhagandaracchedanāḍīdāraṇakuṣṭhalekhanādinā” iti cakraḥ||3||
tatra kṣaraṇāt kṣaṇanādvā kṣāraḥ ||4||

nānauṣadhisamavāyāttridoṣaghnaḥ naca vācyaṃ yadvātaharādikṣāradravyāṇāṃ dagdhatvānna tadguṇānvayo bhasmanīti, dṛṣṭo hi bhasmanyapi prakṛtiguṇānvayaḥ, uktaṃ hi ‘sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmavāri nihanti raktaṃ’ (u. taṃ. a. 45) ityādi” iti cakraḥ, śuklatvāt ‘dahanapacanādikartṛtayā āgneyatvam kṣārasya sphuṭaṃ, pittajayāya svaguṇaṃ saumyatvamasphuṭaṃ sphorayannāha- śuklatvāt saumya iti| saumyatve'pyasya nahi śītatvam, uṣṇatvasyaiva darśanāt| bhūtānāṃ cādṛṣṭaviśeṣayantrito melakaviśeṣaḥ samānāśrayamapi guṇaṃ nārabhate| yathā āmalake amlatvamārabhate noṣṇatvam’ iti cakraḥ saumyaḥ; tasya saumyasyāpi sato dahanapacanadāraṇādiśaktiraviruddhā, āgneyauṣadhiguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvāt ‘sa khalvā...’ iti pā. kaṭuka uṣṇastīkṣṇaḥ pācano vilayanaḥ śodhano ropaṇaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ stambhano ‘stambhanaḥ sirācchedādatipravṛttasya śoṇitasya, kṣāro hi chinnaṃ sirāmukhaṃ pācayitvā śoṇitagatiṃ niruṇaddhi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ lekhanaḥ kṛmyāmakaphakuṣṭhaviṣamedasāmupahantā puṃstvasya cātisevitaḥ ||5||
sa dvividhaḥ- pratisāraṇīyaḥ, pānīyaśca ||6||

tatra pratisāraṇīyaḥ kuṣṭhakiṭibhadadrumaṇḍalakilāsabhagandarārbudārśoduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīla- tilakālakanyacchavyaṅgamaśakabāhyavidradhikṛmiviṣādiṣūpadiśyate atra vidradhiśabdo na paṭhyate hastalikhitapustakeṣu, saptasu ca mukharogeṣūpajihvādhijihvopakuśadantavaidarbheṣu tisṛṣu ca rohiṇīṣu, eteṣvevānuśastrapraṇidhānamuktam ‘kṣāro hi śoṇitena saha sambhūya tāni tāni karmāṇi karotītyāha- eteṣvityādi| eteṣu kuṣṭhādiṣu, cakārāt kaṭhināśrayeṣu tādṛśeṣu kaṭhinotsannavraṇamāṃsādiṣu caivānuśastrapraṇidhānaṃ yathāyogaṃ śastrānuśastrapraṇidhānānantaraṃ kṣārapraṇidhānamuktaṃ pūrvācāryairiti śeṣaḥ”| iti hārāṇacandraḥ||7||
pānīyastu garagulmodarāgnisaṅgājīrṇārocakānāha- śarkarāśmaryābhyantaravidradhikṛmiviṣārśaḥsūpayujyate atrārocakavidradhiśabdau na paṭhyete keṣucitpustakeṣu||8||
ahitastu raktapittajvaritapittaprakṛtibālavṛddhadurbalabhrama- madamūrcchātimiraparītebhyo'nyebhyaścaivaṃvidhebhyaḥ ||9||
taṃ cetarakṣāravaddagdhvā parisrāvayet; tasya vistaro'nyatra ||10||

athetarastrividho athetaro mṛdurmadhyastīkṣṇaśca’ iti pā. mṛdurmadhyastīkṣṇaśca | taṃ cikīrṣuḥ śaradi girisānujaṃ śucirupoṣya ‘śucirupavasanniti kṣāradrumasthitabhūtavighnopaśamārthaṃ, evameva ca grahaṇe bhaiṣajyaṃ guṇayuktaṃ bhavatīti darśayituṃ’ iti cakraḥ praśaste'hani praśastadeśajātamanupahataṃ madhyamavayasaṃ mahāntamasitamuṣkakamadhivāsyāparedyuḥ ‘asitamokṣakaṃ’ iti pā.‘adhivāsyeti samantrabalikarmādinā'dhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā’ iti cakraḥtato'paredyuḥ” iti pā. pāṭayitvā khaṇḍaśaḥ prakalpyāvapāṭya nivāte deśe nicitiṃ hārāṇacandrastu nicitaṃ kṛtvā’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca -nicitaṃ kṛtvā rāśīkṛtya’ kṛtvā sudhāśarkarāśca prakṣipya tilanālairādīpayet | athopaśānte'gnau tadbhasma pṛthaggṛhṇīyādbhasmaśarkarāśca | athānenaiva vidhānena kalpena iti pā. kuṭajapalāśāśvakarṇapāribhadrakabibhītakāragvadhatilvakārkasnuhyapāmārgapāṭalānaktamālavṛṣakadalī- citrakapūtīkendravṛkṣāsphotāśvamārakasaptacchadāgnimanthaguñjāścatasraśca kośātakīḥ samūlaphalapatraśākhā dahet | tataḥ kṣāradroṇamudakadroṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirāloḍya mūtrairvā yathoktairekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ parisrāvya, mahati kaṭāhe śanairdarvyā'vaghaṭṭayan vipacet | sa yadā bhavatyaccho raktastīkṣṇaḥ picchilaśca tamādāya mahati vastre parisrāvyetaraṃ vibhajya punaragnāvadhiśrayet | tata eva kṣārodakāt kuḍavamadhyardhaṃ vā'panayet | tataḥ kaṭaśarkarābhasmaśarkarākṣīrapākaśaṅkhanābhīragnivarṇāḥ kṛtvā''yase pātre tasminneva kṣārodake niṣicya piṣṭvā tenaiva dvidroṇe'ṣṭapalasammitaṃ śaṅkhanābhyādīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ prativāpya atra guṇotkarṣārthamanuktānyapi dakṣaśakṛdādīnyāvāpyānyāhuḥ- “ślakṣṇaṃ śakṛddakṣaśikhigṛdhrakaṅkakapotajam| catuṣpātpakṣipittālamanohvālavaṇāni ca’ (vā. sū. a. 30) iti prakṣepādhikāre tantrāntarānuśāsanāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ, satatamapramattaścainamavaghaṭṭayan vipacet | sa yathā nātisāndro nātidravaśca bhavati tathā prayateta | athainamāgatapākamavatāryānuguptamāyase “āyase pātre iti lauhapātrasyaivātidṛḍhatvena kṣārābhedyatvāt| kiṃvā lauhapātre eva śaktyatiśayaḥ kṣārasya bhavatītyetadvacanādunnīyate’ iti cakraḥ kumbhe saṃvṛtamukhe nidadhyādeṣa madhyamaḥ ||11||

eṣa caivāpratīvāpaḥ kṣāro dvividhaḥ sapratīvāpo'pratīvāpaśca| āvāpānantaraṃ yatpunaḥ śaktyatiśayārthaṃ dīyate sa pratīvāpaḥ| tatrāpratīvāpo mṛduḥ saṃvyūhimasañjñaḥ, sapratīvāpaśca pākyasañjñastīkṣṇaḥ” iti cakraḥ pakvaḥ saṃvyūhimo mṛduḥ ||12||

pratīvāpe yathālābhaṃ dantīdravantīcitrakalāṅgalīpūtikapravālatālapatrīviḍasuvarcikākanakakṣīrīhiṅguvacātiviṣāḥ samāḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇāḥ śuktipramāṇāḥ pratīvāpaḥ | sa eva sapratīvāpaḥ pakvaḥ pākyastīkṣṇaḥ ||13||
teṣāṃ yathāvyādhibalamupayogaḥ ||14||
kṣīṇabale kṣīṇabalatvamatra dravakṣayādeva lakṣaṇīyaṃ| taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe- ‘balārthaṃ kṣīṇapānīye kṣārāmbu punarāvapet’ iti” iti hārāṇacandraḥ tu kṣārodakamāvapedbalakaraṇārtham ||15||

bhavataścātra- naivātitīkṣṇo ‘kṣārasyātitīkṣṇatvaṃ vākśatāt prāgeraṇḍanāladāhāt, mṛdutvaṃ cārvāgapyadāhāllakṣaṇīyaṃ| yaduktaṃ ‘yadyeraṇḍajanālameṣa dahati kṣāro varo vākśatāt’ iti | vākśatādyadi dahati tarhi varaḥ śreṣṭho'nyathā tvavaro'titīkṣṇatvena mṛdutvena ceti tātparyam” iti hārāṇacandraḥ na mṛduḥ śuklaḥ ślakṣṇo'tha picchilaḥ | aviṣyandī śivaḥ śīghraḥ kṣāro hyaṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||16||
atimārdavaśvaityauṣṇyataikṣṇyapaicchilyasarpitāḥ | sāndratā'pakvatā hīnadravyatā doṣa ucyate ||17||

tatra kṣārasādhyavyādhivyādhitamupaveśya nivātātape deśe'sambādhe'gropaharaṇīyoktena vidhānenopasambhṛtasambhāraṃ, tato'sya tamavakāśaṃ nirīkṣyāvaghṛṣyāvalikhya pracchayitvā ‘avaghṛṣyetyādipakṣatraye pittaduṣṭamuttānamavaghṛṣya, vātaduṣṭamanatyavagāḍhaṃ vā'valikhya, kaphaduṣṭamavagāḍhaṃ ca pracchayitveti vyavasthā” iti cakraḥ, śalākayā kṣāraṃ pratisārayet, dattvā vākśatamātramupekṣeta ||18||

div.ab: tasminnipatite vyādhau kṛṣṇatā dagdhalakṣaṇam ‘nipatite iti kṣārāpanīte vyādhau kṛṣṇatā dagdhalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam, etacca dāhe jñeyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ| vikāropaśamādyudarkajñeyamagre vakṣyati” iti cakraḥ|19|

ab.seg: tatrāmlavargaḥ śamanaḥ sarpirmadhukasaṃyutaḥ ||19||

atha cet sthiramūlatvāt “sthiramūlatvena dagdhalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati naca niḥśeṣavyādhiśātanaṃ, tatrāyaṃ lepaḥ- amlakāñjiketyādi” iti cakraḥ kṣāradagdhaṃ na śīryate | idamālepanaṃ tatra samagramavacārayet ||20||
amlakāñjikabījāni tilān madhukameva ca | prapeṣya samabhāgāni tenainamanulepayet ||21||

div.ab: tilakalkaḥ samadhuko ghṛtākto vraṇaropaṇaḥ |22|

ab.seg: rasenāmlena tīkṣṇena vīryoṣṇena ca yojitaḥ ||22||
āgneyenāgninā tulyaḥ kathaṃ kṣāraḥ praśāmyati | evaṃ cenmanyase vatsa! procyamānaṃ nibodha me ||23||
amlavarjān rasān kṣāre sarvāneva vibhāvayet | kaṭukastatra bhūyiṣṭho lavaṇo'nurasastathā | amlena saha saṃyuktaḥ sa ‘sa tīkṣṇalavaṇo rasaḥ’ iti pā. tīkṣṇalavaṇo rase ||24||

mādhuryaṃ bhajate'tyarthaṃ tīkṣṇabhāvaṃ vimuñcati | mādhuryācchamamāpnoti ‘etacca bahirantaścāmlena kṣāramādhuryānayanāt kṣāravikārahananamucyate| yaduktaṃ carake madātyayacikitsite amlena madyenāntarakṣāravikāraśamanaṃ, tathā hi “kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghramamlopasaṃhitaḥ” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti| bāhye tu kṣāre śītasparśatvādapi amlaṃ kṣāradāhaṃ hanti| yaduktaṃ viśvāmitre- “yataścoṣṇatamaḥ kṣāraḥ śaityaṃ cāmle rase'dhikam| tasmāt sekapradehābhyāmamlaḥ kṣāraṃ nivartayet” iti” cakraḥ vahniradbhirivāplutaḥ ||25||

div.ab: tatra samyagdagdhe vikāropaśamo lāghavamanāsrāvaśca |26|
hīnadagdhe todakaṇḍujāḍyāni vyādhivṛddhiśca |26|

ab.seg: atidagdhe dāhapākarāgasrāvāṅgamardaklamapipāsāmūrcchāḥ syurmaraṇaṃ vā ||26||
kṣāradagdhavraṇaṃ kṣāradagdhavraṇamiti hīnātidāhajaṃ vraṇaṃ” iti cakraḥ tu yathādoṣaṃ yathāvyādhi copakramet ||27||
atha naite kṣārakṛtyāḥ- tadyathā- durbalabālasthavirabhīrusarvāṅgaśūnodariraktapittigarbhiṇyṛtumatīpravṛddhajvaripramehirūkṣakṣatakṣīṇa- tṛṣṇāmūrcchopadrutaklībāpavṛttodvṛttaphalayonayaḥ ||28||
tathā marmasirāsnāyusandhitaruṇāsthisevanīdhamanīgalanābhinakhāntaḥśephaḥsrotaḥsvalpamāṃseṣu ca deśeṣvakṣṇośca na dadyādanyatra vartmarogāt ||29||

tatra kṣārasādhyeṣvapi vyādhiṣu śūnagātramasthiśūlinamannadveṣiṇaṃ hṛdayasandhipīḍopadrutaṃ ca kṣāro na sādhayati (durbalabālasthavirādīn pratisāraṇīya ayaṃ pāṭho mudritapustakeṣu na paṭhyate iti) ||30||
bhavati cātra- viṣāgniśastrāśanimṛtyukalpaḥ kṣāro bhavatyalpamatiprayuktaḥ | sa dhīmatā samyaganuprayukto rogānnihanyādacireṇa ghorān ||31||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kṣārapākavidhirnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||

div.head: agnikarmavidhyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'gnikarmavidhimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
kṣārādagnirgarīyān kriyāsu vyākhyātaḥ, taddagdhānāṃ rogāṇāmapunarbhāvādbheṣajaśastrakṣārairasādhyānāṃ ‘...raśakyānāṃ iti pā. tatsādhyatvācca ||3||

athemāni dahanopakaraṇāni bhavanti- tadyathā- pippalyajāśakṛdgodantaśaraśalākājāmbavauṣṭhetaralauhāḥ kṣaudraguḍasnehāśca | tatra, pippalyajāśakṛdgodantaśaraśalākāstvaggatānāṃ, jāmbavauṣṭhetaralauhā māṃsagatānāṃ, kṣaudraguḍasnehāḥ sirāsnāyusandhyasthigatānām tatra maśatilakālakacarmakīlasarukstabdhapramlānāṅgābhiṣyandādhimanthaśirobhrūlalāṭarujārditeṣu sūryakāntapippalyajāśakṛdgodantaśaraśalākābhistvagdāho yathāsvamabhiṣyandādiṣu tu bhrūśaṅkhalalāṭadeśeṣu| granthyarbudārśobhagandaragaṇḍamālāślīpadāntravṛddhiduṣṭavraṇagatināḍyavagāḍhapūyālasakeṣu jāmbavauṣṭhasūcīśalākāghṛtaguḍamadhumadhūcchiṣṭatailavasāhematāmrāyorūpyakāṃsyairmāṃsadāhaḥ, sirāsnāyusandhyasthicchedaśoṇitātipravṛttidantanāḍīśliṣṭavartmopapakṣmalagaṇaliṅganāśā- samyagvyadheṣu jāmbavauṣṭhasūcīśalākāmadhumadhūcchiṣṭaguḍasnehaiḥ sirādidāhaḥ| ... atha dāhārtamāturaṃ kṛtasvastyayanamupahṛtasarvopakaraṇaṃ prākśiraḥ saṃviṣṭamāptāvalambitaṃ kṛtvā vaidyo nirdhūmabṛhatsthiradīptakhadirabadarādyaṅgārairayoghaṭanaprakāreṇa bhastrānilādhmātairvyajanena cordhvānirgacchajjvālatayā''pāditāpādyamānabhāsurāgnivarṇairjāmbavauṣṭhādibhirvyādhipradeśādvalayārdhacandra- svastikāṣṭāpadabindurekhāpratisāraṇavikalpena muhurmuhurhitopahitābhirvāgbhiradbhiścāturamāśvāsayan dahedāsamyagdāhaliṅgotpatteḥ| ucchūnasuṣirapralūnadantanāḍīsajantuduṣṭavraṇeṣu tu snehamadhūcchiṣṭaguḍaiḥ pūrayitvā dahet| samyagdagdhe ca madhusarpiṣī dadyācchītasnigdhāṃśca pradehān’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahe (sū. a. 40)||4||
tatrāgnikarma sarvartuṣu kuryādanyatra śaradgrīṣmābhyāṃ; tatrāpyātyayike'gnikarmasādhye vyādhau tatpratyanīkaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā ||5||

sarvavyādhiṣvṛtuṣu ca picchilamannaṃ bhuktavataḥ; mūḍhagarbhāśmarībhagandarodarārśomukharogeṣvabhuktavataḥ ‘etacca picchilānnabhojanamagneranuśastratvena śastrakarmaṇi vihitabhojanān vyādhīn prati jñeyaṃ, tenārśaḥprabhṛtiṣvabhuktavatāmeva dāhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| hārāṇacandrastu ‘aśmarībhagandarārśomukharogeṣvabhuktavataḥ’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca- ‘mūḍhagarbhāśmarītyevamādistvanākaraḥ pāṭhaḥ, avivakṣitāgnikarmakatvānmūḍhagarbhasyetyavadheyam’ iti karma kurvīta ||6||

tatra dvividhamagnikarmāhureke- tvagdagdhaṃ, māṃsadagdhaṃ ca; iha tu sirāsnāyusandhyasthiṣvapi na pratiṣiddho'gniḥ vihita iti bhāṣāṃ tyaktvā ‘na pratiṣiddha’ iti bhāṣayā kevalātyayikaroga eva paraṃ sirādau kṣaudrādidravyaniyamena cāgnirdātavya iti darśayati’ cakraḥ||7||

tatra, śabdaprādurbhāvo durgandhatā tvaksaṅkocaśca tvagdagdhe, kapotavarṇatā'lpaśvayathuvedanā śuṣkasaṅkucitavraṇatā ca māṃsadagdhe; kṛṣṇonnatavraṇatā srāvasannirodhaśca sirāsnāyudagdhe, rūkṣāruṇatā karkaśasthiravraṇatā ca sandhyasthidagdhe ||8||
tatra śirorogādhimanthayorbhrūlalāṭaśaṅkhapradeśeṣu dahet, vartmarogeṣvārdrālaktakapraticchannāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vartmaromakūpān ||9||

tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthisthite'tyugraruji vāyāvucchritakaṭhinasuptamāṃse ‘duṣṭavraṇocchritakaṭhinamāṃsagranthyarbudāpacīgalagaṇḍagṛdhrasīmaśakagulmodarabhagandarārśaḥ- sandhiślīpadacarmakīlatilakālakasirācchedanāḍīśoṇitātipravṛttiṣu’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vraṇe granthyarśo'rbudabhagandarāpacīślīpadacarmakīlatilakālakāntravṛddhisandhisirācchedanādiṣu nāḍīśoṇitātipravṛttiṣu cāgnikarma kuryāt ||10||
tatra valaya-bindu-vilekhā-pratisāraṇānīti dahanaviśeṣāḥ ||11||
bhavati cātra- rogasya saṃsthānamavekṣya samyaṅnarasya marmāṇi balābalaṃ ca | vyādhiṃ tathartuṃ ca samīkṣya samyak tato'vyavasyedbhiṣagagnikarma ||12||
tatra samyagdagdhe madhusarpirbhyāmabhyaṅgaḥ ||13||
athemānagninā pariharet- pittaprakṛtimantaḥśoṇitaṃ bhinnakoṣṭhamanuddhṛtaśalyaṃ durbalaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhīrumanekavraṇapīḍitamasvedyāṃśceti ||14||

ata ūrdhvamitarathādagdhalakṣaṇaṃ ‘itaratheti valayādi parityajya snehādidāhenānyathādāhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘itarathā vaidyaprayatnanirapekṣatayā bhinnaprakāreṇa dagdhamitarathādagdhamākasmikadagdhamityarthaḥ, tasya lakṣaṇamitarathādagdhalakṣaṇam| atrāgnirdahatīti svatantratvenopadeśo vaidyanirapekṣatvenākasmikatvamāviṣkartum’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| “itarathādagdhaṃ” iti pā. vakṣyāmaḥ | tatra, snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ vā''(cā)śritya dravyamagnirdahati; agnisantapto ‘rūkṣadāhasya valayādinā vyāptatvādvalayādyavyāptaṃ snigdhadāhamāha- agnisantapto hītyādi” iti cakraḥ hi snehaḥ sūkṣmasirānusāritvāttvagādīnanupraviśyāśu ‘sūkṣmamārgānusāritvāt” iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ dahati; tasmāt snehadagdhe'dhikā rujo bhavanti ||15||

tatra pluṣṭaṃ durdagdhaṃ samyagdagdhamatidagdhaṃ ceti caturvidhamagnidagdham | tatra yadvivarṇaṃ pluṣyate'timātraṃ ‘pluṣyata ityagnitāpena svidyata iva iti cakraḥ tat pluṣṭaṃ; yatrottiṣṭhanti sphoṭāstīvrāścoṣadāharāgapākavedanāścirāccopaśāmyanti taddurdagdhaṃ; samyagdagdhamanavagāḍhaṃ ‘vyāpadātmake'pyasmin samyagdagdhatvaṃ nānupapannaṃ, ghuṇākṣaranyāyena kadācittvagādīnāṃ yathāvaddāhāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ tālavarṇaṃ ‘pakvatālaphalavarṇaṃ’ iti pā. susaṃsthitaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇayuktaṃ ca; atidagdhe māṃsāvalambanaṃ gātraviśleṣaḥ sirāsnāyusandhyasthivyāpādanamatimātraṃ jvaradāhapipāsāmūrcchāścopadravā bhavanti, vraṇaścāsya cireṇa rohati, rūḍhaśca vivarṇo bhavati | tadetaccaturvidhamagnidagdhalakṣaṇamātmakarmaprasādhakaṃ ‘pūrvakarmaprasādhakaṃ’ iti pā. bhavati ||16||

div.ab: bhavanti cātra- agninā kopitaṃ raktaṃ bhṛśaṃ jantoḥ prakupyati pradhāvati iti pā.| tatastenaiva vegena pittamasyābhyudīryate ||17|| tulyavīrye ubhe hyete rasato dravyatastathā | tenāsya vedanāstīvrāḥ prakṛtyā ca vidahyate ||18|| sphoṭāḥ śīghraṃ prajāyante jvarastṛṣṇā ca bādhate |19|

ab.seg: dagdhasyopaśamārthāya cikitsā sampravakṣyate ||19||

pluṣṭasyāgnipratapanaṃ kāryamuṣṇaṃ tathauṣadham | śarīre svinnabhūyiṣṭhe ‘svinnabhūyiṣṭhe iti stokāsvinne, udakamiti dāhapratyanīkatayā'jñātamānamudakaṃ, skandayatīti styānīkaroti, skannena ca śoṇitenānirgacchatā tejasā''vṛtamārgeṇa ca vāyunā pacyamānaṃ dāhādi karoti| uṣṇakriyayā tu raktaṃ vilīyate, tejo'paiti, vāyuranulomo bhavati, ityuṣṇairalpaśaḥ kriyā sukhayatīti vākyārthaḥ| iyameva ca viruddhārthakāriṇī kriyā śāstre ucyate’ iti cakraḥ svinnaṃ bhavati śoṇitam ||20||
prakṛtyā hyudakaṃ śītaṃ skandayatyatiśoṇitam | tasmāt sukhayati hyuṣṇaṃ nanu śītaṃ kathañcana ||21||
śītāmuṣṇāṃ ca durdagdhe kriyāṃ kuryādbhiṣak ‘kuryāttataḥ punaḥ’ iti pā. punaḥ | ghṛtālepanasekāṃstu śītānevāsya kārayet ||22||
samyagdagdhe tugākṣīrīplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ | sāmṛtaiḥ sarpiṣā snigdhairālepaṃ ‘yuktaiḥ’ iti pā. kārayedbhiṣak ||23||
grāmyānūpaudakaiścainaṃ piṣṭairmāṃsaiḥ pralepayet | pittavidradhivaccainaṃ santatoṣmāṇamācaret ‘praśāntoṣmāṇaṃ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||24||

div.ab: atidagdhe viśīrṇāni māṃsānyuddhṛtya śītalām | kriyāṃ kuryādbhiṣak paścācchālitaṇḍulakaṇḍanaiḥ ||25|| tindukītvakkapālairvā ghṛtamiśraiḥ pralepayet | vraṇaṃ guḍūcīpatrairvā chādayedathavaudakaiḥ ||26|| kriyāṃ ca nikhilāṃ kuryādbhiṣak pittavisarpavat |27|

ab.seg: madhūcchiṣṭaṃ samadhukaṃ rodhraṃ sarjarasaṃ tathā ||27||
mañjiṣṭhāṃ candanaṃ mūrvāṃ piṣṭvā sarpirvipācayet | sarveṣāmagnidagdhānāmetadropaṇamuttamam ||28||

div.ab: snehadagdhe kriyāṃ rūkṣāṃ viśeṣeṇāvacārayet |29|

ab.seg: ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhūmopahatalakṣaṇam ||29||

śvasiti ‘ete ca śvāsādayo yathāyogyatayā koṣṭhaghrāṇacakṣurādīnāṃ dhūmopaghātāttarkaṇīyāḥ’ cakraḥ| ‘śvasityādhmāti cātyarthaṃ kāsate kṣavate bhṛśam’ iti pā. kṣauti cātyarthamapyādhamati kāsate | cakṣuṣoḥ paridāhaśca rāgaścaivopajāyate ||30||
sadhūmakaṃ niśvasiti ghreyamanyanna vetti ca | tathaiva ca rasān sarvān śrutiścāsyopahanyate ||31||
tṛṣṇādāhajvarayutaḥ sīdatyatha ca mūrcchati | dhūmopahata ityeṣaḥ ‘ityevaṃ’ iti pā. śṛṇu tasya cikitsitam ||32||
sarpirikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā | madhurāmlau rasau vā'pi vamanāya pradāpayet ||33||
vamataḥ koṣṭhaśuddhiḥ syāddhūmagandhaśca naśyati | vidhinā'nena śāmyanti sadanakṣavathujvarāḥ ||34||
dāhamūrcchātṛḍādhmānaśvāsakāsāśca dāruṇāḥ | madhurairlavaṇāmlaiśca kaṭukaiḥ kavalagrahaiḥ ||35||
samyaggṛhṇātīndriyārthān ‘viṣayān’ iti pā. manaścāsya prasīdati | śirovirecanaṃ cāsmai dadyādyogena śāstravit ||36||
dṛṣṭirviśudhyate cāsya śirogrīvaṃ ca dehinaḥ | avidāhi laghu snigdhamāhāraṃ cāsya kalpayet ||37||
uṣṇavātātapairdagdhe śītaḥ kāryo vidhiḥ sadā | śītavarṣānilairdagdhe snigdhamuṣṇaṃ ca śasyate ||38||
tathā'titejasā dagdhe siddharnāsti “siddhirnaikāntikī matā” iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ kathañcana | indravajrāgnidagdhe'pi jīvati pratikārayet | snehābhyaṅgaparīṣekaiḥ pradehaiśca tathā bhiṣak ||39||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'gnikarmavidhirnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
athāto jalaukāvacāraṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
nṛpāḍhyabālasthavirabhīrudurbalanārīsukumārāṇāmanugrahārthaṃ paramasukumāro'yaṃ śoṇitāvasecanopāyo'bhihito jalaukasaḥ ‘yajjalaukasaḥ’ iti pā.||3||

tatra atrāha vāgbhaṭaḥ- “pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ| harecchṛṅgādibhiḥ suptamasṛgvyāpi sirāvyadhaiḥ| pracchānaṃ piṇḍite vā syādavagāḍhe jalaukasaḥ| tvaksthe'lābughaṭīśṛṅgaṃ siraiva vyāpake'sṛji| vātādidhāma vā śṛṅgajalaukālābubhiḥ kramāt” (vā. sū. a. 26) iti vātapittakaphaduṣṭaśoṇitaṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ śṛṅgajalaukālābubhiravasecayet, sarvāṇi sarvāṇi sarvairveti vātādiduṣṭe śṛṅgādiniyamaṃ niṣedhayati| uktāprāptāvayogyatāyāṃ vā yatprāpyate yadvā yogyaṃ bhavati tenaiva kartavyamityarthaḥ, viśeṣatastu visrāvyamiti pūrveṇa sambadhyate| tena vātādiduṣṭe śṛṅgādividhānaṃ mukhyaṃ| uktaṃ hi carake- ‘bhiṣagvātānvitaṃ raktaṃ śṛṅgeṇāśu vinirharet| pittānvitaṃ jalaukobhiralābūbhiḥ kaphānvitam (ca. ci. a. 29)’ iti cakraḥ sarvairvā (viśeṣastu visrāvyaṃ śṛṅgajalaukālābubhirgṛhṇīyāt) ||4||

bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- uṣṇaṃ samadhuraṃ snigdhaṃ gavāṃ śṛṅgaṃ prakīrtitam | tasmādvātopasṛṣṭe tu hitaṃ tadavasecane asyāgre ‘ardhacandrākṛti mahattanu saptāṅgulāyatam| pracchite dāpayecchṛṅgamāsyenācūṣayedvalī’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate||5||
śītādhivāsā madhurā ‘madhureti madhurārthaṅkriyākāritvāt| vārisambhaveti tṛṇajalaukāpratiṣedhārthaṃ’ iti cakraḥ jalaukā vārisambhavā | tasmāt pittopasṛṣṭe tu hitā sā tvavasecane ||6||
alābu kaṭukaṃ rūkṣaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca parikīrtitam | tasmācchleṣmopasṛṣṭe tu hitaṃ tadavasecane ||7||
tatra pracchite tanubastipaṭalāvanaddhena ‘tanuvastrapaṭalasūtrāvanaddhena’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ śṛṅgeṇa śoṇitamavasecayedācūṣaṇāt, sāntardīpayā'lābvā (jalāyukā vakṣyante) ||8||
jalamāsāmāyuriti jalāyukāḥ, jalamāsāmoka iti jalaukasaḥ ||9||
tā dvādaśa; tāsāṃ saviṣāḥ ṣaṭ, tāvatya eva nirviṣāḥ ||10||
