viruddhāśanajān rogān pratihanti virecanam | vamanaṃ śamanaṃ vā'pi pūrvaṃ vā hitasevanam ‘pratihantīti pratipakṣaṃ sat hanti| tena kuṣṭhādipratyanīkaṃ virecanaṃ kuṣṭhādi hanti| evaṃ vamanaśamanayorapi pratyayaṃ vyākhyeyaḥ| pūrvameva mahāprabhāvarasāyanādisevayā na prabhavantyevambhūtā vyādhaya ityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘śuddhiratreṣṭā śamo vā tadvirodhibhiḥ| dravyaistaireva vā pūrva śarīrasyābhisaṃskṛtiḥ’ iti vāgbhaṭaḥ (sū. a.7)||21||

sātmyato'lpatayā sātmyata ityabhyāsasātmyatayā| alpaṃ hīnaśaktitvādabhibhūtaṃ na karoti kārya| taruṇasya pratyagrabalatvādvitathaṃ bhavati| snigdhasya srotaḥsu na tiṣṭhati doṣaḥ, tathā ca doṣavigamādviruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavati| vyāyāminaśca vyāyāmenaiva doṣakṣayaḥ, taduktaṃ- ‘vyāyāmaṃ kurvato nityaṃ viruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet’ iti| balinastu balābhibhūtā eva doṣā na jāyante na kurvanti vā kāryam| yaduktaṃ- ‘balaṃ hyalaṃ nigrahāya doṣāṇāṃ’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti cakraḥ vā'pi dīptāgnestaruṇasya ca | snigdhavyāyāmabalināṃ viruddhaṃ vitathaṃ bhavet ||22||
atha vātaguṇān vakṣyāmaḥ- pūrvaḥ samadhuraḥ snigdho lavaṇaścaiva mārutaḥ | gururvidāhajanano raktapittābhivardhanaḥ ||23||
kṣatānāṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ vraṇinaḥ śleṣmalāśca ye | teṣāmeva viśeṣeṇa sadā rogavivardhanaḥ ||24||
vātalānāṃ praśastaśca śrāntānāṃ kaphaśoṣiṇām | madhuraścāvidāhī ca kaṣāyānuraso laghuḥ | dakṣiṇo mārutaḥ śreṣṭhaścakṣuṣyo balavardhanaḥ ||25||
raktapittapraśamano na ca vātaprakopaṇaḥ | viśado rūkṣaparuṣaḥ kharaḥ snehabalāpahaḥ ||26||
paścimo mārutastīkṣṇaḥ kaphamedoviśoṣaṇaḥ | sadyaḥ prāṇakṣayakaraḥ śoṣaṇastu śarīriṇām ||27||
uttaro mārutaḥ snigdho mṛdurmadhura eva ca | kaṣāyānurasaḥ śīto doṣāṇāṃ cāprakopaṇaḥ ||28||
tasmācca prakṛtisthānāṃ kledano balavardhanaḥ | kṣīṇakṣayaviṣārtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu pūjitaḥ ||29||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne hitāhitīyo nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
athāto vraṇapraśnamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

vātapittaśleṣmāṇa eva ‘evakāro bhinnakramaḥ| tena sambhavahetavaevetyarthaḥ| atra vātādayaḥ śukraśoṇitagatāḥ prakṛtisthatayā garbhasambhave hetavo bhavanti| . . . pralaye iti dehanāśe| raktasyāpi śalyaśāstrapradhānavraṇādhiṣṭhānasya hetuliṅgacikitsitaviśeṣaprayojakatayā prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ doṣatulyatayā sambhavādihetutvaṃ niyamayannāha- tadebhirityādi| avirahitamiti kāraṇatayā avirahitam| śoṇitasya dehakāraṇatvamārtavakāraṇatayā vyaktameva| śoṇitasya dehakārakatvādi coktaṃ śāstre “dehasya rudhiraṃ mūlaṃ rudhireṇaiva dhāryate” iti| sākṣāccāsya vātādivat prapañcānabhidhānena pāramārthikīṃ doṣatāṃ pratikṣipati| yadi hi vātādivaddoṣaḥ syāt tadā tenāpi prakṛtiḥ syādityādidūṣaṇamanusartavyam’ iti cakraḥ dehasambhavahetavaḥ | tairevāvyāpannairadhomadhyordhvasanniviṣṭaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate'gāramiva sthūṇābhistisṛbhiḥ ataśca tristhūṇamāhureke | ta eva ca vyāpannāḥ pralayahetavaḥ | tadebhireva śoṇitacaturthaiḥ sambhavasthitipralayeṣvapyavirahitaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati ||3||

bhavati cātra- narte dehaḥ kaphādasti na pittānna ca mārutāt | śoṇitādapi vā nityaṃ deha etaistu dhāryate ‘astīti bhavati utpadyate ityarthaḥ| dhāryate ityanena sthitihetutvamuktaṃ| pralayahetutvamanuktamapyanugamyameva’ iti cakraḥ||4||

tatra ‘vā’ gatigandhanayoḥ, iti dhātuḥ, ‘tapa’ santāpe, ‘śliṣa’ āliṅgane, eteṣāṃ kṛdvihitaiḥ pratyayairvātaḥ pittaṃ śleṣmeti ca rūpāṇi bhavanti ‘tatra niruktyā vātasya capalatvaṃ, pittasya tāpakatvaṃ, kaphasya upaśleṣakatvamuktaṃ bhavati’ iti cakraḥ||5||
doṣasthānānyata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra samāsena vātaḥ śroṇigudasaṃśrayaḥ; taduparyadho nābheḥ pakvāśayaḥ, pakvāmāśayamadhyaṃ pittasya; āmāśayaḥ śleṣmaṇaḥ ||6||

ataḥ paraṃ pañcadhā vibhajyante | tatra vātasya vātavyādhau vakṣyāmaḥ; pittasya yakṛtplīhānau hṛdayaṃ dṛṣṭistvak pūrvoktaṃ ca; śleṣmaṇa uraḥ śiraḥ kaṇṭho jihvāmūlaṃ sandhaya iti pūrvoktaṃ ca; etāni khalu doṣāṇāṃ sthānānyavyāpannānām ||7||

bhavati cātra- visargodānavikṣepaiḥ somasūryānilā yathā | dhārayanti jagaddehaṃ kaphapittānilāstathā ‘visargaḥ saumyāṃśavisarjanaṃ candrasya kaphasya ca, ādānaṃ saumyāṃśaśoṣaṇaṃ pittasya sūryasya ca, vikṣepaśca bahirantaścācitadhātuvyūhanādi vāyoḥ sādhāraṇam’ iti cakraḥ||8||

tatra jijñāsyaṃ kiṃ pittavyatirekādanyo'gniḥ? āhosvit pittamevāgniriti? | atrocyate- na khalu pittavyatirekādanyo'gnirupalabhyate, āgneyatvāt pitte dahanapacanādiṣvabhipravartamāne'gnivadupacāraḥ kriyate'ntaragniriti; kṣīṇe hyagniguṇe tatsamānadravyopayogāt , ativṛddhe śītakriyopayogāt , āgamācca paśyāmo na ‘na khalu pittavyatirekeṇānyo'gnirlabhyata ityanena pittāgnyorbhedapratipādakāgabhāvaṃ darśayati| yattu ‘tīkṣṇaḥ pittenāgniḥ’ iti bhedāvabhāṣakaṃ vacanaṃ tadyathāśrutārthaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| etadeva pittasyāgnivyapadeśaṃ sopapattikamāha- kṣīṇe ityādi| pittāgnyorbhede pramāṇābhāvaṃ darśayitvā svapakṣasādhakamamedamāha- kṣīṇe hītyādi| āgnerguṇo'nnapācakalakṣita ūṣmā, tasmin kṣīṇe| tatsamānaṃ pittasamānaṃ kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ nāgarādi| ativṛddhe ityagniguṇe eva| śītakriyopayogādityanena pitte pratyanīkakriyātaḥ praśamanaṃ darśayati| etena ‘agnitvena vyavahriyamāṇaṃ tejaḥ pittānumeyarūpaṃ, pittavardhanapittakṣayakarairvṛddhirhrāsayogitvāt, pradeśāntarasthapittāvayavavat’ ityanumānaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati| atraiva sādhye āgamaṃ pramāṇamāha- āgamācceti| āgamaśca yathā- ‘kānakaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛṣṇāyastrapusīsakam| cirasthānādvilīyante pittatejaḥpratāpanāt’ (sū. a.26) iti, tathā ‘ṣaṣṭhī kalā pittadharā’ ityādinā agnyādhārā grahaṇyuktā| bhoje'pi ‘tasmāttejomayaṃ pittaṃ pittoṣmā yaḥ sa paktimān’ ityāgamādamedo jñeyaḥ| pāramārthikābhede hi tīkṣṇaḥ pittenāgniriti kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt, tathā ‘kaṭvajīrṇavidāhyamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittamulbaṇam| āplāvayaddhantyanalaṃ’ (ca. ci. a. 15) iti carakavacanavirodhaḥ| tathā ‘pittaśamanaṃ ghṛtamagnimedhe karoti’ ityuktamasaṅgataṃ syāt, tathā ‘samadoṣaḥ samāgniśca’ (sū. a.15) iti vacanamasaṅgataṃ syāt| yadapyabhedasādhakaṃ ‘pittatejaḥpratāpanāt’ iti , tathā ‘pittoṣmā yaḥ sa paktimān’ iti , tadapi pittādbhinnasya taddharmiṇastejaso'gnitvaṃ vadati| yacchamanaṃ pittasya pittakṣapaṇaiḥ pittavardhanaiśca vardhanaṃ tadghṛtasya pittaśamakasyāgnivardhakatvena kaṭvajīrṇavidāhyamlasya ca pittajananāvāntaravyāpārasyāgnyupaghātakatvena prasiddhatvādasiddham| tasmāddharmadhārmirūpatayaivātrābheda ācāryasya vivakṣitaḥ’| iti cakraḥ khalu pittavyatirekādanyo'gniriti ||9||

taccādṛṣṭahetukena ‘adṛṣṭahetukena viśeṣeṇeti dehajanakenādṛṣṭena hi bāhyādagnerviśiṣṭo'yamagnirārabhyate, yenaivaṃvidhamannapacanarasamalavivecanāgnyantarānugrahaśarīrakṣaṇādīni karotīti bhāvaḥ| śeṣāṇāṃ pittasthānānāmiti tathā śarīrasya cāgnikarmaṇeti pañcabhūtāgnisamadhātvagnikarmaṇā| so'bhiprārthitasādhanakṛdukta iti yogavaśādvaśitvalābhe abhīṣṭasādhanaṃ sādhakenāgninā bhavatītyāgamaḥ| etacca paraṃ sādhakakāryaṃ, tena śauryādi ca tasya kāryaṃ jñeyam| yaduktaṃ carake- “agnireva śarīre pittāntargataḥ kupitākupitaḥ śubhāśubhāni karoti| tadyathā- paktimapaktiṃ darśanamadarśanaṃ mātrāmātratvamūṣmaṇaḥ prakṛtivikṛtivarṇau śauryaṃ bhayaṃ krodhaṃ harṣaṃ mohaṃ prasādamityevamanādīni cāparāṇi dvandvāni” (ca. sū. a.12) iti | kriyādravyāṇāmiti kriyopanītānāṃ bahiḥparimārjanadravyāṇām’ iti cakraḥ viśeṣeṇa pakvāmāśayamadhyasthaṃ pittaṃ caturvidhamannapānaṃ pacati, vivecayati ca doṣarasamūtrapurīṣāṇi; tatrasthameva cātmaśaktyā śeṣāṇāṃ pittasthānānāṃ śarīrasya cāgnikarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karoti, tasmin pitte pācako'gniriti sañjñā; yattu yakṛtplīhnoḥ pittaṃ tasmin rañjako'gniriti sañjñā, sa rasasya rāgakṛduktaḥ; yat pittaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ tasmin sādhako'gniriti sañjñā, so'bhiprārthitamanorathasādhanakṛduktaḥ; yaddṛṣṭyāṃ pittaṃ tasminnālocako'gniriti sañjñā, sa rūpagrahaṇā'dhikṛtaḥ; yattu tvaci pittaṃ tasmin bhrājako'gniriti sañjñā, so'bhyaṅgapariṣekāvagāhālepanādīnāṃ kriyādravyāṇāṃ paktā chāyānāṃ ca prakāśakaḥ ||10||
bhavati cātra- pittaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pūti nīlaṃ pītaṃ tathaiva ca | uṣṇaṃ kaṭurasaṃ caiva vidagdhaṃ cāmlameva ca ||11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ śleṣmasthānānyanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ | tatra, āmāśayaḥ pittāśayasyopariṣṭāt tatpratyanīkatvādūrdhvagatitvāttejasaḥ, candra iva ādityasya , caturvidhasyāhārasyādhāraḥ; sa ca tatraudakairguṇairāhāraḥ praklinno bhinnasaṅghātaḥ sukhajaro bhavati ‘tatpratyanīkatvāditi tejorūpapittapratyanīkatvāt, tathordhvagatitvācca tejaso jāṭharāgneḥ| etena dṛṣṭatvena śleṣmādhāratayā pittapratibandhārthakāśayo niveśitaḥ| candra ivādityasyeti viṣayasādharmyamātreṇa| tatrāmāśaye audakaguṇāvirbhāva audakaśleṣmāśayamahimnā jñeyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ||12||
mādhuryāt picchilatvācca prakleditvāttathaiva ca | āmāśaye sambhavati śleṣmā madhuraśītalaḥ ||13||

sa tatrastha eva ‘eva’ iti hastalikhitapustakeṣu na paṭhyate svaśaktyā śeṣāṇāṃ śleṣmasthānānāṃ śarīrasya codakakarmaṇā'nugrahaṃ karoti; uraḥsthastrikasandhāraṇamātmavīryeṇānnarasasahitena hṛdayāvalambanaṃ karoti; jihvāmūlakaṇṭhastho jihvendriyasya saumyatvāt samyagrasajñāne vartate; śiraḥsthaḥ snehasantarpaṇādhikṛtatvādindriyāṇāmātmavīryeṇānugrahaṃ karot; sandhisthaḥ śleṣmā sarvasandhisaṃśleṣāt sarvasandhyanugrahaṃ karoti ‘svaśaktayeti adṛṣṭāhitaprabhāvena| anugrahaścāplāvanena| trikamiha pṛṣṭhāsthibāhudvayasandhānasthānam| jihvendriyasya rasajñāne śleṣmā saumyatvādvartate kāraṇaṃ bhavati| indriyāṇi hi svajātīyābhivyaktameva viṣayaṃ gṛhṇanti| yathā taijasaṃ cakṣurālokasahakṛtameva rūpaṃ gṛhṇānti| evamāpyaṃ rasanaṃ kaṇṭhagataśleṣmābhivyaktameva rasaṃ gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ| śleṣmaṇā śiraḥsthenendriyāṇyanugrahādātmakāryaṃ kurvanti’ iti cakraḥ||14||
bhavati cātra- śleṣmā śveto guruḥ snigdhaḥ picchilaḥ śīta eva ca | madhurastvavidagdhaḥ syādvidagdho lavaṇa smṛtaḥ ||15||
śoṇitasya ‘śoṇitasthānaṃ prāgabhihitaṃ’ iti pā. sthānaṃ yakṛtplīhānau, tacca prāgabhihitaṃ; tatrasthameva śeṣāṇāṃ śoṇitasthānānāmanugrahaṃ karoti ||16||

bhavati cātra- anuṣṇaśītaṃ ‘anuṣṇaśītamiti saumyāgneyatvācchoṇitasya| vidāhaścāsya pittavaditi duṣṭapittavadityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ raktaṃ ca varṇataḥ | śoṇitaṃ guru visraṃ syādvidāhaścāsya pittavat ||17||

etāni khalu doṣasthānāni; eṣu sañcīyante ‘sañcīyanta iti prakarṣeṇa cīyante| tenānyatrāpi tvagādiṣu bāhyaduṣṭajalādinā cayaḥ kāraṇasambhavādbhavati, so'lpatayā neha kathyate| prāk sañcayaheturukta iti etacca sañcayakāraṇakathanamuktodāharaṇānuguṇyāt, natu tatsañcayakāraṇaniyamāt| yena madhurasnigdhādyāhārādeḥ kaphādicayo'sti anyeṣvapi durnivāra eva’| iti cakraḥ doṣāḥ | prāk sañcayaheturuktaḥ | tatra sañcitānāṃ khalu doṣāṇāṃ stabdhapūrṇakoṣṭhatā pītāvabhāsatā mandoṣmatā cāṅgānāṃ gauravamālasyaṃ cayakāraṇavidveṣaśceti liṅgāni bhavanti | tatra prathamaḥ kriyākālaḥ ||18||

ata ūrdhvaṃ prakopaṇāni ‘prakopakāraṇāni’ iti pā. vakṣyāmaḥ | tatra balavadvigrahātivyāyāmavyavāyādhyayanaprapatanapradhāvanaprapīḍanābhighātalaṅghanaplavanataraṇarātrijāgaraṇabhāraharaṇa- gajaturagarathapadāticaryākaṭukaṣāyatiktarūkṣalaghuśītavīryaśuṣkaśākavallūravarakoddālakakoradūṣaśyāmākanīvāra- mudgamasūrāḍhakīhareṇukalāyaniṣpāvānaśanaviṣamāśanādhyaśanavātamūtrapurīṣaśukracchardikṣavathūdgārabāṣpavegavighātādibhirviśeṣairvāyuḥ prapīḍaneti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate‘vegavighātādibhirvāyuḥ’ iti pā. prakopamāpadyate ||19||

sa śītābhrapravāteṣu gharmānte ca viśeṣataḥ | pratyūṣasyaparāhṇe tu jīrṇe'nne ca prakupyati ‘pravāte iti pravātalakṣite varṣākāle| gharmānte iti prāvṛṣi| atra balavadvigrahādayo vātaṃ janayantaḥ prakṛṣṭameva janayantīti prakopahetavaḥ, na punaḥ pūrvamṛtucaryoktacayahetucitānāmevaite prakopakāḥ, tathā satyetadvyatirekeṇārtavacayasya kopo na syāt| ārtavacayaṃ vinā caiṣāṃ vātavikārahetutā sarvadṛṣṭāntaghaṭitā| tasmādbalavadvigrahādibhiḥ prabalatayā doṣo janyamāno na prakopahetvantaramapekṣate| stokastokasevitayā ṛtvādikāraṇajanitāśca doṣā āśaye līnatvāt prakopakāraṇamapekṣanta eveti ṛtucarye'pi vyutpāditam| evaṃ pittakaphaprakopahetuṣvapi vyākhyeyam’ iti cakraḥ||20||

krodhaśokabhayāyāsopavāsavidagdhamaithunopagamanakaṭvamlalavaṇa- tīkṣṇoṣṇalaghuvidāhitilatailapiṇyākakulatthasarṣapātasīharitakaśāka- godhāmatsyājāvikamāṃsadadhitakrakūrcikāmastusauvīrakasurāvikārāmlaphalakaṭvaraprabhṛtibhiḥ ‘... varāha ... ’ iti pā. pittaṃ prakopamāpadyate ||21||
taduṣṇairuṣṇakāle ca ghanānte ca viśeṣataḥ | madhyāhne cārdharātre ca jīryatyanne ca kupyati ||22||

divāsvapnāvyāyāmālasyamadhurāmlalavaṇaśītasnigdhagurupicchilābhiṣyandihāyanakayavakanaiṣadhetkaṭa- māṣamahāmāṣagodhūmatilapiṣṭavikṛtidadhidugdhakṛśarāpāyasekṣuvikārānūpaudakamāṃsavasābisamṛṇāla- kaserukaśṛṅgāṭakamadhuravallīphalasamaśanādhyaśanaprabhṛtibhiḥ śleṣmā prakopamāpadyate ||23||

sa śītaiḥ śītakāle ca vasante ca viśeṣataḥ | pūrvāhṇe ca pradoṣe ca bhuktamātre prakupyati ‘śītakāle iti hemante| etacca hetvantaracitasya kaphasya vardhakatayā prakopaṇaṃ, na tvārtavacayaprakopakatvamasya, tatra cayahetutvenaivoktatvāt| kiṃvā śītakālo durdinādiḥ’ iti cakraḥ||24||

pittaprakopaṇaireva ‘raktaprakopahetuṣu pittaprakopaṇairiti duṣṭasya raktasya pittatulyatvāduktam| raktasya paramārthato doṣaireva duṣṭiḥ’ iti cakraḥ cābhīkṣṇaṃ dravasnigdhagurubhirāhārairdivāsvapnakrodhānalātapaśramābhighātājīrṇaviruddhādhyaśanādibhirviśeṣairasṛk prakopamāpadyate ||25||
yasmādraktaṃ vinā doṣairna kadācit prakupyati | tasmāttasya yathādoṣaṃ kālaṃ vidyat prakopaṇe ||26||

teṣāṃ prakopāt koṣṭhatodasañcaraṇāmlīkāpipāsāparidāhānnadveṣahṛdayotkledāśca jāyante | tatra dvitīyaḥ ‘kriyākālānāṃ dvitīyādisaṅkhyāpradarśanamuttarottaraṃ garīyastvapradarśanārthaṃ, yaduktaṃ,-‘te tūttarāsu gatiṣu bhavanti balavattarāḥ’ iti cakraḥ kriyākālaḥ ||27||

ata ūrdhvaṃ prasaraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- teṣāmebhirātaṅkaviśeṣaiḥ ‘ātaṅkaviśeṣairiti ātaṅkenātaṅkakāraṇaṃ balavadvigrahādaya ucyante| piṣṭakiṇvodakasamavāya iveti madyasandhāne yathā piṣṭādi kālāhitodrekaṃ prasarati, tathā doṣā api hetubalādudriktāḥ prasaranti deśāntare calanti| prasaraṇaheturiti prasārakaḥ| pravartakamiti pravṛttisvabhāvam, ataḥ pravartayati’ iti cakraḥ prakupitānāṃ kiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya ‘paryuṣitakiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ ivodriktānāṃ prasaro bhavati | teṣāṃ vāyurgatimattvāt prasaraṇahetuḥ satyapyacaitanye | sa hi rajobhūyiṣṭhaḥ; rajaśca pravartakaṃ sarvabhāvānām | yathā- mahānudakasañcayo'tivṛddhaḥ setumavadāryāpareṇodakena vyāmiśraḥ ‘apareṇodakena vyāmiśra ityatra vāśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena doṣāntarasahitasya prasare'yaṃ pakṣaḥ, kevalaprasare tu setumavadāryetyanta eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ’ iti cakraḥ sarvataḥ pradhāvati, evaṃ doṣāḥ kadācidekaśo dviśaḥ samastāḥ śoṇitasahitā vā'nekadhā prasaranti | tadyathā- vātaḥ, pittaṃ, śleṣmā, śoṇitaṃ, vātapitte, vātaśleṣmāṇau, pittaśleṣmāṇau, vātaśoṇite, pittaśoṇite, śleṣmaśoṇite, vātapittaśoṇitāni, vātaśleṣmaśoṇitāni, pittaśleṣmaśoṇitāni, vātapittakaphāḥ, vātapittakaphaśoṇitānīti; evaṃ pañcadaśadhā prasaranti ||28||
kṛtsne'rdhe'vayave vā'pi yatrāṅge kupito bhṛśam | doṣo vikāraṃ nabhasi ‘sṛjati megho vṛṣṭimivāmbare’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ meghavattatra varṣati ||29||

nātyarthaṃ kupitaścāpi līno mārgeṣu tiṣṭhati | niṣpratyanīkaḥ kālena hetumāsādya kupyati ‘līnatvena prabalavikārakāritāṃ niṣedhayati| niṣpratyanīka ityavasthānahetuḥ, yadi hi tatra bheṣajaṃ pratyanīkaṃ bhavettadā tasya līnasya nāśa eva syāt| hetumāsādyeti punaḥ pravartakaṃ hetuṃ prāpya| etadevoktaṃ carake-‘tatrasthāśca vilambante kadācinna samīritāḥ nādeśakāle kupyanti bhūyo hetupratīkṣiṇaḥ’ (su.28) iti cakraḥ||30||

tatra vāyoḥ pittasthānagatasya pittavat pratīkāraḥ, pittasya ca kaphasthānagatasya kaphavat, kaphasya ca vātasthānagatasya vātavat ‘atrārthe carakaḥ- ‘doṣasthānagataṃ doṣaṃ sthānivat samupācaret’ iti cakraḥ; eṣa kriyāvibhāgaḥ ||31||
evaṃ prakupitānāṃ prasaratāṃ vāyorvimārgagamanāṭopau, oṣacoṣaparidāhadhūmāyanāni pittasya, arocakāvipākāṅgasādāśchardiśceti śleṣmaṇo liṅgāni bhavanti; tatra tṛtīyaḥ kriyākālaḥ ||32||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sthānasaṃśrayaṃ ‘sthānasaṃśrayaḥ doṣadūṣyasya saṃśrayaḥ | . . . udarasanniveśe sādhāraṇe'pi vidradhyādikāryabhedāt sthānasaṃśrayabhedaḥ sūkṣmo jñeyaḥ| na hyekasmāt sthānasaṃśrayādekajātidoṣakṛtādbhinnā rogā bhavitumarhanti, evamanyatrāpi vyākhyeyam| saṃśrayasthasaṃśabdaśca gacchato mārgasambandhamātrasya vyādhihetornirāsaḥ’ iti cakraḥ vakṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ prakupitātāṃstāñ śarīrapradeśānāgamya tāṃstān vyādhīn janayanti | te yadodarasanniveśaṃ kurvanti tadā gulma vidradhyudarāgnisaṅgānāhavisūcikātisāraprabhṛtīñjanayanti; bastigatāḥ pramehāśmarīmūtrāghātamūtradoṣaprabhṛtīn; meḍhragatā niruddhaprakaśopadaṃśaśūkadoṣaprabhṛtīn; gudagatā bhagandarārśaḥprabhṛtīn; vṛṣaṇagatā vṛddhīḥ; ūrdhvajatrugatāstūrdhvajān; tvaṅmaṃsaśoṇitasthāḥ kṣudrarogān kuṣṭhāni visarpāṃśca; medogatā granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍālajīprabhṛtīn; asthigatā vidradhyanuśayīprabhṛtīn; pādagatāḥ ślīpadavātaśoṇitavātakaṇṭakaprabhṛtīn; sarvāṅgagatā jvarasarvāṅgarogaprabhṛtīn; teṣāmevamabhisanniviṣṭānāṃ pūrvarūpaprādurbhāvaḥ ‘pūrvarūpameva sthānasaṃśrayaliṅgaṃ| yaduktaṃ-“sthānasaṃśrayiṇaḥ kruddhā bhāvivyādhiprabodhakam| doṣāḥ kurvanti yalliṅgaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ taducyate’ iti | tacca doṣagamakaṃ bhāvivyādhigamakaṃ ca| yadvakṣyati jvaragamakapūrvarūpamabhidhāya ‘sāmānyato viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt’ (su.u.39) ityādi| tathā- vyādherjātirbubhūṣā ca pūrvarūpeṇa lakṣyate| bhāvaḥ kimātmakatvaṃ ca lakṣyate lakṣaṇena tu’ iti | pūrvarūpagateṣu pūrvarūpāvasthāgateṣu vyādhijananonmukheṣu doṣeṣu’ iti cakraḥ; taṃ pratirogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | tatra pūrvarūpagateṣu caturthaḥ kriyākālaḥ ||33||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vyādherdarśanaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- śophārbudagranthividradhivisarpaprabhṛtīnāṃ ‘śothaśceha vraṇaśotha ucyate, uttarakālamasyāvadīrṇatābhidhānāt| pravyaktalakṣaṇatā vyādhīnāṃ vyaktirityarthaḥ| pravyaktalakṣaṇairhi vyādhirutpanno vyajyate, sā ca vyādhivyaktirvyādhyārambhakadoṣaliṅgavatī tathā prātisvikavyādhiliṅgavatī ca’ iti cakraḥ pravyaktalakṣaṇatā jvarātīsāraprabhṛtīnāṃ ca | tatra pañcamaḥ kriyākālaḥ ||34||
ata ūrdhvameteṣāmavadīrṇānāṃ vraṇabhāvamāpannānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kriyākālaḥ, jvarātisāraprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dīrghakālānubandhaḥ | tatrāpratikriyamāṇe'sādhyatāmupayānti ||35||

bhavanti cātra- sañcayaṃ ca prakopaṃ ca prasaraṃ sthānasaṃśrayam | vyaktiṃ bhedaṃ ca yo vetti doṣāṇāṃ ‘vyaktibhedāvapi doṣāṇāṃ dūṣyaviśeṣādisahitānāmavasthābhedau, yena doṣa eva dūṣyaviśeṣasammūrcchito vyādhiḥ, tathā tadbhedo'pi doṣabheda eveti suvyaktaṃ yo vetti doṣāṇāmiti’ iti cakraḥ sa bhavedbhiṣak ||36||

sañcaye'pahṛtā kriyākālānāmuttarottaragarīyastvamāha- sañcaye'pahṛtā doṣā ityādi| balavattarā iti pūrvāpekṣayā dvitvavivakṣayā nirdeśaḥ’ iti cakraḥ doṣā labhante nottarā gatīḥ | te tūttarāsu gatiṣu bhavanti balavattarāḥ ||37||
sarvairbhāvaistribhirvā'pi dvābhyāmekena vā punaḥ | saṃsarge kupitaḥ kruddhaṃ doṣaṃ doṣo'nudhāvati ||38||

saṃsarge yo garīyān ‘garīyānityabhidhānena bhūyasā prakopagarīyastvaṃ cikitsābhedaprayojanaṃ darśayati| upakramyaḥ sa iti prādhānyenopakramyaḥ’ iti cakraḥ syādupakramyaḥ sa vai bhavet | śeṣadoṣāvirodhena sannipāte tathaiva ca ||39||

vṛṇoti ‘vṛṇoti chādayati, ādehadhāraṇāditi utpanno vraṇa ādehadhāraṇaṃ vṛṇot| kathaṃ vṛṇotītyāha- yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavastu vraṇakiṇamādehadhāraṇānna naśyati, tena vraṇakāryeṇa kiṇena dhāraṇaprakarṣādvraṇasañjñeti phalati’ iti cakraḥ yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavastu na naśyati | ādehadhāraṇāttasmādvraṇa ityucyate budhaiḥ ’ādehadhāraṇajjantorvraṇastasmānnirucyate’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vraṇapraśnādhyāyo nāmaikaviṃśodhyāyaḥ ||21||
athāto vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇītyaṣṭau vraṇavastūni ‘vraṇavastūni vraṇopādānabhūtāni dravyāṇi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| atra sarvavraṇasanniveśaḥ ‘yadapi raktamedomajjādi vraṇe'vadṛśyate, tadapi sirāsnayvāśrayatvenaiva vraṇe bhavati, na tu tadadhikaraktādyāśrayatvenetyeke| anye tu sirayā rūdhiraṃ, snāyusaṃbandhena bhedaḥ, asthnā ca tātsthyānmajjā gṛhyate’ iti vadanti’ iti cakraḥ||3||

tatra, ādyaikavastusanniveśī ‘ādyatvena tvaci labdhāyāmekagrahaṇaṃ māṃsādigatavraṇānāmapi pākakāle tvagvidaraṇenādyatvagāśrayatvasya labdhasya nirāsārtham| tvacamevaikāṃ bhettuṃ śīlamasyeti tvagbhedī| etacca tvagādyāśrayatvaṃ vaiśaiṣikaduṣṭyā jñeyam| tena sarvatraiva ‘pacatyataḥ śoṇitameṣa pākaḥ’ ityenena raktapākābhidhānaṃ sarvagāmitayā raktasya yuktam’ iti cakraḥ tvagbhedī vraṇaḥ sūpacaraḥ, śeṣāḥ svayamavadīryamāṇā durupacārāḥ ||4||
tatrāyataścaturasro vṛttastripuṭaka iti vraṇākṛtisamāsaḥ, śeṣāstu vikṛtākṛtayo durupakramā bhavanti ||5||
sarva eva vraṇāḥ kṣipraṃ saṃrohantyātmavatāṃ subhiṣagbhiścopakrāntāḥ; anātmavatāmajñaiścopakrāntāḥ praduṣyanti, pravṛddhatvāddoṣāṇām ||6||

tatrātisaṃvṛto'tivivṛto'tikaṭhino'timṛdurutsanno'vasanno'tiśīto'tyuṣṇaḥ ‘atrātisaṃvṛtātikaṭhinātimātrāvasannātyarthavedanāvāniti vātena, ativivṛtātyuṣṇaraktapūtimāṃsasirāsnāyupratipūrṇapūtipūyāsrāvyamanojñadarśa nagandhātyarthadāhapākarāgavedanāvāniti pittena, śeṣāḥ kaphena; unmārgī mukhāt mukhāntaravān, utsaṅgaḥ koṭaraḥ’ iti cakraḥ; kṛṣṇaraktapītaśuklādīnāṃ varṇānāmanyatamavarṇo bhairavaḥ pūtipūyamāṃsasirāsnāyuprabhṛtibhiḥ pūrṇaḥ pūtipūyāsrāvyunmārgyutsaṅgyamanojñadarśanagandho'tyarthaṃ vedanāvān dāhapākarāgakaṇḍūśophapiḍakopadruto'tyarthaṃ duṣṭaśoṇitāsrāvī dīrghakālānubandhī ceti duṣṭavraṇaliṅgāni | tasya doṣocchrāyeṇa ṣaṭtvaṃ vibhajya ‘tasya doṣocchrāyamavekṣya’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ yathāsvaṃ pratīkāre prayateta ||7||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sarvasrāvān vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra ghṛṣṭāsu chinnāsu vā tvakṣu sphoṭe bhinne vidārite vā salilaprakāśo bhavatyāsrāvaḥ kiñcidvisraḥ pītāvabhāsaśca; māṃsagataḥ sarpiḥprakāśaḥ sāndraḥ śvetaḥ picchilaśca; sirāgataḥ sadyaśchinnāsu sirāsu raktātipravṛttiḥ pakvāsu ca toyanāḍībhiriva toyāgamanaṃ pūyasya, āsrāvaścātra tanurvicchinnaḥ picchilo'valambī śyāvo'vaśyāyapratimaśca; snāyugataḥ snigdho ghanaḥ siṅghāṇakapratimaḥ saraktaśca; asthigato'sthanyabhihate sphuṭite bhinne doṣāvadārite vā doṣabhakṣitatvādasthi niḥsāraṃ śuktidhautamivābhāti ‘asthigate śuktidhautatvaṃ tathā'sthisārastravaṇaṃ ca doṣakṛtaṃ, śeṣastu strāvaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ| śuktidhautamiti mayūravyaṃsakādipāṭhāt pūrvanipāto vyatyayena, dhautaśuktivadityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ, āsrāvaścātra majjamiśraḥ sarudhiraḥ snigdhaśca; sandhigataḥ pīḍyamāno na pravartate, ākuñcanaprasāraṇonnamanavinamanapradhāvanotkāsanapravāhaṇaiśca sravati, āsrāvaścātra picchilo'valambī sarudhironmathitaśca ‘saphenapūyarudhironmiśraśca’ iti pā.; koṣṭhagato'sṛṅmūtrapurīṣapūyodakāni koṣṭhagatastu yathāpratyāsatti purīṣādi sravati| tatra raktasrutiḥ koṣṭhāśrayaplīhādhiṣṭhānatayā, udakasrāvastu pānīyasya saraṇātmakasya prabhāvāt’ iti cakraḥ sravati; marmagatastvagādiṣvavaruddhatvānnocyate | tatra tvagādigatānāmāsrāvāṇāṃ yathākramaṃ ‘yathā kramamiti yathāsaṃkhyam| atra marmavarjiteṣu tvagādiṣu saptasu yathākramaṃ vātapittakaphaśoṇitasannipātānāṃ sapta saptāsrāvā yathoktā bhavanti| śoṇite tu yadvisratvamadhikamuktaṃ tat sarvatvagādyāśrayānugāmi| anye tu yathāsaṃkhyamatra necchanti| sannipāteneha ye nārikelādivarṇā uktāste vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyakṛtā jñeyāḥ| anyathā hi vātādikṛtavarṇamelakenaiva sannipātavarṇo'pyuktaḥ syāt’ iti cakraḥ pāruṣyaśyāvāvaśyāyadadhimastukṣārodakamāṃsadhāvanapulākodakasannibhatvāni mārutādbhavanti; pittādgomedakagomūtrabhasmaśaṅkhakaṣāyodakamādhvīkatailasannibhatvāni; pittavadraktādativisratvaṃ ca; kaphānnavanītakāsīsamajjapiṣṭatilanālikerodakavarāhavasāsannibhatvāni; sannipātānnālikerodakairvārukarasakāñjikaprasādārukodakapriyaṅguphalayakṛnmudgayūṣasavarṇatvānīti ||8||
ślokau cātra bhavataḥ- pakvāśayādasādhyastu pulākodakasannibhaḥ | kṣārodakanibhaḥ srāvo varjyo raktāśayātsravan ||9||

āmāśayāt kalāyāmbhonibhaśca trikasandhijaḥ ‘raktāśayāt yakṛtplīhārūpāt| kalāyāmbhonibhaśca srāvastrikasandhijaḥ koṣṭhamārgeṇa sarannasādhyaḥ | yaduktaṃ bhoje-“pulākodakavarṇastu yadā koṣṭhāt pravartate| pakvāśayāt stravatyevaṃ taṃ bhiṣaka parivajayet|| kṣārodakanibhaḥ strāvo yadā koṣṭhāt pravartate| raktāśayāt stravatyevaṃ taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet|| trikasandhestu vivarāt kalāyodakasannibhaḥ| koṣṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryāti taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet’ iti cakraḥ| srāvānetān parīkṣyādau tataḥ karmācaredbhiṣak ||10||

ata ūrdhvaṃ sarvavraṇavedanā vakṣyāmaḥ- todanabhedanatāḍanacchedanāyāmanamanthanavikṣepaṇacumucumāyananirdahanāvabhañjanasphoṭana vidāraṇotpāṭanakampanavividhaśūlaviśleṣaṇavikiraṇastambhanapūraṇasvapnākuñjanāṅku śikāḥ sambhavanti, animittavividhavedanāprādurbhāvo vā muhurmuhuryatrāgacchanti vedanāviśeṣāstaṃ vātikamiti vidyāt; oṣacoṣaparidāhadhūmāyanāni yatra gātramaṅgārāvakīrṇamiva pacyate yatra coṣmābhivṛddhiḥ kṣate kṣārāvasiktavacca vedanāviśeṣāstaṃ paittikamiti vidyāt; pittavadraktasamutthaṃ jānīyāt; kaṇḍūrgurutvaṃ suptatvamupadeho'lpavedanatvaṃ stambhaḥ śaityaṃ ca yatra taṃ ślaiṣmikamiti vidyāt; yatra sarvāsāṃ vedanānāmutpattistaṃ sānnipātikamiti vidyāt ||11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vraṇavarṇān vakṣyāmaḥ- bhasmakapotāsthivarṇaḥ paruṣo'ruṇaḥ kṛṣṇa iti mārutajasyaḥ nīlaḥ pīto haritaḥ śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo raktaḥ piṅgalaḥ kapila iti raktapittasamutthayoḥ; śvetaḥ snigdhaḥ pāṇḍuriti śleṣmajasya; sarvavarṇopetaḥ sānnipātika iti ||12||
bhavati cātra- na kevalaṃ vraṇeṣūkto vedanāvarṇasaṅgrahaḥ | sarvaśophavikāreṣu vraṇavallakṣayedbhiṣak ||13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyo nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||

athātaḥ kṛtyākṛtyavidhimadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye srāvādinā sādhyāsādhyavraṇasya leśato'bhidhānāttatprasaṅgena prapañcena sādhyāsādhyavraṇavijñānārthaṃ kṛtyākṛtyavidhirabhidhīyate| kṛtyāścikitsārūpakriyārhāḥ sādhyāḥ, tadviparyayeṇākṛtyā asādhyāḥ| tayorvidhirbhedaḥ, sa ca sādhyasya sukhasādhyatvādirasādhyasya yāpyatvasadyaḥprāṇaharatvādiḥ’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tatra, vayaḥsthānāṃ dṛḍhānāṃ prāṇavatāṃ sattvavatāṃ (ātmavatāṃ) ca sucikitsyā vraṇāḥ; ekasmin vā puruṣe yatraitadguṇacatuṣṭayaṃ ‘guṇapañcakaṃ’ iti pā. tasya sukhasādhanīyatamāḥ | tatra, vayaḥsthānāṃ pratyagradhātutvādāśu vraṇā rohanti; dṛḍhānāṃ sthirabahumāṃsatvācchastramavacāryamāṇaṃ sirāsnāyvādiviśeṣānna prāpnoti; prāṇavatāṃ vedanābhighātāhārayantraṇādibhirna glānirutpadyate; sattvavatāṃ dāruṇairapi kriyāviśeṣairna vyathā bhavati; tasmādeteṣāṃ ‘ātmavatāṃ punarmitāhāravihārādibhirupadeśairnānyathāmatiḥ pravartate| sarvaṃ caiṣāṃ sādhu bhavati| tasmādeteṣāṃ sukhasādhanīyatamāḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ sukhasādhanīyatamāḥ ||3||
ta eva viparītaguṇā vṛddhakṛśālpaprāṇabhīruṣu draṣṭavyāḥ ||4||
sphikpāyuprajananalalāṭagaṇḍauṣṭhapṛṣṭhakarṇaphalakoṣodarajatrumukhābhyantarasaṃsthāḥ sukharopaṇīyā ‘atra cādhikaraṇamahimnaiva sukhasādhyatvādiviśeṣo bhavati’ iti cakraḥ vraṇāḥ ||5||

akṣidantanāsāpāṅgaśrotranābhijaṭharasevanīnitambapārśvakukṣivakṣaḥkakṣāstanasandhibhāgagatāḥ saphenapūyaraktānilavāhino'ntaḥśalyāśca duścikitsyāḥ; adhobhāgāścordhvabhāganirvāhiṇo ‘adhogatānāmūrdhvamukhenāsamyakpūyanirgamāt kṛcchratvam’ iti cakraḥ, romāntopanakhamarmajaṅghāsthisaṃśritāśca, bhagandaramapi cāntarmukhaṃ sevanīkuṭakāsthisaṃśritam ||6||
kuṣṭhināṃ ‘kuṣṭhyādīnāmatiśayaduṣṭadūṣyatayā vraṇakṛcchratvam’ iti cakraḥ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām | vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ cāpi vraṇe vraṇāḥ ||7||

avapāṭikāniruddhaprakaśasanniruddhagudajaṭharāṇi, granthikṣatakrimayaḥ pratiśyāyajāḥ koṣṭhajāśca tvagdoṣiṇāṃ pramehiṇāṃ vā ye parikṣateṣu dṛśyante, śarkarā sikatāmeho vātakuṇḍalikā'ṣṭhīlā dantaśarkaropakuśaḥ kaṇṭhaśālūkaṃ niṣkoṣaṇadūṣitāśca dantaveṣṭā visarpāsthikṣatoraḥkṣatavraṇagranthiprabhṛtayaśca ‘vraṇayukto granthirvraṇagranthiḥ’ iti cakraḥ yāpyāḥ ||8||
sādhyā yāpyatvamāyānti yāpyāścāsādhyatāṃ tathā | ghnanti prāṇānasādhyāstu narāṇāmakriyāvatām ||9||
yāpanīyaṃ vijānīyāt kriyā dhārayate tu yam | kriyāyāṃ tu nivṛttāyāṃ sadya eva vinaśyati ||10||
prāptā ‘kriyāyāmiti samyakkriyāyām| prāpteti ucitā’ iti cakraḥ kriyāṃ dhārayati yāpyavyādhitamāturam | prapatiṣyadivāgāraṃ viṣkambhaḥ sādhuyojitaḥ ||11||

ata ūrdhvamasādhyān vakṣyāmaḥ- māṃsapiṇḍavadudgatāḥ prasekino'ntaḥpūyavedanāvanto'śvāpānavadudvṛttauṣṭhāḥ udvṛttauṣṭhetyādinaiko'sādhyavraṇaḥ| prasekinaḥ srāvabahulāḥ| vasādisravaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣasamutthavraṇe'sādhyatālakṣaṇam| śiraḥkaṇṭhasthā iti atra śiraḥsthā vā kaṇṭhasthā vā’ iti cakraḥ, kecit kaṭhinā gośṛṅgavadudgatamṛdumāṃsaprarohāḥ, apare duṣṭarudhirāsrāviṇastanuśītapicchilāsrāviṇo vā madhyonnatāḥ, kecidavasannaśuṣiraparyantāḥ śaṇatūlavat snāyujālavanto durdarśanāḥ, vasāmedomajjamastuluṅgasrāviṇaśca doṣasamutthāḥ, pītāsitamūtrapurīṣavātavāhinaśca koṣṭhasthāḥ, ta evobhayatobhāgavraṇamukheṣu pūyaraktanirvāhiṇaḥ, (kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca hārāṇacandrasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ ) sarvatogatayaścāṇumukhā māṃsabudbudavantaḥ, saśabdavātavāhinaśca śiraḥkaṇṭhasthāḥ, kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca pūyaraktanirvāhiṇo'rocakāvipākakāsaśvāsopadravayuktāḥ, bhinne vā śiraḥkapāle yatra mastuluṅgadarśanaṃ tridoṣaliṅgaprādurbhāvaḥ kāsaśvāsau vā yasyeti ||12||
bhavati cātra- vasāṃ medo'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravet | āgantustu ‘atrāgantoḥ sādhyatvamaduṣṭatvādvraṇadeśasya sāmānyenaiva’ iti cakraḥ vraṇaḥ sidhyenna sidhyeddoṣasambhavaḥ ||13||

amarmopahite ‘amarmopahite iti marmavarjite| deśe iti śarīrapradeśe| tasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ- siretyādi| atrādiśabdaṃ luptamicchanti| tena sirāsnāyvādivarjite tvacīti labhyate, anyatra māṃsādau sirādīnāṃ vidyamānatvāt| vikāro yo'nuparyetīti dhātvantareṣvavagāhate kuṣṭhavātaraktādistadasādhyalakṣaṇaṃ, taduktaṃ- ‘evaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samutpannaṃ tvaci kālaprakarṣataḥ| krameṇa dhātūn vyāpnoti narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ’ (su. ni. a. 6) iti| anye tu vikāro'nuparyetītyanena pratikriyākaraṇe'pi yathoktasukhasādhyadeśabhūto'pi vikāro'nuparyeti vardhate tadbalavadadṛṣṭārabdhatayā'sādhyalakṣaṇamiti vadanti, nahi yathoktadehajātasya vikārasya balavadasādhyatākārakādṛṣṭaṃ vinā vṛddhiryuktā’ iti cakraḥ deśe sirāsandhyasthivarjite | vikāroyo'nuparyeti tadasādhyasya lakṣaṇam ||14||

krameṇopacayaṃ ‘sādhyasyāpyupekṣayā dhātvavagāhanenāsādhyatvaṃ darśayannāha- krameṇetyādi| upacayaṃ prāpta iti dhātvavagāhane hetugarbhaṃ viśeṣaṇam| upacayaścāpratīkārādeva jñeyaḥ| śanairityanena cireṇāsya dhātvavasthānaṃ darśayati| atha tatra punaḥ punarbahvauṣadhaṃ kasmāt sādhakaṃ na bhavatītyāha- sa sthiratvādityādi| sthiratve eva hetudvayaṃ mahattvāddhātvanukramaṇena ceti| mahattvena mahādoṣatvaṃ, dhātvanukramaṇena gambhīratvamucyate’ iti cakraḥ prāpya ‘prāptaḥ’ iti pā.; dhātūnanugataḥ śanaiḥ | na śakya unmūlayituṃ vṛddho vṛkṣa ivāmayaḥ ||15||
sa sthiratvānmahattvācca dhātvanukramaṇena ca | nihantyauṣadhavīryāṇi mantrān duṣṭagraho yathā ||16||
ato yo viparītaḥ syāt sukhasādhyaḥ sa ucyate | abaddhamūlaḥ kṣupako yadvadutpāṭane sukhaḥ ||17||
tribhirdoṣairanākrāntaḥ śyāvauṣṭhaḥ piḍakī samaḥ | avedano nirāsrāvo vraṇaḥ śuddha ihocyate ||18||
kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ | sthirāścipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet ||19||
rūḍhavartmānamagranthimaśūnamarujaṃ vraṇam | tvaksavarṇaṃ samatalaṃ samyagrūḍhaṃ vinirdiśet ||20||
doṣaprakopādvyāyāmādabhighātādajīrṇataḥ | harṣāt krodhādbhayādvā'pi vraṇo rūḍho'pi dīryate ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne kṛtyākṛtyavidhirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23||

athāto vyādhisamuddeśīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye sādhyāsādhyatvamuktaṃ, tacca vyādhīnāṃ snehādinā śastreṇa vā bhavatīti tadbhedapratipādanārthaṃ pravṛttaḥ sarvāneva vyādhīnavaśyapratipādanīyān pratipādayituṃ vyādhisamuddeśīyamāha’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
dvividhāstu vyādhayaḥ- śastrasādhyāḥ, snehādikriyāsādhyāśca | tatra śastrasādhyeṣu snehādikriyā na pratiṣidhyate, snehādikriyāsādhyeṣu śastrakarma na kriyate ||3||

asmin punaḥ śāstre sarvatantrasāmānyāt ‘sarvatantrasāmānyāditi sarvatantraviṣayavyāpakatvāt| yaduktaṃ- ‘yat kiñcidābādhakaraṃ tat sarvaṃ śalyasañjñitam| vyāptānyaṅgānyato'nena śalyajñānena bhūriṇā’ iti cakraḥ sarveṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ yathāsthūlamavarodhaḥ kriyate | prāgabhihitaṃ ‘tadduḥkhasaṃyogā vyādhaya’ (sū. a. 1) iti | tacca duḥkhaṃ trividham- ādhyātmikam, ādhibhautikam, ādhidaivikamiti | tattu saptavidhe vyādhāvupanipatati | te punaḥ saptavidhā vyādhayaḥ; tadyathā- ādibalapravṛttāḥ, janmabalapravṛttāḥ, doṣabalapravṛttāḥ, saṅghātabalapravṛttāḥ, kālabalapravṛttāḥ, daivabalapravṛttāḥ, svabhāvabalapravṛttā ‘atrātmaśabdena śarīraṃ bhaṇyate| ātmanyadhivartata ityadhyātmaṃ śārīramānasādidoṣāḥ, tatra bhavamādhyātmikam| bhūtāni bāhyāni vātādīni pṛthivyādīni ca| tena nimittena bhūtamādhibhautikam| duḥkhamupadiśya tatsambandhena vyādhibhedānāha- tattvityādi| vakṣyamāṇasaptavidhe vyādhau tadduḥkhaprasaraṃ upanipatati upagataṃ bhavati vyādhikāryatayā| ādirjīvopakramaḥ, sa ca śukraśoṇitamelakaḥ, tasya balaṃ prakaraṇādvyādhijanikā śaktiḥ, sā ca śukraśoṇitadoṣarūpaiva, tenādibalena bhūtā ādibalapravṛttāḥ| evaṃ janmani balaṃ pūrvajanmavyavasthitā doṣā evetyādi pūrvavad vyākhyeyam| saṃhananaṃ saṃhatiḥ āgantuhetusambandhaḥ| tadbalapravṛttāḥ saṅghātabalapravṛttāḥ’ iti cakraḥ iti ||4||

tatra, ādibalapravṛttā ye śukraśoṇitadoṣānvayāḥ kuṣṭhārśaḥprabhṛtayaḥ; te'pi dvividhāḥ- mātṛjāḥ, pitṛjāśca | janmabalapravṛttā ye māturapacārāt paṅgujātyandhabadhiramūkaminminavāmanaprabhṛtayo jāyante; te'pi dvividhāḥ rasakṛtāḥ, dauhṛdāpacārakṛtāśca | doṣabalapravṛttā ye ātaṅkasamutpannā mithyāhārācārakṛtāśca; te'pi dvividhāḥ āmāśayasamutthāḥ ‘āmāśayasamutthā nābheruparijāḥ kaphapittajanyā vā| pakvāśayasamutthā nābhyadhogatā vātajanyā vā’ iti cakraḥ, pakvāśayasamutthāśca; punaśca dvividhāḥ- śārīrā, mānasāśca | ta ete ādhyātmikāḥ ||5||

saṅghātabalapravṛttā ya āgantavo ‘ye āgantava iti āgantuviśeṣā ityarthaḥ, aparāgantūnāṃ bhūtādīnāmādhidaivike'bhidhānāt| durbalasya balavadvigrahādityāgantuviśeṣakāraṇopalakṣaṇaṃ, tena patanādijanyānāmapi grahaṇam| śastrakṛtā ityatra śastrasya hiṃsakamātropalakṣaṇatayā atiriktābhighātapīḍanādikṛtāśca gṛhyante’ iti cakraḥ durbalasya balavadvigrahāt; te'pi dvividhāḥ- śastrakṛtā, vyālakṛtāśca | ete ādhibhautikāḥ ||6||

kālabalapravṛttā ye śītoṣṇavātavarṣātapaprabhṛtinimittāḥ; te'pi dvividhāḥ- vyāpannartukṛtāḥ, avyāpannartukṛtāśca ‘avyāpannartukṛtāḥ kālasvabhāvakṛtapittādicayādikṛtāḥ|’ iti cakraḥ| daivabalapravṛtā ye devadrohādabhiśaptakā ‘abhiśastakāḥ’ iti pā. atharvaṇakṛtā upasargajāśca; te'pi dvividhāḥ- vidyudaśanikṛtāḥ, piśācādikṛtāśca; punaśca dvividhāḥ- saṃsargajā ‘atra saṃsargajā aupasargikarogisaṃsargajātāḥ| ākasmikāḥ saṃsargajavyatiriktā ādhidaivikā aparidṛśyamānahetutayā ākasmikā bhaṇyante’ iti cakraḥ, ākasmikāśca | svabhāvabalapravṛttā ‘svabhāvo mānuṣaśarīrasya jātipratibaddho'dṛṣṭakṛto bhāvaḥ’ iti cakraḥ|’ ye kṣutpipāsājarāmṛtyunidrāprabhṛtayaḥ; te'pi dvividhāḥ- kālajā, akālajāśca; tatra parirakṣaṇakṛtāḥ kālajāḥ, aparirakṣaṇakṛtā akālajāḥ | ete ādhidaivikāḥ ‘daivaṃ prāktanaṃ karmādhikṛtya vartate ityadhidaivaṃ, tatra bhūtamityādhidaivike vyutpattimicchāmaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| atra sarvavyādhyavarodhaḥ ||7||

sarveṣāṃ ‘mūlamiti kāraṇam| āgantukāraṇe mānase ca kathaṃ vātādimūlatvamityāha- talliṅgatvāditi| vātādiliṅgayuktatvādityarthaḥ| āgantāvapi hi vātādiliṅgaṃ śarīrakṣobhādavaśyaṃ bhavati, paraṃ tat kiyantamapi kālaṃ vātādicikitsāprayojanakaṃ na bhavati| yaduktaṃ- ‘tatrābhighātajo vāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan’ (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| tathā ‘āganturanveti nijaṃ vikāraṃ’ (ca. sū. a. 19) iti | mānase'pi kāmādau doṣakopo bhavatyeva| yaduktaṃ- ‘kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ’ (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| dṛṣṭaphalatvāditi vātādikriyayā sarvavikāreṣu sādhyeṣūpaśayarūpaphaladarśanāt| āgantāvapi kālānubandhāddoṣakriyayā phalaṃ bhavati| āgamācceti ‘nāsti rogo vinā doṣaiḥ’ (sū. a. 35) ityādi, carake'pyuktaṃ- ‘vikāro dhātuvaiṣamyaṃ’ (ca. sū. a. 9) iti| atra dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathetyādi| vikārajātamiti mahadādīni sapta, ekādaśendriyāṇi, pañcārthāḥ, tathā tadvikārāśca goghaṭādayaḥ| viśvarūpeṇeti sthāvarādiviśvarūpatayā, sattvarajastamasāmeva hi prakṛtirūpāṇāṃ mahadādi sarvaṃ pariṇāma iti sāṅkhyanayaḥ| viśvarūpeṇeti jvarātisāravraṇādirūpeṇa|’ iti cakraḥ ca vyādhīnāṃ vātapittaśleṣmāṇa eva mūlaṃ; talliṅgatvāddṛṣṭaphalatvādāgamācca | yathā hi kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ viśvarūpeṇāvasthitaṃ sattvarajastamāṃsi na vyatiricyante, evameva kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ viśvarūpeṇāvasthitamavyatiricya vātapittaśleṣmāṇo vartante | doṣadhātumalasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vikalpaḥ ‘vikalpā bhavanti’ iti pā.| doṣadūṣiteṣvatyarthaṃ dhātuṣu sañjñā- rasajo'yaṃ, śoṇitajo'yaṃ, māṃsajo'yaṃ, medojo'yaṃ, asthijo'yaṃ majjajo'yaṃ, śukrajo'yaṃ vyādhiriti ||8||

tatra, annāśraddhārocakāvipākāṅgamardajvarahṛllāsatṛptigauravahṛtpāṇḍurogamārgoparodhakārśyavairasyāṅgasādākālajavalīpalitadarśanaprabhṛtayo ‘arocakastvāhārecchāyāṃ satyāmannasya mukhapraveśane asvādutvāvabodhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ rasadoṣajā vikārāḥ; kuṣṭhavisarpapiḍakāmaśakanīlikātilakālakanyacchavyaṅgendraluptaplīhavidradhigulmavātaśoṇitārśo'rbudāṅgamardāsṛgdararaktapittaprabhṛtayo raktadoṣajāḥ atra ‘raktadoṣāḥ’ iti, ‘raktadoṣāt’ iti ca pā.| evamagre'pi ‘māṃsadoṣāḥ’, ‘māṃsadoṣāt’ ityādi jñeyam, gudamukhameḍhrapākāśca; adhimāṃsārbudārśo'dhijihvopajihvopakuśagalaśuṇḍikālajīmāṃsasaṅghātauṣṭhaprakopagalagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāprabhṛtayo māṃsadoṣajāḥ; granthivṛddhigalagaṇḍārbudamedojauṣṭhaprakopamadhumehātisthaulyātisvedaprabhṛtayo medodoṣajāḥ; adhyasthyadhidantāsthitodaśūlakunakhaprabhṛtayo'sthidoṣajāḥ; tamodarśanamūrcchābhramaparvasthūlamūlārurjanmanetrābhiṣyandaprabhṛtayo majjadoṣajāḥ; klaibyāpraharṣaśukrāśmarīśukramehaśukradoṣādayaśca taddoṣāḥ; tvagdoṣāḥ saṅgo'tipravṛttirayathāpravṛttirvā malāyatanadoṣāḥ; indriyāṇāmapravṛttirayathāpravṛttirvendriyāyatanadoṣāḥ; ityeṣa ‘ityevaṃ’ iti pā. samāsa uktaḥ; vistaraṃ ‘vistaranimittāni ca’ iti pā. nimittāni caiṣāṃ pratirogaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ ||9||
bhavati cātra- kupitānāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ śarīre paridhāvatām | yatra saṅgaḥ khavaiguṇyādvyādhistatropajāyate ‘svavaiguṇyāt’ iti pā.||10||

bhūyo'tra ‘evaṃ doṣadhātusaṃsargān vikārānabhidhāya jvarādinā saha vātādīnāṃ saṃsargamāhabhūyo'tretyādi| jvarādayo vātādikāryaṃ, kāryaṃ ca samavāyikāraṇena nityasambaddhaṃ, kāraṇaṃ tu nāvaśyaṃ kāryeṇa| yathā- tantustvanutpādyaiva paṭaṃ bhavitumarhati, kintu na punastantuṃ vinā paṭaḥ| ityevamākārā jvarādayo doṣeṣviti darśayannāha- doṣānityādi| atra dṛṣṭānte ‘ākāśaṃ pratyākhyāya’ iti vacanamakāraṇasyākāśasya vidyudādivyāpakatayā uktam| taraṅgabudbudādayaścodakaviśeṣā iti doṣavyādhivat kāryakāraṇatayā tulya eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ| nimittata eveti jvarādijanakavātādikāraṇāt| tata eva vātāderbhavati nānyataścetyevakārārthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ jijñāsyaṃ, kiṃ vātādīnāṃ jvarādīnāṃ ca nityaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ paricchedo vā? iti; yadi nityaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ syāttarhi nityāturāḥ sarva eva prāṇinaḥ syuḥ; athāpyanyathā ‘athavā’ iti pā.| ‘atheti pakṣopanyāsārtham| vātādīnāṃ jvarādīnāṃ cānyathā paricchede'pi ‘anyatra vartamānānāṃ bhāvānāmanyatra liṅgaṃ na bhavati’ iti kṛtvā iti nyāyāt ‘vātādayo jvarādīnāṃ mūlāni’ iti yaducyate ‘sarveṣāṃ ca vyādhīnāṃ’ ityādinā prāguktena granthasandarbheṇa, tannopapadyate, prāṇināṃ vātādimattve satyapi nityāturatvenālakṣyamāṇatvāt, jvarādīnāṃ vātādiliṅgatvenaivopalambhācceti bhāvaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ vātādīnāṃ jvarādīnāṃ ca, ‘anyatra vartamānānāmanyatra liṅgaṃ na bhavati’ iti kṛtvā yaducyate vātādayo jvarādīnāṃ mūlānīti tanna | atrocyate- doṣān pratyākhyāya jvarādayo na bhavanti; atha ca na (nityaḥ) sambandhaḥ; yathāhi vidyudvātāśanivarṣāṇyākāśaṃ pratyākhyāya na bhavanti, satyapyākāśe kadācinna bhavanti, atha ca nimittatastata evotpattiriti; taraṅgabudbudādayaścodakaviśeṣāḥ eva; vātādīnāṃ jvarādīnāṃ ca nāpyevaṃ saṃśleṣo na paricchedaḥ śāśvatikaḥ, atha ca nimittata evotpattiriti ||11||
bhavati cātra- vikāraparimāṇaṃ ca saṅkhyā caiṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak | vistareṇottare tantre sarvābādhāśca vakṣyate ||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne vyādhisamuddeśīyo nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||24||

div.head: aṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘aṣṭavidhaśastrakarmaṇyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. | “athātaḥ śastrakarmavidhiviniścayamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1|| chedyāstu bhagandarārśo'rbudaduṣṭavraṇanāḍīcarmakīlatilakālakamedogranthiśleṣmanimittāścāmayāstathāmāṃsasirāsnāyukotho māṃsakandī māṃsāsthigatamapi śalyamutsaṅgaḥ śataponako jatumaṇirvalmīkamadhruṣo'dhimāṃsamāṃsasaṅghātagalaśuṇḍikā ityevamādayo vikārāḥ||2|| bhedyāstu sarvajāmṛte vidradhyanuśayī pramehapiḍakā granthayaśca visarpāścāditastrayastrayo vṛddhayaśca vidārikāvamanthaupuṣkarikā nāḍyaḥ stanarogāśca sahopadaṃśaiḥ śothāśca sarvasarāḥ prāyaśaḥ kṣudrarogāstālupuppuṭatuṇḍikerīgilāyuprabhṛtayo'ntaḥ pūyaśalyā ye ca bhedaḥ samutthā aśmarīhetorbastiśca||3|| lekhyāścatasro rohiṇyo vraṇanetravartmārśo'dhijihvopajihvāmāṃsocchrāyāḥ kilāsā dantavaidarbhaḥ pañca medojāśca||4|| vedhyāstu sirodaravṛddhiprabhṛtayaḥ||5|| eṣyāstu gatimanto ‘nāḍyaḥ’ śalyāni ca||6|| āhāryāstu dantāntaḥ- śarkarāśmarīmūḍhagarbhaṅkarṇamalaśalyāni pādaśarkarāśca||7|| visrāvyāvidradhiḥ sarvā bhavedanyatra sarvajāt||8||’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1|| yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2|| chedyā bhagandarā granthiḥ ślaiṣmikastilakālakaḥ | vraṇavartmārbudānyarśaścarmakīlo'sthimāṃsagam ||3|| śalyaṃ jatumaṇirmāṃsasaṅghāto galaśuṇḍikā | snāyumāṃsasirākotho valmīkaṃ śataponakaḥ ||4|| adhruṣaścopadaṃśāśca māṃsakandyadhimāṃsakaḥ |5|

ab.seg: bhedyā vidradhayo'nyatra sarvajādgranthayastrayaḥ ||5||
ādito ye visarpāśca vṛddhayaḥ savidārikāḥ | pramehapiḍakāḥ śophaḥ stanarogo'vamanthakāḥ ||6||
kumbhīkānuśayī nāḍyo vṛndau puṣkarikā'lajī | prāyaśaḥ kṣudrarogāśca puppuṭau tāludantajau ||7||
tuṇḍikerī gilāyuśca pūrvaṃ ye ca prapākiṇaḥ | bastistathā'śmarīhetormedojā cakrastu ‘pañca medaḥsamutthānā’ iti paṭhitvā, ‘galāgaṇḍagranthyapacyarbudavṛddhayaḥ’ iti vyākhyānayati ye ca kecana ||8||

div.ab: lekhyāścatasro rohiṇyaḥ kilāsamupajihvikā | medojo dantavaidarbho granthirvartmādhijihvikā ||9|| arśāṃsi maṇḍalaṃ māṃsakandī māṃsonnatistathā |10|

ab.seg: vedhyāḥ sirā bahuvidhā mūtravṛddhirdakodaram ||10||

div.ab: eṣyā nāḍyaḥ saśalyāśca vraṇā unmārgiṇaśca ye |11|
āhāryāḥ śarkarāstisro dantakarṇamalo'śmarī ||11|| śalyāni mūḍhagarbhāśca varcaśca nicitaṃ gude |12|

srāvyā vidradhayaḥ pañca bhaveyuḥ sarvajādṛte ||12|| kuṣṭhāni vāyuḥ sarujaḥ śopho yaścaikadeśajaḥ | pālyāmayāḥ ślīpadāni viṣajuṣṭaṃ ca śoṇitam ||13|| arbudāni visarpāśca granthayaścāditaśca te | trayastrayaścopadaṃśāḥ stanarogā vidārikā ||14|| su(śu)ṣiro galaśālūkaṃ kaṇṭakāḥ kaṇṭakā jihvākaṇṭakāḥ’ iti cakraḥ kṛmidantakaḥ | dantaveṣṭaḥ sopakuśaḥ śītādo dantapuppuṭaḥ ||15|| pittāsṛkkaphajāścauṣṭhyāḥ kṣudrarogāśca bhūyaśaḥ |16|

sīvyā ‘sīvyā bhedaḥ samutthāśca bhitvā vilikhitā gadāḥ| kaphagranthiralpapāliḥ karṇaḥ sadyovraṇāśca ye|| śirolalāṭākṣikūṭakarṇauṣṭhanāsāgaṇḍakṛkāṭikābāhūdarasphikpāyuprajananamuṣkādiṣu pradeśeṣvacaleṣu māṃsavatsu ca sīvyet| jānukūrparasandhyādiṣu ca pracaleṣvalpamāṃseṣu na sīvyet| vāyunirvāhiṇo'ntarlohitaśalyāḥ saviṣāśca na sīvyāḥ| tatra sīvyaṃ vraṇamabhisamīkṣya calāsthipāṃsutṛṇaromaśuṣkaraktādīnapohyotkṛṣya yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayitvā snāyusūtrabālānāmanyatamena sīvyet, tṛṇāśmantakamūrvātasīnāṃ valkalaiḥ| sūcyastu tisra upadiśyante- dvyaṅgulātryaṅgulā dhanurvakreti| tatra māṃsaleṣvavakāśeṣu tryasrā, sandhyasthisvalpamāṃseṣvavakāśeṣu ca dvyaṅgulā vṛttā, pakvāmāśayayormarmasu ca dhanurvakrā'rdhatṛtīyāṅgulā| gophaṇikā tunnasevanī villitakamṛjugranthiśceti samāsena sīvanavikalpāḥ| teṣāṃ nāmabhirevākṛtayaḥ prāyeṇa vyākhyātāḥ| teṣāṃ prahāramāsādyopayogaṃ buddhvā bandhe na cātisannikṛṣṭāṃ viprakṛṣṭāmalpagrāhiṇīmatigrāhiṇīṃ vā sūcīṃ pātayet| bhavati cātra- dūre nipatitā bādhaṃ sannikṛṣṭe'valuñcanam| alpagrahāttadvadeva vraṇe kuryādatastyajet|| samyak sīvitamavekṣya madhughṛtairañjanamadhukarodhrāpriyaṅguśallakīphalarasāñjanakṣaumamasīcūrṇaiḥ pratisārya bandhenopacaret|| bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- etadaṣṭavidhaṃ karma” ityādistāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ medaḥsamutthāśca bhinnāḥ sulikhitā gadāḥ ||16|| sadyovraṇāśca ye caiva calasandhivyapāśritāḥ ‘calasandhivyayāśrayāḥ’ iti pā|17|
na kṣārāgniviṣairjuṣṭā na ca mārutavāhinaḥ ||17|| nāntarlohitaśalyāśca... |18|
... teṣu samyagviśodhanam |18|

ab.seg: pāṃśuromanakhādīni calamasthi bhavecca yat ||18||
ahṛtāni yato'mūni pācayeyurbhṛśaṃ vraṇam | rujaśca vividhāḥ kuryustasmādetān viśodhayet ||19||

tato vraṇaṃ samunnamya sthāpayitvā yathāsthitam | sīvyet ‘sūtrādibhiryathāyogyatayā sīvyediti yojyam| vellitabandhavadvellitakam| tryasratvaṃ bṛhattvaṃ ca māṃsalāvakāśasya dūravedhyatvāt| sandhyādīnāmalpavedhyatayā vṛttātvamalpatvaṃ ca| pakvāśayādāvantaḥ praveśatayā vakrā’ iti cakraḥ sūkṣmeṇa sūtreṇa valkenāśmantakasya vā ||20||
śaṇajakṣaumasūtrābhyāṃ snāyvā bālena vā punaḥ | mūrvāguḍūcītānairvā sīvyedvellitakaṃ śanaiḥ ||21||
sīvyedgophaṇikāṃ vā'pi sīvyedvā tunnasevanīm | ṛjugranthimatho vā'pi yathāyogamathāpi vā ||22||
deśe'lpamāṃse sandhau ca sūcī vṛttā'ṅguladvayam | āyatā tryaṅgulā tryasrā māṃsale cā'pi pūjitā ||23||
dhanurvakrā hitā marmaphalakośodaropari | ityetāstrividhāḥ sūcīstīkṣṇāgrāḥ susamāhitāḥ ||24||
kārayenmālatīpuṣpavṛntāgraparimaṇḍalāḥ | nātidūre nikṛṣṭe vā sūcīṃ karmaṇi pātayet ||25||
dūrādrujo vraṇauṣṭhasya sannikṛṣṭe'valuñcanam ||26||
atha kṣaumapicucchannaṃ susyūtaṃ ‘saṃsyūtaṃ’ iti pā. pratisārayet | priyaṅgvañjanayaṣṭyāhvarodhracūrṇaiḥ samantataḥ ||27||

śallakīphalacūrṇairvā kṣaumadhyāmena vā punaḥ | tato vraṇaṃ yathāyogaṃ baddhvā''cārikamādiśet ‘atra vraṇarohe krameṇa sūtracchedo'pi jñeyaḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje- “yadā manyeta saṃśliṣṭāṃ peśyā peśīṃ tvacā tvacam| tadā bandhanamekaṃ dve trīṇi vā mokṣayet kramāt” iti cakraḥ||28||
etadaṣṭavidhaṃ karma samāsena prakīrtitam | cikitsiteṣu kārtsnyena vistarastasya vakṣyate ||29||
hīnātiriktaṃ tiryak ca gātracchedanamātmanaḥ | etāścatasro'ṣṭavidhe karmaṇi vyāpadaḥ smṛtāḥ ||30||
ajñānalobhāhitavākyayogabhayapramohairaparaiśca bhāvaiḥ | yadā prayuñjīta bhiṣak kuśastraṃ tadā sa ‘saśeṣān’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ śeṣān kurute vikārān ||31||
taṃ kṣāraśastrāgnibhirauṣadhaiśca bhūyo'bhiyuñjānamayuktiyuktam | jijīviṣurdūrata eva vaidyaṃ vivarjayedugraviṣāhitulyam ||32||
tadeva yuktaṃ tvati marmasandhīn hiṃsyāt sirāḥ snāyumathāsthi caiva | mūrkhaprayuktaṃ puruṣaṃ kṣaṇena prāṇairviyuñjyādathavā kadācit ||33||

bhramaḥ pralāpaḥ patanaṃ pramoho viceṣṭanaṃ saṃlayanoṣṇate hārāṇacandrastu ‘saṃlapanoṣṇate ca’ iti paṭhati, ‘saṃlapanaṃ rahasi bhāṣaṇaṃ, cittavibhramādaspaṣṭamananyāpekṣibhāṣaṇamityetat’ iti vyākhyānayati ca ca | srastāṅgatā mūrcchanamūrdhvavātastīvrā rujo vātakṛtāśca tāstāḥ ||34||
māṃsodakābhaṃ rudhiraṃ ca gacchet sarvendriyārthoparamastathaiva | daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣvapi vikṣateṣu sāmānyato marmasu liṅgamuktam ||35||
surendragopapratimaṃ prabhūtaṃ raktaṃ sravedvai kṣatataśca vāyuḥ | karoti rogān vividhān yathoktāṃśchinnāsu ‘sirāsu cchinnāsvatha vikṣatāsu’ iti pā. bhinnāsvathavā sirāsu ||36||
kaubjyaṃ śarīrāvayavāvasādaḥ kriyāsvaśaktistumulā rujaśca | cirādvrraṇo rohati yasya cāpi taṃ snāyuviddhaṃ manujaṃ vyavasyet ||37||
śophātivṛddhistumulā rujaśca balakṣayaḥ parvasu bhedaśophau | kṣateṣu sandhiṣvacalācaleṣu syāt sandhikarmoparatiśca liṅgam ||38||
ghorā rujo yasya niśādineṣu sarvāsvavasthāsu na ‘ca naiti śāntim’ iti pā. śāntirasti | tṛṣṇāṅgasādau śvayathuśca ruk ‘rūkṣaḥ’ iti pā. ca tamasthividdhaṃ manujaṃ vyavasyet ||39||

div.ab: yathāsvametāni vibhāvayecca liṅgāni marmasvabhitāḍiteṣu |40|

ab.seg: sparśaṃ na jānāti vipāṇḍuvarṇo yo māṃsamarmaṇyabhitāḍitaḥ syāt ||40||
ātmānamevātha jaghanyakārī śastreṇa yo hanti hi karma kurvan | tamātmavānātmahanaṃ kuvaidyaṃ vivarjayedāyurabhīpsamānaḥ ||41||
tiryak praṇihite śastre doṣāḥ pūrvamudāhṛtāḥ | tasmāt pariharan doṣān kuryācchastranipātanam ||42||

div.ab: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ putrān bāndhavānapi cāturaḥ | apyetānabhiśaṅketa vaidye viśvāsameti ca ||43|| visṛjatyātmanā''tmānaṃ na cainaṃ pariśaṅkate |44|

ab.seg: tasmāt putravadevainaṃ pālayedāturaṃ bhiṣak ||44||
dharmārthau kīrtimityarthaṃ ‘kīrtiprītyarthaṃ’ iti pā satāṃ grahaṇamuttamam | prāpnuyāt svargavāsaṃ ca hitamārabhya karmaṇā ||45||
karmaṇā kaścidekena dvābhyāṃ kaścittribhistathā | vikāraḥ sādhyate kaściccaturbhirapi karmabhiḥ ||46||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'ṣṭavidhaśastrakarmīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25||

athātaḥ pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye'ntaḥśalyam’ ityuktam, atasteṣāmantaḥ sthitaśalyānāṃ jñānārthaṃ pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| pranaṣṭamāpātato'nupalabhyamānam’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

‘śala’ ‘śvala’ āśugamane dhātūḥ; tayorādyasya śalyamiti ‘tatra śalyanirūpaṇameva darśayitumudyato niruktyā śalyarūpamāha- śala hiṃsāyāmityādi| atra śaladhātoścaurādikaṇijantāt ‘erac’ (pā. a. 3/3/56) ityacā ‘śala’ iti rūpaṃ, tena śalanaṃ hiṃsanaṃ śalaḥ| tathā ca śalasya hiṃsāyā nimittaṃ saṃyogo yasya tat śalyam| yatpratyayāt śalyamiti rūpasiddhiḥ| asya dvayī pravṛttiḥ| ekā niruktyā śalyaṃ sarvavyādhīnāha, yaduktaṃ- ‘yatkiñcidābādhakaraṃ tatsarvaṃ śalyasañjñitam’ iti| aparā tu rūḍhyā śarādau vartate| tatra niruktyarthameva parigṛhyāha- taddvividhamityādi|’ iti cakraḥ| ‘śalati ‘śala’ gatau (bhvā. 843) adhnyāditvāt (u. 4/ 112) yaḥ’ iti amaravyākhyāyāṃ bhānudīkṣitaḥ| ‘śala’ hiṃsāyāṃ dhātuḥ, tasya yatpratyayasya śalyamiti rūpaṃ bhavati’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ rūpam ||3||
taddvividhaṃ śārīramāgantukaṃ ca ||4||
sarvaśarīrābādhakaraṃ śalyaṃ, tadihopadiśyata ityataḥ ‘ityataḥ śalyaśāstramiti asmiñchāstre niruktyarthameva śalyasya gṛhītvā sarvābādhaviṣayatayā upadeśa iti bhāvaḥ’ iti cakraḥ śalyaśāstram ||5||

tatra ‘tatretyādinā śārīraśalyavivaraṇe dantanakharomādīnāmādau grahaṇaṃ dantādiṣu rūḍhyarthaśalyaśabdasyāpi yogāt| tathāhi- dantaścalitaḥ śārīraṃ śalyam, anyagātrapraviṣṭaṃ mukhyaṃ śalyaṃ ca bhavati| evamuktarūpo nakhaḥ| tathā akṣipratipakṣmaroma śārīraṃ śalyam, anyatra śarīrapradeśe vraṇāntargataṃ mukhyaṃ ca śalyamiti| annaṃ duṣṭaṃ śalyameva ābādhakaratvāt| dhātvādayo'pi duṣṭāḥ śalyam| āgantuśalyodāharaṇe śārīravyatirekeṇeti mānasaśokādiśalyasyāpi grahaṇārtham’ iti cakraḥ śārīraṃ dantaromanakhādi dhātavo'nnamalā doṣāśca duṣṭāḥ; āgantvapi śārīraśalyavyatirekeṇa yāvanto bhāvā duḥkhamutpādayanti ||6||

adhikāro hi lohaveṇuvṛkṣatṛṇaśṛṅgāsthimayeṣu; tatrāpi viśeṣato loheṣveva ‘lohamayeṣveva’ iti pā., viśasanārthopapannatvāllohasya; lohānāmapi durvāratvādaṇumukhatvāddūraprayojanakaratvācca śara evādhikṛtaḥ | sa ca dvividhaḥ karṇī ‘karṇavān’ iti pā., ślakṣṇaśca; prāyeṇa vividhavṛkṣapatrapuṣpaphalatulyākṛtayo vyākhyātāḥ, vyālamṛgapakṣivakrasadṛśāśca ||7||

sarvaśalyānāṃ ‘śarīre sarvaśalyānāṃ gatayaḥ pañcadhā smṛtāḥ| ṛjvāgatamavāñcīnaṃ tirya gūrdhvamadhogatam’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ tu mahatāmaṇūnāṃ vā pañcavidho gativiśeṣa ūrdhvamadho'rvācīnastiryagṛjuriti ||8||

tāni ‘tāni yadā vegakṣayāt ...... śarīrapradeśeṣu, tatra śalyalakṣaṇamucyamānamupadhāraya’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| pratighātāditi asthyādinā vegapratibandhāt| vegakṣayastu svata eva| peśīśabdena peśyormadhyam, ata eva vraṇavastugṛhītamāṃsādasya bhedaḥ| prabhṛtigrahaṇāt sirābhyantaragrahaṇam|’ iti cakraḥ vegakṣayāt pratighātādvā tvagādiṣu vraṇavastuṣvatiṣṭhante, dhamanīsroto'sthivivarapeśīprabhṛtiṣu vā śarīrapradeśeṣu ||9||

tatra śalyalakṣaṇamucyamānamupadhāraya | taddvidhaṃ sāmānyaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ ca | śyāvaṃ piḍakācitaṃ śophavedanāvantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ śoṇitāsrāviṇaṃ budbudavadunnataṃ mṛdumāṃsaṃ ca vraṇaṃ jānīyāt saśalyo'yamiti; sāmānyametallakṣaṇamuktam | vaiśeṣikaṃ tu- tvaggate vivarṇaḥ śopho bhavatyāyataḥ kaṭhinaśca; māṃsagate śophābhi(ti)vṛddhiḥ śalyamārgānupasaṃrohaḥ pīḍanāsahiṣṇutā coṣapākau ca; peśyantarasthe'pyetadeva coṣaśophavarjaṃ; sirāgate sirādhmānaṃ sirāśūlaṃ sirāśophaśca; snāyugate snāyujālotkṣepaṇaṃ saṃrambhaścogrā ruk ca; srotogate srotasāṃ svakarmaguṇahāniḥ; dhamanīsthe saphenaṃ raktamīrayannanilaḥ saśabdo nirgacchatyaṅgamardaḥ pipāsā hṛllāsaśca; asthigate vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaḥ śophaśca; asthivivaragate'sthipūrṇatā'sthitodaḥ saṃharṣo balavāṃśca; sandhigate'sthivacceṣṭoparamaśca; koṣṭhagata āṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhāt; marmagate marmaviddhavacceṣṭate | sūkṣmagatiṣu śalyeṣvetānyeva lakṣaṇānyaspaṣṭāni bhavanti ||10||

mahāntyalpāni vā śuddhadehānāmanulomasanniviṣṭāni rohanti viśeṣataḥ kaṇṭhasrotaḥsirātvakpeśyasthivivareṣaḥ | doṣaprakopavyāyāmābhighātājīrṇebhyaḥ ‘kālāntarakope hetumāha- doṣetyādi| etadeva ca kālāntarakopitvamanviṣyāharaṇe iha vaktavye kāraṇaṃ jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ pracalitāni punarbādhante ||11||

tatra, tvakpranaṣṭe snigdhasvinnāyāṃ mṛnmāṣayavagodhūmagomayamṛditāyāṃ tvaci yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, styānaghṛtamṛccandanakalkairvā pradigdhāyāṃ śalyoṣmaṇā''śu visarati ghṛtamupaśuṣyati cālepo yatra tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; māṃsapranaṣṭe snehasvedādibhiḥ kriyāviśeṣairaviruddhairāturamupapādayet, karśitasya tu śithilībhūtamanavabaddhaṃ kṣubhyamāṇaṃ yatra saṃrambhaṃ vedanāṃ vā janayati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; koṣṭhāsthisandhipeśīvivareṣvavasthitamevameva parīkṣeta; sirādhamanīsrotaḥsnāyupranaṣṭe khaṇḍacakrasaṃyukte yāne vyādhitamāropyāśu viṣame'dhvani yāyāt yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; asthipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannānyasthīni bandhanapīḍanābhyāṃ bhṛśamupācaret, yatra saṃrambho vedanā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt; sandhipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannān sandhīn prasaraṇākuñcanabandhanapīḍanaiḥ bhṛśamupācaret, yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, sandhipranaṣṭe snehasvedopapannān sandhīn prasaraṇākuñcanabandhanapīḍanairbhṛśamupācaret; yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt, marmapranaṣṭe tvananyabhāvānmarmaṇāmuktaṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ bhavati ||12||

sāmānyalakṣamapi ca hastiskandhāśvapṛṣṭhaparvatadrumārohaṇadhanurvyāyāmadrutayānaniyuddhādhvagamanalaṅghanaplavanaprataraṇa- vyāyāmairjṛmbhodgārakāsakṣavathuṣṭhīvanahasanaprāṇāyāmairvātamūtrapurīṣaśukrotsargairvā yatra saṃrambho vedanā vā bhavati tatra śalyaṃ vijānīyāt ||13||
bhavanti cātra- yasmiṃstodādayo deśe suptatā gurutā'pi ca | ghaṭṭate ‘ghaṭṭite’ iti pā. bahuśo yatra śūyate rujyate'pi ca ||14||
āturaścāpi yaṃ deśamabhīkṣṇaṃ parirakṣati | saṃvāhyamāno bahuśastatra śalyaṃ vinirdiśet ||15||
alpābādhamaśūnaṃ ca nīrujaṃ nirupadravam | prasannaṃ mṛduparyantaṃ nirāghaṭṭamanunnatam ||16||
eṣaṇyā sarvato dṛṣṭvā yathāmārgaṃ cikitsakaḥ | prasārākuñcanānnūnaṃ niḥśalyamiti nirdiśet ||17||
asthyātmakaṃ bhajyate tu śalyamantaśca śīryate | prāyo nirbhujyate śārṅgamāyasaṃ ceti niścayaḥ ||18||
vārkṣavaiṇavatārṇāni nirhriyante tu no yadi | pacanti raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kṣiprametāni dehinām ||19||
kānakaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ raitikaṃ trapu sīsakam | cirasthānādvilīyante pittatejaḥpratāpanāt ‘pittatejaḥ jaṭharāgnirūpapittatejaḥsahakṛto dohoṣmā’ iti cakraḥ||20||
svabhāvaśītā mṛdavo ye cānye'pīdṛśā matāḥ | dravībhūtāḥ śarīre'sminnekatvaṃ yānti dhātubhiḥ ||21||

viṣāṇadantakeśāsthiveṇudārupalāni tu | śalyāni na viśīryante śarīre mṛnmayāni ‘anena ca naṣṭaśalyāvasthākathanena asthyātmakamavayavāntaramanviṣyāhartavyaṃ, śārṅgādi haṭhātkṛtvā hartavyaṃ, vārkṣādi śīghramāhartavyaṃ, kānakādīnāṃ pramādabhayādanāharaṇe'pi na doṣa iti prayojanamuktam’ iti cakraḥ ca ||22||
dvividhaṃ pañcagatimattvagādivraṇavastuṣu ‘pañcagatikaṃ’ iti pā.| yo vetti viṣṭitaṃ śalyaṃ sa rājñaḥ kartumarhati ||23||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīyo nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||26||
athātaḥ śalyāpanayanīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāyoktavidhinā jñātasya śalyasya nirharaṇārthaṃ śalyāpanayanīyo'bhidhīyate’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śalyaṃ dvividhamavabaddhamanavabaddhaṃ ca ||3||

tatra samāsenānavabaddhaśalyoddharaṇārthaṃ pañcadaśa tāḍapatrapustake ‘nava hetūn vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti paṭhyate, tatra bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanāni na paṭhyante| eṣāṃ vyākhyānagranthe (5 sūtre)'pi bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanānāṃ vyākhyānaṃ na paṭhyate tāḍapatrapustake| ‘bhedanadāraṇapīḍanavamanavirecanaprakṣālanāni pratikṣipyāvaśiṣṭāni ye paṭhanti teṣāṃ bhedanadāraṇe pācanottarakarmatayā pācane, pīḍanaṃ pramārjane, vamanaṃ pratimarśe, virecanaṃ pravāhaṇaṃ prakṣālanaṃ ca pariṣeke (pramārjane)'ntarmāvanīyam’ iti cakraḥ hetūn vakṣyāmaḥ | tadyathā- svabhāvaḥ, pācanaṃ, bhedanaṃ, dāraṇaṃ, pīḍanaṃ, pramārjanaṃ, nirdhmāpanaṃ, vamanaṃ, virecanaṃ, prakṣālanaṃ, pratimarśaḥ, pravāhaṇam, ācūṣaṇam, ayaskānto, harṣaśceti ||4||

tatrāśrukṣavathūdgārakāsamūtrapurīṣānilaiḥ svabhāvabalapravṛttairnayanādibhyaḥ patati | māṃsāvagāḍhaṃ śalyamavidahyamānaṃ pācayitvā prakothāttasya pūyaśoṇitavegādgauravādvā patati | pakvamabhidyamānaṃ bhedayeddārayedvā | bhinnamanirasyamānaṃ pīḍanīyaiḥ pīḍayet pāṇibhirvā | aṇūnyakṣaśalyāni ‘akṣiśalyāni akṣigataśalyāni| pravāhaṇam adhaḥpreraṇam’ iti cakraḥ pariṣecanādhmāpanairbālavastrapāṇibhiḥ ‘pariṣecanopadhamanaiḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ pramārjayet | āhāraśeṣaśleṣmahīnāṇuśalyāni ‘āhāraśeṣaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ śleṣasiṅghāṇakaṃ niśvāsotkāsanābhyāṃ nirdhamet, etannirdhamanaṃ nāma| annaśalyāni vamanāṅgulisparśanaprabhṛtibhiḥ prabhṛjyoddharet, eṣa pratimarśo nāma’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ śvasanotkāsanapradhamanairnirdhamet | annaśalyāni vamanāṅgulipratimarśaprabhṛtibhiḥ | virecanaiḥ pakvāśayagatāni | vraṇadoṣāśayagatāni prakṣālanaiḥ | vātamūtrapurīṣagarbhasaṅgeṣu pravāhaṇamuktam ‘virecanairvā pravāhaṇenoddharet, etatpravāhaṇaṃ nāma’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| mārutodakasaviṣarudhiraduṣṭastanyeṣvācūṣaṇamāsyena viṣāṇairvā | anulomamanavabaddhamakarṇamanalpavraṇamukhamayaskāntena | hṛdyavasthitamanekakāraṇotpannaṃ śokaśalyaṃ harṣeṇeti ||5||

sarvaśalyānāṃ tu mahatāmaṇūnāṃ vā dvāvevāharaṇahetū bhavataḥ- pratilomo'nulomaśca ‘yathā śalyaṃ praviṣṭaṃ tenāhriyamāṇaṃ pratilomaṃ, parāmukhenāhriyamāṇamanulomam| pratilomaviṣayo'rvācīnaṃ nātidūrapraviṣṭaṃ, tatpraveśamārgeṇaivāharaṇīyam, evaṃ ca pratilomāharaṇaṃ bhavati| parācīnaṃ tu parānirgatamukhaṃ tanmukhenaivāhartavyaṃ, tathā cānulomaṃ bhavati, tasya punaḥ praveśamārgeṇānayanena sthūlaśalyāgreṇa punarbahudeśaghaṭṭanaṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ| anirgatamukhamapi yathā'nulomaṃ parācīnamāhriyate tadāha- uttuṇḍitamityādi| chedanīyamukhaṃ chedanārhadeśamukham| etacca chedayitvā''haraṇaṃ karṇavataḥ śalyasya jñeyam| taddhi praveśamārgeṇāhriyamāṇaṃ bahuśarīrapradeśaṃ karṇāvaṣṭabdhaṃ hinasti, tena parāgbhāgameva stokaṃ chedayitvā nirhriyate, tena karṇavataḥ śalyasyālpopaghātena nirgamo bhavati| yāni tvakarṇavanti parānirgatamukhāni tāni chedanīyamukhānyapi praveśamārgeṇaiva pratilomaṃ hartavyāni’ iti cakraḥ||6||

tatra pratilomamarvācīnamānayet ‘nahyarvācīnaṃ nāmottuṇḍitaṃ kvacidapi pratilomamāhartuṃ yujyate, nāpi cātidīrghaṃ tadanulomaṃ chedānubandhena saṅgharṣaprakarṣeṇa cāśaṅkitatvāt, tadidamucyate uttuṇḍitamiti| uttuṇḍitamudgatakaṇṭakācitamukhaṃ, chidyate'neneti kṛtyalyuṭorbāhulyācchedanīyaṃ dhārā mukhe yasyeti chedanīyamukhaṃ, tātparyādarvācīnaṃ śalyaṃ chittvā nirghātayedānulomyenāharaṇārthaṃ parācīnaṃ kartumiti śeṣaḥ| atra chittveti śalyadairghyapariṇāhasaṅgharṣakṛtopatāpaśaṅkājihāsārthamidaṃ chedanaṃ tāvatyaṃśe kartavyaṃ yāvatyaṃśe chinne sukhaṃ śalyaṃ parācīnaṃ bhavitumarhatīti sudhiyo manyante| na ca vidhirayaṃ sarvatra sāmprataṃ bhavatītyata āha- chedanīyetyādi| apiśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ| hastaśakyamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ| kukṣyādyantarapatitāni kukṣyādimadhyapatitāni kukṣyādiṣvarvācīnānīti yāvat, cakārāduttuṇḍitāni śalyāni chedanīyamukhāni dhārāmukhānyapi, yathāmārgaṃ pratilomaṃ hastenaivāpahartuṃ yateteti samanvayaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘apanayet’ iti pā., anulomaṃ parācīnam ||7||
uttuṇḍitaṃ ‘uttuṇḍitaṃ śalyaṃ budbudavadabhimukhībhūtam’ iti aruṇadattaḥ chittvā nirghātayecchedanīyamukham ||8||
chedanīyamukhānyapi kukṣivakṣaḥkakṣāvaṅkṣaṇaparśukāntarapatitāni ca hastaśakyaṃ yathāmārgeṇa hastenaivāpahartuṃ prayateta ||9||

hastenaivāpahartumaśakyaṃ ‘śalyāpaharaṇaṃ hastenaiva yathāyogyatayā prāyaḥ kartavyaṃ, tenāśakye yantreṇetyāha- hastenetyādi| viśasyeti yantrapraveśanirodhakaṃ pradeśaṃ śastreṇa chittvā’ iti cakraḥ viśasya ‘vimṛṣya śastreṇa vā’ iti pā. śastreṇa yantreṇāpaharet ‘athāharet karaprāpyaṃ kareṇaivetarat punaḥ| dṛśyaṃ siṃhāhimakaravarmikarkaṭakānanaiḥ|| adṛśyaṃ vraṇasaṃsthānādgrahītuṃ śakyate yataḥ| kaṅkabhṛṅgāhvakuraraśarārivāyasānanaiḥ|| adṛśyaṃ vraṇasaṃsthānādgrahītuṃ śakyate yataḥ| kaṅkabhṛṅgāhvakuraraśarārivāyasānanaiḥ|| sandaṃśābhyāṃ tvagādisthaṃ tālābhyāṃ suśiraṃ haret| suśirasthaṃ tu nalakaiḥ śeṣaṃ śeṣairyathāyatham’ (vā. sū. a. 28)||10||
bhavati cātra- śītalena jalenainaṃ mūrcchantamavasecayet | saṃrakṣedasya ‘marmasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ pānīyaghṛtābhyaṅgatarpaṇādinā’ iti cakraḥ marmāṇi muhurāśvāsayecca tam ||11||

tataḥ śalyamuddhṛtya nirlohitaṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā svedārhamagnighṛtaprabhṛtibhiḥ ‘svedārhaṃ saṃsvedya, agninā avadahya, ghṛtena tarpayitveti yojyam| atrātisrutaraktā ghṛtatarpaṇīyāḥ| tatra bhojaḥ- “agnikṛtyā vraṇā ye tu teṣvagnimavacārayet| svedayetsaktupiṇḍībhiḥ svedakṛtyān samantataḥ|| tarpayettarpaṇīyāṃśca sukhoṣṇena ca sarpiṣā’ iti saṃsvedyāvadahya pradihya sarpirmadhubhyāṃ baddhvā''cārikamupadiśet | (sirāsnāyuvilagnaṃ śalākādibhirvimocyāpanayet; śvayathugrastavāraṅgaṃ samavapīḍya śvayathuṃ; durbalavāraṅgaṃ kuśādibhirbaddhvā|) ||12||

hṛdayamabhito ‘hṛdayabhita iti hṛdayasamīpe pārśve ityarthaḥ| hṛdayodvejanaṃ ca śalyakāryapīḍāparijñānārthamityeke| hṛdayodvejanena līnasya yantrasya sambandho na bhavatītyarthaḥ| yathāmārgeṇa durupaharaṃ chedena mukhaṃ viśālaṃ kṛtvā haraṇīyam| tatra tathā chedanaṃ kartavyaṃ yathā sirādikṣaṇanenānyadeśāpabādho na bhavati’ iti cakraḥ vartamānaṃ śalyaṃ śītajalādibhirudvejitasyāpaharedyathāmārgaṃ; durupaharamanyato'pabādhyamānaṃ pāṭayitvoddharet ||13||

asthivivarapraviṣṭamasthividaṣṭaṃ vā'vagṛhya pādābhyāṃ yantreṇāpaharet, aśakyamevaṃ vā balavadbhiḥ suparigṛhītasya yantreṇa grāhayitvā śalyavāraṅgaṃ ‘vāraṅgaṃ śastrādimayasya śalyasya śikhākāraṃ’ ityaruṇadattaḥ| ‘vāraṅgaṃ śastramastake śikhākāro'vayavaḥ’ iti hemādriḥ pravibhujya dhanurguṇairbaddhvaikataścāsya pañcāṅgyāmupasaṃyatasyāśvasyavaktrakavike ‘pañcāṅgyā pañcānāmaṅgānāṃ caturṇāṃ pādānāṃ mukhasahitānāṃ samāhāraḥ pañcāṅgī bandhaviśeṣaḥ, tayā pañcāṅgyā baddhasya’ iti aruṇadattaḥ badhnīyāt, athainaṃ kaśayā tāḍayedyathonnāmayañ śiro vegena śalyamuddharati; dṛḍhāṃ vā vṛkṣaśākhāmavanamya tasyāṃ pūrvavadbaddhvoddharet ||14||

adeśottuṇḍitamaṣṭhīlāśmamudgarāṇāmanyatamasya ‘adeśottuṇḍitamiti pakṣe acchedanīyadeśottuṇḍitamityarthaḥ| asthideśottuṇḍitamityanye| tatrāsthirotho'sthyuttuṇḍitatvam’ iti cakraḥ prahāreṇa vicālya yathāmārgameva yantreṇa ||15||

vimṛditakarṇāni ‘vimṛditakarṇāni karṇavantītyacchedanīyamukhapatitāni| chedanīyamukhe tu deśe karṇavatāmanulomameva chedayitvā''haraṇamāha- anābādhākaretyādi’ iti cakraḥ karṇavantyanābādhakaradeśottuṇḍitāni purastādeva ||16||
jātuṣe kaṇṭhāsakte kaṇṭhe nāḍīṃ praveśyāgnitaptāṃ ca śalākāṃ, tayā'vagṛhya śītābhiradbhiḥ pariṣicya sthirībhūtaṃ śalyamuddharet ||17||
ajātuṣaṃ tu jatumadhūcchiṣṭapraliptayā śalākayā pūrvakalpenetyeke ||18||

asthiśalyamanyadvā tiryakkaṇṭhāsaktamavekṣya keśoṇḍukaṃ ‘keśānāṃ samūhaḥ keśondukam’ iti aruṇadattaḥ| ‘keśondukaḥ keśapuñjaḥ’ iti hemādriḥ| ‘uṇḍukaṃ nāma viśeṣeṇa prasādakiṭṭataḥ pariṇāmimalāśrayaḥ sthūlakṣudrāntrayorantarālastho golaḥ, vakṣyati ca- ‘uṇḍukasthaṃ vibhajate malaṃ maladharā kalā’ iti, tathā ca keśo'yamuṇḍukamiveti keśoṇḍukaṃ ‘paruṣavyāghraḥ’ iti vat| ‘upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyaprayoge’ iti pūrvanipātaḥ ‘keśaguḍaka’ iti niṣkarṣaḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ dṛḍhaikadīrghasūtrabaddhaṃ dravabhaktopahitaṃ pāyayedākaṇṭhāt pūrṇakoṣṭhaṃ ca vāmayet, vamataśca śalyaikadeśasaktaṃ jñātvā sūtraṃ sahasā tvākṣipet; mṛdunā vā dantadhāvanakūrcakenāpaharet praṇudedvā'ntaḥ | kṣatakaṇṭhāya ca madhusarpiṣī leḍhuṃ prayacchettriphalācūrṇaṃ vā madhuśarkarāmiśram ||19||
udakapūrṇodaramavākśirasamavapīḍayeddhunīyādvāmayedvā bhasmarāśau vā nikhanedāmukhāt ||20||
grāsaśalye tu kaṇṭhāsakte niḥśaṅkamanavabuddhaṃ skandhe muṣṭinā'bhihanyāt, snehaṃ madyaṃ pānīyaṃ ‘snehaṃ sukhodakaṃ vā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vā pāyayet ||21||

bāhurajjulatāpāśaiḥ ‘pāśaśalye tu’ iti pā. kaṇṭhapīḍanādvāyuḥ prakupitaḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ kopayitvā sroto niruṇaddhi, lālāsrāvaṃ phenāgamanaṃ sañjñānāśaṃ cāpādayati; tamabhyajya saṃsvedya śirovirecanaṃ tasmai tīkṣṇaṃ vidadhyādrasaṃ ca vātaghnaṃ dadyāditi ||22||
bhavanti cātra- śalyākṛtiviśeṣāṃśca sthānānyāvekṣya buddhimān | tathā yantrapṛthaktvaṃ ca samyak śalyamathāharet ||23||
karṇavanti tu śalyāni duḥkhāhāryāṇi ‘duḥkhānyāharaṇe viduḥ’ iti pā. yāni ca | ādadīta bhiṣak tasmāttāni yuktyā samāhitaḥ ||24||
etairupāyaiḥ śalyaṃ tu naiva niryātyate ‘nirhāryate’ iti pā. yadi | matyā nipuṇayā vaidyo yantrayogaiśca nirharet ||25||
śothapākau rujaścogrāḥ kuryācchalyamanāhṛtam | vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi tasmādyatnādvinirharet ||26||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śalyāpanayanīyo nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||27||

div.head: viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāyaiḥ samāsavistarābhyāṃ vraṇānuddiśyāturopakramaṇīyādhyāye cikitsā sūtrayitavyā| sā tu sāriṣṭatvādgatāyuṣi na sidhyati, ato'riṣṭajñānārthaṃ riṣṭapratipādakādhyāyeṣu sāmānyāriṣṭasvarūpābhidhāyakatayā viparītavraṇavijñānīyo'bhidhīyate| viparīto vraṇaḥ sādhyādanyaḥ sāriṣṭatayā vivakṣitaḥ’ iti cakraḥ| ‘viparītavraṇavijñānīyaṃ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
phalāgnijalavṛṣṭīnāṃ puṣpadhūmāmbudā ‘dhūma iha kāṣṭhamanthanajanyaḥ vahneśca pūrvabhāvī vivakṣito bhāvivahnigamakatayā’ iti cakraḥ yathā | khyāpayanti bhaviṣyattvaṃ tathā riṣṭāni pañcatām ||3||

div.ab: tāni ‘ariṣṭasya maraṇādavaśyaṃ prāgbhāvamāha- tāni saukṣmyādityādi| saukṣmyāt kaṇṭakādi sadapi sūkṣmajijñāsāṃ vinā nopalabhyate| tathā pramādādanavahitaiḥ sadapi nopalabhyate| āśu vyatikramāditi bhūtvā kṣaṇena nāśāt, etadapi sarvathā'vadhānaṃ vinā nopalabhyate| yathā vidyudādi kṣaṇamātrasthāyibhūtamapi nopalabhyate| na tvasambhavādityanena maraṇe'vaśyambhāvitvamuktaṃ, carake'pyuktaṃ ‘maraṇaṃ cāpi tannāsti yannāriṣṭapuraḥsaram’ (ca. i. a. 2)| tathā riṣṭe'pi maraṇaniyamamāha- dhruvamityādi saukṣmyāt pramādādvā tathaivāśu vyatikramāt | gṛhyante nodgatānyajñairmumūrṣorna tvasambhavāt ||4|| dhruvaṃ tu maraṇaṃ riṣṭe... |5|

ab.seg: ... brāhmaṇaistat kilāmalaiḥ | rasāyanatapojapyatatparairvā nivāryate ||5||

nakṣatrapīḍā ‘nakṣatrapīḍeti janmakālasthitagrahaviśeṣairnakṣatrapīḍā yathā kālāntarabhāvimaraṇasūcikā kālāntareṇaiva pacyamānaduṣṭamaraṇaṃ gamayati| tathā'riṣṭānyapi kānicit cirakālapacyamānamārakakarmajanyāni cirabhāvimaraṇavyañjakānīti vākyārthaḥ| ariṣṭapākamiti riṣṭakāraṇamārakakarmaprapākam|’ iti cakraḥ bahudhā yathā kālaṃ ‘kālāt’ iti pā. vipacyate | tathaivāriṣṭapākaṃ ca bruvate bahavo ‘bahudhā’ iti pā. janāḥ ||6||
asiddhimāpnuyālloke pratikurvan gatāyuṣaḥ | ato'riṣṭāni yatnena lakṣayet kuśalo bhiṣak ||7||

gandhavarṇarasādīnāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ svabhāvataḥ ‘svabhāvato vaikṛtamityanena asvābhāvikasya vikṛtasyāpi nātiṣṭatvamiti darśayati| etacca vaikṛtamadṛśyamānahetukaṃ mārakakarmakṛtameva riṣṭaṃ jñeyam| pakvaḥ pātonmukho maraṇonmukha iti yāvat’ iti cakraḥ| ‘samāsataḥ’ iti pā.| vaikṛtaṃ yat tadācaṣṭe vraṇinaḥ pakvalakṣaṇam ||8||

div.ab: kaṭustīkṣṇaśca visraśca gandhastu pavanādibhiḥ | lohagandhistu raktena vyāmiśraḥ sānnipātikaḥ ||9|| lājātasītailasamāḥ kiñcidvisrāśca gandhataḥ | jñeyāḥ prakṛtigandhāḥ syuḥ ... |10|

ab.seg: ... rato'nyadgandhavaikṛtam ||10||
madyāgurvājyasumanāpadmacandanacampakaiḥ | sagandhā divyagandhāśca mumūrṣūṇāṃ vraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||11||
śvavājimūṣikadhvāṅkṣapūtivallūramatkuṇaiḥ | sagandhāḥ paṅkagandhāśca bhūmigandhāśca garhitāḥ ||12||
kuṅkumadhyāmakaṅkuṣṭhasavarṇāḥ pittakopataḥ | na dahyante na cūṣyante bhiṣak tān parivarjayet ||13||
kaṇḍūmantaḥ sthirāḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāḥ kaphanimittataḥ | dūyante vā'pi dahyante bhiṣak tān parivarjayet ||14||
kṛṣṇāstu ‘kṛṣṇā ye tvaruṇasrāvā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ ye tanusrāvā vātajā marmatāpinaḥ | svalpāmapi na kurvanti rujaṃ tān parivarjayet ||15||

div.ab: kṣveḍanti ghurghurāyante jvalantīva ca ye vraṇāḥ | tvaṅmāṃsasthāśca pavanaṃ saśabdaṃ visṛjanti ye ||16|| ye ca marmasvasambhūtā bhavantyatyarthavedanāḥ |17|
dahyante cāntaratyarthaṃ bahiḥ śītāśca ye vraṇāḥ ||17|| dahyante bahiratyarthaṃ bhavantyantaśca śītalāḥ |18|

ab.seg: śaktidhvajarathāḥ kuntavājivāraṇagovṛṣāḥ ‘vāraṇapakṣiṇaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ||18||
yeṣu cāpyavabhāseran prāsādākṛtayastathā | cūrṇāvakīrṇā iva ye bhānticānavacūrṇitāḥ ||19||
prāṇamāṃsakṣayaśvāsakāsārocakapīḍitāḥ | pravṛddhapūyarudhirā vraṇā yeṣāṃ ca marmasu ||20||

kriyābhiḥ ‘bheṣajavikārayuktau riṣṭamāha- kriyābhirityādi| carake upadravāśca bheṣajavikārayuktiśca riṣṭādhikaraṇatayoktā’ iti cakraḥ samyagārabdhā na siddhyanti ca ye vraṇāḥ | varjayettānapi prājñaḥ saṃrakṣannātmano yaśaḥ ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viparītāviparītavraṇavijñānīyo nāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||28||

div.head: viparītāviparītadūtaśakunasvapnanidarśanīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto viparītāviparītasvapnanidarśanīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘viparītasvapnanidarśanīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| ‘viparītāviparītadūtaśakunasvapnanidarśanīyamadhyāyaṃ’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
dūtadarśanasambhāṣā veṣāśceṣṭitameva ca | ṛkṣaṃ velā tithiścaiva nimittaṃ śakuno'nilaḥ ||3||
deśo ‘gehe’ iti pā. vaidyasya vāgdehamanasāṃ ca viceṣṭitam | kathayantyāturagataṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham ||4||

div.ab: pākha(ṣa)ṇḍāśramavarṇānāṃ ‘pāṣaṇḍā vedabāhyāśramāḥ saugatādayaḥ’ iti cakraḥ sapakṣāḥ karmasiddhaye | ta eva viparītāḥ syurdūtāḥ karmavipattaye ||5|| napuṃsakaṃ strī bahavo naikakāryā asūyakāḥ | gardabhoṣṭrarathaprāptāḥ prāptā vā syuḥ paramparāḥ ||6|| vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ |7|

ab.seg: pāśadaṇḍāyudhadharāḥ pāṇḍuretaravāsasaḥ ||7||
ārdrajīrṇāpasavyaikamalinoddhvastavāsasaḥ ‘... malinadhvastavāsasaḥ’ iti pā.| nyūnādhikāṅgā udvignā vikṛtā raudrarūpiṇaḥ ||8||

div.ab: rūkṣaniṣṭhuravaktārastvamaṅgalyābhidhāyinaḥ ‘... vādāścāpyamāṅgalyā ...’ iti pā.|9|

chindantastṛṇakāṣṭhāni spṛśanto ‘rudantaḥ stanayostathā’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ nāsikāṃ stanam ||9|| vastrāntānāmikākeśanakharomadaśāspṛśaḥ | srotovarodhahṛdgaṇḍamūrdhoraḥkukṣipāṇayaḥ ||10|| kapālopalabhasmāsthituṣāṅgārakarāśca ye | vilikhanto mahīṃ kiñcinmuñcanto loṣṭabhedinaḥ ||11|| tailakardamadigdhāṅgā raktasraganulepanāḥ | phalaṃ pakvamasāraṃ vā gṛhītvā'nyacca tadvidham ||12|| nakhairnakhāntaraṃ vā'pi kareṇa caraṇaṃ tathā | upānaccarmahastā vā vikṛtavyādhipīḍitāḥ ||13|| vāmācārā rudantaśca śvāsino vikṛtekṣaṇāḥ | yāmyāṃ diśi prāñjalayo viṣamaikapade sthitāḥ ||14|| vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ |15|

dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ deśe tvaśucau vā hutāśanam | jvalayantaṃ pacantaṃ vā krūrakarmaṇi codyatam ||15|| nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ vā vegotsargeṣu vā'śucim | prakīrṇakeśamabhyaktaṃ svinnaṃ viklavameva vā ||16|| vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ |17|
vaidyasya paitrye daive vā kārye cotpātadarśane ||17|| madhyāhne cārdharātre vā sandhyayoḥ ... |18|

ab.seg: ... kṛttikāsu ca | ārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlapūrvāsu bharaṇīṣu ca ||18||
caturthyāṃ ‘navamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā pakṣasandhidineṣu ca’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ vā navamyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sandhidineṣu ca | vaidyaṃ ya upasarpanti dūtāste cāpi garhitāḥ ||19||

div.ab: svinnābhitaptā madhyāhne jvalanasya samīpataḥ | garhitāḥ pittarogeṣu dūtā vaidyamupāgatāḥ ||20|| ta eva kapharogeṣu karmasiddhikarāḥ smṛtāḥ | etena ‘etena śeṣaṃ vyākhyātamiti vyādhisamānaguṇe deśādau dūtadarśanaṃ vigarhitaṃ, viparītaguṇe ca praśastaṃ| tena vātaroge pravātādi ninditaṃ, nivātādi praśastamityādyūhyamityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ śeṣaṃ vyākhyātaṃ buddhvā saṃvibhajettu tat ||21|| raktapittātisāreṣu prameheṣu tathaiva ca | praśasto jalarodheṣu dūtavaidyasamāgamaḥ ||22|| vijñāyaivaṃ vibhāgaṃ tu śeṣaṃ budhyeta paṇḍitaḥ |23|

ab.seg: śuklavāsāḥ śucirgauraḥ śyāmo vā priyadarśanaḥ ||23||

svasyāṃ jātau svagotro vā dūtaḥ kāryakaraḥ smṛtaḥ | goyānenāgatastuṣṭaḥ ‘goyānaṃ govāhyaśakaṭaḥ, etacca praśastataratvāduktaṃ, tenāniṣiddhamaśvādiyānamapyaviruddhameva’ iti cakraḥ pādābhyāṃ śubhaceṣṭitaḥ ||24||
smṛtimān ‘dhṛtimān’ iti pā. vidhikālajñaḥ svatantraḥ pratipattimān | alaṅkṛto maṅgalavān dūtaḥ kāryakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||25||
svasthaṃ prāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ same deśe śucau śucim | upasarpati yo vaidyaṃ sa ca kāryakaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||26||

div.ab: māṃsodakumbhātapatravipravāraṇagovṛṣāḥ | śuklavarṇāśca pūjyante prasthāne darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||27|| strī putriṇī savatsā gaurvardhamānamalaṅkṛtā ‘vardhamānā svalaṅkṛtā’ iti pā.| ‘vardhamānā iti śarāvāḥ, te ca svalaṅkṛtā iti ālepādinā maṇḍitāḥ| kecidalaṅkṛtā iti kanyāviśeṣaṇaṃ manyante| anye tvaṅkāropitaṃ kumāraṃ kumārīṃ vā vardhamānamāhuḥ’ iti cakraḥ| kanyā matsyāḥ phalaṃ cāmaṃ svastikaṃ modakā dadhi ||28|| hiraṇyākṣatapātraṃ vā ratnāni sumano ‘sumanā’ iti pā. nṛpaḥ | apraśānto'nalo vājī haṃsaścāpaḥ śikhī tathā ||29|| brahmadundubhijīmūtaśaṅkhaveṇurathasvanāḥ | siṃhagovṛṣanādāśca hre(he)ṣitaṃ gajabṛṃhitam ||30|| śastaṃ haṃsarutaṃ nṝṇāṃ kauśikaṃ caiva vāmataḥ | prasthāne yāyinaḥ śreṣṭhā vācaśca hṛdayaṅgamāḥ |32|

ab.seg: patrapuṣpaphalopetān sakṣīrānnīrujo drumān | āśritā vā nabhoveśmadhvajatoraṇavedikāḥ ||32||
dikṣu śāntāsu vaktāro madhuraṃ pṛṣṭhato'nugāḥ | vāmā vā dakṣiṇā vā'pi śakunāḥ karmasiddhaye ||33||
śuṣke'śanihate'patre vallīnaddhe sakaṇṭake | vṛkṣe'thavā'śmabhasmāsthiviṭtuṣāṅgārapāṃśuṣu ||34||
caityavalmīkaviṣamasthitā dīptakharasvarāḥ | purato dikṣu dīptāsu vaktāro nārthasādhakāḥ ||35||
punnāmānaḥ khagā vāmāḥ strīsañjñā dakṣiṇāḥ śubhāḥ | dakṣiṇādvāmagamanaṃ praśastaṃ śvaśṛgālayoḥ | vāmaṃ nakulacāṣāṇāṃ nobhayaṃ śaśasarpayoḥ ||36||
bhāsakauśikayoścaiva na praśastaṃ kilobhayam | darśanaṃ vā rutaṃ vā'pi na godhākṛkalāsayoḥ ||37||
dūtairaniṣṭaistulyānāmaśastaṃ darśanaṃ nṛṇām | kulatthatilakārpāsatuṣapāṣāṇabhasmanām ||38||
pātraṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā'ṅgāratailakardamapūritam | prasannetaramadyānāṃ pūrṇaṃ vā raktasarṣapaiḥ ||39||
śavakāṣṭhapalāśānāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ pathi saṅgamāḥ | neṣyante patitāntasthadīnāndharipavastathā ||40||
mṛduḥ śīto'nukūlaśca sugandhiścānilaḥ śubhaḥ | kharoṣṇo'niṣṭagandhaśca pratilomaśca garhitaḥ ||41||
granthyarbudādiṣu sadā chedaśabdastu pūjitaḥ | vidradhyudaragulmeṣu bhedaśabdastathaiva ca ||42||
raktapittātisāreṣu ruddhaśabdaḥ praśasyate | evaṃ vyādhiviśeṣeṇa nimittamupadhārayet ||43||
tathaivākruṣṭahākaṣṭamākrandaruditasvanāḥ | chardyāṃ vātapurīṣāṇāṃ śabdo vai gardabhoṣṭrayoḥ ||44||
pratiṣiddhaṃ tathā bhagnaṃ ‘lagnaṃ’ iti pā. kṣutaṃ skhalitamāhatam | daurmanasyaṃ ca vaidyasya yātrāyāṃ na praśasyate ||45||
praveśe'pyetaduddeśādavekṣyaṃ ca tathā''ture | pratidvāraṃ gṛhe cāsya punaretanna gaṇyate ||46||
keśabhasmāsthikāṣṭhāśmatuṣakārpāsakaṇṭakāḥ | khaṭvordhvapādā madyāpo vasā tailaṃ tilāstṛṇam ||47||
napuṃsakavyaṅgabhagnanagnamuṇḍāsitāmbarāḥ | prasthāne vā praveśe vā neṣyante darśanaṃ gatāḥ ||48||

div.ab: bhāṇḍānāṃ saṅkarasthānāṃ sthānāt sañcāraṇaṃ tathā | nikhātotpāṭanaṃ bhaṅgaḥ patanaṃ nirgamastathā ||49|| vaidyāsanāvasādo vā rogī vā syādadhomukhaḥ | vaidyaṃ sambhāṣamāṇo'ṅgaṃ kuḍyamāstaraṇāni vā ||50|| pramṛjyādvā ‘pramṛdyādvā’ iti pā. dhunīyādvā karau pṛṣṭhaṃ śirastathā | hastaṃ cākṛṣya vaidyasya nyasecchirasi corasi ||51|| yo vaidyamunmukhaḥ paśyannunmārṣṭi svāṅgamāturaḥ | na sa sidhyati vaidyo vā gṛhe yasya na pūjyate ||52|| bhavane pūjyate vā'pi yasya vaidyaḥ sa sidhyati |53|
śubhaṃ śubheṣu dūtādiṣvaśubhaṃ hyaśubheṣu ca ||53|| āturasya dhruvaṃ tasmāddūtādīn lakṣayedbhiṣak |54|

ab.seg: svapnānataḥ pravakṣyāmi maraṇāya śubhāya ca ||54||
suhṛdo yāṃśca paśyanti vyādhito vā svayaṃ tathā | snehābhyaktaśarīrastu karabhavyālagardabhaiḥ ||55||
varāhairmahiṣairvā'pi yo yāyāddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | raktāmbaradharā kṛṣṇā hasantī muktamūrdhajā ||56||
yaṃ cākarṣati ‘vā''karṣati’ iti pā. baddhvā strī nṛtyantī dakṣiṇāmukham | antāvasāyibhiryo vā''kṛṣyate dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||57||
pariṣvajeran yaṃ vā'pi pretāḥ pravrajitā(na)stathā | muhurāghrāyate ‘mūrdhanyāghrāyate’ iti pā. yastu śvāpadairvikṛtānanaiḥ ||58||
pibenmadhu ca tailaṃ ca yo vā paṅke'vasīdati | paṅkapradigdhagātro vā pranṛtyet prahasettathā ||59||
nirambaraśca yo raktāṃ dhārayecchirasā srajam | yasya vaṃśo nalo vā'pi tālo vorasi jāyate ||60||
yaṃ vā matsyo grasedyo vā jananīṃ praviśennaraḥ | parvatāgrāt patedyo vā śvabhre vā tamasā''vṛte ||61||
hriyeta srotasā yo vā yo vā mauṇḍyamavāpnuyāt | parājīyeta badhyeta kākādyairvā'bhibhūyate ||62||
patanaṃ tārakādīnāṃ praṇāśaṃ dīpacakṣuṣoḥ | yaḥ paśyeddevatānāṃ vā prakampamavanestathā ||63||
yasya chardirvireko vā daśanāḥ prapatanti vā | śālmalīṃ kiṃśukaṃ yūpaṃ valmīkaṃ pāribhadrakam ||64||
puṣpāḍhyaṃ kovidāraṃ vā citāṃ ‘yo'dhirohati mānavaḥ’ iti pā. vā yo'dhirohati | kārpāsatailapiṇyākalohāni lavaṇaṃ tilān ||65||
labhetāśnīta vā pakvamannaṃ yaśca pibet surām | svasthaḥ sa labhate vyādhiṃ vyādhito mṛtyumṛcchati ||66||

yathāsvaṃ prakṛtisvapno vismṛto vihatastathā | cintākṛto divā dṛṣṭo bhavantyaphaladāstu ‘vihataśabdena tantrāntare viphalatvenaiva kathitā atidīrghasvapnādayo grāhyāḥ| uktaṃ hi carake- “divāsvapnamatihrasvamatidīrghaṃ tathaiva ca| dṛṣṭaḥ prathamayāme yaḥ svapnaḥ so'pyaphalo bhavet” (ca. i. a. 5) iti| cintākṛtaśabdena dṛṣṭaśrutānubhūtaprārthitakalpitānāṃ pañcānāmapi vikalpānāṃ grahaṇam| etadvyatiriktasya bhāviphalasambandhasyaiveha grahaṇam| sa ca svapno'riṣṭarūpo manovahasrotasāmatibalaistribhireva doṣaiḥ pūritatvāddṛśyate| yaduktaṃ carake- “manovahānāṃ duṣṭatvāddoṣairatibalaistribhiḥ| srotasāṃ dāruṇān svapnān kāle paśyati dāruṇe” (ca. i. a. 5)- iti| īdṛśaśca doṣaprakopaḥ pacyamānamārakādṛṣṭakṛta eva jñeyaḥ| evaṃ śubhakāle'pi svapnaḥ pacyamānaśubhakarmajanya eva jñeyaḥ| yathā bhūtanimittādipacyamānadaivakṛtameva śubhāśubhasūcakaṃ bhavati’ iti cakraḥ| carake hi saptavidhaṃ svapnadarśanamuktam- “dṛṣṭaṃ śrutānubhūtaṃ ca kalpitaṃ prārthitaṃ tathā| bhāvikaṃ doṣajaṃ caiva svapnaṃ saptavidhaṃ viduḥ’ (ca. i. a. 5) iti| tatra bhāvikamiti bhāviphalasūcakam| bhāvikaṃ doṣajaṃ ca svapnadarśanaṃ phalavat, anyattvaphalamiti jñeyam te ||67||

div.ab: jvaritānāṃ śunā sakhyaṃ kapisakhyaṃ tu śoṣiṇām | unmāde rākṣasaiḥ pretairapasmāre pravartanam ||68|| mehātisāriṇāṃ toyapānaṃ snehasya kuṣṭhinām | gulmeṣu sthāvarotpattiḥ koṣṭhe, mūrdhni śiroruji ||69|| śaṣkulībhakṣaṇaṃ chardyāmadhvā śvāsapipāsayoḥ | hāridraṃ bhojanaṃ vā'pi yasya syāt pāṇḍurogiṇaḥ ||70|| raktapittī pibedyastu śoṇitaṃ sa vinaśyati |71|

ab.seg: svapnānevaṃvidhān dṛṣṭvā prātarutthāya yatnavān ||71||
dadyānmāṣāṃstilāṃllohaṃ viprebhyaḥ kāñcanaṃ tathā | japeccāpi śubhān mantrān gāyatrīṃ tripadāṃ tathā ||72||
dṛṣṭvā tu prathame yāme svapyād dhyātvā punaḥ śubham | japedvā'nyatamaṃ vedaṃ ‘devaṃ’ iti pā. brahmacārī samāhitaḥ ||73||
na cācakṣīta kasmaiciddṛṣṭvā svapnamaśobhanam | devatāyatane caiva vasedrātritrayaṃ tathā | viprāṃśca pūjayennityaṃ duḥsvapnāt pravimucyate ‘parimucyate’ iti pā.||74||
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi praśastaṃ svapnadarśanam | devān dvijāngovṛṣabhān jīvataḥ suhṛdo nṛpān ||75||
samiddhamagniṃ sādhūṃśca ‘viprāṃśca’ iti pā. nirmalāni jalāni ca | paśyet kalyāṇalābhāya vyādherapagamāya ca ||76||
māṃsaṃ matsyān srajaḥ śvetā vāsāṃsi ca phalāni ca | labheta dhanalābhāya vyādherapagamāya ca ||77||
mahāprāsādasaphalavṛkṣavāraṇaparvatān | āroheddravyalābhāya vyādherapagamāya ca ||78||
nadīnadasamudrāṃśca kṣubhitān kaluṣodakān | taret kalyāṇalābhāya vyādherapagamāya ca ||79||
urago vā jalauko vā bhramaro vā'pi yaṃ daśet | ārogyaṃ nirdiśettasya dhanalābhaṃ ca buddhimān ||80||
evaṃ rūpāñ śubhān svapnān yaḥ paśyedvyādhito naraḥ | sa dīrghāyuriti jñeyastasmai karma samācaret ||81||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne viparītāviparītasvapnanidarśanīyo nāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||29||

div.head: pañcendriyārthavipratipattyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pañcendriyārthavipratipattimadhyāyaṃ ‘dvividhaṃ riṣṭaṃ- bāhyaṃ bhūtādigatamāntaraṃ śarīragataṃ ca| tatra vaidyena prathamamupasthitaṃ bhūtādigatameva parīkṣyata iti pūrvādhyāyenoktaṃ, tadanu cāturagṛhagatenāturagataṃ parīkṣaṇīyamiti āturagatariṣṭajñānārthaṃ pañcendriyārthavipratipattiradhyāyo'bhidhīyate| pañcendriyārthāḥ śabdādayaḥ, teṣu viruddhā pratipattiḥ tathā teṣāmevā'nyathābhāvo vipratipattiḥ|’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

śarīraśīlayoryasya ‘tatra prathamataḥ śārīramānasasakalāriṣṭalakṣaṇameva tāvadāha- śarīraśīlayorityādi| śarīraṃ prāṇikāyaḥ, śīlaṃ manovṛttiḥ, śīlena ca mano lakṣyate| tena śarīramanasorityarthaḥ| anayoḥ prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ| sā ca jātyādīnupādhīnapekṣate| vikṛtiranyathābhāvaḥ’ iti cakraḥ prakṛtervikṛtirbhavet | tattvariṣṭaṃ samāsena, vyāsatastu nibodha me ||3||
śṛṇoti vividhāñ śabdān yo divyānāmabhāvataḥ | samudrapurameghānāmasampattau ca niḥsvanān ||4||
tān svanānnāvagṛhṇāti manyate cānyaśabdavat | grāmyāraṇyasvanāṃścāpi viparītāñ śṛṇoti ca ||5||
dviṣacchabdeṣu ramate suhṛcchabdeṣu kupyati | na śṛṇoti ca yo'kasmāttaṃ bruvanti gatāyuṣam ||6||

yastūṣṇamiva gṛhṇāti śītamuṣṇaṃ ca śītavat | sañjātaśītapiḍako ‘sañjātaśītapiḍako yaśca dāhena pīḍyate iti atra śītapīḍakocitāṃ śītavedanāṃ na vetti, dāhaṃ cānucitaṃ vettītīndriyavipratipattī riṣṭaṃ, tathā śītapiḍakocitaṃ śaityaṃ na bhavati dāhaścānucito bhavatīti sparśānyathābhāvo'pi riṣṭam| evamuṣṇagātra ityādāvapi yathāyogyatayā indriyasyārthasya vā vipratipattirvyākhyeyā’ iti cakraḥ yaśca dāhena pīḍyate ||7||
uṣṇagātro'timātraṃ ca yaḥ śītena pravepate | prahārānnābhijānāti yo'ṅgacchedamathāpi vā ||8||
pāṃśunevāvakīrṇāni yaśca gātrāṇi manyate | varṇānyatā ‘varṇānyabhāvo’ iti pā. vā rājyo vā yasya gātre bhavanti hi ||9||

div.ab: snātānuliptaṃ yaṃ cāpi bhajante nīlamakṣikāḥ ‘snātānuliptamityādau riṣṭe gandhasya rasasya cānyathābhāvo riṣṭam| nīlamakṣikā hi atyantamadhure durgandhe ca patanti’ iti cakraḥ|10|

ab.seg: sugandhirvā'ti ‘sugandhiṃ vātīti sugandhigandhamudvahati, ‘vā’ gatigandhanayoḥ, ityasya ‘vāti’ iti gandhanārthe rūpam’ iti cakraḥ yo'kasmāttaṃ bruvanti gatāyuṣam ||10||
viparītena gṛhṇāti rasān yaścopayojitān | upayuktāḥ kramādyasya rasā doṣābhivṛddhaye ||11||
yasya doṣāgnisāmyaṃ ca kuryurmithyopayojitāḥ | yo vā rasānna saṃvetti gatāsuṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||12||

div.ab: sugandhaṃ vetti durgandhaṃ durgandhasya sugandhitām | gṛhṇīte vā'nyathā gandhaṃ śānte dīpe ca nīrujaḥ ||13|| yo vā gandhaṃ na jānāti gatāsuṃ taṃ vinirdiśet |14|
