dvandvānyuṣṇahimādīni kālāvasthā diśastathā ||14|| viparītena gṛhṇāti bhāvānanyāṃśca yo naraḥ |15|

ab.seg: divā jyotīṃṣi yaścāpi jvalitānīva paśyati ||15||
rātrau sūryaṃ jvalantaṃ vā divā vā candravarcasam | ameghopaplave yaśca śakracāpataḍidguṇān ||16||
taḍittvato'sitān yo vā nirmale gagane ghanān | vimānayānaprāsādairyaśca saṅkulamambaram ||17||
yaścānilaṃ mūrtimantamantarikṣaṃ ca paśyati | dhūmanīhāravāsobhirāvṛtāmiva medinīm ||18||
pradīptamiva lokaṃ ca yo vā plutamivāmbhasā | bhūmimaṣṭāpadākārāṃ lekhābhiryaśca paśyati ||19||
na paśyati sanakṣatrāṃ yaśca devīmarundhatīm | dhruvamākāśagaṅgāṃ vā taṃ vadanti gatāyuṣam ||20||

jyotsnādarśoṣṇatoyeṣu ‘jyotsnādau uṣṇaśabdena ātapadīpayorgrahaṇam| yaduktaṃ carake- ‘jyotsnāyāmātape dīpe salilādarśayorapi’ (ca. i. a. 7) iti’ cakraḥ chāyāṃ yaśca na paśyati | paśyatyekāṅgahīnāṃ vā vikṛtāṃ vā'nyasattvajām ||21||
śvakākakaṅkagṛdhrāṇāṃ pretānāṃ yakṣarakṣasām | piśācoraganāgānāṃ bhūtānāṃ vikṛtāmapi ||22||

yo vā mayūrakaṇṭhābhaṃ vidhūmaṃ vahnimīkṣate | āturasya bhavenmṛtyuḥ svastho vyādhimavāpnuyāt ‘svasthaḥ sa labhate vyādhimityatra so'pi vyādhirmaraṇāya bhavatīti jñeyam, anyathā maraṇavyabhicaraṇena riṣṭatvānupapattiḥ syāt’ iti cakraḥ||23||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne pañcendriyārthavipratipattirnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||30||

athātaśchāyāvipratipattimadhyāyaṃ ‘pūrvādhyāye ‘chāyāṃ yaśca na paśyati’ (sū. a. 30) ityuktaṃ, tena chāyā smaryate, sā ca riṣṭāśrayā vaktavyā, ataśchāyāvipratipattirabhidhīyate| chāyāvipratipattyeha chāyāvaikṛtaṃ lakṣyate, tadadhikṛtya kṛto'dhyāyaśchāyāvipratipattiḥ| chāyā ceyaṃ svatantre śārīre tvacāṃ parisaṅkhyāne pañcavidhoktā| yathā- “prathamā'vabhāsinī nāma, yā sarvavarṇānavabhāsayati, pañcavidhāṃ ca chāyāṃ prakāśayati (śā. a. 4)” iti| tathā carake'pyuktaṃ- ‘khādīnāṃ pañca pañcānāṃ chāyā vividhalakṣaṇāḥ’ (ca. i. a. 7) ityādi| iyaṃ ca chāyā carakoktasaptavidhaprabhāyāśca bhinnā caraka evoktā- ‘syāttaijasī prabhā sarvā sā tu saptavidhā matā’ (ca. i. a. 7) ityādi| atrāpi ‘hrīśriyau naśyato yasya ojastejaḥ smṛtiḥ prabhā’ iti vacanācchāyāto bhinnaiva prabhā| carake chāyāprabhayorbhedakaṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ| yathā- “varṇamākrāmati cchāyā bhā tu varṇaprakāśinī| āsannā lakṣyate chāyā prabhā dūrāttu lakṣyate” (ca. i. a. 7) iti| tadevaṃ vyavasthite chāyāgataṃ riṣṭamāha- śyāvetyādi| etāśca prakṛticchāyopamardena bhavantya eva riṣṭam’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śyāvā lohitikā nīlā pītikā vā'pi mānavam | abhidravanti yaṃ chāyāḥ sa parāsurasaṃśayam ||3||
hrīrapakramate yasya prabhāsmṛtidhṛtiśriyaḥ | akasmādyaṃ bhajante vā sa gatāsurasaṃśayam ||4||
yasyādharauṣṭhaḥ patitaḥ kṣiptaścordhvaṃ tathottaraḥ | ubhau vā jāmbavābhāsau durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam ||5||

āraktā daśanā yasya śyāvā ‘śyāvadantatvamiha sāmānyena riṣṭaṃ, visūcyante yacchyāvadantatvaṃ tattu prāyobhāvitvāt punarvaktavyam’ iti cakraḥ vā syuḥ patanti vā | khañjanapratimā vā'pi taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet ||6||
kṛṣṇā stabdhā'valiptā vā jihvā śūnā ca yasya vai | karkaśā vā bhavedyasya so'cirādvijahātyasūn ||7||
kuṭilā sphuṭitā vā'pi śuṣkā vā yasya nāsikā | avasphūrjati magnā vā na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||8||
saṅkṣipte viṣame stabdhe rakte sraste ca locane | syātāṃ vā prasrute yasya sa gatāyurnaro dhruvam ||9||
keśāḥ sīmantino yasya saṅkṣipte vinate bhruvau | luṇḍanti ‘lulanti’ iti pā. cākṣipakṣmāṇi so'cirādyāti mṛtyave ||10||
nāharatyannamāsyasthaṃ na dhārayati yaḥ śiraḥ | ekāgradṛṣṭirmūḍhātmā sadyaḥ prāṇān jahāti saḥ ||11||
balavān durbalo vā'pi sammohaṃ yo'dhigacchati | utthāpyamāno bahuśastaṃ pakvaṃ ‘dhīraḥ parivarjayet’ iti pā. bhiṣagādiśet ||12||
uttānaḥ sarvadā śete pādau vikurute ca yaḥ | viprasāraṇaśīlo vā na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||13||
śītapādakarocchvāsaśchinnocchvāsaśca ‘chinnaśvāsaśca’ iti pā. yo bhavet | kākocchvāsaśca yo martyastaṃ dhīraḥ parivarjayet ||14||
nidrā na chidyate yasya yo vā jāgarti sarvadā | muhyedvā vaktukāmaśca pratyākhyeyaḥ sa jānatā ||15||
uttarauṣṭhaṃ ca yo lihyādutkārāṃśca ‘lihyādudgārāṃśca’ iti pā. karoti yaḥ | pretairvā bhāṣate sārdhaṃ pretarūpaṃ tamādiśet ||16||
khebhyaḥ saromakūpebhyo yasya raktaṃ pravartate | puruṣasyāviṣārtasya sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam ||17||
vātāṣṭhīlā tu hṛdaye yasyordhvamanuyāyinī | rujānnavidveṣakarī sa parāsurasaṃśayam ‘gatāyurna saṃśayaḥ’ iti pā.||18||
ananyopadravakṛtaḥ śophaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ | puruṣaṃ hanti, nārīṃ tu mukhajo guhyajo dvayam ||19||
atisāro jvaro hikkā chardiḥ śūnāṇḍameḍhratā | śvāsinaḥ kāsino vā'pi yasya taṃ kṣīṇamādiśet ||20||
svedo dāhaśca balavān hikkā śvāsaśca mānavam | balavantamapi prāṇairviyuñjanti na saṃśayaḥ ||21||
śyāvā jihvā bhavedyasya savyaṃ cākṣi nimajjati | mukhaṃ ca jāyate pūti yasya taṃ parivarjayet ||22||

vaktramāpūryate'śrūṇāṃ ‘'śrūṇāmiti karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī, ‘nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ’ itivat’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ‘netre cāsreṇa pūryete’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ svidyataścaraṇāvubhau | cakṣuścākulatāṃ yāti yamarāṣṭraṃ gamiṣyataḥ ||23||
atimātraṃ laghūni syurgātrāṇi gurukāṇi vā | yasyākasmāt sa vijñeyo gantā vaivasvatālayam ||24||
paṅkamatsyavasātailaghṛtagandhāṃśca ye narāḥ | mṛṣṭagandhāṃśca ye vānti gantāraste yamālayam ||25||
yūkā lalāṭamāyānti baliṃ nāśnanti vāyasāḥ | yeṣāṃ cāpi ratirnāsti yātāraste yamālayam ||26||
jvarātisāraśophāḥ syuryasyānyonyāvasādinaḥ | prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasya nāsau śakyaścikitsitam ||27||
kṣīṇasya yasya kṣuttṛṣṇe hṛdyairmiṣṭairhitaistathā | na śāmyato'nnapānaiśca tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||28||
pravāhikā śiraḥśūlaṃ koṣṭhaśūlaṃ ca dāruṇam | pipāsā balahāniśca tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||29||
viṣameṇopacāreṇa karmabhiśca purākṛtaiḥ | anityatvācca jantūnāṃ jīvitaṃ nidhanaṃ vrajet ||30||
pretā bhūtāḥ piśācāśca rakṣāṃsi vividhāni ca | maraṇābhimukhaṃ nityamupasarpanti mānavam ||31||
tāni bheṣajavīryāṇi pratighnanti jighāṃsayā | tasmānmoghāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhavantyeva gatāyuṣām ||32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne chāyāvipratipattirnāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||

athātaḥ ‘pūrvādhyāyānuktāṃ śarīravikṛtimavayavapravibhāgena darśayituṃ svabhāvavipratipattirabhidhīyate| tenādhikārānuvṛttirevādhyāyasambandhaḥ’ iti cakraḥ svabhāvavipratipattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

svabhāvasiddhānāṃ ‘svabhāvena prakṛtyā prasiddhānāmiti svabhāvaprasiddhānām’ iti cakraḥ śarīraikadeśānāmanyabhāvitvaṃ maraṇāya | tadyathā- śuklānāṃ kṛṣṇatvaṃ, kṛṣṇānāṃ śuklatā, raktānāmanyavarṇatvaṃ, sthirāṇāṃ mṛdutvaṃ ‘asthiratvaṃ’ iti pā., mṛdūnāṃ sthiratā, calānāmacalatvaṃ, acalānāṃ calatā, pṛthūnāṃ saṅkṣiptatvaṃ, saṅkṣiptānāṃ pṛthutā, dīrghāṇāṃ hrasvatvaṃ, hrasvānāṃ dīrghatā, apatanadharmiṇāṃ ‘apatanadharmaṇāṃ’ iti pā. patanadharmitvaṃ ‘patanadharmatvaṃ’ iti pā., patanadharmiṇāmapatanadharmitvamakasmāt, śaityauṣṇyasnaigdhyaraukṣyaprastambhavaivarṇyāvasādanaṃ cāṅgānām ||3||

svebhyaḥ sthānebhyaḥ śarīraikadeśānāmavastrastotkṣiptabhrāntāvakṣiptapatitavimuktanirgatāntargatagurulaghutvāni, pravālavarṇavyaṅgaprādurbhāvo vā'pyakasmāt, sirāṇāṃ ca darśanaṃ lalāṭe, nāsāvaṃśe vā piḍakotpattiḥ ‘nāsāvaṃśe ca piḍakā pravālavarṇaiva boddhavyā| yaduktaṃ hārīte- ‘bimbīvidrumavarṇābhā śakragopaprabhā'pi vā| nāsāvaṃśe bhavedyasya piḍakā na sa sidhyati’ iti cakraḥ, lalāṭe vā prabhātakāle svedaḥ, netrarogādvinā vā'śrupravṛttiḥ, gomayacūrṇaprakāśasya vā rajaso darśanamuttamāṅge nilayanaṃ vā kapotakaṅkakākaprabhṛtīnāṃ, mūtrapurīṣavṛddhirabhuñjānānāṃ, tatpraṇāśo vā bhuñjānānāṃ, stanamūlahṛdayoraḥsu ca śūlotpattayaḥ, madhye śūnatvamanteṣu parimlāyitvaṃ viparyayo vā, tathā'rdhāṅge śvayathuḥ śoṣo'ṅgapakṣayorvā, naṣṭahīnavikalavikṛtasvaratā vā, vivarṇapuṣpaprādurbhāvo vā dantamukhanakhaśarīreṣu, yasya vā'psu kaphapurīṣaretāṃsi nimajjanti, yasya vā dṛṣṭimaṇḍale ‘bhinnavikṛtāni rūpāṇi netrakumārikāyāṃ jñeyāni’ iti cakraḥ bhinnavikṛtāni rūpāṇyālokyante, snehābhyaktakeśāṅga iva yo bhāti, yaśca durbalo bhaktadveṣātisārābhyāṃ pīḍyate, kāsamānaśca tṛṣṇābhibhūtaḥ, kṣīṇaśchardibhaktadveṣayuktaḥ saphenapūyarudhirodvāmī hatasvaraḥ śūlābhipannaśca manuṣyaḥ, śūnakaracaraṇavadanaḥkṣīṇo'nnadveṣī srastapiṇḍikāṃsapāṇipādo jvarakāsābhibhūtaḥ, yastu pūrvāhṇe bhuktamaparāhṇe chardayatyavidagdhamatisāryate vā sa śvāsānmriyate, bastavadvilapan yaśca bhūmau patati srastamuṣkaḥ, stabdhameḍhro bhagnagrīvaḥ pranaṣṭamehanaśca manuṣyaḥ, prāgviśuṣyamāṇāhṛdaya ārdraśarīraḥ, yaśca loṣṭaṃ loṣṭenābhihanti kāṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhena, tṛṇāni vā chinatti, adharoṣṭhaṃ daśati, uttaroṣṭhaṃ vā leḍhi, āluñcati vā karṇau keśāṃśca; devadvijagurusuhṛdvaidyāṃśca dveṣṭi, yasya vakrānuvakragā ‘vakrānuvakragā ityādyariṣṭāni aśārīrāṇyapyatra prakaraṇe mahāphalatayā asandigdhatayā ca paṭhitāni’ iti cakraḥ grahā garhitasthānagatāḥ pīḍayanti, janmarkṣaṃ vā, yasyolkāśanibhyāmabhihanyate horā vā, gṛhadāraśayanāsanayānavāhanamaṇiratnopakaraṇagarhitalakṣaṇanimittaprādurbhāvo veti ||4||
bhavanti cātra- cikitsyamānaḥ samyak ca vikāro yo'bhivardhate | prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasya lakṣaṇaṃ tadgatāyuṣaḥ ||5||

nivartate mahāvyādhiḥ ‘mahāvyādhiriha mahāmūlo vyādhiḥ, asyātimūlatayā krameṇa vartanaṃ prakṛtiḥ, sahasā nivartanaṃ vikṛtitvādriṣṭam| na cāhāraphalamiti upaśayaśaktilakṣaṇabalajananamāhāraphalaṃ, tanna bhavati’ iti cakraḥ sahasā yasya dehinaḥ | na cāhāraphalaṃ yasya dṛśyate sa vinaśyati ||6||
etānyariṣṭarūpāṇi samyag budhyeta yo bhiṣak | sādhyāsādhyaparīkṣāyāṃ sa ‘ślāghyaḥ sa nṛpaterbhavet’ iti pā. rājñaḥ sammato bhavet ||7||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne svabhāvavipratipattirnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||32||

div.head: avāraṇīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'vāraṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
upadravaistu ye juṣṭā vyādhayo yāntyavāryatām | rasāyanādvinā vatsa! tān śṛṇvekamanā mama ||3||

div.ab: vātavyādhiḥ pramehaśca kuṣṭhamarśo bhagandaram | aśmarī mūḍhagarbhaśca tathaivodaramaṣṭamam ||4|| aṣṭāvete prakṛtyaiva duścikitsyā mahāgadāḥ |5|

ab.seg: prāṇamāṃsakṣayaḥ śoṣastṛṣṇā cchardirjvarastathā ||5||
atīsāraśca mūrcchā ca hikkā śvāsastathaiva ca | etairupadravairjuṣṭān sarvāneva vivarjayet ||6||
śūnaṃ suptatvacaṃ bhagnaṃ kampādhmānanipīḍitam | naraṃ rujārtamantaśca vātavyādhirvināśayet ||7||

yathoktopadravāviṣṭamatiprasrutameva ‘yathoktopadravāviṣṭamiti yasmin pramehe ye upadravā uktāstadyuktaṃ sat atroktopadravayuktaṃ mānavaṃ hantīti jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ vā | piḍakāpīḍitaṃ gāḍhaṃ prameho hanti mānavam ||8||
prabhinnaprasrutāṅgaṃ ca raktanetraṃ hatasvaram | pañcakarmaguṇātītaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hantīha kuṣṭhinam ||9||
tṛṣṇārocakaśūlārtamatiprasrutaśoṇitam | śophātīsārasaṃyuktamarśovyādhirvināśayet ||10||
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi krimayaḥ śukrameva ca | bhagandarāt prasravanti yasya taṃ parivarjayet ||11||
praśūnanābhivṛṣaṇaṃ ruddhamūtraṃ ruganvitam | aśmarī kṣapayatyāśu sikatā śarkarānvitā ||12||
garbhakoṣaparāsaṅgo makkallo yonisaṃvṛtiḥ | hanyāt striyaṃ mūḍhagarbhe yathoktāścāpyupadravāḥ ||13||
pārśvabhaṅgānnavidveṣaśophātīsārapīḍitam | viriktaṃ pūryamāṇaṃ ca varjayedudarārditam ||14||
yastāmyati visañjñaśca śete nipatito'pi vā | śītārdito'ntaruṣṇaśca jvareṇa mriyate naraḥ ||15||
yo hṛṣṭaromā raktākṣo hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavān | nityaṃ vaktreṇa cocchvasyāttaṃ jvaro hanti mānavam ||16||
hikkāśvāsapipāsārtaṃ mūḍhaṃ vibhrāntalocanam | santatocchvāsinaṃ kṣīṇaṃ naraṃ kṣapayati jvaraḥ ||17||
āvilākṣaṃ pratāmyantaṃ nidrāyuktamatīva ca | kṣīṇaśoṇitamāṃsaṃ ca naraṃ nāśayati jvaraḥ ||18||
śvāsaśūlapipāsārtaṃ kṣīṇaṃ jvaranipīḍitam | viśeṣeṇa naraṃ vṛddhamatīsāro vināśayet ||19||
śuklākṣamannadveṣṭāramūrdhvaśvāsanipīḍitam | kṛcchreṇa bahu mehantaṃ yakṣmā hantīha mānavam ||20||
śvāsaśūlapipāsānnavidveṣagranthimūḍhatāḥ | bhavanti durbalatvaṃ ca gulmino mṛtyumeṣyataḥ ||21||
ādhmātaṃ baddhaniṣyandaṃ chardihikkātṛḍanvitam | rujāśvāsasamāviṣṭaṃ vidradhirnāśayennaram ||22||
pāṇḍudantanakho yaśca pāṇḍunetraśca mānavaḥ | pāṇḍusaṅghātadarśī ca pāṇḍurogī vinaśyati ||23||
lohitaṃ chardayedyastu bahuśo lohitekṣaṇaḥ | raktānāṃ ca diśāṃ draṣṭā raktapittī vinaśyati ||24||
avāṅmukhastūnmukho vā kṣīṇamāṃsabalo naraḥ | jāgariṣṇurasandehamunmādena vinaśyati ||25||
bahuśo'pasmarantaṃ tu prakṣīṇaṃ calitabhruvam | netrābhyāṃ ca vikurvāṇamapasmāro vināśayet ||26||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne'vāraṇīyo nāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||33||

div.head: yuktasenīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto yuktasenīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘vyādhitānāṃ mārakamupadravamabhidhāya svasthānāmapyāgantunimittaṃ yataḥ prāyo maraṇaṃ bhavati tadupadeṣṭuṃ yuktasenīyo'bhidhīyate| atra hi sūtrasthāne'vaśyaṃ sūtraṇīyaṃ vakṣyamāṇakalpasthānasya bījabhūtaṃ svasthopadravabhūtaṃ viṣamabhidhātavyaṃ, tathā cānye'pamṛtyava ekottaraśatamityādinā sūtrayitavyāḥ’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
nṛpateryuktasenasya parānabhijigīṣataḥ | bhiṣajā rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yathā tadupadekṣyate ||3||
vijigīṣuḥ sahāmātyairyātrāyuktaḥ prayatnataḥ | rakṣitavyo viśeṣeṇa viṣādeva narādhipaḥ ||4||

panthānamudakaṃ chāyāṃ ‘chāyāśrayavṛkṣādīnāṃ dūṣaṇācchāyāduṣṭirbhavati| duṣṭavṛkṣādicchāyāśrayiṇo vṛkṣādigatena saviṣeṇa pavanena bādhyante| jānīyāditi jñātvā parihārārthaṃ| parihārāśaktau śodhayedapītyuktaṃ| śodhayediti nirviṣīkuryāt’ iti cakraḥ bhaktaṃ yavasamindhanam | dūṣayantyarayastacca jānīyācchodhayettathā ||5||

div.ab: tasya liṅgaṃ cikitsā ca kalpasthāne pravakṣyate |6|
ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśatamatharvāṇaḥ pracakṣate ||6|| tatraikaḥ kālasaṃyuktaḥ ‘kālasañjñastu’ iti pā. śeṣā āgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ |7|
doṣāgantujamṛtyubhyo rasamantraviśāradau ||7|| rakṣetāṃ nṛpatiṃ nityaṃ yattau ‘yatnāt’ iti pā. vaidyapurohitau |8|
brahmā vedāṅgamaṣṭāṅgamāyurvedamabhāṣata ||8|| purohitamate tasmādvarteta bhiṣagātmavān |9|
saṅkaraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ praṇāśo dharmakarmaṇām ||9|| prajānāmapi cocchittirnṛpavyasanahetutaḥ |10|

puruṣāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca kevalaṃ tulyamūrtitā ||10|| ājñā tyāgaḥ kṣamā dhairyaṃ vikramaścāpyamānuṣaḥ | tasmāddevamivābhīkṣṇaṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ ||11|| cintayennṛpatiṃ vaidyaḥ śreyāṃsīcchan vicakṣaṇaḥ |12|

skandhāvāre ca mahati rājagehādanantaram ||12|| bhavetsannihito vaidyaḥ ‘nityaṃ’ iti pā. sarvopakaraṇānvitaḥ | tatrasthamenaṃ dhvajavadyaśaḥkhyātisamucchritam ||13|| upasarpantyamohena viṣaśalyāmayārditāḥ | svatantrakuśalo'nyeṣu śāstrārtheṣvabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||14|| vaidyo dhvaja ivābhāti nṛpatadvidyapūjitaḥ ‘nṛpatadvidhapūjitaḥ’ iti pā.|15|
vaidyo vyādhyupasṛṣṭaśca bheṣajaṃ paricārakaḥ ||15|| ete pādāścikitsāyāḥ karmasādhanahetavaḥ | guṇavadbhistribhiḥ pādaiścaturtho guṇavān bhiṣak ||16|| vyādhimalpena kālena mahāntamapi sādhayet |17|
vaidyahīnāstrayaḥ pādā guṇavanto'pyapārthakāḥ ||17|| udgātṛhotṛbrahmāṇo yathā'dhvaryuṃ vinā'dhvare |18|
vaidyastu guṇavānekastārayedāturāṃ sadā ||18|| plavaṃ pratitarairhīnaṃ ‘praticaraiḥ’ iti pā. karṇadhāra ivāmbhasi |19|

tattvādhigataśāstrārtho ‘tīrthādhigataśāstrārthaḥ’ iti pā. dṛṣṭakarmā svayaṅkṛtī ||19|| laghuhastaḥ śuciḥ śūraḥ sajjopaskarabheṣajaḥ | pratyutpannamatirdhīmān vyavasāyī viśāradaḥ ||20|| satyadharmaparo yaśca sa bhiṣak pāda ucyate |21|
āyuṣmān sattvavān sādhyo dravyavānātmavānapi ||21|| āstiko vaidyavākyastho vyādhitaḥ pāda ucyate |22|

ab.seg: praśastadeśasambhūtaṃ praśaste'hani coddhṛtam ||22||

yuktamātraṃ cakrastu ‘alpamātraṃ bahuguṇaṃ’ iti paṭhati, vyākhyānayati ca ‘alpamātramapi praśastaguṇayogādbahuguṇakaram’ iti manaskāntaṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam | doṣaghnamaglānikaramavikāri viparyaye | samīkṣya dattaṃ kāle ca bheṣajaṃ pāda ucyate ||23||
snigdho'jugupsurbalavān yukto vyādhitarakṣaṇe | vaidyavākyakṛdaśrāntaḥ pādaḥ paricaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||24||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yuktasenīyo nāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||34||

div.head: āturopakramaṇīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta āturopakramaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

āturamupakramamāṇena ‘pūrvādhyāyoktaguṇavadbheṣajādipādatrayayuktabhiṣajā āturaścikitsitumupakramaṇīya ityāturopakramaṇīyo'bhidhīyate| āturopakramaṇaṃ ca gatāyuṣi nirarthakamayaśaskaraṃ cetyadhyāyapratijñānantaramāyuḥparīkṣopadeśaṃ karoti- āturamityādi| āyuḥparīkṣaṇaṃ ca riṣṭasadbhāvābhāvābhyāṃ pūrvādhyāyairyadyapi kṛtameva tathā'pi yaddīrghāyuṣṭvaṃ tattatra noktaṃ, tadiha pratipādanīyam|’ iti cakraḥ bhiṣajā''yurādāveva parīkṣitavyaṃ ‘parīkṣeta’ iti pā.; satyāyuṣi vyādhyṛtvagnivayodehabalasattvasātmyaprakṛtibheṣajadeśān parīkṣeta ||3||

tatra mahāpāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhastanāgradaśanavadanaskandhalalāṭaṃ dīrghāṅguliparvocchvāsaprekṣaṇabāhuṃ, vistīrṇabhrūstanāntaroraskaṃ ‘bhruvoḥ stanayoścāntaraṃ jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ hrasvajaṅghāmeḍhragrīvaṃ, gambhīrasattvasvaranābhim ‘gambhīratvaṃ sattvasya vyasane'bhyudaye cākṣobhyatā’ iti cakra, anuccairbaddhastanam, upacitamahāromaśakarṇaṃ, paścānmastiṣkaṃ, snātānuliptaṃ mūrdhānupūrvyā viśuṣyamāṇaśarīraṃ ‘viśuṣyamāṇāvayavaṃ’ iti pā.| ‘snātānuliptamānupūrvyā paścādviśuṣyamāṇaśarīrahṛdayamiti snātaṃ vā anuliptaṃ vā yathānupūrvyā salilaṃ vā anulepanaṃ vā śarīre lagnaṃ tathaiva viśuṣyamāṇaśarīraṃ paścācca viśuṣyamāṇahṛdayamityarthaḥ’ iti cakraḥ paścācca viśuṣyamāṇahṛdayaṃ puruṣaṃ jānīyāddīrghāyuḥ khalvayamiti | tamekāntenopakramet | ebhirlakṣaṇairviparītairalpāyuḥ; miśrairmadhyamāyuriti ‘madhyamāyuṣamiti’ iti pā.||4||

bhavanti cātra | gūḍhasandhisirāsnāyuḥ saṃhatāṅgaḥ sthirendriyaḥ | uttarottarasukṣetro ‘uttarottarasukṣetra iti uttarottaradīrghāyuḥpuruṣakulajātaḥ, kṣetraṃ prabhavasthānamiha kulapuruṣāḥ’ iti cakraḥ yaḥ sa dīrghāyurucyate ||5||
garbhāt prabhṛtyarogo yaḥ śanaiḥ samupacīyate | śarīrajñānavijñānaiḥ sa dīrghāyuḥ samāsataḥ ||6||

div.ab: madhyamasyāyuṣo jñānamata ūrdhvaṃ nibodha me | adhastādakṣayoryasya lekhāḥ syurvyaktamāyatāḥ ||7|| dve vā tisro'dhikā vā'pi pādau karṇau ca māṃsalau | nāsāgramūrdhvaṃ ca bhavedūrdhvaṃ lekhāśca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||8|| yasya syustasya paramamāyurbhavati saptatiḥ |9|

ab.seg: jaghanyasyāyuṣo jñānamata ūrdhvaṃ nibodha me ||9||
hasvāni yasya parvāṇi sumahaccāpi mehanam | tathorasyavalīḍhāni na ca syātpṛṣṭhamāyatam ||10||
ūrdhvaṃ ca śravaṇau sthānānnāsā coccā śarīriṇaḥ | hasato jalpato vā'pi dantamāṃsaṃ pradṛśyate | prekṣate yaśca vibhrāntaṃ sa jīvetpañcaviṃśatim ||11||

atha punarāyuṣo vijñānārthamaṅgapratyaṅgapramāṇasārānupadekṣyāmaḥ | tatrāṅgānyantarādhisakthibāhuśirāṃsi, tadavayavāḥ pratyaṅgānīti | tatra, svairaṅgulaiḥ pādāṅguṣṭhapradeśinyau dvyaṅgulāyate ‘triyavo'trāṅgulaḥ’ iti cakraḥ; pradeśinyāstu madhyamānāmikākaniṣṭhikā yathottaraṃ pañcamabhāgahīnāḥ; caturaṅgulāyate pañcāṅgulavistṛte prapadapādatale; pañcacaturaṅgulāyatavistṛtā pārṣṇiḥ; caturdaśāṅgulāyataḥ pādaḥ; caturdaśāṅgulapariṇāhāni pādagulphajaṅghājānumadhyāni; aṣṭādaśāṅgulā jaṅghā, jānūpariṣṭācca dvātriṃśadaṅgulam, ete ‘evaṃ’ iti pā. pañcāśat; jaṅghāyāmasamāvūrū; dvyaṅgulāni vṛṣaṇacibukadaśananāsāpuṭabhāgakarṇamūlabhrūnayanāntarāṇi; caturaṅgulāni mehanavadanāntaranāsākarṇalalāṭagrīvocchrāyadṛṣṭyantarāṇi; dvādaśāṅgulāni bhagavistāramehananābhihṛdayagrīvāstanāntaramukhāyāmamaṇibandhaprakoṣṭhasthaulyāni; indrabastipariṇāhāṃsapīṭhakūrparāntarāyāmaḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaḥ; caturviṃśatyaṅgulo hastaḥ; dvātriṃśadaṅgulaparimāṇau bhujau; dvātriṃśatpariṇāhāvūrū; maṇibandhakūrparāntaraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulaṃ; talaṃ ṣaṭcaturaṅgulāyāmavistāram; aṅguṣṭhamūlapradeśinīśravaṇāpāṅgāntaramadhyamāṅgulyau pañcāṅgule; ardhapañcāṅgule ‘sārdhacaturaṅgule’ iti pā. pradeśinyanāmike; sārdhatryaṅgulau kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhau; caturviṃśativistārapariṇāhaṃ mukhagrīvaṃ; tribhāgāṅgulavistārā nāsāpuṭamaryādā; nayanatribhāgapariṇāhā tārakā; navamastārakāṃśo dṛṣṭiḥ; keśāntamastakāntaramekādaśāṅgulaṃ; mastakādavaṭukeśānto daśāṅgulaḥ; karṇāvaṭvantaraṃ caturdaśāṅgulaṃ; puruṣoraḥpramāṇavistīrṇā strīśroṇiḥ; aṣṭādaśāṅgulavistāramuraḥ; tatpramāṇā puruṣasya kaṭī; saviṃśamaṅgulaśataṃ ‘saviṃśamaṅgulaśataṃ puruṣāyāma’ iti pañcāṅgulāyāmā pārṣṇiḥ, jaṅghā caturviṃśatyaṅgulā, jānu caturaṅgulaṃ, ūruścaturviṃśatyaṅgulaḥ, mehananābhyorantaraṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ, nābhihṛdayāntaraṃ tathā grīvāhṛdayāntaraṃ pratyekaṃ dvādaśāṅgulaṃ, grīvā caturaṅgulāyāmā, mukhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ, tathā keśāntacūḍāsthānarūpamastakāntaramekādaśāṅgulamevaṃ saviṃśamaṅgulaśatamāyāmaḥ puruṣasya| anye vistṛtabāhupuruṣāyāmaṃ saviṃśamaṅgulaśataṃ vadanti’ iti cakraḥ puruṣāyāma iti ||12||
bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ | pañcaviṃśe tato varṣe pumān nārī tu ṣoḍaśe | samatvāgatavīryau tau jānīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak ||13||

div.ab: dehaḥ svairaṅgulaireṣa ‘dehaḥ svairaṅgulairityanena nārīśarīraṃ nāryaṅgulena puruṣaśarīraṃ puruṣāṅgulena meyaṃ, kiñca bālaśarīraṃ bālāṅgulena meyamityapi sūcitaṃ jñeyam| svāṅgulo'trāṅgulimadhyapradeśo māne jñeyaḥ, etasmiṃśca svāṅgulamāne triyavamānatā'ṅgulasyoktā na saṅgatā bhavati’ iti cakraḥ yathāvadanukīrtitaḥ |14|

ab.seg: yuktaḥ pramāṇenānena pumān vā yadi vā'ṅganā ||14||
dīrghamāyuravāpnoti vittaṃ ca mahadṛcchati | madhyamaṃ madhyamairāyurvittaṃ hīnaistathā'varam ||15||

atha sārān vakṣyāmaḥ- smṛtibhaktiprajñāśaucaśauryopetaṃ kalyāṇābhiniveśaṃ ‘niveśinaṃ’ iti pā. sattvasāraṃ vidyāt; snigdhasaṃhataśvetāsthidantanakhaṃ bahulakāmaprajaṃ śukreṇa; akṛśamuttamabalaṃ snigdhagambhīrasvaraṃ saubhāgyopapannaṃ mahānetraṃ ca majjñā; mahāśiraḥskandhaṃ dṛḍhadantahanvasthinakhamasthibhiḥ; snigdhamūtrasvedasvaraṃ bṛhaccharīramāyāsāsahiṣṇuṃ medasā; acchidragātraṃ gūḍhāsthisandhiṃ māṃsopacitaṃ ca māṃsena; snigdhatāmranakhanayanatālujihvauṣṭhapāṇipādatalaṃ raktena; suprasannamṛdutvagromāṇaṃ tvaksāraṃ vidyāditi | eṣāṃ ‘eṣāmiti sattvādisārāṇāṃ yadyat pūrvaṃ tattadāyuḥsaubhāgyayoḥ prakarṣakaram| evaṃ yathā yathā dvitryādisāratāyogaprakarṣastathā tathā''yuḥsaubhāgyaprakarṣo'pi jñeyaḥ, saubhāgyaśabdena ca kamanīyāścarake vistarapratipāditā balasaukumāryadhanitvādayo guṇā gṛhītavyāḥ’ iti cakraḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ pradhānamāyuḥsaubhāgyayoriti ||16||
viśeṣato'ṅgapratyaṅgapramāṇādatha sārataḥ | parīkṣyāyuḥ sunipuṇo bhiṣak sidhyati karmasu ||17||

vyādhiviśeṣāstu prāgabhihitāḥ; sarva ‘te tu sarva eva trividhā iti sarva eva rogāḥ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyabhedeṣu madhye ekasminnavaśyaṃ praviśantītyarthaḥ| na tu sarvarogāṇāṃ prati sādhyāditraividhyamanenocyate| yena rohiṇīprabhṛtayo na sādhyāḥ, jvarādayo na yāpyāḥ, tathā tilakālakamaśakādayaḥ sādhyā eva| atra prathamotpanno jvarādirvyādhiḥ, taṃ jaghanyakālajāto vyādhirupasṛjati anugato bhavati yo'tisārādiḥ, sa ca tanmūla eveti pūrvotpannavyādhikāraṇakaḥ san so'tisārādirupadrava ityarthaḥ| atra pūrvotpannamiti kṛtvā vyādhimiti viśeṣaṇamajanitavyādhidoṣāvasthāniṣedhārtham| jaghanyakālajātamitipadaṃ vyādhinā sahotpannārucyādiliṅgarūpavyādhinirāsārtham| yaduktaṃ carake ‘vyādhayaste tadātve tu liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ’ (ca. ni. a. 8) iti| punarvyādhiritipadaṃ vyādhyutpādottarakālabhāvi vyādhyavasthānirāsārtham| tanmūla eveti svahetubalād vyādhyuttarakālotpannasaṃsargirogapratiṣedhārtham| yathā- ślīpadottarakālajamapi kuṣṭhaṃ yathoktalakṣaṇamapi nopadravaḥ| evambhūtopadravalakṣaṇameva carake paṭhyate| yathā- “upadravastu rogāntarakālajo rogāśrayo roga eva, sa sthūlo'ṇurvā bahurvā paścājjāyata ityupadravasañjñaḥ’ (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| prāgutpanno vyādhirityanena jvarādaya eva vyādhayo'bhidhīyante| apūrvarūpa ityanena pūrvarūpādanyatvamucyate| anupadrava ityanena copadravādanyatvamucyate| anyalakṣaṇo nāmetyanena sarvapūrvarūpābhidhānam| bhaviṣyadvyādhikhyāpaka ityanena vartamānavyādhigamakaliṅgādvyāvṛttiḥ| liṅgānāṃ pradhānavyādhigrahaṇenaiva grahaṇamityuktameva, riṣṭānāṃ ca maraṇapūrvarūpatayā grahaṇamiti sarvavyādhiprāptiḥ’ iti cakraḥ evaite trividhāḥ- sādhyā, yāpyāḥ, pratyākhyeyāśca | tatraitān bhūyastridhā parīkṣeta- kimayamaupasargikaḥ, prākkevalaḥ, anyalakṣaṇa iti | tatra, aupasargiko nāma yaḥ pūrvotpannaṃ vyādhiṃ jaghanyakālajāto vyādhirupasṛjati, sa tanmūla tanmūlamūlaka’ iti pā. evopadravasañjñaḥ; prākkevalo nāma yaḥ prāgevotpanno vyādhirapūrvarūpo'nupadravaśca; anyalakṣaṇo nāma yo bhaviṣyadvyādhikhyāpakaḥ, sa pūrvarūpasañjñaḥ | tatra, sopadravamanyonyāvirodhenopakrameta, balavantamupadravaṃ vā; prākkevalaṃ yathāsvaṃ pratikurvīta; anyalakṣaṇe tvādivyādhau prayateta ||18||
bhavati cātra | nāsti rogo vinā doṣairyasmāttasmādvicakṣaṇaḥ | anuktamapi doṣāṇāṃ liṅgairvyādhimupācaret ||19||
prāgabhihitā ṛtavaḥ ||20||
śīte śītapratīkāramuṣṇe coṣṇanivāraṇam | kṛtvā kuryāt kriyāṃ prāptāṃ kriyākālaṃ na hāpayet ||21||
aprāpte vā kriyākāle prāpte vā na kṛtā kriyā | kriyā hīnā'tiriktā vā sādhyeṣvapi na sidhyati ||22||
yā hyudīrṇaṃ śamayati nānyaṃ vyādhiṃ karoti ca | sā kriyā, na tu yā vyādhiṃ haratyanyamudīrayet ||23||

prāgabhihito'gnirannasya pācakaḥ | sa caturvidho bhavati- doṣānabhipanna ‘doṣābhipanno vikriyāmāpannaśca trividho bhavati’ itipāṭhaścakrasammataḥ| ‘doṣābhipanna ityetāvaducyamāne vātādiprakṛtyagnīnāmapi manāgduṣṭādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syādityāha- vikriyāmāpannaśceti| doṣābhipannatvenaiva vikriyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ yat punarvikriyāmāpannaśveti karoti, tena pratikartavyāvirbhūtavikriyāpannatāṃ darśayati, tena prākṛtā'gnivikriyā anyā sarvathā'pratikāryā ca nirasyate| kiṃvā doṣābhipannatvenāprākṛtī duṣṭistrividhā gṛhyate, vikriyāmāpannaścetyanena ca āgantukī vahniduṣṭirucyate’ iti cakraḥ ekaḥ, vikriyāmāpannastrividho bhavati- viṣamo vātena, tīkṣṇaḥ pittena, mandaḥ śleṣmaṇā, caturthaḥ samaḥ sarvasāmyāditi | tatra, yo yathākālamupayuktamannaṃ samyak pacati sa samaḥ, samairdoṣaiḥ; yaḥ kadācit samyak pacati, kadācidādhmānaśūlodāvartātisārajaṭharagauravāntrakūjanapravāhaṇāni kṛtvā, sa viṣamaḥ; yaḥ prabhūtamapyupayuktamannamāśu pacati sa tīkṣṇaḥ, sa evābhivardhamāno'tyagnirityābhāṣyate, sa muhurmuhuḥ prabhūtamapyupayuktamannamāśutaraṃ pacati, pākānte ca galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣadāhasantāpāñjanayati; yastvalpamapyupayuktamudaraśirogauravakāsaśvāsaprasekacchardigātrasadanāni kṛtvā mahatā kālena pacati, sa mandaḥ ||24||
viṣamo vātajān rogāṃstīkṣṇaḥ pittanimittajān | karotyagnistathā mando vikārān kaphasambhavān ||25||

tatra, same parirakṣaṇaṃ kurvīta; viṣame snigdhāmlalavaṇaiḥ kriyāviśeṣaiḥ pratikurvīta; tīkṣṇe madhurasnigdhaśītairvirekaiśca; evamevātyagnau, viśeṣeṇa māhiṣaiśca kṣīradadhisarpirbhiḥ; mande kaṭutiktakaṣāyairvamanaiśca ||26||

jāṭharo ‘audaryaḥ’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| ‘udare bhava audaryaḥ| annasya pācaka ityanena annapākena kāryeṇa lakṣyate pratyakṣānupalabhyamāno'pīti darśyate| sūkṣmatvamihānudbhūtarūpamanukṣaṇadāhakaratvaṃ ca jñeyam| rasānādadāna iti rasamalavivekārthaṃ rasān gṛhṇannityarthaḥ| rasaśabdena rasādhāraṃ dravyamannapānarūpamucyate| vivektumiti rudhirāderanyatayā gṛhītum’ iti cakraḥ bhagavānagnirīśvaro'nnasya pācakaḥ | saukṣmyādrasānādadāno vivektuṃ naiva śakyate ||27||

prāṇāpānasamānaistu ‘atra prāṇāpānābhyāṃ praviśattiṣṭhadbhyāṃ vahneruddīpanaṃ bhastrādhmāpaneneva kriyate, tadetad ‘dhmāpyate’ ityanenoktam| samānena tu vahnipārśvavartinā pālanaṃ kriyate| carake'pi ‘samānenāvadhūto'gniḥ’ (ca. ci. a. 15) ityuktam| sarvata iti sarvamagnisthānaṃ vyāpya’ iti cakraḥ sarvataḥ pavanaistribhiḥ | dhmāyate pālyate cāpi svāṃ svāṃ gatimavasthitaiḥ ||28||

vayastu trividhaṃ- bālyaṃ, madhyaṃ, vṛddhamiti | tatronaṣoḍaśavarṣīyā bālāḥ | te trividhāḥ- kṣīrapāḥ, kṣīrānnādā, annādā iti | teṣu saṃvatsaraparāḥ kṣīrapāḥ, dvisaṃvatsaraparāḥ kṣīrānnādāḥ, parato'nnādā iti | ṣoḍaśasaptatyorantare madhyaṃ vayaḥ | tasya vikalpo- vṛddhiḥ, yauvanaṃ, sampūrṇatā, parihāṇiriti ‘paritaḥ sarvato dhātvindriyabalāderhāniḥ parihāṇiḥ’ iti cakraḥ| tatra, āviṃśatervṛddhiḥ, ātriṃśato yauvanam, ācatvāriṃśataḥ sarvadhātvindriyabalavīryasampūrṇatā, ata ūrdhvamīṣatparihāṇiryāvat saptatiriti | saptaterūrdhvaṃ kṣīyamāṇadhātvindriyabalavīryotsāhamahanyahani valīpalitakhālityajuṣṭaṃ kāsaśvāsaprabhṛtibhirupadravairabhibhūyamānaṃ sarvakriyāsvasamarthaṃ jīrṇāgāramivābhivṛṣṭamavasīdantaṃ vṛddhamācakṣate ||29||
tatrottarottarāsu vayovasthāsūttarottarā ‘uttarottarā iti uttarottaraṃ vardhamānā’ iti cakraḥ bheṣajamātrāviśeṣā bhavanti, ṛte ca parihāṇeḥ; tatrādyāpekṣayā pratikurvīta ||30||
bhavanti cātra- bāle vivardhate śleṣmā madhyame pittameva tu | bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vardhate vāyurvṛddhe tadvīkṣya yojayet ||31||

agnikṣāravirekaistu ‘vireko'tra malavirecanatayā vamanavirecane| yaduktaṃ carake ‘ubhayaṃ vā doṣamalavirecanādvirecanaśabdaṃ labhate’ (ca. ka. a. 1) iti cakraḥ bālavṛddhau vivarjayet | tatsādhyeṣu vikāreṣu mṛdvīṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śanaiḥ ||32||
dehaḥ sthūlaḥ, kṛśo, madhya, iti prāgupadiṣṭaḥ ||33||
karśayedbṛṃhayeccāpi sadā sthūlakṛśau narau | rakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhyasya kurvīta satataṃ bhiṣak ||34||

balamabhihitaguṇaṃ; daurbalyaṃ ‘daurbalyaṃ balameva kṣīṇamucyate| svabhāvādeva kaścinmātṛpitṛbījadoṣād daivādvā durbalo bhavati, kaściddoṣaiḥ kṣayitadhātuguṇatayā durbalo bhavati, jarayā vārdhakyena vā daurbalyaṃ bhavati| ādiśabdāt kālādīnāṃ grahaṇam| kriyāpratipattiḥ kriyāsiddhiḥ| carake'pyuktaṃ- ‘balādhiṣṭhānamārogyam| (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| ārogyādhiṣṭhānānāṃ śarīrāgnibalādīnāṃ madhye etacca prakaraṇe prādhānyakhyāpanaṃ tantradharmaḥ, tena vahnerapi svaviṣaye stutirna virudhyate’ iti cakraḥ tu svabhāvadoṣajarādibhiravekṣitavyam | yasmādbalavataḥ sarvakriyāpravṛttistasmādbalameva pradhānamadhikaraṇānām ||35||

kecit kṛśāḥ prāṇavantaḥ sthūlāścālpabalā narāḥ | tasmāt sthiratvaṃ ‘sthiratvavyāyāmaiḥ’ iti pā.| ‘sthiratvamabhighātādibhiravicālyatvam| kecit sthiratvamiti vyastaṃ paṭhanti| atra sthairyalakṣaṇaṃ balaṃ sthiratvamiti vadanti’ iti cakraḥ vyāyāmairbalaṃ vaidyaḥ pratarkayet ||36||

sattvaṃ ‘kramāgatasattvaparīkṣāyāṃ sattvaṃ sattvaguṇo manogataḥ, tadutkarṣānmano balavadbhavati| avikalpo'vikṛtatvaṃ, sukhaduḥkhahetau nirbhayavikāraśūnyatā aviklavaḥ’ iti cakraḥ tu vyasanābhyudayakriyādisthāneṣvaviklavakaram ‘avaikalyakaram’ iti pā.||37||
sattvavān sahate sarvaṃ saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā | rājasaḥ stabhyamāno'nyaiḥ sahate naiva tāmasaḥ ||38||

sātmyāni ‘tatra sātmyaṃ nāma yadupaśete sukhaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| uktaṃ hi carake ‘sātmyārtho hyupaśayārthaḥ’ (ca. vi. a. 1) iti| tathā ‘yo rasaḥ kalpate yasya sukhitvāya niṣevitaḥ’ ityanantaramevoktam| sukhaṃ cehārogyam| yaduktaṃ ‘sukhasañjñakamārogyaṃ’ (ca. sū. a. 9) iti| taccārogyarūpaṃ sukhaṃ svasthe'nāgatābādhapratiṣedhena tathā vyādhite vyādhyapanayanena sātmyena kriyate| yadapi ca ‘yat prayāti sahātmatām’ iti sātmyalakṣaṇaṃ tadapyevambhūtārthameva, yenātmarūpatā'pyavikārataiva vaktavyā| tacca sātmyaṃ saṅkṣepataḥ pañcaprakāraṃ- deśasātmyaṃ, jātisātmyam, ṛtusātmyaṃ, rogasātmyam, okasātmyaṃ ceti| tatra deśasātmyādīni catvāri carakoktānyeva, okasātmyāni ‘prakṛtiviruddhānyapi yānyabādhakarāṇi’ ityanenoktāni| atra abhyāsādabādhakarāṇītyarthāllabhyate, viruddhānyapyabhyāsādeva paramabādhakarāṇi bhavanti’ iti cakraḥ tu deśakālajātyṛturogavyāyāmodakadivāsvapnarasaprabhṛtīni ‘rasaśabdena bhujyamānaṃ sarvadravyaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti cakraḥ prakṛtiviruddhānyapi yānyabādhakarāṇi bhavanti ||39||
yo rasaḥ kalpate yasya sukhāyaiva niṣevitaḥ | vyāyāmajātamanyadvā tat sātmyamiti nirdiśet ||40||
prakṛtiṃ bheṣajaṃ copariṣṭādvakṣyāmaḥ ||41||

deśastvānūpo jāṅgalaḥ sādhāraṇa iti | tatra, bahūdakanimnonnatanadīvarṣagahano mṛduśītānilo bahumahāparvatavṛkṣo mṛdusukumāropacitaśarīramanuṣyaprāyaḥ kaphavātarogabhūyiṣṭhaścānūpaḥ; ākāśasamaḥ praviralālpakaṇṭakivṛkṣaprāyo'lpavarṣaprasravaṇodapānodakaprāya uṣṇadāruṇavātaḥ praviralālpaśailaḥ sthirakṛśaśarīramanuṣyaprāyo vātapittarogabhūyiṣṭhaśca jāṅgalaḥ; ubhayadeśalakṣaṇaḥ sādhāraṇa iti ||42||
bhavanti cātra- samāḥ sādhāraṇe yasmācchītavarṣoṣmamārutāḥ | doṣāṇāṃ samatā jantostasmātsādhāraṇo mataḥ ||43||

na ‘idānīmanuguṇadoṣadeśajarogasya tadviguṇadeśasambandhe cikitsitamāha- na tathetyādi| jalajā iti jalopalakṣitānūpadeśajātāḥ, sthalāhṛtā iti sthalopalakṣitajāṅgaladeśajātāḥ| vāśabdena sthalajā vā jalāhṛtā iti viparītaguṇaṃ darśayati| tadudāharaṇaṃ yathāanūpadeśajaṃ ślīpadaṃ jāṅgaladeśajātaṃ sat prabalaṃ na bhavati, ānūpaguṇaviparītaguṇajāṅgaladeśaguṇaistathā taddeśīyāhārācāraiścānūpaviparītaiḥ pratibādhyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ| na kevalaṃ vyādhaya eva paraṃ viruddhadeśagatā durbalā bhavanti, kintu doṣā api viruddhadeśaprāptikupitā na balavanta ityāha- svadeśe ityādi| svadeśe ityanuguṇadeśe, yathā- ānūpopacitaḥ kaphaḥ, anyasminniti tadviruddhe jāṅgale prakupitaḥ| evaṃ pittavātayorapyudāhāryam| idānīṃ deśasambandhasyāpyasthiratayā tajjanyarogaśaṅkāyāṃ deśasātmyasevayā'bhayaṃ darśayannāha- ucite ityādi| ucite iti deśaguṇaviparītasātmyāhārasvapnaceṣṭādau vartamānasya| ucitatvameva sphorayati- taddeśasya guṇe satīti|taddeśasya guṇaviparītaguṇe āhārādau satītyarthaḥ| deśakṛtaṃ bhayamiti deśaguṇajanyamānarogabhayaṃ| yadi punarāhārādāvativartate tadā bhavatyeva bhayam’ iti cakraḥ tathā balavantaḥ syurjalajā vā sthalāhṛtāḥ | svadeśe nicitā doṣā anyasmin kopamāgatāḥ ||44||
ucite vartamānasya nāsti deśakṛtaṃ bhayam | āhārasvapnaceṣṭādau taddeśasya guṇe sati ||45||
deśaprakṛtisātmyartuviparīto'cirotthitaḥ | sampattau bhiṣagādīnāṃ balasattvāyuṣāṃ tathā ||46||
kevalaḥ samadehāgneḥ sukhasādhyatamo gadaḥ | ato'nyathā tvasādhyaḥ syātkṛcchro vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ ||47||

kriyāyāstu guṇālābhe kriyāmanyāṃ prayojayet | pūrvasyāṃ śāntavegāyāṃ ‘śāntāyāmiti vaktavye yat ‘śāntavegāyāṃ’ iti karoti, tena dinaviśrāmaṃ darśayati| kriyāsaṅkaraḥ kriyāmelakaḥ| ayaṃ ca pūrvakriyāviruddhaguṇatayā tathā pūrvakriyayā sahātimātratayā agnivadhādihetutvena cābhihita iti jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ na kriyāsaṅkaro hitaḥ ||48||
guṇālābhe'pi sapadi yadi saiva kriyā hitā | kartavyaiva tadā vyādhiḥ kṛcchrasādhyatamo yadi ||49||
ya evamenaṃ vidhimekarūpaṃ bibharti kālādivaśena dhīmān | sa mṛtyupāśāñjagato gadaughāñchinatti bhaiṣajyaparaśvadhena ||50||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne āturopakramaṇīyo nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||35||

athāto bhūmipravibhāgīyamadhyāyaṃ ‘miśrake bheṣajadravyamuktaṃ, dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyādau ca vaktavyaṃ, tacca praśastabhūmijātameva kāryakaraṃ bhavati, ato bheṣajagrahaṇārthaṃ praśastāpraśastabhūmivibhāgīyo'bhidhīyate| bhūmivibhāgopadarśanādhikāreṇa cānyadapi jantujagdhatvādibheṣajadoṣaguṇavarṇanamiha bhaviṣyati| ‘bhūmipravibhāgavijñānīyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

śvabhraśarkarāśmaviṣamavalmīkaśmaśānāghātanadevatāyatanasikatābhiranupahatāmanūṣarāmabhaṅgurāmadūrodakāṃ ‘śvabhrādayaścālpavīryotpādakatayā bheṣajopaghātakāḥ, valmīkādayastu aprāśastyenāpraśastāḥ, aprāśastyaṃ ca teṣāṃ vacanādevonnīyate’ iti cakraḥ snigdhāṃ prarohavatīṃ mṛdvīṃ sthirāṃ samāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ gaurīṃ lohitāṃ vā bhūmimauṣadhagrahaṇāya ‘bhūmimauṣadhārthaṃ’ iti pā. parīkṣeta | tasyāṃ jātamapi kṛmiviṣaśastrātapapavanadahanatoyasambādhamārgairanupahatamekarasaṃ ‘ātapapavanayoratiyogena upaghātaḥ, toyasambādho'tijalasambādhaḥ| ekarasamiti vṛkṣāntarānākrāntam| avagāḍhamityanuttānamūlam’ iti cakraḥ puṣṭaṃ pṛthvavagāḍhamūlamudīcyāṃ cauṣadhamādadītetyeṣa bhūmiparīkṣāviśeṣaḥ sāmānyaḥ ||3||

viśeṣatastu ‘viśeṣatastvityādinā bhūmiparīkṣāviśeṣaḥ kathyate| ayaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇo viśeṣaḥ ‘pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūmau jātāni virecanadravyāṇyādadīta’ ityādau prayojanavān| sthireti kaṭhinā| nānāvarṇeti tejaso nānāvarṇakāraṇatvāt| praroho'ṅkuraḥ|’ iti cakraḥ tatra, aśmavatī sthirā gurvī śyāmā kṛṣṇā vā sthūlavṛkṣaśasyaprāyā svaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā; snigdhā śītalā''sannodakā snigdhaśasyatṛṇakomalavṛkṣaprāyā śuklā'mbuguṇabhūyiṣṭhā; nānāvarṇā laghvaśmavatī praviralālpapāṇḍuvṛkṣaprarohā'gniguṇabhūyiṣṭhā; rūkṣā bhasmarāsabhavarṇā tanuvṛkṣālparasakoṭaravṛkṣaprāyā'nilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā; mṛdvī samā śvabhravatyavyaktarasajalā sarvato'sāravṛkṣā mahāparvatavṛkṣaprāyā śyāmā cākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā ||4||

atra kecidāhurācāryāḥ- prāvṛḍvarṣāśaraddhemantavasantagrīṣmeṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mūlapatratvakkṣīrasāraphalānyādadīteti; tattu na samyak, saumyāgneyatvājjagataḥ | saumyānyauṣadhāni ‘bheṣajadravyamapi kiñcit saumyaṃ kiñcidāgneyam| tena yat saumyaṃ tat somaguṇātirikteṣu saumyeṣu ṛtuṣu sampūrṇavīryatayā grāhyam, evamāgneyamāgneyeṣu, sarvathā mūlādyaṅge grāhyam| yattu grīṣmādiṣu mūlādigrahaṇaṃ tadanupapattikatvādasādhu| etadeva vyākaroti- tatra saumyetyādi| saumyānāṃ saumyagrahaṇe guṇātiśayaṃ darśayan samānanyāyatayā āgneyānyagniguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūmau kaṭutarāṇi rūkṣatarāṇi ca bhavanti’ iti cakraḥ| ‘teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamaciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayorgrāhyaṃ, grīṣme mūlāni śiśire ca śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāṃ, śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi, hemante sārāṇi, yathartu puṣpaphalam’ (ca. ka. a. 1) iti carakaḥ saumyeṣvṛtuṣvādadīta, āgneyānyāgneyeṣu; evamavyāpannaguṇāni bhavanti | saumyānyauṣadhmani saumyeṣvṛtuṣu gṛhītāni somaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūmau jātānyatimadhurasnigdhaśītāni jāyante | etena śeṣaṃ vyākhyātam ||5||

tatra pṛthivyambuguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ bhūmau jātāni virecanadravyāṇyādadīta ‘virecanamadhobhāgaṃ tadadhogāmipṛthivyambuguṇabhūmiṣṭhāyāṃ balavattaraṃ bhavati| anilāgnī tūrdhvagau, tena tadguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāmūrdhvagaṃ vamanaṃ balavattaraṃ bhavati, ubhayatobhāgaharāṇi vamanavirecanakarāṇi arkakṣīrādīni| ākāśasya sarvagatatvena śamanauṣadhakāritvaṃ, śamanaṃ hi sarvagataṃ doṣaṃ tatraiva śamayati| abhinavānīti abhinavatvamiha sampūrṇavīryatākāratvam| tena yattu mūlake bilve ca bālāvasthāyāmeva praśastatvaṃ tattvavasthāgṛhītamevābhinavatvaṃ jñeyam’ iti cakraḥ, agnyākāśamārutaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ vamanadravyāṇi, ubhayaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāmubhayatobhāgāni, ākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāyāṃ saṃśamanāni, evaṃ balavattarāṇi bhavanti ||6||
sarvāṇyeva cābhinavāni, anyatra madhughṛtaguḍapippalīviḍaṅgebhyaḥ ||7||
viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī kṣaudraṃ sarpiścāpyanavaṃ hitam | śeṣamanyatvabhinavaṃ gṛhṇīyāddoṣavarjitam ||8||
(sarvāṇyeva sakṣīrāṇi vīryavanti;) teṣāmasampattāvatikrāntasaṃvatsarāṇyādadīteti ‘anatikrāntasaṃvatsarāṇi’ iti pā.||9||

bhavanti cātra- gopālāstāpasā vyādhā ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ | mūlāhārāśca ‘mūlānyāharanti kāryārthamiti mūlahārāḥ| bheṣajavyaktiriti bheṣajākāranāmajñānaṃ, rasavīryādidvārā bheṣajavyaktiḥ śāstrādeva jñeyā’ iti cakraḥ ye tebhyo bheṣajavyaktiriṣyate ||10||

sarvāvayavasādhyeṣu palāśalavaṇādiṣu | vyavasthito na kālo'sti tatra tatra sarvo vivīyata iti sarva eva kālaḥ palāśalavaṇārthaṃ gṛhyamāṇapalāśe gṛhyate, yadi kālaniyamenāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tadā militavṛkṣagrāhakaḥ kālo nāstīti tatprayogo na syāt| vayaḥsthānāmiti taruṇānāṃ, bālavṛddhayostu asampūrṇadhātutvādevāpraśastatvam’ iti cakraḥ sarvo vidhīyate ||11||
gandhavarṇarasopetā ṣaḍvidhā bhūmiriṣyate | tasmādbhūmisvabhāvena bījinaḥ ṣaḍrasāyutāḥ ||12||
avyaktaḥ kila toyasya raso niścayaniścitaḥ | rasaḥ sa eva cāvyakto vyakto bhūmirasādbhavet ||13||
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā bhūmiḥ sādhāraṇā smṛtā | dravyāṇi yatra tatraiva tadguṇāni viśeṣataḥ ||14||
vigandhenāparāmṛṣṭamavipannaṃ rasādibhiḥ | navaṃ dravyaṃ purāṇaṃ vā grāhyamevaṃ vinirdiśet ||15||
jaṅgamānāṃ vayaḥsthānāṃ raktaromanakhādikam | kṣīramūtrapurīṣāṇi jīrṇāhāreṣu saṃharet ||16||
plotamṛdbhāṇḍaphalakaśaṅkuvinyastabheṣajam | praśastāyāṃ diśi śucau bheṣajāgāramiṣyate ||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne bhūmipravibhāgīyo nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36||

div.head: miśrakādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto ‘pūrvādhyāyoktavidhiparīkṣitasya rogiṇaścikitsā kartavyā, tatra caitattantre vraṇinaḥ prādhānyādvraṇacikitsāmeva vimlāpanapāṭanadāraṇādikāṃ miśrīkṛtya dravyaistaistairmātuluṅgādibhirabhidhātuṃ miśrako'bhidhīyate| atrauṣadhānāṃ miśrīkṛtya gaṇarūpatayā'bhidhānādasya miśrakasañjñā|’ iti cakraḥ miśrakamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
mātuluṅgyagnimanthau ca bhadradāru mahauṣadham | ahiṃsrā caiva rāsnā ca pralepo vātaśophajit ||3||
dūrvā ca nalamūlaṃ ca madhukaṃ candanaṃ tathā | śītalāśca gaṇāḥ sarve pralepaḥ pittaśophahṛt ||4||

āgantuje ‘āgantujaraktajayorapi pittapradhānatayā āgantuja ityādinā'tideśaḥ kṛtaḥ| āgantuje'pi āditaḥ pittakṣobhādūṣmādivṛddhau pittaharaṃ lepanaṃ yuktameva pākapratibandhārtham’ iti cakraḥ raktaje ca hyeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | vidhirviṣaghno viṣaje pittaghno'pi hitastathā ||5||
ajagandhā'śvagandhā ca kālā saralayā saha | ekaiṣikājaśṛṅgī ca pralepaḥ śleṣmaśophahṛt ||6||
ete vargāstrayo lodhraṃ pathyā piṇḍītakāni ca | anantā ceti lepo'yaṃ sānnipātikaśophahṛt ||7||
snigdhāmlalavaṇo vāte koṣṇaḥ, śītaḥ payoyutaḥ | pitte, coṣṇaḥ kaphe kṣāramūtrāḍhyastatpraśāntaye ||8||

śaṇamūlakaśigrūṇāṃ phalāni tilasarṣapāḥ | saktavaḥ ‘atra saktavo yadyapi śītāstathā'pi dravyāntarasaṃyogādvraṇapācanā bhavanti| yathā tile proktaṃ- ‘śodhayedropayeccaiva yuktaḥ śodhanaropaṇaiḥ’ (ci. a. 1) iti| saktūnāṃ ca svatantre ‘dadhicukrasurāśukta’ (ci. a. 1) ityādinā saṃyuktasyaiva pācanatvaṃ vaktavyam| carake'pyuktaṃ- “satilā sātasībījadadhyambhaḥśaktupiṇḍikā” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti| tathā śītatve'pi śaktūnāṃ vraṇapācanaśaktirācāryavacanādevonnīyate| bhavati hi viṣayabhede'pi bhinnaśaktitvaṃ| yathā- kāñjikasyoṣṇasyāpi bahiḥsparśanaśītatvaṃ, tathā tilasya kaphapittakarasyāpi vraṇaviṣaye tridoṣaharatvam| yaduktaṃ “sa mādhuryāttathaivauṣṇyāt snehāccānilanāśanaḥ| kaṣāyabhāvānmādhuryāttiktatvāccāpi pittanut| auṣṇyāt kaṣāyabhāvācca tiktatvācca kaphe hitaḥ” iti cakraḥ kiṇvamatasī dravyāṇyuṣṇāni pācanam ||9||
cirabilvo'gniko dantī citrako hayamārakaḥ | kapotakaṅkagṛdhrāṇāṃ purīṣāṇi ca dāraṇam | kṣāradravyāṇi vā yāni kṣāro vā dāraṇaṃ param ||10||
dravyāṇāṃ ‘dravyāṇāṃ picchilānāṃ śālmalīśelutvakprabhṛtīnām’ iti cakraḥ picchilānāṃ tu tvaṅmūlāni prapīḍanam | yavagodhūmamāṣāṇāṃ cūrṇāni ca samāsataḥ ||11||
śāṅkhinyaṅkoṭhasumanaḥkaravīrasuvarcalāḥ | śodhanāni kaṣāyāṇi vargaścāragvadhādikaḥ ||12||

div.ab: ajagandhā'jaśṛṅgī ca gavākṣī lāṅgalāhvayā | pūtīkaścitrakaḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgailāhareṇavaḥ ||13|| kaṭutrikaṃ yavakṣāro lavaṇāni manaḥśilā | kāsīsaṃ trivṛtā dantī haritālaṃ surāṣṭrajā ||14|| saṃśodhanīnāṃ vartīnāṃ dravyāṇyetāni nirdiśet |15|

ab.seg: etairevauṣadhaiḥ kuryātkalkānapi ca śodhanān ||15||

div.ab: arkottamāṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ ‘sudhākṣīraṃ’ iti pā. piṣṭvā kṣārottamāni ca | jātīmūlaṃ haridre dve kāsīsaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ||16|| pūrvoddiṣṭāni cānyāni kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ ghṛtam |17|

ab.seg: mayūrako rājavṛkṣo nimbaḥ kośātakī tilāḥ ||17||
bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī ca haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | śodhanāni ca yojyāni taile dravyāṇi śodhane ||18||
kāsīse saindhave kiṇve vacāyāṃ rajanīdvaye | śodhanāṅgeṣu cānyeṣu cūrṇaṃ kurvīta śodhanam ||19||
sālasārādisāreṣu paṭolatriphalāsu ca | rasakriyā vidhātavyā śodhanī śodhaneṣu ca ||20||
śrīveṣṭake sarjarase sarale devadāruṇi | sāreṣvapi ca kurvīta matimān vraṇadhūpanam ||21||
kaṣāyāṇāmanuṣṇānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ tvakṣu sādhitaḥ | śṛtaḥ śītakaṣāyo vā ropaṇārthaṃ praśasyate ||22||
somāmṛtāśvagandhāsu kākolyādau gaṇe tathā | kṣīripraroheṣvapi ca vartayo ropaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||23||
samaṅgā somasaralā somavalkaḥ sacandanaḥ | kākolyādiśca kalkaḥ syāt praśasto vraṇaropaṇe ||24||
pṛthakparṇyātmaguptā ca haridre mālatī sitā | kākolyādiśca yojyaḥ syādbhiṣajā ropaṇe ghṛte ||25||
kālānusāryāguruṇī haridre devadāru ca | priyaṅgavaśca rodhraṃ ca taile yojyāni ropaṇe ||26||
kaṅgukā triphalā rodhraṃ kāsīsaṃ śravaṇāhvayā | dhavāśvakarṇayostvak ca ropaṇaṃ cūrṇamiṣyate ||27||
priyaṅgukā sarjarasaḥ puṣpakāsīsameva ca | tvakcūrṇaṃ dhavajaṃ caiva ropaṇārthaṃ praśasyate ||28||
tvakṣu nyagrodhavargasya triphalāyāstathaiva ca | rasakriyāṃ ropaṇārthe vidadhīta yathākramam ||29||

apāmārgo'śvagandhā ‘atra cotsādanaṃ yadyapi mṛduśītaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati, apāmārgaśca tīkṣṇaḥ, tathā'pi tasya mūlamihātīkṣṇaṃ grahītavyaṃ bhavati| aṅgabhedena dravyāṇāṃ guṇaviśeṣo yathā- śobhāñjanaṃ mūle phale ca tīkṣṇaṃ, puṣpaṃ tu tasya mṛdvapi’ iti cakraḥ ca tālapatrī suvarcalā | utsādane praśasyante kākolyādiśca yo gaṇaḥ ||30||
kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ kiṇvaṃ kuruvindo manaḥśilā | kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni sumanomukulāni ca ||31||
phale śairīṣakārañje dhātucūrṇāni yāni ca | vraṇeṣūtsannamāṃseṣu praśastānyavasādane ||32||

samastaṃ ‘samprati atrādhyāye kathitauṣadhavargāṇāṃ tathā dravyasaṅgrahaṇīye tathā saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīye ca ye vargāḥ paṭhanīyāstatra sarvālābhe'rdhavargeṇa yathālabdhena vā dvitryādidravyeṇa cikitsāprayogārthaṃ paribhāṣāmāha- samastaṃ vargamityādi| atra vargaśabdena prakaraṇāt samānakriyāṇāṃ samūha ucyate| tenātraivādhyāye prāyeṇa samānakāryā vargā uktāḥ, teṣveveyaṃ paribhāṣā| yatra tu saṃyogaśaktyā prayogopadarśanaṃ na tatrārdhavargādiprayogaḥ, saṃyogaśakteranyatarasaṃyogyapanayenāpyapārthakatvāt| nahi pānīyakalyāṇaghṛtādau yathālābhaṃ pāko bhavati| yatra tu samānavīryatayā ekatra prayogo gaṇokteṣu dravyeṣu bhavati, tatrānyatarāpāye'pi tacchaktīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ prayogārthaṃ sādhako bhavatyeva| ata eva carake'pyetadviṣaya evoktaṃ- “vargamapi vargeṇopasṛjet, uktamapi yadayaugikaṃ manyeta tadapoddharet” (ca. vi. a. 8) ityādi| etad dravyasamūhānāṃ tulyavīryatayā vā prayogaṃ tathā saṃyogaśaktyā vā prayogaṃ vivekena jñātumuktamatrāpi- bhiṣak prājña iti| atra ca yadyapi ardhavargaprayogo yathālābhaṃ prayogo'pi samastavargaprayogatulyatayā uktaḥ, tathā'pi samastaprayogasyaiva mahāphalatvaṃ jñeyaṃ, tasyaiva bahudravyaśaktiyogena mahāguṇatvāt| samastālābhe'rdhavargādiprayogaścireṇālpasādhako jñeyaḥ| anyathā tulyaphalatvaṃ syāt sarvasyārdhādibhiḥ samaṃ tadā prayāsasādhyaṃ sarvamardhavargādāvalpaprayāsasādhye samānaphale sati ko bāliśa upadiśedanutiṣṭhedvā| tasmāt sarvālābhe'rdhādividhānametat’ iti cakraḥ vargamardhaṃ vā yathālābhamathāpi vā | prayuñjīta bhiṣak prājño yathoddiṣṭeṣu karmasu ||33||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne miśrakādhyāyo nāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||37||

div.head: dravyasaṃgrahaṇīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ bhūmipravibhāgīyoktanyāyena gṛhītānāṃ bheṣajānāṃ yatra yatra vyādhipraśamanādau kārye yeṣāṃ bheṣajānāṃ kṣamatvaṃ tāni vargīkṛtyābhidhātuṃ dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyo'bhidhīyate| atra cānnapānādau vidārīkandaśatāvarīprabhṛtayaḥ samānaguṇā gaṇatayā nirdiṣṭāḥ, teṣāṃ gaṇarūpamelake saṃyogamahimnā guṇāntarasambhāvanānirāsārthaṃ tathā tatrākathitaguṇakarmadarśanārthamiha pāṭhaḥ| dṛśyate hi kvacit saṃyoge prakṛtiviruddhaguṇodayo, yathā- madhusarpiṣoḥ| atrāpi ca sampūrṇagaṇeṣu śaktyutkarṣaḥ, tathā'rdhaprayoge yathālābhaprayoge vā śaktyapakarṣo miśrakoktanyāyād vyākaraṇīyaḥ|’ iti cakraḥ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
samāsena saptatriṃśaddravyagaṇā bhavanti ||3||
tadyathā- vidārigandhā vidārī viśvadevā sahadevā śvadaṃṣṭrā pṛthakparṇī śatāvarī sārivā kṛṣṇasārivā jīvakarṣabhakau mahāsahā kṣudrasahā bṛhatyau punarnavairaṇḍo haṃsapādī vṛścikālyṛṣabhī ceti ||4||
vidārīgandhādirayaṃ gaṇaḥ pittānilāpahaḥ | śoṣagulmāṅgamardordhvaśvāsakāsavināśanaḥ ||5||
āragvadhamadanagopaghoṇṭākaṇṭakīkuṭajapāṭhāpāṭalāmūrvendrayavasaptaparṇanimbakuruṇṭakadāsīkuruṇṭaka- guḍūcīcitrakaśārṅga(rṅge)ṣṭākarañjadvayapaṭolakirātatiktakāni suṣavī ceti ||6||
āragvadhādirityeṣa gaṇaḥ śleṣmaviṣāpahaḥ | mehakuṣṭhajvaravamīkaṇḍūghno vraṇaśodhanaḥ ||7||
sālasārājakarṇakhadirakadarakālaskandhakramukabhūrjameṣaśṛṅgatiniśacandanakucandanaśiṃśapā- śirīṣāsanadhavārjunatālaśākanaktamālapūtīkāśvakarṇāgurūṇi kālīyakaṃ ceti ||8||
sālasārādirityeṣa gaṇaḥ kuṣṭhavināśanaḥ | mehapāṇḍvāmayaharaḥ kaphamedoviśoṣaṇaḥ ||9||
varuṇārtagalaśigrumadhuśigrutarkārīmeṣaśṛṅgīpūtīkanaktamālamoraṭāgnimanthasaireyakadvayabimbīvasukavasiracitraka- śatāvarībilvājaśṛṅgīdarbhā bṛhatīdvayaṃ ceti ||10||
varuṇādirgaṇo hyeṣa kaphamedonivāraṇaḥ | vinihanti śiraḥśūlagulmābhyantaravidradhīn ||11||
vīratarusahacaradvayadarbhavṛkṣādanīgundrānalakuśakāśāśmabhedakāgnimanthamoraṭāvasukavasirabhallūkakuraṇṭikendīvarakapotavaṅkāḥ śvadaṃṣṭrā ceti ||12||
vīratarvādirityeṣa gaṇo vātavikāranut | aśmarīśarkarāmūtrakṛcchrāghātarujāpahaḥ ||13||
lodhrasāvaralodhrapalāśakuṭannaṭāśokaphañjīkaṭphalailavālukaśallakījiṅginīkadambasālāḥ ‘kuṭannaṭaṃ kaivartamustakam’ iti cakraḥ kadalī ceti ||14||
eṣa rodhrādirityukto medaḥkaphaharo gaṇaḥ | yonidoṣaharaḥ stambhī varṇyo viṣavināśanaḥ ||15||
arkālarkakarañjadvayanāgadantīmayūrakabhārgīrāsnendrapuṣpīkṣudraśvetāmahāśvetāvṛścikālyalavaṇāstāpasavṛkṣaśceti ||16||
arkādiko gaṇo hyeṣa kaphamedoviṣāpahaḥ | kṛmikuṣṭhapraśamano viśeṣādvraṇaśodhanaḥ ||17||

surasāśvetasurasāphaṇijjhakārjakabhūstṛṇasugandhakasumukhakālamālakuṭherakakāsamardakṣavakakharapuṣpāviḍaṅgakaṭphala- surasīnirguṇḍīkulāhalondurukarṇikāphañjīprācībalakākamācyo ‘phaṇijjhakaḥ tīkṣṇaparṇāsaḥ, arjakaḥ śvetaparṇāsaḥ, kālamālaḥ kṛṣṇapuṣpaḥ parṇāsaḥ, kuṭherakaḥ parṇāsaḥ’ iti cakraḥ viṣamuṣṭikaśceti ||18||
surasādirgaṇo hyeṣa kaphahṛt kṛmisūdanaḥ | pratiśyāyāruciśvāsakāsaghno vraṇaśodhanaḥ ||19||
muṣkakapalāśadhavacitrakamadanavṛkṣakaśiṃśapāvajravṛkṣāstriphalā ‘muṣkako ghaṇṭāpāṭaliḥ’ iti cakraḥ ceti ||20||
muṣkakādirgaṇo hyeṣa medoghnaḥ śukradoṣahṛt | mehārśaḥpāṇḍurogāśmaśarkarānāśanaḥ paraḥ ||21||
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakaśṛṅgaveramaricahastipippalīhareṇukailājamodendrayavapāṭhājīrakasarṣapa- mahānimbaphalahiṅgubhārgīmadhurasātiviṣāvacāviḍaṅgāni kaṭurohiṇī ceti ||22||
pippalyādiḥ kaphaharaḥ pratiśyāyānilārucīḥ | nihanyāddīpano gulmaśūlaghnaścāmapācanaḥ ||23||

elātagarakuṣṭhamāṃsīdhyāmakatvakpatranāgapuṣpapriyaṅguhareṇukāvyāghranakhaśukticaṇḍāsthauṇeyakaśrīveṣṭaka- cocacorakavālukaguggulusarjarasaturuṣkakundurukāguruspṛkkośīrabhadradārukuṅkumāni punnāgakeśaraṃ ceti ||24||
elādiko vātakaphau nihanyādviṣameva ca | varṇaprasādanaḥ kaṇḍūpiḍakākoṭhanāśanaḥ ||25||
vacāmustātiviṣābhayābhadradārūṇi nāgakeśaraṃ ceti ||26||
haridrādāruharidrākalaśīkuṭajabījāni madhukaṃ ceti ||27||
etau vacāharidrādī gaṇau stanyaviśodhanau | āmātisāraśamanau viśeṣāddoṣapācanau ||28||
śyāmāmahāśyāmātrivṛddantīśaṅkhinītilvakakampillakaramyakakramukaputraśreṇīgavākṣī- rājavṛkṣakarañjadvayaguḍūcīsaptalācchagalāntrīsudhāḥ suvarṇakṣīrī ceti ||29||
uktaḥ śyāmādirityeṣa gaṇo gulmaviṣāpahaḥ | ānāhodaraviḍbhedī tathodāvartanāśanaḥ ||30||
bṛhatīkaṇṭakārikākuṭajaphalapāṭhā madhukaṃ ceti ||31||
pācanīyo bṛhatyādirgaṇaḥ pittānilāpahaḥ | kaphārocakahṛdrogamūtrakṛcchrarujāpahaḥ .. hṛllāsa... iti pā.||32||
paṭolacandanakucandanamūrvāguḍūcīpāṭhāḥ kaṭurohiṇī ceti ||33||
paṭolādirgaṇaḥ pittakaphārocakanāśanaḥ | jvaropaśamano vraṇyaśchardikaṇḍūviṣāpahaḥ ||34||
kākolīkṣīrakākolījīvakarṣabhakamudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇīmedāmahāmedācchinnaruhā karkaṭaśṛṅgītugākṣīrīpadmakaprapauṇḍarīkardhivṛddhimṛdvīkājīvantyo madhukaṃ ceti ||35||
kākolyādirayaṃ pittaśoṇitānilanāśanaḥ | jīvano bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ stanyaśleṣmakarastathā ||36||
ūṣakasaindhavaśilājatukāsīsadvayahiṅgūni tutthakaṃ ceti ||37||
ūṣakādiḥ kaphaṃ hanti gaṇo medoviśoṣaṇaḥ | aśmarīśarkarāmūtrakṛcchragulmapraṇāśanaḥ ‘śūlakagulmanut’ iti pā.||38||
sārivāmadhukacandanakucandanapadmakakāśmarīphalamadhūkapuṣpāṇyuśīraṃ ceti ||39||
sārivādiḥ pipāsāghno raktapittaharo gaṇaḥ | pittajvarapraśamano viśeṣāddāhanāśanaḥ ||40||
añjanarasāñjananāgapuṣpapriyaṅgunīlotpalanaladanalinakeśarāṇi madhukaṃ ceti ||41||
añjanādirgaṇo hyeṣa raktapittanibarhaṇaḥ | viṣopaśamano dāhaṃ nihantyābhyantaraṃ bhṛśam ||42||
parūṣakadrākṣākaṭphaladāḍimarājādanakatakaphalaśākaphalāni ‘parūṣakādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ, tena kaṭphalā gāmbhārī, tasyāḥ phalam’ iti cakraḥ triphalā ceti ||43||
parūṣakādirityeṣa gaṇo'nilavināśanaḥ | mūtradoṣaharo hṛdyaḥ pipāsāghno rucipradaḥ ||44||
priyaṅgusamaṅgādhātakīpunnāganāgapuṣpacandanakucandanamocarasarasāñjanakumbhīkasrotojapadmakesarayojanavallyo dīrghamūlā ceti ||45||
ambaṣṭhādhātakīkusumasamaṅgākaṭvaṅgamadhukabilvapeśikāsāvararodhrapalāśanandīvṛkṣāḥ padmakeśarāṇi ceti ||46||
gaṇau priyaṅgvambaṣṭhādī pakvātīsāranāśanau | sandhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānāṃ cāpi ropaṇau ||47||
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣamadhukakapītanakakubhāmrakośāmracorakapatrajambūdvayapriyāla- madhūkarohiṇīvañjulakadambabadarītindukīsallakīrodhrasāvararodhrabhallātakapalāśā nandīvṛkṣaśceti ||48||
nyagrodhādirgaṇo vraṇyaḥ saṅgrāhī bhagnasādhakaḥ | raktapittaharo dāhamedoghno yonidoṣahṛt ||49||
guḍūcīnimbakustumburucandanāni padmakaṃ ceti ||50||
eṣa sarvajvarān hanti guḍūcyādistu dīpanaḥ | hṛllāsārocakavamīpipāsādāhanāśanaḥ ||51||
utpalaraktotpalakumudasaugandhikakuvalayapuṇḍarīkāṇi madhukaṃ ceti ||52||
utpalādirayaṃ dāhapittaraktavināśanaḥ | pipāsāviṣahṛdrogacchardimūrcchāharo gaṇaḥ ||53||
mustāharidrādāruharidrāharītakyāmalakabibhītakakuṣṭhahaimavatīvacāpāṭhākaṭurohiṇīśārṅgaṣṭātiviṣādrāviḍībhallātakāni citrakaśceti ||54||
eṣa mustādiko nāmnā ‘mustādirākhyātaḥ’ iti pā. gaṇaḥ śleṣmaniṣūdanaḥ | yonidoṣaharaḥ stanyaśodhanaḥ pācanastathā ||55||
harītakyāmalakabibhītakānīti triphalā ||56||
triphalā kaphapittaghnī mehakuṣṭhavināśanī | cakṣuṣyā dīpanī caiva viṣamajvaranāśanī ||57||
pippalīmaricaśṛṅgaverāṇīti trikaṭukam ||58||
tryūṣaṇaṃ kaphamedoghnaṃ mehakuṣṭhatvagāmayān | nihanyāddīpanaṃ gulmapīnasāgnyalpatāmapi ||59||
āmalakīharītakīpippalyaścitrakaśceti ||60||
āmalakyādirityeṣa gaṇaḥ sarvajvarāpahaḥ | cakṣuṣyo dīpano vṛṣyaḥ kaphārocakanāśanaḥ ||61||
trapusīsatāmrarajatasuvarṇakṛṣṇalohāni lohamalaśceti ||62||
gaṇastrapvādirityeṣa garakrimiharaḥ paraḥ | pipāsāviṣahṛdrogapāṇḍumehaharastathā ||63||
lākṣārevatakuṭajāśvamārakaṭphalaharidrādvayanimbasaptacchadamālatyastrāyamāṇā ceti ||64||
kaṣāyatiktamadhuraḥ kaphapittārtināśanaḥ | kuṣṭhakrimiharaścaiva duṣṭavraṇaviśodhanaḥ ||65||

pañca pañcamūlānyata ‘pañcasu pañcamūleṣu mūlānīti vacanānmūlameva paraṃ grāhyam| iti cakraḥ| ‘pañca pañcakān vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | - tatra trikaṇṭakabṛhatīdvayapṛthakparṇyo vidārigandhā ceti kanīyaḥ ||66||
kaṣāyatiktamadhuraṃ kanīyaḥ pañcamūlakam | vātaghnaṃ pittaśamanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanam ||67||
bilvāgnimanthaṭiṇṭukapāṭalāḥ kāśmarī ceti mahat ||68||
satiktaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ pāke laghvagnidīpanam | madhurānurasaṃ caiva pañcamūlaṃ mahat smṛtam ||69||
anayordaśamūlamucyate ||70||
gaṇaḥ śvāsaharo hyeṣa kaphapittānilāpahaḥ | āmasya pācanaścaiva sarvajvaravināśanaḥ ||71||
vidārīsārivārajanīguḍūcyo'jaśṛṅgī ceti vallīsañjñaḥ ||72||
karamardītrikaṇṭakasairīyakaśatāvarīgṛdhranakhya iti kaṇṭakasañjñaḥ ||73||
raktapittaharau hyetau śophatrayavināśanau | sarvamehaharau caiva śukradoṣavināśanau ||74||
kuśakāśanaladarbhakāṇḍekṣukā iti tṛṇasañjñakaḥ ||75||
mūtradoṣavikāraṃ ca raktapittaṃ tathaiva ca | antyaḥ prayuktaḥ kṣīreṇa śīghrameva vināśayet ||76||
eṣāṃ vātaharāvādyāvantyaḥ pittavināśanaḥ | pañcakau śleṣmaśamanāvitarau parikīrtitau ||77||
trivṛtādikamanyatropadekṣyāmaḥ ||78||

div.ab: samāsena gaṇā hyete proktāsteṣāṃ tu vistaram | cikitsiteṣu vakṣyāmi, ... |79|

ab.seg: ... jñātvā doṣabalābalam ||79||
ebhirlepān kaṣāyāṃśca tailaṃ sarpīṃṣi pānakān | pravibhajya yathānyāyaṃ kurvīta matimān bhiṣak ||80||
dhūmavarṣānilakledaiḥ sarvartuṣvanabhidrute | grāhayitvā gṛhe nyasyedvidhinauṣadhasaṅgraham ||81||

samīkṣya doṣabhedāṃśca ‘doṣabhedena doṣābhinno vyādhirapi grāhyaḥ| bhinnāniti bhinnatvenoktān| pṛthagiti pratyekam| miśrāniti gaṇāntaramiśrān| samastāniti dvitryādīn| yaduktamanyatra ‘vargamapi vargeṇa yojayedekenānekena vā’ iti| vyastamiti tricaturādirahitaṃ, saṃhatamiti militam| ayaṃ cārtho miśrakokto'pi punaḥ prakaraṇādabhidhīyata iti na paunaruktyam’ iti cakraḥ bhinnān miśrān bhinnān prayojayet | pṛthaṅmiśrān samastānvā gaṇaṃ vā vyastasaṃhatam ||82||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dravyasaṅgrahaṇīyo nāmāṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||38||
athātaḥ saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

madanakuṭajajīmūtakekṣvākudhāmārgavakṛtavedhanasarṣapaviḍaṅgapippalīkarañjaprapunnāḍa kovidārakarbudārāriṣṭāśvagandhāvidulabandhujīvakaśvetāśaṇapuṣpībimbīvacāmṛgervāravaścitrā cetyūrdhvabhāgaharāṇi | tatra, kovidārapūrvāṇāṃ phalāni, kovidārādīnāṃ mūlāni ||3||

vivṛtāśyāmādantīdravantīsaptalāśaṅkhinīviṣāṇikāgavākṣīcchagalāntrīsnuksu varṇakṣīrīcitrakakiṇihīkuśakāśatilvakakampillakaramyakapāṭalāpūgaharītakyā malakabibhītakanīlinīcaturaṅgulairaṇḍapūtīkamahāvṛkṣasaptacchadārkā jyotiṣmatī cetyadhobhāgaharāṇi | tatra tilvakapūrvāṇāṃ mūlāni ‘mūlavarge snuhīpāṭhānmūlamapi snuhyā gṛhyate, kṣīravarge pāṭhācca kṣīramapi| kampillakastu tvagvarge pāṭhāttvacā grāhya eva, paraṃ vaidyavyavahārāccarakavacanācca tasya phalarajo gṛhyate| uktaṃ hi carake ‘kampillakāragvadhayoḥ phalaṃ yat kuṭajasya ca’ (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| āragvadhasya patraṃ virecanaṃ, carakavacanāt phalaṃ ca| pūtikasya tu patraṃ virecanamuktaṃ, carake tu ‘pūtikaḥ kṛṣṇagandhā ca’ ityādinā tvak pradhānamuktā, teneha prayogeṣu grahītavyā| kośātakyādīnāṃ svarasā ubhayabhāgaharāḥ| phalaṃ tu kośātakīdevadālyorvāmanamuktam’ iti cakraḥ, tilvakādīnāṃ pāṭalāntānāṃ tvacaḥ, kampillakaphalarajaḥ, pūgādīnāmeraṇḍāntānāṃ phalāni, pūtīkāragvadhayoḥ patrāṇi, śeṣāṇāṃ kṣīrāṇīti ||4||
kośātakī saptalā śaṅkhinī devadālī kāravellikā cetyubhayatobhāgaharāṇi | eṣāṃ svarasā iti ||5||

pippalīviḍaṅgāpāmārgaśigrusiddhārthakaśirīṣamaricakaravīrabimbīgirikarṇikākiṇihīvacājyotiṣmatī- karañjārkālarkalaśunātiviṣāśṛṅgaveratālīśatamālasurasārjakeṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgīmātuluṅgīmuraṅgīpīlu- jātīśālatālamadhūkalākṣāhiṅgulavaṇamadyagośakṛdrasamūtrāṇīti ‘hiṅgvādīnāṃ mūlāntānāṃ svarūpakathanena sarvāṅgaprayogaṃ darśayati’ iti cakraḥ śirovirecanāni | tatra karavīrapūrvāṇāṃ phalāni, karavīrādīnāmarkāntānāṃ mūlāni, tālīśapūrvāṇāṃ kandāḥ, tālīśādīnāmarjakāntānāṃ patrāṇi, iṅgudīmeṣaśṛṅgyostvacaḥ, mātuluṅgīmuraṅgīpīlujātīnāṃ puṣpāṇi, śālatālamadhūkānāṃ sārāḥ, hiṅgulākṣe niryāsau, lavaṇāni pārthivaviśeṣāḥ; madyānyāsutasaṃyogāḥ, śakṛdrasamūtre ‘gomūtraśakṛdrasau’ iti pā. malāviti ||6||

saṃśamanānyata ‘saṃśamanaṃ nāma yaddoṣaṃ doṣagrahaṇagṛhītaṃ ca vyādhiṃ saṃśodhanaṃ vinā kṣapayati, samaṃ ca nodīrayati’ iti cakraḥ ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- tatra bhadradārukuṣṭhaharidrāvaruṇameṣaśṛṅgībalātibalārtagalakacchurāśallakīkuberākṣīvīratarusahacarāgnimantha- vatsādanyeraṇḍāśmabhedakālarkārkaśatāvarīpunarnavāvasukavaśirakāñcanakabhārgīkārpāsīvṛścikālīpattūrabadarayavakolakulatthaprabhṛtīni vidārigandhādiśca dve cādye pañcamūlyau samāsena vātasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||7||

candanakucandanahrīberośīramañjiṣṭhāpayasyāvidārīśatāvarīgundrāśaivalakahlārakumudotpalakanda(da)līdūrvāmūrvāprabhṛtīni kākolyādiḥ sārivādirañjanādirutpalādirnyagrodhādistṛṇapañcamūlamiti samāsena pittasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||8||

kāleyakāgurutilaparṇīkuṣṭhaharidrāśītaśivaśatapuṣpāsaralārāsnāprakīryodakīryeṅgudīsumanā- kākādanīlāṅgalakīhastikarṇamuñjātakalāmajjakaprabhṛtīni vallīkaṇṭakapañcamūlyau pippalyādirbṛhatyādirmuṣkakādirvacādiḥ surasādirāragvadhādiriti samāsena śleṣmasaṃśamano vargaḥ ||9||

tatra sarvāṇyevauṣadhāni ‘sarvāṇīti saṃśodhanāni saṃśamanāni ca| vyādhiśabdenātra doṣasyāpi grahaṇāddoṣabalamapyavekṣyam| tatra vyādherdoṣasya balatvaṃ hetubāhulyālliṅgabāhulyācca, durbalatvaṃ tadviparyayāt| agnerbalatvaṃ guruvṛṣyādijaraṇaśaktyā, ucitāhārapākāśaktyā durbalatvam| dehabalaṃ ca vyāyāmena, viparyayeṇa daurbalyam| upacayāpacayābhyāṃ ca dehabalaṃ jñeyam| puruṣagrahaṇena manaso balābale api grāhye| anyavyādhimiti atiyogajanyavyādhiṃ doṣaṃ vā| madāḥ śarīramanobalabhraṃśakṛtā jñeyāḥ| atipātayatīti atidoṣapātanaṃ karoti| saṃśamanāpekṣayā saṃśodhanamatiyuktamativyāpattikaraṃ bhavatyeva| vyādhyapekṣayā hi prādhānyena bheṣajamātrā| sā tu samyakpākārthamagnibalaṃ puruṣabalaṃ cāpekṣate| nanu, uktadoṣapramāṇānurūpo hi bheṣajapramāṇavikalpo balapramāṇāpekṣo bhavati, tataśca hīnamebhyo dattamiti bahuvacanamanupapannam? naivaṃ, bahuvacanaṃ tāvadbalavati vyādhau tathā balavatorvyādhipuruṣabalayostathā balavatsu vyādhipuruṣāgniṣu, ityādivikalpabahutvādapyupapannaṃ| kintu vyādhibalamātrasamaṃ bheṣajaṃ balavatyagnau puruṣe vā alpamātratayā upayuktaṃ sat tayorbalenābhipūyālpaśaktikaṃ kriyate, tena vyādhimapi na tathā śamayati, tena hīnamebhya iti bahuvacanamupapannam’ iti cakraḥ vyādhyagnipuruṣabalānyabhisamīkṣya vidadhyāt | tatra, vyādhibalādadhikamauṣadhamupayuktaṃ tamupaśamya vyādhiṃ vyādhimanyamāvahati; agnibalādadhikamajīrṇaṃ viṣṭabhya vā pacyate; puruṣabalādadhikaṃ glānimūrcchāmadānāvahati saṃśamanam; evaṃ saṃśodhanamatipātayati | hīnamebhyo dattamakiñcitkaraṃ bhavati | tasmāt samameva vidadhyāt ||10||

bhavanti cātra- roge śodhanasādhye tu yo bhaveddoṣadurbalaḥ | tasmai dadyādbhiṣak cakrastu ‘taṃ samīkṣya bhiṣagdadyāt’ iti paṭhati vyākhyānayati ca- ‘samīkṣyeti samyagbalaṃ nirūpya’ iti prājño doṣapracyāvānaṃ mṛdu ||11||
cale doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe nekṣetātra balaṃ nṛṇām | avyādhidurbalasyāpi śodhanaṃ hi tadā bhavet ||12||
svayaṃ pravṛttadoṣasya mṛdukoṣṭhasya śodhanam | bhavedalpabalasyāpi prayuktaṃ vyādhināśanam ||13||
vyādhyādiṣu tu madhyeṣu kvāthasyāñjaliriṣyate | biḍālapadakaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaḥ kalko'kṣasammitaḥ ||14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne saṃśodhanasaṃśamanīyo nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39||
athāto dravyarasaguṇavīryavipākavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

kecidācāryā ‘dravyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ prādhānyamekīyamatena darśayituṃ dravyasya prādhānye prathamaṃ sahetukamekīyamatamāha- kecidityādi| etaccaikīyamatopadarśanaṃ samyagdravyādisvabhāvajñānārtham, abhiniviṣṭo hi vādī svapakṣasādhanārthaṃ svarūpaṃ prādhānyakhyāpakaṃ darśayati, tena cānte vakṣyamāṇācāryasiddhāntasahitena samyagarthapratītirbhavati| vyavasthitatvāditi avasthābhedena rasādibhede'pi dravyasya vyavasthitatvāt| yathā- āmraphalaṃ prathamaṃ kaṣāyāmlaṃ, madhye'mlaṃ, tato madhuram, evaṃ rasāvyavasthāne'pi dravyamātrarūpatayā vyavasthitatvam| nityatvācceti nityatvaṃ rasādināśe'pyavasthitatvamiha jñeyaṃ, vyavasthitatvaṃ tu rasānyathātve tadrūpatayā vyavasthitatvamiti bhedaḥ| kālādītyatrādiśabdena jalavātādayo gṛhyante| svajātyavasthānāditi pariṇāme'pi dravyaṃ svajātāvavatiṣṭhate na jātyantaraṃ bhavati, pārthivaṃ tu pārthivameva yadāpyaṃ tadāpyamevetyādisvajātyaparityāgaḥ| rasastu kṣīramadhuratvaṃ parityajyāmlatāṃ yātītyanusaraṇīyaṃ, jātiśceha pārthivatvādirūpā vyavasthitā'bhipretā, tena kṣīrasya dadhitvaṃ guḍasya śarkarātvamityādijātibhedo nodbhavanīyaḥ| pañcendriyagrahaṇādityatra pañcabhirindriyairdravyaṃ gṛhyate iti cakṣuṣā sparśanena tāvaddravyagrahaṇamavivādasiddhameva| ghrāṇarasanāśrotrāṇāmapi surabhi candanaṃ, madhuraḥ koṣakāraḥ, tathā susvarā vīṇetyādi sāmānādhikaraṇyajñānena dravyagrahaṇaṃ prati sphuṭataravyāpārād dravyagrāhakatvaṃ jñeyam| āśrayatvācceti rasādīnāṃ dravyamāśrayaḥ, tenāśritā rasādayaḥ paratantratvādapradhānāḥ, āśrayastu pradhānamityarthaḥ| kasmādrasādīnāmekadeśena vyādhayo na sādhyanta ityāha- niravayavatvāditi| kriyāvadguṇavat samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyamiti kriyā karma, guṇā rasādayaḥ, samavāyikāraṇaṃ svasamavetakāryajanakam| ete kriyādayo rasādau vyāvṛtā itīhoktāḥ| sarvadravyavyāpakavijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ tu lakṣaṇamiha- kriyāguṇavattvameva| etadeva hi kriyāguṇayoryathākramaṃ dravyaṃ vyāpya kriyā dravye vidyate, guṇāḥ samavayantīti| vidyate iti sattāmātraṃ vyāptiḥ, samavayantīti vyāpya dravyamavatiṣṭhante, nahi nirguṇaṃ dravyaṃ kiñcidastīti’ iti cakraḥ bruvate- dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kasmāt? vyavasthitatvāt, iha khalu dravyaṃ vyavasthitaṃ na rasādayaḥ, yathā ‘tathāhi’ iti pā. āme phale ye rasādayaste pakve na santi; nityatvācca, nityaṃ hi dravyamanityā guṇāḥ, yathā kalkādipravibhāgaḥ, sa eva sampannarasagandho vyāpannarasagandho ‘vyāpannarasagandha’ iti pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate, ḍalhaṇenāpi na vyākhyātaḥ| ‘yathā- kālādipravibhāgāttadeva sampannarasagandhaṃ vyāpannarasagandhaṃ vā bhavati’ iti cakrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ vā bhavati; svajātyavasthānācca, yathā hi pārthivaṃ dravyamanyabhāvaṃ na gacchatyevaṃ śeṣāṇi; pañcendriyagrahaṇāśca, pañcabhirindriyairgṛhyate dravyaṃ na rasādayaḥ; āśrayatvācca, dravyamāśritā rasādayaḥ; ārambhasāmarthyācca, dravyāśrita ārambhaḥ, yathā- ‘vidārigandhādimāhṛtya saṅkṣudya vipacet’ ityevamādiṣu na rasādiṣvārambhaḥ; śāstraprāmāṇyācca, śāstre hi dravyaṃ pradhānamupadeśe yogānāṃ, yathā- ‘mātuluṅgāgnimanthau ca’ ityādau na rasādaya upadiśyante; kramāpekṣitatvācca rasādīnāṃ, rasādayo hi dravyakramamapekṣante, yathā- taruṇe taruṇāḥ sampūrṇe sampūrṇā iti; ekadeśasādhyatvācca, dravyāṇāmekadeśenāpi vyādhayaḥ sādhyante, yathā- mahāvṛkṣakṣīreṇeti; tasmāddravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, na rasādayaḥ, kasmāt? niravayavatvāt | dravyalakṣaṇaṃ tu ‘kriyāguṇavat samavāyikāraṇam’ iti ||3||

netyāhuranye ‘dravyādapi rasaprādhānyaṃ darśayituṃ dravyaprādhānyaṃ niṣedhayati- netyāhuranye iti| ete dravyaprādhānyakhyāpakā hetavo vaktavyarasaprādhānyahetvapekṣayā aprayojakā ityabhimāno rasavādino jñeyaḥ| evaṃ vīryavādinastathā vipākavādinaśca ‘netyāhuranye’ iti vacanamanayā diśā vyākhyeyam| rasaprādhānye āgamāditi hetuḥ āgama eva kaṇṭharaveṇa rasasya prādhānyaṃ kathayatītyāhuḥ| upadeśāditi tu rasena dravyādisamudāyakāryopadeśādityarthabhedo neyaḥ| ṛṣivacanamiha vedaḥ| ṛṣaya āptāḥ| tadvacanatā ca vedasya ṛṣibhiḥ prathamamudāharaṇāt, na tu ṛṣikāryatayā| kiṃvā nyāyamate maheśvararūparṣivacanatā vedasya jñeyā| dravyādiprādhānyavicāre kasmādguṇa nodbhāvitā ityāha- raseṣu tu guṇasañjñeti| raseṣvityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena vīryavipākayorapi guṇasañjñeti boddhavyaṃ, tena rasādiprādhānyavyutpādanena guṇaviśeṣaprādhānyaṃ labhyata ityarthaḥ|’ iti cakraḥ, rasāstu pradhānaṃ; kasmāt? āgamāt, āgamo hi śāstramucyate; śāstre hi rasā adhikṛtāḥ, yathā- rasāyatta āhāra iti, tasmiṃstu prāṇāḥ; upadeśācca, upadiśyante hi rasāḥ, yathā- madhurāmlalavaṇā vātaṃ śamayanti; anumānācca, rasena hyanumīyate dravyaṃ, yathā- madhuramiti; ṛṣivacanācca, ṛṣivacanaṃ vedo yathā- kiñcidijyārthaṃ madhuramāharediti, tasmādrasāḥ pradhānaṃ; raseṣu guṇasañjñā | rasalakṣaṇamanyatropadekṣyāmaḥ ||4||

netyāhuranye ‘vīryaprādhānyavādimatamāha- netyāhuranye ityādi| prādhānyāditi pradhānadharmayogāt, pradhānadharmaśca vīryavaśenauṣadhānāṃ kāryaniṣpādakatvam| atra vīryaśabdena dravyasya dvividhā'pi cintyā acintyā ca śaktirucyate| tatrācintyā śaktiryā tantrāntare prabhāva ityucyate sā grāhyā, tasyaiva ca vīryasya prabhāvākhyasya svatantre ‘taddravyamātmanā kiñcit’ ityanena grahaṇaṃ jñeyam| rasasya vipākasya ca śāstre pṛthaṅnirdeśānna vīryavyavahāraḥ, pariṇāmasaṅkhyādayo guṇā na śāstre tathā kāryakarā iti pṛthaktvena dravyarasādigaṇanāyāṃ gaṇyante| cintyāyāṃ vaidyasampradāyena śītoṣṇalakṣaṇaṃ dvividhamaṣṭavidhaṃ vā uṣṇaśītasnigdharūkṣaviśadapicchilamṛdutīkṣṇarūpamucyate| yadā dvividhaṃ vīryaṃ tadā snigdharūkṣādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi pariṇāmasaṅkhyādivadaprādhānyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ jñeyam| snigdhādīnāmaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ rasādidharmatayaiva kāryagrahaṇaṃ| vakṣyati hi- ‘madhuro rasaḥ snigdhaḥ’ ityādi| aṣṭavidhavīryapakṣe tūṣṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāmeva balavatkāryakartṛvivakṣayā vīryatvamiti sthitiḥ| samprati śāstre vyavahārasiddhameva vīryaṃ vivecayannāha- tattu vīryamityādi| kathametānyuṣṇādīni vīryākhyānītyāha- etāni khalvityādi| svabalaguṇotkarṣāditi balaṃ śaktiḥ, sa eva guṇaḥ praśastatvāt| svaśaktirūpaguṇotkarṣāduṣṇādīni rasamabhibhūya svakāryaṃ kurvanti|’ iti cakraḥ| ‘vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, sā ca pṛthivyādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ yaḥ sārabhāgastadatiśayarūpā bodhyā| sā ca dvividhā, cintyācintyakriyāhetutvena| tatra cintyakriyāheturyā dravyarasādīnāṃ svasvakarmaṇi svabhāvasiddhā śaktiḥ, acintyakriyāhetuśca prabhāvāparaparyāyā dravyāṇāṃ rasādyananurūpakāryakāraṇaśaktiḥ| uktaṃ ca- “bhūtaprasādātiśayo dravye pāke rase sthitaḥ| cintyācintyakriyāheturvīryaṃ dhanvantarermatam”- iti| etena dravyarasapākānāṃ svasvakāryakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ vīryamityarthaḥ| yatpunaścarake- “vīryaṃ tu kriyate yena yā kriyā”- (ca. sū. a. 26) ityanena rasādīnāmapi vīryatvamuktaṃ, taddharmadharmiṇorabhedādeva samarthanīyam| na caivaṃ dravyasyāpi vīryatvaprasaṅgaḥ| yeneti karaṇe tṛtīyā, karaṇasyaiva śaktitvāt, dravyasya ca kartṛtvāt| etena dravyakartṛke rasādikaraṇake kārye rasādīnāmapi vīryatvamityarthaḥ| suśrute'pyuktaṃ- “yena kurvanti tadvīryam”- (su. sū. a. 41) iti| atra kecit- nanu, yadi śaktireva vīrya na tarhi śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇam, atha śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇaṃ na tadā śaktilakṣaṇamiti| satyaṃ, paramārthataḥ śaktireva vīryaṃ, sā punarbalavatkriyānirvartanakṣamā rasādinā'yogānnirupādhiriti tasyāḥ śītoṣṇādayo guṇā upādhitvenāṅgīkṛtāḥ, te tu dravyasamavāyino rasādiṣu punarupacaritavṛttaya iti| uktaṃ ca- “guṇāḥ karmavyavasthāyai dravyāṇāṃ rasapākayoḥ| śakteḥ karmasu śaktā ye nirupādherupādhayaḥ”- ityāhuḥ| yatpunaḥ “mṛdutīkṣṇagurulaghusnigdharūkṣoṣṇaśītalam| vīryamaṣṭavidhaṃ kecit keciddvividhamāsthitāḥ|| śītoṣṇamiti” (ca. sū. a. 26)- iti matabhedenāṣṭavidhaṃ dvividhaṃ vā vīryamityuktaṃ carakeṇa, tatpāribhāṣikavīryapuraskāreṇa| vaidyake hi rasavipākaprabhāvātirikte prabhūtakāryakāriṇi guṇe vīryamiti sañjñā| tenāṣṭavidhavīryavādimate picchilaviśadādayo guṇā na rasādiviparītaṃ kāryaṃ prāyaḥ kurvantīti teṣāṃ rasādyupadeśenaiva grahaṇaṃ| mṛdvādīnāmaṣṭānāṃ tu rasādyabhibhāvakatvamasti| suśrute'pyuktam- “etāni khalu vīryāṇi svabalaguṇotkarṣādrasamabhibhūyātmakarma kurvanti”- (su. sū. a. 40) iti| śītoṣṇavīryavādimataṃ tvagnīṣomīyatvājjagataḥ śītoṣṇayoreva prādhānyājjñeyam| uktaṃ ca- “nānātmakamapi dravyagnīṣomau mahābalau| vyaktāvyaktaṃ jagadiva nātikramati jātucit”- (vā. sū. a. 9) iti| prathamavādimate śaktimātraṃ vīryaṃ, tadyogādrasādīnāmapi vīryasañjñā| pāribhāṣikavīryavādimate tu śaktiviśeṣo vīryaṃ, tadyogānmṛdutīkṣṇādīnāmeva vīryasañjñā nāpareṣāṃ guṇānāmiti| śāstre vyavahārastu pāribhāṣikavīryanayenaiveti| bhavanti cātra- “śaktimātraṃ tu vīryaṃ syāditi kecidbudhā viduḥ| tanmate dravyarasayoḥ pākasya ca guṇasya ca|| mṛdvādeḥ svakriyotpāde śaktivīryamiti sthitiḥ| taduktaṃ carake- ‘vīryaṃ kriyate yena yā kriyā|| nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā kriyā’| ityanena rasādīnāṃ vīryatvaṃ tadabhedataḥ|| mṛdvādayo guṇā hyaṣṭau vīryāṇītyūcire pare| yasmāt sarvaguṇotkṛṣṭāḥ śaktyutkarṣayutā amī|| vyavahāropayuktāśca nedṛśāstvapare guṇāḥ| tasmānna te vīryasañjñā iti śāstravidāṃ matam|| anye śītoṣṇabhedena vīryaṃ dvividhamūcire| agnīṣomamayaṃ viśvaṃ yata etaccarācaram”- iti| prabhāvo'cintyakriyāhetuvīryameveti śaktiviśeṣa eva prabhāva ityabhidhīyate| prabhāvasattve ca carake mānamapyuktam| yathā- “rasavīryavipākanāṃ sāmānyaṃ yatra lakṣyate| viśeṣaḥ karmaṇāṃ caiva prabhāvastasya sa smṛtaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 26) iti| sāmānyamiti tulyatā, karmaṇāṃ punarviśeṣo na tulyatetyarthaḥ| etena dravyayordvayo rasādisāmye satyapyekasmin dravye jāyate kāryaviśeṣaḥ, itaratra tu na jāyate, ityatra yatkāraṇatayā vācyaṃ tadeva prabhāva ityarthaḥ| tathā rasādisāmyabhāve'pi rasādijanyatvena yatkāryaṃ nāvadhārayituṃ pāryate tadapi prabhāvakṛtameva mantavyaṃ| yathā- maṇyādīnāṃ viṣaharaṇādikaṃ karma” iti dravyaguṇasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāṃ śivadāsasenaḥ| “vīryaṃ punarvadantyeke guru snigdhaṃ himaṃ mṛdu| laghurūkṣoṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ ca tadevaṃ matamaṣṭadhā|| carakastvāha vīryaṃ tat kriyate yena yā kriyā| nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā hi sā|| gurvādiṣveva vīryākhyā tenānvartheti varṇyate| samagraguṇasāreṣu śaktyutkarṣavivartiṣu|| vyavahārāya mukhyatvādbahvagragrahaṇādapi| ataśca viparītatvāt sambhavatyapi naiva sā|| vivakṣyate rasādyeṣu vīryaṃ gurvādayo hyataḥ|” iti vāgbhaṭaḥ (vā. sū. a. 9), vīryaṃ pradhānamiti | kasmāt? tadvaśenauṣadhakarmaniṣpatteḥ | ihauṣadhakarmāṇyūrdhvādhobhāgobhayabhāgasaṃśodhanasaṃśamanasaṅgrāhikāgnidīpanapīḍanalekhanabṛṃhaṇa- rasāyanavājīkaraṇaśvayathukaravilayanadahanadāraṇamādanaprāṇaghnaviṣapraśamanādīni vīryaprādhānyādbhavanti | tacca vīryaṃ dvividhamuṣṇaṃ śītaṃ ca, agnīṣomīyatvājjagataḥ | kecidaṣṭavidhamāhuḥ- śītamuṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ viśadaṃ ‘guru laghu’ iti hārāṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| “neha gurulaghuśabdāvartanena viśadapicchilayoḥ pāṭho nyāyyaḥ, śāstre'smin kvacidapi tayorvīryatvenānupadeśādupadeśācca gurulaghunoḥ| vakṣyati ca ‘ye rasā’ ityupakramya ‘raukṣyalāghavaśaityāni na te hanyuḥ samīraṇam’ ityādi’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ picchilaṃ mṛdu tīkṣṇaṃ ceti | etāni vīryāṇi svabalaguṇotkarṣādrasamabhibhūyātmakarma kurvanti | yathā tāvanmahatpañcamūlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tiktānurasaṃ vātaṃ śamayati, uṣṇavīryatvāt; tathā kulatthaḥ kaṣāyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ palāṇḍuḥ, snehabhāvācca; madhuraścekṣuraso vātaṃ vardhayati, śītavīryatvāt; kaṭukā pippalī pittaṃ śamayati, mṛduśītavīryatvāt; amlamāmalakaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ ca; tiktā kākamācī pittaṃ vardhayati, uṣṇavīryatvāt, madhurā matsyāśca; kaṭukaṃ mūlakaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ vardhayati, snigdhavīryatvāt; amlaṃ kapitthaṃ śleṣmāṇāṃ śamayati, rūkṣavīryatvāt, madhuraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca; tadetannidarśanamātramuktam ||5||
bhavanti cātra- ye rasā vātaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai | raukṣyalāghavaśaityāni na te hanyuḥ samīraṇam ||6||
ye rasāḥ pittaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai | taikṣṇyauṣṇyalaghutāścaiva na te tatkarmakāriṇaḥ ||7||
ye rasāḥ śleṣmaśamanā bhavanti yadi teṣu vai | snehagauravaśaityāni na te tatkarmakāriṇaḥ ||8||
tasmādvīryaṃ pradhānamiti ||9||

netyāhuranye ‘idānīṃ vipākaguṇā vācyāḥ, ato vipākasvarūpaṃ nirūpyate- avasthāpākāpekṣayā viśiṣṭaḥ pāko vipākaḥ| vipākaśabdeneha lakṣaṇayā vipākādheya āhārasya rasaviśeṣo gauraveṇa lāghavena vā yukto'bhidhīyate| uktaṃ ca vāgbhaṭena- “jāṭhareṇāgninā yogādyadudeti rasāntaram| rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ”- (vā. sū. a. 9) iti| atra rasānāṃ pariṇāmā madhurāmlakaṭurūpāstrayo'vasthāpākāḥ ṣaḍrasasyaivānnasyāmāśayādisthānasambandhamahimnā jāyante, te ca carake grahaṇīcikitsite “annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ” (ca. ci. a. 15) ityādinoktā anusandheyāḥ, teṣāmante'vasāne punarjāṭharāgnisaṃyoge sati yadrasāntaraṃ rasaviśeṣa udeti sa vipāka ityarthaḥ| carakeṇa tu traya eva vipākā aṅgīkṛtāḥ kaṭvamlamadhurabhedena| atastadvacanamupanyasyate- “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ| amlo'mlaṃ pacyate svādurmadhuraṃ lavaṇastathā”- iti (ca. sū. a. 26)| prāyaśa iti vacanāt pippalīkulatthādīnāṃ rasānanuguṇapākatāṃ darśayati| pākastu tejaḥsaṃyogarūpo raseṣu na sambhavatīti kaṭvādiśabdaistadādhāradravyāṇyucyante| etena yat kaiściducyate- “avasthāpākāvasāne ṣaḍrasasyaivānnasya kaṭurasatvena tadānīṃ tiktādirasānāmabhāvātteṣāṃ vipāko nopapadyate” iti| tadapyapāstaṃ, tiktādirasānāmabhāve'pi tadāśrayadravyasya vidyamānatvāditi| vastutastu, avasthāpākatrayeṇa tattadāmāśayādisthānamahimnā madhurāmlakaṭurasā udbhūtāḥ paraṃ kriyante, na tu sarvathā prākṛtarasābhibhavaḥ| anyathā'vasthāpākena prākṛtānāṃ madhurādirasānāṃ sarvathā'prākṛtatve teṣāṃ kaphādijanakatvābhidhānaṃ niravakāśaṃ syāditi| nanu, carake- “annasya bhuktamātrasya ṣaḍrasasya prapākataḥ” (ca. ci. a. 15)- ityādinā ṣaṇṇāmeva rasānāmaviśeṣeṇāvasthāpākavaśāt kaphādijanakatvamuktaṃ, tataścātra rasaviśeṣāṇāmeva doṣaviśeṣajanakatvamuktaṃ, tathā “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ”- (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinā ca yo vipāka uktastat sarvaṃ virudhyate, avasthāpākenaiva bādhitatvāditi| naivaṃ, nahyavasthāpāko'yaṃ rasasvabhāvaṃ niṣṭhāpākaṃ bādhate, kiñcāvasthāyāṃ svakāryaṃ karoti| tena rasādayo'pi svakāryaṃ kurvanti, avasthāpāko'pi svīyaṃ kāryaṃ karoti, yathā- madhuratiktādyanekarase upayukte madhuro'pi svakāryaṃ karoti, tiktādayaśca svakāryaṃ kurvanti| ayaṃ tu viśeṣo- yadi madhurākhyasyāvasthāpākasya madhurādayaḥ śleṣmajanakā rasā anuguṇā bhavanti, tadā sa bahuśleṣmāṇaṃ janayati, yadā tu viparītakaṭukādiparigṛhīto bhavati, tadā stokamātraṃ kaphaṃ janayati| evaṃ pittajanakāvasthāpāke'pi vācyam| “kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ” (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinoktaśca niṣṭhāpāko rasamalavivekasamakālo, bhinnakāla evāvasthāpākaiḥ samamiti na virodhaḥ| sa ca bhinnakālo'pyavasthāpākajanyadoṣānuguṇatayā ananuguṇatayā vā'vasthāpākāhitadoṣāṇāṃ vardhanaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ vā karotīti niṣṭhāpākābhidhānaṃ śāstre prayojanavadeva| anye tvāhuḥ- yat- nānnasyāgnisaṃyogānmadhurādyavasthitaṃ bhavati, kintu kaphādisthāneṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ svabhāvādeva madhurādayo rasāstiṣṭhanti, te cānnaṃ svasvabhāvaṃ nītvā kaphādīn janayanti| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare- “madhuro hṛdayādūrdhvaṃ rasaḥ koṣṭhe vyavasthitaḥ| tataḥ saṃvardhate śleṣmā śarīrabalavardhanaḥ|| nābhihṛdayamadhye hi rasastvamlo vyavasthitaḥ| svabhāvena manuṣyāṇāṃ tatra pittaṃ vivardhate|| adho nābhyāstu khalvekaḥ kaṭuko'vasthito rasaḥ| prāyaḥ śreṣṭhatamastatra prāṇināṃ vardhate'nilaḥ|| tasmādvipākastrividho rasānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ” iti| etacca tantrāntaraṃ śleṣmapittagatamadhurāmlarasavāyuprābhāvikakaṭurasābhiprāyeṇa varṇanīyam| te ca kaphādigatā rasā asmākamapyagnyāśayapākasahakāritayā'numatā eva, tasmādyathokta evārtho nyāyya iti| ayaṃ ca vipākādheyo (raso) na rasanendriyagrāhyaḥ, kintu tattatkāryeṇaivonnīyate| yathā- kaṭurasāyā uṣṇavīryāyā api śuṇṭhyā vṛṣyatvena madhuraḥ pāko'numīyate, tathā lavaṇasya sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratvena madhuraḥ pāka unnīyate, tathā tiktakaṣāyayorbaddhaviṇmūtratayā kaṭupāka unnīyata iti| nanu, lavaṇasya madhurapākitve pittaraktādikartṛtvamanupapannaṃ, tathā tiktakaṣāyayoḥ kaṭupākitve ca pittahantṛtvamanupapannam| naivaṃ, satyapi lavaṇasya madhurapākitve tatra lavaṇe uṣṇavīryaṃ yadasti tena tasya pittaraktādikārakatvaṃ, vipākastu tatra pittaraktakaraṇalakṣaṇe kārye bādhito'pi sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādilakṣaṇe lakṣyata eva, tathā tiktakaṣāyayorapi kaṭuvipāko balavatā śītavīryeṇa bādhitatvānna pittajanakaḥ, baddhaviṇmūtratayā tu lakṣyata eva| etena yaducyate- lavaṇādiṣu vipāko yadi rasavīryābhyāṃ bādhitaḥ svakāryakaro na syāt, tat kiṃ tenopadiṣṭeneti, tannirastaṃ bhavati| yato'styeva sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratādi tatkāryamiti| na ca traya eva vipākāḥ kathaṃ bhavanti, tiktādayo'pi kuto na syuriti vācyaṃ| bhūtasvabhāvasyāparyanuyojyatvāt| nanu, yatra rasaviparītaḥ pāko yathā- lavaṇasya madhuraḥ, tiktakaṣāyayośca kaṭuḥ, sa ucyatāṃ| yastu samānaguṇo madhurasya madhuraḥ, amlasyāmlaḥ, kaṭukasya kaṭukaḥ, tatkathanena kiṃ prayojanaṃ| yato rasaguṇaireva tatra vipākaguṇo'pi jñāsyate| naivaṃ, lavaṇādivadvisadṛśarasāntarotpādaśaṅkānirāsārthamapi tatrānuguṇo'pi vipāko vaktavya eva| tathā yatra samānaguṇo vipākastatra balavatkāryaṃ bhavati, viparyaye tu durbalamiti jñeyam| suśrutena dvividha eva vipāko'ṅgīkṛto madhuraḥ kaṭukaśceti, dvaividhye ca bhūtānāṃ gurulāghavena dvaividhyameva hetuḥ| yaduktaṃ tenaiva- “tatra, pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśānāṃ dvaividhyaṃ bhavati guṇasādharmyād gurutā laghutā ca| tatra pṛthivyāpaśca gurvyaḥ, śeṣāṇi laghūni| tasmāddvividha eva vipāko bhavati”- iti (su. sū. a. 40)| atrāpi suśrutamate yadyapyamlalavaṇau madhuravipākau tathā'pi tayorvātaharatve sṛṣṭaviṇmūtratāyāṃ ca madhurakāryakaratvaṃ na punaḥ pittaharatve, tathā tiktakaṣāyayoḥ kaṭuvipākayorapi vātakartṛtve baddhaviṇmūtratāyāṃ ca kaṭukāryakaratvaṃ na punaḥ pittakartṛtve, acintyatvāt prabhāvasya| nanu, “pañcabhūtātmake dehe āhāraḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ| vipakvaḥ pañcadhā samyak svān guṇānabhivardhayet” (su. sū. a. 46)- ityanena pañcadhā'pi vipākastenaivoktaḥ, tatkathaṃ na virodha iti cet| naivam, upādhibhedena virodhābhāvāt| tatra hi bhūtabhedamavalambya pañcadhātvaṃ, atra tu lāghavagauravarūpaṃ bhūtaguṇadvaividhyamāśritya dvaividhyamuktamiti na virodhaḥ| yathā- pañcabhūtātmakatve'pi dravyāṇāṃ saumyāgneyatvāddvaividhyamiti| yatpunaḥ suśrutenāmlapāko na manyate taccarakamatānuyāyino na sahante, yato'mlapākatayaiva vrīhikulatthādīnāṃ pittakartṛtvamupapadyate, atha manyase- vrīhyāderuṣṇavīryatvena tatra pittakartṛtvaṃ? tadasat, madhurasya vrīhestanmate madhuravipākasyoṣṇavīryatāyāmapi satyāṃ na pittakartṛtvamupapadyate, rasavipākābhyāmekasya vīryasya bādhanīyatvāt| kiñcāmlapākatvād vrīhyādeḥ pittamamlaguṇamutpadyate, yadi tūṣṇavīryatākṛtaṃ syāttadā kaṭuguṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pittaṃ syāt, dṛśyate ca- vrīhibhakṣaṇādamlodgārādinā'mlaguṇabhūyiṣṭhataiveti| kiñca pṛthivīsomaguṇātirekānmadhuraḥ pāko bhavati, vāyvagnyākāśātirekācca kaṭurbhavati- iti pakṣe yadā vyāmiśraguṇātireko bhavati, tadā somāgnyātmakasyāmlasyotpādaḥ kathaṃ pratikṣepaṇīyaḥ| athavā tantrakārayoḥ kimanayoranena vacanamātravirodhena kartavyaṃ| yato yadamlapākaṃ carako brūte tat suśrutena vīryoṣṇamiti kṛtvā samādhīyate, anena na kaściddravyaguṇe virodhaḥ|’ iti dravyaguṇasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāṃ śivadāsasenaḥ| ‘vipāka iti pākaḥ pacanaṃ dravyāṇāṃ svarūparasayoḥ parā vṛttiḥ| sā ca svarūpāntaratvena rasāntaratvena ca pariṇatiḥ, tasyā viśeṣo vipākaḥ|....kasya rasasya kiṃ rasāntaratvenodayaḥ pariṇāmaḥ syādityata āha- ‘kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ vipākaḥ prāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ’ ityādi| bhuktānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ yaḥ kaṭustiktaḥ kaṣāyo vā rasaḥ sa sa rasaḥ khalu jāṭhareṇāgninā pacyamānānāṃ bhuktānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ rasākhyadhāturūpeṇa pariṇāme tatpākena pacyamānaḥ san prāyaśaḥ kaṭurvipākaḥ syāt| kaṭuśca kaṭuviśeṣeṇābhiniṣpannaḥ saṃstatra rasākhye dhātau vartate (evaṃ śeṣeṣvapi vyākhyeyam)...itthaṃ ca rasapākābhiprāyeṇa tridhā vipāka uktaḥ (carakeṇa)| suśrute bhūtaguṇapākābhiprāyeṇa dvidhā vipāka ukto gururlaghuśceti krameṇa madhurasañjñaḥ kaṭusañjñaśca’ iti carakaṭīkāyāṃ jalpakalpatarau gaṅgādharakavirājaḥ| “vipākaprādhānyavādimataṃ vīryavādimataṃ niṣedhayitvā prāha- netyāhuranye ityādi| vipākaḥ pradhānamiti pratijñā| vipākaśabdeneha lakṣaṇayā abhyavahṛtadravyāntapākādheya āhārasya rasaviśeṣo gauraveṇa lāghavena vā yukto'bhidhīyate, viśiṣṭo naiṣṭhikaḥ pāko vipāka ityarthaḥ| atra hetuḥ- samyaṅmithyāvipākatvāditi| asyārthaṃ vyākaroti- sarvadravyāṇītyādi| samyagvipakvāni guṇaṃ mithyāvipakvāni doṣaṃ janayanti| samyakpākaḥ samenāgninā, mithyāpākastu hīnātipākarūpo yathākramaṃ mandena tīkṣṇena cāgninā kriyate| tatra hīnāpāke āmavikārāḥ, tīkṣṇapāke ca bhasmakavikārā doṣāḥ| samapāke tu dhātusāmyaṃ guṇaśca| ayaṃ ca pāko yadyapi jaṭharāgnyadhīnaḥ sarvāhārasādhāraṇo natu dravyādhīno dravyaguṇarūpo ya ihādhikṛtaḥ ‘pippalyā madhuravipākaḥ, arghyaṃ madhu kaṭukam’ ityādinā pratipādanīyaḥ| ayameva pāka etatprakaraṇasiddhānte ca ‘taddravyamātmanā kiñcit’ ityādau darśitaḥ| tathā hyubhayorapi pākayoragnyādheyānyapākarūpatayā ekataḥ prādhānye sādhite'paratrāpi siddhaṃ bhavatīti granthārtho neyaḥ| kiṃvā samyakpāko dravyaguṇānuguṇaḥ pāko, yathā ‘citrakaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke’, tathā ‘kṣīraṃ madhuraṃ rasapākayoḥ’ ityādi| atra hi dravyaguṇasadṛśa eka pākaḥ| mithyāpākaḥ dravyaguṇavisadṛśaḥ pākaḥ, yathā ‘pippalyaḥ kaṭukāḥ satyo madhuravipākāḥ’ ityādau| guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayantīti samyakpāke tathā mithyāpāke ca pratyekaṃ yojanīyam| tena dravyaguṇānuguṇo hi madhuraḥ pākaḥ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādiguṇaṃ kaphajananaṃ doṣaṃ ca karoti, tathā dravyaguṇavisadṛśaśca pippalyāḥ kaṭukāyā madhuraḥ pāko yathoktaṃ guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā karoti| asmin vyākhyāne abhimatavyākhyādhīnapākaprādhānye heturukto bhavatīti nāsaṅgatārthatvamasya, yasmādrasaṃ vīryaṃ ca tiraskṛtyāntyo vipāko guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vā janayati, tena vipākaḥ pradhānamiti| samprati svābhimatavipākasvarūpaṃ darśayituṃ parābhimatavipākānyupanyasati- tatrāhuranye ityādi| pratirasaṃ pākameva vivṛṇoti- madhuro madhurasyāmlo'mlasyetyādi| atra dṛṣṭāntamāha- yathetyādi| prakīrṇā ityuptāḥ| tena śāliyavādaya uptaprarūḍhāḥ phalitāśca śāliyavādisvarūpā eva bhavanti, atraiva pakṣe matāntaramāha- kecitpunarityādi| abalavanto rasā alpatayā balavatāmityulbaṇānāṃ rasānāṃ vaśatāṃ parādhīnatāmalpatāmiti yāvat| tena niṣṭhāpākena balavatā durbalarasābhibhavānna pratiniyamena madhurasya madhura eva pāko'mlasya vā'mlaḥ pāka ityādi pratiniyamābhāvādanavasthitaḥ pāka
