mūḍhena ‘mūḍhena tu sāsthiśalyamabhyavahṛtaṃ’ iti tā. māṃsalubdhena yadasthiśalyamannena sahābhyavahṛtaṃ yadā'vagāḍhapurīṣonmiśramapānenādhaḥpreritamasamyagāgataṃ gudamapakṣiṇoti tadā kṣatanimittaḥ kotha upajāyate, tasmiṃśca kṣate pūyarudhirāvakīrṇamāṃsakothe bhūmāviva jalapraklinnāyāṃ krimayaḥ sañjāyante, te bhakṣayanto gudamanekadhā pārśvato dārayanti, tasya tairmārgaiḥ kṛmikṛtairvātamūtrapurīṣaretāṃsyabhiniḥsaranti; taṃ bhagandaramunmārgiṇamityācakṣate ||9||
bhavanti cātra- utpadyate'lparuk śophāt ‘'lparukśothā’ iti pā. kṣipraṃ cāpyupaśāmyati | pāyvantadeśe piḍakā sā jñeyā'nyā bhagandarāt ||10||
pāyoḥ syād dvyaṅgule deśe gūḍhamūlā sarugjvarā | bhāgandarīti vijñeyā piḍakā'to viparyayāt ||11||
yānayānānmalotsargāt kaṇḍūrugdāhaśophavān | pāyurbhavedrujaḥ kaṭyāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ bhagandare ||12||
ghorāḥ sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ sarva eva bhagandarāḥ | teṣvasādhyastridoṣotthaḥ ‘asādhyastu tridoṣotthaḥ’ iti pā. kṣatajaśca bhagandaraḥ ||13||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagandaranidānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||

div.head: kuṣṭhanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

mithyāhārācārasya ‘mithyāhārācārasya pittaśleṣmāṇau prakupitau’ iti tā. viśeṣādguruviruddhāsātmyājīrṇāhitāśinaḥ snehapītasya vāntasya vā vyāyāmagrāmyadharmasevino grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsāni vā payasā'bhīkṣṇamaśnato yo vā majjatyapsūṣmābhitaptaḥ sahasā chardiṃ vā pratihanti, tasya pittaśleṣmāṇau prakupitau parigṛhyānilaḥ pravṛddhastiryaggāḥ sirāḥ samprapadya samuddhūya bāhyaṃ mārgaṃ prati samantādvikṣipati, yatra yatra ca doṣo vikṣipto niścarati tatra tatra maṇḍalāni prādurbhavanti, evaṃ samutpannastvaci doṣastatra tatra ca parivṛddhiṃ prāpyāpratikriyamāṇo'bhyantaraṃ pratipadyate dhātūnabhidūṣayan ||3||
tasya pūrvarūpāṇi- tvakpāruṣyamakasmādromaharṣaḥ kaṇḍūḥ svedabāhulyamasvedanaṃ vā'ṅgapradeśānāṃ svapanamaṅgānāmasṛkkṛṣṇatvaṃ ca’ iti pā. svāpaḥ kṣatavisarpaṇamasṛjaḥ kṛṣṇatā ceti ||4||

tatra sapta mahākuṣṭhāni, ekādaśa kṣudrakuṣṭhāni, evamaṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti | tatra mahākuṣṭhānyaruṇodumbararṣya(rkṣa)jihvakapālakākaṇakapuṇḍarīkadadrukuṣṭhānīti | kṣudrakuṣṭhānyapi sthūlāruṣkaṃ mahākuṣṭhamekakuṣṭhaṃ carmadalaṃ visarpaḥ parisarpaḥ sidhmaṃ vicarcikā kiṭibhaṃ (maṃ) pāmā rakasā ceti ||5||
sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni savātāni sapittāni saśleṣmāṇi sakrimīṇi ca bhavanti, utsannatastu doṣagrahaṇamabhibhavāt ||6||
tatra vātenāruṇaṃ, pittenodumbararṣya(rkṣa)jihvakapālakākaṇakāni, śleṣmaṇā puṇḍarīkaṃ dadrukuṣṭhaṃ ceti | teṣāṃ mahattvaṃ kriyāgurutvamuttarottaraṃ dhātvanupraveśādasādhyatvaṃ ceti ||7||

tatra, vātenāruṇābhāni tanūni visarpīṇi todabhedasvāpayuktānyaruṇāni | pittena pakvodumbaraphalākṛtivarṇānyaudumbarāṇi ‘pakvodumbaravarṇāni’ iti tā., ṛṣya(kṣa)jihvāprakāśāni ‘ṛṣyajihvāprakāśakharatvāni’ iti pā.| ‘ṛṣyajihveva kharāṇi’ iti tā. kharāṇi ṛṣya(kṣa)jihvāni, kṛṣṇakapālikāprakāśāni kapālakuṣṭhāni, kākaṇantikāphalasadṛśānyatīva raktakṛṣṇāni kākaṇakāni asyāgre ‘pacyante’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ; teṣāṃ caturṇāmapyoṣacoṣaparidāhadhūmāyanāni kṣiprotthānaprapākabheditvāni krimijanma ca sāmānyāni liṅgāni | śleṣmaṇā puṇḍarīkapatraprakāśāni pauṇḍarīkāṇi, atasīpuṣpavarṇāni tāmrāṇi vā visarpīṇi piḍakāvanti ca dadrukuṣṭhāni; tayordvayorapyutsannatā parimaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūścirotthānatvaṃ ceti sāmānyāni rūpāṇi ||8||

div.ab: kṣudrakuṣṭhānyata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- sthūlāni aruḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sthūlamūlānyarūṃsi sañjāyante sandhiṣu dāruṇāni’ iti tā. sandhiṣvatidāruṇāni sthūlāruṣi ‘sthūlāruṣi sthūlāruṣkasañjñe kuṣṭhe’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ syuḥ kaṭhinānyarūṃṣi |9|

ab.seg: tvakkocabhedasvapanāṅgasādāḥ kuṣṭhe mahatpūrvayute bhavanti ‘mahākuṣṭhe sarvadehe bhavanti tvaksaṅkocasvedabhedāṅgadāhāḥ’ iti tā.||9||

div.ab: kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ yena bhaveccharīraṃ tadekakuṣṭhaṃ pravadanti kuṣṭham kṛṣṇo deho yasya kṛṣṇāruṇo vā taccaikākhyaṃ kuṣṭhamāhuḥ sukaṣṭam’ iti tā.|10|

ab.seg: syuryena kaṇḍūvyathanauṣacoṣāstaleṣu ‘kaṇḍū coṣau todadāhau tu yasya’ iti tā. taccarmadalaṃ vadanti ||10||
visarpavat sarpati sarvato yastvagraktamāṃsānyabhibhūya śīghram | mūrcchāvidāhāratitodapākān kṛtvā visarpaḥ sa bhavedvikāraḥ ||11||

div.ab: śanaiḥ śarīre piḍakāḥ sravantyaḥ ‘yasmin sphoṭāḥ srāvavantastamāhuḥ pārīsarpaṃ tacchanaiḥ sarpamāṇam| vaisarpaṃ syāt sarvataḥ sarpaṇāttu tvagraktādīn vyāpya bhāvān suśīghram’ iti tā. sarpanti yāstaṃ parisarpamāhuḥ |12|

ab.seg: kaṇḍvanvitaṃ śvetamapāyi sidhma ‘svacchaṃ śvetaṃ kaṇḍumaccāpi sidhmaṃ paridhvaṃsi prāyaśaścordhvakāye’ iti tā. vidyāttanu ‘tanoḥ’ pā. prāyaśa ūrdhvakāye ||12||
rājyo'tikaṇḍvartirujaḥ sarūkṣā bhavanti gātreṣu vicarcikāyām | kaṇḍūmatī dāharujopapannā vipādikā pādagateyameva ||13||

div.ab: yat srāvi vṛttaṃ ghanamugrakaṇḍu tat snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ kiṭibhaṃ(maṃ) vadanti |14|

sāsrāvakaṇḍūparidāhakābhiḥ ‘sūkṣmā bahvayaḥ piḍakāḥ srāvavatyaḥ pāmetyuktāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ sadāhāḥ| saiva sphoṭaistīvradāhairupetā jñeyāḥ pāṇyoḥ kacchurugrā sphicośca’ iti tā. pāmā'ṇukābhiḥ piḍakābhirūhyā ||14|| sphoṭaiḥ sadāhairati saiva kacchūḥ sphikpāṇipādaprabhavairnirūpyā |15|

ab.seg: kaṇḍvanvitā ‘kṛtsne dehe piḍakāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ saivāsrāvā rakasetyucyate tu’ iti tā. yā piḍakā śarīre saṃsrāvahīnā rakasocyate sā ||15||

aruḥ ‘tatrāruṣkaṃ rākasaṃ yacca sidhma kaphādhikyādekakuṣṭhaṃ mahacca| pittādhikyāt pārisarpaṃ tu vidyāddṛṣṭastvevaṃ kuṣṭhavargastridoṣaḥ’ iti tā. sasidhmaṃ rakasā mahacca yaccaikakuṣṭhaṃ kaphajānyamūni | vāyoḥ prakopāt parisarpamekaṃ śeṣāṇi pittaprabhavāṇi vidyāt ||16||

kilāsamapi kuṣṭhavikalpa ‘kuṣṭhavikāraḥ’ iti tā. eva; tattrividhaṃ- vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā ceti | kuṣṭhakilāsayorantaraṃ- tvaggatameva kilāsamaparisrāvi ca | tadvātena maṇḍalamaruṇaṃ paruṣaṃ paridhvaṃsi ca, pittena padmapatrapratīkāśaṃ saparidāhaṃ ca, śleṣmaṇā śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ bahalaṃ kaṇḍūmacca | teṣu sambaddhamaṇḍalamantejātaṃ raktaroma cāsādhyamagnidagdhaṃ ca ||17||

kuṣṭheṣu tu tvaksaṅkocasvāpasvedaśophabhedakauṇyasvaropaghātā vātena, pākāvadaraṇāṅgulipatanakarṇanāsābhaṅgākṣirāgasattvotpattayaḥ ‘rāgāḥ śīghrotpattayaḥ’ iti tā. pittena, kaṇḍūvarṇabhedaśophāsrāvagauravāṇi śleṣmaṇā ||18||
tatrādibalapravṛttaṃ pauṇḍarīkaṃ kākaṇaṃ cāsādhyam ||19||
bhavanti cātra- yathā vanaspatirjātaḥ prāpya kālaprakarṣaṇam kālaṃ krameṇa tu’ iti tā.| antarbhūmiṃ vigāheta mūlairvṛṣṭivivardhitaiḥ ||20||
evaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samutpannaṃ tvaci kālaprakarṣataḥ | krameṇa dhātūn vyāpnoti narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ ||21||
sparśahāniḥ svedanatvamīṣatkaṇḍūśca jāyate | vaivarṇyaṃ rūkṣabhāvaśca kuṣṭhe tvaci samāśrite ‘tvaksthe vaivarṇyamaṅgeṣu kuṣṭhe raukṣyaṃ ca jāyate’ iti tā.||22||
tvaksvāpo romaharṣaśca svedasyābhipravartanam | kaṇḍūrvipūyakaścaiva kuṣṭhe śoṇitasaṃśrite ||23||
bāhulyaṃ vakraśoṣaśca kārkaśyaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ | todaḥ sphoṭaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca kuṣṭhe māṃsasamāśrite ||24||
daurgandhyamupadehaśca pūyo'tha krimayastathā | gātrāṇāṃ bhedanaṃ cāpi kuṣṭhe medaḥsamāśrite ||25||
nāsābhaṅgo'kṣirāgaśca kṣate ca krimisambhavaḥ | bhavet svaropaghātaśca hyasthimajjasamāśrite ||26||
kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo'ṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ kṣatasarpaṇam | śukrasthānagate liṅgaṃ prāguktāni tathaiva ca ||27||
strīpuṃsayoḥ kuṣṭhadoṣādduṣṭaśoṇitaśukrayoḥ | yadapatyaṃ tayorjātaṃ jñeyaṃ tadapi kuṣṭhitam ||28||
kuṣṭhamātmavataḥ sādhyaṃ tvagraktapiśitāśritam | medogataṃ bhavedyāpyamasādhyamata uttaram ||29||
brahmastrīsajjanavadhaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ | karmabhiḥ pāparogasya prāhuḥ kuṣṭhasya sambhavam ‘devadravyagurudravyaparasvaharaṇādibhiḥ| pāpmā pāpakṛtāmetat kuṣṭhamityabhiśabditam’ iti tā.||30||
mriyate yadi kuṣṭhena punarjāte'pi gacchati | nātaḥ kaṣṭataro rogo yathā kuṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam ||31||
āhārācārayoḥ proktāmāsthāya mahatīṃ kriyām | auṣadhīnāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ tapasaśca niṣevaṇāt | yastena mucyate jantuḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt ||32||
prasaṅgādgātrasaṃsparśānniśvāsāt sahabhojanāt | sahaśayyāsanāccāpi vastramālyānulepanāt ||33||
kuṣṭhaṃ jvaraśca śoṣaśca netrābhiṣyanda eva ca | aupasargikarogāśca saṅkrāmanti narānnaram ||34||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||

div.head: pramehanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ pramehanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
divāsvapnāvyāyāmālasyaprasaktaṃ śītasnigdhamadhuramedyadravānnapānasevinaṃ puruṣaṃ jāniyāt pramehī bhaviṣyatīti ||3||

tasya caivampravṛttasyāparipakvā ‘caivampravṛttasya yadā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo medaścāparipakvamadho gatvā’ iti pā. eva vātapittaśleṣmāṇo yadā medasā sahaikatvamupetya mūtravāhisrotāṃsyanusṛtyādho gatvā bastermukhamāśritya nirbhidyante tadā pramehāñjanayanti ||4||

teṣāṃ tu pūrvarūpāṇi- hastapādataladāhaḥ snigdhapicchilagurutā gātrāṇāṃ madhuraśuklamūtratā tandrā sādaḥ pipāsā durgandhaśca śvāsastālugalajihvādanteṣu malotpattirjaṭilībhāvaḥ keśānāṃ vṛddhiśca nakhānām ||5||
tatrāvilaprabhūtamūtralakṣaṇāḥ sarva eva pramehā bhavanti ||6||
sarva eva sarvadoṣasamutthāḥ saha piḍakābhiḥ ||7||

tatra, kaphādudakekṣuvālikāsurāsikatāśanairlavaṇapiṣṭasāndraśukraphenamehā ‘kaphādudakekṣusurā.’ iti pā. daśa sādhyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ samakriyatvāt; pittānnīlaharidrāmlakṣāramañjiṣṭhāśoṇitamehāḥ ṣaḍ yāpyāḥ, doṣadūṣyāṇāṃ viṣamaktiyatvāt; vātāt sarpirvasākṣaudrahastimehāścatvāro'sādhyatamāḥ, mahātyayikatvāt ||8||
tatra vātapittamedobhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā śleṣmapramehāñjanayati, vātakaphaśoṇitamedobhiranvitaṃ pittaṃ pittapramehān, kaphapittavasāmajjamedobhiranvito vāyurvātapramehān ||9||

tatra, śvetamavedanamudakasadṛśamudakamehī mehati; ikṣurasatulyamikṣuvālikāmehī; surātulyaṃ surāmehī; sarujaṃ sikatānuviddhaṃ sikatāmehī; śanaiḥ sakaphaṃ mṛtsnaṃ śanairmehī; viśadaṃ lavaṇatulyaṃ lavaṇamehī; hṛṣṭaromā piṣṭarasatulyaṃ piṣṭamehī; āvilaṃ sāndraṃ sāndramehī; śukratulyaṃ śukramehī; stokaṃ stokaṃ saphenamacchaṃ phenamehī mehati ||10||

ata ūrdhvaṃ pittanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- saphenamacchaṃ nīlaṃ nīlamehī mehati; sadāhaṃ haridrābhaṃ haridrāmehī; amlarasagandhamamlamehī; srutakṣārapratimaṃ kṣāramehī; mañjiṣṭhodakaprakāśaṃ mañjiṣṭhāmehī; śoṇitaprakāśaṃ śoṇitamehī mehati ||11||

ata ūrdhvaṃ vātanimittān vakṣyāmaḥ- sarpiḥprakāśaṃ sarpirmehī mehati; vasāprakāśaṃ vasāmehī; kṣaudrarasavarṇaṃ kṣaudramehī; mattamātaṅgavadanuprabandhaṃ ‘anuprabaddhaṃ’ iti pā. hastimehī mehati ||12||

makṣikopasarpaṇamālasyaṃ asyāgre ‘upadravānata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ māṃsopacayaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ śaithilyārocakāvipākāḥ kaphaprasekacchardinidrākāsaśvāsāśceti śleṣmajānāmupadravāḥ; vṛṣaṇayoravadaraṇaṃ bastibhedo meḍhratodo hṛdi śūlamamlīkājvarātīsārārocakā vamathuḥ paridhūpanaṃ ‘paridhūmāyanaṃ’ iti pā. dāho mūrcchā pipāsā nidrānāśaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ceti paittikānāṃ; hṛdgraho laulyamanidrā stambhaḥ kampaḥ śūlaṃ baddhapurīṣatvaṃ ceti ‘śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaśceti vātajānāmupadravā bhavanti’ iti tā. vātajānām | evamete viṃśati pramehāḥ sopadravā vyākhyātāḥ ||13||

tatra vasāmedobhyāmabhipannaśarīrasya tribhirdoṣaiścānugatadhātoḥ pramehiṇo daśa ‘nava’ iti tā. piḍakā jāyante | tadyathā- śarāvikā, sarṣapikā, kacchapikā, jālinī, vinatā, putriṇī, masūrikā, alajī, vidārikā, vidradhikā ceti ||14||
śarāvamātrā tadrūpā nimnamadhyā śarāvikā | gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā tatpramāṇā ca sārṣapī ||15||
sadāhā kūrmasaṃsthānā jñeyā kacchapikā budhaiḥ | jālinī tīvradāhā tu māṃsajālasamāvṛtā ‘māṃsajālasamāśritā’ iti pā.||16||
mahatī piḍakā nīlā piḍakā vinatā smṛtā ayamardhaślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate| mahatyalpācitā jñeyā piḍakā sā tu putriṇī ||17||
masūrasamasaṃsthānā jñeyā sā tu masūrikā | raktā sitā sphoṭavatī dāruṇā tvalajī bhavet ||18||
vidārīkandavadvṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā | vidradherlakṣaṇairyuktā jñeyā vidradhikā budhaiḥ ||19||

div.ab: ye yanmayāḥ smṛtā mehāsteṣāmetāstu tatkṛtāḥ |20|

ab.seg: gude hṛdi śirasyaṃse pṛṣṭhe marmaṇi cotthitāḥ | sopadravā durbalāgneḥ ‘durbalasya’ iti pā. piḍakāḥ parivarjayet ||20||
kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjavasāyutaḥ | adhaḥ prakramate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ ||21||
pramehapūrvarūpāṇāmākṛtiryatra dṛśyate | kiñciccāpyadhikaṃ mūtraṃ taṃ pramehiṇamādiśet ‘tasminbheho bhaviṣyati’ iti pā.||22||
kṛtsnānyardhāni vā yasmin pūrvarūpāṇi mānave | pravṛttamūtramatyarthaṃ taṃ pramehiṇamādirot ‘pramehaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet’ iti pā.||23||
piḍakāpīḍitaṃ gāḍhamupasṛṣṭamupadravaiḥ | madhumehinamācaṣṭe sa cāsādhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||24||
sa cāpi gamanāt sthānaṃ sthānādāsanamicchati | āsanādṛṇute śayyāṃ śayanāt svapnamicchati ‘suptumicchati’ iti pā.||25||

yathā hi varṇānāṃ ‘śuklādivarṇānāṃ’ iti tā. pañcānāmutkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa śabalababhrukapilakapotamecakādīnāṃ varṇānāmanekeṣāmutpattirbhavati, evameva doṣadhātumalāhāraviśeṣeṇotkarṣāpakarṣakṛtena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa pramehāṇāṃ nānākaraṇaṃ bhavati ||26||
bhavati cātra- sarva eva pramehāstu kālenāpratikurvataḥ ‘apratikāriṇaḥ’ iti pā.| madhumehatvamāyānti tadā'sādhyā bhavanti hi ||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||

div.head: udaranidānam

ab.seg: athāta udarāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
dhanvantarirdharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭho rājarṣirindrapratimo'bhavadyaḥ ‘babhūva’ iti pā.| brahmarṣiputraṃ vinayopapannaṃ śiṣyaṃ śubhaṃ suśrutamanvaśāt saḥ ||3||
pṛthak samastairapi ceha doṣaiḥ plīhodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ tathaiva | āgantukaṃ saptamamaṣṭamaṃ ca dakodaraṃ ceti vadanti tāni ||4||

div.ab: sudurbalāgnerahitāśanasya saṃśuṣkapūtyannaniṣevaṇādvā | snehādimithyācaraṇācca jantorvṛddhiṃ gatāḥ koṣṭhamabhiprapannāḥ ||5|| gulmākṛtivyañjitalakṣaṇāni kurvanti ghorāṇyudarāṇi doṣāḥ |6|
koṣṭhādupasnehavadannasāro niḥsṛtya duṣṭo'nilaveganunnaḥ ||6|| tvacaḥ samunnamya śanaiḥ samantādvivardhamāno jaṭharaṃ karoti |7|
tatpūrvarūpaṃ balavarṇakāṅkṣāvalīvināśo jaṭhare hi rājyaḥ ||7|| jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau rujaḥ pādagataśca śophaḥ |8|
saṅgṛhya pārśvodarapṛṣṭhanābhīryadvardhate kṛṣṇasirāvanaddham ||8|| saśūlamānāhavadugraśabdaṃ satodabhedaṃ pavanātmakaṃ tat |9|
yaccoṣatṛṣṇājvaradāhayuktaṃ pītaṃ sirā bhānti ca yatra pītāḥ ||9|| pītākṣiviṇmūtranakhānanasya pittodaraṃ tattvacirābhivṛddhi |10|
yacchītalaṃ śuklasirāvanaddhaṃ guru sthiraṃ śuklanakhānanasya ||10|| snigdhaṃ mahacchophayutaṃ sasādaṃ kaphodaraṃ tattu cirābhivṛddhi |11|

striyo'nnapānaṃ nakharomamūtraviḍārtavairyuktamasādhuvṛttāḥ ||11|| yasmai prayacchantyarayo garāṃśca duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanādvā | tenāśu raktaṃ kupitāśca doṣāḥ kurvanti ghoraṃ jaṭharaṃ triliṅgam ||12|| tacchītavātābhrasamudbhaveṣu ‘tacchītavāte bhṛśadurdine ca’ iti pā.| ‘tacchītavātātapadurdineṣu’ iti tā. viśeṣataḥ kupyati dahyate ca sa cāturo mūrcchati samprasaktaṃ pāṇḍuḥ kṛśaḥ śuṣyati tṛṣṇayā ca ||13|| prakīrtitaṃ ‘dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeva’ iti tā. dūṣyudaraṃ tu ghoraṃ ... |14|

... plīhodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha | vidāhyabhiṣyandiratasya jantoḥ praduṣṭamatyarthamasṛk kaphaśca ||14|| plīhābhivṛddhiṃ satataṃ karoti plīhodaraṃ tat pravadanti tajjñāḥ | vāme ca pārśve parivṛddhimeti viśeṣataḥ sīdati cāturo'tra ||15|| mandajvarāgniḥ kaphapittaliṅgairupadrutaḥ kṣīṇabalo'tipāṇḍuḥ |16|

ab.seg: savyetarasmin yakṛti praduṣṭe jñeyaṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ tadeva ||16||

div.ab: yasyāntramannairupalepibhirvā bālāśmabhirvā sahitaiḥ ‘pihitaṃ yathāvat’ iti pā. pṛthagvā | sañcīyate tatra malaḥ sadoṣaḥ krameṇa nāḍyāmiva saṅkaro hi ||17|| nirudhyate cāsya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrādapi cālpamalpam | hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhimeti ta(ya)ccodaraṃ viṭsamagandhikaṃ ca ||18|| pracchardayan baddhagudī vibhāvyaḥ, ... |19|

...tataḥ parisrāvyudaraṃ nibodha | śalyaṃ yadannopahitaṃ tadantraṃ bhinatti yasyāgatamanyathā vā ||19|| tasmāt sruto'ntrāt salilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūyaḥ | nābheradhaścodarameti vṛddhiṃ nistudyate'tīva vidahyate ca ||20|| etat parisrāvyudaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ... |21|

ab.seg: ... dakodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha | yaḥ snehapīto'pyanuvāsito vā vānto virikto'pyathavā nirūḍhaḥ ||21||
pibejjalaṃ śītalamāśu tasya srotāṃsi duṣyanti hi tadvahāni | snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavadabhyupaiti ||22||
snigdhaṃ mahat samparivṛttanābhi bhṛśonnataṃ pūrṇamivāmbunā ca | yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyati kampate ca śabdāyate cāpi dakodaraṃ ‘cāpyudakodaraṃ tat’ iti pā. tat ||23||
ādhmānaṃ gamane'śaktirdaurbalyaṃ durbalāgnitā | śophaḥ sadanamaṅgānāṃ saṅgo vātapurīṣayoḥ | dāhastṛṣṇā ca sarveṣu jaṭhareṣu bhavanti hi ||24||
ante salilabhāvaṃ hi bhajante jaṭharāṇi tu | sarvāṇyeva parīpākāttadā tāni ‘vidhyettyajeta vā’ iti pā. vivarjayet ||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
athāto mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

grāmyadharmayānavāhanādhvagamanapraskhalanaprapatanaprapīḍanadhāvanābhighātaviṣamaśayanāsanopavāsavegābhighātātirūkṣa- kaṭutiktabhojanaśokātikṣārasevanātisāravamanavirecanapreṅkholanājīrṇagarbhaśātanaprabhṛtibhirviśeṣairbandhanānmucyate garbhaḥ, phalamiva vṛntabandhanādabhighātaviśeṣaiḥ; sa vimuktabandhano garbhāśayamatikramya yakṛtplīhāntravivarairavasraṃsamānaḥ koṣṭhasaṅkṣobhamāpādayati, tasyā jaṭharasaṅkṣobhādvāyurapāno mūḍhaḥ pārśvabastiśīrṣodarayoniśūlānāhamūtrasaṅgānāmanyatamamāpadya garbhaṃ cyāvayati ‘vyāpādayati’ iti pā. taruṇaṃ śoṇitasrāveṇa; tameva kadācidvivṛddhamasamyagāgatamapatyapathamanuprāptamanirasyamānaṃ viguṇāpānasammohitaṃ garbhaṃ mūḍhagarbhamityācakṣate ||3||

tataḥ kīlaḥ ‘saṅkīlaḥ’ iti pā. pratikhuro bījakaḥ parigha iti | tatra, ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādo yo yonimukhaṃ niruṇaddhi kīla iva sa kīlaḥ; niḥsṛtahastapādaśirāḥ kāyasaṅgī pratikhuraḥ; yo nirgacchatyekaśirobhujaḥ sa bījakaḥ; yastu parigha iva yonimukhamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati sa parighaḥ; iti caturvidho bhavatītyeke bhāṣante | tattu na samyak; kasmāt? sa yadā viguṇānilaprapīḍito'patyapathamanekadhā prapadyate tadā saṅkhyā hīyate ||4||

tatra, kaściddvābhyāṃ sakthibhyāṃ yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate; kaścidābhugnaikasakthirekena; kaścidābhugnasakthiśarīraḥ sphigdeśena tiryagāgataḥ; kaściduraḥpārśvapṛṣṭhānāmanyatamena yonidvāraṃ pidhāyāvatiṣṭhate; antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ kaścidekena bāhunā; kaścidābhugnaśirā bāhudvayena; kaścidābhugnamadhyo hastapādaśirobhiḥ; kaścidekena sakthnā yonimukhaṃ pratipadyate'pareṇa pāyum; ityaṣṭavidhā mūḍhagarbhagatiruddiṣṭā samāsena ||5||
tatra dvāvantyāvasādhyau mūḍhagarbhau, śeṣānapi viparītendriyārthākṣepakayonibhraṃśasaṃvaraṇamakkallaśvāsakāsabhramanipīḍitān ‘… kṣepakavātavikārayonibhraṃśa ...’ iti pā. pariharet ||6||
bhavanti ‘bhavanti cātra’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate cātra- kālasya pariṇāmena muktaṃ vṛntādyathā phalam | prapadyate svabhāvena nānyathā patituṃ dhruvam ||7||
evaṃ kālaprakarṣeṇa mukto nāḍīnibandhanāt | garbhāśayastho yo garbho jananāya prapadyate ||8||
kṛmivātābhighātaistu tadevopadrutaṃ phalam | patatyakāle'pi yathā tathā syādgarbhavicyutiḥ ||9||
ācaturthāttato māsāt prasravedgarbhavicyutiḥ ‘garbhavidravaḥ’ iti pā.| tataḥ sthiraśarīrasya pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ ||10||
pravidhyati śiro yā tu śītāṅgī nirapatrapā | nīloddhatasirā hanti sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tathā ||11||
garbhāspandanamāvīnāṃ praṇāśaḥ śyāvapāṇḍutā | bhavatyucchvāsapūtitvaṃ śūlaṃ ‘śūnatā'ntarmṛte’ iti pā. cāntarmṛte śiśau ||12||
mānasāgantubhirmāturupatāpaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ | garbho vyāpadyate kukṣau vyādhibhiśca prapīḍitaḥ ||13||

bastamāravipannāyāḥ vāgbhaṭe tvayaṃ śloko'nyathā paṭhyate| yathā,- “bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi| janmakāle tataḥ śīghraṃ pāṭayitvoddharecchiśum”- iti| “garbhiṇyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate'tyantaṃ calati| kva pradeśe? bastidvāre| kadā? janmakāle garbhaprasavonmukhe kāle| tadā kuśalo vaidyaḥ śīghraṃ kukṣipraspandanādanantaraṃ pāṭayitvā śiśuṃ bālakamuddharet” ityaruṇadattaṭīkā| hārāṇacandrastu ‘bastidvāre vipannāyāḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ‘janmakāle upasthite prasavakāle vipannāyā mṛtāyā yadi kukṣiḥ praspandate, tarhi tatkṣaṇāt bastidvāre bastiṃ dvāraṃ ca pāṭayitvā bhiṣak taṃ garbhamuddharet’ iti vyākhyānayati kukṣiḥ praspandate yadi | tatkṣaṇājjanmakāle taṃ pāṭayitvoddharedbhiṣak ||14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||

div.head: vidradhinidānam

ab.seg: athāto vidradhīnāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarvāmaraguruḥ śrīmānnimittāntarabhūmipaḥ | śiṣyāyovāca nikhilamidaṃ vidradhilakṣaṇam ||3||
tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi pradūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ | doṣāḥ śophaṃ śanairghoraṃ janayantyucchritā bhṛśam ||4||
mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ cā(vā')pyathavā''yatam | tamāhurvidradhiṃ dhīrā, vijñeyaḥ sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ ||5||
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca kṣatenāpyasṛjā tathā | ṣaṇṇāmapi hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||6||
kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā paruṣo bhṛśamatyarthavedanaḥ | citrotthānaprapākaśca vidradhirvātasambhavaḥ ||7||
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ śyāvo vā jvaradāhavān | kṣiprotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ pittasambhavaḥ ||8||
śarāvasadṛśaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śītaḥ stabdho'lpavedanaḥ | cirotthānaprapākaśca sakaṇḍuśca kaphotthitaḥ ||9||

div.ab: tanupītasitāścaiṣāmāsrāvāḥ kramaśaḥ smṛtāḥ |10|
nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān ||10|| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpi vidradhiḥ sānnipātikaḥ |11|
taistairbhāvairabhihate kṣate vā'pathyasevinaḥ ||11|| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛtaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayet | jvarastṛṣṇā ca dāhaśca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||12|| eṣa vidradhirāgantuḥ pittavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ |13|
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvastīvradāharujājvaraḥ ‘tīvradāharujākaraḥ’ iti pā.||13|| pittavidradhiliṅgastu raktavidradhirucyate |14|

ab.seg: uktā vidradhayo hyete teṣvasādhyastu sarvajaḥ ||14||

div.ab: ābhyantarānatastūrdhvaṃ vidradhīn paricakṣate | gurvasātmyaviruddhānnaśuṣkasaṃsṛṣṭabhojanāt ‘saṅkliṣṭabhojanāt’ iti, ‘saṅklinnabhojanāt’ iti ca pā.||15|| ativyavāyavyāyāmavegāghātavidāhibhiḥ | pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||16|| valmīkavatsamunnaddhamantaḥ kurvanti vidradhim | gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayostathā ||17|| vṛkkayoryakṛti plīhni hṛdaye klomni vā tathā | teṣāṃ liṅgāni jānīyādbāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||18|| āmapakvaiṣaṇīyācca ‘āmapakvaiṣaṇīyena’ iti pā. pakvāpakvaṃ vinirdiśet |19|

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ śṛṇu viśeṣataḥ ||19||
gude vātanirodhastu bastau kṛcchrālpamūtratā | nābhyāṃ hikkā tathā''ṭopaḥ kukṣau mārutakopanam ||20||
kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahastīvro vaṅkṣaṇotthe tu vidradhau | vṛkkayoḥ pārśvasaṅkocaḥ plīhnyucchvāsāvarodhanam ||21||
sarvāṅgapragrahastīvro hṛdi śūlaśca dāruṇaḥ | śvāso yakṛti tṛṣṇā ca pipāsāklomaje'dhikā ||22||
āmo vā yadi vā pakvo mahān vā yadi vetaraḥ | sarvo marmotthitaścāpi ‘marmotthitatvācca’ iti pā. vidradhiḥ kaṣṭa ucyate ||23||
nābheruparijāḥ pakvā yāntyūrdhvamitare tvadhaḥ | jīvatyadho niḥsruteṣu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||24||
hṛnnābhibastivarjyā ye teṣu bhinneṣu bāhyataḥ | jīvet kadācit puruṣo netareṣu kadācana ||25||
strīṇāmapaprajātānāṃ prajātānāṃ tathā'hitaiḥ | dāhajvarakaro ghoro jāyate raktavidradhiḥ ||26||

div.ab: api samyakprajātānāmasṛk kāyādaniḥsṛtam | raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ kuryāt kukṣau makkallasañjñitam ||27|| saptāhānnopaśāntaścettato'sau samprapacyate |28|

ab.seg: viśeṣamatha vakṣyāmi spaṣṭaṃ vidradhigulmayoḥ ||28||
gulmadoṣasamutthānādvidradhergulmakasya ca | kasmānna pacyate gulmo vidradhiḥ pākameti ca ||29||
na nibandho'sti gulmānāṃ vidradhiḥ sanibandhanaḥ | gulmākārāḥ svayaṃ doṣā vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite ||30||
vivarānucaro granthirapsu budbudako yathā | evamprakāro gulmastu tasmāt pākaṃ na gacchati ||31||
māṃsaśoṇitabāhulyāt pākaṃ gacchati vidradhiḥ | māṃsaśoṇitahīnatvādgulmaḥ pākaṃ na gacchati ||32||
gulmastiṣṭhati doṣe sve vidradhirmāṃsaśoṇite | vidradhiḥ pacyate tasmādgulmaścāpi na pacyate ||33||

div.ab: hṛnnābhibastijaḥ pakvo varjyo yaśca tridoṣajaḥ |34|

ab.seg: atha majjaparīpāko ghoraḥ samupajāyate ||34||
so'sthimāṃsanirodhena dvāraṃ na labhate yadā | tataḥ sa vyādhinā tena jvalaneneva dahyate ||35||
asthi(tha) majjoṣmaṇā tena śīryate dahyamānavat | vikāraḥ śalyabhūto'yaṃ kleśayedāturaṃ ciram ||36||
athāsya karmaṇā vyādhirdvāraṃ tu labhate yadā | tato medaḥprabhaṃ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ śītamatho guru ||37||
bhinne'sthni niḥsravet ‘prasravet’ iti pā. pūyametadasthigataṃ viduḥ | vidradhiṃ śāstrakuśalāḥ sarvadoṣarujāvaham ||38||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vidradhinidānaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||

div.head: visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānam

ab.seg: athāto visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitagatāḥ kupitāstu doṣāḥ sarvāṅgasāriṇamihāsthitamātmaliṅgam | kurvanti vistṛtamanunnatamāśu visṛtamunnatamāśu’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, ‘visṛtaṃ vistīrṇaṃ, unnataṃ mahāntam’ iti ca vyākhyānayati śophaṃ taṃ sarvato visaraṇācca visarpamāhuḥ ||3||
vātātmako'sitamṛduḥ paruṣo'ṅgamardasambhedatodapavanajvaraliṅgayuktaḥ | gaṇḍairyadā tu viṣamairatidūṣitatvādyuktaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ khalu varjanīyaḥ ||4||
pittātmako drutagatirjvaradāhapākasphoṭaprabhedabahulaḥ kṣatajaprakāśaḥ | doṣapravṛddhihatamāṃsasiro yadā syāt srotojakardamanibho na tadā sa sidhyet ||5||

div.ab: śleṣmātmakaḥ sarati mandamaśīghrapākaḥ snigdhaḥ sitaśvayathuralparugugrakaṇḍuḥ |6|

ab.seg: sarvātmakastrividhavarṇarujo'vagāḍhaḥ pakvo na sidhyati ca māṃsasirāpraśātāt ‘māṃsasirāpraṇāśāt’ iti pā.||6||
sadyaḥkṣatavraṇamupetya narasya pittaṃ raktaṃ ca doṣabahulasya karoti śopham | śyāvaṃ salohitamatijvaradāhapākaṃ sphoṭaiḥ kulatthasadṛśairasitaiśca kīrṇam ||7||
sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti | paittānilāvapi ca darśitapūrvaliṅgau sarve ca marmasu bhavanti hi kṛcchrasādhyāḥ ||8||

div.ab: śophaṃ na pakvamiti ‘śopho na pakva iti’ iti pā. pakvamupekṣate yo yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyamasādhuvṛttaḥ | abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni ‘pūrvagaditāni’ iti ga. tataḥ sa pūyaḥ ||9|| tasyātimātragamanādgatirityataśca nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī |10|

ab.seg: doṣaistribhirbhavati sā pṛthagekaśaśca sammūrcchitairapi ca śalyanimittato'nyā ||10||

div.ab: tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddhamadhikaṃ sravati kṣapāyām |11|

ab.seg: tṛṭtāpatodasadanajvarabhedahetuḥ pītaṃ sravatyadhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu pittāt ||11||

div.ab: jñeyā kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā rātrisrutiḥ stimitarukkaṭhinā sakaṇḍūḥ |12|

ab.seg: doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīrvyatikaraprabhavāstu vidyāt ||12||
dāhajvaraśvasanamūrcchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavantyabhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni | tāmādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopāddhorāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālarātrim ||13||
naṣṭaṃ kathañcidanumārgamudīriteṣu ‘aṇumātramudīriteṣu’ iti pā. sthāneṣu śalyamacireṇa gatiṃ karoti | sā phenilaṃ mathitamacchamasṛgvimiśramuṣṇaṃ sraveta sahasā sarujā ca nityam ||14||
yāvatyo gatayo yaiśca kāraṇaiḥ sambhavanti hi | tāvantaḥ stanarogāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṃ taireva hetubhiḥ ||15||

dhamanyaḥ saṃvṛtadvārāḥ kanyānāṃ stanasaṃśritāḥ | doṣāvisaraṇāttāsāṃ ‘doṣāvitaraṇāt’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ paṭhati, doṣāvitaraṇāt saṃvṛtadvāratayā stanāmayārambhakāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmavisarjanāt’ iti ca vyākhyānayati na bhavanti stanāmayāḥ ||16||
tāsāmeva prajātānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca tāḥ punaḥ | svabhāvādeva vivṛtā jāyante sambhavantyataḥ ||17||
rasaprasādo madhuraḥ pakvāhāranimittajaḥ | kṛtsnadehāt stanau prāptaḥ stanyamityabhidhīyate ||18||

div.ab: viśasteṣvapi gātreṣu yathā śukraṃ na dṛśyate | sarvadehāśritatvācca ‘sarvadehāśritatve'pi stanyaṃ lakṣaṇatastathā’ iti hārāṇacandasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ śukralakṣaṇamucyate ||19|| tadeva ceṣṭayuvaterdarśanāt smaraṇādapi | śabdasaṃśravaṇāt sparśāt saṃharṣācca pravartate ||20|| suprasannaṃ manastatra harṣaṇe heturucyate | āhārarasayonitvādevaṃ ‘āhārarasavīryatvāt’ iti tā. stanyamapi striyāḥ ||21|| tadevāpatyasaṃsparśāddarśanāt smaraṇādapi | grahaṇācca śarīrasya śukravat sampravartate ||22|| sneho nirantarastatra prasrave heturucyate |23|

ab.seg: tat kaṣāyaṃ bhavedvātāt kṣiptaṃ ca plavate'mbhasi ||23||
pittādamlaṃ sakaṭukaṃ rājyo'mbhasi ca pītikāḥ | kaphādghanaṃ picchilaṃ ca jale cāpyavasīdati | sarvairduṣṭaiḥ sarvaliṅgamabhighātācca duṣyati ||24||
yat kṣīramudake kṣiptamekībhavati ‘ekatvaṃ yāti’ iti pā. pāṇḍuram | madhuraṃ cāvivarṇaṃ ca prasannaṃ tadvinirdiśet ||25||
sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā prāpya doṣaḥ stanau striyāḥ | raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca sandūṣya stanarogāya kalpate ||26||
pañcānāmapi teṣāṃ tu hitvā śoṇitavidradhim | lakṣaṇāni samānāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne visarpanāḍīstanaroganidānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||

div.head: granthyapacyarbudagalagaṇḍanidānam

ab.seg: athāto granthapacyarbudagalagaṇḍānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātādayo māṃsamasṛk ca duṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaśca kaphānuviddham ‘tathā sirāśca’ iti tā.| vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ tu śophaṃ kurvantyato granthiriti pradiṣṭaḥ ||3||
āyamyate vyathyata ‘vyathyati tudyate ca’ iti tā. eti todaṃ pratyasyate kṛtyata ‘mathyati bhidyate ca’ iti tā. eti bhedam | kṛṣṇo'mṛdurbastirivātataśca bhinnaḥ sraveccānilajo'sramaccham ||4||
dandahyate dhūpyati cūṣyate ‘cātimātraṃ’ iti pā. ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi | raktaḥ sapīto'pyathavā'pi pittādbhinnaḥ sraveduṣṇamatīva cāsram ||5||
śīto'vivarṇo'lparujo'tikaṇḍūḥ pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapannaḥ | cirābhivṛddhiśca kaphaprakopādbhinnaḥ sravecchuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||6||
śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniḥ snigdho mahānalparujo'tikaṇḍūḥ | medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||7||

div.ab: vyāyāmajātairabalasya taistairākṣipya vāyurhi sirāpratānam | sampīḍya saṅkocya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karotyunnatamāśu vṛttam ||8|| granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhavedyadi syāt sarujaścalaśca | aruk sa evāpyacalo ‘sa evāvicalaḥ’ iti pā. mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||9|| iti granthīnāṃ nidānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: hanvasthikakṣākṣakabāhusandhimanyāgaleṣūpacitaṃ tu medaḥ | granthiṃ sthiraṃ vṛttamathāyataṃ vā snigdhaṃ kaphaścālparujaṃ karoti ||10||

taṃ granthibhistvāmalakāsthimātrairmatsyāṇḍajālapratimaistathā'nyaiḥ ‘jāle jālākāre ādhāre matsyāṇḍaṃ matsyāṇḍajālaṃ, rājadantādiṣu draṣṭavyaṃ| tatsadṛśairmatsyāṇḍajālapratimaiḥ’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ| ananyavarṇairupacīyamānaṃ cayaprakarṣādapacīṃ vadanti ||11||
kaṇḍūyutāste'lparujaḥ prabhinnāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye | medaḥkaphābhyāṃ khalu roga eṣa sudustaro varṣagaṇānubandhī ||12||

div.ab: gātrapradeśe kvacideva doṣāḥ sammūrcchitā māṃsamabhipradūṣya | vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntamanalpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||13|| kurvanti māṃsopacayaṃ tu śophaṃ tamarbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti |14|
vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā ca ||14|| tajjāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni sadā bhavanti |15|

doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirāstu sampīḍya saṅkocya gatastvapākam ||15|| sāsrāvamunnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurairācitamāśuvṛddhim | sravatyajasraṃ rudhiraṃ praduṣṭamasādhyametadrudhirātmakaṃ syāt ||16|| raktakṣayopadravapīḍitatvāt pāṇḍurbhavet so'rbudapīḍitastu |17|

muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ prakaroti śopham ||17|| avedanaṃ snigdhamananyavarṇamapākamaśmopamamapracālyam | praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya bāḍhametadbhavenmāṃsaparāyaṇasya ||18|| māṃsārbudaṃ tvetadasādhyamuktaṃ... |19|

ab.seg: ...sādhyeṣvapīmāni vivarjayettu | samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yacca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yacca bhavedacālyam ||19||
yajjāyate'nyat ‘sañjāyate yat’ iti pā. khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ tadadhyarbudamarbudajñaiḥ | yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādvā dvirarbudaṃ tacca bhavedasādhyam ||20||
na pākamāyānti kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca viśeṣatastu | doṣasthiratvādgrathanācca teṣāṃ sarvārbudānyeva nisargatastu ||21||
vātaḥ kaphaścaiva gale ‘bhṛśaṃ’ iti pā. pravṛddhau manye tu saṃsṛtya tathaiva medaḥ | kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍamāhuḥ ||22||

todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā pavanātmakastu | medonvitaścopacitaśca kālādbhavedatisnigdhataro'rujaśca ‘bhavet pratistabdhagalo'rujaśca’ iti, ‘bhavet pradigdhe ca gale'rujaśca’ iti ca pā.||23||
pāruṣyayuktaściravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākamiyāt kadācit vairasyamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ ||24||
sthiraḥ savarṇo'lparugugrakaṇḍūḥ ‘gururugrakaṇḍūḥ’ iti tā. śīto mahāṃścāpi kaphātmakastu | cirābhivṛddhiṃ kurute cirācca prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit ||25||
mādhuryamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapralepaḥ | snigdho mṛduḥ pāṇḍuraniṣṭagandho medaḥkṛto ‘medaḥśritaḥ’ iti pā. nīrugathātikaṇḍūḥ ||26||

pralambate'lābuvadalpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ‘vivardhate hīyati cātra dehaḥ’ iti tā.| gayadāsasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavecca jantorgale'nuśabdaṃ ‘galena’ iti pā. kurute ca nityam ||27||
kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ mṛdusarvagātraṃ saṃvatsarātītamarocakārtam | kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍinaṃ tu bhinnasvaraṃ caiva vivarjayettu ||28||
nibaddhaḥ śvayathuryasya muṣkavallambate gale | mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ taṃ gaṇḍamiti nirdiśet’ iti pā. tamādiśet ||29||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacyarbudanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
athāto vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitamedomūtrāntranimittāḥ sapta vṛddhayo bhavanti | tāsāṃ ‘teṣāṃ’ ityādi tāḍapatrapustake tathā gayadāsena ca vṛddhiśabdaḥ sarvatra puṃlliṅga eva paṭhyate mūtrāntranimitte vṛddhī vātasamutthe, kevalamutpattiheturanyatamaḥ ||3||
adhaḥ prakupito'nyatamo hi doṣaḥ phalakośavāhinīrabhiprapadya dhamanīḥ phalakoṣayorvṛddhiṃ janayati, tāṃ vṛddhimityācakṣate ||4||
tāsāṃ bhaviṣyatīnāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi- bastikaṭīmuṣkameḍhreṣu vedanā mārutanigrahaḥ phalakośaśophaśceti ||5||

tatrānilaparipūrṇāṃ bastimivātatāṃ paruṣāmanimittānilarujāṃ vātavṛddhimācakṣate; pakvodumbarasaṅkāśāṃ jvaradāhoṣmavatīṃ cāśusamutthānapākāṃ pittavṛddhiṃ; kaṭhināmalpavedanāṃ śītāṃ ‘kaṭhinaṃ snigdhamalpavedanaṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmatīṃ śleṣmavṛddhiṃ; kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtāṃ pittavṛddhiliṅgāṃ raktavṛddhiṃ, mṛdusnigdhāṃ kaṇḍūmatīmalpavedanāṃ tālaphalaprakāśāṃ medovṛddhiṃ; mūtrasandhāraṇaśīlasya mūtravṛddhirbhavati, sā gacchato'mbupūrṇā dṛtiriva kṣubhyati mūtrakṛcchravedanāṃ vṛṣaṇayoḥ śvayathuṃ kośayoścāpādayati, tāṃ mūtravṛddhiṃ vidyāt; bhāraharaṇabalavadvigrahavṛkṣaprapatanādibhirāyāsaviśeṣairvāyurabhipravṛddhaḥ ‘vāyuḥ prakupito'ntrasya sthūlasyetarasya vā’ iti tā. prakupitaśca sthūlāntrasyetarasya ‘kṣudrāntrasyaikadeśaṃ’ iti pā. caikadeśaṃ viguṇamādāyādho viguṇaṃ saṅkucitaṃ| ‘dviguṇaṃ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtamityarthaḥ gatvā vaṅkṣaṇasandhimupetya granthirūpeṇa sthitvā'pratikriyamāṇe ca kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ praviśya muṣkaśophamāpādayati, ādhmāto bastirivātataḥ pradīrghaḥ sa śopho bhavati, saśabdamavapīḍitaścordhvamupaiti, vimuktaśca punarādhmāyate ‘punarādhamati’ iti, ‘punarādhmāti’ iti ca pā., tāmantravṛddhimasādhyāmityācakṣate ||6||

tatrātimaithunādatibrahmacaryādvā ‘tatra brahmacāriṇīṃ dīrghakarkaśaromāṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāmalpadvārāmapriyāmakāmāmacaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayoniṃ vā nārīṃ yo'bhigacchet tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanāddhastābhighātāccatuṣpadīgamanādacaukṣasalilaprakṣālanādvā prakupitāḥ’ iti tāḍapatrapustake pāṭhaḥ| gayadāsenāpyayameva vyākhyātaḥ tathā'tibrahmacāriṇīṃ cirotsṛṣṭāṃ rajasvalāṃ dīrgharomāṃ karkaśaromāṃ saṅkīrṇaromāṃ nigūḍharomāmalpadvārāṃ mahādvārāmapriyāmakāmāmacaukṣasalilaprakṣālitayonimaprakṣālitayoniṃ yonirogopasṛṣṭāṃ svabhāvato vā duṣṭayoniṃ viyoniṃ vā nārīmatyarthamupasevamānasya tathā karajadaśanaviṣaśūkanipātanādbandhanāddhastābhighātāccatuṣpadīgamanādacaukṣasalilaprakṣālanādavapīḍanācchrukravegavidhāraṇānmaithunānte vā'prakṣālanādibhirmeḍhramāgamya aprakṣālanādevaṃvidhādvā'nyasmāt’ iti pā. prakupitā doṣāḥ kṣate'kṣate vā śvayathumupajanayanti, tamupadaṃśamityācakṣate ||7||
sa pañcavidhastribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthak samastairasṛjā ceti ‘caikaḥ’ iti pā.||8||

tatra vātike pāruṣyaṃ tvakparipuṭanaṃ stabdhameḍhratā paruṣaśophatā vividhāśca ‘vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaśca’ iti tā. vātavedanāḥ; paittike jvaraḥ śvayathuḥ pakvoḍumbarasaṅkāśastīvradāhaḥ kṣiprapākaḥ pittavedanāśca; ślaiṣmike śvayathuḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ śleṣmavedanāśca; raktaje kṛṣṇasphoṭaprādurbhāvo'tyarthamasṛkpravṛttiḥ pittaliṅgānyatyarthaṃ jvaradāhau śoṣaśca, yāpyaścaiva kadācit; sarvaje sarvaliṅgadarśanamavadaraṇaṃ ca śephasaḥ kṛmiprādurbhāvo maraṇaṃ ceti ||9||

kupitāstu doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇo'dhaḥprapannā vaṅkṣaṇorujānujaṅghāsvavatiṣṭhamānāḥ kālāntareṇa pādamāśritya śanaiḥ śophaṃ janayanti, taṃ ślīpadamityācakṣate | tattrividhaṃ- vātapittakaphanimittamiti ||10||

tatra, vātajaṃ kharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paruṣamanimittānilarujaṃ parisphuṭati ca bahuśaḥ; pittajaṃ tu pītāvabhāsamīṣanmṛdu jvaradāhaprāyaṃ ca; śleṣmajaṃ tu śvetaṃ snigdhāvabhāsaṃ mandavedanaṃ bhārikaṃ mahāgranthikaṃ kaṇṭakairupacitaṃ ca ||11||
tatra saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkajātaṃ prasṛtamiti varjanīyāni ||12||
bhavanti cātra- trīṇyapyetāni jānīyācchlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt | gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmānnāsti vinā kaphāt ||13||
purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ | ye deśāsteṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||14||
pādavaddhastayoścāpi ślīpadaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | karṇākṣināsikauṣṭheṣu kecidicchanti tadvidaḥ ||15||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne vṛddhyupadaṃśaślīpadanidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||

div.head: kṣudraroganidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

samāsena catuścatvāriṃśat ‘saptacatvāriṃśat’ iti tā. kṣudrarogā bhavanti | tadyathā,- ajagallikā, yavaprakhyā, andhālajī, vivṛtā, kacchapikā, valmīkaṃ, indravṛddhā ‘indraviddhā, gardabhikā’ iti tā., panasikā, pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ, jālagardabhaḥ, kakṣā ‘kakṣā, irivellikā, gandhanāmā’ iti tā., visphoṭakaḥ, agnirohiṇī, cippaṃ, kunakhaḥ, anuśayī, vidārikā śarkarārbudaṃ, pāmā, vicarcikā, rakasā, pādadārikā, kadaraṃ, alasendraluptau ‘alasaḥ, rujyā’ iti pā., dāruṇakaḥ, aruṃṣikā, palitaṃ, masūrikā, yauvanapiḍakā, padminīkaṇṭakaḥ, jatumaṇiḥ, maśakaḥ, carmakīlaḥ tāḍapatrapustake carmakīlasthāne nīlikā paṭhyate, tilakālakaḥ, nyacchaṃ, vyaṅgaḥ, parivartikā, avapāṭikā, niruddhaprakaśaḥ sanniruddhagudaḥ, ahipūtanaṃ, vṛṣaṇakacchraḥ, gudabhraṃśaśceti ||3||
snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā ‘granthisannibhā’ iti pā.| kaphavātotthitā jñeyā bālānāmajagallikā ||4||
yavākārā sukaṭhinā grathitā māṃsasaṃśritā | piḍakā śleṣmavātābhyāṃ yavaprakhyeti socyate ||5||
ghanāmavaktrāṃ piḍakāmunnatāṃ parimaṇḍalām | andhālajīmalpapūyāṃ tāṃ vidyāt kaphavātajām ||6||
vivṛtāsyāṃ mahādāhāṃ pakvodumbarasannibhām | vivṛtāmiti tāṃ vidyāt pittotthāṃ parimaṇḍalām ||7||
grathitāḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā dāruṇāḥ kacchaponnatāḥ | kaphānilābhyāṃ piḍakā jñeyā kacchapikā budhaiḥ ||8||
pāṇipādatale sandhau grīvāyāmūrdhvajatruṇi | granthirvalmīkavadyastu śanaiḥ samupacīyate ||9||
todakledaparīdāhakaṇḍūmadbhirmukhairvṛtaḥ | vyādhirvalmīka ityeṣa kaphapittānilodbhavaḥ ‘vijñeyaḥ kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti tā.||10||

div.ab: padmapuṣkaravanmadhye ‘padmakarṇivanmadhye’ iti pā. piḍakābhiḥ samācitām | indravṛddhāṃ tu tāṃ vidyādvātapittotthitāṃ bhiṣak ||11|| maṇḍalaṃ vṛttamutsannaṃ saraktaṃ piḍakācitam | rujākarīṃ gadarbhikāṃ tāṃ vidyādvātapittajām |12|

ab.seg: karṇau ‘karṇasyābhyantare jātāṃ piḍakāmugravedanām| sthirāṃ panasikāṃ tāṃ tu vidyādvātakaphotthitām’ iti tā. pari samantādvā pṛṣṭhe vā piḍakograruk | śālūkavatpanasikāṃ tāṃ vidyācchleṣmavātajām ||12||
hanusandhau samudbhūtaṃ śophamalparujaṃ sthiram | pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ ‘pāṣāṇagardabhamiti brūyāttat kaphapittataḥ’ iti tā. vidyādbalāsapavanātmakam ||13||
visarpavat sarpati yo ‘yaḥ śophastanurapākavān| dāhajvarakaraḥ pittāt’ iti tā. dāhajvarakarastanuḥ | apākaḥ śvayathuḥ pittāt sa jñeyo jālagardabhaḥ ||14||
piḍikāmuttamāṅgasthāṃ vṛttāmugrarujājvarām | sarvātmakāṃ sarvaliṅgāṃ jānīyādirivellikām ||15||
bāhupārśvāṃsakakṣāsu kṛṣṇasphoṭāṃ savedanām | pittaprakopasambhūtāṃ kakṣāmiti vinirdiśet ||16||
ekāmevaṃvidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā piṭikāṃ sphoṭasannibhām | tvaggatāṃ pittakopena gandhanāmāṃ pracakṣate ||17||
agnidagdhanibhāḥ sphoṭāḥ sajvarāḥ pittaraktataḥ | kvacit sarvatra vā dehe smṛtā visphoṭakā iti ||18||
kakṣābhāgeṣu ye sphoṭā jāyante māṃsadāru(ra)ṇāḥ | antardāhajvarakarā dīptapāvakasannibhāḥ ||19||
saptāhādvā daśāhādvā pakṣādvā nghanti mānavam | tāmagnirohiṇīṃ vidyādasādhyāṃ sannipātataḥ ||20||

div.ab: nakhamāṃsamadhiṣṭhāya pittaṃ vātaśca vedanām ‘dehinām’ iti tā.| karoti dāhapākau ca taṃ vyādhiṃ cippamādiśet ||21|| tadevākṣatarogākhyaṃ tathopanakhamityapi ‘tadevālpatarairdoṣaiḥ kunakhaṃ paruṣaṃ kharam’ iti tā.| abhighātāt praduṣṭo yo nakho rūkṣo'sitaḥ kharaḥ ||22|| bhavettaṃ kunakhaṃ vidyāt kulīnamiti sañjñitam |23|
gambhīrāmalpasaṃrambhāṃ savarṇāmuparisthitām ||23|| kaphādantaḥprapākāṃ tāṃ vidyādanuśayīṃ bhiṣak ‘pādasyānuśayīṃ tāṃ tu vidyādantaḥprapākinīm’ iti tā.|24|

vidārīkandavadvṛttāṃ kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu ||24|| raktāṃ vidārikāṃ vidyāt sarvajāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām ‘vidārikāmiti vadet sarujāṃ sarvalakṣaṇām’ iti tā.| ‘vidārīkandavadvṛttā kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| raktā vidārikā jñeyā sarvajā sarvalakṣaṇā’ iti gayadāsasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ|25|

prāpya māṃsasirāsnāyu śleṣmā medastathā'nilaḥ ||25|| granthiṃ kurvanti bhinno'sau madhusarpirvasānibham | sravatyāsrāvamatyarthaṃ ‘karoti’ tā. tatra vṛddhiṃ gato'nilaḥ ‘gataḥ punaḥ’ iti tā.||26|| māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ janayet ‘janayatyataḥ’ iti tā. punaḥ | durgandhaṃ klinnamatyarthaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tataḥ sirāḥ ||27|| sravanti sahasā raktaṃ tadvidyāccharkarārbudam |28|

ab.seg: pāmāvicarcyau kuṣṭheṣu rakasā ca prakīrtitā ||28||
parikramaṇaśīlasya vāyuratyartharūkṣayoḥ | pādayoḥ kurute dārīṃ sarujāṃ talasaṃśritaḥ ||29||
śarkaronmathite pāde kṣate vā kaṇṭakādibhiḥ | medoraktānugaiścaiva ‘granthiḥ kī(ko)lavadutsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tataḥ’ iti tā. doṣairvā jāyate nṛṇām ||30||
sakīlakaṭhino granthirnimnamadhyonnato'pi vā | kolamātraḥ saruk srāvī jāyate kadarastu saḥ ||31||
klinnāṅgulyantarau pādau kaṇḍūdāharuganvitau | duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśādalasaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||32||
romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam | pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ ||33||
ruṇaddhi romakūpāṃstu tato'nyeṣāmasambhavaḥ | tadindraluptaṃ khālityaṃ rujyeti ca vibhāvyate ||34||
dāruṇā kaṇḍurā rūkṣā keśabhūmiḥ prapāṭyate | kaphavātaprakopeṇa vidyāddāruṇakaṃ tu tam ||35||
arūṃṣi bahuvaktrāṇi bahukledīni mūrdhani | kaphāsṛkkṛmikopena ‘kaphāsṛkpittakopena’ iti tā. nṛṇāṃ vidyādaruṃṣikām ||36||
krodhaśokaśramakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ | pittaṃ ca keśān pacati palitaṃ tena jāyate ||37||
dāhajvararujāvantastāmrāḥ sphoṭāḥ sapītakāḥ ‘savedanāḥ’ iti tā.| gātreṣu vadane cāntarvijñeyāstā masūrikāḥ ||38||
śālmalīkaṇṭakaprakhyāḥ kaphamārutaśoṇitaiḥ | jāyante piḍakā yūnāṃ vaktre yā ‘yuvānapiḍakā yūnāṃ vijñeyā’ iti tā. mukhadūṣikāḥ ||39||
kaṇṭakairācitaṃ vṛttaṃ ‘vidyānmaṇḍalaṃ pāṇḍu kaṇḍuram’ iti tā. kaṇḍūmat pāṇḍumaṇḍalam | padminīkaṇṭakaprakhyaistadākhyaṃ kaphavātajam ||40||
nīrujaṃ samamutsannaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kapharaktajam | sahajaṃ raktamīṣacca ‘lakṣma caikeṣāṃ lakṣyo jatumaṇīti saḥ’ iti tā. ślakṣṇaṃ jatumaṇiṃ viduḥ ||41||
avedanaṃ sthiraṃ caiva yasya gātreṣu dṛśyate | māṣavatkṛṣṇamutsannamanilānmaṣakaṃ vadet ||42||
kṛṣṇāni tilamātrāṇi nīrujāni samāni ca | vātapittakaphocchoṣāttān ‘vātapittakaphodrekāt’ iti pā. vidyāttilakālakān ||43||
maṇḍalaṃ mahadalpaṃ vā śyāmaṃ vā yadi vā sitam | sahajaṃ nīrujaṃ gātre nyacchamityabhidhīyate ||44||

div.ab: samutthānanidānābhyāṃ carmakīlaṃ prakīrtitam |45|
krodhāyāsaprakupito vāyuḥ pittena saṃyutaḥ ||45|| sahasā mukhamāgatya maṇḍalaṃ visṛjatyataḥ | nīrujaṃ tanukaṃ śyāvaṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ tamādiśet ||46|| kṛṣṇamevaṅguṇaṃ gātre mukhe vā nīlikāṃ viduḥ |47|

mardanāt pīḍanāccāti tathaivāpyabhighātataḥ | meḍhracarma yadā vāyurbhajate sarvataścaraḥ ||47|| tadā vātopasṛṣṭaṃ tu carma pratinivartate | maṇeradhastāt kośaśca granthirūpeṇa lambate ||48|| savedanaḥ sadāhaśca pākaṃ ca vrajati kvacit | mārutāgantusambhūtāṃ vidyāttāṃ parivartikām ‘parivartiketi tāṃ vidyāt sarujāṃ vātasambhavām’ iti tā.||49|| sakaṇḍūḥ kaṭhinā cāpi saiva śleṣmasamutthitā |50|

alpīyaḥkhāṃ ‘alpīyasīṃ yadā harṣādbalādgacchet’ iti pā. yadā harṣādbālāṃ gacchet striyaṃ naraḥ ||50|| hastābhighātādathavā carmaṇyudvartite balāt | mardanātpīḍanādvā'pi śukravegavighātataḥ ||51|| yasyāvapāṭyate carma tāṃ vidyādavapāṭikām |52|

ab.seg: vātopasṛṣṭamevaṃ tu carma saṃśrayate maṇim ||52||
maṇiścarmopanaddhastu ‘carmoparuddhastu’ iti tā. mūtrasroto ruṇaddhi ca | niruddhaprakaśe tasminmandadhāramavedanam ‘savedanam’ iti tā.||53||
mūtraṃ pravartate jantormaṇirna ‘maṇirvivriyate na ca’ iti pā. ca vidīryate | niruddhaprakaśaṃ vidyāddurūḍhāṃ ‘sarujaṃ vātasambhavam’ iti pā. cāvapāṭikām ||54||
vegasandhāraṇādvāyurvihato gudamāśritaḥ | niruṇaddhi mahatsrotaḥ sūkṣmadvāraṃ karoti ca ||55||
mārgasya saukṣmyāt kṛcchreṇa purīṣaṃ tasya gacchati | sanniruddhagudaṃ vyādhimenaṃ vidyāt sudustaram ||56||
śakṛnmūtrasamāyukte'dhaute'pāne śiśorbhavet | svinnasyāsnāpyamānasya kaṇḍū raktakaphodbhavā ||57||
kaṇḍūyanāttataḥ kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaśca jāyate | ekībhūtaṃ vraṇairghoraṃ taṃ vidyādahipūtanam ||58||
snānotsādanahīnasya malo vṛṣaṇasaṃśritaḥ | yadā praklidyate svedāt kaṇḍūṃ sañjanayettadā ||59||
tatra kaṇḍūyanāt kṣipraṃ sphoṭāḥ srāvaśca jāyate | prāhurvṛṣaṇakacchūṃ tāṃ śleṣmaraktaprakopajām ||60||

pravāhaṇātisārābhyāṃ nirgacchati gudaṃ bahiḥ | rūkṣadurbaladehasya taṃ gudabhraṃśamādiśet asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘ityevaṃ kṣudrarogāṇāṃ sthānaṃ samparikīrtitam| tadavekṣya bhiṣak prājño yathādoṣamupācaret’ ityadhikaḥ śloka upalabhyate||61||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne kṣudraroganidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||

div.head: śūkadoṣanidānam

ab.seg: athātaḥ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

liṅgavṛddhimicchatāmakramapravṛttānāṃ śūkadoṣanimittā daśa cāṣṭau ca vyādhayo jāyante | tadyathā sarṣapikā, aṣṭhīlikā, grathitaṃ, kumbhīkā, alajī, mṛditaṃ, sammūḍhapiḍakā, avamanthaḥ, puṣkarikā, sparśahāniḥ, uttamā, śataponakaḥ, tvakpākaḥ, śoṇitārbudaṃ, māṃsārbudaṃ, māṃsapākaḥ, vidradhiḥ, tilakālakaśceti ||3||
gaurasarṣapatulyā tu śūkadurbhagnahetukā | piḍakā kapharaktābhyāṃ jñeyā sarṣapikā budhaiḥ ||4||
kaṭhinā viṣamairantairmārutasya prakopataḥ | śūkaistu viṣasambhugnaiḥ ‘viṣasaṃyuktaiḥ’ iti pā. piḍakā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet ‘kaṭhinā viṣamā bha(bhu)gnairvoyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet iti tā.||5||

div.ab: śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitaṃ tat ‘nāma tat kaphāt’ iti tā. kaphotthitam |6|

ab.seg: kumbhīkā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā'śubhā ||6||
alajīlakṣaṇairyuktāmalajīṃ ‘tulyajāṃ tvalajīṃ vidyādyathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ’ iti tā. ca vitarkayet | mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yattu saṃrabdhaṃ vāyukopataḥ ||7||

div.ab: pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe sammūḍhapiḍakā bhavet |8|
dīrghā bahvyaśca piḍakā dīryante madhyatastu yāḥ ||8|| so'vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣakṛt |9|
pittaśoṇitasambhūtā piḍakā piḍakācitā ||9|| padmapuṣkarasaṃsthānā ‘padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā’ iti tā. jñeyā puṣkariketi sā |10|

ab.seg: janayet sparśahāniṃ tu śoṇitaṃ śūkadūṣitam ||10||
mudgamāṣopamā raktā piḍakā raktapittajā | uttamaiṣā ‘vyādhireṣottamo nāma śūkājīrṇanimittajaḥ’ iti tā. tu vijñeyā śūkājīrṇanimittajā ||11||
chidrairaṇumukhairvastu ‘chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ’ iti, ‘chidrairaṇumukhairyattu citaṃ meḍhraṃ’ iti ca pā. citaṃ yasya samantataḥ | vātaśoṇitajo vyādhirvijñeyaḥ śataponakaḥ ||12||

div.ab: pittaraktakṛto ‘vātapittakṛtaḥ’ iti pā. jñeyastvakpāko jvaradāhavān |13|

ab.seg: kṛṣṇauḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktaiśca piḍakābhiśca pīḍitam ‘dūṣitam’ iti pā.| yasya vastu rujaścogrā jñeyaṃ tacchoṇitārbudam ||13||

div.ab: māṃsadoṣeṇa jānīyādarbudaṃ māṃsasambhavam |14|
śīryante yasya māṃsāni yatra sarvāśca vedanāḥ ||14|| vidyāttaṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak |15|

ab.seg: vidradhiṃ sannipātena yathoktamabhinirdiśet ||15||
kṛṣṇāni citrāṇyathavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi ca | pātitāni pacantyāśu meḍhraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ||16||
kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ | sannipātasamutthānaṃ taṃ vidyāttilakālakam ||17||
tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yacca māṃsapākaśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ | vidradhiśca na sidhyanti ye ca syustilakālakāḥ ||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||

div.head: bhagnanidānam

ab.seg: athāto bhagnānāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
patanapīḍanaprahārākṣepaṇavyālamṛgadaśanaprabhṛtibhirabhighātaviśeṣairanekavidhamasthnāṃ bhaṅgamupadiśanti ‘bhagnamupadiśanti’ iti pā.||3||
tatra ‘tattu’ iti pā. bhaṅga(gna)jātamanekavidhamanusāryamāṇaṃ dvividhamevopapadyate sandhimuktaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca | tatra ṣaḍvidhaṃ sandhimuktaṃ, dvādaśavidhaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ bhavati ||4||
tatra sandhimuktam- utpiṣṭaṃ, viśliṣṭaṃ, vivartitam, avakṣiptam, atikṣiptaṃ, tiryakkṣiptamiti ṣaḍvidham ||5||
tatra prasāraṇākuñcanavivartanākṣepaṇāśaktirugrarujatvaṃ sparśāsahatvaṃ ceti sāmānyaṃ sandhimuktalakṣaṇamuktam ||6||

vaiśeṣikaṃ tūtpiṣṭe sandhāvubhayataḥ śopho vedanāprādurbhāvo viśeṣataśca nānāprakārā vedanā rātrau prādurbhavanti; viśliṣṭe'lpaḥ śopho vedanāsātatyaṃ sandhivikriyā ca; vivartite tu sandhipārśvāpagamanādviṣamāṅgatā vedanā ca; avakṣipte sandhiviśleṣastīvrarujatvaṃ ca; atikṣipte dvayoḥ sandhyasthnoratikrāntatā vedanā ca; tiryakkṣipte tvekāsthipārśvāpagamanamatyarthaṃ vedanā ceti ||7||
kāṇḍabhagnamata ūrdhvaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ- karkaṭakam, aśvakarṇaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ, piccitam, asthicchallitaṃ, kāṇḍabhagnaṃ, majjānugatam, atipātitaṃ, vakraṃ, chinnaṃ, pāṭitaṃ, sphuṭitamiti dvādaśavidham ||8||

śvayathubāhulyaṃ ‘śvayathubāhulyamavapīḍyamāne vividhavedanāpravṛttiriti sāmānyataḥ’ iti tā. spandanavivartanasparśāsahiṣṇutvamavapīḍyamāne śabdaḥ srastāṅgatā vividhavedanāprādurbhāvaḥ sarvāsvavasthāsu na śarmalābha iti samāsena kāṇḍabhagnalakṣaṇamuktam ||9||

viśeṣastu sammūḍhamubhayato'sthi madhye bha(la)gnaṃ granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭakam, aśvakarṇavadudgatamaśvakarṇakaṃ, spṛśyamānaṃ ‘śabdasparśābhyāṃ cūrṇitamavagacchet’ iti tā. śabdavaccūrṇitamavagacchet, piccitaṃ pṛthutāṃ gatamanalpaśophaṃ ‘alpaśothaṃ’ iti tā., pārśvayorasthi hīnodgatamasthicchalitaṃ, vellate prakampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam, asthyavayavo'sthimadhyamanupraviśya majjānamunnahyatīti majjānugatam, asthi niḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitam, ābhugnamavimuktāsthi vakram, anyatarapārśvāvaśiṣṭaṃ chinnaṃ, pāṭitamaṇubahuvidāritaṃ vedanāvacca, śūkapūrṇamivādhmātaṃ vipulaṃ visphuṭitaṃ sphuṭitamiti ||10||

teṣu cūrṇitacchinnātipātitamajjānugatāni kṛcchrasādhyāni, kṛśavṛddhabālānāṃ ‘kṛśātivṛddhabālāsahānāṃ’ iti pā. kṣatakṣīṇakuṣṭhiśvāsināṃ sandhyupagataṃ ‘savraṇāni sandhyupagatāni ca’ iti tā. ceti ||11||

div.ab: bhavanti cātra- bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ tu sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam | jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca varjayettaccikitsakaḥ ||12|| asaṃśliṣṭaṃ kapālaṃ tu lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat | bhagnaṃ stanāntare śaṅkhe pṛṣṭhe mūrdhni ca varjayet ||13|| ādito yacca durjātamasthi sandhirathāpi vā | samyagyamitamapyasthi ‘samyaksaṃhitamapyasthi’ iti pā. durnyāsāddurnibandhanāt ‘durnikṣepanibandhanāt’ iti pā.||14|| saṅkṣobhādvā'pi yadgacchedvikriyāṃ tacca varjayet |15|
madhyasya vayaso'vasthāstisro yāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||15|| tatra sthiro bhavejjanturupakrānto vijānatā ayaṃ ślokastāḍapatrapustake na paṭhyate| gayadāsenāvyākhyātaśca|16|

ab.seg: taruṇāsthīni namyante bhajyante nalakāni tu ||16||
kapālāni vibhidyante ‘vibhajyante’ iti pā. sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne bhagnanidānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||

div.head: mukharoganidānam

ab.seg: athāto mukharogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

mukharogāḥ pañcaṣaṣṭirbhavanti saptasvāyataneṣu | tatrāyatanāni- oṣṭhau, dantamūlāni, dantāḥ, jihvā, tālu, kaṇṭhaḥ, sarvāṇi ceti | tatrāṣṭāvoṣṭhayoḥ, pañcadaśa dantamūleṣu, aṣṭau danteṣu, pañca jihvāyāṃ, nava tāluni, saptadaśa kaṇṭhe, trayaḥ sarveṣvāyataneṣu ||3||
tatrauṣṭhaprakopā vātapittaśleṣmasannipātaraktamāṃsamedobhighātanimittāḥ ||4||
karkaśau paruṣau stabdhau kṛṣṇau tīvraruganvitau ‘samāṃsānilavedanau’ iti tā.| dālyete paripāṭyete hyoṣṭhau mārutakopataḥ ||5||
ācitau ‘cīyete pīḍakābhiśca sarujābhiḥ samantataḥ’ iti tā. piḍakābhistu sarṣapākṛtibhirbhṛśam | sadāhapākasaṃsrāvau ‘... pākapīḍakau pītābhāsau ca’ iti tā. nīlau pītau ca pittataḥ ||6||
savarṇābhistu cīyete piḍakābhiravedanau | kaṇḍūmantau ‘bhavatastu kaphādoṣṭhau’ iti tā. kaphācchūnau picchilau śītalau gurū ||7||
sakṛt kṛṣṇau sakṛt pītau sakṛcchvetau tathaiva ca | sannipātena vijñeyāvanekapiḍikācitau ||8||
kharjūraphalavarṇābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ ‘piḍakābhirnipīḍitau’ iti tā. samācitau | raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇitaprabhau ||9||
māṃsaduṣṭau gurū sthūlau māṃsapiṇḍavadudgatau | jantavaścātra mūrcchanti sṛkkasyobhayato ‘narasyobhayataḥ’ iti tā. mukhāt ||10||
medasā ‘sarpirmaṇḍapratīkāśau medasā kaṇḍurau gurū’ iti tā. ghṛtamaṇḍābhau kaṇḍūmantau sthirau mṛdū | acchaṃ sphaṭikasaṅkāśamāsrāvaṃ sravato gurū ‘bhṛśam’ iti tā.||11||
kṣatajābhau ‘oṣṭhau paryavadīryete’ iti tā. vidīryete pāṭyete cābhighātataḥ | grathitau ‘tato vraṇaḥ susaṃrūḍho mṛdutvamupagacchati’ iti pā. ca samākhyātāvoṣṭhau kaṇḍūsamanvitau ||12||
dantamūlagatāstu- śītādo, dantapuppuṭako, dantaveṣṭakaḥ, śauṣiro, mahāśauṣiraḥ, paridara, upakuśo, dantavaidarbho, vardhanaḥ, adhimāṃso, nāḍyaḥ pañceti ||13||
śoṇitaṃ dantaveṣṭebhyo yasyākasmāt pravartate | durgandhīni sakṛṣṇāni prakledīni mṛdūni ca ||14||
dantamāṃsāni śīryante pacanti ca parasparam | śītādo nāma sa vyādhiḥ kaphaśoṇitasambhavaḥ ||15||
dantayostriṣu vā yasya śvayathuḥ sarujo ‘śvayathuḥ sparśanāsahaḥ’ iti tā. mahān | dantapuppuṭako jñeyaḥ kapharaktanimittajaḥ ||16||
sravanti pūyarudhiraṃ calā dantā bhavanti ca | dantaveṣṭaḥ sa vijñeyo duṣṭaśoṇitasambhavaḥ ||17||
śvayathurdantamūleṣu rujāvān kapharaktajaḥ kaphasambhavaḥ’ iti tā| lālāsrāvī sa vijñeyaḥ kaṇḍūmāñ ‘śauṣiro nāma nāmataḥ’ iti tā. śauṣiro gadaḥ ||18||
dantāścalanti veṣṭebhyastālu cāpyavadīryate | dantamāṃsāni pacyante mukhaṃ ca paripīḍyate ||19||
yasmin sa sarvajo vyādhirmahāśauṣirasañjñakaḥ | dantamāṃsāni śīryante yasmin ṣṭhīvati cāpyasṛk ‘cāsakṛt’ iti tā.||20||

pittāsṛkkaphajo vyādhirjñeyaḥ paridaro hi saḥ | veṣṭeṣu dāhaḥ pākaśca tebhyo dantāścalanti ca asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘dāhena veṣṭāstaptāśca śuṣyante cāgninā yathā’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate||21||
āghaṭṭitāḥ prasravanti śoṇitaṃ mandavedanāḥ | ādhmāyante srute rakte mukhaṃ pūti ca jāyate ||22||
yasminnupakuśaḥ sa syāt ‘yasmin sopakuśo nāma’ iti pā. pittaraktakṛto gadaḥ | ghṛṣṭeṣu dantamūleṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān ||23||
bhavanti ca calā dantāḥ sa vaidarbho'bhighātajaḥ | mārutenādhiko danto jāyate tīvravedanaḥ ||24||
vardhanaḥ sa mato vyādhirjāte ‘khalivardhanasañjño'sau’ iti mādhavanidāne pā. ruk ca praśāmyati | hānavye paścime dante mahāñchotho mahārujaḥ ||25||
lālāsrāvī kaphakṛto vijñeyaḥ so'dhimāṃsakaḥ | dantamūlagatā nāḍyaḥ pañca jñeyā yatheritāḥ ||26||
dantagatāstu- dālanaḥ, krimidantako, dantaharṣo, bhañjanakaḥ, dantaśarkarā, kapālikā, śyāvadantako, hanumokṣaśceti ||27||
dālyante ‘dīryamāṇeṣviva rujā yasya danteṣu jāyate| dālano nāma sa vyādhiḥ’ iti tā. bahudhā dantā yasmiṃstīvraruganvitāḥ | dālanaḥ sa iti jñeyaḥ sadāgatinimittajaḥ ||28||
kṛṣṇaśchidrī calaḥ srāvī sasaṃrambho mahārujaḥ | animittarujo vātādvijñeyaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ ||29||

śītamuṣṇaṃ ca daśanāḥ ‘śītarūkṣapravātāmlasparśānāmasahā dvijāḥ| pittamārutakopena dantaharṣaḥ sa nāmataḥ’ iti mādhavanidāne pāṭhaḥ sahante sparśanaṃ na ca | yasya taṃ dantaharṣaṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt samīraṇāt ||30||
vaktraṃ vakraṃ bhavedyasmin ‘bhavedyasya dantabhaṅgaśca jāyate’ iti tā. dantabhaṅgaśca tīvraruk | kaphavātakṛto vyādhiḥ sa bhañjanakasañjñitaḥ ||31||

śarkareva ‘malo dantagato yastu pittamārutaśoṣitaḥ| śarkareva kharasparśā sā jñeyā dantaśarkarā’ iti mādhavanidāne sthirībhūto malo danteṣu yasya vai | sā dantānāṃ guṇaharī vijñeyā dantaśarkarā ||32||
dalanti dantavalkāni yadā śarkarayā saha | jñeyā kapālikā saiva daśanānāṃ vināśinī ‘kapāleṣviva dīryatsu dantānāṃ saiva śarkarā| kapāliketi vijñeyā sadā dantavināśinī’ iti tā.||33||
yo'sṛṅmiśreṇa pittena dagdho dantastvaśeṣataḥ | śyāvatāṃ nīlatāṃ vā'pi gataḥ sa śyāvadantakaḥ ||34||
vātena taistairbhāvaistu hanusandhirvisaṃhataḥ ‘visaṅgataḥ’ iti tā.| hanumokṣa iti jñeyo vyādhirarditalakṣaṇaḥ ||35||
jihvāgatāstu- kaṇṭakāstrividhāstribhirdoṣaiḥ, alāsa, upajihvikā ceti ||36||

jihvā'nilena sphuṭitā prasuptā bhavecca śākacchadanaprakāśā | pittena ‘pittāt sadāhairanucīyate ca dīrghaiḥ’ iti tā. pītā paridahyate ca citā saraktairapi kaṇṭakaiśca | kaphena gurvī bahalā citā ca māṃsodgamaiḥ śālmalikaṇṭakābhaiḥ ||37||
jihvātale ‘adhogato yaḥ’ iti tā. yaḥ śvayathuḥ pragāḍhaḥ so'lāsasañjñaḥ kapharaktamūrtiḥ | jihvāṃ sa tu stambhayati pravṛddho mūle tu jihvā bhṛśameti pākam ||38||

jihvāgrarūpaḥ śvayathurhi jihvāmunnamya jātaḥ kapharaktayoniḥ ‘kapharaktamūlaḥ| lālākaraḥ kaṇḍuyutaḥ sacoṣaḥ sa tūpajihvā kathitā bhiṣagbhiḥ’ iti pā.| prasekakaṇḍūparidāhayuktā prakathyate'sāvupajihviketi ||39||
tālugatāstu- galaśuṇḍikā, tuṇḍikerī, adhruṣaḥ, kacchapaḥ, arbudaṃ, māṃsasaṅghātaḥ, tālupuppuṭaḥ, tāluśoṣaḥ, tālupāka iti ||40||
śleṣmāsṛgbhyāṃ tālumūlāt pravṛddho dīrghaḥ śopho dhmātabastiprakāśaḥ | tṛṣṇākāsaśvāsakṛt sampradiṣṭo vyādhirvaidyaiḥ kaṇṭhaśuṇḍīti nāmnā ||41||

śophaḥ sthūlastodadāhaprapākī prāguktābhyāṃ tuṇḍikerī matā tu | śophaḥ ‘mṛduḥ śotho lohitastāludeśe jñeyo'dhruṣaḥ sajvarastīvraruk ca’ iti tā. stabdho lohitastāludeśe raktājjñeyaḥ so'dhruṣo rugjvarāḍhyaḥ ||42||
kūrmotsanno'vedano'śīghrajanmā'rakto ‘kūrmonnataḥ’ iti tā. jñeyaḥ kacchapaḥ śleṣmaṇā syāt | padmākāraṃ tālumadhye tu śophaṃ vidyādraktādarbudaṃ proktaliṅgam ||43||

duṣṭaṃ māṃsaṃ śleṣmaṇā nīrujaṃ ca tālvantaḥsthaṃ māṃsasaṅghātamāhuḥ | nīruk ‘aruk sthiraḥ kolamātraḥ kaphena samedasā’ iti tā. sthāyī kolamātraḥ kaphāt syānmedoyuktāt ‘medoyuktaḥ’ iti pā. puppuṭastāludeśe ||44||

śoṣo'tyarthaṃ śuṣyatyatyarthaṃ’ iti tā. dīryate cāpi tāluḥ śvāso ‘śvāsaścaivograstāluśoṣo'nilāttu’ iti tā. vātāttāluśoṣaḥ sapittāt | pittaṃ kuryāt pākamatyarthaghoraṃ tālunyenaṃ tālupākaṃ vadanti ||45||
kaṇṭhagatāstu- rohiṇyaḥ pañca, kaṇṭhaśālūkam, adhijihvo, balayo, balāsa ‘alāsaḥ’ iti tā., ekavṛndo, vṛndaḥ, śataghnī, gilāyuḥ, galavidradhiḥ, galaughaḥ, svaraghno, māṃsatāno, vidārī ceti ||46||

gale'nilaḥ pittakaphau ca mūrcchitau pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam ‘pradūṣya māṃsaṃ ca tathaiva śoṇitam| galopasaṃrodhakaraistathā'ṅkurairhinastyasūn vyādhirayaṃ hi rohiṇī’ iti tā.| pradūṣya māṃsaṃ galarodhino'ṅkurān sṛjanti yān sā'suharā hi rohiṇī ||47||
jihvāṃ samantādbhṛśavedanā ye māṃsāṅkurāḥ kaṇṭhanirodhinaḥ syuḥ | tāṃ rohiṇīṃ vātakṛtāṃ vadanti vātātmakopadravagāḍhayuktām ‘tisraśca tāstvādita eva kṛcchrāḥ’ iti tā.||48||

kṣiprodgamā kṣipravidāhapākā tīvrajvarā pittanimittajā syāt | srotonirodhinyapi ‘srotovirodhinyacalonnatā ca sthirāṅkurā yā kaphasambhavā sā’ iti tā. mandapākā gurvī sthirā sā kaphasambhavā vai ||49||
gambhīrapākā'prativāravīryā tridoṣaliṅgā trayasambhavā syāt | sphoṭācitā pittasamānaliṅgā'sādhyā pradiṣṭā rudhirātmikeyam ||50||
kolāsthimātraḥ kaphasambhavo yo granthirgale kaṇṭakaśūkabhūtaḥ | kharaḥ sthiraḥ śastranipātasādhyastaṃ kaṇṭhaśālūkamiti bruvanti ||51||
jihvāgrarūpaḥ śvayathuḥ kaphāttu jihvāprabandhopari jihvopariṣṭādapi’ iti tā. raktamiśrāt | jñeyo'dhijihvaḥ khalu roga eṣa vivarjayedāgatapākamenam ||52||
balāsa evāyatamunnataṃ ca śophaṃ karotyannagatiṃ nivārya | taṃ sarvathaivāprativāravīryaṃ vivarjanīyaṃ valayaṃ vadanti ||53||
gale tu śophaṃ kurutaḥ pravṛddhau śleṣmānilau śvāsarujopapannam | marmacchidaṃ dustarametadāhurbalāsasañjñaṃ ‘...ralāsasañjñaṃ’ iti tā. nipuṇā vikāram ||54||
vṛttonnato yaḥ śvayathuḥ sadāhaḥ kaṇḍvanvito'pākyamṛdurguruśca | nāmnaikavṛndaḥ parikīrtito'sau vyādhirbalāsakṣatajaprasūtaḥ ||55||
samunnataṃ vṛttamamandadāhaṃ tīvrajvaraṃ vṛndamudāharanti | taṃ cāpi pittakṣatajaprakopādvidyāt satodaṃ pavanāsrajaṃ tu ‘pavanātmakaṃ’ iti pā.||56||
vartirghanā kaṇṭhanirodhinī yā citā'timātraṃ piśitaprarohaiḥ | nānārujocchrāyakarī ‘anekaruk prāṇaharī trirātrājjñeyā śataghnī tu śataghnirūpā’ iti tā. tridoṣājjñeyā śataghnīva śataghnyasādhyā ||57||
granthirgale tvāmalakāsthimātraḥ sthiro'lparuk syāt kapharaktamūrtiḥ ‘kaphapittamūrtiḥ| yo lakṣyate raktamivāsravaśca’ iti tā.| saṃlakṣyate saktamivāśanaṃ ca sa śastrasādhyastu gilāyusañjñaḥ ||58||
sarvaṃ galaṃ vyāpya samutthito yaḥ śopho rujo yatra ca santi sarvāḥ | sa sarvadoṣo galavidradhistu tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasya ||59||
śopho mahānannajalāvarodhī tīvrajvaro vātagaternihantā | kaphena jāto rudhirānvitena gale galaughaḥ parikīrtyate'sau ||60||
yo'tipratāmyan śvasiti prasaktaṃ bhinnasvaraḥ śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭhaḥ | kaphopadigdheṣvanilāyaneṣu jñeyaḥ sa rogaḥ śvasanāt svaraghnaḥ ||61||
pratānavān yaḥ śvayathuḥ sukaṣṭo galoparodhaṃ kurute krameṇa | sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito'valambī prāṇapraṇut sarvakṛto vikāraḥ ||62||
sadāhatodaṃ śvayathuṃ saraktamantargale pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsam | pittena vidyādvadane vidārīṃ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete ||63||
sarvasarāstu vātapittakaphaśoṇitanimittāḥ ||64||
sphoṭaiḥ satodairvadanaṃ samantādyasyācitaṃ sarvasaraḥ sa vātāt | raktaiḥ sadāhaistanubhiḥ sapītairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa pittakopāt ||65||

kaṇḍūyutairalparujaiḥ ‘avedanaiḥ kaṇḍuyutaiḥ sadāhaiḥ’ iti tā. savarṇairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa vai kaphena | raktena pittodita eka eva kaiścit pradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ asyāgre tāḍapatrapustake ‘sūtre pradiṣṭaṃ daśa ṣaṭ ca pūrvaṃ sthānaṃ nidānaṃ bhavatīti yacca| savistaraṃ tatkathitaṃ mayeha svayambhunā yat kathitaṃ hitāya’ ityadhikaḥ śloka upalabhyate||66||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānasthāne mukharoganidānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16|| iti bhagavatā śrīdhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ tacchiṣyeṇa maharṣiṇā suśrutena viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyaṃ nidānasthānaṃ samāptam |

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvabhūtacintāśārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇamakāraṇaṃ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇamaṣṭarūpamakhilasya ‘akhilasyāsya’ iti tā. jagataḥ sambhavaheturavyaktaṃ nāma | tadekaṃ bahūnāṃ ‘anekeṣāṃ’ iti pā. kṣetrajñānāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ samudra ivaudakānāṃ bhāvānām ||3||

tasmādavyaktānmahānutpadyate talliṅga eva | talliṅgācca mahatastallakṣaṇa evāhaṅkāra utpadyate; sa ‘sa tu’ iti pā. trividho vaikārikastaijaso bhūtādiriti | tatra vaikārikādahaṅkārāttaijasasahāyāttallakṣaṇānyevaikādaśendriyāṇyutpadyante, tadyathā- śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇavāgghastopasthapāyupādamanāṃsīti; tatra pūrvāṇi pañca buddhīndriyāṇi, itarāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi, ubhayātmakaṃ manaḥ; bhūtāderapi taijasasahāyāttallakṣaṇānyeva pañcatanmātrāṇyutpadyante- śabdatanmātraṃ, sparśatanmātraṃ, rūpatanmātraṃ, rasatanmātraṃ, gandhatanmātramiti; teṣāṃ viśeṣāḥ- śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ; tebhyo bhūtāni- vyomānilānalajalorvyaḥ; evameṣā tattvacaturviṃśatirvyākhyātā ||4||
tatra buddhīndriyāṇāṃ śabdādayo viṣayāḥ; karmendriyāṇāṃ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vacanādānānandavisargaviharaṇāni ||5||
avyaktaṃ mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi cetyaṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ; śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśa vikārāḥ ||6||

svaḥ svaścaiṣāṃ viṣayo'dhibhūtaṃ; svayamadhyātmam; adhidaivatam- atha buddherbrahmā, ahaṅkārasyeśvaraḥ, manasaścandramāḥ, diśaḥ śrotrasya, tvaco vāyuḥ, sūryaścakṣuṣaḥ, rasanasyāpaḥ, pṛthivī ghrāṇasya, vāco'gniḥ, ‘vacaso'gniḥ’ iti pā. hastayorindraḥ, pādayorviṣṇuḥ, pāyormitraḥ, prajāpatirupasthasyeti ||7||

tatra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake na paṭhyate sarva evācetana eṣa vargaḥ, puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥ kāryakāraṇasaṃyuktaścetayitā bhavati | satyapyacaitanye pradhānasya puruṣakaivalyārthaṃ ‘puruṣakaivalyārthaṃ’ iti pā. pravṛttimupadiśanti, kṣīrādīṃścātra hetūnudāharanti ||8||

ata ūrdhvaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ sādharmyavaidharmye vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | tadyathā- ubhāvapyanādī, ubhāvapyanantau, ubhāvapyaliṅgau, ubhāvapi nityau, ubhāvapyanaparau ubhāvapyaparau’ iti pā., ubhau ca sarvagatāviti; ekā tu prakṛtiracetanā triguṇā bījadharmiṇī prasavadharmiṇyamadhyasthadharmiṇī ceti, bahavastu puruṣāścetanāvanto'guṇā abījadharmāṇo'prasavadharmāṇo madhyasthadharmāṇaśceti ||9||
tatra kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamiti kṛtvā sarva evaite viśeṣāḥ sattvarajastamomayā bhavanti; tadañjanatvāttanmayatvācca tadguṇā eva puruṣā bhavantītyeke bhāṣante ||10||
vaidyake tu- svabhāvamīśvaraṃ kālaṃ yadṛcchāṃ niyatiṃ tathā | pariṇāmaṃ ca manyante prakṛtiṃ pṛthudarśinaḥ ||11||
tanmayānyeva ‘tato jātāni’ iti tā. bhūtāni tadguṇānyeva cādiśet | taiśca tallakṣaṇaḥ kṛtsno bhūtagrāmo vyajanyata ||12||
tasyopayogo'bhihitaścikitsāṃ prati sarvadā | bhūtebhyo hi paraṃ yasmānnāsti cintā cikitsite ||13||
yato'bhihitaṃ- “tatsambhavadravyasamūho bhūtādiruktaḥ” (sū.1); bhautikāni cendriyāṇyāyurvede varṇyante, tathendriyārthāḥ ||14||
bhavati cātra- indriyeṇendriyārthaṃ tu svaṃ svaṃ gṛhṇāti mānavaḥ | niyataṃ tulyayonitvānnānyenānyamiti sthitiḥ ||15||

na cāyurvedaśāstreṣūpadiśyante sarvagatāḥ kṣetrajñā nityāśca; asarvagateṣu ca kṣetrajñeṣu nityapuruṣakhyāpakān hetūnudāharanti; āyurvedaśāstreṣvasarvagatāḥ ‘āyurvedaśāstrasiddhānteṣvasarvagatāḥ’ iti pā. kṣetrajñā nityāśca, tiryagyonimānuṣadeveṣu sañcaranti dharmādharmanimittaṃ; ta ete'numānagrāhyāḥ paramasūkṣmāścetanāvantaḥ śāśvatā lohitaretasoḥ ‘śukrārtavayoḥ’ iti tā. sannipāteṣvabhivyajyante, yato'bhihitaṃ- ‘pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣaḥ’ (sū.1) iti; sa eṣa karmapuruṣaścikitsādhikṛtaḥ ||16||
tasya sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnaḥ prāṇāpānāvunmeṣanimeṣau buddhirmanaḥ saṅkalpo vicāraṇā smṛtirvijñānamadhyavasāyo viṣayopalabdhiśca guṇāḥ ||17||

sāttvikāstu- ānṛśaṃsyaṃ saṃvibhāgarucitā titikṣā satyaṃ dharma āstikyaṃ jñānaṃ buddhirmedhā smṛtirdhṛtiranabhiṣaṅgaśca; rājasāstu- duḥkhabahulatā'ṭanaśīlatā'dhṛtirahaṅkāra ānṛtikatvamakāruṇyaṃ dambho māno harṣaḥ kāmaḥ krodhaśca; tāmasāstu- viṣāditvaṃ nāstikyamadharmaśīlatā buddhernirodho'jñānaṃ durmedhastvamakarmaśīlatā nidrālutvaṃ ceti ||18||

āntarikṣāḥ- śabdaḥ śabdendriyaṃ sarvacchidrasamūho viviktatā ca; vāyavyāstu- sparśaḥ sparśendriyaṃ sarvaceṣṭāsamūhaḥ sarvaśarīraspandanaṃ laghutā ca; taijasāstu- rūpaṃ rūpendriyaṃ varṇaḥ santāpo bhrājiṣṇutā paktiramarṣastaikṣṇyaṃ śauryaṃ ca; āpyāstu- raso rasanendriyaṃ sarvadravasamūho gurutā śaityaṃ sneho retaśca; pārthivāstu- gandho gandhendriyaṃ sarvamūrtasamūho gurutā ceti ||19||
tatra sattvabahulamākāśaṃ, rajobahulo vāyuḥ, sattvarajobahulo'gniḥ, sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ, tamobahulā pṛthivīti ||20||
ślokau cātra bhavataḥ- anyo'nyānupraviṣṭāni sarvāṇyetāni nirdiśet | sve sve dravye tu sarveṣāṃ vyaktaṃ lakṣaṇamiṣyate ||21||
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktā vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu | kṣetrajñaśca samāsena svatantraparatantrayoḥ ‘svatantraparatantrataḥ’ iti pā.||22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ śārīrasthāne sarvabhūtacintāśārīraṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||

div.head: śukraśoṇitaśuddhiśārīram

ab.seg: athātaḥ śukraśoṇitaśuddhiśārīraṃ ‘śukraśoṇitaśuddhiṃ nāma śārīraṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vāta-pitta-śleṣma-kuṇapa ‘kuṇapagandhi’ iti pā. -granthi-pūtipūya-kṣīṇa-mūtrapurīṣaretasaḥ prajotpādane na samarthā bhavanti ||3||

teṣu vātavarṇavedanaṃ vātena, pittavarṇavedanaṃ pittena, śleṣmavarṇavedanaṃ śleṣmaṇā, kuṇapagandhyanalpaṃ ca raktena, granthibhūtaṃ śleṣmavātābhyāṃ, pūtipūyanibhaṃ pittaśleṣmabhyāṃ, kṣīṇaṃ prāguktaṃ pittamārutābhyāṃ, mūtrapurīṣagandhi sannipāteneti | teṣu kuṇapagranthipūtipūyakṣīṇaretasaḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ, mūtrapurīṣaretasastvasādhyā iti ||4||

ārtavamapi tribhirdoṣaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiḥ pṛthagdvandvaiḥ samastaiścopasṛṣṭamabījaṃ bhavati; tadapi doṣavarṇavedanādibhirvijñeyam | teṣu kuṇapagranthipūtipūyakṣīṇamūtrapurīṣaprakāśamasādhyaṃ ‘…granthipūya’ iti pā., sādhyamanyacceti ||5||

div.ab: bhavanti cātra- teṣvādyāñ śukradoṣāṃstrīn snehasvedādibhirjayet | kriyāviśeṣairmatimāṃstathā cottarabastibhiḥ ||6|| pāyayeta naraṃ sarpirbhiṣak kuṇaparetasi | dhātakīpuṣpakhadiradāḍimārjunasādhitam ||7|| pāyayedathavā sarpiḥ śālasārādisādhitam | granthibhūte śaṭīsiddhaṃ ‘'śmabhitsiddhaṃ’ iti pā. pālāśe vā'pi bhasmani ||8|| parūṣakavaṭādibhyāṃ pūyaprakhye ca sādhitam | prāguktaṃ vakṣyate yacca tat kāryaṃ kṣīṇaretasi ||9|| viṭprabhe pāyayet ‘tu pibet’ iti pā. siddhaṃ citrakośīrahiṅgubhiḥ asyāgre ‘snehādiśca kramaḥ kāryaḥ ṣaṭsvetāsu vijānatā’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacidupalabhyate| snigdhaṃ vāntaṃ viriktaṃ ca nirūḍhamanuvāsitam ||10|| yojayecchukradoṣārtaṃ samyaguttarabastinā |11|
sphaṭikābhaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ madhugandhi ca ||11|| śukramicchanti, kecittu tailakṣaudranibhaṃ tathā |12|

ab.seg: vidhimuttarabastyantaṃ kuryādārtavaśuddhaye ||12||
strīṇāṃ snehādiyuktānāṃ catasṛṣvārtavārtiṣu | kuryātkalkān picūṃścāpi pathyānyācamanāni ca ||13||
granthibhūte pibet pāṭhāṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣakāṇi ca | durgandhipūyasaṅkāśe ‘durgandhe pūyasaṅkāśe’ iti pā. majjatulye tathā''rtave ||14||
pibedbhadraśriyaḥ ‘bhadraśriyaṃ’ iti pā. kvāthaṃ candanakvāthameva ca | śukradoṣaharāṇāṃ ca yathāsvamavacāraṇam ||15||
yogānāṃ ‘doṣāṇāṃ’ iti pā. śuddhikaraṇaṃ śeṣāsvapyārtavārtiṣu | annaṃ śāliyavaṃ madyaṃ hitaṃ māṃsaṃ ca pittalam ||16||
śaśāsṛkpratimaṃ yattu yadvā lākṣārasopamam | tadārtavaṃ praśaṃsanti yadvāso ‘yadvā'psu na virajyate’ iti tā. na virañjayet ||17||

div.ab: tadevātiprasaṅgena pravṛttamanṛtāvapi | asṛgdaraṃ vijānīyādato'nyadraktalakṣaṇāt ‘vijānīyāduktalakṣaṇalakṣitam’ iti pā.| vijānīyādraktalakṣaṇalakṣitam’ iti tā.||18|| asṛgdaro bhavet sarvaḥ sāṅgamardaḥ savedanaḥ | tasyātivṛttau ‘atipravṛttau’ iti tā. daurbalyaṃ bhramo mūrcchā tamastṛṣā ‘madastṛṣā’ iti tā.||19|| dāhaḥ pralāpaḥ pāṇḍutvaṃ tandrā rogāśca vātajāḥ | taruṇyā hitasevinyāstamalpopadravaṃ bhiṣak ||20|| raktapittavidhānena yathāvat samupācaret |21|

ab.seg: doṣairāvṛtamārgatvādārtavaṃ naśyati striyāḥ ||21||
tatra matsyakulatthāmlatilamāṣasurā ‘māṃsa... iti tā hitāḥ | pāne mūtramudaśvicca dadhi śuktaṃ ca bhojane ||22||
kṣīṇaṃ prāgīritaṃ raktaṃ salakṣaṇacikitsitam | tathā'pyatra ‘athāpyatra’ iti pā. vidhātavyaṃ vidhānaṃ naṣṭaraktavat ||23||
evamaduṣṭaśukraḥ śuddhārtavā ca ||24||

ṛtau prathamadivasāt prabhṛti brahmacāriṇī divāsvapnāñjanāśrupātasnānānulepanābhyaṅganakhacchedanapradhāvanahasanakathanātiśabdaśravaṇāvalekhanānilāyāsān pariharet | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? divā svapantyāḥ svāpaśīlaḥ, añjanādandhaḥ, rodanādvikṛtadṛṣṭiḥ, snānānulepanādduḥkhaśīlaḥ ‘…dduḥśīlaḥ’ iti tā., tailābhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhī, nakhāpakartanāt kunakhī, pradhāvanāccañcalaḥ, hasanācchyāvadantauṣṭhatālujihvaḥ, pralāpī cātikathanāt ‘pralepanāt’ iti pā., atiśabdaśravaṇādbadhiraḥ, avalekhanāt khalatiḥ, mārutāyāsasevanādunmatto garbho bhavatītyevametān pariharet | darbhasaṃstaraśāyinīṃ karatalaśarāvaparṇānyatamabhojinīṃ haviṣyaṃ, tryahaṃ ca bhartuḥ saṃrakṣet | tataḥ śuddhasnātāṃ caturthe'hanyahatavāsaḥsamalaṅkṛtāṃ ‘anāhatavastravāsinīṃ’ iti tā. kṛtamaṅgalasvastivācanāṃ bhartāraṃ darśayet | tat kasya hetoḥ? ||25||
pūrvaṃ paśyedṛtusnātā yādṛśaṃ naramaṅganā | tādṛśaṃ janayet putraṃ bhartāraṃ darśayedataḥ ||26||
tato vidhānaṃ putrīyamupādhyāyaḥ samācaret | karmānte ca kramaṃ hyetamārabheta vicakṣaṇaḥ ||27||

tato'parāhṇe pumān māsaṃ brahmacārī sarpiḥsnigdhaḥ sarpiḥkṣīrābhyāṃ śālyodanaṃ bhuktvā ‘abhiprāśya’ iti tā. māsaṃ brahmacāriṇīṃ tailasnigdhāṃ tailamāṣottarāhārāṃ nārīmupeyādrātrau sāmabhirabhiviśvāsya ‘āśvāsya’ iti pā.; vikalpyaivaṃ caturthyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāmaṣṭamyāṃ daśamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ copeyāditi …‘dataḥ paraṃ māsādupeyāt, labdhagarbhāṃ naiva ca’ iti tā. putrakāmaḥ ||28||
eṣūttarottaraṃ vidyādāyurārogyameva ca | prajāsaubhāgyamaiśvaryaṃ balaṃ ca divaseṣu vai ||29||
ataḥ paraṃ pañcamyāṃ saptamyāṃ navamyāmekādaśyāṃ ca strīkāmaḥ; trayodaśīprabhṛtayo nindyāḥ ||30||

tatra prathame divase ṛtumatyāṃ maithunagamanamanāyuṣyaṃ puṃsāṃ bhavati, yaśca tatrādhīyate garbhaḥ sa prasavamāno vimucyate ‘vipadyate’ iti tā.; dvitīye'pyevaṃ sūtikāgṛhe vā; tṛtīye'pyevamasampūrṇāṅgo'lpāyurvā bhavati; caturthe tu sampūrṇāṅgo dīrghāyuśca bhavati | na ca pravartamāne rakte bījaṃ praviṣṭaṃ guṇakaraṃ bhavati, yathā nadyāṃ pratisrotaḥ plāvidravyaṃ prakṣiptaṃ pratinivartate nordhvaṃ gacchati tadvadetaddraṣṭavyam | tasmānniyamavatīṃ trirātraṃ pariharet | ataḥ paraṃ māsādupeyāt ||31||

labdhagarbhāyāścaiteṣvahaḥsu lakṣmaṇāvaṭaśuṅgasahadevāviśvadevānāmanyatamāṃ kṣīreṇābhiṣutya trīṃścaturo vā bindūn dadyāddakṣiṇe nāsāpuṭe putrakāmāyai asyāgre ‘vāme duhitṛkāmāyai’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate kvacitpustake, na ca tānniṣṭhīvet ||32||
dhruvaṃ caturṇāṃ sānnidhyādgarbhaḥ syādvidhipūrvakam | ṛtukṣetrāmbubījānāṃ sāmagryādaṅkuro yathā ||33||
evaṃ jātā rūpavantaḥ sattvavantaścirāyuṣaḥ ‘mahāsattvā’... iti pā.| bhavantyṛṇasya moktāraḥ satputrāḥ putriṇe hitāḥ ||34||

tatra tejodhāturvarṇānāṃ ‘sarvavarṇānāṃ’ iti pā. prabhavaḥ, sa yadā garbhotpattāvabdhātuprāyo bhavati tadā garbhaṃ gauraṃ karoti, pṛthivīdhātuprāyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ, pṛthivyākāśadhātuprāyaḥ kṛṣṇaśyāmaṃ, toyākāśadhātuprāyo gauraśyāmam | ‘yādṛgvarṇamāhāramupasevate garbhiṇī tādṛgvarṇaprasavā bhavati’ ityeke bhāṣante | tatra dṛṣṭibhāgamapratipannaṃ tejo jātyandhaṃ karoti, tadeva raktānugataṃ raktākṣaṃ, pittānugataṃ piṅgākṣaṃ, śleṣmānugataṃ śuklākṣaṃ, vātānugataṃ vikṛtākṣamiti asyāgre tā. pustake “bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ-viśuddhaḥ pavano yasya nayane pratipadyate| jāyete nayane tasya nimne kṛṣṇe site tathā|| pittaṃ kaphayutaṃ yasya nirmalaṃ yāti locane| haripiṅgalasañjñe vai jāyete tasya locane|| vinirdhūtamalaḥ śleṣmā yadā vrajati locane| tasya netre prakāśete śuklamaṇḍalamaṇḍale|| raktaṃ kaphayutaṃ yasya yadā vrajati locane| kapotanīle nayane rakte vā jāyate nṝṇām” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhvate||35||
bhavanti cātra- ghṛtapiṇḍo yathaivāgnimāśritaḥ pravilīyate | visarpatyārtavaṃ nāryāstathā ‘puruṣasya samāgamāt’ iti tā. puṃsāṃ samāgame ||36||

bīje'ntarvāyunā bhinne dvau jīvau kukṣimāgatau | yamāvityabhidhīyete dharmetarapuraḥsarau asyāgre tā. pustake ‘miśrībhāve yadā puṃsāṃ retastu bahu nirmalam| tadā prasūyate nārī garbhiṇī dārakadvayam|| miśrībhāve striyāścaiva bahu śukraṃ yadā bhavet| kanyādvayaṃ tadā nārī sūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate||37||
pitroratyalpabījatvādāsekyaḥ puruṣo bhavet | sa śukraṃ prāśya labhate dhvajocchrāyamasaṃśayam ||38||
yaḥ pūtiyonau jāyeta sa saugandhikasañjñitaḥ | sa yoniśephasorgandhamāghrāya labhate balam ||39||

div.ab: sve gude'brahmacaryādyaḥ strīṣu puṃvat pravartate | kumbhīkaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ... |40|
...īrṣyakaṃ śṛṇu cāparam ||40|| dṛṣṭvā vyavāyamanyeṣāṃ vyavāye yaḥ pravartate | īrṣyakaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ,... |41|

ab.seg: ...ṣaṇḍhakaṃ śṛṇu pañcamam ||41||
yo bhāryāyāmṛtau mohādaṅganeva pravartate | tataḥ strīceṣṭitākāro jāyate ṣaṇḍhasañjñitaḥ ||42||
ṛtau puruṣavadvā'pi pravartetāṅganā yadi | tatra kanyā yadi bhavet sā bhavennaraceṣṭitā ||43||
āsekyaśca sugandhī ca kumbhīkaścerṣyakastathā | saretasastvamī jñeyā aśukraḥ ṣaṇḍhasañjñitaḥ ||44||
anayā viprakṛtyā tu teṣāṃ śukravahāḥ sirāḥ | harṣāt sphuṭatvamāyānti dhvajocchrāyastato bhavet ||45||
āhārācāraceṣṭābhiryādṛśībhiḥ samanvitau | strīpuṃsau samupeyātāṃ tayoḥ putro'pi garbho'pi’ iti tā. tādṛśaḥ ||46||
yadā nāryāvupeyātāṃ vṛṣasyantyau kathañcana | muñcataḥ ‘muñcantyau’ iti pā. śukramanyonyamanasthistatra jāyate ||47||
ṛtusnātā tu yā nārī svapne maithunamāvahet | ārtavaṃ vāyurādāya kukṣau garbhaṃ karoti hi ||48||
māsi māsi vivardheta garbhiṇyā garbhalakṣaṇam | kalalaṃ jāyate tasyā varjitaṃ paitṛkairguṇaiḥ ||49||
sarpavṛścikakūṣmāṇḍavikṛtākṛtayaśca ye | garbhāstvete striyāścaiva ‘garbhā evaṃvidhāścānye’ iti tā. jñeyāḥ pāpakṛto bhṛśam ||50||
garbho vātaprakopeṇa dauhṛde ‘daurhṛdena vimānitaḥ’ iti tā. vā'vamānite | bhavet kubjaḥ kuṇiḥ paṅgurmūko minmiṇa eva vā ||51||
mātāpitrostu nāstikyādaśubhaiśca purākṛtaiḥ | vātādīnāṃ prakopeṇa garbho vaikṛtamāpnuyāt ||52||
malālpatvādayogācca vāyoḥ pakvāśayasya ca | vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi na garbhasthaḥ karoti hi ||53||
jarāyuṇā mukhe cchanne kaṇṭhe ca kaphaveṣṭite | vāyormārganirodhācca ‘vāyorgatinirodhācca’ iti tā. na garbhasthaḥ praroditi ||54||
niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṅkṣobhasvapnān garbho'dhigacchati | māturniśvasitocchvāsasaṅkṣobhasvapnasambhavān ||55||
sanniveśaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ dantānāṃ patanodbhavau | taleṣvasambhavo yaśca romṇāmetat svabhāvataḥ ||56||
bhāvitāḥ pūrvadeheṣu satataṃ śāstrabuddhayaḥ | bhavanti sattvabhūyiṣṭhāḥ pūrvajātismarā narāḥ ||57||
karmaṇā codito yena tadāpnoti punarbhave | abhyastāḥ pūrvadehe ye tāneva bhajate guṇān ||58||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ śārīrasthāne śukraśoṇitaśuddhiśārīraṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
athāto garbhāvakrāntiṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
saumyaṃ śukramārtavamāgneyamitareṣāmapyatra ‘api’ iti pā. bhūtānāṃ sānnidhyamastyaṇunā viśeṣeṇa, parasparopakārāt (parasparānugrahāt,) parasparānupraveśācca ||3||

tatra strīpuṃsayoḥ saṃyoge tejaḥ śarīrādvāyurudīrayati, tatastejonilasannipātācchukraṃ cyutaṃ yonimabhipratipadyate saṃsṛjyate cārtavena, tato'gnīṣomasaṃyogāt saṃsṛjyamāno garbhāśayamanupratipadyate kṣetrajño vedayitā spraṣṭā ghrātā draṣṭā śrotā rasayitā puruṣaḥ sraṣṭā gantā sākṣī dhātā vaktā yaḥ ko'sāvityevamādibhiḥ paryāyavācakairnāmabhirabhidhīyate daivasaṃyogādakṣayo'vyayo'cintyo bhūtātmanā sahānvakṣaṃ sattvarajastamobhirdaivāsurairaparaiśca bhāvairvāyunā'bhipreryamāṇo garbhāśayamanupraviśyāvatiṣṭhate ||4||
tatra śukrabāhulyāt pumān, ārtavabāhulyāt strī, sāmyādubhayornapuṃsakamiti ||5||
ṛtustu dvādaśarātraṃ bhavati dṛṣṭārtavaḥ; adṛṣṭārtavā'pyastītyeke bhāṣante ||6||
bhavanti cātra- pīnaprasannavadanāṃ praklinnātmamukhadvijām | narakāmāṃ priyakathāṃ srastakukṣyakṣimūrdhajām ||7||
sphuradbhujakucaśroṇinābhyūrujaghanasphicām | harṣautsukyaparāṃ cāpi vidyādṛtumatīmiti ‘...dṛtumatīṃ striyam’ iti tā.||8||
niyataṃ divase'tīte saṅkucatyambujaṃ yathā | ṛtau vyatīte nāryāstu yoniḥ saṃvriyate tathā ||9||
māsenopacitaṃ kāle dhamanībhyāṃ tadārtavam | īṣatkṛṣṇaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca vāyuryonimukhaṃ nayet ||10||
tadvarṣāddvādaśāt kāle vartamānamasṛk punaḥ | jarāpakvaśarīrāṇāṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam ||11||
yugmeṣu tu pumān prokto divaseṣvanyathā'balā | puṣpakāle śucistasmādapatyārtho striyaṃ vrajet ||12||
tatra sadyogṛhītagarbhāyā liṅgāni- śramo glāniḥ pipāsā sakthisadanaṃ śukraśoṇitayoravabandhaḥ sphuraṇaṃ ca yoneḥ ||13||
stanayoḥ kṛṣṇamukhatā romarājyudgamastathā | akṣipakṣmāṇi cāpyasyāḥ sammīlyante viśeṣataḥ ||14||
akāmataśchardayati gandhādudvijate śubhāt | prasekaḥ sadanaṃ cāpi garbhiṇyā liṅgamucyate ||15||

tadā prabhṛti ‘prabhṛtyeva’ iti pā. vyavāyaṃ vyāyāmamatitarpaṇamatikarśanaṃ divāsvapnaṃ rātrijāgaraṇaṃ śokaṃ yānārohaṇaṃ ‘yānāvarohaṇaṃ’ iti pā. bhayamutkuṭukāsanaṃ caikāntataḥ snehādikriyāṃ śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ cākāle vegavidhāraṇaṃ ca na seveta ||16||
doṣābhighātairgarbhiṇyā yo yo bhāgaḥ prapīḍyate | sa sa bhāgaḥ śiśostasya garbhasthasya prapīḍyate ||17||

tatra prathame māsi kalalaṃ jāyate; dvitīye śītoṣmānilairabhiprapacyamānānāṃ mahābhūtānāṃ saṅghāto ghanaḥ sañjāyate, yadi piṇḍaḥ pumān, strī cet peśī, napuṃsakaṃ cedarbudamiti; tṛtīye hastapādaśirasāṃ pañcapiṇḍakā nirvartante'ṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaśca sūkṣmo bhavati; caturthe sarvāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaḥ pravyakto bhavati, garbhahṛdayapravyaktibhāvāccetanādhāturabhivyakto bhavati, kasmāt? tatsthānatvāt | tasmādgarbhaścaturthe māsyabhiprāyamindriyārtheṣu karoti, dvihṛdayāṃ ca nārīṃ dauhṛdinīmācakṣate | dauhṛdavimānanāt kubjaṃ kuṇiṃ khañjaṃ jaḍaṃ vāmanaṃ vikṛtākṣamanakṣaṃ vā nārī sutaṃ janayati, tasmāt sā yadyadicchettattasyai dāpayet, labdhadauhṛdā hi vīryavantaṃ cirāyuṣaṃ ca putraṃ janayati ||18||
bhavanti cātra- indriyārthāṃstu yān yān sā bhoktumicchati garbhiṇī garbhābādhabhayāttāṃstān bhiṣagāhṛtya dāpayet ||19||
sā prāptadauhṛdā putraṃ janayeta guṇānvitam | alabdhadauhṛdā garbhe labhetātmani vā bhayam ||20||
yeṣu yeṣvindriyārtheṣu dauhṛde vai vimānanā | prajāyeta sutasyārtistasmiṃstasmiṃstathendriye ||21||
rājasandarśane yasyā daurhṛdaṃ jāyate striyāḥ | arthavantaṃ mahābhāgaṃ kumāraṃ sā prasūyate ||22||
dukūlapaṭṭakauśeyabhūṣaṇādiṣu dauhṛdāt | alaṅkāraiṣiṇaṃ putraṃ lalitaṃ sā prasūyate ||23||
āśrame saṃyatātmānaṃ dharmaśīlaṃ prasūyate | devatāpratimāyāṃ tu prasūte pārṣadopamam | darśane vyālajātīnāṃ hiṃsāśīlaṃ prasūyate ||24||
godhāmāṃsāśane putraṃ suṣupsuṃ dhāraṇātmakam ‘dhāvanātmakam’ iti pā.| gavāṃ māṃse tu balinaṃ sarvakleśasahaṃ tathā ||25||
māhiṣe daurhṛdācchūraṃ raktākṣaṃ lomasaṃyutam ‘lomaśaṃ sutam’ iti pā.| varāhamāṃsāt svapnāluṃ śūraṃ sañjanayet sutam ||26||
mārgādvikrāntajaṅghālaṃ sadā vanacaraṃ sutam | sṛmarādvignamanasaṃ nityabhītaṃ ca taittirāt ||27||
ato'nukteṣu yā nārī samabhidhyāti daurhṛdam | śarīrācāraśīlaiḥ sā samānaṃ janayiṣyati ||28||
karmaṇā coditaṃ jantorbhavitavyaṃ punarbhavet | yathā tathā daivayogāddaurhṛdaṃ janayeddhṛdi ||29||

pañcame manaḥ pratibuddhataraṃ bhavati, ṣaṣṭhe buddhiḥ, saptame sarvāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaḥ pravyaktataraḥ; aṣṭame'sthirībhavatyojaḥ ‘asthiraṃ bhavati’ iti pā., tatra jātaścenna jīvennirojastvānnaiṛutabhāgatvācca ‘naiṛutabhāgadheyatvāt’ iti pā., tato baliṃ māṃsaudanamasmai dāpayet; navamadaśamaikādaśadvādaśānāmanyatamasmiñjāyate, ato'nyathā vikārī bhavati ||30||

mātustu khalu rasavahāyāṃ nāḍyāṃ garbhanābhināḍīpratibaddhā, sā'sya māturāhārarasavīryamabhivahati | tenopasnehenāsyābhivṛddhirbhavati | asañjātāṅgapratyaṅgapravibhāgamāniṣekāt asañjātāṅgapratyaṅgavibhāgaṃ tu garbhaṃ niṣekāt prabhṛti’ iti pā. prabhṛti sarvaśarīrāvayavānusāriṇīnāṃ rasavahānāṃ tiryaggatānāṃ dhamanīnāmupasneho jīvayati ||31||

garbhasya khalu sambhavataḥ pūrvaṃ śiraḥ sambhavatītyāha śaunakaḥ, śiromūlatvāt ‘tanmūlatvāt’ iti tā. pradhānendriyāṇāṃ ‘dehendriyāṇām’ iti pā.; hṛdayamiti kṛtavīryo, buddhermanasaśca sthānatvāt; nābhiriti pārāśaryaḥ, tato hi vardhate deho dehinaḥ; pāṇipādamiti mārkaṇḍeyaḥ, tanmūlatvācceṣṭāyā garbhasya; madhyaśarīramiti subhūtirgautamaḥ, tannibaddhatvāt sarvagātrasambhavasya | tattu na samyak, sarvāṇyaṅgapratyaṅgāni yugapat sambhavantītyāha dhanvantariḥ, garbhasya sūkṣmatvānnopalabhyante vaṃśāṅkuravaccūtaphalavacca; tadyathā- cūtaphale paripakve keśaramāṃsāsthimajjānaḥ pṛthak pṛthagdṛśyante kālaprakarṣāt, tānyeva taruṇe nopalabhyante sūkṣmatvāt; teṣāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ keśarādīnāṃ kālaḥ pravyaktatāṃ karoti; etenaiva vaṃśāṅkuro'pi vyākhyātaḥ | evaṃ garbhasya tāruṇye sarveṣvaṅgapratyaṅgeṣu satsvapi saukṣmyādanupalabdhiḥ, tānyeva kālaprakarṣāt pravyaktāni bhavanti ||32||
