sarpasaṅkhyāṃ vibhāgaṃ ca daṣṭalakṣaṇameva ca | jñānaṃ ca viṣavegānāṃ bhagavan ! vaktumarhasi ||4||

div.ab: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prābravīdbhiṣajāṃ varaḥ | asaṅkhyā vāsukiśreṣṭhā `vāsukimukhā’ iti pā. vikhyātāstakṣakādayaḥ ||5|| mahīdharāśca nāgendrā hutāgnisamatejasaḥ | ye cāpyajasraṃ garjanti varṣanti ca tapanti ca ||6|| sasāgaragiridvīpā yairiyaṃ dhāryate mahī | kruddhā niḥśvāsadṛṣṭibhyāṃ ye hanyurakhilaṃ jagat ||7|| namastebhyo'sti no teṣāṃ kāryaṃ kiñciccikitsayā | ye tu daṃṣṭrāviṣā bhaumā ye daśanti ca mānuṣān ||8|| teṣāṃ saṅkhyāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ |9|

aśītistveva sarpāṇāṃ bhidyate pañcadhā tu sā ||9|| darvīkarā maṇḍalino rājimantastathaiva ca | nirviṣā vaikarañjāśca trividhāste punaḥ smṛtāḥ ||10|| darvīkarā maṇḍalino rājimantaśca pannagāḥ | teṣu darvīkarā jñeyā viṃśatiḥ ṣaṭ ca pannagāḥ `rājimantastathaiva ca’ iti pā.||11|| dvāviṃśatirmaṇḍalino rājimantastathā daśa | nirviṣā dvādaśa jñeyā vaikarañjāstrayastathā ||12|| vaikarañjodbhavāḥ sapta citrā `citramaṇḍalirājilāḥ’ iti pā. maṇḍalirājilāḥ |13|
pādābhimṛṣṭā duṣṭā vā kruddhā grāsārthino'pi vā ||13|| te daśanti mahākrodhāstrividhaṃ `taddhi trividhamucyate’ iti pā. bhīmadarśanāḥ |14|

ab.seg: sarpitaṃ raditaṃ cāpi tṛtīyamatha nirviṣam | sarpāṅgābhihataṃ kecidicchanti khalu tadvidaḥ ||14||
padāni yatra dantānāmekaṃ dve vā bahūni vā | nimagnānyalparaktāni yānyudvṛtya karoti hi ||15||
cañcumālakayuktāni vaikṛtyakaraṇāni ca | saṅkṣiptāni saśophāni vidyāttat sarpitaṃ bhiṣak ||16||
rājyaḥ salohitā yatra nīlāḥ pītāḥ sitāstathā | vijñeyaṃ raditaṃ tattu `tvakṣu’ iti pā. jñeyamalpaviṣaṃ ca tat ||17||
aśophamalpaduṣṭāsṛk prakṛtisthasya dehinaḥ | padaṃ padāni vā vidyādaviṣaṃ taccikitsakaḥ ||18||
sarpaspṛṣṭasya bhīrorhi bhayena kupito'nilaḥ | kasyacit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat ||19||
vyādhitodvignadaṣṭāni jñeyānyalpaviṣāṇi tu | tathā'tivṛddhabālābhidaṣṭamalpaviṣaṃ `tathā'tivṛddhātibāladaṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. smṛtam ||20||
suparṇadevabrahmarṣiyakṣasiddhaniṣevite | viṣaghnauṣadhiyukte ca deśe na kramate viṣam ||21||
rathāṅgalāṅgalacchatrasvastikāṅkuśadhāriṇaḥ | jñeyā darvīkarāḥ sarpāḥ phaṇinaḥ śīghragāminaḥ ||22||
maṇḍalairvividhaiścitrāḥ pṛthavo mandagāminaḥ | jñeyā maṇḍalinaḥ sarpā jvalanārkasamaprabhāḥ `jvalanārkasamā viṣe’ iti pā.||23||
snigdhā vividhavarṇābhistiryagūrdhvaṃ ca rājibhiḥ | citritā iva ye bhānti rājimantastu te smṛtāḥ ||24||
muktārūpyaprabhā ye ca kapilā ye ca pannagāḥ | sugandhayaḥ suvarṇābhāste jātyā brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||25||
kṣatriyāḥ snigdhavarṇāstu pannagā bhṛśakopanāḥ | sūryacandrākṛticchatralakṣma teṣāṃ tathā'mbujam ||26||
kṛṣṇā vajranibhā `vajraprabhā’ iti pā. ye ca lohitā varṇatastathā | dhūmrāḥ pārāvatābhāśca vaiśyāste pannagāḥ smṛtāḥ ||27||
mahiṣadvīpivarṇābhāstathaiva paruṣatvacaḥ | bhinnavarṇāśca ye kecicchūdrāste parikīrtitāḥ ||28||

div.ab: kopayantyanilaṃ jantoḥ phaṇinaḥ sarva eva tu | pittaṃ maṇḍalinaścāpi kaphaṃ cānekarājayaḥ ||29|| apatyamasavarṇābhyāṃ dvidoṣakaralakṣaṇam | jñeyau doṣaiśca dampatyo... |31|

ab.seg: ...rviśeṣaścātra vakṣyate ||30||
rajanyāḥ paścime yāme sarpāścitrāścaranti hi | śeṣeṣūktā maṇḍalino divā darvīkarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||31||
darvīkarāstu taruṇā vṛddhā maṇḍalinastathā | rājimanto vayomadhyā jāyante mṛtyuhetavaḥ ||32||
nakulākulitā bālā vāriviprahatāḥ kṛśāḥ | vṛddhā muktatvaco bhītāḥ sarpāstvalpaviṣāḥ smṛtāḥ ||33||

div.ab: tatra, darvīkarāḥ- kṛṣṇasarpo, mahākṛṣṇaḥ, kṛṣṇodaraḥ śvetakapoto, mahākapoto, balāhako, mahāsarpaḥ, śaṅkhakapālo `śaṅkhakāmalo’ iti pā., lohitākṣo, gavedhukaḥ, parisarpaḥ, khaṇḍaphaṇaḥ, kakudaḥ, padmo, mahāpadmo, darbhapuṣpo, dadhimukhaḥ, puṇḍarīko, bhrūkuṭīmukho, viṣkiraḥ, puṣpābhikīrṇo, girisarpaḥ, ṛjusarpaḥ, śvetodaro, mahāśirā, alagarda, āśīviṣa iti (1); maṇḍalinastu- ādarśamaṇḍalaḥ, śvetamaṇḍalo, raktamaṇḍalaḥ, citramaṇḍalaḥ, pṛṣato, rodhrapuṣpo, milindako, gonaso, vṛddhagonasaḥ, panaso, mahāpanaso, veṇupatrakaḥ, śiśuko madanaḥ, pālindiraḥ, piṅgalaḥ `piṅgalatantukaḥ’ iti pā., tantukaḥ puṣpapāṇḍuḥ, ṣaḍaṅgo, agniko babhruḥ, kaṣāyaḥ, kaluṣaḥ pārāvato, hastābharaṇaḥ, citrakaḥ, eṇīpada iti (2); rājimantastu- puṇḍarīko rājicitro, aṅgularājiḥ, bindurājiḥ, kardamakaḥ, tṛṇaśoṣakaḥ, sarṣapakaḥ śvetahanuḥ, darbhapuṣpaścakrako, godhūmakaḥ, kikkisāda iti (3); nirviṣāstu- galagolī, śūkapatro, ajagaro, divyako, varṣāhikaḥ, puṣpaśakalī, jyotīrathaḥ, kṣīrikāpuṣpako, ahipatāko, andhāhiko, gaurāhiko, vṛkṣeśaya iti (4); vaikarañjāstu trayāṇāṃ darvīkarādīnāṃ vyatikarājjātāḥ, tadyathā- mākuliḥ, poṭagalaḥ, snigdharājiriti | tatra, kṛṣṇasarpeṇa gonasyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jāto mākuliḥ; rājilena gonasyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jātaḥ poṭagalaḥ; kṛṣṇasarpeṇa rājimatyāṃ vaiparītyena vā jātaḥ snigdharājiriti | teṣāmādyasya pitṛvadviṣotkarṣo, dvayormātṛvadityeke (5) |34|

ab.seg: trayāṇāṃ vaikarañjānāṃ punardivyelakarodhrapuṣpakarājicitrakapoṭagalapuṣpābhikīrṇadarbhapuṣpavellitakāḥ sapta; teṣāmādyāstrayo rājilavat, śeṣā maṇḍalivat, evameteṣāṃ sarpāṇāmaśītirvyākhyātā ||34||
tatra mahānetrajihvāsyaśirasaḥ pumāṃsaḥ, sūkṣmanetrajihvāsyaśirasaḥ striyaḥ, ubhayalakṣaṇā mandaviṣā akrodhā napuṃsakā iti ||35||

tatra sarveṣāṃ sarpāṇāṃ sāmānyata eva daṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇaṃ? viṣaṃ hi niśitanistriṃśāśanihutavahadeśyamāśukāri muhartamapyupekṣitamāturamatipātayati, na cāvakāśo'sti vāksamūhamupasartuṃ pratyekamapi daṣṭalakṣaṇe'bhihite sarvatra `sarvatraividhyaṃ’ iti pā. traividhyaṃ bhavati, tasmāt traividhyameva vakṣyāmaḥ; etaddhyāturahitamasammohakaraṃ ca, api cātraiva sarvasarpavyañjanāvarodhaḥ ||36||

tatra, darvīkaraviṣeṇa tvaṅnayananakhadaśanavadanamūtrapurīṣadaṃśakṛṣṇatvaṃ raukṣyaṃ śiraso gauravaṃ sandhivedanā kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrīvādaurbalyaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ vepathuḥ svarāvasādo ghurghurako jaḍatā śuṣkodgāraḥ kāsaśvāsau hikkā vāyorūrdhvagamanaṃ śūlodveṣṭanaṃ tṛṣṇā lālāsrāvaḥ phenāgamanaṃ sroto'varodhastāstāśca vātavedanā bhavanti; maṇḍaliviṣeṇa tvagādīnāṃ pītatvaṃ śītābhilāṣaḥ paridhūpanaṃ dāhastṛṣṇā mado mūrcchā jvaraḥ śoṇitāgamanamūrdhvamadhaśca māṃsānāmavaśātanaṃ śvayathurdaṃśakothaḥ pītarūpadarśanamāśukopastāstāśca pittavedanā bhavanti; rājimadviṣeṇa śuklatvaṃ tvagādīnāṃ śītajvaro romaharṣaḥ stabdhatvaṃ gātrāṇāmādaṃśaśophaḥ sāndrakaphaprasekaśchardirabhīkṣṇamakṣṇoḥ kaṇḍūḥ kaṇṭhe śvayathurghurghuraka ucchvāsanirodhastamaḥpraveśastāstāśca kaphavedanā bhavanti ||37||

puruṣābhidaṣṭa ūrdhvaṃ prekṣate, adhastāt striyā sirāścottiṣṭhanti lalāṭe, napuṃsakābhidaṣṭastiryakprekṣī bhavati, garbhiṇyā pāṇḍumukhodhmātaśca, sūtikayā kukṣiśūlārtaḥ sarudhiraṃ mehatyupajihvikā cāsya bhavati, grāsārthinā'nnaṃ kāṅkṣati, vṛddhena cirānmandāśca vegāḥ, bālenāśu mṛdavaśca, nirviṣeṇāviṣaliṅgaṃ, andhāhikenāndhatvamityeke, grasanāt ajagaraḥ śarīraprāṇaharo na viṣāt | tatra sadyaḥprāṇaharāhidaṣṭaḥ patati śāstrāśanihata iva bhūmau, srastāṅgaḥ svapiti ||38||

tatra sarveṣāṃ sarpāṇāṃ viṣasya sapta vegā bhavanti | tatra, darvīkarāṇāṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati, tat praduṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇatāmupaiti, tena kārṣṇyaṃ pipīlikāparisarpaṇamiva cāṅge bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tenātyarthaṃ kṛṣṇatā śopho granthayaścāṅge bhavanti; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena daṃśakledaḥ śirogauravaṃ `śirograhaṇaṃ’ iti pā. svedaścakṣurgrahaṇaṃ ca; caturthe koṣṭhamanupraviśya kaphapradhānān doṣān dūṣayati, tena tandrāprasekasandhiviśleṣā bhavanti; pañcame'sthīnyanupraviśati prāṇamagniṃ ca dūṣayati, tena parvabhedo hikkā dāhaśca bhavati; ṣaṣṭhe majjānamanupraviśati grahaṇīṃ cātyarthaṃ dūṣayati, tena gātrāṇāṃ gauravamatīsāro hṛtpīḍā mūrcchā ca bhavati; saptame śukramanupraviśati vyānaṃ cātyarthaṃ kopayati kaphaṃ ca sūkṣmasrotobhyaḥ pracyāvayati, tena śleṣmavartiprādurbhāvaḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhabhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭāvighāto lālāsvedayoratipravṛttirucchvāsanirodhaśca bhavati | maṇḍalināṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati, tat praduṣṭaṃ pītatāmupaiti, tatra paridāhaḥ pītāvabhāsatā cāṅgānāṃ bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tenātyarthaṃ pītatā paridāho daṃśe śvayathuśca bhavati; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena pūrvavaccakṣurgrahaṇaṃ tṛṣṇā daṃśakledaḥ svedaśca; caturthe koṣṭhamanupraviśya jvaramāpādayati; pañcame paridāhaṃ sarvagātreṣu karoti, ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ pūrvavat | rājimatāṃ prathame vege viṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati tat praduṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāmupaiti, tena romaharṣaḥ śuklāvabhāsaśca puruṣo bhavati; dvitīye māṃsaṃ dūṣayati, tena pāṇḍutā'tyarthaṃ jāḍyaṃ śiraḥśophaśca bhavati; tṛtīye medo dūṣayati, tena cakṣurgrahaṇaṃ daṃśakledaḥ svedo ghrāṇākṣisrāvaśca bhavati; caturthe koṣṭhamanupraviśya manyāstambhaṃ śirogauravaṃ cāpādayati; pañcame vāksaṅgaṃ śītajvaraṃ ca karoti; ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ pūrvavaditi ||39||
bhavanti cātra- dhātvantareṣu yāḥ sapta kalāḥ samparikīrtitāḥ | tāsvekaikāmatikramya vegaṃ prakurute viṣam ||40||
yenāntareṇa tu kalāṃ kālakalpaṃ bhinatti hi | samīraṇenohyamānaṃ tattu vegāntaraṃ smṛtam ||41||
śūnāṅgaḥ prathame vege paśurdhyāyati duḥkhitaḥ | lālāsrāvo dvitīye tu kṛṣṇāṅgaḥ `hṛṣṭāṅgaḥ’ iti pā. pīḍyate hṛdi ||42||
tṛtīye ca śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇṭhagrīvaṃ ca bhajyate | caturthe vepate mūḍhaḥ khādan dantān jahātyasūn ||43||
kecidvegatrayaṃ prāhurantaṃ caiteṣu tadvidaḥ | dhyāyati prathame vege pakṣī muhyatyataḥ param ||44||
dvitīye vihvalaḥ proktastṛtīye `pakṣī kūjan maraṇamṛcchati’ iti pā. mṛtyumṛcchati | kecidekaṃ vihaṅgeṣu viṣavegamuśanti hi | mārjāranakulādīnāṃ viṣaṃ nātipravartate `nātiprasarpati’ iti pā.||45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne sarpadaṣṭaviṣavijñānīyaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||

div.head: sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitaṃ kalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarvairevāditaḥ sarpaiḥ śākhādaṣṭasya dehinaḥ | daṃśasyopari badhnīyādariṣṭāścaturaṅgule ||3||
plotacarmāntavalkānāṃ mṛdunā'nyatamena vai | na gacchati viṣaṃ dehamariṣṭābhirnivāritam ||4||
daheddaṃśamathotkṛtya yatra bandho na jāyate | ācūṣaṇacchedadāhāḥ sarvatraiva tu pūjitāḥ ||5||
pratipūrya mukhaṃ vastrairhitamācūṣaṇaṃ bhavet | sa daṣṭavyo'thavā `sandaṣṭavya’ iti pā. sarpo loṣṭo vā'pi hi tatkṣaṇam ||6||
atha maṇḍalinā daṣṭaṃ na kathañcana dāhayet | sa pittabāhulyaviṣāddaṃśo dāhādvisarpate ||7||
ariṣṭāmapi mantraiśca badhnīyānmantrakovidaḥ | sā tu rajjvādibhirbaddhā viṣapratikarī matā ||8||
devabrahmarṣibhiḥ proktā mantrāḥ satyatapomayāḥ | bhavanti nānyathā kṣipraṃ viṣaṃ hanyuḥ sudustaram ||9||
viṣaṃ tejomayairmantraiḥ satyabrahmatapomayaiḥ | yathā nivāryate kṣipraṃ prayuktairna tathauṣadhaiḥ ||10||
mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ kāryaṃ strīmāṃsamadhuvarjinā | mitāhāreṇa `jitāhāreṇa’ iti pā. śucinā kuśāstaraṇaśāyinā ||11||
gandhamālyopahāraiśca balibhiścāpi devatāḥ | pūjayenmantrasiddhyarthaṃ japahomaiśca yatnataḥ ||12||
mantrāstvavidhinā proktā hīnā vā svaravarṇataḥ | yasmānna siddhimāyānti tasmādyojyo'gadakramaḥ ||13||
samantataḥ sirā daṃśādvidhyettu kuśalo bhiṣak | śākhāgre vā lalāṭe vā vyadhyāstā visṛte viṣe ||14||
rakte nirhriyamāṇe tu kṛtsnaṃ nirhriyate viṣam | tasmādvisrāvayedraktaṃ sā hyasya paramā kriyā ||15||
samantādagadairdaṃśaṃ pracchayitvā pralepayet | candanośīrayuktena vāriṇā pariṣecayet ||16||

div.ab: pāyayetāgadāṃstāṃstān kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtādibhiḥ | tadalābhe hitā vā syāt kṛṣṇā valmīkamṛttikā ||17|| kovidāraśirīṣārkakaṭabhīrvā'pi bhakṣayet |18|

ab.seg: na pibettailakaulatthamadyasauvīrakāṇi ca ||18||
dravamanyattu yatkiñcit pītvā pītvā tadudvamet | prāyo hi vamanenaiva sukhaṃ nirhriyate viṣam ||19||

div.ab: phaṇināṃ viṣavege tu prathame śoṇitaṃ haret | dvitīye madhusarpirbhyāṃ pāyayetāgadaṃ bhiṣak ||20|| nasyakarmāñjane yuñjyāttṛtīye viṣanāśane | vāntaṃ caturthe pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūmatha dāpayet ||21|| śītopacāraṃ kṛtvā''dau bhiṣak pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ | pāyayecchodhanaṃ `dāpayet’ iti pā. tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ cāpi kīrtitām ||22|| saptame tvavapīḍena śirastīkṣṇena śodhayet | tīkṣṇamevāñjanaṃ dadyāt, tīkṣṇaśastreṇa mūrdhni ca ||23|| kṛtvā kākapadaṃ carma sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ `māṃsakaṃ’ iti pā. kṣipet |24|

ab.seg: pūrve maṇḍalināṃ vege darvīkaravadācaret ||24||
agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ dvitīye pāyayeta ca | vāmayitvā yavāgūṃ ca pūrvoktāmatha dāpayet ||25||
tṛtīye śodhitaṃ tīkṣṇairyavāgūṃ pāyayeddhitām | caturthe pañcame cāpi darvīkaravadācaret ||26||
kākolyādirhitaḥ ṣaṣṭhe peyaśca madhuro'gadaḥ `madhuro gaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| hito'vapīḍe tvagadaḥ saptame viṣanāśanaḥ ||27||

div.ab: pūrve rājimatāṃ vege'lābubhiḥ śoṇitaṃ haret `atha rājimatāṃ vege prathame śoṇitaṃ haret’ iti pā.| agadaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ pāyayeta ca ||28|| vāntaṃ dvitīye tvagadaṃ pāyayedviṣanāśanam | tṛtīyādiṣu triṣvevaṃ vidhirdārvīkaro hitaḥ ||29|| ṣaṣṭhe'ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇatamamavapīḍaśca saptame |30|
garbhiṇībālavṛddhānāṃ sirāvyadhanavarjitam ||30|| viṣārtānāṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ vidhānaṃ śasyate mṛdu |31|
raktāvasekāñjanāni naratulyānyajāvike ||31|| triguṇaṃ mahiṣe soṣṭre gavāśve dviguṇaṃ tu tat `gavāśvayośca dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ mahiṣoṣṭrayoḥ’ iti pā.| caturguṇaṃ tu nāgānāṃ,... |33|

ab.seg: ...kevalaṃ sarvapakṣiṇām ||32||
pariṣekān pradehāṃśca suśītānavacārayet | māṣakaṃ tvañjanasyeṣṭaṃ dviguṇaṃ nasyato hitam | pāne caturguṇaṃ pathyaṃ vamane'ṣṭaguṇaṃ punaḥ ||33||
deśaprakṛtisātmyartuviṣavegabalābalam | pradhārya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā tataḥ karma samācaret ||34||
vegānupūrvyā karmoktamidaṃ viṣavināśanam `vegānupūrvamityetat karmoktaṃ viṣanāśanam’ iti pā.| karmāvasthāviśeṣeṇa viṣayorubhayoḥ śṛṇu ||35||
vivarṇe kaṭhine śūne saruje'ṅge viṣānvite `viṣārdite’ iti pā.| tūrṇaṃ visravaṇaṃ kāryamuktena vidhinā tataḥ ||36||

kṣudhārtamanilaprāyaṃ tadviṣārtaṃ `tadviṣātiṃsamanvitam’ iti pā. samāhitaḥ | pāyayeta rasaṃ sarpiḥ śuktaṃ `takraṃ’ iti pā.| `pāyayeddadhi takraṃ vā sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ tathā rasam’ iti pā. kṣaudraṃ tathā dadhi ||37||
tṛḍdāhagharmasammohe paittaṃ paittaviṣāturam `paitte viṣāturam’ iti pā.| śītaiḥ saṃvāhanasnānapradehaiḥ samupācaret ||38||
śīte śītaprasekārtaṃ ślaiṣmikaṃ kaphakṛdviṣam | vāmayedvamanaistīkṣṇaistathā mūrcchāmadānvitam ||39||
koṣṭhadāharujādhmānamūtrasaṅgaruganvitam | virecayecchakṛdvāyusaṅgapittāturaṃ naram ||40||
śūnākṣikūṭaṃ nidrārtaṃ vivarṇāvilalocanam | vivarṇaṃ cāpi paśyantamañjanaiḥ samupācaret ||41||

div.ab: śiroruggauravālasyahanustambhagalagrahe | śiro virecayet kṣipraṃ manyāstambhe ca dāruṇe ||42|| naṣṭasañjñaṃ vivṛttākṣaṃ bhagnagrīvaṃ virecanaiḥ | cūrṇaiḥ pradhamanaistīkṣṇairviṣārtaṃ samupācaret ||43|| tāḍayecca sirāḥ kṣipraṃ tasya śākhālalāṭajāḥ | tāsvaprasicyamānāsu mūrdhni śastreṇa śastravit ||44|| kuryāt kākapadākāraṃ vraṇamevaṃ sravanti tāḥ | saraktaṃ carma māṃsaṃ vā nikṣipeccāsya mūrdhani ||45|| carmavṛkṣakaṣāyaṃ vā kalkaṃ `cūrṇaṃ’ iti pā. vā kuśalo bhiṣak | vādayeccāgadairliptvā dundubhīṃstasya pārśvayoḥ ||46|| labdhasañjñaṃ punaścainamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhayet | niḥśeṣaṃ nirhareccaivaṃ viṣaṃ paramadurjayam ||47|| alpamapyavaśiṣṭaṃ hi bhūyo vegāya kalpate | kuryādvā sādavaivarṇyajvarakāsaśirorujaḥ ||48|| śophaśoṣapratiśyāyatimirārucipīnasān | teṣu cāpi yathādoṣaṃ pratikarma prayojayet ||49|| viṣārtopadravāṃścāpi yathāsvaṃ samupācaret |50|
athāriṣṭāṃ vimucyāśu `vimucyāpsu’ iti pā. pracchayitvā'ṅkitaṃ tayā `tathā’ iti pā.||50|| dahyāttatra viṣaṃ skannaṃ bhūyo vegāya kalpate |51|

ab.seg: evamauṣadhibhirmantraiḥ kriyāyogaiśca yatnataḥ ||51||
viṣe hṛtaguṇe dehādyadā doṣaḥ prakupyati | tadā pavanamudvṛttaṃ snehādyaiḥ samupācaret ||52||
tailamatsyakulatthāmlavarjyairviṣaharāyutaiḥ `mārutanāśanaiḥ’ iti pā.| pittajvaraharaiḥ pittaṃ kaṣāyasnehabastibhiḥ ||53||
kaphamāragvadhādyena sakṣaudreṇa gaṇena tu | śleṣmaghnairagadaiścaiva tiktai rūkṣaiśca bhojanaiḥ ||54||
vṛkṣaprapātaviṣamapatitaṃ mṛtamambhasi | udbaddhaṃ ca mṛtaṃ sadyaścikitsennaṣṭasañjñavat ||55||
gāḍhaṃ baddhe'riṣṭayā pracchite vā tīkṣṇairlepaistadvidhairvā'vaśiṣṭaiḥ `viśeṣaiḥ’ iti pā.| śūne gātre klinnamatyarthapūti jñeyaṃ māṃsaṃ tadviṣāt pūti kaṣṭam ||56||

div.ab: sadyo viddhaṃ nisravet kṛṣṇaraktaṃ pākaṃ yāyāddahyate cāpyabhīkṣṇam | kṛṣṇībhūtaṃ klinnamatyarthapūti śīrṇaṃ māṃsaṃ yātyajasraṃ kṣatācca ||57|| tṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhrāntidāhau jvaraśca yasya syustaṃ digdhaviddhaṃ vyavasyet |58|
pūrvoddiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvametajjuṣṭaṃ yasyālaṃ viṣeṇa vraṇāḥ syuḥ ||58|| lūtādaṣṭā digdhaviddhā viṣairvā juṣṭā prāyaste vraṇāḥ pūtimāṃsāḥ `juṣṭā ye syurye vraṇāḥ pūtimāṃsāḥ’ iti pā.|59|

ab.seg: teṣāṃ yuktyā pūtimāṃsānyapohya vāryokobhiḥ śoṇitaṃ cāpahṛtya ||59||
hṛtvā doṣān kṣipramūrdhvaṃ tvadhaśca samyak siñcet kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyaiḥ | antarvastraṃ dāpayecca pradehān śītairdravyairājyayuktairviṣaghnaiḥ ||60||

div.ab: bhinne tvasthnā duṣṭajātena kāryaḥ pūrvo mārgaḥ paittike yo viṣe ca |61|

trivṛdviśalye madhukaṃ haridre raktā narendro lavaṇaśca vargaḥ ||61|| kaṭutrikaṃ caiva sucūrṇitāni śṛṅge nidadhyānmadhusaṃyutāni | eṣo'gado hanti viṣaṃ prayuktaḥ pānāñjanābhyañjananasyayogaiḥ ||62|| avāryavīryo viṣavegahantā `viṣavegahārī’ iti pā. mahāgado nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ |63|

viḍaṅgapāṭhatriphalājamodāhiṅgūni vakraṃ trikaṭūni caiva ||63|| sarvaśca vargo lavaṇaḥ susūkṣmaḥ sacitrakaḥ kṣaudrayuto nidheyaḥ | śṛṅge gavāṃ śṛṅgamayena caiva pracchāditaḥ pakṣamupekṣitaśca ||64|| eṣo'gadaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ jetā `hantā’ iti pā. viṣāṇāmajito hi nāmnā |65|

prapauṇḍarīkaṃ suradāru mustā kālānusāryā kaṭurohiṇī ca ||65|| sthauṇeyakadhyāmakaguggulūni `sthauṇeyakadhyāmakapadmakāni’ iti pā. punnāgatālīśasuvarcikāśca | kuṭannaṭailāsitasindhuvārāḥ śaileyakuṣṭhe tagaraṃ priyaṅguḥ ||66|| rodhraṃ jalaṃ kāñcanagairikaṃ ca samāgadhaṃ candanasaindhavaṃ ca | sūkṣmāṇi cūrṇāni samāni kṛtvā śṛṅge nidadhyānmadhusaṃyutāni ||67|| eṣo'gadastārkṣya iti pradiṣṭo viṣaṃ nihanyādapi takṣakasya |68|

māṃsīhareṇutriphalāmuraṅgīraktālatāyaṣṭikapadmakāni ||68|| viḍaṅgatālīśasugandhikailātvakkuṣṭhapatrāṇi sacandanāni | bhārgī paṭolaṃ kiṇihī sapāṭhā mṛgādanī karkaṭikā puraśca ||69|| pālindyaśokau kramukaṃ surasyāḥ prasūnamāruṣkarajaṃ ca puṣpam | sūkṣmāni cūrṇāni samāni śṛṅge nyaset sapittāni samākṣikāṇi `cūrṇānyathaiṣāṃ nihitāni śṛṅge nyasecca pittāni samākṣikāṇi’ iti pā.||70|| varāhagodhāśikhiśallakīnāṃ `varāhagodhāśikhiśalyakānāṃ’ iti pā. mārjārajaṃ pārṣatanākule ca | yasyāgado'yaṃ sukṛto gṛhe syānnāmnarṣabho nāma nararṣabhasya ||71|| na tatra sarpāḥ kuta eva kīṭāstyajanti vīryāṇi viṣāṇi caiva | etena bheryaḥ paṭahāśca digdhā nānadyamānā viṣamāśu hanyuḥ ||72|| digdhāḥ patākāśca nirīkṣya sadyo viṣābhibhūtā hyaviṣā bhavanti |73|

lākṣā hareṇurnaladaṃ priyaṅguḥ śigrudvayaṃ yaṣṭikapṛthvikāśca ||73|| cūrṇīkṛto'yaṃ rajanīvimiśro sarpirmadhubhyāṃ `vargo vidheyo madhusarpiṣā''ktaḥ’ iti pā. sahito nidheyaḥ | śṛṅge gavāṃ pūrvavadāpidhānastataḥ prayojyo'ñjananasyapānaiḥ ||74|| sañjīvano nāma gatāsukalpāneṣo'gado jīvayatīha martyān |75|
śleṣmātakīkaṭphalamātuluṅgyaḥ śvetā girihvā kiṇihī sitā ca ||75|| sataṇḍulīyo'gada eṣa mukhyo viṣeṣu darvīkararājilānām |76|

drākṣā sugandhā nagavṛttikā ca śvetā samaṅgā `śvetā ca piṣṭā palikaiśca bhāgaiḥ’ iti pā. samabhāgayuktā ||76|| deyo dvibhāgaḥ surasācchadasya kapitthabilvādapi dāḍimācca | tathā'rdhabhāgaḥ `tathā'rdhabhāgo'sitasindhuvārāt’ iti pā. sitasindhuvārādaṅkoṭhamūlādapi gairikācca ||77|| eṣo'gadaḥ kṣaudrayuto nihanti viśeṣato maṇḍalināṃ viṣāṇi |78|

ab.seg: vaṃśatvagārdrā''malakaṃ kapitthaṃ kaṭutrikaṃ haimavatī sakuṣṭhā ||78||
karañjabījaṃ tagaraṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ ca gopittayutaṃ nihanti | viṣāṇi lūtondurapannagānāṃ kaiṭaṃ ca lepāñjananasyapānaiḥ ||79||
purīṣamūtrānilagarbhasaṅgānnihanti vartyañjananābhilepaiḥ | kācārmakothān paṭalāṃśca ghorān puṣpaṃ ca hantyañjananasyayogaiḥ ||80||
samūlapuṣpāṅkuravalkabījāt kvāthaḥ śirīṣāt trikaṭupragāḍhaḥ | salāvaṇaḥ kṣaudrayuto'tha pīto viśeṣataḥ kīṭaviṣaṃ nihanti ||81||
kuṣṭhaṃ trikaṭukaṃ dārvī madhukaṃ lavaṇadvayam | mālatī nāgapuṣpaṃ ca sarvāṇi madhurāṇi ca ||82||
kapittharasapiṣṭo'yaṃ śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutaḥ | viṣaṃ hantyagadaḥ sarvaṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||83||
somarājīphalaṃ `somarājīphalaṃ mukhyaṃ kadalī sindhuvārakaḥ’ iti pā. puṣpaṃ kaṭabhī sindhuvārakaḥ | corako varuṇaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sarpagandhā sasaptalā ||84||
punarnavā śirīṣasya puṣpamāragvadhārkajam | śyāmā'mbaṣṭhā viḍaṅgāni tathā'mrāśmantakāni ca ||85||
bhūmī kurabakaścaiva gaṇa ekasaraḥ smṛtaḥ | ekaśo dvitriśo vā'pi prayoktavyo viṣāpahaḥ ||86||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne sarpadaṣṭaviṣacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
athāto dundubhisvanīyaṃ kalpaṃ `adhyāyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

dhavāśvakarṇaśirīṣatiniśapalāśapicumardapāṭalipāribhadrakāmrodumbarakarahāṭakārjunakakubhasarja- kapītanaśleṣmātakāṅkoṭhāmalakapragrahakuṭajaśamīkapitthāśmantakārkacirabilvamahāvṛkṣāruṣkarāralu- madhukamadhuśigruśākagojīmūrvābhūrjatilvakekṣurakagopaghoṇṭārimedānāṃ bhasmānyāhṛtya gavāṃ mūtreṇa kṣārakalpena parisrāvya vipacet, dadyāccātra pippalīmūlataṇḍulīyakavarāṅgacocamañjiṣṭhākarañjikāhastipippalīmaricaviḍaṅgagṛhadhūmānantā- somasaralābāhlīkaguhākośāmraśvetasarṣapavaruṇalavaṇaplakṣaniculakavañjulavakrālavardhamānaputraśreṇī- saptaparṇaṭuṇṭukailavālukanāgadantyativiṣābhayābhadradārukuṣṭhaharidrāvacācūrṇāni lohānāṃ ca samabhāgāni, tataḥ kṣāravadāgatapākamavatārya lohakumbhe nidadhyāt ||3||
anena dundubhiṃ limpet patākāṃ toraṇāni ca | śravaṇāddarśanāt sparśāt viṣāt `viṣaṃ teṣāṃ praśāmyati’ iti pā. sampratimucyate ||4||
eṣa kṣārāgado nāma śarkarāsvaśmarīṣu ca | arśaḥsu vātagulmeṣu `arśaḥsu vātaśūle ca śūlagulmodareṣu ca’ iti pā. kāsaśūlodareṣu ca ||5||
ajīrṇe grahaṇīdoṣe bhaktadveṣe `śophe sarvasare tathā’ iti pā. ca dāruṇe | śophe `aruciśvāsakāseṣu hikkāpāṇḍugadeṣu ca’ iti pā. sarvasare cāpi deyaḥ śvāse ca dāruṇe ||6||
sadā sarvaviṣārtānāṃ sarvathaivopayujyate | eṣa takṣakamukhyānāmapi darpāṅkuśo'gadaḥ ||7||
viḍaṅgatriphalādantībhadradāruhareṇavaḥ | tālīśapatramañjiṣṭhākeśarotpalapadmakam ||8||
dāḍimaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ rajanyau sārive sthire | priyaṅgustagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bṛhatyau cailavālukam ||9||
sacandanagavākṣībhiretaiḥ siddhaṃ viṣāpaham | sarpiḥ kalyāṇakaṃ hyetadgrahāpasmāranāśanam ||10||
pāṇḍvāmayagaraśvāsamandāgnijvarakāsanut | śoṣiṇāmalpaśukrāṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ ca praśasyate ||11||
apāmārgasya bījāni śirīṣasya ca māṣakān | śvete dve kākamācīṃ ca gavāṃ mūtreṇa peṣayet ||12||
sarpiretaistu saṃsiddhaṃ viṣasaṃśamanaṃ param | amṛtaṃ nāma vikhyātamapi sañjīvayenmṛtam ||13||
candanāguruṇī kuṣṭhaṃ tagaraṃ tilaparṇikam | prapauṇḍarīkaṃ `prapauṇḍarīkaṃ yaṣṭayāhvaṃ naladaṃ devadāru ca’ iti pā. naladaṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca ||14||
bhadraśriyaṃ yavaphalāṃ bhārgī nīlīṃ sugandhikām | kāleyakaṃ padmakaṃ ca madhukaṃ nāgaraṃ `saralaṃ’ iti pā. jaṭām ||15||
punnāgailailavālūni gairikaṃ dhyāmakaṃ balām | toyaṃ sarjarasaṃ māṃsīṃ śatapuṣpāṃ hareṇukām ||16||
tālīśapatraṃ kṣudrailāṃ priyaṅguṃ sakuṭannaṭam | śilāpuṣpaṃ saśaileyaṃ patraṃ kālānusārivām ||17||
kaṭutrikaṃ `śrīparṇikāṃ śītaśivaṃ trikaṭuṃ kaṭurohiṇīm’ iti pā. śītaśivaṃ kāśmaryaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | somarājīmativiṣāṃ pṛthvikāmindravāruṇīm `indrajān yavān’ iti pā.||18||
uśīraṃ varuṇaṃ mustaṃ kustumburu nakhaṃ tathā | śvete haridre sthauṇeyaṃ lākṣāṃ ca lavaṇāni ca ||19||
kumudotpalapadmāni puṣpaṃ cāpi tathā'rkajam | campakāśokasumanastilvakaprasavāni ca ||20||
pāṭalīśālmalīśailuśirīṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | kusumaṃ tṛṇamūlyāśca surabhīsindhuvārajam `surasyāstṛṇaśūnyāśca sindhuvārasya yāni ca’ iti pā.||21||
dhavāśvakarṇapārthānāṃ puṣpāṇi tiniśasya ca | gugguluṃ kuṅkumaṃ bimbīṃ sarpākṣīṃ gandhanākulīm ||22||
etat sambhṛtya sambhāraṃ sūkṣmacūrṇāni `vidhivatsūkṣmacūrṇitam’ iti pā. kārayet | gopittamadhusarpirbhiryuktaṃ śṛṅge nidhāpayet ||23||
bhagnaskandhaṃ vivṛtākṣaṃ mṛtyordaṃṣṭrāntaraṃ gatam | anenāgadamukhyena manuṣyaṃ `cikitseddhi viṣāturam’ iti pā. punarāharet ||24||
eṣo'gnikalpaṃ durvāraṃ kruddhasyāmitatejasaḥ | viṣaṃ nāgapaterhanyāt prasabhaṃ vāsukerapi ||25||
mahāsugandhināmā'yaṃ pañcāśītyaṅgasaṃyutaḥ | rājā'gadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ rājño haste bhavet sadā ||26||
snātānuliptastu `tenānuliptastu’ iti pā. nṛpo bhavet sarvajanapriyaḥ | bhrājiṣṇutāṃ ca labhate `tejasvitāṃ samāpnoti’ iti pā. śatrumadhyagato'pi san ||27||
uṣṇavarjyo vidhiḥ kāryo viṣārtānāṃ vijānatā | muktvā kīṭaviṣaṃ taddhi śītenābhipravardhate ||28||
annapānavidhāvuktamupadhārya śubhāśubham | śubhaṃ deyaṃ viṣārtebhyo viruddhebhyaśca vārayet ||29||
phāṇitaṃ śigrusauvīramajīrṇādhyaśanaṃ tathā | varjayecca samāsena navadhānyādikaṃ gaṇam ||30||
divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ krodhamātapam | surātilakulatthāṃśca varjayeddhi viṣāturaḥ ||31||

prasannadoṣaṃ prakṛtisthadhātumannābhikāṅkṣaṃ `annābhikāmaṃ’ iti pā. samasūtrajihvam | prasannavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ `prasannakāyendriyavarṇaceṣṭaṃ vaidyastu vidyādaviṣaṃ manuṣyam’ iti pā. vaidyo'vagacchedaviṣaṃ manuṣyam ||32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne dundubhisvanīyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||

div.head: mūṣikakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūṣikakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūrvaṃ śukraviṣā uktā mūṣikā ye samāsataḥ | nāmalakṣaṇabhaiṣajyairaṣṭādaśa nibodha me `tān’ iti pā.||3||
lālanaḥ putrakaḥ kṛṣṇo haṃsiraścikvi(kki)rastathā | chucchundaro'lasaścaiva kaṣāyadaśano'pi ca ||4||
kuliṅgaścājitaścaiva capalaḥ kapilastathā kokilo'ruṇasañjñaśca mahākṛṣṇastathonduraḥ ||5||
śvetena mahatā sārdhaṃ kapilenākhunā tathā | mūṣikaśca kapotābhastathaivāṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ||6||
śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ `śukraghṛṣṭaiḥ’ iti pā. spṛśanti vā | nakhadantādibhistasmin gātre raktaṃ praduṣyati ||7||

div.ab: jāyante granthayaḥ śophāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca | pīḍakopacayaścogro visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca ||8|| parvabhedo rujastīvrā mūrcchā'ṅgasadanaṃ `jvaro mūrcchā ca dāruṇā’ iti pā. jvaraḥ | daurbalyamaruciḥ śvāso vamathurlomaharṣaṇam ||9|| daṣṭarūpaṃ samāsoktametadvyāsamataḥ ‘... metacca vyāsataḥ śṛṇu’ iti pā. śṛṇu |10|
lālāsrāvo lālanena hikkā chardiśca jāyate `chardayate’ iti pā.||10|| taṇḍulīyakakalkaṃ tu lihyāttatra samākṣikam |11|

ab.seg: putrakeṇāṅgasādaśca pāṇḍuvarṇaśca jāyate ||11||
cīyate granthibhiścāṅgamākhuśāvakasannibhaiḥ | śirīṣeṅgudakalkaṃ tu lihyāttatra samākṣikam ||12||
kṛṣṇena `kṛṣṇenāsṛk chardayati durdineṣu viśeṣataḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śopho'sṛkchardiḥ prāyaśca durdine | śirīṣaphalakuṣṭhaṃ tu pibet kiṃśukabhasmanā ||13||
haṃsireṇānnavidveṣo jṛmbhā romṇāṃ ca harṣaṇam | pibedāragvadhādiṃ tu suvāntastatra mānavaḥ ||14||

div.ab: cikvi(kki)reṇa śiroduḥkhaṃ śopho hikkā vamistathā | jālinīmadanāṅkoṭhakaṣāyairvāmayettu tam ||15|| yavanālarṣabhīkṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet |16|

chucchundareṇa `chucchundareṇa viḍbhaṅgo grīvāstambho vijṛmbhaṇam| yavanālarṣabhakṣāraṃ bṛhatyoścātra dāpayet’ iti pā. tṛṭ chardirjvaro daurbalyameva ca ||16|| grīvāstambhaḥ pṛṣṭhaśopho gandhājñānaṃ visūcikā | cavyaṃ harītakī śuṇṭhī viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī madhu ||17|| aṅkoṭhabījaṃ ca tathā pibedatra viṣāpaham |18|

grīvāstambho'lasenordhvavāyurdaṃśe rujā jvaraḥ ||18|| mahāgadaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ lihyāttatra samākṣikam | nidrā kaṣāyadantena hṛcchoṣaḥ kārśyameva ca ||19|| kṣaudropetāḥ śirīṣasya lihyāt sāraphalatvacaḥ | kuliṅgena rujaḥ `rujā srāvo’ iti pā. śopho rājyaśca daṃśamaṇḍale ||20|| sahe sasindhuvāre ca lihyāttatra samākṣike |21|
ajitenāṅgakṛṣṇatvaṃ `ajitena vamirmūrcchā hṛdgrahaḥ kṛṣṇanetratā’ iti pā. chardirmūrcchā ca hṛdgrahaḥ ||21|| snukkṣīrapiṣṭāṃ pālindīṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhunā lihet |22|
capalena bhavecchardirmūrcchā ca saha tṛṣṇayā ||22|| kṣaudreṇa kṣaudreṇalihyāttriphalāṃ’ iti pā. triphalāṃ lihyādbhadrakāṣṭhajaṭānvitām |23|

kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro granthyudgamaḥ satṛṭ ||23|| lihyānmadhuyutāṃ `kṣaudreṇa lihyāntriphalāṃ’ iti pā. śvetāṃ śvetāṃ cāpi punarnavām | granthayaḥ kokilenogrā jvaro dāhaśca dāruṇaḥ `jāyate’ iti pā.||24|| varṣābhūnīlinīkvāthakalkasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet |25|

aruṇenānilaḥ kruddho vātajān kurute gadān ||25|| mahākṛṣṇena pittaṃ ca śvetena kapha eva ca | mahatā kapilenāsṛk kapotena `kapotenaiva tu trayam’ iti pā. catuṣṭayam ||26|| bhavanti caiṣāṃ daṃśeṣu granthimaṇḍalakarṇikāḥ | piḍakopacayaścograḥ śophaśca bhṛśadāruṇaḥ ||27|| dadhikṣīraghṛtaprasthāstrayaḥ pratyekaśo matāḥ | karañjāragvadhavyoṣabṛhatyaṃśumatīsthirāḥ ||28|| niṣkvāthya caiṣāṃ kvāthasya caturthoṃ'śaḥ punarbhavet | trivṛdgojyamṛtāvakrasarpagandhāḥ `trivṛttiktā'mṛtā’ iti pā. samṛttikāḥ ||29|| kapitthadāḍimatvak ca ślakṣṇapiṣṭāḥ `supiṣṭāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pradāpayet | tat sarvamekataḥ kṛtvā śanairmṛdvagninā pacet ||30|| pañcānāmaruṇādīnāṃ viṣametadvyapohati | kākādanīkākamācyoḥ svaraseṣvathavā kṛtam ||31|| sirāśca srāvayet `mokṣayet’ iti pā. prāptāḥ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca |32|

ab.seg: sarveṣāṃ ca vidhiḥ kāryo mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣeṣvayam ||32||
dagdhvā visrāvayeddaṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet | śirīṣarajanīkuṣṭhakuṅkumairamṛtāyutaiḥ ||33||
chardanaṃ jālinīkvāthaiḥ śukākhyāṅkoṭhayorapi ||34||
śukākhyākoṣavatyośca mūlaṃ madana eva ca | devadālīphalaṃ caiva dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet | sarvamūṣikadaṣṭānāmeṣa yogaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ||35||
phalaṃ vacā devadālī kuṣṭhaṃ gobhūtrapeṣitam | pūrvakalpena yojyāḥ `yojyaṃ syātsarvonduraviṣacchidi iti pā. syuḥ sarvonduruviṣacchidaḥ ||36||

div.ab: virecane trivṛddantītriphalākalka iṣyate |37|
śirovirecane sāraḥ śirīṣasya phalāni ca ||37|| hitastrikaṭukāḍhyaśca gomayasvaraso'ñjane |38|

ab.seg: kapitthagomayarasau `kapitthagomayarasaḥ sakṣaudro leha iṣyate’ iti pā. lihyānmākṣikasaṃyutau ||38||
rasāñjanaharidrendrayavakaṭvīṣu vā kṛtam | prātaḥ sātiviṣaṃ kalkaṃ lihyānmākṣikasaṃyutam ||39||
taṇḍulīyakamūleṣu sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibennaraḥ | āsphotamūlasiddhaṃ vā pañcakāpitthameva vā ||40||
mūṣikāṇāṃ viṣaṃ prāyaḥ kupyatyabhreṣvanirhṛtam `abhreṣu nirhṛtaṃ’iti pā.| tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ kāryo yaśca dūṣīviṣāpahaḥ ||41||
sthirāṇāṃ rujatāṃ vā'pi vraṇānāṃ karṇikāṃ bhiṣak | pāṭayitvā yathādoṣaṃ vraṇavaccāpi śodhayet ||42||

div.ab: śvaśṛgālatarakṣvṛkṣavyāghrādīnāṃ yadā'nilaḥ | śleṣmapraduṣṭo muṣṇāti sañjñāṃ sañjñāvahāśritaḥ ||43|| tadā prasrastalāṅgūlahanuskandho'tilālavān | atyarthabadhiro'ndhaśca `avyaktabadhirāndhaśca’ iti pā. so'nyonyamabhidhāvati ||44|| tenonmattena daṣṭasya daṃṣṭriṇā saviṣeṇa tu | suptatā jāyate daṃśe kṛṣṇaṃ cātisravatyasṛk ||45|| digdhaviddhasya liṅgena prāyaśaścopalakṣitaḥ |46|
yena cāpi bhaveddaṣṭastasya ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ ||46|| bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇaḥ kriyāhīno vinaśyati |47|
daṃṣṭriṇā yena daṣṭaśca tadrūpaṃ yastu paśyati ||47|| apsu `apsu vā''darśabimbe vā tasya tadriṣṭamādiśet’ iti pā. vā yadi vā''darśe'riṣṭaṃ tasya vinirdiśet |48|
trasyatyakasmādyo'bhīkṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā `śrutvā dṛṣṭvā'pi’ iti pā. spṛṣṭvā'pi vā jalam ||48|| jalatrāsaṃ tu vidyāttaṃ riṣṭaṃ tadapi `tamapi kīrtayet’ iti pā. kīrtitam |49|
adaṣṭo vā jalatrāsī na kathañcana sidhyati ||49|| prasupto'thotthito vā'pi svasthastrasto na sidhyati |50|

daṃśaṃ visrāvya tairdaṣṭe sarpiṣā paridāhitam ||50|| pradihyādagadaiḥ, sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pāyayeta ca | arkakṣīrayutaṃ hyasya `vā'pi dadyādāśu’ iti pā. dadyāccāpi viśodhanam ||51|| śvetāṃ punarnavāṃ cāsya dadyāddhattūrakāyutām | palalaṃ tilatailaṃ ca rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||52|| nihanti viṣamālarkaṃ meghavṛndamivānilaḥ |53|

mūlasya śarapuṅkhāyāḥ karṣaṃ dhattūrakārdhikam ||53|| taṇḍulodakamādāya peṣayettaṇḍulaiḥ saha | unmattakasya patraistu saṃveṣṭyāpūpakaṃ pacet ||54|| khādedauṣadhakāle tamalarkaviṣadūṣitaḥ | karoti śvavikārāṃstu `karotyanyān vikārāṃstu’ iti pā. tasmiñjīryati cauṣadhe ||55|| vikārāḥ śiśire yāpyā gṛhe vārivivarjite | tataḥ śāntavikārastu snātvā caivāpare'hani ||56|| śāliṣaṣṭikayorbhaktaṃ kṣīreṇoṣṇena bhojayet | dinatraye pañcame vā vidhireṣo'rdhamātrayā ||57|| kartavyo bhiṣajā'vaśyamalarkaviṣanāśanaḥ | kupyet svayaṃ viṣaṃ yasya na sa jīvati mānavaḥ ||58|| tasmāt prakopayedāśu svayaṃ yāvat `yāvanna kupyati’ iti pā. prakupyati |59|

bījaratnauṣadhīgarbhaiḥ `kṣiptaratnauṣadhibījaiḥ’ iti pā. kumbhaiḥ śītāmbupūritaiḥ ||59|| snāpayettaṃ nadītīre samantrairvā catuṣpathe | baliṃ nivedya tatrāpi piṇyākaṃ palalaṃ dadhi ||60|| mālyāni ca vicitrāṇi māṃsaṃ pakvāmakaṃ tathā | alakādhipate yakṣa sārameyagaṇādhipa ! ||61|| alarkajuṣṭametanme nirviṣaṃ kuru mācirāt |62|
dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ tīkṣṇamevaṃ snātasya `tīkṣṇamajasraṃ tasya’ iti pā. dehinaḥ ||62|| aśuddhasya surūḍhe'pi vraṇe kupyati tadviṣam |63|

ab.seg: śvādayo'bhihitā vyālā ye'tra `vātapittaprakopaṇāḥ’ iti pā. daṃṣṭrāviṣā mayā ||63||
ataḥ karoti daṣṭastu teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ | bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇo na cirānmriyate ca saḥ ||64||
nakhadantakṣataṃ vyālairyatkṛtaṃ tadvimardayet | siñcettailena koṣṇena te hi vātaprakopakāḥ ||65||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne mūṣikakalpo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||

div.head: kīṭakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kīṭakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarpāṇāṃ śukraviṇmūtraśavapūtyaṇḍasambhavāḥ | vāyvagnyambuprakṛtayaḥ kīṭāstu vividhāḥ `trividhāḥ’ iti pā. smṛtāḥ ||3||
sarvadoṣaprakṛtibhiryuktāste pariṇāmataḥ | kīṭatve'pi sughorāḥ `sughorāste’ iti pā. syuḥ, sarva eva caturvidhāḥ ||4||

div.ab: kumbhīnasastuṇḍikerī śṛṅgī śatakulīrakaḥ | ucciṭiṅgo'gnināmā ca cicciṭiṅgo mayūrikā ||5|| āvartakastathorabhraḥ sārikāmukhavaidalau | śarāvakurdo'bhīrājiḥ paruṣaścitraśīrṣakaḥ `citramūrdhakaḥ’ iti pā.||6|| śatabāhuśca yaścāpi raktarājiśca kīrtitaḥ | aṣṭādaśeti vāyavyāḥ `aṣṭādaśaiva jñātavyāḥ’ iti pā. kīṭāḥ pavanakopanāḥ ||7|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogā vātanimittajāḥ |8|

kauṇḍinyakaḥ kaṇabhako varaṭī patravṛścikaḥ ||8|| vināsikā brāhmaṇikā bindulo bhramarastathā | bāhyakī picciṭaḥ kumbhī varcaḥkīṭo'rimedakaḥ ||9|| padmakīṭo dundubhiko makaraḥ śatapādakaḥ | pañcālakaḥ pākamatsyaḥ kṛṣṇatuṇḍo'tha `sūkṣmatuṇḍo'tha’ iti pā. gardabhī ||10|| klītaḥ kṛmisarārī ca yaścāpyutkleśakastathā | ete hyagniprakṛtayaścaturviṃśatireva ca ||11|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogāḥ pittanimittajāḥ |12|

viśvambharaḥ pañcaśuklaḥ pañcakṛṣṇo'tha `valabhī kapilastathā| sairīyakaḥ pañcakṛṣṇaḥ pracalāko'tha koṭikaḥ’ iti pā. kokilaḥ ||12|| saireyakaḥ pracalako valabhaḥ kiṭibhastathā | sūcīmukhaḥ kṛṣṇagodhā yaśca kāṣāyavāsikaḥ ||13|| kīṭo gardabhakaścaiva `koṭīgardabhakaścaiva’ iti pā. tathā troṭaka eva ca | trayodaśaite saumyāḥ syuḥ kīṭāḥ śleṣmaprakopaṇāḥ ||14|| tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ rogāḥ kaphanimittajāḥ |15|

ab.seg: tuṅgīnāso vicilakastālako vāhakastathā ||15||
koṣṭhāgārī krimikaro yaśca maṇḍalapucchakaḥ | tuṇḍa(ṅga)nābhaḥ sarṣapiko valguliḥ śambukastathā ||16||
agnikīṭaśca vijñeyā dvādaśa prāṇanāśanāḥ | tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ vegajñānāni sarpavat ||17||
tāstāśca vedanāstīvrā rogā vai sānnipātikāḥ | kṣārāgnidagdhavaddaṃśo raktapītasitāruṇaḥ ||18||

div.ab: jvarāṅgamardaromāñcavedanābhiḥ samanvitaḥ | chardyatīsāratṛṣṇāśca dāho mūrcchā vijṛmbhikā ||19|| vepathuśvāsahikkāśca dāhaḥ śītaṃ ca dāruṇam | piḍakopacayaḥ śopho granthayo maṇḍalāni ca ||20|| dadravaḥ karṇikāścaiva visarpāḥ kiṭibhāni ca | tairbhavantīha daṣṭānāṃ yathāsvaṃ cāpyupadravāḥ ||21|| ye'nye teṣāṃ viśeṣāstu tūrṇaṃ teṣāṃ samādiśet | dūṣīviṣaprakopācca tathaiva viṣalepanāt ||22|| liṅgaṃ tīkṣṇaviṣeṣveta... |23|
...cchṛṇu mandaviṣeṣvataḥ | prasekārocakacchardiśirogauravaśītakāḥ ||23|| piḍakākoṭhakaṇḍūnāṃ janma `koṭhārupiḍakākaṇḍūjanma’ iti pā. doṣavibhāgataḥ |24|

yogairnānāvidhaireṣāṃ cūrṇāni garamādiśet ||24|| dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ `dūṣīviṣaprakopācca’ iti, `dūṣīviṣaprakārāṇāṃ tathaivāpyanulepanāt’ iti ca pā.| asyāgre hārāṇacandrastu `tena pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo'lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ| jaṭharagrahaṇīrogayakṣmagulmakṣayaiśca saḥ| nipīḍito marmasu ca śūnapādakaro'lasaḥ| svapne mārjaragomāyuvyālān sa nakulān kapīna|| prāyaḥ paśyati nadyādīn śuṣkāṃśca sa vanaspatīn|’ ityadhikaṃ pāṭhaṃ paṭhati tathā cāpyanulepanāt |25|

ab.seg: ekajātīnatastūrdhvaṃ kīṭān vakṣyāmi bhedataḥ ||25||
sāmānyato daṣṭaliṅgaiḥ sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ca | trikaṇṭaḥ `trikaṇṭakaḥ kuṇī cāpi’ iti pā. kariṇī cāpi hastikakṣo'parājitaḥ | catvāra ete kaṇabhā vyākhyātāstīvravedanāḥ ||26||
tairdaṣṭasya śvayathuraṅgamardo gurutā gātrāṇāṃ daṃśaḥ kṛṣṇaśca bhavati ||27||

pratisūryakaḥ `catuṣpadāḥ kīṭāḥ pratisūryakaḥ’ iti pā., piṅgābhāso, bahuvarṇo, nirūpamo `virūpakaḥ’ iti pā. godhereka iti pañca godherakāḥ `iti pañca’ iti pā.; tairdaṣṭasya śopho dāharujau ca bhavataḥ, godherakeṇaitadeva granthiprādurbhāvo jvaraśca ||28||

galagolikā `gogatiḥ’ iti, galagolī, śvetakṛṣṇā iti ca pā. - śvetā, kṛṣṇā, raktarājī, raktamaṇḍalā, sarvaśvetā, sarṣapiketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe sarṣapikāvarjaṃ dāhaśophakledā bhavanti, sarṣapikayā hṛdayapiḍā'tisāraśca, tāsu madhye sarṣapikā prāṇaharī ||29||

śatapadyastu- paruṣā, kṛṣṇā, citrā, kapilā, pītikā, raktā, śvetā, agniprabhā, ityaṣṭau; tābhirdaṣṭe śopho vedanā dāhaśca hṛdaye, śvetāgniprabhābhyāmetadeva dāho mūrcchā cātimātraṃ śvetapiḍakotpattiśca ||30||

maṇḍūkāḥ- kṛṣṇaḥ, sāraḥ, kuhako, harito, rakto, yavavarṇābho, bhṛkuṭī, koṭikaścetyaṣṭau; tairdaṣṭasya daṃśe kaṇḍūrbhavati pītaphenāgamaśca vaktrāt, bhṛkuṭīkoṭikābhyāmetadeva dāhaśchardirmūrcchā cātimātram ||31||
viśvambharābhirdaṣṭe daṃśaḥ sarṣapākārābhiḥ piḍakābhiḥ sarujābhiścīyate, śītajvarārtaśca puruṣo bhavati ||32||
ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭe todadāhakaṇḍuśvayathavo bhavanti mohaśca; kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭe pītāṅgaśchardyatīsārajvarādibhirabhihanyate; śūkavṛntābhirdaṣṭe kaṇḍūkoṭhāḥ pravardhante śūkaṃ cātra lakṣyate ||33||

pipīlikāḥ- sthūlaśīrṣā, saṃvāhikā, brāhmaṇikā, aṅgulikā; kapilikā, citravarṇeti ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭe `daṣṭasya koṭhaḥ sparśo'gnidagdhavacca| sarvā eva sādhyāḥ’ iti pā. daṃśe śvayathuragnisparśavaddāhaśophau bhavataḥ ||34||

makṣikāḥ- kāntārikā, kṛṣṇā, piṅgalā, madhūlikā, kāṣāyī, sthāliketyevaṃ ṣaṭ; tābhirdaṣṭasya kaṇḍuśophadāharujo bhavanti, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva śyāvapiḍakotpattirupadravāśca jvarādayo bhavanti, kāṣāyī sthālikā ca prāṇahare `tābhirdaṣṭasya dāhaśophau bhavataḥ, sthālikākāṣāyībhyāmetadeva piḍakāśca sopadravā bhavanti’ iti hāraṇacandrasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ||35||
maśakāḥ- sāmudraḥ, parimaṇḍalo, hastimaśakaḥ, kṛṣṇaḥ, pārvatīya iti pañca; tairdaṣṭasya tīvrā kaṇḍūrdaṃśaśophaśca, pārvatīyastu kīṭaiḥ prāṇaharaistulyalakṣaṇaḥ ||36||
nakhāvakṛṣṭe'tyarthaṃ piḍakādāhapākā bhavanti | jalaukasāṃ daṣṭalakṣaṇamuktaṃ cikitsitaṃ ca ||37||
bhavanti cātra- godherakaḥ sthālikā ca ye ca śvetāgnisaprabhe | bhṛkuṭī koṭikaścaiva na sidhyantyekajātiṣu ||38||
śavamūtrapurīṣaistu saviṣairavamarśanāt | syuḥ kaṇḍūdāhakoṭhāruḥpiḍakātodavedanāḥ ||39||
prakledavāṃstathā srāvo bhṛśaṃ sampācayettvacam | digdhaviddhakriyāstatra yathāvadavacārayet ||40||
nāvasannaṃ na cotsannamatisaṃrambhavedanam | daṃśādau viparītārti kīṭadaṣṭaṃ subādhakam ||41||
daṣṭānugraviṣaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarpavat samupācaret | trividhānāṃ tu pūrveṣāṃ `sarpāṇāṃ’ iti pā. traividhyena kriyā hitāḥ ||42||

div.ab: svedamālepanaṃ sekaṃ coṣṇamatrāvacārayet | anyatra mūrcchitāddaṃśāt pākakothaprapīḍitāt ||43|| viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ bahuśaḥ `kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca’ iti pā. śodhanāni ca |44|

ab.seg: śirīṣakaṭukākuṣṭhavacārajanisaindhavaiḥ `... niśogrāsindhusambhavaiḥ’ iti pā.||44||
kṣīramajjavasāsarpiḥśuṇṭhīpippalidāruṣu | utkārikā sthirādau vā sukṛtā svedane hitā ||45||

div.ab: na svedayeta cādaṃśaṃ dhūmaṃ vakṣyāmi vṛścike |46|

ab.seg: agadānekajātīṣu pravakṣyāmi pṛthak pṛthak ||46||
kuṣṭhaṃ vakraṃ vacā pāṭhā bilvamūlaṃ suvarcikā | gṛhadhūmaṃ haridre dve trikaṇṭakaviṣe hitāḥ ||47||
rajanyāgāradhūmaśca vakraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ palāśajam | galagolikadṣṭānāmagado viṣanāśanaḥ ||48||
kuṅkumaṃ tagaraṃ śigru padmakaṃ rajanīdvayam | agado jalapiṣṭo'yaṃ śatapadviṣanāśanaḥ ||49||
meṣaśṛṅgī vacā pāṭhā niculo rohiṇī jalam | sarvamaṇḍūkadaṣṭānāmagado'yaṃ viṣāpahaḥ ||50||
dhavāśvagandhātibalābalāsātiguhāguhāḥ `vacāśvagandhā’ iti pā.| viśvambharābhidaṣṭānāmagado'yaṃ viṣāpahaḥ ||51||
śirīṣaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śāliparṇī sahā niśe | ahiṇḍukābhirdaṣṭānāmagado viṣanāśanaḥ ||52||

div.ab: kaṇḍūmakābhirdaṣṭānāṃ rātrau śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ | divā te naiva sidhyanti sūryaraśmibalārditāḥ ||53|| vakraṃ kuṣṭhamapāmārgaḥ śūkavṛntaviṣe'gadaḥ | bhṛṅgasvarasapiṣṭā vā kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā ||54|| pipīlikābhirdaṣṭānāṃ makṣikāmaśakaistathā | gomūtreṇa yuto lepaḥ kṛṣṇavalmīkamṛttikā ||55|| nakhāvaghṛṣṭasañjāte śophe bhṛṅgaraso hitaḥ `nakhāvakṛṣṭe syāllepe mārkavasvaraso hitaḥ’ iti pā.|56|
pratisūryakadaṣṭānāṃ sarpadaṣṭavadācaret |56|

ab.seg: trividhā vṛścikāḥ proktā mandamadhyamahāviṣāḥ ||56||
gośakṛtkothajā mandā madhyāḥ kāṣṭheṣṭikodbhavāḥ | sarpakothodbhavāstīkṣṇā ye cānye viṣasambhavāḥ ||57||
mandā dvādaśa madhyāstu trayaḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ | daśa viṃśatirityete saṅkhyayā parikīrtitāḥ ||58||

div.ab: kṛṣṇaḥ śyāvaḥ karburaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇo `kāṇḍavarṇo’ iti pā. gomūtrābhaḥ karkaśo `mecako rūkṣavarṇaḥ’ iti pā. mecakaśca | pīto `śveto rakto’ iti pā. dhūmro romaśaḥ śāḍvalābho raktaḥ śvetenodareṇeti mandāḥ `raktaścaite mandavīryā matāstu’ iti pā.||59|| yuktāścaite vṛścikāḥ pucchadeśe syurbhūyobhiḥ parvabhiścetarebhyaḥ | ebhirdaṣṭe vedanā vepathuśca gātrastambhaḥ kṛṣṇaraktāgamaśca ||60|| śākhādaṣṭe vedanā cordhvameti dāhasvedau daṃśaśopho jvaraśca |61|

raktaḥ pītaḥ kāpilenodareṇa sarve dhūmrāḥ parvabhiśca tribhiḥ syuḥ ||61|| ete mūtroccārapūtyaṇḍajātā madhyā jñeyāstriprakāroragāṇām | yasyaiteṣāmanvayādyaḥ prasūto doṣotpattiṃ tatsvarūpāṃ sa kuryāt ||62|| jihvāśopho bhojanasyāvarodho `rasanasyopaghāto’ iti pā. mūrcchā cogrā madhyavīryābhidaṣṭe `vṛścikairmadhyamaistu’ iti pā.|63|

ab.seg: śvetaścitraḥ śyāmalo lohitābho `lohitaśca kṛṣṇaḥ pītaḥ śuklanīlodarau ca’ iti pā. raktaḥ śveto raktanīlodarau ca ||63||

pīto'rakto `agnyābhāsaḥ kāpilo raktakoṣṭho yo vā yuktaḥ kāpilenodareṇa’ iti, `kṛṣṇaḥ śvetaḥ śvetakṛṣṇau pavitrau raktāgnyābhaścāpyathānyonyacitrau’ iti ca pā. nīlapīto'parastu rakto nīlo nīlaśuklastathā ca | rakto babhruḥ pūrvavaccaikaparvā yaścāparvā parvaṇī dve ca yasya ||64||
nānārūpā varṇataścāpi ghorā jñeyāścaite vṛścikāḥ prāṇacaurāḥ `mṛtyurūpāḥ’ iti pā.| janmaiteṣāṃ sarpakothāt pradiṣṭaṃ dehebhyo vā ghātitānāṃ viṣeṇa ||65||
ebhirdaṣṭe sarpavegapravṛttiḥ sphoṭotpattirbhrāntidāhau jvaraśca | khebhyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ śoṇitaṃ yāti tīvraṃ tasmāt `paścāt prāṇān muñcati kṣiprameva’ iti pā. prāṇaistyajyate śīghrameva ||66||

div.ab: ugramadhyaviṣairdaṣṭaṃ cikitset sarpadaṣṭavat | ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchitaṃ pratisārayet ||67|| rajanīsaindhavavyoṣaśirīṣaphalapuṣpajaiḥ |68|

ab.seg: mātuluṅgāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ ca surasāgrajam ||68||
lepe, svede sukhoṣṇaṃ ca gomayaṃ hitamiṣyate | pāne kṣaudrayutaṃ sarpiḥ `sarpiśca sakṣaudraṃ’ iti pā. kṣīraṃ vā bahuśarkaram ||69||
daṃśaṃ mandaviṣāṇāṃ tu cakratailena secayet | vidārīgaṇasiddhena sukhoṣṇenāthavā punaḥ ||70||
kuryāccotkārikāsvedaṃ viṣaghnairupanāhayet `viṣaghnairupanāhanaiḥ’ iti pā.| guḍodakaṃ vā suhimaṃ cāturjātakasaṃyutam ||71||
pānamasmai pradātavyaṃ kṣīraṃ vā saguḍaṃ himam | śikhikukkuṭabarhāṇi saindhavaṃ tailasarpiṣī ||72||
dhūmo hanti prayuktastu śīghraṃ vṛścikajaṃ viṣam | kusumbhapuṣpaṃ rajanī niśā vā kodravaṃ tṛṇam ||73||
ebhirghṛtāktairdhūpastu pāyudeśe prayojitaḥ | nāśayedāśu kīṭotthaṃ vṛścikasya ca yadviṣam ||74||
lūtāviṣaṃ ghoratamaṃ durvijñeyatamaṃ ca tat | duścikitsyatamaṃ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate cāpi bhiṣagbhirmandabuddhibhiḥ ||75||
saviṣaṃ nirviṣaṃ caitadityevaṃ pariśaṅkite | viṣaghnameva kartavyamavirodhi yadauṣadham ||76||
agadānāṃ hi saṃyogo viṣajuṣṭasya yujyate | nirviṣe mānave yukto'gadaḥ sampadyate'sukham ||77||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena `tasmādyatnena bhiṣajā’ iti. jñātavyo viṣaniścayaḥ | ajñātvā viṣasadbhāvaṃ bhiṣagvyāpādayennaram ||78||
prodbhidyamānastu yathā'ṅkureṇa na vyaktajātiḥ pravibhāti vṛkṣaḥ | tadvaddurālakṣyatamaṃ hi tāsāṃ viṣaṃ śarīre pravikīrṇamātram ||79||
īṣatsakaṇḍu pracalaṃ sakoṭhamavyaktavarṇaṃ prathame'hani syāt | anteṣu śūnaṃ parinimnamadhyaṃ pravyaktarūpaṃ ca dine dvitīye ||80||
tryaheṇa taddarśayatīha rūpaṃ viṣaṃ caturthe'hani kopameti | ato'dhike'hni prakaroti jantorviṣaprakopaprabhavān vikārān ||81||
ṣaṣṭhe dine viprasṛtaṃ tu sarvān marmapradeśān bhṛśamāvṛṇoti | tat saptame'tyarthaparītagātraṃ vyāpādayenmartyamatipravṛddham ||82||
yāstīkṣṇacaṇḍograviṣā hi lūtāstāḥ saptarātreṇa naraṃ nihanyuḥ | ato'dhikenāpi nihanyuranyā yāsāṃ viṣaṃ madhyamavīryamuktam ||83||
yāsāṃ kanīyo viṣavīryamuktaṃ tāḥ pakṣamātreṇa vināśayanti | tasmāt prayatnaṃ bhiṣagatra kuryādādaṃśapātādviṣaghātiyogaiḥ ||84||

div.ab: viṣaṃ tu lālānakhamūtradaṃṣṭrārajaḥpurīṣairatha cendriyeṇa | saptaprakāraṃ visṛjanti lūtāstadugramadhyāvaravīryayuktam ||85|| sakaṇḍukoṭhaṃ sthiramalpamūlaṃ lālākṛtaṃ mandarujaṃ vadanti | śophaśca kaṇḍūśca pulālikā `pulānikā’ iti pā. ca dhūmāyanaṃ caiva nakhāgradaṃśe ||86|| daṃśaṃ tu mūtreṇa sakṛṣṇamadhyaṃ saraktaparyantamavehi dīrṇam | daṃṣṭrābhirugraṃ kaṭhinaṃ vivarṇaṃ jānīhi daṃśaṃ sthiramaṇḍalaṃ ca ||87|| rajaḥpurīṣendriyajaṃ hi viddhi sphoṭaṃ vipakvāmalapīlupāṇḍum |88|

ab.seg: etāvadetat samudāhṛtaṃ tu vakṣyāmi lūtāprabhavaṃ purāṇam ||88||
sāmānyato daṣṭamasādhyasādhyaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāpi yathāviśeṣam ||89||
viśvāmitro nṛpavaraḥ kadācidṛṣisattamam | vaśiṣṭhaṃ kopayāmāsa gatvā''śramapadaṃ kila ||90||
kupitasya munestasya lalāṭāt svedabindavaḥ | apatan darśanādeva ravestatsamatejasaḥ `hyadhastāttīkṣṇavarcasaḥ’ iti pā.||91||
tṛṇe maharṣiṇā lūne dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte'pi ca | tato jātāstvimā ghorā nānārūpā mahāviṣāḥ | apakārāya vartante nṛpasādhanavāhane ||92||
yasmāllūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptā muneḥ prasvedabindavaḥ | tasmāllūteti bhāṣyante saṅkhyayā tāśca ṣoḍaśa ||93||

div.ab: kṛcchrasādhyāstathā'sādhyā lūtāstu dvividhāḥsmṛtāḥ | tāsāmaṣṭau kṛcchrasādhyā varjyāstāvatya eva tu ||94|| trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā pītikā tathā | ālamūtraviṣā raktā kasanā cāṣṭamī smṛtā ||95|| tābhirdaṣṭe śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇḍūrdaṃśe ca vedanā | bhavanti ca viśeṣeṇa gadāḥ ślaiṣmikavātikāḥ ||96|| sauvarṇikā lājavarṇā jālinyeṇīpadī tathā | kṛṣṇā'gnivarṇā kākāṇḍā mālāguṇā'ṣṭamī tathā ||97|| tābhirdaṣṭe daṃśakothaḥ pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasya ca | jvaro dāho'tisāraśca gadāḥ syuśca tridoṣajāḥ ||98|| piḍakā vividhākārā maṇḍalāni mahānti ca | mahānto mṛdavaḥ śophā raktāḥ śyāvāścalāstathā ||99|| sāmānyaṃ sarvalūtānāmetadādaṃśalakṣaṇam |100|

ab.seg: viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi sacikitsitam ||100||
trimaṇḍalāyā daṃśe'sṛk kṛṣṇaṃ sravati dīryate | bādhiryaṃ kaluṣā dṛṣṭistathā dāhaśca netrayoḥ ||101||
tatrārkamūlaṃ rajanī nākulī pṛśniparṇikā | pānakarmaṇi śasyante nasyālepāñjaneṣu ca ||102||
śvetāyāḥ piḍakā daṃśe śvetā kaṇḍūmatī bhavet | dāhamūrcchājvaravatī visarpakledarukkarī ||103||
tatra candanarāsnailāhareṇunalavañjulāḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ lāmajjakaṃ vakraṃ naladaṃ cāgado hitaḥ ||104||
ādaṃśe piḍakā tāmrā kapilāyāḥ sthirā bhavet | śiraso gauravaṃ dāhastimiraṃ bhrama eva ca ||105||
tatra padmakakuṣṭhailākarañjakakubhatvacaḥ | sthirārkaparṇyapāmārgadūrvābrāhmyo viṣāpahāḥ ||106||
ādaṃśe pītikāyāstu piḍakā pītikā sthirā | bhavecchardirjvaraḥ śūlaṃ mūrdhni rakte tathā'kṣiṇī ||107||
tatreṣṭāḥ kuṭajośīratuṅgapadmakavañjulāḥ | śirīṣakiṇihīśelukadambakakubhatvacaḥ ||108||
raktamaṇḍanibhe daṃśe piḍakāḥ sarṣapā iva | jāyante tāluśoṣaśca dāhaścālaviṣārdite ||109||
tatra priyaṅguhrīberakuṣṭhalāmajjavañjulāḥ | agadaḥ śatapuṣpā ca sapippalavaṭāṅkurāḥ ||110||
pūtirmūtraviṣādaṃśo visarpī kṛṣṇaśoṇitaḥ | kāsaśvāsavamīmūrcchājvaradāhasamanvitaḥ ||111||
manaḥśilālamadhukakuṣṭhacandanapadmakaiḥ | madhumiśraiḥ salāmajjairagadastatra kīrtitaḥ ||112||
āpāṇḍupiḍako daṃśo dāhakledasamanvitaḥ | raktāyā raktaparyanto vijñeyo raktasaṃyutaḥ ||113||
kāryastatrāgadastoyacandanośīrapadmakaiḥ | tathaivārjunaśelubhyāṃ tvagbhirāmrātakasya ca ||114||
picchilaṃ kasanādaṃśādrudhiraṃ śītalaṃ sravet | kāsaśvāsau ca tatroktaṃ raktalūtācikitsitam ||115||
purīṣagandhiralpāsṛk kṛṣṇāyā daṃśa eva tu | jvaramūrcchāvamīdāhakāsaśvāsasamanvitaḥ ||116||
tatrailāvakrasarpākṣīgandhanākulicandanaiḥ | mahāsugandhisahitaiḥ pratyākhyāyāgadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||117||
daṃśo dāho'gnivakrāyāḥ srāvo'tyarthaṃ jvarastathā | coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā `coṣakaṇḍūromaharṣā vidāhaḥ sphoṭajanma ca’ iti pā. dāhavisphoṭasaṃyutaḥ ||118||
kṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ cātra pratyākhyāya prayojayet | sārivośīrayaṣṭyāhvacandanotpalapadmakam ||119||
sarvāsāmeva yuñjīta viṣe śleṣmātakatvacam | bhiṣak sarvaprakāreṇa tathā cākṣīvapippalam ||120||
kṛcchrasādhyaviṣā hyaṣṭau proktā dve ca yadṛcchayā | avāryaviṣavīryāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni nibodha me ||121||
dhyāmaḥ sauvarṇikādaṃśaḥ sapheno matsyagandhakaḥ | śvāsaḥ kāso jvarastṛṣṇā mūrcchā cātra sudāruṇā ||122||
ādaṃśe lājavarṇāyā dhyāmaṃ pūti sravedasṛk | dāho mūrcchā'tisāraśca śiroduḥkhaṃ `mūrghni cātyarthavedanā’ iti pā. ca jāyate ||123||
ghoro daṃśastu jālinyā rājimānavadīryate | stambhaḥ śvāsastamovṛddhistāluśoṣaśca jāyate ||124||
eṇīpadyāstathā daṃśo bhavet kṛṣṇatilākṛtiḥ | tṛṣṇāmūrcchājvaracchardikāsaśvāsasamanvitaḥ `tṛṣṇāmūrcchājvaraśvāsadāhakṛt prāṇanāśanaḥ’ iti pā.||125||
daṃśaḥ kākāṇḍikādaṣṭe pāṇḍurakto'tivedanaḥ | tṛṇmūrcchāśvāsahṛdrogahikkākāsāḥ syurucchritāḥ ||126||
rakto mālāguṇādaṃśo dhūmagandho'tivedanaḥ | bahudhā ca viśīryeta dāhamūrcchājvarānvitaḥ ||127||
asādhyāsvapyabhihitaṃ pratyākhyāyāśu yojayet | doṣocchrāyaviśeṣeṇa dāhacchedavivarjitam ||128||
sādhyābhirābhirlūtābhirdaṣṭamātrasya `sādhyābhirapi lūtābhiḥ’ iti pā. dehinaḥ | vṛddhipatreṇa matimān samyagādaṃśamuddharet ||129||
amarmaṇi vidhānajño varjitasya jvarādibhiḥ | daṃśasyotkartanaṃ kuryādalpaśvayathukasya ca ||130||
madhusaindhavasaṃyuktairagadairlepayettataḥ | priyaṅgurajanīkuṣṭhasamaṅgāmadhukaistathā ||131||
sārivāṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ payasyāṃ kṣīramoraṭam | vidārīgokṣurakṣaudramadhukaṃ pāyayeta vā ||132||
kṣīriṇāṃ tvakkaṣāyeṇa suśītena ca secayet | upadravān yathādoṣaṃ viṣaghnaireva sādhayet ||133||
nasyāñjanābhyañjanapānadhūmaṃ tathā'vapīḍaṃ kavalagrahaṃ ca | saṃśodhanaṃ cobhayataḥ pragāḍhaṃ kuryātsirāmokṣaṇameva cātra ||134||
kīṭadaṣṭavraṇān sarvānahidaṣṭavraṇānapi | ādāhapākāttān `ādaṃśapākaṃ yatnena cikitset sarpadaṣṭavat’ iti pā. sarvāñcikitsedduṣṭavadbhiṣag ||135||
vinivṛtte tataḥ śophe karṇikāpātanaṃ hitam | nimbapatraṃ trivṛddantī kusumbhaṃ kusumaṃ madhu ||136||
gugguluḥ saindhavaṃ kiṇvaṃ varcaḥ pārāvatasya ca | viṣavṛddhikaraṃ cānnaṃ hitvā sambhojanaṃ hitam ||137||
viṣebhyaḥ khalu sarvebhyaḥ karṇikāmarujāṃ sthirām | pracchayitvā madhūnmiśraiḥ śodhanīyairupācaret ||138||
saptaṣaṣṭhasya kīṭānāṃ śatasyaitadvibhāgaśaḥ | daṣṭalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ cikitsā cāpyanantaram ||139||

div.ab: saviṃśamadhyāyaśatametaduktaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ |140|

ab.seg: ihoddiṣṭānanirdiṣṭānarthān vakṣyāmyathottare ||140||
sanātanatvādvedānāmakṣaratvāttathaiva ca | tathā dṛṣṭaphalatvācca hitatvādapi dehinām ||141||
vāksamūhārthavistārāt pūjitatvācca dehibhiḥ | cikitsitāt puṇyatamaṃ na kiñcidapi śuśrumaḥ ||142||
ṛṣerindraprabhāvasyāmṛtayonerbhiṣagguroḥ | dhārayitvā tu vimalaṃ mataṃ paramasammatam | uktāhārasamācāra iha pretya ca modate ||143||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ kalpasthāne kīṭakalpo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| iti bhagavatā śrīdhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ tacchiṣyeṇa maharṣiṇā suśrutena viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcamaṃ kalpasthānaṃ samāptam |

div.head: aupadravikādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta aupadravikamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: adhyāyānāṃ śate viṃśe yaduktamasakṛnmayā | vakṣyāmi bahudhā samyaguttare'rthānimāniti ||3|| idānīṃ tat pravakṣyāmi tantramuttaramuttamam |4|

nikhilenopadiśyante yatra ‘tatra’ iti pā. rogāḥ pṛthagvidhāḥ ||4|| śālākyatantrābhihitā videhādhipakīrtitāḥ | ye ca vistarato dṛṣṭāḥ kumārābādhahetavaḥ ||5|| ṣaṭsu kāyacikitsāsu ye coktāḥ paramarṣibhiḥ | upasargādayo rogā ye cāpyāgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||6|| triṣaṣṭī rasasaṃsargāḥ svasthavṛttaṃ tathaiva ca | yuktārthā yuktayaścaiva doṣabhedāstathaiva ca ||7|| yatroktā vividhā arthā rogasādhanahetavaḥ |8|

ab.seg: mahatastasya tantrasya durgādhasyāmbudheriva ||8||
ādāvevottamāṅgasthān rogānabhidadhāmyaham | saṅkhyayā lakṣaṇaiścāpi sādhyāsādhyakrameṇa ca ||9||

div.ab: vidyāddvayaṅgulabāhulyaṃ svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitam | dvyaṅgulaṃ sarvataḥ sārdhaṃ bhiṣaṅnayanabudbudam ||10|| suvṛttaṃ gostanākāraṃ sarvabhūtaguṇodbhavam |11|
palaṃ bhuvo'gnito raktaṃ vātāt kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ jalāt ||11|| ākāśādaśrumārgāśca jāyante netrabudbude |12|

ab.seg: dṛṣṭiṃ cātra tathā vakṣye yathā brūyādviśāradaḥ ||12||
netrāyāmatribhāgaṃ tu kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamucyate | kṛṣṇāt saptamamicchanti dṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭiviśāradāḥ ||13||
maṇḍalāni ca sandhīṃśca paṭalāni ca locane | yathākramaṃ vijānīyāt pañca ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca ||14||
pakṣmavartmaśvetakṛṣṇadṛṣṭīnāṃ maṇḍalāni tu | anupūrvaṃ tu te madhyāścatvāro'ntyā yathottaram ||15||
pakṣmavartmagataḥ sandhirvartmaśuklagato'paraḥ | śuklakṛṣṇagatastvanyaḥ kṛṣṇadṛṣṭigato'paraḥ | tataḥ kanīnakagataḥ ṣaṣṭhaścāpāṅgagaḥ smṛtaḥ ||16||
dve vartmapaṭale vidyāccatvāryanyāni cākṣiṇi | jāyate timiraṃ yeṣu vyādhiḥ paramadāruṇaḥ ||17||

div.ab: tejojalāśritaṃ bāhyaṃ teṣvanyat piśitāśritam | medastṛtīyaṃ paṭalamāśritaṃ tvasthi cāparam ||18|| pañcamāṃśasamaṃ dṛṣṭesteṣāṃ bāhulyamiṣyate |19|
sirāṇāṃ kaṇḍarāṇāṃ ca medasaḥ kālakasya ca ||19|| guṇāḥ kālāt paraḥ śleṣmā bandhane'kṣṇoḥ sirāyutaḥ |20|
sirānusāribhirdoṣairviguṇairūrdhvamāgataiḥ ||20|| jāyante netrabhāgeṣu rogāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ |21|

ab.seg: tatrāvilaṃ sasaṃrambhamaśrukaṇḍūpadehavat ‘... maśrupūrṇopadehavat’ iti pā.||21||
gurūṣātodarāgādyairjuṣṭaṃ ‘gurūṣācoṣarāgādyaiḥ’ iti pā. cāvyaktalakṣaṇaiḥ | saśūlaṃ vartmakoṣeṣu śūkapūrṇābhameva ca ||22||
vihanyamānaṃ rūpe vā kriyāsvakṣi yathā purā | dṛṣṭvaiva dhīmān budhyeta doṣeṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ tu tat ||23||
tatra sambhavamāsādya yathādoṣaṃ bhiṣagjitam | vidadhyānnetrajā rogā balavantaḥ syuranyathā ||24||
saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam | vātādīnāṃ pratīghātaḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ ||25||
uṣṇābhitaptasya jalapraveśāddūrekṣaṇāt svapnaviparyayācca | prasaktasaṃrodanakopaśokakleśābhighātādatimaithunācca ||26||
śuktāranālāmlakulatthamāṣaniṣevaṇādvegavinigrahācca | svedādatho dhūmaniṣevaṇācca chardervighātādvamanātiyogāt | bāṣpagrahāt sūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārān janayanti doṣāḥ ||27||

div.ab: vātāddaśa tathā pittāt kaphāccaiva trayodaśa | raktāt ṣoḍaśa vijñeyāḥ sarvajāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ ||28|| tathā bāhyau punardvau ca rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ |29|

hatādhimantho nimiṣo dṛṣṭirgambhīrikā ca yā ||29|| yacca vātahataṃ vartma na te sidhyanti vātajāḥ | yāpyo'tha tanmayaḥ kācaḥ sādhyāḥ syuḥsānyamārutāḥ ||30|| śuṣkākṣipākādhīmanthasyandamārutaparyayāḥ |31|

asādhyo hrasvajāḍyo yo jalasrāvaśca paittikaḥ ||31|| parimlāyī ca nīlaśca yāpyaḥ kāco'tha tanmayaḥ | abhiṣyando'dhimantho'mlādhyuṣitaṃ śuktikā ca yā ||32|| dṛṣṭiḥ pittavidagdhā ca dhūmadarśī ca sidhyati |33|

ab.seg: asādhyaḥ kaphajaḥ srāvo yāpyaḥ kācaśca tanmayaḥ ||33||
abhiṣyando'dhimanthaśca balāsagrathitaṃ ca yat | dṛṣṭiḥ śleṣmavidagdhā ca pothakyo lagaṇśca yaḥ ||34||
krimigranthipariklinnavartmaśuklārmapiṣṭakāḥ ‘krimigranthiḥ pariklinnavartma śuklārma piṣṭakaḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmopanāhaḥ sādhyāstu kathitāḥ śleṣmajeṣu tu ||35||
raktasrāvo'jakājātaṃ śoṇitārśovraṇānvitam ‘lambitam’ iti pā.| śukraṃ na sādhyaṃ kācaśca yāpyastajjaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||36||
manthasyandau kliṣṭavartma ‘klinnavartma’ iti pā. harṣotpātau tathaiva ca | sirājātā'ñjanākhyā ca sirājālaṃ ca yat smṛtam ||37||
parvaṇyathāvraṇaṃ śukraṃ śoṇitārmārjunaśca yaḥ | ete sādhyā vikāreṣu raktajeṣu bhavanti hi ||38||
pūyāsrāvo nākulāndhyamakṣipākātyayo'lajī | asādhyāḥ sarvajā yāpyaḥ kācaḥ kopaśca pakṣmaṇaḥ ||39||
vartmāvabandho yo vyādhiḥ sirāsu piḍakā ca yā | prastāryarmādhimāṃsārma snāyvarmotsaṅginī ca yā ||40||
pūyālasaścārbudaṃ ca śyāvakardamavartmanī | tathā'rśovartma śuṣkārśaḥ śarkarāvartma yacca vai ||41||
saśophaścāpyaśophaśca pāko bahalavartma ca | aklinnavartma kumbhīkā bisavartma ca sidhyati ||42||

div.ab: sanimitto'nimittaśca dvāvasādhyau tu bāhyajau |43|

ab.seg: ṣaṭsaptatirvikārāṇāmeṣā saṅgrahakīrtitā ‘saṅgrahakīrtanā’ iti pā.||43||
nava sandhyāśrayāsteṣu vartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ | śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ ||44||
sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu | bāhyajau dvau samākhyātau rogau paramadāruṇau | bhūya etān pravakṣyāmi saṅkhyārūpacikitsitaiḥ ||45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālakyatantre aupadraviko nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||

div.head: saṃdhigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sandhigatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūyālasaḥ sopanāhaḥ srāvāḥ parvaṇikā'lajī | krimigranthiśca vijñeyā rogāḥ sandhigatā nava ||3||

div.ab: pakvaḥ śophaḥ sandhijaḥ saṃsravedyaḥ sāndraṃ pūyaṃ pūti pūyālasaḥ saḥ |4|

ab.seg: granthirnālpo dṛṣṭisandhāvapākaḥ kaṇḍūprāyo nīrujastūpanāhaḥ ||4||
gatvā sandhīnaśrumārgeṇa doṣāḥ kuryuḥ srāvān rugvihīnān kanīnāt | tān vai srāvān netranāḍīmathaike tasyā liṅgaṃ kīrtayiṣye caturdhā ||5||
pākaḥ sandhau saṃsravedyaśca pūyaṃ pūyāsrāvo naikarūpaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ | śvetaṃ sāndraṃ picchilaṃ saṃsravedyaḥ śleṣmāsrāvo nīrujaḥ sa pradiṣṭaḥ ||6||
raktāsrāvaḥ śoṇitotthaḥ saraktamuṣṇaṃ nālpaṃ saṃsravennātisāndram | pītābhāsaṃ nīlamuṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittāsrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt ||7||
tāmrā tanvī dāhaśūlopapannā raktājjñeyā parvaṇī vṛttaśophā | jātā sandhau kṛṣṇaśukle'lajī syāttasminneva khyāpitā pūrvaliṅgaiḥ ||8||
krimigranthirvartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaśca kaṇḍūṃ kuryuḥ krimayaḥ sandhijātāḥ | nānārūpā vartmaśuklasya sandhau ‘vartmaśuklāntasandhau’ iti pā. caranto'ntarnayanaṃ dūṣayanti ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre sandhigatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvitīyo'dhyayaḥ ||2||

div.head: vartmagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vartmagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pṛthagdoṣāḥ samastā vā yadā vartmavyapāśrayāḥ | sirā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhante vartmasvadhikamūrcchitāḥ ||3||
vivardhya ‘vibadhya’ iti pā. māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca tadā vartmavyapāśrayān | vikārāñjanayantyāśu nāmatastānnibodhata ||4||

div.ab: utsaṅginyatha kumbhīkā pothakyo vartmaśarkarā | tathā'rśovartma śuṣkārśastathaivāñjananāmikā ||5|| bahalaṃ vartma yaccāpi vyādhirvartmāvabandhakaḥ | kliṣṭakardamavartmākhyau śyāvavartma tathaiva ca ||6|| praklinnamapariklinnaṃ vartma vātahataṃ tu yat | arbudaṃ nimiṣaścāpi śoṇitārśaśca yat smṛtam ||7|| lagaṇo biśanāmā ca pakṣmakopastathaiva ca | ekaviṃśatirityete vikārā vartmasaṃśrayāḥ ||8|| nāmabhiste samuddiṣṭā... |9|
...lakṣaṇaistān pracakṣmahe | abhyantaramukhī bāhyotsaṅge'dho vartmanaśca yā ‘piḍakā'bhyantaramukhī bāhyā'dhovartmasaṃśrayā’ iti pā.||9|| vijñeyotsaṅginī nāma tadrūpapiḍakācitā |10|
kumbhīkabījapratimāḥ piḍakā yāstu ‘piḍakāḥ pakṣmavartmanoḥ’ iti pā. vartmajāḥ ||10|| ādhmāpayanti bhinnā yāḥ ‘ādhmāyante tu bhinnāśca’ iti pā. kumbhīkapiḍakāstu tāḥ |11|

ab.seg: srāviṇyaḥ kaṇḍurā ‘kaṇḍūsrāvānvitā’ iti pā. gurvyo raktasarṣapasannibhāḥ | piḍakāśca rujāvatyaḥ pothakya iti sañjñitāḥ ||11||
piḍakābhiḥ susūkṣmābhirghanābhirabhisaṃvṛtā | piḍakā yā kharā sthūlā sā jñeyā vartmaśarkarā ||12||
ervārubījapratimāḥ `ervārubījapratimā pīḍakā mandavedanā| sūkṣmā kharā ca vartmasthā tadarśoṃvartma kīrtyate’ iti pā. piḍakā mandavedanāḥ | sūkṣmāḥ kharāśca vartmasthāstadarśovartma kīrtyate ||13||
dīrgho'ṅkuraḥ kharaḥ stabdho dāruṇo vartmasambhavaḥ | vyādhireṣa samākhyātaḥ śuṣkārśa iti sañjñitaḥ ||14||
dāhatodavatī tāmrā piḍakā vartmasambhavā | mṛdvī mandarujā sūkṣmā jñeyā sā'ñjananāmikā ||15||
vartmopacīyate yasya piḍakābhiḥ samantataḥ | savarṇābhiḥ samābhiśca vidyādbahalavartma tat ||16||
kaṇḍūmatā'lpatodena vartmaśophena yo naraḥ | na samaṃ chādayedakṣi bhavedbandhaḥ sa vartmanaḥ ||17||
mṛdalpavedanaṃ tāmraṃ yadvartma samameva ca | akasmācca bhavedraktaṃ kliṣṭavartma tadādiśet ||18||
kliṣṭaṃ punaḥ pittayutaṃ vidahecchoṇitaṃ yadā | tadā klinnatvamāpannamucyate vartmakardamaḥ ||19||
yadvartma bāhyato'ntaśca śyāvaṃ śūnaṃ savedanam | dāhakaṇḍūparikledi `sakaṇḍūṣāparikledaṃ’ iti pā. śyāvavartmeti tanmatam ||20||
arujaṃ bāhyataḥ śūnamantaḥ klinnaṃ sravatyapi | kaṇḍūnistodabhūyiṣṭhaṃ klinnavartma taducyate ||21||
yasya dhautāni dhautāni sambadhyante punaḥ punaḥ | vartmānyaparipakvāni vidyādaklinnavartma tat ||22||
vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ vartma yasya na mīlyate | etadvātahataṃ vidyāt sarujaṃ yadi vā'rujam ||23||
vartmāntarasthaṃ viṣamaṃ granthibhūtamavedanam | vijñeyamarbudaṃ puṃsāṃ saraktamavalambitam ||24||
nimeṣaṇīḥ sirā vāyuḥ praviṣṭo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ | cālayatyati `cālayedakṣivartmāni’ iti, `cālayedativartmāni’ iti ca pā. vartmāni nimeṣaḥ sa gado mataḥ ||25||
chinnāśchinnā vivardhante vartmasthā mṛdavo'ṅkurāḥ | dāhakaṇḍūrujopetāste'rśaḥ śoṇitasambhavāḥ `śoṇitasambhavam’ iti pā.||26||
apākaḥ kaṭhinaḥ sthūlo granthirvartmabhavo'rujaḥ | sakaṇḍūḥ picchilaḥ kolapramāṇo lagaṇastu saḥ ||27||
śūnaṃ yadvartma bahubhiḥ sūkṣmaiśchidraiḥ samanvitam | bisamantarjala iva bisavartmeti tanmatam ||28||
doṣāḥ pakṣmāśayagatāstīkṣṇāgrāṇi kharāṇi ca | nirvartayanti pakṣmāṇi tairghuṣṭaṃ `tairjuṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. cākṣi dūyate ||29||
uddhṛtairuddhṛtaiḥ `utpāṭitaiḥ punaḥ’ iti pā. śāntiḥ pakṣmabhiścopajāyate | vātātapānaladveṣī pakṣmakopaḥ sa ucyate ||30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre vartmagatarogavijñānīyo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||

div.head: śuklagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śuklagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: prastāriśuklakṣatajādhimāṃsasnāyvarmasañjñāḥ khalu pañca rogāḥ | syuḥ śuktikā cārjunapiṣṭakau ca jālaṃ sirāṇāṃ piḍakāśca yāḥ syuḥ ||3|| rogā balāsagrathitena sārdhamekādaśākṣṇoḥ khalu śuklabhāge |4|

ab.seg: prastāri prathitamihārma śuklabhāge vistīrṇaṃ tanu rudhiraprabhaṃ sanīlam ||4||

div.ab: śuklākhyaṃ mṛdu kathayanti śuklabhāge saśvetaṃ samamiha vardhate ’samamabhivardhate’ iti pā. cireṇa |5|

ab.seg: yanmāṃsaṃ pracayamupaiti śuklabhāge padmābhaṃ tadupadiśanti lohitārma ||5||

div.ab: vistīrṇaṃ mṛdu bahalaṃ yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā tadadhikamāṃsajārma vidyāt |6|

ab.seg: śukle yat piśitamupaiti vṛddhimetat snāyvarmetyabhipaṭhitaṃ kharaṃ prapāṇḍu ||6||

div.ab: śyāvāḥ syuḥ piśitanibhāśca bindavo ye śuktyābhāḥ sitanayane sa śuktisañjñaḥ |7|

ab.seg: eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamastu binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tamarjunaṃ vadanti ||7||

div.ab: utsannaḥ salilanibho'tha piṣṭaśuklo binduryo bhavati sa piṣṭakaḥ suvṛttaḥ |8|

ab.seg: jālābhaḥ kaṭhinasiro mahān saraktaḥ santānaḥ smṛta iha jālasañjñitastu ||8||

div.ab: śuklasthāḥ sitapiḍakāḥ sirāvṛtā yāstā vidyādasitasamīpajāḥ sirājāḥ |9|

ab.seg: kāṃsyābho `kāṃsyābho bhavati sirāvṛtaḥ site yo bindurvā sa tu nirujo balāsakākhyaḥ’ iti pā. bhavati site'mbubindutulyaḥ sa jñeyo'mṛdurarujo balāsakākhyaḥ ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre śuklagatarogavijñānīyo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||

div.head: kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
yat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)mathāvraṇaṃ vā pākātyayaścāpyajakā tathaiva | catvāra ete'bhihitā vikārāḥ kṛṣṇāśrayāḥ saṅgrahataḥ purastāt ||3||
nimagnarūpaṃ hi bhavettu kṛṣṇe sūcyeva viddhaṃ pratibhāti yadvai `yacca’ iti pā.| srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamatīva ruk ca tat savraṇaṃ śukra(kla)mudāharanti ||4||
dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavettu yacca na cāvagāḍhaṃ na ca saṃsraveddhi | avedanāvanna ca yugmaśukraṃ tatsiddhimāpnoti kadācideva ||5||
vicchinnamadhyaṃ piśitāvṛtaṃ vā calaṃ sirāsaktamadṛṣṭikṛcca ‘sirāsūkṣmaṃ’ iti pā.| dvitvaggataṃ lohitamantataśca cirotthitaṃ cāpi vivarjanīyam ||6||
uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā ca kṛṣṇe yasmin bhavenmudganibhaṃ ca śukram | tadapyasādhyaṃ pravadanti kecidanyacca yattittiripakṣatulyam ||7||
sitaṃ yadā bhātyasitapradeśe syandātmakaṃ nātirugaśruyuktam | vihāyasīvācchaghanānukāri ‘abhradalānukāri’iti pā. tadavraṇaṃ sādhyatamaṃ vadanti ||8||

div.ab: gambhīrajātaṃ bahalaṃ ca śukraṃ cirotthitaṃ cāpi vadanti kṛcchram |9|

sañcchādyate `śvetaḥ samākrāmati sarvato hi’ iti pā. śvetanibhena sarvaṃ doṣeṇa yasyāsitamaṇḍalaṃ tu ||9|| tamakṣipākātyayamakṣikopasamutthitaṃ `... makṣirogaṃ sarvātmakaṃ varjayitavyamāhuḥ’ iti pā. tīvrarujaṃ vadanti |10|

ab.seg: ajāpurīṣapratimo rujāvān salohito lohitapicchilāśruḥ | vidārya kṛṣṇaṃ pracayo'bhyupaiti taṃ cājakājātamiti vyavasyet ||10||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre kṛṣṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||

div.head: sarvagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sarvagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
syandāstu catvāra ihopadiṣṭāstāvanta eveha tathā'dhimanthāḥ | śophānvito'śophayutaśca pākāvityevamete daśa sampradiṣṭāḥ ||3||
hatādhimantho'nilaparyayaśca śuṣkākṣipāko'nyata eva vātaḥ | dṛṣṭistathā'mlādhyuṣitā sirāṇāmutpātaharṣāvapi sarvabhāgāḥ ||4||
prāyeṇa sarve nayanāmayāstu bhavantyabhiṣyandanimittamūlāḥ | tasmādabhiṣyandamudīryamāṇamupācaredāśu hitāya dhīmān ||5||
nistodanaṃ stambhanaromaharṣasaṅgharṣapāruṣyaśirobhitāpāḥ | viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca vātābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||6||
dāhaprapākau śiśirābhinandā dhūmāyanaṃ bāṣpasamucchrayaśca | uṣṇāśrutā pītakanetratā ca pittābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||7||
uṣṇābhinandā gurutā'kṣiśophaḥ kaṇḍūpadehau sitatā'tiśaityam | srāvo muhuḥ picchila eva cāpi kaphābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||8||
tāmrāśrutā lohitanetratā ca rājyaḥ samantādatilohitāśca | pittasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni raktābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||9||
vṛddhairetairabhiṣyandairnarāṇāmakriyāvatām | tāvantastvadhimanthāḥ syurnayane tīvravedanāḥ ||10||
utpāṭyata ivātyarthaṃ netraṃ nirmathyate tathā | śiraso'rdhaṃ ca taṃ vidyādadhimanthaṃ svalakṣaṇaiḥ ||11||
netramutpāṭyata iva mathyate'raṇivacca yat | saṅgharṣatodanirbhedamāṃsasaṃrabdhamāvilam ||12||
kuñcanāsphoṭanādhmānavepathuvyathanairyutam | śiraso'rdhaṃ ca yena syādadhimanthaḥ sa mārutāt ||13||
raktarājicitaṃ srāvi vahninevāvadahyate | yakṛtpiṇḍopamaṃ dāhi kṣāreṇāktamiva kṣatam ||14||
prapakvocchūnavartmāntaṃ sasvedaṃ pītadarśanam | mūrcchāśirodāhayutaṃ pittenākṣyadhimanthitam ||15||
śophavannātisaṃrabdhaṃ srāvakaṇḍūsamanvitam | śaityagauravapaicchilyadūṣikāharṣaṇānvitam ||16||
rūpaṃ paśyati duḥkhena pāṃśupūrṇamivāvilam | nāsādhmānaśiroduḥkhayutaṃ śleṣmādhimanthitam ||17||
bandhujīvapratīkāśaṃ tāmyati sparśanākṣamam | raktāsrāvaṃ sanistodaṃ paśyatyagninibhā diśaḥ ||18||
raktamagnāriṣṭavacca kṛṣṇabhāgaśca lakṣyate | yaddīptaṃ raktaparyantaṃ tadraktenādhimanthitam ||19||
hanyāddṛṣṭiṃ saptarātrāt kaphottho'dhīmantho'sṛksambhavaḥ pañcarātrāt | ṣaḍrātrādvai mārutottho nihānyānmithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||20||
kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakvodumbarasannibhaḥ | dāhasaṃharṣatāmratvaśophanistodagauravaiḥ ||21||
juṣṭo muhuḥ sraveccāsramuṣṇaśītāmbu picchilam | saṃrambhī pacyate yaśca netrapākaḥ saśophajaḥ ||22||

div.ab: śophahīnāni liṅgāni netrapāke tvaśophaje |23|

ab.seg: upekṣaṇādakṣi yadā'dhimantho vātātmakaḥ sādayati prasahya | rujābhirugrābhirasādhya eṣa hatādhimanthaḥ khalu nāma rogaḥ ||23||
antaḥsirāṇāṃ śvasanaḥ sthito dṛṣṭiṃ pratikṣipan | hatādhimanthaṃ janayettamasādhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ||24||
pakṣmadvayākṣibhruvamāśritastu yatrānilaḥ sañcarati praduṣṭaḥ | paryāyaśaścāpi rujaḥ karoti taṃ vātaparyāyamudāharanti ||25||
yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma vilokane cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi ||26||
yasyāvaṭūkarṇaśirohanustho manyāgato vā'pyanilo'nyato vā | kuryādrujo'ti bhruvi locane vā tamanyatovātamudāharanti ||27||
amlena bhuktena vidāhinā ca sañchādyate sarvata eva netram | śophānvitaṃ lohitakaiḥ sanīlairetādṛgamlādhyuṣitaṃ vadanti ||28||
avedanā vā'pi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyanti ca tāḥ samantād vyādhiḥ sirotpāta iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||29||
mohāt sirotpāta upekṣitastu jāyeta rogastu sirāpraharṣaḥ | tāmrācchamasraṃ `tāmrābhamasraṃ’ iti pā. sravati pragāḍhaṃ tathā na śaknotyabhivīkṣituṃ ca ||30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre sarvagatarogavijñānīyo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||

div.head: dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
masūradalamātrāṃ tu pañcabhūtaprasādajām | khadyotavisphuliṅgābhāmiddhāṃ `siddhāṃ iti pā. tejobhiravyayaiḥ ||3||
āvṛtāṃ paṭalenākṣṇorbāhyena vivarākṛtim | śītasātmyāṃ nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭimāhurnayanacintakāḥ ||4||
rogāṃstadāśrayān ghorān ṣaṭ ca ṣaṭ ca pracakṣmahe | paṭalānupraviṣṭasya timirasya ca lakṣaṇam ||5||

div.ab: sirābhirabhisamprāpya vigu'bhyantare bhṛśam | prathame paṭale doṣo yasya dṛṣṭau vyavasthitaḥ ||6|| avyaktāni sa rūpāṇi sarvāṇyeva prapaśyati |7|

ab.seg: dṛṣṭirbhṛśaṃ vihvalati dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate ||7||
makṣikā maśakān keśāñjālakāni ca paśyati | maṇḍalāni patākāṃśca marīcīḥ kuṇḍalāni ca ||8||
pariplavāṃśca `paripūrvāśca’ iti pā. vividhān varṣamabhraṃ tamāṃsi ca | dūrasthānyapi rūpāṇi manyate ca samīpataḥ ||9||
samīpasthāni dūre ca dṛṣṭergocaravibhramāt | yatnavānapi cātyarthaṃ sūcīpāśaṃ na paśyati ||10||

div.ab: ūrdhvaṃ paśyati nādhastāttṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ gate | mahāntyapi ca rūpāṇi cchāditānīva vāsasā ||11|| karṇanāsākṣiyuktāni viparītāni vīkṣate `cekṣate’ iti pā.| yathādoṣaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭirdoṣe balīyasi ||12|| adhaḥsthite samīpasthaṃ dūrasthaṃ coparisthite | pārśvasthite tathā doṣe pārśvasthāni na paśyati ||13|| samantataḥ sthite doṣe saṅkulānīva `saṅkulāni ca’ iti pā. paśyati | dṛṣṭimadhyagate doṣe sa ekaṃ manyate dvidhā ||14|| dvidhāsthite tridhā paśyedbahudhā cānavasthite | timirākhyaḥ sa vai doṣaḥ... |15|

ab.seg: ... caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ ||15||
ruṇaddhi sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ liṅganāśaḥ sa ucyate | tasminnapi tamobhūte nātirūḍhe mahāgade ||16||
candrādityau sanakṣatrāvantarīkṣe ca vidyutaḥ | nirmalāni ca tejāṃsi bhrājiṣṇūni `bhrājiṣṇūnīva paśyati’ iti pā. ca paśyati ||17||

div.ab: sa eva liṅganāśastu nīlikākācasañjñitaḥ |18|
tatra vātena rūpāṇi bhramantīva sa paśyati ||18|| āvilānyaruṇābhāni vyāviddhāni ca mānavaḥ |19|
pittenādityakhadyotaśakracāpataḍidguṇān ||19|| śikhibarhavicitrāṇi nīlakṛṣṇāni paśyati |20|
kaphena paśyedrūpāṇi snigdhāni ca sitāni ca ||20|| gauracāmaragaurāṇi śvetābhrapratimāni ca | paśyedasūkṣmāṇyatyarthaṃ vyabhre caivābhrasamplavam ||21|| salilaplāvitānīva parijāḍyāni mānavaḥ |22|
tathā raktena raktāni tamāṃsi vividhāni ca ||22|| haritaśyāvakṛṣṇāni dhūmadhūmrāṇi cekṣate |23|

ab.seg: sannipātena citrāṇi viplutāni ca paśyati ||23||
bahudhā vā dvidhā vā'pi sarvāṇyeva samantataḥ | hīnādhikāṅgānyathavā jyotīṃṣyapi ca paśyati `mānavaḥ’ iti pā.||24||

div.ab: pittaṃ kuryāt parimlāyi mūrcchitaṃ raktatejasā | pītā diśastathodyantamādityamiva paśyati ||25|| vikīryamāṇān khadyotairvṛkṣāṃstejobhireva ca |26|

ab.seg: vakṣyāmi ṣaḍvidhaṃ `ṣaḍvidhaiḥ’ iti pā. rāgairliṅganāśamataḥ param ||26||
rāgo'ruṇo mārutajaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pittāt parimlāyyathavā'pi nīlaḥ | kaphāt sitaḥ śoṇitajastu raktaḥ samastadoṣo'tha vicitrarūpaḥ `samastadoṣe'tha vicitravarṇaḥ’ iti pā.||27||

div.ab: raktajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭau sthūlakācānalaprabham `sthūlakācāruṇaprabham’ iti pā.| parimlāyini roge syānmlāyyānīlaṃ ca maṇḍalam ||28|| doṣakṣayāt kadācit syātsvayaṃ tatra ca darśanam |29|

ab.seg: aruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vātāccañcalaṃ paruṣaṃ tathā ||29||
pittānmaṇḍalamānīlaṃ kāṃsyābhaṃ pītameva vā | śleṣmaṇā bahalaṃ snigdhaṃ śaṅkhakundendupāṇḍuram ||30||
calatpadmapalāśasthaḥ śuklo bindurivāmbhasaḥ | saṅkucatyātape'tyarthaṃ chāyāyāṃ vistṛto bhavet ||31||
mṛdyamāne ca nayane maṇḍalaṃ tadvisarpati | pravālapadmapatrābhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śoṇitātmakam ||32||
dṛṣṭirāgo bhaveccitro liṅganāśe tridoṣaje | yathāsvaṃ doṣaliṅgāni sarveṣveva bhavanti hi ||33||

div.ab: ṣaḍ liṅganāśāḥ ṣaḍime ca rogā dṛṣṭyāśrayāḥ ṣaṭ ca ṣaḍeva ca syuḥ | tathā naraḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ kaphena cānyastvatha dhūmadarśī ||34|| yo hrasvajāḍyo(tyo) `yo hasvajātyo’ iti pā. nakulāndhatā ca gambhīrasañjñā ca tathaiva dṛṣṭiḥ |35|

pittena duṣṭena gatena dṛṣṭiṃ pītā bhavedyasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ ||35|| pītāni rūpāṇi ca manyate yaḥ sa mānavaḥ pittavidagdhadṛṣṭiḥ | prāpte tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ tu doṣe divā na paśyenniśi vīkṣate ca ||36|| (rātrau ‘ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate’ sa śītānugṛhītadṛṣṭiḥ pittālpabhāvādapi tāni paśyet) |37|

ab.seg: tathā naraḥ śleṣmavidagdhadṛṣṭistānyeva śuklāni hi manyate tu ||37||
triṣu sthitolpaḥ paṭaleṣu doṣo naktāndhyamāpādayati prasahya | divā sa sūryānugṛhītacakṣurikṣeta `sūryānugṛhītacakṣurīkṣeta’ iti pā. rūpāṇi kaphālpabhāvāt ||38||
śokajvarāyāsaśirobhitāpairabhyāhatā yasya narasya dṛṣṭiḥ | sadhūmakān paśyati sarvabhāvāṃstaṃ dhūmadarśīti vadanti rogam ||39||

div.ab: sa hrasvajāḍyo `hrasvajātyo’ iti pā. divaseṣu kṛcchrāddhrasvāni rūpāṇi ca yena paśyet |40|
vidyotate yena narasya dṛṣṭirdoṣābhipannā nakulasya yadvat ||40|| citrāṇi rūpāṇi divā sa paśyet sa vai vikāro nakulāndhyasañjñaḥ |41|
dṛṣṭirvirūpā śvasanopasṛṣṭā saṅkucyate'bhyantarataśca yāti ||41|| rujāvagāḍhā ca tamakṣirogaṃ gambhīriketi pravadanti tajjñāḥ |42|
bāhyau punardvāviha sampradiṣṭau nimittataścāpyanimittataśca ||42|| nimittatastatra śirobhitāpājjñeyastvabhiṣyandanidarśanaiśca `abhiṣyandanidarśanaśca’ iti pā.|43|

ab.seg: surarṣigandharvamahoragāṇāṃ sandarśanenāpi ca bhāsvarāṇām ||43||
hanyeta dṛṣṭirmanujasya yasya sa liṅganāśastvanimittasañjñaḥ | tatrākṣi vispaṣṭamivāvabhāti vaidūryavarṇā vimalā ca dṛṣṭiḥ ||44||
vidīryate sīdati hīyate vā nṛṇāmabhīghātahatā tu dṛṣṭiḥ ||45||
ityete nayanagatā mayā vikārāḥ saṅkhyātāḥ pṛthagiha ṣaṭ ca saptatiśca | eteṣāṃ pṛthagiha vistareṇa sarvaṃ vakṣye'haṃ tadanu cikitsitaṃ yathāvat ||46||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||

div.head: cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaścikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ `cikitsitapravibhāgīyaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ (suśrutāya) ||2||
ṣaṭsaptatirye'bhihitā vyādhayo nāmalakṣaṇaiḥ | cikitsitamidaṃ teṣāṃ samāsavyāsataḥ `samāsādvyāsataḥ\\’ iti pā. śṛṇu ||3||
chedyāsteṣu daśaikaśca nava lekhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | bhedyāḥ pañca vikārāḥ syurvyadhyāḥ pañcadaśaiva tu ||4||
dvādaśā'śastrakṛtyāśca yāpyāḥ sapta bhavanti hi | rogā varjayitavyāḥ syurdaśa pañca ca jānatā | asādhyau vā bhavetāṃ tu yāpyau cāgantusañjñitau ||5||
arśo'nvitaṃ bhavati vartma tu yattathā'rśaḥ śuṣkaṃ tathā'rbudamatho piḍakāḥ sirājāḥ | jālaṃ sirājamapi pañcavidhaṃ tathā'rma chedyā bhavanti saha parvaṇikāmayena ||6||
utsāṅginī bahalakardamavartmanī ca śyāvaṃ ca yacca paṭhitaṃ tviha baddhavartma | kliṣṭaṃ ca pothakiyutaṃ khalu yacca vartma kumbhīkinī ca saha śarkarayā ca lekhyāḥ ||7||

div.ab: śleṣmopanāhalagaṇau ca bisaṃ ca bhedyā granthiśca yaḥ kṛmikṛto'ñjananāmikā ca |8|
ādau sirā nigaditāstu yayoḥ prayoge pākau ca yau nayanayoḥ pavano'nyataśca ||8|| pūyālasānilaviparyayamanthasañjñāḥ syandāstu yāntyupaśamaṃ hi sirāvyadhena |9|

ab.seg: śuṣkākṣipākakaphapittavidagdhadṛṣṭiṣvamlākhyaśukrasahitārjunapiṣṭakeṣu ||9||
aklinnavartmahutabhugdhvajadarśiśuktipraklinnavartmasu tathaiva balāsasañjñe | āgantunā''mayayugena ca dūṣitāyāṃ dṛṣṭau na śastrapatanaṃ pravadanti tajjñāḥ ||10||

div.ab: sampaśyataḥ ṣaḍapi ye'bhihitāstu kācāste pakṣmakopasahitāstu bhavanti yāpyāḥ |11|

ab.seg: catvāra eva pavanaprabhavāstvasādhyā dvau pittajau kaphanimittaja eka eva | aṣṭārdhakā rudhirajāśca gadāstridoṣāstāvanta eva gaditāvapi bāhyajau dvau ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre cikitsitapravibhāgavijñānīyo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||

div.head: vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: purāṇasarpiṣā snigdhau syandādhīmanthapīḍitau | svedayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sirāmokṣeṇa yojayet ||3|| sampādayedbastibhistu samyak snehavirecitau | tarpaṇaiḥ puṭapākaiśca dhūmairāścyotanaistathā ||4|| nasyasnehaparīṣekaiḥ śirobastibhireva ca |5|
vātaghnānūpajalajamāṃsāmlakvāthasecanaiḥ ||5|| snehaiścaturbhiruṣṇaiśca tatpītāmbaradhāraṇaiḥ | payobhirvesavāraiśca sālvaṇaiḥ pāyasaistathā ||6|| bhiṣak sampādayedetāvupanāhaiśca pūjitaiḥ |7|
grāmyānūpaudakarasaiḥ snigdhaiḥ phalarasānvitaiḥ ||7|| susaṃskṛtaiḥ payobhiśca tayorāhāra iṣyate |8|

tathā copari bhaktasya sarpiḥpānaṃ(ne)praśasyate `bhaktasyopari sarpistau pibetāṃ cāpi mānavau’ iti pā.||8|| triphalākvāthasaṃsiddhaṃ kevalaṃ jīrṇameva vā | siddhaṃ vātaharaiḥ kṣīraṃ prathamena gaṇena vā ||9|| snehāstailādvinā siddhā vātaghnaistarpaṇe hitāḥ |10|
snaihikaḥ puṭapākaśca dhūmo nasyaṃ ca tadvidham ||10|| nasyādiṣu sthirākṣīramadhuraistailamiṣyate |11|
eraṇḍapallave mūle tvaci vā''jaṃ payaḥ śṛtam ||11|| kaṇṭakāryāśca mūleṣu sukhoṣṇaṃ secane hitam |12|
saindhavodīcyayaṣṭyāhvapippalībhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ ||12|| hitamardhodakaṃ seke tathā''ścyotanameva ca |13|
hīberavakramañjiṣṭhodumbaratvakṣu sādhitam ||13|| sāmbhaśchāgaṃ payo vā'pi śūlāścyotanamuttamam |14|
madhukaṃ rajanīṃ pathyāṃ devadāruṃ ca peṣayet ||14|| ājena payasā śreṣṭhamabhiṣyande tadañjanam |15|
gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nāgaraṃ ca yathottaram ||15|| dviguṇaṃ piṣṭamadbhistu guṭikāñjanamiṣyate |16|

ab.seg: snehāñjanaṃ hitaṃ cātra vakṣyate tadyathāvidhi ||16||
rogo yaścānyatovāto yaśca mārutaparyayaḥ | anenaiva vidhānena bhiṣak tāvapi sādhayet ||17||

div.ab: pūrvabhaktaṃ hitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ vā'pyatha bhojane | vṛkṣādanyāṃ kapitthe ca pañcamūle mahatyapi ||18|| sakṣīraṃ karkaṭarase siddhaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ pibet | siddhaṃ vā hitamatrāhuḥ pattūrārtagalagnikaiḥ ||19|| sakṣīraṃ meṣaśṛṅgyā vā sarpirvīratareṇa vā |20|

ab.seg: saindhavaṃ dāru śuṇṭhī ca mātuluṅgaraso ghṛtam ||20||
stanyodakābhyāṃ kartavyaṃ śuṣkapāke tadañjanam | pūjitaṃ sarpiṣaścātra pānamakṣṇośca tarpaṇam ||21||
ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena cāṇunā | pariṣeke hitaṃ cātra payaḥ śītaṃ sasaindhavam ||22||
rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samāyutam | sarpiryutaṃ stanyaghṛṣṭamañjanaṃ vā mahauṣadham ||23||
vasā vā''nūpajalajā saindhavena samāyutā | nāgaronmiśritā kiñcicchuṣkapāke tadañjanam ||24||
pavanaprabhavā rogā ye keciddṛṣṭināśanāḥ | bījenānena matimān teṣu karma prayojayet ||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre vātābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||

div.head: pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pittasyande paittike cādhimanthe raktāsrāvaḥ sraṃsanaṃ cāpi kāryam | akṣṇoḥ sekālepanasyāñjanāni paitte ca syādyadvisarpe vidhānam ||3||

div.ab: gundrāṃ śāliṃ śaivalaṃ śailabhedaṃ dārvīmelāmutpalaṃ rodhramabhram | padmātpatraṃ śarkarā darbhamikṣuṃ tālaṃ rodhraṃ vetasaṃ padmakaṃ ca ||4|| drākṣāṃ kṣaudraṃ candanaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ yoṣitkṣīraṃ rātryanante ca piṣṭvā | sarpiḥsiddhaṃ tarpaṇe sekanasye ‘nāvane ca’ iti pā. śastaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhameteṣu cājam ||5|| yojyo vargo vyasta eṣo'nyathā vā samyaṅnasye'ṣṭārdhasaṅkhye'pi nityam |6|

ab.seg: kriyāḥ sarvā pittaharyaḥ praśastāstryahāccordhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam ‘śastā'śeṣā pittahantrī kriyā ca tryahādūrdhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam’ iti pā.||6||

div.ab: pālāśaṃ syācchoṇitaṃ cāñjanārthe śallakyā vā śarkarākṣaudrayuktam |7|

ab.seg: rasakriyāṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktāṃ pālindyāṃ vā madhuke vā'pi kuryāt ||7||

div.ab: mustā phenaḥ sāgarasyotpalaṃ ca kṛmighnailādhātribījādrasaśca |8|

ab.seg: tālīśailāgairikośīraśaṅkhairevaṃ yuñjyādañjanaṃ stanyapiṣṭaiḥ ||8||

div.ab: cūrṇaṃ kuryādañjanārthe raso vā stanyopeto dhātakīsyandanābhyām |9|

ab.seg: yoṣitstanyaṃ śātakumbhaṃ vighṛṣṭaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ kaiṃśukaṃ cāpi puṣpam ||9||
rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca nāryāḥ kṣīre yaṣṭikāhvaṃ vacāṃ ca | piṣṭvā kṣīre varṇakasya tvacaṃ ca toyonmiśre candanodumbare ca ||10||
kāryaḥ phenaḥ sāgarasyāñjanārthe nārīstanye mākṣike cāpi ghṛṣṭaḥ | yoṣitstanye sthāpitaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca ||11||
kṣaumābaddhaṃ pathyamāścyotane vā sarpirghṛṣṭaṃ ‘sarpirbhṛṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhram | toyonmiśrāḥ kāśmarīdhātripathyāstadvaccāhuḥ kaṭphalaṃ cāmbunaiva ||12||
eṣo'mlākhye'nukramaścāpi śuktau kāryaḥ sarvaḥ syātsirāmokṣavarjyaḥ ||13||

div.ab: sarpiḥ peyaṃ traiphalaṃ tailvakaṃ vā peyaṃ vā syāt kevalaṃ yat purāṇam |14|

ab.seg: doṣe'dhastācchuktikāyāmapāste śītairdravyairañjanaṃ kāryamāśu ||14||
vaidūryaṃ yat sphāṭikaṃ vaidrumaṃ ca mauktaṃ śāṅkhaṃ rājataṃ śātakumbham | cūrṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktaṃ śuktiṃ hanyādañjanaṃ caitadāśu ||15||
yuñjyāt sarpirdhūmadarśī narastu śeṣaṃ kuryādraktapitte vidhānam | yaccaivānyat pittahṛccāpi sarvaṃ yadvīsarpe paittike vai vidhānam ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pittābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||

div.head: śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śleṣmābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: syandādhimanthau kaphajau pravṛddhau jayet sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇena | svedāvapīḍāñjanadhūmasekapralepayogaiḥ kavalagrahaiśca ||3|| rūkṣaistathā''ścyotanasaṃvidhānaistathaiva rūkṣaiḥ puṭapākayogaiḥ | tryahāttryahāccāpyapatarpaṇānte prātastayostiktaghṛtaṃ praśastam ||4|| tadannapānaṃ ca samācareddhi yacchleṣmaṇo naiva karoti vṛddhim |5|
kuṭannaṭāsphoṭaphaṇijjhabilvapattūrapilvarkakapitthabhaṅgaiḥ ||5|| svedaṃ vidadhyāt... |6|
... athavā'nulepaṃ barhiṣṭhaśuṇṭhīsurakāṣṭhakuṣṭhaiḥ |6|

sindhūtthahiṅgutriphalāmadhūkaprapauṇḍarīkāñjanatutthatāmraiḥ ||6|| piṣṭairjalenāñjanavartayaḥ syuḥ pathyāharidrāmadhukāñjanairvā | trīṇyūṣaṇāni triphalā haridrā viḍaṅgasāraśca samāni ca syuḥ ||7|| barhiṣṭhakuṣṭhāmarakāṣṭhaśaṅkhapāṭhāmalavyoṣamanaḥśilāśca ‘pāṭhānakhavyoṣamanaḥśilāśca’ iti pā.| piṣṭvā'mbunā vā kusumāni jātikarañjaśobhāñjanajāni yuñjyāt ||8|| phalaṃ prakīryādathavā'pi śigroḥ puṣpaṃ ca tulyaṃ ‘tutthaṃ’ iti pā. bṛhatīdvayasya | rasāñjanaṃ saindhavacandanaṃ ca manaḥśilāle laśunaṃ ca tulyam ||9|| piṣṭvā'ñjanārthe kaphajeṣu dhīmān vartīrvidadhyānnayanāmayeṣu |10|

ab.seg: roge balāsagrathite'ñjanaṃ jñaiḥ kartavyametat suviśuddhakāye ||10||
nīlān yavān gavyapayo'nupītān śalākinaḥ śuṣkatanūn vidahya | tathā'rjakāsphotakapitthabilvanirguṇḍijātīkusumāni caiva ||11||
tatkṣāravatsaindhavatuttharocanaṃ pakvaṃ vidadhyādatha lohanāḍyām | etadbalāsagrathite'ñjanaṃ syādeṣo'nukalpastu phaṇijjhakādau ||12||
mahauṣadhaṃ māgadhikāṃ ca mustāṃ ‘mukhyāṃ’ iti pā. sasaindhavaṃ yanmaricaṃ ca śuklam | tanmātuluṅgasvarasena piṣṭaṃ netrāñjanaṃ piṣṭakamāśu hanyāt ||13||

div.ab: phale ‘phalaṃ bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāmādāya’ iti pā. bṛhatyā magadhodbhavānāṃ nidhāya kalkaṃ phalapākakāle | srotojayuktaṃ ‘srotojayuktaṃ khalu saptarātrāttaduddhṛtaṃ syāttu tathaiva pathyam’ iti pā. ca taduddhṛtaṃ syāttadvattu piṣṭe ... |14|
...vidhireṣa cāpi ||14|| vārtākaśigrvindrasurāpaṭolakirātatiktāmalakīphaleṣu |15|
