kāsīsasāmudrarasāñjanāni jātyāstathā kṣā(ko)rakameva cāpi ||15|| praklinnavartmanyupadiśyate tu yogāñjanaṃ tanmadhunā'vaghṛṣṭam |16|
nādeyamagryaṃ maricaṃ ca śuklaṃ nepālajātā ca samapramāṇā ||16|| samātuluṅgadrava eṣa yogaḥ kaṇḍūṃ nihanyāt sakṛdañjanena |17|
saśṛṅgaveraṃ suradāru mustaṃ sindhuprabhū(sū)taṃ mukulāni jātyāḥ ||17|| surāprapiṣṭaṃ tvidamañjanaṃ hi kaṇḍvāṃ ca śophe ca hitaṃ vadanti |18|

ab.seg: syandādhimanthakramamācarecca sarveṣu caiteṣu sadā'pramattaḥ ||18||
(viśeṣato nāvanameva kāryaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ cāpi yathopadiṣṭam ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate ) ||19||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kaphābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||

div.head: raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
manthaṃ syandaṃ sirotpātaṃ sirāharṣaṃ ca raktajam | ekenaiva vidhānena cikitseccaturo gadān ||3||
vyādhyārtāṃścaturo'pyetān snigdhānkaumbhena sarpiṣā | rasairudārairathavā sirāmokṣeṇa yojayet ||4||

div.ab: viriktānāṃ prakāmaṃ ca śirāṃsyeṣāṃ viśodhayet | vairecanikasiddhena sitāyuktena sarpiṣā ||5|| (majjñā vā tadvimiśreṇa medasā tacchṛtena vā) |6|

ab.seg: tataḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni nasyāni dhūmāśca yathāsvameva | āścyotanābhyañjanatarpaṇāni snigdhāśca kāryāḥ puṭapākayogāḥ ||6||
nīlotpalośīrakaṭaṅkaṭerīkālīyayaṣṭīmadhumustarodhraiḥ | sapadmakairdhautaghṛtapradigdhairakṣṇoḥ pralepaṃ paritaḥ prakuryāt ||7||
rujāyāṃ cāpyatibhṛśaṃ svedāśca mṛdavo hitāḥ | akṣṇoḥ samantataḥ kāryaṃ pātanaṃ ca jalaukasām ||8||
ghṛtasya mahatī mātrā pītā cārtiṃ niyacchati | pittābhiṣyandaśamano vidhiścāpyupapāditaḥ ||9||
kaśerumadhukābhyāṃ vā cūrṇamambarasaṃvṛtam | nyastamapsvāntarikṣāsu hitamāścyotanaṃ bhavet ||10||
pāṭalyarjunaśrīparṇīdhātakīdhātribilvataḥ | puṣpāṇyatha bṛhatyośca bimbīloṭācca tulyaśaḥ ||11||
samañjiṣṭhāni madhunā piṣṭānīkṣurasena vā | raktābhiṣyandaśāntyarthametadañjanamiṣyate ||12||
candanaṃ kumudaṃ patraṃ śilājatu sakuṅkumam | ayastāmrarajastutthaṃ nimbaniryāsamañjanam ||13||
trapu kāṃsyamalaṃ cāpi piṣṭvā puṣparasena tu | vipulā yāḥ kṛtā vartyaḥ pūjitāścāñjane sadā ||14||

div.ab: syādañjanaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ sirotpātasya bheṣajam | tadvatsaindhavakāsīsaṃ stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ca pūjitam ||15|| madhunā śaṅkhanaipālītutthadārvyaḥ sasaindhavāḥ | rasaḥ śirīṣapuṣpācca surāmaricamākṣikaiḥ ||16|| yuktaṃ tu madhunā vā'pi gairikaṃ hitamañjane |17|

ab.seg: sirāharṣe'ñjanaṃ kuryāt phāṇitaṃ madhusaṃyutam ||17||
madhunā tārkṣyajaṃ vā'pi kāsīsaṃ vā sasaindhavam | vetrāmlastanyasaṃyuktaṃ phāṇitaṃ ca sasaindhavam ||18||

div.ab: paittaṃ vidhimaśeṣeṇa kuryādarjunaśāntaye | ikṣukṣaudrasitāstanyadārvīmadhukasaindhavaiḥ ||19|| sekāñjanaṃ cātra hitamamlairāścyotanaṃ tathā | sitāmadhukakaṭvaṅgamastukṣaudrāmlasaindhavaiḥ ||20|| bījapūrakakolāmladāḍimāmlaiśca yuktitaḥ | ekaśo vā dviśo vā'pi yojitaṃ vā tribhistribhiḥ ||21|| sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ śaṅkho madhukaṃ madhu caiva hi | śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyuktaḥ sāmudraḥ phena eva vā ||22|| dvāvimau vihitau yogāvañjane'rjunanāśanau | saindhavakṣaudrakatakāḥ sakṣaudraṃ vā rasāñjanam ||23|| kāsīsaṃ madhunā vā'pi yojyamatrāñjane sadā |24|

lohacūrṇāni sarvāṇi dhātavo lavaṇāni ca ||24|| ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi gaṇaścāpyavasādanaḥ | kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni laśunaṃ kaṭukatrayam ||25|| karañjabījamelā ca lekhyāñjanamidaṃ smṛtam | puṭapākāvasānena raktavisrāvaṇādinā ||26|| sampāditasya vidhinā kṛtsnena syandaghātinā |27|

ab.seg: anenāpaharecchukramavraṇaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak ||27||

div.ab: uttānamavagāḍhaṃ vā karkaśaṃ vā'pi savraṇam | śirīṣabījamaricapippalīsaindhavairapi ||28|| śukrasya gharṣaṇaṃ kāryamathavā saindhavena tu | kuryāttāmrarajaḥśaṅkhaśilāmaricasaindhavaiḥ ||29|| antyāddviguṇitairebhirañjanaṃ śukranāśanam | kuryādañjanayogau vā samyak ślokārdhikāvimau ||30|| śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ | kṣaudradantārṇavamalaśirīṣakusumairapi ||31|| kṣārāñjanaṃ vā vitaredbalāsagrathitāpaham | mudgān vā nistuṣān bhṛṣṭān śaṅkhakṣaudrasitāyutān ||32|| madhūkasāraṃ madhunā yojayeccāñjane sadā | bibhītakāsthimajjā vā sakṣaudraḥ śukranāśanaḥ ||33|| śaṅkhaśuktimadhudrākṣāmadhukaṃ katakāni ca | dvitvaggate saśūle vā vātaghnaṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam ||34|| vaṃśajāruṣkarau tālaṃ nārikelaṃ ca dāhayet | visrāvya kṣāravaccūrṇaṃ bhāvayetkarabhāsthijam ||35|| bahuśo'ñjanametatsyācchukravaivarṇyanāśanam |36|

ab.seg: ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam ||36||
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena pūrayet sarpiṣā saha | bahuśo'valikheccāpi vartmāsyopagataṃ yadi ||37||

div.ab: saśophaścāpyaśophaśca dvau pākau yau prakīrtitau | snehasvedopapannasya tatra viddhvā sirāṃ bhiṣak ||38|| sekāścyotananasyāni puṭapākāṃśca kārayet |39|

sarvataścāpi śuddhasya kartavyamidamañjanam ||39|| tāmrapātrasthitaṃ māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ sarpiḥsaindhavasaṃyutam’ iti pā. sarpiḥ saindhavasaṃyutam | maireyaṃ vā'pi dadhyevaṃ dadhyuttarakameva vā ||40|| ghṛtaṃ kāṃsyamalopetaṃ stanyaṃ vā'pi sasaindhavam | madhūkasāraṃ madhunā tulyāṃśaṃ gairikeṇa vā ||41|| sarpiḥsaindhavatāmrāṇi yoṣitstanyayutāni vā |42|

ab.seg: dāḍimārevatāśamantakolāmlaiśca sasaindhavām | rasakriyāṃ vā vitaretsamyakpākajighāṃsayā ||42||
māsaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ’ iti pā. saindhavasaṃyuktaṃ sthitaṃ sarpiṣi nāgaram | āścyotanāñjanaṃ yojyamabalākṣīrasaṃyutam ||43||
jātyāḥ puṣpaṃ saindhavaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kṛṣṇābījaṃ kīṭaśatrośca sāram | etat piṣṭaṃ netrapāke'ñjanārthaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ nirviśaṅkaṃ ‘nirviśaṅkaiḥ’ iti pā. prayojyam ||44||
pūyālase śoṇitamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitaṃ tathaivāpyupanāhanaṃ ca | kṛtsno vidhiścekṣaṇapākaghātī yathāvidhānaṃ bhiṣajā prayojyaḥ ||45||
kāsīsasindhuprabhavārdrakaistu hitaṃ bhavedañjanameva cātra | kṣaudrānvitairebhirathopayuñjyādanyattu tāmrāyasacūrṇayuktaiḥ ||46||
snehādibhiḥ samyagapāsya doṣāṃstṛptiṃ vidhāyātha yathāsvameva | praklinnavartmānamupakrameta sekāñjanāścyotananasyadhūmaiḥ ||47||
mustāharidrāmadhukapriyaṅgusiddhārtharodhrotpalasārivābhiḥ | kṣuṇṇābhirāścyotanameva kāryamatrāñjanaṃ cāñjanamākṣikaṃ syāt ||48||

div.ab: patraṃ phalaṃ cāmalakasya paktvā kriyāṃ vidadhyādathavā'ñjanārthe | vaṃśasya mūlena rasakriyāṃ vā vartīkṛtāṃ tāmrakapālapakvām ||49|| rasakriyāṃ vā triphalāvipakvāṃ palāśapuṣpaiḥ kharamañjarervā |50|
piṣṭvā chagalyāḥ payasā malaṃ vā kāṃsasya dagdhvā saha tāntavena ||50|| pratyañjanaṃ tanmaricairupetaṃ cūrṇena tāmrasya sahopayojyam |51|
samudraphenaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca śaṅkho'tha mudgo maricaṃ ca śuklam ||51|| cūrṇāñjanaṃ jāḍyamathāpi ‘yojyamathāpi’ iti pā. kaṇḍūmaklinnavartmānyupahanti śīghram |52|

ab.seg: praklinnavartmanyapi caita eva yogāḥ prayojyāśca samīkṣya doṣam ||52||
sakajjalaṃ tāmraghaṭe ca ghṛṣṭhaṃ sarpiryutaṃ tutthakamañjanaṃ ca ||53||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatentre raktābhiṣyandapratiṣedho nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||

div.head: lekhyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto lekhyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: nava ye'bhihitā lekhyāḥ sāmānyasteṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ | snigdhavāntaviriktasya nivātātapasadmani ||3|| (āptairdṛḍhaṃ gṛhītasya veśmanyuttānaśāyinaḥ) | sukhodakaprataptena vāsasā susamāhitaḥ | svedayedvartma nirbhujya vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulisthitam ||4|| aṅgulyaṅguṣṭhakābhyāṃ tu ni rbhugnaṃ vartma yatnataḥ | plotāntarābhyāṃ ‘plotāntarīkṛtaṃ naiva’ iti pā. na yathā calati sraṃsate'pi vā ||5|| tataḥ pramṛjya plotena vartma śastrapadāṅkitam | likhecchastreṇa patrairvā, tato rakte sthite punaḥ ||6|| svinnaṃ manohvākāsīsavyoṣārdrāñjanasaindhavaiḥ vyoṣāñjanakasaindhavaiḥ’ iti pā.| ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ samākṣīkaiḥ pratisāryoṣṇavāriṇā ||7|| prakṣālya haviṣā siktaṃ vraṇavat samupācaret | svedāvapīḍaprabhṛtīṃstryahādūrdhvaṃ prayojayet ||8|| vyāsataste samuddiṣṭaṃ vidhānaṃ lekhyakarmaṇi |9|
asṛgāsrāvarahitaṃ kaṇḍūśophavivarjitam ||9|| samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ vartma likhitaṃ samyagiṣyate |10|

ab.seg: raktamakṣi sravet skannaṃ kṣatācchastrakṛtāddhruvam ||10||
rāgaśophaparisrāvāstimiraṃ vyādhyanirjayaḥ | vartma śyāvaṃ guru stabdhaṃ kaṇḍūharṣopadehavat ||11||
netrapākamudīrṇaṃ vā kurvītāpratikāriṇaḥ | etaddurlikhitaṃ jñeyaṃ snehayitvā punārlikhet ||12||

div.ab: vyāvartate yadā vartma pakṣma cāpi vimuhyati ‘vimuñcati’ iti pā.| syāt saruk srāvabahulaṃ tadatisrāvitaṃ viduḥ ||13|| snehasvedādiriṣṭaḥ syāt kramastatrānilāpahaḥ |14|
vartmāvabandhaṃ kliṣṭaṃ ca bahalaṃ yacca kīrtitam ||14|| pothakīścāpyavalikhet pracchayitvā'grataḥ śanaiḥ |15|

ab.seg: samaṃ likhettu medhāvī śyāvakardamavartmanī ||15||
kumbhīkinīṃ śarkarāṃ ca tathaivotsaṅginīmapi | kalpayitvā ‘kartayitvā’ iti pā. tu śastreṇa likhet paścādatandritaḥ ||16||
bhaveyurvartmasu ca yāḥ piḍakāḥ kaṭhinā bhṛśam | hrasvāstāmrāśca tāḥ pakvā bhindyādbhinnā likhedapi ||17||
taruṇīścālpasaṃrambhā piḍakā bāhyavartmajāḥ | viditvaitāḥ praśamayet svedālepanaśodhanaiḥ ||18||
iti suśutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre lekhyarogapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||

div.head: bhedyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto bhedyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
svedayitvā bisagranthiṃ chidrāṇyasya nirāśayam ‘nirāśrayaṃ’ iti pā.| pakvaṃ bhittvā tu śastreṇa saindhavenāvacūrṇayet ||3||
kāsīsamāgadhīpuṣpanepālyelāyutena tu | tataḥ kṣaudraghṛtaṃ dattvā samyagbandhamathācaret ||4||

div.ab: rocanākṣāratutthāni pippalyaḥ kṣaudrameva ca | pratisāraṇamekaikaṃ bhinne lagaṇa iṣyate ||5|| mahatyapi ca yuñjīta kṣārāgnī vidhikovidaḥ |6|
svinnāṃ bhinnāṃ viniṣpīḍya bhiṣagañjananāmikām ||6|| śilailānatasindhūtthaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet |7|
rasāñjanamadhubhyāṃ tu bhittvā vā śastrakarmavit ||7|| pratisāryāñjanairyuñjyāduṣṇairdīpaśikhodbhavaiḥ |8|
samyaksvinne kṛmigranthau bhinne syāt pratisāraṇam ||8|| triphalātutthakāsīsasaindhavaiśca rasakriyā ‘rasakriyām’ iti pā.|9|
bhittvopanāhaṃ kaphajaṃ pippalīmadhusaindhavaiḥ ||9|| lekhayenmaṇḍalāgreṇa samantāt pracchayedapi |10|

ab.seg: saṃsnehya patrabhaṅgaiśca svedayitvā yathāsukham ||10||
āpākādvidhinoktena pañcamedyānupācaret | sarveṣveteṣu vihitaṃ vidhānaṃ snehapūrvakam | sampakve prayato bhūtvā kurvīta vraṇaropaṇam ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre bhedyarogapratiṣedho nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||

div.head: chedyarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaśchedyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
snigdhaṃ bhuktavato hyannamupaviṣṭasya yatnataḥ | saṃroṣayettu nayanaṃ bhiṣak cūrṇaistu lāvaṇaiḥ ||3||

div.ab: tataḥ saṃroṣitaṃ tūrṇaṃ susvinnaṃ parighaṭṭitam | arma yatra valījātaṃ tatraitallagayedbhiṣak ||4|| apāṅgaṃ prekṣamāṇasya baḍiśena samāhitaḥ | mucuṇḍyā''dāya medhāvī sūcīsūtreṇa vā punaḥ ||5|| na cotthāpayatā kṣipraṃ kāryamabhyunnataṃ ‘kāryamatyunnataṃ’ iti pā. tu tat | śastrābādhabhayāccāsya ‘śasrapātabhayāccāsya’ iti pā. vartmanī grāhayeddṛḍham ||6|| tataḥ praśithilībhūtaṃ tribhireva vilambitam | ullikhanmaṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇena pariśodhayet ||7|| vimuktaṃ sarvataścāpi kṛṣṇācchuklācca maṇḍalāt | nītvā kanīnakopāntaṃ chindyānnātikanīnakam ||8|| caturbhāgasthite māṃse nākṣi vyāpattimṛcchati | kanīnakavadhādasraṃ nāḍī vā'pyupajāyate ||9|| hīnacchedāt punarvṛddhiṃ śīghramevādhigacchati |10|
arma yajjālavadvyāpi tadapyunmārjya ‘tadeṣyonmārjya’ iti pā. lambitam ||10|| chindyādvakreṇa śastreṇa vartmaśuklāntamāśritam |11|

pratisāraṇamakṣṇostu tataḥ kāryamanantaram ||11|| yāvanālasya cūrṇena trikaṭorlavaṇasya ca | svedayitvā tataḥ paścādbadhnīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak ||12|| doṣartubalakālajñaḥ snehaṃ dattvā yathāhitam | vraṇavat saṃvidhānaṃ tu tasya kuryādataḥ param ||13|| tryahānmuktvā karasvedaṃ dattvā śodhanamācaret |14|

karañjabījāmalakamadhukaiḥ sādhitaṃ payaḥ ||14|| hitamāścyotanaṃ śūle dvirahnaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyutam | madhukotpalakiñjalkadūrvākalkaiśca mūrdhani ||15|| pralepaḥ saghṛtaḥ śītaḥ kṣīrapiṣṭaḥ praśasyate |16|

ab.seg: lekhyāñjanairapaharedarmaśeṣaṃ bhavedyadi ||16||
arma cālpaṃ dadhinibhaṃ nīlaṃ raktamathāpi vā | dhūsaraṃ tanu yaccāpi śukravattadupācaret ||17||
carmābhaṃ bahalaṃ yattu snāyumāṃsaghanāvṛtam | chedyameva tadarma syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalagaṃ ca yat ||18||
viśuddhavarṇamakliṣṭaṃ kriyāsvakṣi gataklamam | chinne'rmaṇi bhavet samyagyathāsvamanupadravam ||19||
sirājāle sirā yāstu kaṭhināstāśca buddhimān | ullikhenmaṇḍalāgreṇa baḍiśenāvalambitāḥ ||20||
sirāsu piḍakā jātā yā na sidhyanti bheṣajaiḥ | armavanmaṇḍalāgreṇa tāsāṃ chedanamiṣyate ||21||
rogayoścaitayoḥ kāryamarmoktaṃ pratisāraṇam | vidhiścāpi yathādoṣaṃ lekhanadravyasambhṛtaḥ ||22||

div.ab: sandhau saṃsvedya śastreṇa parvaṇīkāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | uttare ca tribhāge ca baḍiśenāvalambitām ||23|| chindyāttato'rdhamagre, syādaśrunāḍī hyato'nyathā | pratisāraṇamatrāpi saindhavakṣaudramiṣyate ||24|| lekhanīyāni cūrṇāni vyādhiśeṣasya bheṣajam |25|

ab.seg: śaṅkhaṃ samudraphenaṃ ca maṇḍūkīṃ ca samudrajām ||25||
sphaṭikaṃ kuruvindaṃ ca pravālāśmantakaṃ tathā | vaidūryaṃ ‘vaidūryopalakaṃ’ iti pā. pulakaṃ muktāmayastāmrarajāṃsi ca ||26||
samabhāgāni sampiṣya sārdhaṃ srotoñjanena tu | cūrṇāñjanaṃ kārayitvā bhājane meṣaśṛṅgaje ||27||
saṃsthāpyobhayataḥ kālamañjayet satataṃ budhaḥ | armāṇi piḍakāṃ hanyāt sirājālāni tena vai ||28||
arśastathā yacca nāmnā śuṣkārśo'rbudameva ca | abhyantaraṃ vartmaśayā vidhānaṃ teṣu vakṣyate ||29||

div.ab: vartmopasvedya nirbhujya sūcyotkṣipya prayatnataḥ | maṇḍalāgreṇa tīkṣṇena mūle bhindyādbhiṣagvaraḥ ||30|| tataḥ saindhavakāsīsakṛṣṇābhiḥ pratisārayet | sthite ca rudhire vartma dahet samyak śalākayā ||31|| kṣāreṇāvalikheccāpi vyādhiśeṣo bhavedyadi | tīkṣṇairubhayatobhāgaistato doṣamadhikṣipet ||32|| vitarecca yathādoṣamabhiṣyandakriyāvidhim |33|

ab.seg: śastrakarmaṇyuparate māsaṃ ca syāt suyantritaḥ ||33||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre chedyarogapratiṣedho nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
athātaḥ pakṣmakopapratiṣedhaṃ ‘pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedhaṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
yāpyastu yo vartmabhavo vikāraḥ pakṣmaprakopo'bhihitaḥ purastāt | tatropaviṣṭasya narasya carma vartmopariṣṭādanutiryageva ||3||
bhruvoradhastāt parimucya bhāgau pakṣmāśritaṃ caikamato'vakṛntet | kanīnakāpāṅgasamaṃ samantādyavākṛti snigdhatanornarasya ||4||
utkṛtya śastreṇa yavapramāṇaṃ bālena sīvyedbhiṣagapramattaḥ | dattvā ca sarpirmadhunā'vaśeṣaṃ kuryādvidhānaṃ ‘kuryādvidhiṃ yo'bhihito vraṇe tam’ iti pā. vihitaṃ vraṇe yat ||5||
lalāṭadeśe ca nibaddhapaṭṭaṃ ‘nibadhya paṭṭaṃ’ iti pā. prāksyūtamatrāpyaparaṃ ca baddhvā | sthairyaṃ gate cāpyatha śastramārge bālān vimuñcet kuśalo'bhivīkṣya ||6||
evaṃ na cecchāmyati tasya vartma nirbhujya doṣopahatāṃ valiṃ ca | tato'gninā vā pratisārayettāṃ kṣāreṇa vā samyagavekṣya dhīraḥ ||7||
chitvā samaṃ vā'pyupapakṣmamālāṃ samyaggṛhītvā baḍiśaistribhistu | pathyāphalena pratisārayettu ghṛṣṭena vā tauvarakeṇa samyak ||8||
catvāra ete vidhayo vihantuṃ pakṣmoparodhaṃ pṛthageva śastāḥ | virecanāścyotanadhūmanasyalepāñjanasneharasakriyāśca ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pakṣmagatarogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||

div.head: dṛṣṭigatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dṛṣṭigatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: trayaḥ sādhyāstrayo'sādhyā yāpyāḥ ṣaṭ ca bhavanti hi |3|

ab.seg: tatraikasya pratīkāraḥ kīrtito dhūmadarśinaḥ ||3||

div.ab: dṛṣṭau pittavidagdhāyāṃ vidagdhāyāṃ kaphena ca | pittaśleṣmaharaṃ kuryādvidhiṃ śastrakṣatādṛte ||4|| nasyasekāñjanālepapuṭapākaiḥ satarpaṇaiḥ | ādye tu traiphalaṃ peyaṃ sarpistraivṛtamuttare ||5|| tailvakaṃ cobhayoḥ pathyaṃ kevalaṃ jīrṇameva vā |6|
gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā godantasya maṣī tathā ||6|| gomāṃsaṃ maricaṃ bījaṃ śirīṣasya manaḥśilā | vṛntaṃ kapitthānmadhunā svayaṅguptāphalāni ca ||7|| catvāra ete yogāḥ syurubhayorañjane hitāḥ |8|
kubjakāśokaśālāmrapriyaṅgunalinotpalaiḥ ||8|| puṣpairhareṇukṛṣṇāhvāpathyāmalakasaṃyutaiḥ | sarpirmadhuyutaiścūrṇairveṇunāḍyāmavasthitaiḥ ||9|| añjayed dvāvapi bhiṣak pittaśleṣmavibhāvitau |10|
āmrajambūdbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ tadrasena hareṇukām ||10|| piṣṭvā kṣaudrājyasaṃyuktaṃ prayojyamathavā'ñjanam | nalinotpalakiñjalkagairikairgośakṛdrasaiḥ ||11|| guḍikāñjanametadvā dinarātryandhayorhitam |12|
rasāñjanarasakṣaudratālīśasvarṇagairikam ||12|| gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktaṃ pittopahatadṛṣṭaye |13|

ab.seg: śītaṃ sauvīrakaṃ vā'pi piṣṭvā'tha rasabhāvitam ||13||
kūrmapittena matimān bhāvayedrauhitena vā | cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ nityaṃ prayojyaṃ pittaśāntaye ||14||
kāśamarīpuṣpamadhukadārvīrodhrarasāñjanaiḥ | sakṣaudramañjanaṃ tadvaddhitamatrāmaye sadā ||15||
srotojaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ reṇukāṃ cāpi peṣayet | ajāmūtreṇa tā vartyaḥ kṣaṇadāndhyāñjane hitāḥ ||16||

div.ab: kālānusārivāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nāgaraṃ madhukaṃ tathā | tālīśapatraṃ kṣaṇade gāṅgeyaṃ ca yakṛdrase ||17|| kṛtāstā vartayaḥ piṣṭāśchāyāśuṣkāḥ sukhāvahāḥ |18|
manaḥśilābhayāvyoṣabalākālānusārivāḥ ||18|| saphenā vartayaḥ piṣṭāśchāgakṣīrasamanvitāḥ |19|

gomūtrapittamadirāyakṛddhātrīrase pacet ||19|| kṣudrāñjanaṃ rasenānyadyakṛtastraiphale'pi vā | gomūtrājyārṇavamalapippalīkṣaudrakaṭphalaiḥ ||20|| saindhavopahitaṃ yuñjyānnihitaṃ veṇugahvare ‘veṇubhājane’ iti pā.|21|

ab.seg: medo yakṛddhṛtaṃ cājaṃ pippalyaḥ saindhavaṃ madhu ||21||
rasamāmalakāccāpi pakvaṃ samyaṅnidhāpayet | kośe khadiranirmāṇe tadvat kṣudrāñjanaṃ hitam ||22||
hareṇumagadhājāsthimajjailāyakṛdanvitam | yakṛdrasenāñjanaṃ vā śleṣmopahatadṛṣṭaye ||23||
vipācya godhāyakṛdardhapāṭitaṃ supūritaṃ māgadhikābhiragninā | niṣevitaṃ tadyakṛdañjanena nihanti naktāndhyamasaṃśayaṃ khalu ||24||
tathā yakṛcchāgabhavaṃ hutāśane vipācya samyaṅmagadhāsamanvitam | prayojitaṃ pūrvavadāśvasaṃśayaṃ jayet kṣapāndhyaṃ sakṛdañjanānnṛṇām ||25||
plīhā yakṛccāpyupabhakṣite ‘upalakṣite’ iti pā. ubhe prakalpya śūlye ghṛtatailasaṃyute | te sārṣapasnehasamāyute'ñjanaṃ naktāndhyamāśveva hataḥ prayojite ||26||
nadījaśimbītrikaṭūnyathāñjanaṃ manaḥśilā dve ca niśe ya(śa)kṛdgavām | sacandaneyaṃ guṭikā'thavā'ñjanaṃ praśasyate vai divaseṣvapaśyatām ||27||
bhavanti yāpyāḥ khalu ye ṣaḍāmayā haredasṛkteṣu sirāvimokṣaṇaiḥ | virecayeccāpi purāṇasarpiṣā virecanāṅgopahitena sarvadā ||28||

div.ab: payovimiśraṃ pavanodbhave hitaṃ vadanti pañcāṅgulatailameva tu | bhaveddhṛtaṃ traiphalameva śodhanaṃ viśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittarogayoḥ ||29|| trivṛdvirekaḥ kaphaje praśasyate tridoṣaje tailamuśanti tatkṛtam |30|
purāṇasarpistimireṣu sarvaśo hitaṃ bhavedāyasabhājanasthitam ||30|| hitaṃ ca vidyāttriphalāghṛtaṃ sadā kṛtaṃ ca yanmeṣaviṣāṇanāmabhiḥ |31|
sadā'valihyāttriphalaṃ sucūrṇitāṃ ghṛtapragāḍhāṃ timire'tha pittaje ||31|| samīraje tailayutāṃ kaphātmake madhupragāḍhāṃ vidadhīta yuktitaḥ |32|

ab.seg: gavāṃ śakṛtkvāthavipakvamuttamaṃ hitaṃ tu tailaṃ timireṣu nāvanam ||32||

div.ab: hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kevala eva paittike hyajāvikaṃ yanmadhurairvipācitam |33|

ab.seg: tailaṃ sthirādau madhure ca yadgaṇe tathā'ṇutailaṃ pavanāsṛgutthayoḥ ||33||
sahāśvagandhātibalāvarīśṛtaṃ hitaṃ ca nasye trivṛtaṃ yadīritam | jalodbhavānūpajamāṃsasaṃskṛtāddhṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ payaso yadutthitam ||34||

div.ab: sasaindhavaḥ kravyabhugeṇamāṃsayorhitaḥ sasarpiḥ samadhuḥ puṭāhvayaḥ |35|

ab.seg: vasā'tha gṛdhroragatāmracūḍajā sadā praśastā madhukānvitā'ñjane ||35||

div.ab: pratyañjanaṃ srotasi yatsamutthitaṃ kramādrasakṣīraghṛteṣu bhāvitam |36|

ab.seg: sthitaṃ daśāhatrayametadañjanaṃ kṛṣṇoragāsye kuśasampraveṣṭite ||36||
tanmālatīkorakasaindhavāyutaṃ sadā'ñjanaṃ syāttimire'tha rāgiṇi | subhāvitaṃ vā payasā dinatrayaṃ kācāpahaṃ śāstravidaḥ pracakṣate ||37||
havirhitaṃ kṣīrabhavaṃ tu paittike vadanti nasye madhurauṣadhaiḥ kṛtam | tattarpaṇe caiva hitaṃ prayojitaṃ sajāṅgalasteṣu ca yaḥ puṭāhvayaḥ ||38||

div.ab: rasāñjanakṣaudrasitāmanaḥśilāḥ kṣudrāñjanaṃ tanmadhukena saṃyutam |39|

ab.seg: samāñjanaṃ vā kanakārodbhavaṃ sucūrṇitaṃ śreṣṭhamuśanti tadvidaḥ ||39||

div.ab: bhilloṭagandhodakasekasecitaṃ pratyañjane cātra hitaṃ tu tutthakam |40|

ab.seg: sameṣaśṛṅgāñjanabhāgasammitaṃ jalodbhavaṃ kācamalaṃ vyapohati ||40||

div.ab: palāśarohītamadhūkajā rasāḥ kṣaudreṇa yuktā madirāgramiśritāḥ ‘madirāgrapeṣitāḥ’ iti pā.|41|

ab.seg: uśīralodhratriphalāpriyaṅgubhiḥ pacettu nasyaṃ kapharogaśāntaye ||41||

div.ab: viḍaṅgapāṭhākiṇihīṅgudītvacaḥ prayojayeddhūmamuśīrasaṃyutāḥ |42|

ab.seg: vanaspatikvāthavipācitaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitaṃ haridrānalade ca tarpaṇam ||42||

div.ab: samāgadho mākṣikasaindhavāḍhyaḥ sajāṅgalaḥ syāt puṭapāka eva ca |43|

ab.seg: manaḥśilātryūṣaṇaśaṅkhamākṣikaiḥ sasindhukāsīsarasāñjanaiḥ kriyāḥ ||43||

div.ab: hite ca kāsīsarasāñjane tathā vadanti pathye guḍanāgarairyute |44|

ab.seg: yadañjanaṃ vā bahuśo niṣecitaṃ samūtravarge triphalodake śṛte ||44||
niśācarāsthisthitametadañjanaṃ kṣipecca māsaṃ salile'sthire punaḥ | meṣasya puṣpairmadhukena saṃyutaṃ tadañjanaṃ sarvakṛte prayojayet ||45||

div.ab: kriyāśca sarvāḥ, kṣatajodbhave hitaḥ kramaḥ parimlāyini cāpi pittahṛt |46|

ab.seg: kramo hitaḥ syandaharaḥ prayojitaḥ samīkṣya doṣeṣu ‘roge ca’ iti pā. yathāsvameva ca ||46||

div.ab: doṣodaye naiva ca viplatiṅgate dravyāṇi nasyādiṣu yojayedbudhaḥ |47|

ab.seg: punaśca kalpe'ñjanavistaraḥ śubhaḥ pravakṣyate'nyastamapīha yojayet ||47||
ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ triphalāṃ śatāvarīṃ paṭolamudgāmalakaṃ yavānapi | niṣevamāṇasya narasya yatnato bhayaṃ sughorāttimirānna vidyate ||48||
śatāvarīpāyasa eva kevalastathā kṛto vā''malakeṣu pāyasaḥ | prabhūtasarpistriphalodakottaro yavaudano vā timiraṃ vyapohati ||49||
jīvantiśākaṃ suniṣaṇṇakaṃ ca sataṇḍulīyaṃ varavāstukaṃ ca | cillī tathā mūlakapotikā ca dṛṣṭerhitaṃ śākunajāṅgalaṃ ca ||50||
paṭolakarkoṭakakāravellavārtākutarkārikarīrajāni | śākāni śigrvārtagalāni caiva hitānī dṛṣṭerghṛtasādhitāni ||51||
vivarjayetsirāmokṣaṃ timire rāgamāgate | yantreṇotpīḍito doṣo nihanyādāśu darśanam ||52||
arāgi timiraṃ sādhyamādyaṃ paṭalamāśritam | kṛcchraṃ dvitīye rāgi syāttṛtīye yāpyamucyate ||53||
rāgaprāpteṣvapi hitāstimireṣu tathā kriyāḥ | yāpanārthaṃ yathoddiṣṭāḥ sevyāścāpi jalaukasaḥ ||54||
ślaiṣmike liṅganāśe tu karma vakṣyāmi siddhaye | na cedardhendugharmāmbubindumuktākṛtiḥ sthiraḥ ||55||
viṣamo vā tanurmadhye rājimān vā bahuprabhaḥ | dṛṣṭistho lakṣyate doṣaḥ sarujo vā salohitaḥ ||56||

div.ab: snigdhasvinnasya tasyātha kāle nātyuṣṇaśītale | yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svāṃ nāsāṃ paśyataḥ samam ||57|| matimān śuklabhāgau dvau kṛṣṇānmuktvā hyapāṅgataḥ | unmīlya nayane samyak sirājālavivarjite ||58|| nādho nordhvaṃ na pārśvābhyāṃ chidre daivakṛte tataḥ | śalākayā prayatnena viśvastaṃ yavavakrayā ||59|| madhyapradeśinyaṅguṣṭhasthirahastagṛhītayā | dakṣiṇena bhiṣak savyaṃ vidhyet savyena cetarat ||60|| vāribindvāgamaḥ samyag bhavecchabdastathā vyadhe |61|

saṃsicya viddhamātraṃ tu yoṣitstanyena kovidaḥ ||61|| sthire doṣe cale vā'pi svedayedakṣi bāhyataḥ | samyak śalākāṃ saṃsthāpya bhaṅgairanilanāśanaiḥ ||62|| śalākāgreṇa tu tato nirlikheddṛṣṭimaṇḍalam | vidhyato yo'nyapārśve'kṣṇastaṃ ruddhvā nāsikāpuṭam ||63|| ucchiṅghanena hartavyo dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaḥ kaphaḥ |64|

ab.seg: nirabhra iva gharmāṃśuryadā dṛṣṭiḥ prakāśate ||64||
tadā'sau likhitā samyag jñeyā yā cāpi nirvyathā | (evaṃ tvaśakye nirhartuṃ doṣe pratyāgate'pi vā ||65||
snehādyairupapannasya vyadho bhūyo vidhīyate) | tato dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākāmāharecchanaiḥ ||66||
ghṛtenābhyajya nayanaṃ vastrapaṭṭena veṣṭayet | tato gṛhe nirābādhe śayītottāna eva ca ||67||
udgārakāsakṣavathuṣṭhīvanotkampanāni ‘ṣṭhīvanojjṛmbhaṇāni’ iti pā. ca | tatkālaṃ nācaredūrdhvaṃ yantraṇā snehapītavat ||68||
tryahāt tryahācca dhāveta kaṣāyairanilāpahaiḥ | vāyorbhayāt tryahādūrdhvaṃ svedayedakṣi pūrvavat ||69||
daśāhamevaṃ saṃyamya hitaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanam | paścātkarma ca seveta laghvannaṃ cāpi mātrayā ||70||
sirāvyadhavidhau pūrvaṃ narā ye ca vivārjitāḥ | na teṣāṃ nīlikāṃ vidhyedanyatrābhihitādbhiṣak ||71||
pūryate śoṇitenākṣi sirāvedhādvisarpatā | tatra strīstanyayaṣṭyāhvapakvaṃ seke hitaṃ ghṛtam ||72||
apāṅgāsannaviddhe tu śophaśūlāśruraktatāḥ | tatropanāhaṃ bhrūmadhye kuryāccoṣṇājyasecanam ||73||
vyadhenāsannakṛṣṇena rāgaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca pīḍyate | tatrādhaḥśodhanaṃ sekaḥ sarpiṣā raktamokṣaṇam ||74||
athāpyupari viddhe tu kaṣṭā ruk sampravartate | tatra koṣṇena haviṣā pariṣekaḥ praśasyate ||75||
śūlāśrurāgāstvatyarthamadhovedhena ‘adhoviddhe bhavanti hi’ iti pā. picchilaḥ | śalākāmanu cāsrāvastatra ‘vidadhīta bhiṣak tatra’ iti pā. pūrvacikitsitam ||76||
rāgāśruvedanāstambhaharṣāścātivighaṭṭite | snehasvedau hitau tatra hitaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam ||77||
doṣastvadho'pakṛṣṭo'pi taruṇaḥ punarūrdhvagaḥ | kuryācchuklāruṇaṃ netraṃ tīvraruṅnaṣṭadarśanam ||78||
madhuraistatra siddhena ghṛtenākṣṇaḥ prasecanam | śirobastiṃ ca tenaiva dadyānmāṃsaiśca bhojanam ||79||
doṣastu sañjātabalo ghanaḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ | prāpya naśyecchalākāgraṃ tanvabhramiva mārutam ||80||
mūrdhābhighātavyāyāmavyavāyavamimūrcchanaiḥ | doṣaḥ pratyeti kopācca viddho'titaruṇaśca ‘vṛddhaḥ’ iti pā. yaḥ ||81||

div.ab: śalākā karkaśā śūlaṃ, kharā doṣapariplutim | vraṇaṃ viśālaṃ sthūlāgrā, tīkṣṇā hiṃsyādanekadhā ||82|| jalāsrāvaṃ tu viṣamā, kriyāsaṅgamathāsthirā | karoti ... |83|
... varjitā doṣaistasmādebhirhitā bhavet ||83|| aṣṭāṅgulāyatā madhye sūtreṇa pariveṣṭitā | aṅguṣṭhaparvasamitā vaktrayormukulākṛtiḥ ||84|| tāmrāyasī śātakumbhī śalākā syādaninditā |85|

ab.seg: rāgaḥ śopho'rbudaṃ coṣo budbudaṃ śūkarākṣitā ||85||
adhimanthādayaścānye rogāḥ syurvyadhadoṣajāḥ | ahitācārato vā'pi yathāsvaṃ tānupācaret ||86||
rujāyāmakṣirāge vā yogān bhūyo nibodha me | gairikaṃ sārivā dūrvā yavapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ payaḥ ||87||
sukhālepaḥ ‘mukhālepaḥ’ iti pā. prayojyo'yaṃ vedanārāgaśāntaye | mṛdubhṛṣṭaistilairvā'pi siddhārthakasamāyutaiḥ ||88||
mātuluṅgarasopetaiḥ sukhālepastadarthakṛt ‘mukhālepaḥ’ iti pā.| payasyāsārivāpatramañjiṣṭhāmadhukairapi ||89||
ajākṣīrānvitairlepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ pathya ucyate | dārupadmakaśuṇṭhībhirevameva kṛto'pi vā ||90||
drākṣāmadhukakuṣṭhairvā tadvat saindhavasaṃyutaiḥ | rodhrasaindhavamṛdvīkāmadhukairvā'pyajāpayaḥ ||91||
śṛtaṃ seke prayoktavyaṃ rujārāganivāraṇam | madhukotpalakuṣṭhairvā drākṣālākṣāsitāyutaiḥ | sasaindhavaiḥ śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ rujārāganibarhaṇam ||92||
śatāvarīpṛthakparṇīmustāmalakapadmakaiḥ ‘madhukapadmakaiḥ’ iti pā.| sājakṣīraiḥ śṛtaṃ sarpirdāhaśūlanibarhaṇam ||93||
vātaghnasiddhe payasi siddhaṃ sarpiścaturguṇe | kākolyādipratīvāpaṃ tadyuñjyāt sarvakarmasu ||94||
śāmyatyevaṃ na cecchūlaṃ snigdhasvinnasya mokṣayet | tataḥ sirāṃ dahedvā'pi matimān kīrtitaṃ yathā ||95||
dṛṣṭerataḥ prasādārthamañjane śṛṇu me śubhe | meṣaśṛṅgasya puṣpāṇi śirīṣadhavayorapi ||96||
sumanāyāśca puṣpāṇi ‘tulyāni’ iti pā. muktā vaidūryameva ca | ajākṣīreṇa sampiṣya tāmre saptāhamāvapet ||97||
pravidhāya ca tadvartīryojayeccāñjane bhiṣak | srotojaṃ vidrumaṃ phenaṃ sāgarasya manaḥśilām ||98||
maricāni ca tadvartīḥ kārayeccāpi pūrvavat | dṛṣṭisthairyārthametattu vidadhyādañjane hitam ||99||
bhūyo vakṣyāmi mukhyāni vistareṇāñjanāni ca | kalpe nānāprakārāṇi tānyapīha prayojayet ||100||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre dṛṣṭigatarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||17||

div.head: kriyākalpādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kriyākalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñastapodṛṣṭirudāradhīḥ ‘taponidhiḥ’ iti pā.| vaiśvāmitraṃ śaśāsātha śiṣyaṃ kāśipatirmuniḥ ||3||
tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaśca seka āścyotanāñjane | tatra tatropadiṣṭāni teṣāṃ vyāsaṃ nibodha me ||4||
saṃśuddhadehaśiraso jīrṇānnasya śubhe dine | pūrvāhṇe vā'parāhṇe vā kāryamakṣṇostu tarpaṇam ||5||
vātātaparajohīne veśmanyuttānaśāyinaḥ | ādhārau māṣacūrṇena klinnena parimaṇḍalau ||6||
samau dṛḍhāvasambādhau kartavyau netrakośayoḥ | pūrayedghṛtamaṇḍasya vilīnasya sukhodake ||7||
āpakṣmāgrāttataḥ sthāpyaṃ pañca tadvākśatāni tu | svasthe, kaphe ṣaṭ, pitte'ṣṭau, daśa vāte taduttamam ||8||
rogasthānaviśeṣeṇa kecit kālaṃ pracakṣate | yathākramopadiṣṭeṣu trīṇyekaṃ pañca sapta ca ||9||
daśa dṛṣṭyāmathāṣṭau ca vākśatāni vibhāvayet | tataścāpāṅgataḥ snehaṃ srāvayitvā'kṣi śodhayet ||10||
svinnena yavapiṣṭena, snehavīryeritaṃ tataḥ | yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena kaphamasya viśodhayet ||11||

div.ab: ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vā'pi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param |12|

ab.seg: tarpaṇe tṛptiliṅgāni netrasyemāni lakṣayet ||12||
sukhasvapnāvabodhatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ varṇapāṭavam | nirvṛtirvyādhividhvaṃsaḥ kriyālāghavameva ca ||13||
gurvāvilamatisnigdhamaśrukaṇḍūpadehavat | jñeyaṃ doṣasamutkliṣṭaṃ netramatyarthatarpitam ||14||
rūkṣamāvilamasrāḍhyamasahaṃ rūpadarśane | vyādhivṛddhiśca tajjñeyaṃ hīnatarpitamakṣi ca ||15||
anayordoṣabāhulyāt prayateta cikitsite | dhūmanasyāñjanaiḥ sekai rūkṣaiḥ snigdhaiśca yogavit ||16||

div.ab: tāmyatyativiśuṣkaṃ yadrūkṣaṃ yaccātidāruṇam | śīrṇapakṣmāvilaṃ jihmaṃ rogakliṣṭaṃ ca yadbhṛśam ||17|| tadakṣi tarpaṇādeva labhetorjāmasaṃśayam |18|
durdinātyuṣṇaśīteṣu cintāyāsabhrameṣu ca ||18|| aśāntopadrave cākṣṇi tarpaṇaṃ na praśasyate |19|
puṭapākastathaiteṣu, nasyaṃ yeṣu ca garhitam ||19|| tarpaṇārhā na ye proktāḥ snehapānākṣamāśca ye |20|

ab.seg: tataḥ praśāntadoṣeṣu puṭapākakṣameṣu ca ||20||
puṭapākaḥ prayoktavyo netreṣu bhiṣajā bhavet | snehano lekhanīyaśca ropaṇīyaśca sa tridhā ||21||
hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi ca lekhanaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthamaparaḥ pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut ||22||
snehamāṃsavasāmajjamedaḥsvādvauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | snehanaḥ puṭapākastu dhāryo dve vākśate tu saḥ ||23||
jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravyasambhṛtaiḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaṅkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ ||24||
samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ | lekhano vākśataṃ tasya paraṃ dhāraṇamucyate ||25||
stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktadravyavipācitaḥ | lekhanāttriguṇaṃ dhāryaḥ puṭapākastu ropaṇaḥ ||26||
vitarettarpaṇoktaṃ tu dhūmaṃ hitvā tu ropaṇam | snehasvedau dvayoḥ kāryau, kāryo naiva ca ropaṇe ||27||

div.ab: ekāhaṃ vā dvyahaṃ vā'pi tryahaṃ vā'pyavacāraṇam |28|

ab.seg: yantraṇā tu kriyākālāddviguṇaṃ kālamiṣyate ||28||
tejāṃsyanilamākāśamādarśaṃ bhāsvarāṇi ca | nekṣeta tarpite netre puṭapākakṛte tathā ||29||
mithyopacārādanayoryo vyādhirupajāyate | añjanāścyotanasvedairyathāsvaṃ tamupācaret ||30||
prasannavarṇaṃ viśadaṃ vātātapasahaṃ laghu | sukhasvapnāvabodhyakṣi puṭapākaguṇānvitam ||31||

div.ab: atiyogādrujaḥ śophaḥ piḍakāstimirodgamaḥ |32|

ab.seg: pāko'śru harṣaṇaṃ cāpi hīne doṣodgamastathā ||32||
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākaprasādhanam | dvau bilvamātrau ślakṣṇasya piṇḍau māṃsasya peṣitau ||33||
dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ | tadaikadhyaṃ samāloḍya patraiḥ supariveṣṭitam ||34||
(kāśmarīkumudairaṇḍapadminīkadalībhavaiḥ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate ) | mṛdāvaliptamaṅgāraiḥ khādirairavakūlayet ||35||
katakāśmantakairaṇḍapāṭalāvṛṣabādaraiḥ | sakṣīradrumakāṣṭhairvā gomayairvā'pi yuktitaḥ ||36||
svinnamuddhṛtya niṣpīḍya rasamādāya taṃ nṛṇām | tarpaṇoktena vidhinā yathāvadavacārayet ||37||
kanīnake niṣecyaḥ syānnityamuttānaśāyinaḥ | rakte pitte ca tau śītau koṣṇau vātakaphāpahau ||38||
atyuṣṇatīkṣṇau satataṃ dāhapākakarau smṛtau | aplutau śītalau cāśrustambharuggharṣakārakau ||39||
atimātrau kaṣāyatvasaṅkocasphuraṇāvahau | hīnapramāṇau doṣāṇāmutkleśajananau bhṛśam ||40||

div.ab: yuktau kṛtau dāhaśopharugdharṣasrāvanāśanau | kaṇḍūpadehadūṣīkāraktarājivināśanau ||41|| tasmāt pariharan doṣān vidadhyāttau sukhāvahau |42|

ab.seg: vyāpadaśca yathādoṣaṃ nasyadhūmāñjanairjayet ||42||
ādyantayoścāpyanayoḥ sveda uṣṇāmbucailikaḥ | tathā hito'vasāne ca dhūmaḥ śleṣmasamucchritau ||43||
yathādoṣopayuktaṃ tu nātiprabalamojasā | rogamāścyotanaṃ hanti sekastu balavattaram ||44||

div.ab: tau tridhaivopayujyete rogeṣu puṭapākavat |45|
lekhane sapta cāṣṭau vā bindavaḥ snaihike daśa ||45|| āścyotane prayoktavyā dvādaśaiva tu ropaṇe |46|

ab.seg: sekasya dviguṇaḥ kālaḥ puṭapākāt paro mataḥ ||46||

div.ab: athavā kāryanirvṛtterupayogo yathākramam |47|

ab.seg: pūrvāparāhṇe madhyāhne rujākāleṣu cobhayoḥ ||47||

div.ab: yogāyogāt snehaseke tarpaṇoktān pracakṣate |48|

rogāñchirasi sambhūtān hatvā'tiprabalān guṇān ||48|| karoti śiraso bastiruktā ye mūrdhatailikāḥ | śuddhadehasya sāyāhne yathāvyādhyaśitasya tu ||49|| ṛjvāsīnasya badhnīyādvastikośaṃ tato dṛḍham | yathāvyādhiśṛtasnehapūrṇaṃ saṃyamya dhārayet ||50|| tarpaṇoktaṃ daśaguṇaṃ yathādoṣaṃ vidhānavit |51|

ab.seg: vyaktarūpeṣu doṣeṣu śuddhakāyasya kevale ||51||
netra eva sthite doṣe prāptamañjanamācaret | lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ cāpi prasādanamathāpi vā ||52||
tatra pañca rasān vyastānādyaikarasavarjitān | pañcadhā lekhanaṃ yuñjyādyathādoṣamatandritaḥ ||53||
netravartmasirākośasrotaḥśṛṅgāṭakāśritam | mukhanāsākṣibhirdoṣamojasā srāvayettu tat ||54||
kaṣāyaṃ tiktakaṃ vā'pi sasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam | tatsnehaśaityādvarṇyaṃ ‘tatsnehaśaityādvraṇyaṃ’ iti pā. syāddṛṣṭeśca balavardhanam ||55||
madhuraṃ snehasampannamañjanaṃ tu prasādanam | dṛṣṭidoṣaprasādārthaṃ snehanārthaṃ ca taddhitam ||56||
yathādoṣaṃ prayojyāni tāni rogaviśāradaiḥ | añjanāni yathoktāni prāhṇasāyāhnarātriṣu ||57||
guṭikārasacūrṇāni trividhānyañjanāni tu | yathāpūrvaṃ balaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||58||
hareṇumātrā vartiḥ syāllekhanasya pramāṇataḥ | prasādanasya cādhyardhā dviguṇā ropaṇasya ca ||59||

div.ab: rasāñjanasya mātrā tu yathāvartimitā ‘piṣṭā vartimitā’ iti pā. matā |60|

ab.seg: dvitricatuḥśalākāśca cūrṇasyāpyanupūrvaśaḥ ||60||

div.ab: teṣāṃ tulyaguṇānyeva vidadhyādbhājanānyapi | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śārṅgaṃ tāmraṃ vaidūryakāṃsyajam ||61|| āyasāni ca yojyāni śalākāśca yathākramam |62|
vaktrayormukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||62|| aṣṭāṅgulā tanurmadhye sukṛtā sādhunigrahā |63|

ab.seg: audumbaryaśmajā vā'pi śārīrī vā hitā bhavet ||63||
vāmenākṣi vinirbhujya hastena susamāhitaḥ | śalākayā dakṣiṇena kṣipet kānīnamañjanam ||64||
āpāṅgyaṃ vā yathāyogaṃ kuryāccāpi gatāgatam | vartmopalepi vā yattadaṅgulyaiva prayojayet ||65||

div.ab: akṣi nātyantayorañjyādbādhamāno'pi vā bhiṣak |66|
na cānirvāntadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ samprayojayet ||66|| doṣaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ san hanyād dṛṣṭerbalaṃ tathā |67|
gatadoṣamapetāśru paśyedyat samyagambhasā ||67|| prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ |68|

ab.seg: śramodāvartaruditamadyakrodhabhayajvaraiḥ ||68||
vegāghātaśirodoṣaiścārtānāṃ neṣyate'ñjanam | rāgaruktimirāsrāvaśūlasaṃrambhasambhavāt ||69||
nidrākṣaye kriyāśaktiṃ, pravāte dṛgbalakṣayam | rajodhūmahate rāgasrāvādhīmanthasambhavam ||70||
saṃrambhaśūlau nasyānte, śiroruji śirorujam | śiraḥsnāte'tiśīte ca ravāvanudite'pi ca ||71||
doṣasthairyādapārthaṃ syāddoṣotkleśaṃ karoti ca | ajīrṇe'pyevameva syāt srotomārgāvarodhanāt ||72||
doṣavegodaye dattaṃ kuryāttāṃstānupadravān | tasmāt pariharan doṣānañjanaṃ sādhu yojayet ||73||

div.ab: lekhanasya viśeṣeṇa kāla eṣa prakīrtitaḥ |74|
vyāpadaśca jayedetāḥ sekāścyotanalepanaiḥ ||74|| yathāsvaṃ dhūmakavalairnasyaiścāpi samutthitāḥ |75|
viśadaṃ laghvanāsrāvi kriyāpaṭu sunirmalam ||75|| saṃśāntopadravaṃ netraṃ viriktaṃ samyagādiśet |76|
jihmaṃ dāruṇadurvarṇaṃ srastaṃ rūkṣamatīva ca ||76|| netraṃ virekātiyoge syandate cātimātraśaḥ |77|

ab.seg: tatra santarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānaṃ cānilāpaham ||77||

div.ab: akṣi mandaviriktaṃ syādudagrataradoṣavat |78|

ab.seg: dhūmanasyāñjanaistatra hitaṃ doṣāvasecanam ||78||
snehavarṇabalopetaṃ prasannaṃ doṣavarjitam | jñeyaṃ prasādane samyagupayukte'kṣi nirvṛtam ||79||

div.ab: kiñjiddhīnavikāraṃ syāttarpaṇāddhi kṛtādati |80|

ab.seg: tatra doṣaharaṃ rūkṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ śasyate mṛdu ||80||
sādhāraṇamapi jñeyamevaṃ ropaṇalakṣaṇam | prasādanavadācaṣṭe tasmin yukte'tibheṣajam ||81||

div.ab: snehanaṃ ropaṇaṃ vā'pi hīnayuktamapārthakam |82|

ab.seg: kartavyaṃ mātrayā tasmādañjanaṃ siddhimicchatā ||82||
puṭapākakriyadyāsu kriyāsveṣai(kai)va kalpanā | sahasraśaścāñjaneṣu bījenoktena pūjitāḥ ||83||
dṛṣṭerbalavivṛddhyarthaṃ yāpyarogakṣayāya ca | rājārhānyañjanāgryāṇi nibodhemānyataḥ param ||84||
aṣṭau bhāgānañjanasya nīlotpalasamatviṣaḥ | audumbaraṃ śātakumbhaṃ rājataṃ ca samāsataḥ ||85||
ekādaśaitān bhāgāṃstu yojayet kuśalo bhiṣak | mūṣākṣiptaṃ tadādhmātamāvṛtaṃ jātavedasi ||86||
khadirāśmantakāṅgārairgośakṛdbhirathāpi vā | gavāṃ śakṛdrase mūtre dadhni sarpiṣi mākṣike ||87||
tailamadyavasāmajjasarvagandhodakeṣu ca | drākṣārasekṣutriphalāraseṣu suhimeṣu ca ||88||
sārivādikaṣāye ca kaṣāye cotpalādike | niṣecayet pṛthak cainaṃ dhmātaṃ dhmātaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||89||
tato'ntarīkṣe saptāhaṃ plotabaddhaṃ sthitaṃ jale | viśoṣya cūrṇayenmuktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vidrumaṃ tathā ||90||
kālānusārivāṃ cāpi śucirāvāpya yogataḥ | etaccūrṇāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nihitaṃ bhājane śubhe ||91||
dantasphaṭikavaidūryaśaṅkhaśailāsanodbhave | śātakumbhe'tha śārṅge vā rājate vā susaṃskṛte | sahasrapākavat pūjāṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ prayojayet ||92||
tenāñjitākṣo nṛpatirbhavet sarvajanapriyaḥ | adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭirogavivarjitaḥ ||93||
kuṣṭhaṃ candanamelāśca patraṃ madhukamañjanam | meṣaśṛṅgasya puṣpāṇi vakraṃ ratnāni sapta ca ||94||
utpalasya bṛhatyośca padmasyāpi ca keśaram | nāgapuṣpamuśīrāṇi pippalī tutthamuttamam ||95||
kukkuṭāṇḍakapālāni dārvīṃ pathyāṃ sarocanām | maricānyakṣamajjānaṃ tulyāṃ ca gṛhagopikām ||96||
kṛtvā sūkṣmaṃ tataścūrṇaṃ nyasedabhyarcya pūrvavat | etadbhadrodayaṃ nāma sadaivārhati bhūmipaḥ ||97||
vakraṃ samaricaṃ caiva māṃsīṃ śaileyameva ca | tulyāṃśāni samānaistaiḥ samagraiśca manaḥśilā ||98||
patrasya bhāgāścatvāro dviguṇaṃ sarvato'ñjanam | tāvacca yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ pūrvavaccaitadañjanam ||99||
manaḥśilāṃ devakāṣṭhaṃ rajanyau triphaloṣaṇam | lākṣālaśunamañjiṣṭhāsaindhavailāḥ samākṣikāḥ ||100||
rodhraṃ sāvarakaṃ cūrṇamāyasaṃ tāmrameva ca | kālānusārivāṃ caiva kukkuṭāṇḍadalāni ca ||101||
tulyāni payasā piṣṭvā guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | kaṇḍūtimiraśuklārmaraktarājyupaśāntaye ||102||
kāṃsyāpamārjanamasī madhukaṃ saindhavaṃ tathā | eraṇḍamūlaṃ ca samaṃ bṛhatyaṃśadvayānvitam ||103||
ājena payasā piṣṭvā tāmrapātraṃ pralepayet | saptakṛtvastu tā vartyaśchāyāśuṣkā rujāpahāḥ ||104||
pathyātutthakayaṣṭyāhvaistulyairmaricaṣoḍaśā | pathyā sarvavikāreṣu vartiḥ śītāmbupeṣitā ||105||
rasakriyāvidhānena yathoktavidhikovidaḥ | piṇḍāñjanāni kurvīta yathāyogamatandritaḥ ||106||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre kriyākalpo nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||

div.head: nayanābhighātapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nayanābhighātapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: abhyāhate tu nayane bahudhā narāṇāṃ saṃrambharāgatumulāsu rujāsu dhīmān | nasyāsyalepapariṣecanatarpaṇādyamuktaṃ punaḥ kṣatajapittajaśūlapathyam ||3|| dṛṣṭiprasādajananaṃ vidhimāśu kuryāt snigdhairhimaiśca madhuraiśca tathā prayogaiḥ |4|

ab.seg: svedāgnidhūmabhayaśokarujābhighātairabhyāhatāmapi tathaiva bhiṣak cikitset ||4||

div.ab: sadyohate nayana eṣa vidhistadūrdhvaṃ syanderito bhavati doṣamavekṣya kāryaḥ |5|

ab.seg: abhyāhataṃ nayanamīṣadathāsyabāṣpasaṃsveditaṃ bhavati tannirujaṃ kṣaṇena ||5||

div.ab: sādhyaṃ kṣataṃ paṭalamekamubhe tu kṛcchre trīṇi kṣatāni paṭalāni vivarjayettu | syāt piccitaṃ ca nayanaṃ hyati cāvasannaṃ srastaṃ cyutaṃ ca hatadṛk ca bhavettu yāpyam ||6|| vistīrṇadṛṣṭitanurāgamasatpradarśi, sādhyaṃ yathāsthitamanāviladarśanaṃ ca |7|

ab.seg: prāṇoparodhavamanakṣutakaṇṭharodhairunnamyamāśu nayanaṃ yadatipraviṣṭam ||7||

div.ab: netre vilambini vidhirvihitaḥ purastāducchiṅghanaṃ śirasi vāryavasecanaṃ ca |8|
ṣaṭsaptatirnayanajā ya ime pradiṣṭā rogā bhavantyamahatāṃ mahatāṃ ca tebhyaḥ ||8|| stanyaprakopakaphamārutapittaraktairbālākṣivartmabhava eva kukūṇako'nyaḥ |9|

ab.seg: mṛdgāti netramatikaṇḍumathākṣikūṭaṃ nāsālalāṭamapi tena śiśuḥ sa nityam ||9||
sūryaprabhāṃ na sahate sravati prabaddhaṃ, tasyāharedrudhiramāśu vinirlikhecca | kṣaudrāyutaiśca kaṭubhiḥ pratisārayettu mātuḥ śiśorabhihitaṃ ca vidhiṃ vidadhyāt ||10||

div.ab: taṃ vāmayettu madhusaindhavasamprayuktaiḥ pītaṃ payaḥ khalu phalaiḥ kharamañjarīṇām ||11|| syātpippalīlavaṇamākṣikasaṃyutairvā... |12|
... nainaṃ vamantamapi vāmayituṃ yateta |12|

ab.seg: dattvā vacāmaśanadugdhabhuje prayojyamūrdhvaṃ tataḥ phalayutaṃ vamanaṃ vidhijñaiḥ ||12||

div.ab: jambvāmradhātryaṇudalaiḥ paridhāvanārthaṃ kāryaṃ kaṣāyamavasecanameva cāpi |13|

ab.seg: āścyotane ca hitamatra ghṛtaṃ guḍūcīsiddhaṃ tathā''hurapi ca triphalāvipakvam ||13||

div.ab: nepālajāmaricaśaṅkharasāñjanāni sindhuprasūtaguḍamākṣikasaṃyutāni | syādañjanaṃ, madhurasāmadhukāmrakairvā ... |14|

ab.seg: ... kṛṣṇāyasaṃ ghṛtapayo madhu vā'pi dagdham ||14||
vyoṣaṃ palāṇḍu madhukaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca gaurikayutāṃ guṭikāñjanaṃ vā | nimbacchadaṃ madhukadārvi satāmralodhramicchanti cātra bhiṣajo'ñjanamaṃśatulyam ||15||
srotojaśaṅkhadadhisaindhavamardhapakṣaṃ śukraṃ śiśornudati bhāvitamañjanena | syande kaphadabhihitaṃ kramamācarecca bālasya rogakuśalo'kṣigadaṃ jighāṃsuḥ ||16||
samudra iva gambhīraṃ naiva śakyaṃ cikitsitam | vaktuṃ niravaśeṣeṇa ślokānāmayutairapi ||17||
sahasrairapi vā, proktamarthamalpamatirnaraḥ | tarkagranthārtharahito naiva gṛhṇātyapaṇḍitaḥ ||18||
tadidaṃ bahugūḍhārthaṃ cikitsābījamīritam | kuśalenābhipannaṃ tadbahudhā'bhiprarohati ||19||
tasmānmatimatā nityaṃ nānāśāstrārthadarśinā | sarvamūhyamagādhārthaṃ śāstramāgamabuddhinā ||20||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nayanābhighātacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||

div.head: karṇagatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
karṇaśūlaṃ praṇādaśca bādhiryaṃ kṣveḍa eva ca | karṇasrāvaḥ karṇakaṇḍūḥ karṇavarcastathaiva ca ||3||
kṛmikarṇapratināhau vidradhirdvividhastathā | karṇapākaḥ pūtikarṇastathaivārśaścaturvidham ||4||
karṇārbudaṃ saptavidhaṃ śophaścāpi caturvidhaḥ | ete karṇagatā rogā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ ||5||
samīraṇaḥ śrotragato'nyathācaraḥ samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ | karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ ||6||
yadā tu nāḍīṣu vimārgamāgataḥ sa eva śabdābhivahāsu tiṣṭhati | śṛṇoti śabdān vividhāṃstadā naraḥ praṇādamenaṃ kathayanti cāmayam ||7||
sa eva śabdānuvahā yadā sirāḥ kaphānuyāto vyanusṛtya tiṣṭhati | tadā narasyāpratikārasevino bhavettu bādhiryamasaṃśayaṃ khalu ||8||
śramāt kṣayādrūkṣakaṣāyabhojanāt samīraṇaḥ śabdapathe pratiṣṭhitaḥ | viriktaśīrṣasya ca śītasevinaḥ karoti hi kṣveḍamatīva karṇayoḥ ||9||
śirobhighātādathavā nimajjato jale prapākādathavā'pi vidradheḥ | sravettu pūyaṃ śravaṇo'nilāvṛtaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ ||10||

div.ab: kaphena kaṇḍūḥ pracitena karṇayorbhṛśaṃ bhavet srotasi karṇasañjñite |11|

ab.seg: viśoṣite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā nṛṇāṃ bhavet srotasi karṇagūthakaḥ ||11||
sa karṇaviṭko dravatāṃ yadā gato vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate | tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito bhavedvikāraḥ śiraso'bhitāpanaḥ ||12||
yadā tu mūrcchantyathavā'pi jantavaḥ sṛjantyapatyānyathavā'pi makṣikāḥ | tadañjanatvācchravaṇo nirucyate bhiṣagbhirādyaiḥ kṛmikarṇako gadaḥ ||13||
kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavettathā doṣakṛto'paraḥ punaḥ | saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravet pratodadhūmāyanadāhacoṣavān ||14||

div.ab: bhavet prapākaḥ khalu pittakopato vikothavikledakaraśca karṇayoḥ |15|
sthite kaphe srotasi pittatejasā vilāyyamāne bhṛśasampratāpavān ||15|| avedano vā'pyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇakaḥ |16|

ab.seg: pradiṣṭaliṅgānyaraśāṃsi tattvatastathaiva śophārbudaliṅgamīritam | mayā purastāt prasamīkṣya yojayedihaiva tāvat prayato bhiṣagvaraḥ ||16||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogavijñānīyo nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||

div.head: karṇagatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇagatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sāmānyaṃ karṇarodheṣu ghṛtapānaṃ rasāyanam | avyāyāmo'śiraḥsnānaṃ brahmacaryamakatthanam ||3||
karṇaśūle praṇāde ca bādhiryakṣveḍayorapi | caturṇāmapi rogāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ bheṣajaṃ viduḥ ||4||
snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ svedairnaraṃ snehavirecitam | nāḍīsvedairupacaretpiṇḍasvedaistathaiva ca ||5||
bilvairaṇḍārkavarṣābhūdadhitthonmattaśigrubhiḥ | bastagandhāśvagandhābhyāṃ tarkārīyavaveṇubhiḥ ||6||
āranālaśṛtairebhirnāḍīsvedaḥ prayojitaḥ | kaphavātasamutthānaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ nirasyati ||7||
mīnakukkuṭalāvānāṃ māṃsajaiḥ payasā'pi vā | piṇḍaiḥ svedaṃ ca kurvīta karṇaśūlanivāraṇam ||8||
aśvatthapatrakhallaṃ vā vidhāya bahupatrakam | tadaṅgāraiḥ susampūrṇaṃ nidadhyācchravaṇopari ||9||
yattailaṃ cyavate tasmāt khallādaṅgāratāpitāt | tat prāptaṃ śravaṇasrotaḥ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||10||
kṣaumaguggulvagurubhiḥ saghṛtairdhūpayecca tam | bhaktopari hitaṃ sarpirbastikarma ca pūjitam ||11||

div.ab: niranno niśi tatsarpiḥ pītvopari pibet payaḥ | mūrdhabastiṣu nasye ca mastiṣke pariṣecane ||12|| śatapākaṃ balātailaṃ praśastaṃ cāpi bhojane |13|
kaṇṭakārīmajākṣīre paktvā kṣīreṇa tena ca ||13|| vipacet kukkuṭavasāṃ karṇayostatprapūraṇam |14|

ab.seg: taṇḍulīyakamūlāni phalamaṅkolajaṃ tathā ||14||
ahiṃsrākendukānmūlaṃ saralaṃ devadāru ca | laśunaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca tathā vaṃśāvalekhanam ||15||
kalkaireṣāṃ tathā'mlaiśca pacet snehaṃ caturvidham | vedanāyāḥ praśāntyarthaṃ hitaṃ tatkarṇapūraṇam ||16||
laśunārdrakaśigrūṇāṃ muraṅgyā mūlakasya ca | kadalyāḥ svarasaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaduṣṇaḥ karṇapūraṇe ||17||
śṛṅgaverarasaḥ kṣaudraṃ saindhavaṃ tailameva ca | kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayordeyametadvā vedanāpaham ||18||
vaṃśāvalekhanāyukte mūtre cājāvike bhiṣak | sarpiḥ pacettena karṇaṃ pūrayet karṇaśūlinaḥ ||19||
mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍamaṣṭādaśāṅgulam | kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya saṃsicya tailenādīpayettataḥ ||20||
yattailaṃ cyavate tebhyo dhṛtebhyo bhājanopari | jñeyaṃ taddīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||21||
kuryādevaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhe kuṣṭhe kāṣṭhe ca sārale | matimān dīpikātailaṃ karṇaśūlanibarhaṇam ||22||
arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktān lavaṇānvitān | sannidadhyāt snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛte ||23||
puṭapākakramāsvinnān pīḍayedārasāgamāt | sukhoṣṇaṃ tadrasaṃ karṇe dāpayecchūlaśāntaye ||24||
kapitthamātuluṅgāmlaśṛṅgaverarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sukhoṣṇaiḥ pūrayet karṇaṃ tacchūlavinivṛttaye ||25||
karṇaṃ koṣṇena cukreṇa pūrayet karṇaśūlinaḥ | samudraphenacūrṇena yuktyā cāpyavacūrṇayet ||26||
aṣṭānāmiha mūtrāṇāṃ mūtreṇānyatamena tu | koṣṇena pūrayet karṇaṃ karṇaśūlopaśāntaye ||27||
mūtreṣvamleṣu vātaghne gaṇe ca kvathite bhiṣak | paceccaturvidhaṃ snehaṃ pūraṇaṃ tacca karṇayoḥ ||28||

div.ab: etā eva kriyāḥ kuryāt pittaghnaiḥ pittasaṃyute |29|

ab.seg: kākolyādau daśakṣīraṃ tiktaṃ cātra hitaṃ haviḥ ||29||
kṣīravṛkṣapravāleṣu madhuke candane tathā | kalkakvāthe paraṃ pakvaṃ śarkarāmadhukaiḥ saraiḥ ||30||
iṅgudīsarṣapasnehau sakaphe pūraṇe hitau | tiktauṣadhānāṃ yūṣāśca svedāśca kaphanāśanāḥ ||31||
surasādau kṛtaṃ tailaṃ pañcamūle mahatyapi | mātuluṅgarasaḥ śuktaṃ laśunārdrakayo rasaḥ ||32||
ekaikaḥ pūraṇe pathyastailaṃ teṣvapi vā kṛtam | tīkṣṇā mūrdhavirekāśca kavalāścātra pūjitāḥ ||33||

div.ab: karṇaśūlavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ pittaghnaḥ śoṇitāvṛte |34|

śūlapraṇādabādhiryakṣveḍānāṃ tu prakīrtitam ||34|| sāmānyato, viśeṣeṇa ‘viśeṣastu’ iti pā. bādhirye pūraṇaṃ śṛṇu | gavāṃ mūtreṇa bilvāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||35|| sajalaṃ ca sadugdhaṃ ca bādhirye karṇapūraṇam |36|

sitāmadhukabimbībhiḥ siddhaṃ vā''je payasyapi ||36|| bimbīkvāthe vimathyoṣṇaṃ śītībhūtaṃ taduddhṛtam | punaḥ paceddaśakṣīraṃ sitāmadhukacandanaiḥ ||37|| bilvāmbugāḍhaṃ tattailaṃ bādhirye karṇapūraṇam |38|

ab.seg: vakṣyate yaḥpratiśyāye vidhiḥ so'pyatra pūjitaḥ ||38||

div.ab: vātavyādhiṣu yaścokto vidhiḥ sa ca hito bhavet |39|
karṇasrāve pūtikarṇe tathaiva kṛmikarṇake ||39|| samānaṃ karma kurvīta yogān vaiśeṣikānapi |40|

ab.seg: śirovirecanaṃ caiva dhūpanaṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā ||40||
pramārjanaṃ dhāvanaṃ ca vīkṣya vīkṣyāvacārayet | rājavṛkṣāditoyena surasādigaṇena vā ||41||
karṇaprakṣālanaṃ kāryaṃ cūrṇaireṣāṃ ca pūraṇam | kvāthaṃ pañcakaṣāyaṃ tu kapittharasayojitam ||42||
karṇasrāve praśaṃsanti pūraṇaṃ madhunā saha | sarjatvakcūrṇasaṃyuktaḥ kārpāsīphalajo rasaḥ ||43||
yojito madhunā vā'pi karṇasrāve praśasyate | lākṣā rasāñjanaṃ sarjaścūrṇitaṃ karṇapūraṇam ||44||
saśaivalaṃ mahāvṛkṣajambvāmraprasavāyutam | kulīrakṣaudramaṇḍūkīsiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūjitam ||45||
tindukānyabhayā rodhraṃ samaṅgā''malakaṃ madhu | pūraṇaṃ cātra ‘cātipathyaṃ syāt’ iti pā. pathyaṃ syātkapittharasayojitam ||46||

div.ab: rasamāmrakapitthānāṃ madhūkadhavaśālajam | pūraṇārthaṃ praśaṃsanti tailaṃ vā tairvipācitam ||47|| priyaṅgumadhukāmbaṣṭhādhātakīśilaparṇibhiḥ | mañjiṣṭhālodhralākṣābhiḥ kapitthasya rasena vā ||48|| pacettailaṃ tadāsrāvamavagṛhṇāti pūraṇāt |49|

ghṛtaṃ rasāñjanaṃ nāryāḥ kṣīreṇa madhusaṃyutam ||49|| tatpraśastaṃ cirotthe'pi sāsrāve pūtikarṇake | nirguṇḍīsvarasastailaṃ sindhurdhūmarajo guḍaḥ ||50|| pūraṇaḥ pūtikarṇasya śamano madhusaṃyutaḥ |51|

ab.seg: kṛmikarṇakanāśārthaṃ kṛmighnaṃ yojayedvidhim ||51||

div.ab: vārtākudhūmaśca hitaḥ sārṣapasneha eva ca |52|

ab.seg: kṛmighnaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca ||52||
gugguloḥ karṇadaurgandhye dhūpanaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate | chardanaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kavalasya ca dhāraṇam ||53||
karṇakṣveḍe hitaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapaṃ caiva pūraṇam | vidradhau cāpi kurvīta vidradhyuktaṃ cikitsitam ||54||
prakledya dhīmāṃstailena svedena pravilāyya ca | śodhayetkarṇaviṭkaṃ tu bhiṣak samyak śalākayā ||55||
nāḍīsvedo'tha vamanaṃ dhūmo mūrdhavirecanam | vidhiśca kaphahṛtsarvaḥ karṇakaṇḍūmapohati ||56||
atha karṇapratīnāhe snehasvedau prayojayet | tato viriktaśirasaḥ kriyāṃ prāptāṃ samācaret ||57||

div.ab: karṇapākasya bhaiṣajyaṃ kuryātpittavisarpavat |58|
karṇacchidre vartamānaṃ kīṭaṃ kledamalādi vā ||58|| śṛṅgeṇāpahareddhīmānathavā'pi śalākayā |59|

ab.seg: śeṣāṇāṃ tu vikārāṇāṃ prāk cikitsitamīritam ||59||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre karṇagatarogapratiṣedho nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21||

div.head: nāsāgatarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
apīnasaḥ pūtinasyaṃ ‘pūtināsaḥ’ iti pā. nāsāpākastathaiva ca | tathā śoṇitapittaṃ ca pūyaśoṇitameva ca ||3||
kṣavathurbhraṃśathurdīpto nāsānāhaḥ parisravaḥ | nāsāśoṣeṇa sahitā daśaikāśceritā gadāḥ ||4||
catvāryarśāṃsi catvāraḥ śophāḥ saptārbudāni ca | pratiśyāyāśca ye pañca vakṣyante sacikitsitāḥ | ekatriṃśanmitāste ‘ekatriṃśatsahitaistaistu’ iti pā. tu nāsārogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||5||

div.ab: ānahyate yasya vidhūpyate ca praklidyate śuṣyati ‘pāpacyate klidyati’ iti pā. cāpi nāsā | na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ vyavasyettamapīnasena ||6|| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam |7|
doṣairvidagdhairgalatālumūle saṃvāsito yasya samīraṇastu ||7|| nireti pūtirmukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtināsaṃ pravadanti rogam |8|
ghrāṇāśritaṃ pittamarūṃṣi kuryādyasmin vikāre balavāṃśca pākaḥ ||8|| taṃ nāsikāpākamiti vyavasyedvikledakothāvapi yatra dṛṣṭau |9|

ab.seg: caturvidhaṃ dviprabhavaṃ dvimārgaṃ vakṣyāmi bhūyaḥ khalu raktapittam ||9||
doṣairvidagdhairathavā'pi jantorlalāṭadeśe'bhihatasya taistu | nāsā sravet pūyamasṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam ||10||

div.ab: ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi sampraduṣṭe ‘sampraduṣṭaḥ’ iti pā. yasyānilo nāsikayā nireti ||11|| kaphānuyāto bahuśaḥ saśabdastaṃ rogamāhuḥ kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ |12|
tīkṣṇopayogādatijighrato vā bhāvān kaṭūnarkanirīkṣaṇādvā ||12|| sūtrādibhirvā taruṇāsthimarmaṇyudghāṭite'nyaḥ kṣavathurnireti |13|
prabhraśyate nāsikayaiva yaśca ‘yasya’ iti pā. sāndro vidagdho lavaṇaḥ kaphastu ||13|| prāk sañcito mūrdhani pittataptastaṃ bhraṃśathuṃ vyādhimudāharanti |14|
ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsareddhūma iveha vāyuḥ ||14|| nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantorvyādhiṃ tu taṃ dīptamudāharanti |15|
kaphāvṛto vāyurudānasañjño yadā svamārge viguṇaḥ sthitaḥ syāt ||15|| ghrāṇaṃ vṛṇotīva tadā sa rogo nāsāpratīnāha iti pradiṣṭaḥ |16|
ajasramacchaṃ salilaprakāśaṃ yasyāvivarṇaṃ sravatīha nāsā ||16|| rātrau viśeṣeṇa hi taṃ vikāraṃ nāsāparisrāvamiti vyavasyet |17|
ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca ||17|| samucchvasityūrdhvamadhaśca kṛcchrādyastasya nāsāpariśoṣa uktaḥ |18|
doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca brūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śophān ||18|| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ tu |19|

ab.seg: rogaḥ pratiśyāya ihopadiṣṭaḥ sa vakṣyate pañcavidhaḥ purastāt ||19||

div.ab: (nāsāsrotogatā rogāstriṃśadekaśca kīrtitāḥ |20|

ab.seg: srotaḥpathe yadvipulaṃ kośavaccārbudaṃ bhavet ayaṃ śloko hārāṇacandreṇa na paṭhitaḥ ) ||20||
śophāstu śophavijñānā nāsāsrotovyavasthitāḥ | nidāne'rśāṃsi nirdiṣṭānyevaṃ tāni vibhāvayet ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogavijñānīyo nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||

div.head: nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto nāsāgatarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
pūrvoddiṣṭe pūtinasye ca jantoḥ snehasvedau chardanaṃ sraṃsanaṃ ca | yuktaṃ bhaktaṃ tīkṣṇamalpaṃ laghu syāduṣṇaṃ toyaṃ dhūmapānaṃ ca kāle ||3||
hiṅgu vyoṣaṃ vatsakākhyaṃ śivāṭī lākṣā bījaṃ saurabhaṃ kaṭphalaṃ ca | ugrā kuṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇagandhā viḍaṅgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ cāvapīḍe karañjam ||4||

div.ab: etairdravyaiḥ sārṣapaṃ mūtrayuktaṃ tailaṃ dhīmānnasyahetoḥ paceta |5|
nāsāpāke pittahṛtsaṃvidhānaṃ kāryaṃ sarvaṃ bāhmamābhyantaraṃ ca ||5|| hṛtvā raktaṃ kṣīravṛkṣatvacaśca sājyāḥ sekā yojanīyāśca lepāḥ |6|
vakṣyāmyūrdhvaṃ raktapittopaśāntiṃ... |6|

ab.seg: ... nāḍīvatsyāt pūyarakte cikitsā ||6||

div.ab: vānte samyak cāvapīḍaṃ vadanti tīkṣṇaṃ ghūmaṃ śodhanaṃ cātra nasyam |7|
kṣepyaṃ nasyaṃ mūrdhavairecanīyairnāḍyā cūrṇaṃ kṣavathau bhraṃśathau ca ||7|| kuryāt svedān mūrdhni vātāmayaghnān snigdhān dhūmān yadyadanyadvitaṃ ca |8|

ab.seg: dīpte roge paittikaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ svādu yacchītalaṃ ca ||8||
nāsānāhe snehapānaṃ pradhānaṃ snigdhā dhūmā mūrdhabastiśca nityam | balātailaṃ sarvathaivopayojyaṃ vātavyādhāvanyaduktaṃ ca yadyat ||9||
nāsāsrāve ghrāṇataścūrṇamuktaṃ nāḍyā deyaṃ yo'vapīḍaśca tīkṣṇaḥ | tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ devadārvagnikābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ vā''jaṃ yuktamatrādiśanti ||10||
nāsāśoṣe kṣīrasarpiḥ pradhānaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāṇukalpena nasyam | sarpiḥpānaṃ bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaiśca snehaḥ svedaḥ snaihikaścāpi dhūmaḥ ||11||
śeṣān rogān ghrāṇajān sanniyaccheduktaṃ teṣāṃ yadyathā saṃvidhānam ||12||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre nāsāgatarogapratiṣedho nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23||

div.head: pratiśyāyapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pratiśyāyapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ | sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam ||3||
cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairnṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi ||4||
śirogurutvaṃ kṣavathoḥ pravartanaṃ tathā'ṅgamardaḥ parihṛṣṭaromatā | upadravāścāpyapare pṛthagvidhā nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyapuraḥsarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||5||

div.ab: ānaddhā pihitā nāsā tanusrāvapravartinī | galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣaśca nistodaḥ śaṅkhayostathā ||6|| svaropaghātaśca bhavet pratiśyāye'nilātmake |7|

ab.seg: uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike ||7||
kṛśo'tipāṇḍuḥ santapto bhavattṛṣṇāni(bhi)pīḍitaḥ | sadhūmaṃ sahasā vahniṃ vamatīva ca mānavaḥ ||8||

div.ab: kaphaḥ kaphakṛte ghrāṇācchuklaḥ śītaḥ sravenmuhuḥ | śuklāvabhāsaḥ śūnākṣo bhavedguruśiromukhaḥ ||9|| śirogalauṣṭhatālūnāṃ kaṇḍūyanamatīva ca |10|

ab.seg: bhūtvā bhūtvā pratiśyāyo yo'kasmādvinivartate ||10||
sampakvo vā'pyapakvo vā sa sarvaprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | liṅgāni caiva sarveṣāṃ pīnasānāṃ ca sarvaje ||11||

div.ab: raktaje tu pratiśyāye raktāsrāvaḥ pravartate | tāmrākṣaśca bhavejjantururoghātaprapīḍitaḥ ||12|| durgandhocchvāsavadanastathā gandhānna vetti ca | mūrcchanti cātra kṛmayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāstathā'ṇavaḥ ‘kṛṣṇāḥ’ iti pā.||13|| kṛmimūrdhavikāreṇa samānaṃ cāsya lakṣaṇam |14|

praklidyati punarnāsā punaśca pariśuṣyati ||14|| muhurānahyate cāpi muhurvivriyate tathā | niḥśvāsocchvāsadaurgandhyaṃ tathā gandhānna vetti ca ||15|| evaṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaṃ jānīyāt kṛcchrasādhanam |16|

ab.seg: sarva eva pratiśyāyā narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ ||16||
kālena rogajananā jāyante duṣṭapīnasāḥ | bādhiryamāndhyamaghrāṇaṃ ghorāṃśca nayanāmayān | kāsāgnisādaśophāṃśca vṛddhāḥ kurvanti pīnasāḥ ||17||
navaṃ pratiśyāyamapāsya sarvamupācaret sarpiṣa eva pānaiḥ | svedairvicitrairvamanaiśca yuktaiḥ kālopapannairavapīḍanaiśca ||18||
apacyamānasya hi pācanārthaṃ svedo hito'mlairahimaṃ ca bhojyam | niṣevyamāṇaṃ payasā''rdrakaṃ vā sampācayedikṣuvikārayogaiḥ ||19||
pakvaṃ ghanaṃ cāpyavalambamānaṃ śirovirekairapakarṣayettam | virecanāsthāpanadhūmapānairavekṣya doṣān kavalagrahaiśca ||20||
nivātaśayyāsanaceṣṭanāni mūrdhno gurūṣṇaṃ ca tathaiva vāsaḥ | tīkṣṇā virekāḥ śirasaḥ sadhūmā rūkṣaṃ yavānnaṃ ‘palānnaṃ’ iti pā. vijayā ca sevyā ||21||
śītāmbuyoṣicchiśirāvagāhacintātirūkṣāśanavegarodhān | śokaṃ ca madyāni navāni caiva vivarjayet pīnasarogajuṣṭaḥ ||22||
chardyaṅgasādajvaragauravārtamarocakāratyatisārayuktam | vilaṅghanaiḥ pācanadīpanīyairupācaret pīnasinaṃ yathāvat ||23||
bahudravairvātakaphopasṛṣṭaṃ pracchardayet pīnasinaṃ vayaḥstham | upadravāṃścāpi yathopadeśaṃ svairbheṣajairbhojanasaṃvidhānaiḥ | jayedviditvā mṛdutāṃ gateṣu prāglakṣaṇeṣūktamathādiśecca ||24||

div.ab: vātike tu pratiśyāye pibet sarpiryathākramam | pañcabhirlavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ prathamena gaṇena ca ||25|| nasyādiṣu vidhiṃ kṛtsnamavekṣetārditeritam |26|

ab.seg: pittaraktotthayoḥ peyaṃ sarpirmadhurakaiḥ śṛtam ||26||
pariṣekān pradehāṃśca kuryādapi ca śītalān | śrīsarjarasapattaṅgapriyaṅgumadhuśarkarāḥ ||27||
drākṣāmadhūlikāgojīśrīparṇīmadhukaistathā | yujyante kavalāścātra vireko madhurairapi ||28||

div.ab: dhavatvaktriphalāśyāmātilvakairmadhukena ca | śrīparṇīrajanīmiśraiḥ kṣīre daśaguṇe pacet ||29|| tailaṃ kālopapannaṃ tannasyaṃ syādanayorhitam |30|

ab.seg: kaphaje sarpiṣā snigdhaṃ tilamāṣavipakvayā ||30||
yavāgvā vāmayedvāntaḥ kaphaghnaṃ kramamācaret | ubhe bale bṛhatyau ca viḍaṅgaṃ satrikaṇṭakam ||31||
śvetāmūlaṃ sadābhadrāṃ ‘sahāṃ bhadrāṃ’ iti pā. varṣābhūṃ cātra saṃharet | tailamebhirvipakvaṃ tu nasyamasyopakalpayet ||32||
saralākiṇihīdārunikumbheṅgudibhiḥ kṛtāḥ | vartayaścopayojyāḥ syurdhūmapāne yathāvidhi ||33||
sarpīṃṣi kaṭutiktāni tīkṣṇadhūmāḥ kaṭūni ca | bheṣajānyupayuktāni hanyuḥ sarvaprakopajam ||34||
rasāñjane sātiviṣe mustāyāṃ bhadradāruṇi | tailaṃ vipakvaṃ nasyārthe vidadhyāccātra buddhimān ||35||

div.ab: mustā tejovatī pāṭhā kaṭphalaṃ kaṭukā vacā | sarṣapāḥ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalyaḥ saindhavāgnikau ||36|| tutthaṃ karañjabījaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ bhadradāru ca | etaiḥ kṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ tu kavale samprayojayet ||37|| hitaṃ mūrdhavireke ca tailamebhirvipācitam |38|

ab.seg: kṣīramardhajale kvāthyaṃ jāṅgalairmṛgapakṣibhiḥ ||38||
puṣpairvimiśraṃ jalajairvātaghnairauṣadhairapi | hime kṣīrāvaśiṣṭe'smin ghṛtamutpādya yatnataḥ ||39||
sarvagandhasitānantāmadhukaṃ ‘sarvagandhāḥ sitā'nantāmadhukaṃ’ iti pā. candanaṃ tathā | āvāpya vipayedbhūyo daśakṣīraṃ tu tadghṛtam ||40||
nasye prayuktamudriktān pratiśyāyān vyapohati | yathāsvaṃ doṣaśamanaistailaṃ kuryācca yatnataḥ ||41||
samūtrapittāścoddiṣṭāḥ kriyāḥ kṛmiṣu yojayet | yāpanārthaṃ kṛmighnāni bheṣajāni ca buddhimān ||42||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre pratiśyāyapratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||24||

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śiro rujati martyānāṃ vātapittakaphaistribhiḥ | sannipātena raktena kṣayeṇa krimibhistathā ||3||

sūryāvartānantavātārdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhakaiḥ | ekādaśaprakārasya ‘sūryovartāvabhedābhyāṃ śaṅkhakena tathaiva ca| daśaprakārasyāpyasya’ iti pā.| ḍalhaṇavyākhyānamapyetatpāṭhāntarānusāreṇaiva jñayam lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||4||
yasyānimittaṃ śiraso rujaśca bhavanti tīvrā niśi cātimātram | bandhopatāpaiśca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa samīraṇena ||5||
yasyoṣṇamaṅgāracitaṃ yathaiva dahyeta ‘bhavecchiro dhūmavatī ca nāsā’ iti pā. dhūpyeta śirokṣināsam | śītena rātrau ca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpaḥ sa tu pittakopāt ||6||
śirogalaṃ yasya kaphopadigdhaṃ guru pratiṣṭabdhamatho himaṃ ca | śūnākṣikūṭaṃ vadanaṃ ca yasya śirobhitāpaḥ sa kaphaprakopāt ||7||

div.ab: śirobhitāpe tritayapravṛtte sarvāṇi liṅgāni samudbhavanti ‘muhurbhavanti’ iti pā.|8|

ab.seg: raktātmakaḥ pittasamānaliṅgaḥ sparśāsahatvaṃ śiraso bhavecca ||8||

div.ab: vasābalāsakṣatasambhavānāṃ śirogatānāmiha saṅkṣayeṇa | kṣayapravṛttaḥ śiraso'bhitāpaḥ kaṣṭo bhavedugrarujo'timātram ||9|| saṃsvedanacchardanadhūmanasyairasṛgvimokṣaiśca vivṛddhimeti |10|
nistudyate yasya śiro'timātraṃ sambhakṣyamāṇaṃ sphuṭatīva ‘sphuratīva cantaḥ’ iti pā. cāntaḥ ||10|| ghrāṇācca gacchetsalilaṃ saraktaṃ śirobhitāpaḥ kṛmibhiḥ sa ghoraḥ |11|

sūryodayaṃ yā prati mandamandamakṣibhruvaṃ ruk samupaiti gāḍham ||11|| vivardhate cāṃśumatā sahaiva sūryāpavṛttau vinivartate ca | śītena śāntiṃ labhate kadāciduṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca ||12|| taṃ bhāskarāvartamudāharanti sarvātmakaṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ vikāram |13|

doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya eva manyāṃ sampīḍya ghāṭāsu rujāṃ sutīvrām ||13|| kurvanti sākṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe sthitiṃ karotyāśu viśeṣatastu | gaṇḍasya pārśve tu karoti kampaṃ hanugrahaṃ locanajāṃśca rogān ||14|| anantavātaṃ tamudāharanti doṣatrayotthaṃ śiraso vikāram |15|
yasyottamāṅgārdhamatīva jantoḥ sambhedatodabhramaśūlajuṣṭam ||15|| pakṣāddaśāhādathavā'pyakasmāttasyārdhabhedaṃ tritayādvyavasyet |16|

ab.seg: śaṅkhāśrito vāyurudīrṇavegaḥ kṛtānuyātraḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ ||16||
rujaḥ sutīvrāḥ pratanoti mūrdhni viśeṣataścāpi hi śaṅkhayostu | sukaṣṭamenaṃ khalu śaṅkhakākhyaṃ maharṣayo vedavidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||17||
vyādhiṃ vadantyudgatamṛtyukalpaṃ bhiṣaksahasrairapi durnivāram ||18||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogavijñānīyo nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25||

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātavyādhividhiḥ kāryaḥ śiroroge'nilātmake | payonupānaṃ seveta ghṛtaṃ tailamathāpi vā ||3||

div.ab: mudgān kulatthānmāṣāṃśca khādecca niśi kevalān | kaṭūṣṇāṃśca ‘kaṭūṣṇān samasarpiṣkān’ iti pā. sasarpiṣkānuṣṇaṃ cānu payaḥ pibet ||4|| pibedvā payasā tailaṃ tatkalkaṃ vā'pi mānavaḥ |5|

vātaghnasiddhaiḥ kṣīraiśca sukhoṣṇaiḥ sekamācaret ||5|| tatsiddhaiḥ pāyasairvā'pi sukhoṣṇairlepayecchiraḥ | svinnairvā ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. matsyapiśitaiḥ kṛśarairvā sasaindhavaiḥ ||6|| candanotpalakuṣṭhairvā suślakṣṇairmagadhāyutaiḥ | snigdhasya tailaṃ nasyaṃ syāt kulīrarasasādhitam ||7|| varuṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīramardhodakaṃ pacet | kṣīraśeṣaṃ ca tanmathyaṃ śītaṃ sāramupāharet ||8|| tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasye tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ | tasmin vipakve kṣīre tu peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram ||9|| dhūmaṃ cāsya yathākālaṃ snaihikaṃ yojayedbhiṣak |10|
pānābhyañjananasyeṣu bastikarmaṇi secane ||10|| vidadhyāttraivṛtaṃ dhīmān balātailamathāpi vā |11|

ab.seg: bhojayecca rasaiḥ snigdhaiḥ payobhirvā susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||11||

div.ab: pittaraktasamutthānau śirorogau nivārayet | śirolepaiḥ sasarpiṣkaiḥ pariṣekaiśca śītalaiḥ ||12|| kṣīrekṣurasadhānyāmlamastukṣaudrasitājalaiḥ |13|

nalavañjulakahlāracandanotpalapadmakaiḥ ||13|| vaṃśaśaivalayaṣṭyāhvamustāmbhoruhasaṃyutaiḥ ‘śaṅkhaśaivalayaṣṭyāhva...’ iti pā.| śiraḥpralepaiḥ saghṛtairvaisarpaiśca tathāvidhaiḥ ||14|| madhuraiśca mukhālaipairnasyakarmabhireva ca |15|
āsthāpanairvirekaiśca pathyaiśca snehabastibhiḥ ||15|| kṣīrasarpirhitaṃ nasyaṃ vasā vā jāṅgalā śubhā |16|

ab.seg: utpalādivipakvena kṣīreṇāsthāpanaṃ hitam ||16||
bhojanaṃ jāṅgalarasaiḥ sarpiṣā cānuvāsanam | madhuraiḥ kṣīrasarpistu snehane ca saśarkaram ||17||

div.ab: pittaraktaghnamuddiṣṭaṃ yaccānyadapi taddhitam |18|

ab.seg: kaphotthitaṃ śirorogaṃ jayet kaphanivāraṇaiḥ ||18||
śirovirekairvamanaistīkṣṇairgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaiḥ | acchaṃ ca pāyayetsarpiḥ svedayeccāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ||19||
śiro madhūkasāreṇa snigdhaṃ cāpi virecayet | iṅgudasya tvacā vā'pi meṣaśṛṅgasya ‘meṣaśṛṅgyā ca’ iti pā. vā bhiṣak ||20||
ābhyāmeva kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmapāne prayojayet | ghreyaṃ kaṭphalacūrṇaṃ ca kavalāśca kaphāpahāḥ ||21||
saralākuṣṭhaśārṅgeṣṭādevakāṣṭhaiḥ sarohiṣaiḥ | kṣārapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇairlepayecchiraḥ ||22||
yavaṣaṣṭikayoścānnaṃ vyoṣakṣārasamāyutam | paṭolamudgakaulatthairmātrāvadbhojayedrasaiḥ ||23||

div.ab: śiroroge tridoṣotthe tridoṣaghno vidhirhitaḥ |24|

ab.seg: sarpiḥpānaṃ viśeṣeṇa purāṇaṃ vā diśanti hi ||24||

div.ab: kṣayaje kṣayamāsādya kartavyo bṛṃhaṇo vidhiḥ | pāne nasye ca sarpiḥ syādvātaghnamadhuraiḥ śṛtam ||25|| kṣayakāsāpahaṃ cātra sarpiḥ pathyatamaṃ viduḥ |26|

ab.seg: kṛmibhirbhakṣyamāṇasya vakṣyate śirasaḥ kriyā ||26||
nasye hi śoṇitaṃ dadyāttena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ | mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena samāyānti yatastataḥ ||27||
teṣāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tato mūrdhavirecanaiḥ | hrasvaśigrukabījairvā kāṃsyanīlīsamāyutaiḥ ||28||
kṛmighnairavapīḍaiśca mūtrapiṣṭairupācaret | pūtimatsyayutān dhūmān kṛmighnāṃśca prayojayet ||29||

div.ab: bhojanāni kṛmighnāni pānāni vividhāni ca |30|

ab.seg: sūryāvarte vidhātavyaṃ nasyakarmādibheṣajam ||30||

div.ab: bhojanaṃ jāṅgalaprāyaṃ kṣīrānnavikṛtirghṛtam |31|

tathā'rdhabhedake vyādhau prāptamanyacca yadbhavet ||31|| śirīṣamūlakaphalairavapīḍo'nayorhitaḥ | vaṃśamūlakakarpūrairavapīḍaṃ prayojayet ||32|| avapīḍo hitaścātra vacāmāgadhikāyutaḥ | madhukenāvapīḍo vā madhunā saha saṃyutaḥ ||33|| manaḥśilāvapīḍo vā madhunā candanena vā |34|

ab.seg: teṣāmante hitaṃ nasyaṃ sarpirmadhurasānvitam ||34||

div.ab: sārivotpalakuṣṭhāni madhukaṃ cāmlapeṣitam | sarpistailayuto lepo dvayorapi sukhāvahaḥ ||35|| eṣa eva prayoktavyaḥ śiroroge kaphātmake |36|

anantavāte kartavyaḥ sūryāvartaharo ‘sūryāvarteritaḥ’ iti pā. vidhiḥ ||36|| sirāvyadhaśca kartavyo'nantavātapraśāntaye | āhāraśca vidhātavyo vātapittavināśanaḥ ||37|| madhumastakasaṃyāvaghṛtapūraiśca bhojanam |38|
kṣīrasarpiḥ praśaṃsanti nasye pāne ca śaṅkhake ||38|| jāṅgalānāṃ rasaiḥ snigdhairāhāraścātra śasyate |39|

ab.seg: śatāvarīṃ tilān kṛṣṇān madhukaṃ nīlamutpalam ||39||
dūrvāṃ punarnavāṃ caiva lepe sādhvavacārayet | mahāsugandhāmathavā pālindīṃ cāmlapeṣitām ||40||

div.ab: śītāṃścātra parīṣekān pradehāṃśca prayojayet |41|

ab.seg: avapīḍaśca deyo'tra sūryāvartanivāraṇaḥ ||41||

div.ab: kṛmikṣayakṛtau hitvā śirorogeṣu buddhimān | madhutailasamāyuktaiḥ śirāṃsyativirecayet ||42|| paścātsarṣapatailena tato nasyaṃ prayojayet |43|
na cecchāntiṃ vrajantyevaṃ snigdhasvinnāṃstato bhiṣak ||43|| paścādupācaretsamyak sirāṇāmatha mokṣaṇaiḥ |44|

ab.seg: ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogā daśāṣṭādaśa karṇajāḥ ||44||
ekatriṃśad ghrāṇagatāḥ śirasyekādaśaiva tu | iti vistarato dṛ(di)ṣṭāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ ||45||
saṃhitāyāmabhihitāḥ saptaṣaṣṭirmukhāmayāḥ | etāvanto yathāsthūlamuttamāṅgagatā gadāḥ | asmiñchāstre nigaditāḥ saṅkhyārūpacikitsitaiḥ ||46||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate śālākyatantre śirorogapratiṣedho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||26|| iti śrībhagavatā dhanvantariṇopadiṣṭāyāṃ maharṣiṇā suśrutācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargataṃ śālākyatantraṃ samāptam |

div.head: navagrahākṛtivijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto navagrahākṛtivijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
bālagrahāṇāṃ vijñānaṃ sādhanaṃ cāpyanantaram | utpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ caiva suśrutaikamanāḥ śṛṇu ||3||
skandagrahastu prathamaḥ skandāpasmāra eva ca | śakunī revatī caiva pūtanā cāndhapūtanā ||4||
pūtanā śītanāmā ca tathaiva mukhamaṇḍikā | navamo naigameṣaśca yaḥ pitṛgrahasañjñitaḥ ||5||
dhātrīmātroḥ prākpradiṣṭāpacārācchaucabhraṣṭānmaṅgalācārahīnān | trastān hṛṣṭāṃstarjitān tāḍitān vā pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān ||6||
aiśvaryasthāste na śakyā viśanto dehaṃ draṣṭuṃ mānuṣairviśvarūpāḥ | āptaṃ vākyaṃ tatsamīkṣyābhidhāsye liṅgānyeṣāṃ yāni dehe bhavanti ||7||
śūnākṣaḥ ‘stabdhākṣaḥ’ iti pā. kṣatajasagandhikaḥ stanadviḍ vakrāsyo hatacalitaikapakṣmanetraḥ | udvignaḥ sululitacakṣuralparodī skandārto bhavati ca gāḍhamuṣṭivarcāḥ ||8||
niḥsañjño bhavati punarbhavetsasañjñaḥ saṃrabdhaḥ karacaraṇaiśca nṛtyatīva | viṇmūtre sṛjati vinadya jṛmbhamāṇaḥ phenaṃ ca prasṛjati tatsakhābhipannaḥ ||9||
srastāṅgo bhayacakito vihaṅgagandhiḥ saṃsrāvivraṇaparipīḍitaḥ samantāt | sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākairvijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā ||10||
raktāsyo haritamalo'tipāṇḍudehaḥ śyāvo vā jvaramukhapākavedanārtaḥ | revatyā vyathitatanuśca karṇanāsaṃ mṛdnāti dhruvamabhipīḍitaḥ kumāraḥ ||11||
srastāṅgaḥ svapiti sukhaṃ divā na rātrau viḍ bhinnaṃ sṛjati ca kākatulyagandhiḥ | chardyā''rto hṛṣitatanūruhaḥ kumārastṛṣṇālurbhavati ca pūtanāgṛhītaḥ ||12||
yo dveṣṭi stanamatisārakāsahikkācchardībhirjvarasahitābhirardyamānaḥ | durvarṇaḥ satatamadhaḥśayo'mlagandhistaṃ brūyurbhiṣaja ihāndhapūtanārtam ||13||
udvigno bhṛśamativepate prarudyāt saṃlīnaḥ svapiti ca yasya cāntrakūjaḥ | visrāṅgo bhṛśamatisāryate ca yastaṃ jānīyādbhiṣagiha śītapūtanārtam ||14||
mlānāṅgaḥ surucirapāṇipādavaktro bahvāśī kaluṣasirāvṛtodaro yaḥ | sodvego bhavati ca mūtratulyagandhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śiśuriha vaktramaṇḍikārtaḥ ||15||
yaḥ phenaṃ vamati vinamyate ca madhye sodvegam vilapati cordhvamīkṣamāṇaḥ | jvaryeta pratatamatho vasāsagandhirniḥsañjño bhavati hi naigameṣajuṣṭaḥ ||16||
prastabdho yaḥ stanadveṣī muhyate cāviśanmuhuḥ | taṃ bālamacirāddhanti grahaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ ||17||

div.ab: viparītamataḥ sādhyaṃ cikitsedacirārditam |18|

ab.seg: gṛhe purāṇahaviṣā'bhyajya bālaṃ śucau śuciḥ ||18||
sarṣapān prakiretteṣāṃ tailairdīpaṃ ‘taile dīpaṃ’ iti pā. ca kārayet | sadā sannihitaṃ cāpi juhuyāddhavyavāhanam ||19||
sarvagandhauṣadhībījairgandhamālyairalaṅkratam | agnaye kṛttikābhyaśca svāhā svāheti santatam ||20||
namaḥ skandāya devāya grahādhipataye namaḥ | śirasā tvā'bhivande'haṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva me balim | nīrujo nirvikāraśca śiśurme jāyatāṃ drutam ||21||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre navagrahākṛtivijñānīyo nāma (prathamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
athātaḥ skandhagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
skandagrahopasṛṣṭānāṃ kumārāṇāṃ praśasyate | vātaghnadrumapatrāṇāṃ niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane ||3||
teṣāṃ mūleṣu siddhaṃ ca tailamabhyañjane hitam | sarvagandhasurāmaṇḍakaiḍaryāvāpamiṣyate ||4||
devadāruṇi rāsnāyāṃ madhureṣu drumeṣu ca | siddhaṃ sarpiśca sakṣīraṃ pānamasmai prayojayet ||5||
sarṣapāḥ sarpanirmoko vacā kākādanī ghṛtam | uṣṭrājāvigavāṃ caiva romāṇyuddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ ||6||
somavallīmindravallīṃ śamīṃ bilvasya kaṇṭakān | mṛgādanyāśca mūlāni grathitānyeva dhārayet ||7||
raktāni mālyāni tathā patākā raktāśca gandhā vividhāśca bhakṣyāḥ | ghaṇṭā ca devāya balirnivedyaḥ sukukkuṭaḥ skandagrahe hitāya ||8||
snānaṃ trirātraṃ niśi catvareṣu kuryāt puraṃ śāliyavairnavaistu | adbhiśca gāyatryabhimantritābhiḥ prajvālanaṃ vyāhṛtibhiśca vahneḥ ||9||
rakṣāmataḥ pravakṣyāmi bālānāṃ pāpanāśinīm | ahanyahani kartavyā yā bhiṣagbhiratandritaiḥ ||10||
tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vapuṣāṃ tathā | nidhānaṃ yo'vyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu ||11||
grahasenāpatirdevo devasenāpatirvibhuḥ | devasenāripuharaḥ pātu tvāṃ bhagavān guhaḥ ||12||
devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya ca yaḥ sutaḥ | gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchatu ||13||
raktamālyāmbaraḥ śrīmān raktacandanabhūṣitaḥ | raktadivyavapurdevaḥ pātu tvāṃ krauñcasūdanaḥ ||14||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandapratiṣedho nāmā(dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, ādito')ṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||28||

div.head: skandāpasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ skandāpasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
bilvaḥ śirīṣo golomī surasādiśca yo gaṇaḥ | pariṣeke prayoktavyaḥ skandāpasmāraśāntaye ||3||

div.ab: sarvagandhavipakvaṃ tu tailamabhyañjane hitam | kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāye ca kākolyādau gaṇe tathā ||4|| vipaktavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpi pānīyaṃ payasā saha |5|

ab.seg: utsādanaṃ vacāhiṅguyuktaṃ skandagrahe hitam ||5||
gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi keśā hastinakhā ghṛtam | vṛṣabhasya ca romāṇi yojyānyuddhūpane'pi ca ||6||

div.ab: anantāṃ kukkuṭīṃ bimbīṃ markaṭīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|
pakvāpakvāni māṃsāni prasannā rudhiraṃ payaḥ ||7|| bhūtaudano nivedyaśca skandāpasmāriṇe'vaṭe |8|

ab.seg: catuṣpathe ca kartavyaṃ snānamasya yatātmanā ||8||
skandāpasmārasañjño yaḥ skandasya dayitaḥ sakhā | viśākhasañjñaśca śiśoḥ śivo'stu vikṛtānanaḥ ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre skandāpasmārapratiṣedho nāma (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29||

div.head: śakunīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śakunīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
śakunyabhiparītasya kāryo vaidyena jānatā | vetasāmrakapitthānāṃ niṣkvāthaḥ pariṣecane ||3||

div.ab: kaṣāyamadhuraustailaṃ kāryamabhyañjane śiśoḥ |4|
madhukośīrahrīberasārivotpalapadmakaiḥ ||4|| rodhrapriyaṅgumañjiṣṭhāgairikaiḥ pradihecchiśum |5|

ab.seg: vraṇeṣūktāni cūrṇāni pathyāni vividhāni ca ||5||

div.ab: skandagrahe dhūpanāni tānīhāpi prayojayet |6|
śatāvarīmṛgairvārunāgadantīnidigdhikāḥ ||6|| lakṣmaṇāṃ sahadevāṃ ca bṛhatīṃ cāpi dhārayet |7|
tilataṇḍulakaṃ mālyaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||7|| balireṣa karañjeṣu nivedyo niyatātmanā |8|

ab.seg: niṣkuṭe ca prayoktavyaṃ snānamasya yathāvidhi ||8||

div.ab: skandāpasmāraśamanaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpīha pūjitam |9|

ab.seg: kuryācca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ śakunyāḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||9||
antarīkṣacarā devī sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā | ayomukhī tīkṣṇatuṇḍā śakunī te prasīdatu ||10||
durdarśanā mahākāyā piṅgākṣī bhairavasvarā | lambodarī śaṅkukarṇī ‘śaṅkhavarṇā’ iti pā. śakunī te prasīdatu ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śakunīpratiṣedho nāma (caturtho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||30||

div.head: revatīpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto revatīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
aśvagandhā ca śṛṅgī ca sārivā sapunarnavā | sahe tathā vidārī ca kaṣāyāḥ secane hitāḥ ||3||
tailamabhyañjane kāryaṃ kuṣṭhe sarjarase'pi ca | palaṅkaṣāyāṃ nalade tathā girikadambake ||4||
dhavāśvakarṇakakubhadhātakītindukīṣu ca | kākolyādigaṇe caiva pānīyaṃ sarpiriṣyate ||5||

div.ab: kulatthāḥ śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ ca pradehaḥ sārvagandhikaḥ | gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi yavā yavaphalo ghṛtam ||6|| sandhyayorubhayoḥ kāryametaduddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ | varuṇāriṣṭakamayaṃ rucakaṃ saindukaṃ tathā ||7|| satataṃ dhārayeccāpi kṛtaṃ vā pautrajīvikam | śuklāḥ sumanaso lājāḥ payaḥ śālyodanaṃ tathā ||8|| balirnivedyo gotīrthe revatyai prayatātmanā |9|

ab.seg: saṅgame ca bhiṣak snānaṃ kuryāddhātrīkumārayoḥ ||9||
nānāvastradharā devī citramālyānulepanā | calatkuṇḍalinī śyāmā revatī te prasīdatu ||10||
upāsate yāṃ satataṃ devyo vividhabhūṣaṇāḥ | lambā karālā vinatā tathaiva bahuputrikā | revatī śuṣkanāmā yā sā te devī prasīdatu ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre revatīpratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
athātaḥ pūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
kapotavaṅkā'raluko varuṇaḥ pāribhadrakaḥ | āsphotā caiva yojyāḥ syurbālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||
vacā vayaḥsthā golomī haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | kuṣṭhaṃ sarjarasaścaiva tailarthe varga iṣyate ||4||
hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ tugākṣīryāṃ siddhaṃ madhurakeṣu ca | kuṣṭhatālīśakhadiracandanasyandane tathā ||5||
devadāruvacāhiṅgukuṣṭhaṃ girikadambakaḥ | elā hareṇavaścāpi yojyā uddhūpane sadā ||6||
gandhanākulikumbhīke majjāno badarasya ca | karkaṭāsthi ghṛtaṃ cāpi dhūpanaṃ sarṣapaiḥ saha ||7||
kākādanīṃ citraphalāṃ bimbīṃ guñjāṃ ca dhārayet | matsyaudanaṃ ca kurvīta kṛśarāṃ palalaṃ tathā | śarāvasampuṭe kṛtvā baliṃ śūnyagṛhe haret ||8||
ucchiṣṭenābhiṣekeṇa śiśoḥ snapanamiṣyate | pūjyā ca pūtanā devī balibhiḥ sopahārakaiḥ ||9||
malināmbarasaṃvītā malinā rūkṣamūrdhajā | śūnyāgārāśritā `śūnyārāmāśritā' iti pā. devī dārakaṃ pātu pūtanā ||10||
durdarśanā sudurgandhā karālā meghakālikā | bhinnagārāśrayā devī dārakaṃ pātu pūtanā ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre (ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||32||

div.head: andhapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: tiktakadrumapatrāṇāṃ kāryaḥ kvātho'vasecane |3|
surā sauvīrakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ||3|| tathā sarjarasaścaiva tailārthamupadiśyate | pippalyaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ vargo madhurako madhu ||4|| śālaparṇī bṛhatyau ca ghṛtārthamupadiśyate |5|

ab.seg: sarvagandhaiḥ pradehaśca gātreṣvakṣṇośca śītalaiḥ ||5||
purīṣaṃ kaukkuṭaṃ keśāṃścarma sarpatvacaṃ tathā | jīrṇāṃ ca bhikṣusaṅghāṭīṃ dhūmanāyopakalpayet ||6||
kukkuṭīṃ markaṭīṃ śimbīmanantāṃ cāpi dhārayet | māṃsamāmaṃ tathā pakvaṃ śoṇitaṃ ca catuṣpathe ||7||
nivedyamantaśca gṛhe śiśo rakṣānimittataḥ | śiśośca snapanaṃ kuryāt sarvagandhodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||8||
karālā piṅgalā muṇḍā kaṣāyāmbaravāsinī | devī bālamimaṃ prītā saṃrakṣatvandhapūtanā ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre'ndhapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma (saptamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||33||

div.head: śītapūtanāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śītapūtanāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: kapitthaṃ suvahāṃ bimbīṃ tathā bilvaṃ pracībalam | nandīṃ bhallātakaṃ cāpi pariṣeke prayojayet ||3|| bastamūtraṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ mustaṃ ca suradāru ca | kuṣṭhaṃ ca sarvagandhāṃśca tailārthamavacārayet ||4|| rohiṇīsarjakhadirapalāśakakubhatvacaḥ | niṣkvāthya tasminniṣkvāthe sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam ||5|| gṛdhrolūkapurīṣāṇi bastagandhāmahestvacaḥ | nimbapatrāṇi madhukaṃ dhūpanārthaṃ prayojayet ||6|| dhārayedapi lambāṃ ca guñjāṃ kākādanīṃ tathā |7|

ab.seg: nadyāṃ mudgakṛtaiścānnaistarpayecchītapūtanām ||7||
devyai deyaścopahāro vāruṇī rudhiraṃ tathā | jalāśayānte bālasya snapanaṃ copadiśyate ||8||
mudgaudanāśanā devī surāśoṇitapāyinī | jalāśayālayā devī pātu tvāṃ śītapūtanā ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre śītapūtanāpratiṣedho nāma(aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||34||
athāto mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
kapitthabilvatarkārīvāṃśīgandharvahastakāḥ | kuberākṣī ca yojyāḥ syurbālānāṃ pariṣecane ||3||
svarasairbhṛṅgavṛkṣāṇāṃ `bhṛṅgavṛkṣo bhṛṅgarāja' iti hārāṇacandraḥ tathā'jaharigandhayoḥ | tailaṃ vasāṃ ca saṃyojya pacedabhyañjane śiśoḥ ||4||
madhūlikāyāṃ payasi tugākṣīryāṃ gaṇe tathā | madhure pañcamūle ca kanīyasi ghṛtaṃ pacet ||5||
vacā sarjarasaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ sarpiścoddhūpanaṃ hitam | dhārayedapi jihvāśca cāṣacīrallisarpajāḥ ||6||
varṇakaṃ cūrṇakaṃ mālyamañjanaṃ pāradaṃ tathā | manaḥśilāṃ copaharedgoṣṭhamadhye baliṃ tathā ||7||
pāyasaṃ sapuroḍāśaṃ balyarthamupasaṃharet | mantrapūtābhiradbhiśca tatraiva snapanaṃ hitam ||8||
alaṅkṛtā rūpavatī subhagā kāmarūpiṇī | goṣṭhamadhyālayaratā pātu tvāṃ mukhamaṇḍikā ||9||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre mukhamaṇḍikāpratiṣedho nāma(navamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||35||
athāto naigameṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
bilvāgnimanthapūtīkāḥ kāryāḥ syuḥ pariṣecane | surā sabījaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pariṣeke ca śasyate ||3||
priyaṅgusaralānantāśatapuṣpākuṭannaṭaiḥ | pacettailaṃ sagomūtrairdadhimastvamlakāñjikaiḥ ||4||
pañcamūladvayakvāthe kṣīre madhurakeṣu ca | pacedghṛtaṃ ca medhāvī kharjūrīmastake'pi vā ||5||
vacāṃ vayaḥsthāṃ golomīṃ jaṭilāṃ cāpi dhārayet | utsādanaṃ hitaṃ cātra skandāpasmāranāśanam ||6||
siddhārthakavacāhiṅgukuṣṭhaṃ caivākṣataiḥ saha | bhallātakājamodāśca hitamuddhūpanaṃ śiśoḥ ||7||
markaṭolūkagṛdhrāṇāṃ purīṣāṇi navagrahe | dhūpaḥ supte jane kāryo bālasya hitamicchatā ||8||
tilataṇḍulakaṃ mālyaṃ bhakṣyāṃśca vividhānapi | kumārapitṛmeṣāya vṛkṣamūle nivedayet ||9||
adhastādvaṭavṛkṣasya snapanaṃ copadiśyate | baliṃ nyagrodhavṛkṣeṣu tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ nivedayet ||10||
ajānanaścalākṣibhraḥ kāmarūpī mahāyaśāḥ | bālaṃ bālapitā devo naigameṣo'bhirakṣatu ||11||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre naigameṣapratiṣedho nāma(daśamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36||

div.head: grahotpattyadhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto grahotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
nava skandādayaḥ proktā bālānāṃ ya ime grahāḥ | śrīmanto divyavapuṣo nārīpuruṣavigrahāḥ ||3||
ete guhasya rakṣārthaṃ kṛttikomāgniśūlibhiḥ | sṛṣṭāḥ śaravaṇasthasya rakṣitasyātmatejasā ||4||
strīvigrahā grahā ye tu nānārūpā mayeritāḥ | gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ te bhāgā rājasatāmasāḥ ||5||
naigameṣastu pārvatyā sṛṣṭo meṣānano grahāḥ | kumāradhārī devasya guhasyātmasamaḥ sakhā ||6||
skandāpasmārasañjño yaḥ so'gninā'gnisamadyutiḥ | sa ca skandasakhā nāma viśākha iti cocyate ||7||
skandaḥ sṛṣṭo bhagavatā devena tripurāriṇā | bibharti cāraparāṃ sañjñāṃ kumāra iti sa grahaḥ ||8||
bālalīlādharo yo'yaṃ devo rudrāgnisambhavaḥ | mithyācāreṣu `mithyā bāleṣu' iti pā. bhagavān svayaṃ naiṣa pravartate ||9||
kumāraḥ skandasāmānyādatra kecidapaṇḍitāḥ | gṛhṇātītyalpavijñānā bruvate dehacintakāḥ ||10||

div.ab: tato bhagavati skande surasenāpatau kṛte | upatasthurgrahāḥ sarve dīptaśaktidharaṃ guham ||11|| ūcuḥ prāñjalayaścainaṃ vṛttiṃ naḥ saṃvidhatsva vai | teṣāmarthe tataḥ skandaḥ śivaṃ devamacodayat ||12|| tato grahāṃstānuvāca bhagavān bhaganetrahṛt | tiryagyoniṃ mānuṣaṃ ca daivaṃ ca tritayaṃ jagat ||13|| parasparopakāreṇa vartate dhāryate'pi ca | devā manuṣyān prīṇanti tairyagyonīṃstathaiva ca ||14|| vartamānairyathākālaṃ śītavarṣoṣṇamārutaiḥ | ijyāñjalinamaskārajapahomavratādibhiḥ ||15|| narāḥ samyak prayuktaiśca prīṇanti tridiveśvarān | bhāgadheyaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca śeṣaṃ kiñcinna vidyate ||16|| tadyuṣmākaṃ śubhā vṛttirbāleṣveva bhaviṣyati | kuleṣu yeṣu nejyante devāḥ pitara eva ca ||17|| brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaścaiva guravo'tithayastathā | nivṛttācāraśauceṣu parapākopajīviṣu ||18|| utsannabalibhikṣeṣu bhinnakāṃsyopabhojiṣu | gṛheṣu teṣu ye bālāstān gṛhṇīdhvamaśaṅkitāḥ ||19|| tatra vo vipulā vṛttiḥ pūjā caiva bhaviṣyati | evaṃ grahāḥ samutpannā bālān gṛhṇanti cāpyataḥ ||20|| grahopasṛṣṭā bālāstu duścikitsyatamā matāḥ |21|

ab.seg: vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ cāpi dhruvaṃ skandagrahe matam ||21||
