skandagraho'tyugratamaḥ sarveṣveva yataḥ smṛtaḥ | anyo vā sarvarūpastu na sādhyo graha ucyate ||22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre grahotpattyadhyāyo nāma(ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||37||

div.head: yonivyāpatpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto yonivyāpatpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: pravṛddhaliṅgaṃ puruṣaṃ yā'tyarthamupasevate | rūkṣadurbalabālā yā tasyā vāyuḥ prakupyati ||3|| sa duṣṭo yonimāsādya yonirogāya kalpate |4|
trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ yathāsvaṃ lakṣaṇena tu ||4|| viṃśatirvyāpado yonernirdiṣṭā rogasaṅgrahe | mithyācāreṇa yāḥ strīṇāṃ praduṣṭenārtavena ca ||5|| jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak |6|

udāvartā tathā vandhyā viplutā ca pariplutā ||6|| vātalā ceti vātotthāḥ, pittotthā rudhirakṣarā | vāminī sraṃsinī cāpi putraghnī pittalā ca yā ||7|| atyānandā ca yā yoniḥ karṇinī caraṇādvayam `caraṇīdvayam' iti pā.| śleṣmalā `ślaiṣmikī sakaphā jñeyā' iti pā. ca kaphājjñeyā, ṣaṇḍākhyā phalinī tathā ||8|| mahatī `mehanī' iti pā. sūcivaktrā ca sarvajeti tridoṣajā |9|

ab.seg: saphenilamudāvartā rajaḥ kṛcchreṇa muñcati ||9||
vandhyāṃ naṣṭārtavāṃ vidyādviplutāṃ nityavedanām | pariplutāyāṃ bhavati grāmyadharme rujā bhṛśam ||10||
vātalā karkaśā stabdhā śūlanistodapīḍitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu bhavantyanilavedanāḥ ||11||
sadāhaṃ prakṣaratyasraṃ yasyāṃ sā lohitakṣarā | savātamudgiredbījaṃ vāminī rajasā yutam ||12||
prasraṃsinī syandate tu kṣobhitā duḥprasūśca yā | sthitaṃ sthitaṃ hanti garbhaṃ putraghnī raktasaṃsravāt ||13||
atyarthaṃ pittalā yonirdāhapākajvarānvitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu pittaliṅgocchrayo bhavet ||14||
atyānandā na santoṣaṃ grāmyadharmeṇa gacchati | karṇinyāṃ karṇikā yonau śleṣmāsṛgbhyaṃ prajāyate ||15||
maithune'caraṇā `maithune'caraṇī' iti pā. pūrvaṃ puruṣādatiricyate | bahuśaścāticaraṇādanyā bījaṃ na vindati ||16||
śleṣmalā picchilā yoniḥ kaṇḍūyuktā'tiśītalā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu śleṣmaliṅgocchritirbhavet ||17||
anārtavastanā ṣaṇḍī kharasparśā ca maithune | atikāyagṛhītāyāstaruṇyāḥ phalinī bhavet ||18||
vivṛtā'timahāyoniḥ sūcīvaktrā'tisaṃvṛtā | sarvaliṅgasamutthānā sarvadoṣaprakopajā ||19||
catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu sarvaliṅgocchritirbhavet | pañcāsādhyā bhavantīmā yonayaḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ ||20||
pratidoṣaṃ tu sādhyāsu snehādikrama iṣyate | dadyāduttarabastīṃśca viśeṣeṇa yathoditān ||21||

div.ab: karkaśāṃ śītalāṃ stabdhāmalpasparśāṃ ca maithune | kumbhīsvedairupacaret sānūpaudakasaṃyutaiḥ ||22|| madhurauṣadhasaṃyuktān veśavārāṃśca yoniṣu | nikṣipeddhārayeccāpi picutailamatandritaḥ ||23|| dhāvanāni ca pathyāni kurvītāpūraṇāni ca |24|

ab.seg: oṣacoṣānvitāsūktaṃ kuryācchītaṃ vidhiṃ bhiṣak ||24||
durgandhāṃ picchilāṃ cāpi cūrṇaiḥ pañcakaṣāyajaiḥ | pūrayedrājavṛkṣādikaṣāyaiścāpi dhāvanam ||25||
yonyāṃ tu pūyasrāviṇyāṃ śodhanadravyasambhṛtaiḥ | sagomūtraiḥ salavaṇaiḥ śodhanaṃ hitamiṣyate `piṇḍairāpūraṇaṃ hitam' iti pā.||26||
bṛhatīphalakalkasya dviharidrāyutasya ca | kaṇḍūmatīmalpasparśāṃ pūrayeddhūpayettathā ||27||
vartiṃ pradadyāt karṇinyāṃ śodhanadravyasambhṛtām | prasraṃsinīṃ ghṛtābhyaktāṃ kṣīrasvinnāṃ praveśayet ||28||
pidhāya veśavāreṇa tato bandhaṃ samācaret | pratidoṣaṃ vidadhyācca surāriṣṭāsavān bhiṣak ||29||
prātaḥ prātarniṣeveta rasonāduddhṛtaṃ rasam | kṣīramāṃsarasaprāyamāhāraṃ vidadhīta ca ||30||
śukrārtavādayo doṣāḥ stanarogāśca kīrtitāḥ | klaibyasthānāni `klabyotthānāni' iti pā. mūḍhasya garbhasya vidhireva ca ||31||
garbhiṇīpratirogeṣu cikitsā cāpyudāhṛtā | sarvathā tāṃ prayuñjīta yonivyāpatsu buddhimān | apaprajātārogāṃśca cikitseduttarādbhiṣak ||32||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kumāratantre yonivyāpatpratiṣedho nāma(dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, ādito')ṣṭatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||38||
uttaratantre dvitīyaṃ kaumāratantraṃ samāptam ||2||

div.head: jvarapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto jvarapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: yenāmṛtamapāṃ madhyāduddhṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani | yato'maratvaṃ samprāptāstridaśāstridiveśvarāt ||3|| śiṣyāstaṃ devamāsīnaṃ papracchuḥ suśrutādayaḥ | vraṇasyopadravāḥ proktā vraṇināmapyataḥ param ||4|| samāsād vyāsataścaiva brūhi no bhiṣajāṃvara |5|

ab.seg: upadraveṇa juṣṭasya vraṇaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati ||5||
upadravāstu vraṇinaḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasya śeṣadhātuparikṣayāt ||6||
tasmādupadravān kṛtsnān brūhi naḥ sacikitsitān | sarvakāyacikitsāsu ye dṛṣṭāḥ paramarṣiṇā ||7||
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prābravīdbhiṣajāṃvaraḥ | jvaramādau pravakṣyāmi sa rogānīkarāṭ smṛtaḥ ||8||
rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ sarvabhūtapratāpanaḥ | taistairnāmabhiranyeṣāṃ sattvānāṃ parikīrtyate ||9||
janmādau nidhane caiva prāyo viśati dehinam `dehinaḥ' iti `dehinām' iti ca pā.| ataḥ sarvavikarāṇāmayaṃ rājā prakīrtitaḥ ||10||

div.ab: ṛte devamanuṣyebhyo nānyo viṣahate tu tam | karmaṇā labhate yasmāddevatvaṃ mānuṣādapi ||11|| punaścaiva cyutaḥ svargānmānuṣyamanuvartate | tasmātte devabhāvena sahante mānuṣā jvaram ||12|| śeṣāḥ sarve vipadyante tairyagyonā jvarārditāḥ |13|
svedāvarodhaḥ `svedoparodhaḥ' iti pā. santāpaḥ sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tathā ||13|| vikārā yugapadyasmin jvaraḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ |14|
doṣaiḥ pṛthak samastaiśca dvandvairāgantureva ca ||14|| anekakāraṇotpannaḥ smṛtastvaṣṭavidho jvaraḥ |15|

doṣāḥ prakupitāḥ sveṣu kāleṣu svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ ||15|| vyāpya dehamaśeṣeṇa jvaramāpādayanti hi | duṣṭāḥ svahetubhirdoṣāḥ prāpyāmāśayamūṣmaṇā ||16|| sahitā rasamāgatya rasasvedapravāhiṇām | srotasāṃ mārgamāvṛtya mandīkṛtya hutāśanam ||17|| nirasya bahirūṣmāṇaṃ paktisthānācca kevalam | śarīraṃ samabhivyāpya svakāleṣu jvarāgamam ||18|| janayantyatha vṛddhiṃ vā svavarṇaṃ ca tvagādiṣu |19|

ab.seg: mithyātiyuktairapi ca snehādyaiḥ karmabhirnṛṇām ||19||
vividhādabhighātācca rogotthānāt prapākataḥ | śramāt kṣayādajīrṇācca viṣātsātmyartuparyayāt ||20||
oṣadhīpuṣpagandhācca śokānnakṣatrapīḍayā `kopānnakṣatrapīḍanāt' iti pā.| abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ manobhūtābhiśaṅkayā ||21||
strīṇāmapaprajātānāṃ prajātānāṃ tathā'hitaiḥ | stanyāvataraṇe caiva jvaro doṣaiḥ pravartate ||22||
tairvegavadbhirbahudhā samudbhrāntairvimārgagaiḥ | vikṣipyamāṇo'ntaragnirbhavatyāśu bahiścaraḥ ||23||
ruṇaddhi cāpyapāndhātuṃ yasmāttasmājjvarāturaḥ | bhavatyatyuṣṇagātraśca jvaritastena `na ca svidyati sarvataḥ' iti pā. cocyate ||24||
śramo'ratirvivarṇatvaṃ vairasyaṃ nayanaplavaḥ | icchādveṣau muhuścāpi śītavātātapādiṣu ||25||
jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo gurutā romaharṣo'rucistamaḥ | apraharṣaśca śītaṃ ca bhavatyutpatsyati jvare ||26||
sāmānyato, viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt | pittānnayanayordāhaḥ, kaphānnānnābhinandanam ||27||
sarvaliṅgasamavāyaḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaje | dvayordvayostu rūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvandvajaṃ viduḥ ||28||
vepathurviṣamo vegaḥ kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇam | nidrānāśaḥ kṣutaḥ stambho gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyameva ca ||29||
śirohṛdgātrarugvaktravairasyaṃ baddhaviṭkatā | jṛmbhā''dhmānaṃ tathā śūlaṃ bhavatyanilaje jvare ||30||
vegastīkṣṇo'tisāraśca nidrālpatvaṃ tathā vamiḥ | kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pākaḥ svedaśca jāyate ||31||
pralāpaḥ kaṭutā vaktre mūrcchā dāho madastṛṣā | pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ paittike bhrama eva ca ||32||
gauravaṃ śītamutkleśo romaharṣo'tinidratā | srotorodho rugalpatvaṃ `viḍalpatvaṃ' iti pā. praseko madhurāsyatā ||33||
nātyuṣṇagātratā chardiraṅgasādo'vipākatā | pratiśyāyo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ kaphaje'kṣṇośca `kaphaje'kṣyādiśuklatā' iti pā. śuklatā ||34||

div.ab: nidrānāśo bhramaḥ śvāsastandrā suptāṅgatā'ruciḥ | tṛṣṇā moho madaḥ stambho dāhaḥ śītaṃ hṛdi vyathā ||35|| paktiścireṇa doṣāṇāmunmādaḥ śyāvadantatā | rasanā paruṣā kṛṣṇā sandhimūrdhāsthijā rujaḥ ||36|| nirbhugne kaluṣe netre karṇau śabdaruganvitau | pralāpaḥ srotasāṃ pākaḥ kūjanaṃ cetanācyutiḥ ||37|| svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāmalpaśaḥ sucirāt srutiḥ |38|
sarvaje sarvaliṅgāni... |38|

...viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu ||38|| nātyuṣṇaśīto'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hatasvaraḥ | kharajihvaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ ||39|| sāsro nirbhugnahṛdayo `sāsranirbhugnanayanaḥ' iti pā. bhaktadveṣī hataprabhaḥ | śvasannipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravāyutaḥ ||40|| tamabhinyāsamityāhurhataujasamathāpare |41|

ab.seg: sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchramasādhyamapare viduḥ ||41||
nidropetamabhinyāsaṃ kṣīṇamenaṃ hataujasam | sannyastagātraṃ sannyāsaṃ vidyātsarvātmake jvare ||42||

div.ab: ojo visraṃsate yasya pittānilasamucchrayāt | sa gātrastambhaśītābhyāṃ śayanepsuracetanaḥ `śayane syādacetanaḥ' iti pā.||43|| api jāgrat svapan jantustandrāluśca pralāpavān | saṃhṛṣṭaromā srastāṅgo mandasantāpavedanaḥ ||44|| ojonirodhajaṃ tasya jānīyāt kuśalo bhiṣak |45|
saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe'pi vā ||45|| punarghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā |46|

ab.seg: dvidoṣocchrāyaliṅgāstu dvandvajāstrividhāḥ smṛtāḥ ||46||

div.ab: tṛṣṇā mūrcchā bhramo dāhaḥ svapnanāśaḥ śirorujā | kaṇṭhāsyadaśoṣo vamathū romaharṣo'rucistathā ||47|| parvabhedaśca jṛmbhā ca vātapittajvarākṛtiḥ |48|

ab.seg: staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ bhedo nidrā gauravameva ca ||48||
śirograhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ kāsaḥ svedapravartanam | santāpo madhyavegaśca vātaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ ||49||

div.ab: liptātiktāsyatā tandrā mohaḥ kāso'rucistṛṣā | muhurdāho muhuḥ śītaṃ śleṣmapittajvarākṛtiḥ ||50|| (jṛmbhādhmānamadotkampaparvabhedaparikṣayāḥ| tṛṭpralāpābhitāpāḥ syurjvare mārutapaittike ||1|| śūlakāsakaphotkleśaśītavepathupīnasāḥ| gauravāruciviṣṭambhā vātaśleṣmasamudbhave||2|| śītadāhārucistambhasvedamohamadabhramāḥ| kāsāṅgasādahṛllāsā bhavanti kaphapaittike||3||) |

ab.seg: kṛśānāṃ `kṣāmāṇāṃ' iti pā. jvaramuktānāṃ mithyāhāravihāriṇām | doṣaḥ svalpo'pi saṃvṛddho dehināmanileritaḥ ||51||
satatānyedyuṣkatryākhyacāturthān sapralepakān | kaphasthānavibhāgena yathāsaṅkhyaṃ karoti hi ||52||
ahorātrādahorātrāt sthānāt sthānaṃ prapadyate | tataścāmāśayaṃ prāpya doṣaḥ `ghoraṃ' iti pā. kuryājjvaraṃ nṛṇām ||53||
tathā pralepako jñeyaḥ `pralepakastvaviṣamaḥ' iti madhukośe pāṭhaḥ śoṣiṇāṃ prāṇanāśanaḥ | duścikitsyatamo mandaḥ sukaṣṭo dhātuśoṣakṛt ||54||
kaphasthāneṣu vā doṣastiṣṭhan dvitricaturṣu vā | viparyayākhyān kurute viṣamān kṛcchrasādhanān ||55||
paro hetuḥ svabhāvo vā viṣame kaiścidīritaḥ | āgantuścānubandho hi prāyaśo viṣamajvare ||56||
vātādhikatvāt pravadanti tajjñāstṛtīyakaṃ cāpi caturthakaṃ ca | aupatyake madyasamudbhave ca hetuṃ jvare pittakṛtaṃ vadanti ||57||
pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ ca kaphādhikatvena vadanti tajjñāḥ | mūrcchānubandhā viṣamajvarā ye prāyeṇa te dvandvasamutthitāstu ||58||
tvaksthau śleṣmānilau śītamādau janayato jvare | tayoḥ praśāntayoḥ `tasmin praśānte tvitarau kurutaḥ śītamantataḥ' iti pā. pittamante dāhaṃ karoti ca ||59||
karotyādau tathā pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ dāhamatīva ca | praśānte kurutastasmiṃśchītamante ca tāvapi ||60||
dvāvetau dāhaśītādī jvarau saṃsargajau smṛtau | dāhapūrvastayoḥ kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaśca sa smṛtaḥ ||61||

div.ab: prasaktaścābhighātotthaścetanāprabhavastu `cetanāprasavaḥ' iti pā. yaḥ |62|
rātryahnoḥ ṣaṭsu kāleṣu kīrtiteṣu yathā purā ||62|| prasahya viṣamo'bhyeti mānavaṃ bahudhā jvaraḥ |63|

ab.seg: sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācidvimuñcati ||63||
glānigauravakārśyebhyaḥ `yasmādgauravavaivarṇyakārśyebhyo na vimucyate' iti pā. sa yasmānna pramucyate | vege tu samatikrānte gato'yamiti lakṣyate ||64||
dhātvantarastho līnatvānna saukṣmyādupalabhyate | alpadoṣendhanaḥ kṣīṇaḥ kṣīṇendhana ivānalaḥ ||65||
doṣo'lpo'hitasambhūto jvarotsṛṣṭasya vā punaḥ | dhātumanyatamaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram ||66||

div.ab: satataṃ `santataṃ' iti pā. rasaraktasthaḥ so'nyedyuḥ piśitāśritaḥ | medogatastṛtīye'hni tvasthimajjagataḥ punaḥ ||67|| kuryāccāturthakaṃ ghoramantakaṃ rogasaṅkaram |68|

ab.seg: kecidbhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ bruvate viṣamajvaram ||68||
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāhamathāpi vā | santatyā yo'visargī syātsantataḥ sa nigadyate ||69||

div.ab: ahorātre satatako dvau kālāvanuvartate | anyedyuṣkastvahorātrādekakālaṃ pravartate ||70|| tṛtīyakastṛtīye'hni caturthe'hni caturthakaḥ |71|

vātenodīryamāṇāśca hrīyamāṇāśca sarvataḥ | ekadvidoṣā martyānāṃ tasminnevodite'hani ||71|| velāṃ tāmeva kurvanti jvaravege muhurmuhuḥ | (vātenoddhūyamānastu ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate yathā pūryeta sāgaraḥ ||72|| vātenodīritāstadvaddoṣāḥ kurvanti vai jvarān | yathā vegāgame velāṃ chādayitvā mahodadheḥ ||73|| vegahānau tadevāmbhastatraivāntarnilīyate | doṣavegodaye tadvadudīryeta jvaro'sya vai ||74|| vegahānau praśāmyeta yathā'mbhaḥ sāgare tathā) |75|
vividhenābhighātena jvaro yaḥ sampravartate ||75|| yathādoṣaprakopaṃ tu tathā manyeta taṃ jvaram |76|

śyāvāsyatā viṣakṛte dāhātīsārahṛdgrahāḥ `dāhātīsārahṛdgadāḥ' iti pā.||76|| abhaktaruk pipāsā ca todo mūrcchā balakṣayaḥ | oṣadhīgandhaje mūrcchā śiroruk vamathuḥ kṣavaḥ ||77|| kāmaje cittavibhraṃśastandrā''lasyamarocakaḥ | hṛdaye vedanā cāsya gātraṃ ca pariśuṣyati ||78|| bhayāt pralāpaḥ śokācca bhavet kopācca vepathuḥ | abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ mohastṛṣṇā ca jāyate ||79|| bhūtābhiṣaṅgādudvegahāsyakampanarodanam |80|
śramakṣayābhighātebhyo dehināṃ kupito'nilaḥ ||80|| pūrayitvā'khilaṃ dehaṃ jvaramāpādayedbhṛśam |81|

ab.seg: rogāṇāṃ tu samutthānādvidāhāgantutastathā ||81||
jvaro'paraḥ sambhavati taistairanyaiśca hetubhiḥ | doṣāṇāṃ sa tu liṅgāni kadācinnātivartate ||82||

div.ab: gurutā hṛdayotkleśaḥ sadanaṃ chardyarocakau | rasasthe tu jvare liṅgaṃ dainyaṃ cāsyopajāyate ||83|| raktaniṣṭhīvanaṃ dāhaḥ svedaśchardanavibhramau | pralāpaḥ piṭikā tṛṣṇā raktaprāpte jvare nṛṇām ||84|| piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ tṛṣṇā sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā | ūṣmā'ntardāhavikṣepau `ūṣmāntarmohavikṣepau' iti pā. glāniḥ syānmāṃsage jvare ||85|| bhṛśaṃ svedastṛṣā mūrcchā pralāpaśchardireva ca | daurgandhyārocakau glānirmedaḥsthe cāsahiṣṇutā ||86|| bhedo'sthnāṃ kuñca(ja)naṃ śvāso virekaśchardireva ca | vikṣepaṇaṃ ca gātrāṇāmetadasthigate jvare ||87|| tamaḥpraveśanaṃ hikkā kāsaḥ śaityaṃ vamistathā | antardāho mahāśvāso marmacchedaśca majjage | maraṇaṃ prāpnuyāttatra śukrasthānagate jvare ||88|| śephasaḥ stabdhatā mokṣaḥ śukrasya tu viśeṣataḥ | dagdhvendhanaṃ yathā vahnirdhātūn hatvā yathā viṣam ||89|| kṛtakṛtyo vrajecchāntiṃ dehaṃ hatvā tathā jvaraḥ |90|

vātapittakaphotthānāṃ jvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yathā ||90|| tathā teṣāṃ bhiṣagbrūyādrasādiṣvapi buddhimān | samastaiḥ sannipātena dhātusthamapi nirdiśet ||91|| dvandvajaṃ dvandvajaireva doṣaiścāpi vadet kṛtam |92|
gambhīrastu jvaro jñeyo hyantardāhena tṛṣṇayā ||92|| ānaddhatvena cātyarthaṃ śvāsakāsodgamena ca |93|
hataprabhendriyaṃ kṣīṇamarocakanipīḍitam `kṣāmaṃ durātmānamupadrutam' iti pā.||93|| gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet |94|
hīnamadhyādhikairdoṣaistrisaptadvādaśāhikaḥ ||94|| jvaravego bhavettīvro yathāpūrvaṃ sukhakriyaḥ |95|

ab.seg: kālo hyoṣa yamaścaiva niyatirmṛtyureva ca ||95||
tasmin vyapagate dehājjanmeha punarucyate | iti jvarāḥ samākhyātāḥ karmedānīṃ pravakṣyate ||96||
jvarasya pūrvarūpeṣu vartamāneṣu buddhimān | pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ svacchaṃ tataḥ sa labhate sukham ||97||
vidhirmārutajeṣveṣa, paittikeṣu virecanam | mṛdu, pracchardanaṃ tadvatkaphajeṣu vidhīyate ||98||

div.ab: sarvadvidoṣajeṣūktaṃ yathādoṣaṃ vikalpayet |99|

ab.seg: asnehanīyo'śodhyaśca saṃyojyo laṅghanādinā ||99||

div.ab: rūpaprāgrūpayorvidyānnānātvaṃ vahnidhūmavat |100|

ab.seg: pravyaktarūpeṣu hitamekāntenāpatarpaṇam ||100||

div.ab: āmāśayasthe doṣe tu sotkleśe vamanaṃ param |101|
ānaddhaḥ stimitairdoṣairyāvantaṃ kālamāturaḥ ||101|| kuryādanaśanaṃ tāvattataḥ saṃsargamācaret |102|
na laṅghayenmārutaje kṣayaje mānase tathā ||102|| alaṅghyāścāpi ye pūrvaṃ dvivraṇīye prakīrtitāḥ |103|
anavasthitadoṣāgnerlaṅghanaṃ doṣapācanam ||103|| jvaraghnaṃ dīpanaṃ kāṅkṣārucilāghavakārakam |104|
sṛṣṭamārutaviṇmūtraṃ kṣutpipāsā'sahaṃ laghum ||104|| prasannātmendriyaṃ kṣāmaṃ naraṃ vidyāt sulaṅghitam |105|
balakṣayastṛṣā śoṣastandrānidrābhramaklamāḥ ||105|| upadravāśca śvāsādyāḥ sambhavantyatilaṅghanāt |106|
dīpanaṃ kaphavicchedi pittavātānulomanam ||106|| kaphavātajvarārtebhyo hitamuṣṇāmbu tṛṭchidam | taddhi mārdavakṛddoṣasrotasāṃ ... |107|
... śītamanyathā ||107|| sevyamānena toyena jvaraḥ śītena vardhate |108|
pittamadyaviṣottheṣu śītalaṃ tiktakaiḥ śṛtam ||108|| gāṅgeyanāgarośīraparpaṭodīcyacandanaiḥ |109|
dīpanī pācanī laghvī jvarārtānāṃ jvarāpahā ||109|| annakāle hitā peyā yathāsvaṃ pācanaiḥ kṛtā |110|

bahudoṣasya mandāgneḥ saptarātrāt paraṃ jvare ||110|| laṅghanāmbuyavāgūbhiryadā `laṅghanānte yavāgūbhiḥ' iti pā. doṣo na pacyate | tadā taṃ mukhavairasyatṛṣṇārocakanāśanaiḥ ||111|| kaṣāyaiḥ pācanairhṛdyairjvaraghnaiḥ samupācaret |112|
pañcamūlīkaṣāyaṃ tu pācanaṃ pavanajvare ||112|| sakṣaudraṃ paittike mustakaṭukendrayavaiḥ kṛtam | pippalyādikaṣāyaṃ tu kaphaje paripācanam ||113|| dvandvajeṣu tu saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dadyāt ... |114|

ab.seg: ... atha vivarjayet | pītāmburlaṅghito bhukto'jīrṇī kṣīṇaḥ pipāsitaḥ ||114||

(tīkṣṇe jvare gurau dehe vibaddheṣu maleṣu ca| sāmadoṣaṃ vijānīyājjvaraṃ pakvamato'nyathā ayaṃ ślokaḥ keṣucitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate||) mṛdau jvare laghau dehe pracaleṣu maleṣu ca | pakvaṃ doṣaṃ vijānīyājjvare deyaṃ tadauṣadham ||115||

div.ab: doṣaprakṛtivaikṛtyādekeṣāṃ pakvalakṣaṇam |116|

hṛdayodveṣṭanaṃ tandrā lālāsrutirarocakaḥ ||116|| doṣāpravṛttirālasyaṃ vibandho bahumūtratā | gurūdaratvamasvedo na paktiḥ śakṛto'ratiḥ ||117|| svāpaḥ stambho gurutvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ vahnimārdavam | mukhasyāśuddhiraglāniḥ prasaṅgī balavāñjvaraḥ ||118|| liṅgairebhirvijānīyājjvaramāmaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |119|
saptarātrātparaṃ kecinmanyante deyamauṣadham ||119|| daśarātrātparaṃ keciddātavyamiti niścitāḥ |120|
paittike vā jvare deyamalpakālasamutthite ||120|| acirajvaritasyāpi deyaṃ syāddoṣapākataḥ |121|
bheṣajaṃ hyāmadoṣasya bhūyo jvalayati jvaram ||121|| śodhanaṃ, śamanīyaṃ tu karoti viṣamajvaram |122|
cyavamānaṃ jvarotkliṣṭamupekṣeta malaṃ sadā ||122|| atipravartamānaṃ ca sādhayedatisāravat |123|
yadā koṣṭhānugāḥ pakvā vibaddhāḥ srotasāṃ malāḥ ||123|| acirajvaritasyāpi tadā dadyādvirecanam |124|

ab.seg: pakvo hyanirhṛto doṣo dehe tiṣṭhan mahātyayam ||124||
viṣamaṃ vā jvaraṃ kuryādbalavyāpadameva ca | tasmānnirharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ doṣāṇāṃ vamanādibhiḥ ||125||

div.ab: prākkarma vamanaṃ cāsya kāryamāsthāpanaṃ tathā | virecanaṃ tathā kuryācchirasaśca virecanam ||126|| kramaśaḥ... |127|

ab.seg: ...baline deyaṃ vamanaṃ ślaiṣmike jvare | pittaprāye virekastu kāryaḥ praśithilāśaye ||127||
saruje'nilaje kāryaṃ sodāvarte nirūhaṇam | kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahārtasya dīptāgneranuvāsanam ||128||
śirogauravaśūlaghnamindriyapratibodhanam | kaphābhipanne śirasi kāryaṃ mūrdhavirecanam ||129||

div.ab: durbalasya samādhmātamudaraṃ sarujaṃ dihet | dāruhaimavatīkuṣṭhaśatāhvāhiṅgusaindhavaiḥ ||130|| amlapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiśca... |131|

ab.seg: ...pavane tūrdhvamāgate | ruddhamūtrapūrīṣāya gude vartiṃ nidhāpayet ||131||
pippalīpippalīmūlayavānīcavyasādhitām | pāyayeta yavāgūṃ vā mārutādyanulominīm ||132||
śuddhasyobhayato yasya jvaraḥ śāntiṃ na gacchati | saśeṣadoṣarūkṣasya tasya taṃ sarpiṣā jayet ||133||
kṛśaṃ caivālpadoṣaṃ ca śamanīyairupācaret | upavāsairbalasthaṃ tu jvare santarpaṇotthite ||134||

div.ab: klinnāṃ yavāgūṃ mandāgniṃ tṛṣārtaṃ pāyayennaram |135|

tṛṭchardidāhagharmārtaṃ madyapaṃ lājatarpaṇam ||135|| sakṣaudramambhasā paścājjīrṇe yūṣarasaudanam | upavāsaśramakṛte kṣīṇaṃ(ṇe) vātādhike jvare ||136|| dīptāgniṃ bhojayet prājño naraṃ māṃsarasaudanam | mudgayūṣaudanaścāpi hitaḥ kaphasamutthite ||137|| sa eva sitayā yuktaḥ śītaḥ pittajvare hitaḥ |138|

ab.seg: dāḍimāmalamudgānāṃ yūṣaścānilapaittike ||138||
hrasvamūlakayūṣastu `hrasvamūlakayūṣeṇa bhojayet kaphavātike' iti pā. vātaśleṣmādhike hitaḥ | paṭolanimbayūṣastu pathyaḥ pittakaphātmake ||139||
dāhacchardiyutaṃ kṣāmaṃ nirannaṃ tṛṣṇayā'rditam | sitākṣaudrayutaṃ lājatarpaṇaṃ pāyayeta ca ||140||

div.ab: kaphapittaparītasya grīṣme'sṛkpittinastathā | madyanityasya na hitā yavāgūstamupācaret ||141|| yūṣairamlairanamlairvā jāṅgalaiśca rasairhitaiḥ |142|

ab.seg: madyaṃ purāṇaṃ mandāgneryavānnopahitaṃ hitam ||142||

div.ab: savyoṣaṃ vitarettakraṃ kaphārocakapīḍite |143|

ab.seg: kṛśo'lpadoṣo dīnaśca naro jīrṇajvarārditaḥ ||143||
vibaddhaḥ sṛṣṭadoṣaśca rūkṣaḥ pittānilajvarī | pipāsārtaḥ sadāho vā payasā sa sukhī bhavet ||144||

div.ab: tadeva `tadeva tu payaḥ pītaṃ taruṇe hanti mānavam' iti pā. taruṇe pītaṃ viṣavaddhanti mānavam |145|
sarvajvareṣu sulaghu mātrāvadbhojanaṃ hitam ||145|| vegāpāye'nyathā taddhi jvaravegābhivardhanam |146|

jvarito hitamaśnīyādyadyapyasyārucirbhavet ||146|| annakāle hyabhuñjānaḥ kṣīyate mriyate'thavā | sa kṣīṇaḥ kṛcchratāṃ yāti yātyasādhyatvameva ca ||147|| tasmādrakṣedbalaṃ puṃsāṃ bale sati hi jīvitam | gurvabhiṣyandyakāle ca jvarī nādyāt kathañcana ||148|| na tu tasyāhitaṃ bhuktamāyuṣe vā sukhāya vā |149|
santataṃ viṣamaṃ vā'pi kṣīṇasya sucirotthitam ||149|| jvaraṃ sambhojanaiḥ pathyairlaghubhiḥ samupācaret |150|
mudgānmasurāṃścaṇakān kulatthān samakuṣṭhakān ||150|| āhārakāle yūṣārthaṃ jvaritāya pradāpayet |151|

ab.seg: paṭolapatraṃ vārtākaṃ kaṭhillaṃ pāpacailikam ||151||
karkoṭakaṃ parpaṭakaṃ gojihvāṃ bālamūlakam | patraṃ guḍūcyāḥ śākārthe jvaritānāṃ pradāpayet ||152||

div.ab: lāvān kapiñjalāneṇān pṛṣatāñcharabhāñchaśān | kālapucchān kuraṅgāṃśca tathaiva mṛgamātṛkān ||153|| māṃsārthe māṃsasātmyānāṃ jvaritānāṃ ‘hitānīti prakalpayet' iti pā. pradāpayet |154|
sārasakrauñcaśikhinaḥ kukkuṭāṃstittirāṃ(rīṃ)stathā ||154|| gurūṣṇatvānna śaṃsanti jvare keciccikitsakāḥ |155|
jvaritānāṃ prakopaṃ tu yadā yāti samīraṇaḥ ||155|| tadaite'pi hi śasyante mātrākālopapāditāḥ |156|

ab.seg: pariṣekān pradehāṃśca snehān saṃśodhanāni ca ||156||
(snānābhyaṅgadivāsvapnaśītavyāyāmayoṣitaḥ) | kaṣāyagururūkṣāṇi krodhādīni tathaiva ca ||157||
sāravanti ca bhojyāni varjayettaruṇajvarī | tathaiva navadhānyādiṃ varjayecca samāsataḥ ||158||
anavasthitadoṣāgnerebhiḥ sandhukṣito jvaraḥ | gambhīratīkṣṇavegatvaṃ yātyasādhyatvameva ca ||159||
śītatoyadivāsvapnakrodhavyāyāmayoṣitaḥ | na seveta jvarotsṛṣṭo yāvanna balavān bhavet ||160||
muktasyāpi jvareṇāśu durbalasyāhitairjvaraḥ | pratyāpanno daheddehaṃ śuṣkaṃ vṛkṣamivānalaḥ ||161||
tasmātkāryaḥ parīhāro jvaramuktairviriktavat | yāvanna prakṛtisthaḥ syāddoṣataḥ prāṇatastathā ||162||
jvare pramoho bhavati svalpairapyavaceṣṭitaiḥ | niṣaṇṇaṃ bhojayettasmānmūtroccārau ca kārayet ||163||
arocake gātrasāde vaivarṇye'ṅgamalādiṣu | śāntajvaro'pi śodhyaḥ syādanubandhabhayānnaraḥ ||164||
na jātu snāpayet `tarpayet' iti pā. prājñaḥ sahasā jvarakarśitam | tena sandūṣito hyasya punareva bhavejjvaraḥ ||165||
cikitsecca jvarān sarvānnimittānāṃ viparyayaiḥ | śramakṣayābhighātotthe mūlavyādhimupācaret ||166||
strīṇāmapaprajātānāṃ stanyāvataraṇe ca yaḥ | tatra saṃśamanaṃ kuryādyathādoṣaṃ vidhānavit ||167||
ataḥ saṃśamanīyāni kaṣāyāṇi nibodha me | sarvajvareṣu deyāni yāni vaidyena jānatā ||168||
pippalīsārivādrākṣāśatapuṣpāhareṇubhiḥ | kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ saguḍo hanyācchvasanajaṃ jvaram ||169||

div.ab: śṛtaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā guḍūcyāḥ peyameva tu |170|
balādarbhaśvadaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kaṣāyaṃ pādaśeṣitam ||170|| śarkarāghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ pibedvātajvarāpaham |171|

ab.seg: śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhadevadāruhareṇukāḥ ||171||
kustumburūṇi naladaṃ mustaṃ `māṃsī' iti pā. caivāpsu sādhayet | kṣaudreṇa sitayā cāpi yuktaḥ kvātho'nilādhike ||172||
drākṣāguḍūcīkāśmaryatrāyamāṇāḥ sasārivāḥ | niṣkvāthya saguḍaṃ kvāthaṃ pibedvātakṛte jvare ||173||
guḍūcyāḥ svaraso grāhyaḥ śatāvaryāśca tatsamaḥ | nihanyātsaguḍaḥ pītaḥ sadyo'nilakṛtaṃ jvaram ||174||

div.ab: ghṛtābhyaṅgasvedalepānavasthāsu ca yojayet |175|
śrīparṇīcandanośīraparūṣakamadhūkajaḥ ||175|| śarkarāmadhuro hanti kaṣāyaḥ paittikaṃ jvaram |176|

ab.seg: pītaṃ pittajvaraṃ hanyātsārivādyaṃ saśarkaram ||176||

div.ab: sayaṣṭīmadhukaṃ hanyāttathaivotpalapūrvakam |177|

ab.seg: śṛtaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā sotpalaṃ śarkarāyutam ||177||
guḍūcīpadmarodhrāṇāṃ sārivotpalayostathā | śarkarāmadhuraḥ kvāthaḥ śītaḥ pittajvarāpahaḥ ||178||

div.ab: drākṣāragvadhayoścāpi kāśmaryasyāthavā punaḥ | svādutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaiḥ śarkarāyutaiḥ ||179|| suśītaiḥ śamayettṛṣṇāṃ pravṛddhāṃ dāhameva ca |180|
śītaṃ madhuyutaṃ toyamākaṇṭhādvā pipāsitam ||180|| vāmayetpāyayitvā tu tena tṛṣṇā praśāmyati |181|
kṣīraiḥ kṣīrikaṣāyaiśca suśītaiścandanāyutaiḥ ||181|| antardāhe vidhātavyamebhiścānyaiśca śītalaiḥ |182|

padmakaṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ puṇḍarīkamathotpalam ||182|| yavān bhṛṣṭānuśīrāṇi samaṅgāṃ kāśmarīphalam | nidadhyādapsu cāloḍya niśāparyuṣitaṃ tataḥ ||183|| kṣaudreṇa yuktaṃ pibato jvaradāhau praśāmyataḥ |184|

ab.seg: jihvātālugalaklomaśoṣe mūrdhni ca dāpayet ||184||

div.ab: keśaraṃ mātulaṅgasya madhusaindhavasaṃyutam | śarkarādāḍimābhyāṃ vā drākṣākharjūrayostathā ||185|| vairasye dhārayetkalkaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ ca tathā hitam |186|
saptacchadaṃ guḍūcīṃ ca nimbaṃ sphūrjakameva ca ||186|| kvāthayitvā pibet kvāthaṃ sakṣaudraṃ kaphaje jvare |187|
kaṭutrikaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ haridrā kaṭurohiṇī ||187|| kauṭajaṃ ca phalaṃ hanyāt sevyamānaṃ kaphajvaram |188|

ab.seg: haridrāṃ citrakaṃ nimbamuśīrātiviṣe vacām ||188||
kuṣṭhamindrayavān mūrvāṃ paṭolaṃ cāpi sādhitam | pibenmaricasaṃyuktaṃ sakṣaudraṃ kaphaje jvare ||189||
sārivātiviṣākuṣṭhapurākhyaiḥ sadurālabhaiḥ | mustena ca kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ pīto hanyāt kaphajvaram ||190||
mustaṃ vṛkṣakabījāni triphalā kaṭurohiṇī | parūṣakāṇi ca kvāthaḥ kaphajvaravināśanaḥ ||191||
rājavṛkṣādivargasya kaṣāyo madhusaṃyutaḥ | kaphavātajvaraṃ hanyācchīghraṃ kāle'vacāritaḥ ||192||

div.ab: nāgaraṃ dhānyakaṃ bhārgīmabhayāṃ suradāru ca | vacāṃ parpaṭakaṃ mustaṃ bhūtīkamatha kaṭphalam ||193|| niṣkvāthya kaphavātotthe kṣaudrahiṅgusamanvitam | dā(pā)tavyaṃ śvāsakāsaghnaṃ śleṣmotseke galagrahe ||194|| hikkāsu kaṇṭhaśvayathau śūle hṛdayapārśvaje |195|

balāpaṭolatriphalāyaṣṭyāhvānāṃ vṛṣasya ca ||195|| kvātho madhuyutaḥ pīto hanti pittakaphajvaram | kaṭukāvijayādrākṣāmustaparpaṭakaiḥ kṛtaḥ ||196|| kaṣāyo nāśayet pītaḥ śleṣmapittabhavaṃ jvaram | bhārgīvacāparpaṭakadhānyahiṅgvabhayāghanaiḥ ||197|| kāśmaryanāgaraiḥ kvāthaḥ sakṣaudraḥ śleṣmapittaje | saśarkarāmakṣamātrāṃ kaṭukāmuṣṇavāriṇā ||198|| pītvā jvaraṃ jayejjantuḥ kaphapittasamudbhavam |199|

kirātatiktamamṛtāṃ drākṣāmāmalakaṃ śaṭīm ||199|| niṣkvāthya vātapittotthe taṃ kvāthaṃ saguḍaṃ pibet | rāsnā vṛṣo'tha triphalā rājavṛkṣaphalaiḥ saha ||200|| kaṣāyaḥ sādhitaḥ pīto vātapittajvaraṃ jayet |201|

ab.seg: sarvadoṣasamutthe tu saṃsṛṣṭānavacārayet ||201||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchrayaṃ cāpi jvarān sarvānupācaret |202|
vṛścīvabilvavarṣābhvaḥ payaścodakameva ca ||202|| pacet kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tu taddhi sarvajvarāpaham |203|
udakāṃśāstrayaḥ kṣīraṃ śiṃśapāsārasaṃyutam `śiṃśapāsārameva ca' iti pā.||203|| tat kṣīraśeṣaṃ kvathitaṃ peyaṃ sarvajvarāpaham |204|

ab.seg: nalavetasayormūle mūrvāyāṃ devadāruṇi ||204||
kaṣāyaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā peyametajjvarāpaham | haridrā bhadramustaṃ ca triphalā kaṭurohiṇī ||205||
picumandaḥ paṭolī ca devadāru nidigdhikā | eṣāṃ kaṣāyaḥ pītastu sannipātajvaraṃ jayet ||206||
avipaktiṃ prasekaṃ ca śophaṃ kāsamarocakam | traiphalo vā sasarpiṣkaḥ kvāthaḥ peyastridoṣaje ||207||

div.ab: anantāṃ bālakaṃ mustāṃ nāgaraṃ kaṭurohiṇīm sukhāmbunā prāgudayātpāyayetākṣasammitam ||208|| eṣa sarvajvarān hanti dīpayatyāśu cānalam |209|
dravyāṇi dīpanīyāni tathā vairecanāni ca ||209|| ekaśo vā dviśo vā'pi jvaraghnāni prayojayet |210|
sarpirmadhvabhayātailaleho'yaṃ sarvajaṃ jvaram ||210|| śāntiṃ nayettrivṛccāpi sakṣaudrā prabalaṃ jvaram |211|

ab.seg: jvare tu viṣame kāryamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam ||211||

div.ab: ghṛtaṃ plīhodaroktaṃ vā nihanyādviṣamajvaram |212|

ab.seg: guḍapragāḍhāṃ triphalāṃ pibedvā viṣamārditaḥ ||212||

div.ab: guḍūcīnimbadhātrīṇāṃ kaṣāyaṃ vā samākṣikam |213|

ab.seg: prātaḥ prātaḥ sasarpiṣkaṃ rasonamupayojayet ||213||

div.ab: tricaturbhiḥ pibet kvāthaṃ pañcabhirvā samanvitaiḥ `samanvitam' iti pā.| madhukasya paṭolasya rohiṇyā mustakasya ca ||214|| harītakyāśca sarvo'yaṃ trividho yoga iṣyate `ucyate' iti pā.|215|
sarpiḥkṣīrasitākṣaudramāgadhīrvā yathābalam ||215|| daśamūlīkaṣāyeṇa māgadhīrvā prayojayet |216|

ab.seg: pippalīvardhamānaṃ vā pibet kṣīrarasāśanaḥ ||216||

div.ab: tāmracūḍasya māṃsena pibedvā madyamuttamam |217|
kolāgnimanthatriphalākvāthe dadhnā ghṛtaṃ pacet ||217|| tilvakāvāpametaddhi viṣamajvaranāśanam |218|

pippalyativiṣādrākṣāsārivābilvacandanaiḥ ||218|| kaṭukendrayavośīrasiṃhītāmalakīghanaiḥ | trāyamāṇāsthirādhātrīviśvabheṣajacitrakaiḥ ||219|| pakvametairghṛtaṃ pītaṃ vijitya viṣamāgnitām | jīrṇajvaraśiraḥśūlagulmodarahalīmakān ||220|| kṣayakāsaṃ sasantāpaṃ pārśvaśūlānapāsyati |221|
guḍūcītriphalāvāsātrāyamāṇāyavāsakaiḥ ||221|| kvathitairvidhivatpakvametaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ samaiḥ | drākṣāmāgadhikāmbhodanāgarotpalacandanaiḥ ||222|| pītaṃ sarpiḥ kṣayaśvāsakāsajīrṇajvarān jayet |223|

kalaśībṛhatīdrākṣātrāyantīnimbagokṣuraiḥ ||223|| balāparpaṭakāmbhodaśālaparṇīyavāsakaiḥ | pakvamutkvathitaiḥ sarpiḥ kalkairebhiḥ samanvitam ||224|| śaṭītāmalakībhārgīmedāmalakapauṣkaraiḥ | kṣīradviguṇasaṃyuktaṃ jīrṇajvaramapohati ||225|| śiraḥpārśvarujākāsakṣayapraśamanaṃ param |226|

paṭolīparpaṭāriṣṭaguḍūcītriphalāvṛṣaiḥ ||226|| kaṭukāmbudabhūnimbayāsayaṣṭyāhvacandanaiḥ | dārvīśakrayavośīratrāyamāṇākaṇotpalaiḥ ||227|| dhātrībhṛṅgarajobhīrukākamācīrasairghṛtam | siddhamāśvapacīkuṣṭhajvaraśukrārjunavraṇān ||228|| hanyānnayanavadanaśravaṇaghrāṇajān gadān |229|

viḍaṅgatriphalāmustamañjiṣṭhādāḍimotpalaiḥ ||229|| priyaṅgvelailavālūkacandanāmaradārubhiḥ | barhiṣṭhakuṣṭharajanīpārṇinīsārivādvayaiḥ ||230|| hareṇukātrivṛddantīvacātālīśakesaraiḥ | dvikṣīraṃ vipacetsarpirmālatīkusumaiḥ saha ||231|| jīrṇajvaraśvāsakāsagulmonmādagarāpaham | etatkalyāṇakaṃ nāma sarpirmāṅgalyamuttamam ||232|| alakṣmīgraharakṣognimāndyāpasmārapāpanut | śasyate naṣṭaśukrāṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ garbhadaṃ param ||233|| medhyaṃ cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyaṃ retomārgaviśodhanam |234|

etaireva tathā dravyaiḥ sarvagandhaiśca sādhitam ||234|| kapilāyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ suvarṇamaṇisaṃyutam | tatkṣīreṇa sahaikadhyaṃ prasādhya kusumairimaiḥ ||235|| sumanaścampakāśokaśirīṣakusumairvṛtam | tathā naladapadmānāṃ keśarairdāḍimasya ca ||236|| tithau praśaste nakṣatre sādhakasyāturasya ca | kṛtaṃ manuṣyadevāya brāhmaṇairabhimantritam ||237|| dattaṃ sarvajvarān hanti mahākalyāṇakaṃ tvidam ||238|| darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca sarvarogaharaṃ śivam | adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ valīpalitavarjitaḥ ||239|| asyābhyāsādghṛtasyeha jīvedvarṣaśatatrayam |240|

ab.seg: gavyaṃ dadhi ca mūtraṃ ca kṣīraṃ sarpiḥ śakṛdrasaḥ ||240||
samabhāgāni pācyāni kalkāṃścaitān samāvapet | triphalāṃ citrakaṃ mustaṃ haridrātiviṣe vacām ||241||
viḍaṅgaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ suradāru tathaiva ca | pañcagavyamidaṃ pānādviṣamajvaranāśanam ||242||

div.ab: pañcagavyamṛte garbhātpācyamanyad... |243|
... vṛṣeṇa ca | balayā'tha paraṃ pācyaṃ guḍūcyā tadvadeva tu ||243|| jīrṇajvare ca śophe ca pāṇḍuroge ca pūjitam |244|

ab.seg: etenaiva tu kalpena ghṛtaṃ pañcāvikaṃ pacet | pañcājaṃ pañcamahiṣaṃ caturuṣṭramathāpi ca ||244||

div.ab: triphalośīraśampākakaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ | śatāvarīsaptaparṇaguḍūcīrajanīdvayaiḥ ||245|| citrakatrivṛtāmūrvāpaṭolāriṣṭavālakaiḥ | kirātatiktakavacāviśālāpadmakotpalaiḥ ||246|| sārivādvayayaṣṭyāhvacavikāraktacandanaiḥ | durālabhāparpaṭakatrāyamāṇāṭarūṣakaiḥ ||247|| rāsnākuṅkumamañjiṣṭhāmāgadhīnāgaraistathā | dhātrīphalarasaiḥ samyagdviguṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ haviḥ ||248|| parisarpajvaraśvāsagulmakuṣṭhanivāraṇam | pāṇḍuplīhāgnisādibhya etadeva paraṃ hitam ||249|| paṭolakaṭukādārvīnimbavāsāphalatrikam | durālabhāparpaṭakatrāyamāṇāḥ palonmitāḥ ||250|| prasthamāmalakānāṃ ca kvāthayetsalilārmaṇe | tena pādāvaśeṣeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||251|| kalkaiḥ kuṭajabhūnimbaghanayaṣṭyāhvacandanaiḥ | sapippalīkaistatsiddhaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ śuklayorhitam ||252|| ghrāṇakarṇākṣivadanavartmarogavraṇāpaham | raktapittakaphasvedakledapūyopaśoṣaṇam ||253|| kāmalājvaravīsarpagaṇḍamālāharaṃ param |254|

ab.seg: śṛtaṃ payaḥ śarkarā ca pippalyo madhusarpiṣī ||254||
pañcasāramidaṃ peyaṃ mathitaṃ viṣamajvare | kṣatakṣīṇe kṣaye śvāse hṛdroge caitadiṣyate ||255||
lākṣāviśvaniśāmūrvāmañjiṣṭhāsvarjikāmayaiḥ | ṣaḍguṇena ca takreṇa siddhaṃ tailaṃ jvarāntakṛt ||256||
kṣīrivṛkṣāsanāriṣṭajambūsaptacchadārjunaiḥ | śirīṣakhadirāsphoṭāmṛtavallyāṭarūṣakaiḥ ||257||
kaṭukāparpaṭośīravacātejovatīghanaiḥ | sādhitaṃ tailamabhyaṅgādāśu jīrṇajvarāpaham ||258||
nirviṣairbhujagairnāgairvinītaiḥ kṛtataskaraiḥ | trāsayedāgame cainaṃ tadaharbhojayenna ca ||259||
atyabhiṣyandigurubhirvāmayedvā punaḥ punaḥ | madyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ vā jvaranāśanam ||260||
purāṇaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ kāmamudāraṃ vā virecanam | nirūhayedvā matimān susvinnaṃ tadaharnaram ||261||
ajāvyoścarmaromāṇi vacā kuṣṭhaṃ palaṅkaṣā | nimbapatraṃ madhuyutaṃ dhūpanaṃ tasya dāpayet ||262||

div.ab: baiḍālaṃ vā śakṛdyojyaṃ vepamānasya dhūpanam |263|

ab.seg: pippalī saindhavaṃ tailaṃ nepālī cekṣaṇāñjanam ||263||
udaroktāni sarpiṃṣi yānyuktāni purā mayā | kalpoktaṃ cājitaṃ sarpiḥ sevyamānaṃ jvaraṃ jayet ||264||

div.ab: bhūtavidyāsamuddiṣṭairbandhāveśanapūjanaiḥ | jayedbhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ... |265|

ab.seg: ... vijñānādyaiśca mānasam ||265||

div.ab: śramakṣayotthe bhuñjīta ghṛtābhyakto rasaudanam |266|

ab.seg: abhiśāpābhicārotthau jvarau homādinā jayet ||266||

div.ab: dānasvastyayanātithyairutpātagrahapīḍitam |267|
abhighātajvare kuryāt kriyāmuṣṇavivarjitām ||267|| kaṣāyamadhurāṃ snigdhāṃ yathādoṣamathāpi vā |268|

ab.seg: oṣadhīgandhaviṣajau viṣapittaprasādhanaiḥ ||268||
jayet kaṣāyaṃ ca hitaṃ sarvagandhakṛtaṃ tathā | nimbadārukaṣāyaṃ vā hitaṃ saumanasaṃ yathā ||269||

div.ab: yavānnavikṛtiḥ sarpirmadyaṃ ca viṣame hitam |270|

ab.seg: sampūjayeddvijān gāśca devamīśānamambikām ||270||
kaphavātotthayoścāpi jvarayoḥ śītapīḍitam | dihyāduṣṇena vargeṇa paraścoṣṇo vidhirhitaḥ ||271||
siñcet koṣṇairāranālaśuktagomūtramastubhiḥ | dihyāt palāśaiḥ piṣṭairvā surasārjakaśigrujaiḥ ||272||
kṣāratailena vā'bhyaṅgaḥ saśuktena vidhīyate | pānamāragvadhādeśca kvathitasya viśeṣataḥ ||273||
avagāhaḥ sukhoṣṇaśca vātaghnakvāthayojitaḥ | jitvā śītaṃ kramairebhiḥ sukhoṣṇajalasecitam ||274||
praveśyaurṇikakārpāsakauśeyāmbarasaṃvṛtam | śāyayet kṣāmadehaṃ ca kālāguruvibhūṣitam ||275||
stanāḍhyā rūpasampannāḥ kuśalā navayauvanāḥ | bhajeyuḥ pramadā gātraiḥ śītadainyāpahāḥ śubhāḥ ||276||
śaracchaśāṅkavadanā nīlotpalavilocanāḥ | sphuritabhrūlatābhaṅgalalāṭataṭakampanāḥ ||277||
pralambabimbapracaladbimbīphalanibhādharāḥ `pralambavilasatkāñcyo bimbīphalanibhādharāḥ' iti pā.| kṛśodaryo'tivistīrṇajaghanodvahanālasāḥ ||278||
kuṅkumāgurudigdhāṅgyo ghanatuṅgapayodharāḥ | sugandhidhūpitaślakṣṇasrastāṃśukavibhūṣaṇāḥ ||279||
gāḍhamāliṅgayeyustaṃ taruṃ vanalatā iva | prahlādaṃ cāsya vijñāya tāḥ strīrapanayet punaḥ ||280||
tāsāmaṅgapariṣvaṅganivāritahimajvaram | bhojayeddhitamannaṃ ca yathā sukhamavāpnuyāt ||281||

div.ab: dāhābhibhūte tu vidhiṃ kuryāddāhavināśanam | madhuphāṇitayuktena nimbapatrāmbhasā'pi vā ||282|| dāhajvarārtaṃ matimān vāmayet kṣiprameva ca | śatadhautaghṛtābhyaktaṃ dihyādvā yavaśatkubhiḥ ||283|| kolāmalakasaṃyuktaiḥ śuktadhānyāmlasaṃyutaiḥ | amlapiṣṭaiḥ suśītaiśca phenilāpallavaistathā ||284|| amlapiṣṭaiḥ suśītairvā palāśatarujairdihet | badarīpallavotthena phenenāriṣṭakasya ca ||285|| lipte'ṅge dāhatṛṇmūrcchāḥ praśāmyanti ca sarvaśaḥ |286|

ab.seg: yavārdhakuḍavaṃ piṣṭvā mañjiṣṭhārdhapalaṃ tathā ||286||
amlaprasthaśatonmiśraṃ tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet | etat prahlādanaṃ tailaṃ jvaradāhavināśanam ||287||
nyagrodhādirgaṇo yastu kākolyādiśca yo gaṇaḥ | utpalādirgaṇo yastu piṣṭairvā taiḥ pralepayet ||288||
tatkaṣāyāmlasaṃsiddhāḥ snehāścābhyañjane hitāḥ | teṣāṃ śītakaṣāye vā dāhārtamavagāhayet ||289||
dāhavege tvatikrānte tasmāduddhṛtya mānavam | pariṣicyāmbubhiḥ śītaiḥ pralimpeccandanādibhiḥ ||290||
glānaṃ vā dīnamanasamāśliṣeyurvarāṅganāḥ | pelavakṣaumasaṃvītāścandanārdrapayodharāḥ ||291||
bibhratyo'bjasrajaścitrā maṇiratnavibhūṣitāḥ | bhajeyustāḥ stanaiḥ śītaiḥ spṛśantyo'mburuhaiḥ sukhaiḥ ||292||
prahlādaṃ cāsya vijñāya tāḥ strīrapanayet punaḥ | hitaṃ ca bhojayedannaṃ tathā''pnoti sukhaṃ mahat ||293||

div.ab: pittajvaroktaṃ śamanaṃ vireko'nyaddhitaṃ `virekastaddhitaṃ' iti pā. ca yat |294|
nirharetpittamevādau doṣeṣu samavāyiṣu ||294|| durnivārataraṃ taddhi jvarārtānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |295|
chardimūrcchāpipāsādīnavirodhājjvarasya ca ||295|| upadravāñjayeccāpi pratyanīkena hetunā |296|

ab.seg: viśeṣamaparaṃ cātra śṛṇūpadravanāśanam ||296||
madhukaṃ rajanī mustaṃ dāḍimaṃ sāmlavetasam | añjanaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca naladaṃ patramutpalam ||297||
tvacaṃ vyāghranakhaṃ caiva mātuluṅgaraso madhu | dihyādebhirjvarārtasya madhuśuktayutaiḥ śiraḥ ||298||
śirobhitāpasammohavamihikkāpravepathūn | pradeho nāśayatyeṣa jvaritānāmupadravān ||299||
madhūkamatha hrīberamutpalāni madhūlikām ||300||
līḍhvā cūrṇāni madhunā sarpiṣā ca jayedvamim | kaphaprasekāsṛkpittahikkāśvāsāṃśca dāruṇān ||301||
lihan jvarārtastriphalāṃ pippalīṃ ca samākṣikām | kāse śvāse ca madhunā sarpiṣā ca sukhī bhavet ||302||
vidārī dāḍimaṃ lodhraṃ dadhitthaṃ bījapūrakam | ebhiḥ pradihyānmūrdhānaṃ tṛḍdāhārtasya dehinaḥ ||303||

div.ab: dāḍimasya sitāyāśca drākṣāmalakayostathā | vairasye dhārayet kalkaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ ca yathāhitam ||304|| kṣīrekṣurasamākṣīkasarpistailoṣṇavāribhiḥ |305|

ab.seg: śūnye mūrdhni hitaṃ nasyaṃ jīvanīyaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam ||305||

div.ab: cūrṇitaistriphalāśyāmātrivṛtpippalisaṃyutaiḥ | sakṣaudraḥ śarkarāyukto virekastu praśasyate ||306|| pakve pittajvare rakte cordhvage vepathau tathā |307|

ab.seg: kaphavātotthayorevaṃ snehābhyaṅgairviśodhayet ||307||

div.ab: hṛtadoṣo bhramārtastu lihyāt kṣaudrasitābhayāḥ |308|
vātaghnamadhurairyojyā nirūhā vātaje jvare ||308|| avekṣya `vibhajya' iti pā. doṣaṃ prāṇaṃ ca yathāsvaṃ cānuvāsanāḥ |309|

utpalādikaṣāyādyā(ḍhyā)ścandanośīrasaṃyutāḥ ||309|| śarkarāmadhurāḥ śītāḥ pittajvaraharā matāḥ | āmrādīnāṃ tvacaṃ śaṅkhaṃ candanaṃ madhukotpale ||310|| gairikāñjanamañjiṣṭhāmṛṇālānyatha padmakam | ślakṣṇapiṣṭaṃ tu payasā śarkarāmadhusaṃyutam ||311|| supūtaṃ śītalaṃ bastiṃ dahyamānāya dāpayet |312|

ab.seg: jvaradāhāpahaṃ teṣu siddhaṃ caivānuvāsanam ||312||
āragvadhagaṇakvāthāḥ pippalyādisamāyutāḥ | sakṣaudramūtrā deyāḥ syuḥ kaphajvaravināśanāḥ ||313||

div.ab: kaphaghnaireva saṃsiddhā dravyaiścāpyanuvāsanāḥ |314|

ab.seg: saṃsarge sannipāte ca saṃsṛṣṭā bastayo hitāḥ ||314||

div.ab: saṃsṛṣṭaireva saṃsṛṣṭā dravyaiścāpyanuvāsanāḥ |315|
vātarogāpahāḥ sarve snehā ye samyagīritāḥ ||315|| vinā tailaṃ ta eva syuryojyā mārutaje jvare |316|

ab.seg: nikhilenopayojyāśca ta evābhyañjanādiṣu ||316||

div.ab: paittike madhuraistiktaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiśca pūjyate |317|

ab.seg: ślaiṣmike kaṭutiktaiśca, saṃsṛṣṭānītareṣu ca ||317||

div.ab: hṛtāvaśeṣaṃ pittaṃ tu tvaksthaṃ janayati jvaram | pibedikṣurasaṃ tatra śītaṃ vā śarkarodakam ||318|| śāliṣaṣṭikayorannamaśnīyāt kṣīrasamplutam |319|

ab.seg: kaphavātotthayoreva svedābhyaṅgau prayojayet ||319||
ghṛtaṃ dvādaśarātrāttu deyaṃ sarvajvareṣu ca | tenāntareṇāśayaṃ svaṃ gatā doṣā bhavanti hi ||320||
dhātūn prakṣobhayan doṣo mokṣakāle balīyate | tena vyākulacittastu mriyamāṇa ivehate ||321||
laghutvaṃ śirasaḥ svedo mukhamāpāṇḍu pāki ca | kṣavathuścānnakāṅkṣā ca jvaramuktasya lakṣaṇam ||322||
śambhukrodhodbhavo ghoro balavarṇāgnisādakaḥ | rogarāṭ roghasaṅghāto jvara ityupadiśyate ||323||
vyāpitvāt sarvasaṃsparśāt kṛcchratvādantasambhavāt | antako hyeṣa bhūtānāṃ jvara ityupadiśyate ||324||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre jvarapratiṣedho nāma(prathamo'dhyāyaḥ, ādita) ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39||

div.head: atisārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'tīsārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
gurvatisnigdharūkṣoṣṇadravasthūlātiśītalaiḥ | viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇairasātmyaiścāpi bhojanaiḥ ||3||
snehādyairatiyuktaiśca mithyāyuktairviṣādbhayāt | śokādduṣṭāmbumadyātipānāt sātmyartuparyayāt ||4||
jalātiramaṇairvegavighātaiḥ kṛmidoṣataḥ | nṛṇāṃ bhavatyatīsāro lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyate ||5||
saṃśamyāpāndhāturantaḥ kṛśānuṃ varcomiśro mārutena praṇunnaḥ | vṛddho'tīvādhaḥ saratyeṣa yasmādvyādhiṃ ghoraṃ taṃ tvatīsāramāhuḥ ||6||

div.ab: ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaścāpi doṣaiḥ śokenānyaḥ ṣaṣṭha āmena coktaḥ | kecit prāhurnaikarūpaprakāraṃ naivetyevaṃ kāśirājastvavocat ||7|| doṣāvasthāstasya naikaprakārāḥ kāle kāle vyādhitasyodbhavanti |8|
hṛnnābhipāyūdarakukṣitodagātrāvasādānilasannirodhāḥ ||8|| viṭsaṅga ādhmānamathāvipāko bhaviṣyatastasya puraḥsarāṇi |9|
śūlāviṣṭaḥ saktamūtro'ntrakūjī srastāpānaḥ sannakaṭyūrujaṅghaḥ ||9|| varco muñcatyalpamalpaṃ saphenaṃ rūkṣaṃ śyāvaṃ sānilaṃ mārutena |10|
durgandhyuṣṇaṃ vegavanmāṃsatoyaprakhyaṃ bhinnaṃ svinnadeho'titīkṣṇam ||10|| pittāt pītaṃ nīlamālohitaṃ vā tṛṣṇāmūrcchādāhapākajvarārtaḥ |11|
tandrānidrāgauravotkleśasādī vegāśaṅkī sṛṣṭaviṭko'pi bhūyaḥ ||11|| śuklaṃ sāndraṃ śleṣmaṇā śleṣmayuktaṃ bhaktadveṣī niḥsvanaṃ hṛṣṭaromā |12|
tandrāyukto mohasādāsyaśoṣī varcaḥ kuryānnaikavarṇaṃ tṛṣārtaḥ ||12|| sarvodbhūte sarvaliṅgopapattiḥ kṛcchraścāyaṃ bālavṛddheṣvasādhyaḥ |13|

taistairbhāvaiḥ śocato'lpāśanasya bāṣpāvegaḥ paktimāvidhya(śya)jantoḥ ||13|| koṣṭhaṃ gatvā kṣobhayatyasya raktaṃ taccādhastāt kākaṇantīprakāśam | varcomiśraṃ niḥpurīṣaṃ sagandhaṃ nirgandhaṃ vā sāryate tena kṛcchrāt ||14|| śokotpanno duścikitsyo'timātraṃ rogo vaidyaiḥ kaṣṭa eṣa pradiṣṭaḥ |15|

ab.seg: āmājīrṇopadrutāḥ kṣobhayantaḥ koṣṭhaṃ doṣāḥ sampraduṣṭāḥ sabhaktam ||15||
nānāvarṇaṃ naikaśaḥ sārayanti kṛcchrājjantoḥ ṣaṣṭhamenaṃ vadanti ||16||
saṃsṛṣṭamebhirdoṣaistu nyastamapsvavasīdati | purīṣaṃ bhṛśadurgandhi vicchinnaṃ cāmasañjñakam `cāmasaṃskṛtam' iti pā.||17||
etānyeva tu liṅgāni viparītāni yasya tu | lāghavaṃ ca manuṣyasya tasya pakvaṃ vinirdiśet ||18||
sarpirmedovesavārāmbutailamajjākṣīrakṣaudrarūpaṃ sravedyat | mañjiṣṭhābhaṃ mastuluṅgopamaṃ vā visraṃ śītaṃ pretagandhyañjanābham ||19||
rājīmadvā candrakaiḥ santataṃ vā pūyaprakhyaṃ kardamābhaṃ tathoṣṇam | hanyādetadyat pratīpaṃ bhavecca kṣīṇaṃ hanyuścopasargāḥ prabhūtāḥ ||20||
asaṃvṛtagudaṃ kṣīṇaṃ durādhmātamupadrutam | gude pakve gatoṣmāṇamatīsārakiṇaṃ tyajet ||21||
śarīriṇāmatīsāraḥ sambhūto yena kenacit | doṣāṇāmeva liṅgāni kadācinnātivartate ||22||
snehājīrṇanimittastu bahuśūlapravāhikaḥ | visūcikānimittastu cānyo'jīrṇanimittajaḥ | viṣārśaḥkṛmisambhūto yathāsvaṃ doṣalakṣaṇaḥ ||23||
āmapakvakramaṃ hitvā nātisāre kriyā yataḥ | ataḥ sarve'tisārāstu jñeyāḥ pakvāmalakṣaṇaiḥ ||24||
tatrādau 'ādau tu laṅganaṃ kāryaṃ' iti pā. laṅghanaṃ kāryamatisāreṣu dehinām | tataḥ pācanasaṃyukto yavāgvādikramo hitaḥ ||25||
athavā vāmayitvā''me śūlādhmānanipīḍitam | pippalīsaindhavāmbhobhirlaṅghanādyairupācaret ||26||
kāryaṃ vamanasyānte pradravaṃ laghubhojanam | khaḍayūṣayavāgūṣu pippalyādyaṃ ca yojayet ||27||
anena vidhinā cāmaṃ yasya vai nopaśāmyati | haridrādiṃ vacādiṃ vā pibet prātaḥ sa mānavaḥ ||28||
āmātīsāriṇāṃ kāryaṃ nādau saṅgrahaṇaṃ nṛṇām | teṣāṃ doṣā vibaddhāḥ prāgjanayantyāmayānimān ||29||
plīhapāṇḍvāmayānāhamehakuṣṭhodarajvarān | śophagulmagrahaṇyarśaḥśūlālasakahṛdgrahān ||30||
saśūlaṃ bahuśaḥ kṛcchrādvibaddhaṃ yo'tisāryate | doṣān sannicitān tasya pathyābhiḥ sampravartayet ||31||
yo'tidravaṃ prabhūtaṃ ca pūrīṣamatisāryate | tasyādau vamanaṃ kuryāt paścāllaṅghanapācanam ||32||
stokaṃ stokaṃ vibaddhaṃ vā saśūlaṃ yo'tisāryate | abhayāpippalīkalkaiḥ sukhoṣṇaistaṃ virecayet ||33||

div.ab: āme ca laṅghanaṃ śastamādau pācanameva vā |34|

ab.seg: yogāścātra pravakṣyante tvāmātīsāranāśanāḥ ||34||
kaliṅgātiviṣāhiṅgusauvarcalavacābhayāḥ | devadāruvacāmustānāgarātiviṣābhayāḥ ||35||
abhayā dhānyakaṃ mustaṃ pippalī nāgaraṃ vacā | nāgaraṃ dhānyakaṃ mustaṃ vālakaṃ bilvameva ca ||36||
mustaṃ parpaṭakaṃ śuṇṭhī vacā prativiṣā'bhayā | abhayā'tiviṣā hiṅgu vacā sauvarcalaṃ tathā ||37||
citrakaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ vacā kaṭukarohiṇī | pāṭhā vatsakabījāni harītakyo mahauṣadham ||38||
mūrvā nirdahanī pāṭhā tryūṣaṇaṃ gajapippalī | siddhārthakā bhadradāru śatāhvā kaṭurohiṇī ||39||
elā sāvarakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridre kauṭajā yavāḥ | meṣaśṛṅgī tvagele ca kṛmighnaṃ vṛkṣakāṇi ca ||40||
vṛkṣādanī vīratarurbṛhatyau dve sahe tathā | aralutvak taindukī ca dāḍimī kauṭajī śamī ||41||
pāṭhā tejovatī mustaṃ pippalī kauṭajaṃ phalam | paṭolaṃ(lī) dīpyako bilvaṃ haridre devadāru ca ||42||
viḍaṅgamabhayā pāṭhā śṛṅgaveraṃ ghanaṃ vacā | vacā vatsakabījāni saindhavaṃ kaṭurohiṇī ||43||
hiṅgurvatsakabījāni vacā bilvaśalāṭu ca | nāgarātiviṣe mustaṃ pippalyo vātsakaṃ phalam ||44||
mahauṣadhaṃ prativiṣā mustaṃ cetyāmapācanāḥ | prayojyā viṃśatiryogāḥ ślokārdhavihitāstvime ||45||
dhānyāmloṣṇāmbumadyānāṃ pibedanyatamena vā | niṣkvāthān vā pibedeṣāṃ sukhoṣṇān sādhu sādhitān ||46||
payasyutkvāthya mustānāṃ viṃśatiṃ triguṇāmbhasi | kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tatpītaṃ hantyāmaṃ śūlameva ca ||47||
nikhilenopadiṣṭo'yaṃ vidhirāmopaśāntaye | harītakīmativiṣāṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ vacām ||48||
pibet sukhāmbunā janturāmātīsārapīḍitaḥ | paṭolaṃ dīpyakaṃ bilvaṃ vacāpippalināgaram ||49||
mustaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca pibedvā'pi sukhāmbunā | śṛṅgaveraṃ guḍūcīṃ ca pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā ||50||
lavaṇānyatha pippalyo viḍaṅgāni harītakī | citrakaṃ śiṃśapā pāṭhā śārṅgeṣṭā lavaṇāni ca ||51||
hiṅgurvṛkṣakabījāni lavaṇāni ca bhāgaśaḥ | hastidantyatha pippalyaḥ kalkāvakṣasamau smṛtau ||52||
vacā guḍūcīkāṇḍāni yogo'yaṃ paramo mataḥ | ete sukhāmbunā yogā deyāḥ pañca satāṃ matāḥ ||53||
nivṛtteṣvāmaśūleṣu yasya na praguṇo'nilaḥ | stokaṃ stokaṃ rujāmacca saśūlaṃ yo'tisāryate ||54||
sakṣāralavaṇairyuktaṃ mandāgniḥ sa pibedghṛtam | kṣīranāgaracāṅgerīkoladadhyamlasādhitam ||55||
sarpiracchaṃ pibedvāpi śūlātīsāraśāntaye | dadhnā tailaghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ savyoṣājāticitrakaiḥ ||56||
sabilvapippalīmūladāḍimairvā ruganvitaiḥ | nikhilo vidhirukto'yaṃ vātaśleṣmopaśāntaye ||57||
tīkṣṇoṣṇavarjyamenaṃ tu vidadhyātpittaje bhiṣak | yathoktamupavāsānte yavāgūśca praśasyate ||58||
balayoraṃśumatyāṃ ca śvadaṃṣṭrabṛhatīṣu ca | śatāvaryāṃ ca saṃsiddhāḥ suśītā madhusaṃyutāḥ ||59||

div.ab: mudgādiṣu ca yūṣāḥ syurdravyairetaiḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ |60|

ab.seg: mṛdubhirdīpanaistiktairdravyaiḥ syādāmapācanam ||60||
haridrātiviṣāpāṭhāvatsabījarasāñjanam | rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve bījāni kuṭajasya ca ||61||
pāṭhā guḍūcī bhūnimbastathaiva kaṭurohiṇī | etaiḥ ślokārdhanirdiṣṭaiḥ kvāthāḥ syuḥ pittapācanāḥ ||62||

div.ab: mustaṃ kuṭajabījāni bhūnimbaṃ sarasāñjanam | dārvī durālabhā bilvaṃ vālakaṃ raktacandanam ||63|| candanaṃ vālakaṃ mustaṃ bhūnimbaṃ sadurālabham | mṛṇālaṃ candanaṃ rodhraṃ nāgaraṃ nīlamutpalam ||64|| pāṭhā mustaṃ haridre dve pippalī kauṭajaṃ phalam | phalatvacaṃ vatsakasya śṛṅgaveraṃ ghanaṃ `vacā biḍam' iti pā. vacā ||65|| ṣaḍete'bhihitā yogāḥ pittātīsāranāśanāḥ |66|

ab.seg: bilvaśakrayavāmbhodabālakātiviṣākṛtaḥ | kaṣāyo hantyatīsāraṃ sāmaṃ pittasamudbhavam ||66||
madhukotpalabilvābdahrīberośīranāgaraiḥ | kṛtaḥ kvātho madhuyutaḥ pittātīsāranāśanaḥ ||67||
yadā pakvo'pyatīsāraḥ saratyeva muhurmuhuḥ | grahaṇyā mārdavājjantostatra saṃstambhanaṃ hitam ||68||
samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ mañjiṣṭhā lodhramustakam | śālmalīveṣṭako rodhraṃ vṛkṣadāḍimayostvacau ||69||
āmrāsthimadhyaṃ lodhraṃ ca bilvamadhyaṃ priyaṅgavaḥ | madhukaṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ ca dīrghavṛntatvageva ca ||70||
catvāra ete yogāḥ syuḥ pakvātīsāranāśanāḥ | uktā ya upayojyāste sakṣaudrāstaṇḍulāmbunā ||71||
maustaṃ kaṣāyamekaṃ vā peyaṃ madhusamāyutam | lodhrāmbaṣṭhāpriyaṅgvādīn gaṇānevaṃ prayojayet ||72||
padmāṃ samaṅgāṃ madhukaṃ bilvajambūśalāṭu ca | pibettaṇḍulatoyena sakṣaudramagadaṅkaram ||73||

div.ab: kacchurāmūlakalkaṃ vā'pyudumbaraphalopamam | payasyā candanaṃ padmā sitāmustābjakeśaram ||74|| pakvātisāraṃ yogo'yaṃ jayetpītaḥ saśoṇitam |75|
nirāmarūpaṃ śūlārtaṃ laṅghanādyaiśca karṣitam ||75|| naraṃ rūkṣamavekṣyāgniṃ sakṣāraṃ pāyayedghṛtam |76|
balābṛhatyaṃśumatīkacchurāmūlasādhitam ||76|| madhūkṣitaṃ samadhukaṃ pibecchūlairabhidrutaḥ |77|
dārvībilvakaṇādrākṣākaṭukendrayavairghṛtam ||77|| sādhitaṃ hantyatīsāraṃ vātapittakaphātmakam | dadhnā cāmlena sampakvaṃ savyoṣājājicitrakam ||78|| sacavyapippalīmūlaṃ dāḍimairvā rugarditaḥ |79|
payo ghṛtaṃ ca madhu ca pibecchūlairabhidrutaḥ ||79|| sitājamodakaṭvaṅgamadhukairavacūrṇitam |80|
avedanaṃ susampakvaṃ dīptāgneḥ sucirotthitam ||80|| nānāvarṇamatīsāraṃ puṭapākairupācaret |81|

tvakpiṇḍaṃ dīrghavṛntasya padmakesarasaṃyutam ||81|| kāśmarīpadmapatraiścāveṣṭya sūtreṇa sandṛḍham | mṛdā'valiptaṃ sukṛtamaṅgāreṣvavakūlayet ||82|| svinnamuddhṛtya niṣpīḍya rasamādāya taṃ tataḥ | śītaṃ madhuyutaṃ kṛtvā pāyayetodarāmaye ||83|| jīvantīmeṣaśṛṅgyādiṣvevaṃ dravyeṣu sādhayet |84|
tittiriṃ luñcitaṃ samyak niṣkṛṣṭāntraṃ tu pūrayet ||84|| nyagrodhāditvacāṃ kalkaiḥ pūrvavaccāvakūlayet | rasamādāya tasyātha susvinnasya samākṣikam ||85|| śarkaropahitaṃ śītaṃ pāyayetodarāmaye |86|
lodhracandanayaṣṭyāhvadārvīpāṭhāsitotpalān ||86|| taṇḍulodakasampiṣṭān dīrghavṛntatvaganvitān | pūrvavat kūlitāttasmādrasamādāya śītalam ||87|| madhvāktaṃ pāyayeccaitat kaphapittodarāmaye |88|
evaṃ prarohaiḥ kurvīta vaṭādīnāṃ vidhānavat ||88|| puṭapākān yathāyogaṃ jāṅgalopahitān śubhān |89|

ab.seg: bahuśleṣma saraktaṃ ca mandavātaṃ cirotthitam ||89||
kauṭajaṃ phāṇitaṃ vā'pi hantyatīsāramojasā | ambaṣṭhādimadhuyutaṃ pippalyādisamanvitam ||90||
pṛśniparṇībalābilvavālakotpaladhānyakaiḥ | sanāgaraiḥ pibet peyāṃ sādhitāmudarāmayī ||91||

div.ab: aralutvak priyaṅguṃ ca madhukaṃ dāḍimāṅkurān | āvāpya piṣṭvā dadhani yavāgūṃ sādhayeddravām ||92|| eṣā sarvānatīsārān hanti pakvānasaṃśayam |93|

ab.seg: rasāñjanaṃ sātiviṣaṃ tvagbījaṃ kauṭajaṃ tathā ||93||
dhātakī nāgaraṃ caiva pāyayettaṇḍulāmbunā | saśūlaṃ raktajaṃ ghnanti ete madhusamāyutāḥ ||94||

div.ab: madhukaṃ bilvapeśī ca śarkarāmadhusaṃyutā | atīsāraṃ nihanyuśca śāliṣaṣṭikayoḥ kaṇāḥ ||95|| tadvallīḍhaṃ madhuyutaṃ badarīmūlameva tu |96|
badaryarjunajambvāmraśallakīvetasatvacaḥ ||96|| śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktāḥ pītā ghnantyudarāmayam |97|
etaireva yavāgūṃśca ṣaḍān yūṣāṃśca kārayet ||97|| pānīyāni ca tṛṣṇāsu dravyeṣveteṣu buddhimān |98|
kṛtaṃ śālmalivṛnteṣu kaṣāyaṃ himasañjñitam ||98|| niśāparyuṣitaṃ peyaṃ sakṣaudraṃ madhukānvitam |99|

ab.seg: vibaddhavātaviṭ śūlaparītaḥ sapravāhikaḥ ||99||
saraktapittaśca payaḥ pibettṛṣṇāsamanvitaḥ | yathā'mṛtaṃ tathā kṣīramatīsāreṣu pūjitam ||100||
cirotthiteṣu tat peyamapāṃ bhāgaistribhiḥ śṛtam | doṣaśeṣaṃ harettaddhi tasmātpathyatamaṃ smṛtam ||101||
hitaḥ snehavireko vā bastayaḥ picchilāśca ye | picchilasvarase siddhaṃ hitaṃ ca ghṛtamucyate ||102||

div.ab: śakṛtā yastu saṃsṛṣṭamatisāryeta śoṇitam | prāk paścādvā purīṣasya saruk saparikartikaḥ ||103|| kṣīriśuṅgāśṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pibet sakṣaudraśarkaram |104|

ab.seg: dārvītvakpippalīśuṇṭhīlākṣāśakrayavairghṛtam ||104||
saṃyuktaṃ bhadrarohiṇyā pakvaṃ peyādimiśritam | tridoṣamapyatīsāraṃ pītaṃ hanti sudāruṇam ||105||
gaurave vamanaṃ pathyaṃ yasya syāt prabalaḥ kaphaḥ | jvare dāhe saviḍbandhe mārutādraktapittavat ||106||
sampakve bahudoṣe ca vibandhe mūtraśodhanaiḥ | kāryamāsthāpanaṃ kṣipraṃ tathā `tathaivāpyanuvāsanam' iti pā. caivānuvāsanam ||107||
pravāhaṇe `pravāheṇa' iti pā. gudabhraṃśe mūtrāghāte kaṭigrahe | madhurāmlaiḥ śṛtaṃ tailaṃ sarpirvā'pyanuvāsanam ||108||
gudapākastu pittena yasya syādahitāśinaḥ | tasya pittaharāḥ sekāstatsiddhāścānuvāsanāḥ ||109||
dadhimaṇḍasurābilvasiddhaṃ tailaṃ samārute | bhojane ca hitaṃ kṣīraṃ kacchurāmūlasādhitam ||110||
alpālpaṃ bahuśo raktaṃ sarugya upaveśyate | yadā vāyurvibaddhaśca picchābastistadā hitaḥ ||111||
prāyeṇa gudadaurbalyaṃ dīrghakālātisāriṇām | bhavettasmāddhitaṃ teṣāṃ gude tailāvacāraṇam ||112||
kapitthaśālmalīphañjīvaṭakārpāsadāḍimāḥ | yūthikā kacchurā śeluḥ śaṇaścuccūśca dādhikāḥ ||113||

div.ab: śālaparṇī pṛśniparṇī bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā | balāśvadaṃṣṭrābilvāni pāṭhānāgaradhānyakam ||114|| eṣa āhārasaṃyoge hitaḥ sarvātisāriṇām |115|

ab.seg: tilakalko hitaścātra maudgo mudgarasastathā ||115||

div.ab: pittātisārī yo martyaḥ pittalānyatiṣevate | pittaṃ praduṣṭaṃ tasyāśu raktātīsāramāvahet ||116|| jvaraṃ śūlaṃ tṛṣāṃ dāhaṃ gudapākaṃ ca dāruṇam |117|

yo raktaṃ śakṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā pratisāryate ||117|| sa pallavairvaṭādīnāṃ sasarpiḥ sādhitaṃ payaḥ | pibet saśarkarākṣaudramathavā'pyabhimathya tat ||118|| navanītamatho lihyāttakraṃ cānupibettataḥ |119|
priyālaśālmalīplakṣaśallakītiniśatvacaḥ ||119|| kṣīre vimṛditāḥ pītāḥ sakṣaudrā raktanāśanāḥ |120|
madhukaṃ śarkarāṃ lodhraṃ payasyāmatha sārivām ||120|| pibecchāgena payasā sakṣaudraṃ raktanāśanam |121|
mañjiṣṭhāṃ sārivāṃ lodhraṃ padmakaṃ kumudotpalam ||121|| pibet padmāṃ ca dugdhena chāgenāsṛkpraśāntaye |122|

ab.seg: śarkarotpalalodhrāṇi samaṅgā madhukaṃ tilāḥ ||122||
tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sayaṣṭyāhvāḥ samaṅgā cotpalāni ca | tilā mocaraso lodhraṃ tathaiva madhukotpalam ||123||
kacchurā tilakalkaśca yogāścatvāra eva ca | ājena payasā peyāḥ sarakte madhusaṃyutāḥ ||124||
drave sarakte sravati bālabilvaṃ saphāṇitam | sakṣaudratailaṃ prāgeva lihyādāśu hitaṃ hi tat ||125||
kośakāraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ lājacūrṇaṃ sitā madhu | saśūlaṃ raktapittotthaṃ līḍhaṃ hantyudarāmayam ||126||
bilvamadhyaṃ samadhukaṃ śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutam | taṇḍulāmbuyuto yogaḥ pittaraktotthitaṃ jayet ||127||
yogān sāṅgrāhikāṃścānyān pibetsakṣaudraśarkarān | nyagrodhādiṣu kuryācca puṭapākān yatheritān ||128||

div.ab: gudapāke ca ye uktāste'trāpi vidhayaḥ smṛtāḥ |129|

ab.seg: rujāyāṃ cāpraśāmyantyāṃ picchābastirhito bhavet ||129||
saktaviḍ doṣabahulaṃ dīptāgniryo'tisāryate | viḍaṅgatriphalākṛṣṇākaṣāyaistaṃ virecayet ||130||
athavairaṇḍasiddhena payasā kevalena vā | yavāgūrvitareccāsya vātaghnairdīpanaiḥ kṛtāḥ ||131||
dīptāgnirniṣpurīṣo yaḥ sāryate phenilaṃ śakṛt | sa pibet phāṇitaṃ śuṇṭhīdadhitailapayoghṛtam ||132||

div.ab: svinnāni guḍatailābhyāṃ bhakṣayedbadarāṇi ca |133|

ab.seg: svinnāni piṣṭavadvā'pi samaṃ bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ ||133||

div.ab: dadhnopayujya kulmāṣān śvetāmanupibet surām |134|
śaśamāṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ samaṅgāṃ saghṛtaṃ dadhi ||134|| khādedvipācya seveta mṛdvannaṃ śakṛtaḥ kṣaye |135|
saṃskṛto yamake māṣayavakolarasaḥ śubhaḥ ||135|| bhojanārthaṃ pradātavyo dadhidāḍimasādhitaḥ |136|
viḍaṃ bilvaśalāṭūni nāgaraṃ cāmlapeṣitam ||136|| dadhnaḥ saraśca yamake bhṛṣṭo varcaḥkṣaye hitaḥ |137|

ab.seg: saśūlaṃ kṣīṇavarcā yo dīptāgniratisāryate | sa pibeddīpanairyuktaṃ sarpiḥ saṅgrāhakaiḥ saha ||137||
vāyuḥ pravṛddho nicitaṃ balāsaṃ nudatyadhastādahitāśanasya | pravāhamāṇasya muhurmalāktaṃ pravāhikāṃ tāṃ pravadanti tajjñāḥ ||138||

div.ab: pravāhikā vātakṛtā saśūlā pittāt sadāhā sakaphā kaphācca | saśoṇitā śoṇitasambhavā tu tāḥ sneharūkṣaprabhavā matāstu ||139|| tāsāmatīsāravadādiśecca liṅgaṃ kramaṃ cāmavipakvatāṃ ca |140|
na śāntimāyāti vilaṅghanairyā yogairudīrṇā yadi pācanairvā ||140|| tāṃ kṣīramevāśu śṛtaṃ nihanti tailaṃ tilāḥ picchilabastayaśca |141|

ārdraiḥ kuśaiḥ sampariveṣṭitāni vṛntānyathārdrāṇi hi śālmalīnām ||141|| pakvāni samyak puṭapākayogenāpothya tebhyo rasamādadīta | kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ tailahavirvimiśraṃ kalkena yaṣṭīmadhukasya vā'pi ||142|| bastiṃ vidadhyādbhiṣagapramattaḥ pravāhikāmūtrapurīṣasaṅge |143|
dvipañcamūlīkvathitena śūle pravāhamāṇasya samākṣikeṇa ||143|| kṣīreṇa cāsthāpanamagryamuktaṃ... |144|
...tailena yuñjyādanuvāsanaṃ ca |144|

ab.seg: vātaghnavarge lavaṇeṣu caiva tailaṃ ca siddhaṃ hitamannapāne ||144||

div.ab: lodhraṃ viḍaṃ bilvaśalāṭu caiva lihyācca tailena kaṭutrikāḍhyam |145|

ab.seg: dadhnā sasāreṇa samākṣikeṇa bhuñjīta niścā(ssā)rakapīḍitastu ||145||
sutaptakupyakvathitena vā'pi kṣīreṇa śītena madhuplutena | śūlārdito vyoṣavidārigandhāsiddhena dugdhena hitāya bhojyaḥ ||146||
vātaghnasāṅgrāhikadīpanīyaiḥ kṛtān ṣaḍāṃścāpyupabhojayecca `rasān' iti pā.| khādecca matsyān rasamāpnuyācca vātaghnasiddhaṃ saghṛtaṃ satailam ||147||
eṇāvyajānāṃ tu vaṭapravālaiḥ siddhāni sārdhaṃ piśitāni khādet | medhya(dya)sya siddhaṃ tvatha vā'pi raktaṃ bastasya dadhnā ghṛtatailayuktam ||148||
khādet pradehaiḥ śikhilāvajairvā bhuñjīta yūṣairdadhibhiśca mukhyaiḥ | māṣān susiddhān ghṛtamaṇḍayuktān khādecca dadhnā maricopadaṃśān ||149||

div.ab: mahāruje mūtrakṛcchre bhiṣag bastiṃ pradāpayet | payomadhughṛtonmiśraṃ madhukotpalasādhitam ||150|| sa bastiḥ śamayettasya raktaṃ dāhamatho jvaram |151|
madhurauṣadhasiddhaṃ ca hitaṃ tasyānuvāsanam ||151|| rātrāvahani vā nityaṃ rujārto yo bhavennaraḥ |152|

ab.seg: yathā yathā satailaḥ syādvātaśāntistathā tathā ||152||
praśānte mārute cāpi śāntiṃ yāti pravāhikā | tasmāt pravāhikāroge mārutaṃ śamayedbhiṣak ||153||

div.ab: pāṭhājamodākuṭajotpalaṃ `kuṭajasya bījaiḥ' iti pā. ca śuṇṭhī samā māgadhikāśca piṣṭāḥ | sukhāmbupītāḥ śamayanti rogaṃ... |154|

ab.seg: ... medhyāṇḍasiddhaṃ saghṛtaṃ payo vā ||154||

div.ab: śuṇṭhīṃ ghṛtaṃ sakṣavakaṃ satailaṃ vipācya līḍhvā''mayamāśu hanyāt |155|
gajāśanākumbhikadāḍimānāṃ rasaiḥ kṛtā tailaghṛte sadadhni ||155|| bilvānvitā pathyatamā yavāgū... |156|
...rdhāroṣṇadugdhasya tathā ca pānam |156|

ab.seg: laghūni pathyānyatha dīpanāni snigdhāni bhojyānyudarāmayeṣu ||156||
hitāya nityaṃ vitaredvibhajya yogāṃśca tāṃstān bhiṣagapramattaḥ ||157||
tṛṣṇāpanayanī laghvī dīpanī bastiśodhanī | jvare caivātisāre ca yavāgūḥ sarvadā hitā ||158||

div.ab: rūkṣājjāte kriyā snigdhā rūkṣā snehanimittaje | bhayaje sāntvanāpūrvā śokaje śokanāśinī ||159|| viṣārśaḥkṛmisambhūte hitā cobhayaśarmadā |160|

ab.seg: chardimūrcchātṛḍādyāṃśca sādhayedavirodhataḥ ||160||
samavāye tu doṣāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pittamupācaret | jvare caivātisāre ca sarvatrānyatra mārutam ||161||
yasyoccāraṃ vinā mūtraṃ samyagvāyuśca gacchati | dīptāgnerlaghukoṣṭhasya sthitastasyodarāmayaḥ ||162||

div.ab: karmajā vyādhayaḥ keciddoṣajāḥ santi cāpare | karmadoṣodbhavāścānye... |163|
... karmajāsteṣvahetukāḥ ||163|| naśyanti tvakriyābhiste kriyābhiḥ karmasaṅkṣaye |164|

ab.seg: śāmyanti doṣasambhūtā doṣasaṅkṣayahetubhiḥ ||164||
teṣāmalpanidānā ye pratikaṣṭā bhavanti ca | mṛdavo bahudoṣā vā karmadoṣodbhavāstu te ||165||

div.ab: karmadoṣakṣayakṛtā teṣāṃ siddhirvidhīyate |166|

ab.seg: duṣyati grahaṇī jantoragnisādanahetubhiḥ ||166||
atisāre nivṛtte'pi mandāgnerahitāśinaḥ | bhūyaḥ sandūṣito vahnirgrahaṇīmabhidūṣayet ||167||
tasmātkāryaḥ parīhārastvatīsāre viriktavat | yāvanna prakṛtisthaḥ syāddoṣataḥ prāṇatastathā ||168||
ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇī sā prakīrtitā ||169||
grahaṇyā balamagnirhi sa cāpi grahaṇīṃ śritaḥ | tasmāt sandūṣite vahnau grahaṇī sampraduṣyati ||170||
ekaśaḥ sarvaśaścaiva doṣairatyarthamucchritaiḥ | sā duṣṭā bahuśo bhuktamāmameva vimuñcati ||171||
pakvaṃ vā sarujaṃ pūti muhurbaddhaṃ muhurdravam | grahaṇīrogamāhustamāyurvedavido janāḥ ||172||
tasyotpattau vidāho'nne sadanālasyatṛṭklamāḥ | balakṣayo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ karṇakṣveḍo'ntrakūjanam ||173||
atha jāte bhavejjantuḥ śūnapādakaraḥ kṛśaḥ | parvaruglaulyatṛṭchardijvarārocakadāhavān ||174||
udgirecchuktatiktāmlalohadhūmāmagandhikam | prasekamukhavairasyatamakārucipīḍitaḥ ||175||
vātācchūlādhikaiḥ pāyuhṛtpārśvodaramastakaiḥ | pittāt sadāhairgurubhiḥ kaphāttribhyastrilakṣaṇaiḥ ||176||
doṣavarṇairnakhaistadvadviṇmūtranayanānanaiḥ | hṛtpāṇḍūdaragulmārśaḥplīhāśaṅkhī ca mānavaḥ ||177||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchrayaṃ tasya viśuddhasya yathākramam | peyādiṃ vitaret samyagdīpanīyopasambhṛtam ||178|| tataḥ pācanasaṅgrāhidīpanīyagaṇatrayam | pibet prātaḥ surāriṣṭasnehamūtrasukhāmbubhiḥ ||179|| takreṇa vā'tha takraṃ vā kevalaṃ hitamucyate | kṛmigulmodarārśoghnīḥ kriyāścātrāvacārayet ||180|| cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam |181|
kalkena magadhādeśca cāṅgerīsvarasena ca ||181|| caturguṇena dadhnā ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ bhavet |182|

ab.seg: sarvathā dīpanaṃ sarvaṃ grahaṇīrogiṇāṃ hitam ||182||
jvarādīnavirodhācca sādhayet svaiścikitsitaiḥ ||183||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre'tisārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||40||

div.head: śoṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śoṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
anekarogānugato bahurogapurogamaḥ | durvijñeyo durnivāraḥ śoṣo vyādhirmahābalaḥ ||3||
saṃśoṣaṇādrasādīnāṃ śoṣa ityabhidhīyate | kriyākṣayakaratvācca kṣaya ityucyate punaḥ ||4||
rājñaścandramaso yasmādabhūdeṣa kilāmayaḥ | tasmāttaṃ rājayakṣmeti kecidāhuḥ `kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ' iti pā. punarjanāḥ ||5||

div.ab: sa vyastairjāyate doṣairiti kecidvadanti hi |6|

ab.seg: ekādaśānāmekasmin sānnidhyāttantrayuktitaḥ ||6||
kriyāṇāmavibhāgena prāgekotpādanena ca | eka eva mataḥ śoṣaḥ sannipātātmako hyataḥ ||7||

div.ab: udrekāttatra liṅgāni doṣāṇāṃ nipatanti hi |8|
kṣayādvegapratīghātādāghātādviṣamāśanāt ||8|| jāyate kupitairdoṣairvyāptadehasya dehinaḥ |9|

ab.seg: kaphapradhānairdoṣairhi ruddheṣu rasavartmasu ||9||
ativyavāyino vā'pi kṣīṇe retasyanantaram | kṣīyante dhātavaḥ sarve tataḥ śuṣyati mānavaḥ ||10||
bhaktadveṣo jvaraḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ śoṇitadarśanam | svarabhedaśca jāyeta ṣaḍrūpe rājayakṣmaṇi ||11||
svarabhedo'nilāñchūlaṃ saṃlocaścāṃsapārśvayoḥ | jvaro dāho'tisāraśca pittādraktasya cāgamaḥ ||12||
śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvamabhaktacchanda eva ca | kāsaḥ kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃso vijñeyaḥ kaphakopataḥ ||13||
ekādaśabhirebhirvā ṣaḍbhirvā'pi samanvitam | (kāsātīsārapārśvārtisvarabhedārucijvaraiḥ ||14||
tribhirvā pīḍitaṃ liṅgairjvarakāsāsṛgāmayaiḥ) | jahyācchoṣārditaṃ jantumicchan suvipulaṃ yaśaḥ ||15||
vyavāyaśokasthāviryavyāyāmādhvopavāsataḥ | vraṇoraḥkṣatapīḍābhyāṃ śoṣananye vadanti hi ||16||
vyavāyaśoṣī śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairupadrutaḥ | pāṇḍudeho yathāpūrvaṃ kṣīyante cāsya dhātavaḥ ||17||
pradhyānaśīlaḥ srastāṅgaḥ śokaśoṣyapi tādṛśaḥ | vinā śukrakṣayakṛtairvikārairabhilakṣitaḥ ||18||
jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandavīryabuddhibalendriyaḥ | kampano'rucimān `śvasano' iti pā. bhinnakāṃsyapātrahatasvaraḥ(naḥ) ||19||
ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnaṃ gauravārucipīḍitaḥ `tathaivārucipīḍitaḥ' iti `tathaivāratipīḍitaḥ' iti ca pā.| samprasrutāsyanāsākṣaḥ suptarūkṣamalacchaviḥ ||20||
adhvapraśoṣī srastāṅgaḥ sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ | prasuptagātrāvayavaḥ śuṣkaklomagalānanaḥ ||21||
vyāyāmaśoṣī bhūyiṣṭhamebhireva samanvitaḥ | uraḥkṣatakṛtairliṅgaiḥ saṃyuktaśca kṣatādvinā ||22||
raktakṣayādvedanābhistathaivāhārayantraṇāt | vraṇitasya `vraṇitasya bhavecchoṣo doṣaiḥ sādhyatamaḥ sa ca' iti hastalikhitapustake pāṭha upalabhyate bhavecchoṣaḥ sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||23||

div.ab: vyāyāmabhārādhyayanairabhighātātimaithunaiḥ | karmaṇā cāpyurasyena `karmabhiścāpyanaurasyairvakṣo' iti pā. vakṣo yasya vidāritam | tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati ||24|| kāsamānaśchardayecca pītaraktāsitāruṇam | santaptavakṣāḥ so'tyarthaṃ dūyanātparitāmyati ||25|| durgandhavadanocchvāso bhinnavarṇasvaro naraḥ |26|
keṣāñcidevaṃ śoṣo hi kāraṇairbhedamāgataḥ ||26|| na tatra doṣaliṅgānāṃ samastānāṃ nipātanam |27|

ab.seg: kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ dhātusañjñitāḥ ||27||
cikitsitaṃ tu teṣāṃ hi prāguktaṃ dhātusaṅkṣaye ||28||
śvāsāṅgasādakaphasaṃsravatāluśoṣacchardyagnisādamadapīnasapāṇḍunidrāḥ | śoṣe bhaviṣyati bhavanti sa cāpi jantuḥ śuklekṣaṇo bhavati māṃsaparo riraṃsuḥ ||29||
svapneṣu kākaśukaśallakinīlakaṇṭhagṛdhrāstathaiva kapayaḥ kṛkalāsakāśca | taṃ vāhayanti sa nadīrvijalāśca paśyecchuṣkāṃstarūn pavanadhūmadavārditāṃśca ||30||
mahāśanaṃ kṣīyamāṇamatīsāranipīḍitam | śūnamuṣkodaraṃ caiva yakṣmiṇaṃ parivarjayet ||31||

div.ab: upācaredātmavantaṃ dīptāgnimakṛśaṃ navam `naraṃ' iti pā.|32|

ab.seg: sthirādivargasiddhena ghṛtenājāvikena ca ||32||
snigdhasya mṛdu kartavyamūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam | āsthāpanaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śirasaśca virecanam ||33||

div.ab: yavagodhūmaśālīṃśca rasairbhuñjīta śodhitaḥ |34|

ab.seg: dṛḍhe'gnau bṛṃhayeccāpi nivṛttopadravaṃ naram ||34||
vyavāyaśoṣiṇaṃ prāyo bhajante vātajā gadāḥ | bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhistasmai hitaḥ snigdho'nilāpahaḥ ||35||
kākānulūkānnakulān biḍālān gaṇḍūpadān vyālabileśayākhūn | gṛdhrāṃśca dadyādvividhaiḥ pravādaiḥ `prakāraiḥ' iti pā. sasaindhavān sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭān ||36||
deyāni māṃsāni ca jāṅgalāni mudgāḍhakīsūparasāśca `mudgāḍhakīyūṣarasāśca' iti pā. hṛdyāḥ | kharoṣṭranāgāśvatarāśvajāni deyāni māṃsāni sukalpitāni ||37||
māṃsopadaṃśāṃśca pibedariṣṭān mārdvīkayuktān madirāśca sevyāḥ | arkāmṛtākṣārajaloṣitebhyaḥ kṛtvā yavebhyo vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān ||38||
khādet, pibet sarpirajāvikaṃ vā kṛśo yavāgvā saha bhaktakāle | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ trikaṭu pralihyāccavyāviḍaṅgopahitaṃ kṣayārtaḥ ||39||

div.ab: māṃsādamāṃseṣu ghṛtaṃ ca siddhaṃ śoṣāpahaṃ kṣaudrakaṇāsametam |40|
drākṣāsitāmāgadhikāvalehaḥ sakṣaudratailaḥ kṣayarogaghātī ||40|| ghṛtena cājena samākṣikeṇa turaṅgagandhātilamāṣacūrṇam |41|

ab.seg: sitāśvagandhāmagadhodbhavānāṃ cūrṇaṃ `kalkaṃ' iti pā. ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ pralihyāt ||41||

div.ab: kṣīraṃ pibedvā'pyatha vājigandhāvipakvamevaṃ labhate'ṅgapuṣṭim |42|

ab.seg: tadutthitaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ sitāḍhyaṃ prātaḥ pibedvā'pi payonupānam ||42||

div.ab: utsādane cāpi turaṅgagandhā yojyā yavāścaiva punarnave ca |43|
kṛtsne vṛṣe tatkusumaiśca siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibetkṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||43|| yakṣmāṇametat prabalaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ ca hanyādapi pāṇḍutāṃ ca |44|

śakṛdrasā gośvagajāvyajānāṃ kvāthā mitāścāpi tathaiva bhāgaiḥ ||44|| mūrvāharidrākhadiradrumāṇāṃ kṣīrasya bhāgastvaparo ghṛtasya | bhāgān daśaitān vipacedvidhijño dattvā trivargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam ||45|| kaṭutrikaṃ caiva sabhadradāru ghṛtottamaṃ yakṣmanivāraṇāya |46|

ab.seg: dve pañcamūlyau varuṇaṃ karañjaṃ bhallātakaṃ bilvapunarnave ca ||46||
yavān kulatthān badarāṇi bhārgīṃ pāṭhāṃ hutāśaṃ samahīkadambam | kṛtvā kaṣāyaṃ vipaceddhi tasya ṣaḍbhirhi pātrairghṛtapātramekam ||47||
vyoṣaṃ mahāvṛkṣapayo'bhayāṃ ca cavyaṃ surākhyaṃ lavaṇottamaṃ ca | etaddhi śoṣaṃ jaṭharāṇi caiva hanyāt pramehāṃśca sahānilena ||48||
gośvāvyajebhaiṇakharoṣṭrajātaiḥ śakṛdrasakṣīrarasakṣatotthaiḥ | drākṣāśvagandhāmagadhāsitābhiḥ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yakṣmavikārahāri ||49||
elājamodāmalakābhayākṣagāyatryariṣṭāsanaśālasārān | viḍaṅgabhallātakacitrakogrākaṭutrikāmbhodasurāṣṭrajāṃśca ||50||
paktvā jale tena paceddhi sarpistasmin susiddhe tvavatārite ca | triṃśatpalānyatra sitopalāyā dattvā tugākṣīripalāni ṣaṭ ca ||51||
prasthe ghṛtasya dviguṇaṃ ca dadyāt kṣaudraṃ tato manthahataṃ vidadhyāt | palaṃ palaṃ prātarataḥ pralihya paścāt pibet kṣīramatandritaśca ||52||
etaddhi medhyaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ cakṣuṣyamāyuṣyamatho yaśasyam | yakṣmāṇamāśu vyapahanti caitat pāṇḍvāmayaṃ caiva bhagandaraṃ ca ||53||
śvāsaṃ ca hanti svarabhedakāsahṛtplīhagulmagrahaṇīgadāṃśca | na cātra kiñcit parivarjanīyaṃ rasāyanaṃ caitadupāsyamānam ||54||

div.ab: plīhodaroktaṃ vihitaṃ ca sarpistrīṇyeva cānyāni hitāni cātra |55|

ab.seg: upadravāṃśca svaravaikṛtādīn jayedyathāsvaṃ prasamīkṣya śāstram ||55||
ajāśakṛnmūtrapayoghṛtāsṛṅmāṃsālayāni pratisevamānaḥ | snānādinānāvidhinā jahāti māsādaśeṣaṃ niyamena śoṣam ||56||
rasonayogaṃ vidhivat kṣayārtaḥ kṣīreṇa vā nāgabalāprayogam | seveta vā māgadhikāvidhānaṃ tathopayogaṃ jatuno'śmajasya ||57||

div.ab: śokaṃ striyaṃ krodhamasūyanaṃ ca tyaje... |58|

ab.seg: ...dudārān viṣayān bhajeta | vaidyān dvijātīṃstridaśān gurūṃśca vācaśca puṇyāḥ śṛṇuyāddvijebhyaḥ ||58||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, ādita) ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41||

div.head: gulmapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto gulmapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
yathoktaiḥ kopanairdoṣāḥ kupitāḥ koṣṭhamāgatāḥ | janayanti nṛṇāṃ gulmaṃ sa pañcavidha ucyate ||3||
hṛdbastyorantare granthiḥ sañcārī yadi vā'calaḥ | cayāpacayavān vṛttaḥ sa gulma iti kīrtitaḥ ||4||

div.ab: pañca gulmāśrayā nṝṇāṃ pārśve hṛnnābhibastayaḥ |5|
gupitānilamūlatvādgūḍhamūlodayādapi `kupitānilamūlatvāt' iti pā.||5|| gulmavadvā viśālatvādgulma ityabhidhīyate |6|
sa yasmādātmani cayaṃ gacchatyapsviva budbudaḥ ||6|| antaḥ sarati yasmācca na pākamupayātyataḥ |7|
sa vyastairjāyate doṣaiḥ samastairapi cocchritaiḥ ||7|| puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ jñeyo raktena cāparaḥ |8|

ab.seg: sadanaṃ madantā vahnerāṭopo'ntravikūjanam ||8||
viṇmūtrānilasaṅgaśca sauhityāsahatā tathā | dveṣo'nne vāyurūrdhvaṃ ca pūrvarūpeṣu gulminām ||9||
hṛtkukṣiśūlaṃ mukhakaṇṭhaśoṣo vāyornirodho viṣamāgnitā ca | te te vikārāḥ pavanātmakāśca bhavanti gulme'nilasambhave tu ||10||
svedajvarāhāravidāhadāhāstṛṣṇā'ṅgarāgaḥ kaṭuvaktratā ca | pittasya liṅgānyakhilāni yāni pittātmake tāni bhavanti gulme ||11||
staimityamanne'ruciraṅgasādaśchardiḥ praseko madhurāsyatā ca | kaphasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni bhavanti gulme kaphasambhave tu ||12||

div.ab: sarvātmakaḥ sarvavikārayuktaḥ so'sādhya uktaḥ, ... |13|

ab.seg: ... kṣatajaṃ pravakṣye | navaprasūtā'hitabhojanā yā yā cāmagarbhaṃ visṛjedṛtau `prasavedathartau' iti pā. vā ||13||
vāyurhi tasyāḥ parigṛhya raktaṃ karoti gulmaṃ sarujaṃ sadāham | paittasya liṅgena samānaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ cāpyaparaṃ nibodha ||14||
na spandate nodarameti vṛddhiṃ bhavanti liṅgāni ca garbhiṇīnām | taṃ garbhakālātigame cikitsyamasṛgbhavaṃ gulmamuśanti tajjñāḥ ||15||
vātagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ yuktaṃ snehavirecanaiḥ | upācaredyathākālaṃ nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ ||16||
pittagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ kākolyādighṛtena tu | viriktaṃ madhurairyogairnirūhaiḥ samupācaret ||17||
śleṣmagulmārditaṃ snigdhaṃ pippalyādighṛtena tu | tīkṣṇairviriktaṃ tadrūpairnirūhaiḥ samupācaret ||18||

div.ab: sannipātotthite gulme tridoṣaghno vidhirhitaḥ |19|

ab.seg: pittavadraktagulminyā nāryāḥ kāryaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ ||19||
viśeṣamaparaṃ cāsyāḥ śṛṇu raktavibhedanam | palāśakṣāratoyena `palāśabhasmatoyena' iti pā. siddhaṃ sarpiḥ prayojayet ||20||
dadyāduttarabastiṃ ca pippalyādighṛtena tu | uṣṇairvā bhedayedbhinne vidhirāsṛgdaro hitaḥ ||21||
ānūpaudakamajjāno vasā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi | vipakvamekataḥ śastaṃ vātagulme'nuvāsanam ||22||

div.ab: jāṅgalaikaśaphānāṃ tu vasā sarpiśca paittike |23|

ab.seg: tailaṃ jāṅgalamajjāna evaṃ gulme kaphotthite ||23||
dhātrīphalānāṃ svarase ṣaḍaṅgaṃ vipacedghṛtam | śarkarāsaindhavopetaṃ taddhitaṃ vātagulmine ||24||
citrakavyoṣasindhūtthapṛthvīkācavyadāḍimaiḥ | dīpyakagranthikājājīhapuṣādhānyakaiḥ samaiḥ ||25||
dadhyāranālabadaramūlakasvarasairghṛtam | tatpibedvātagulmāgnidaurbalyāṭopaśūlanut ||26||
hiṅgusauvarcalājājīviḍadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ | puṣkaravyoṣadhānyāmlavetasakṣāracitrakaiḥ ||27||
śaṭīvacājagandhailāsurasaiśca vipācitam | śūlānāhaharaṃ sarpirdadhnā cānilagulminām ||28||
viḍadāḍimasindhūtthahutabhugvyoṣajīrakaiḥ | hiṅgusauvarcalakṣārarugvṛkṣāmlāmlavetasaiḥ ||29||
bījapūrarasopetaṃ sarpirdadhicaturguṇam | sādhitaṃ dādhikaṃ nāma gulmahṛt plīhaśūlajit ||30||
rasonasvarase sarpiḥ pañcamūlarasānvitam | surāranāladadhyamlamūlakasvarasaiḥ saha ||31||
vyoṣadāḍimavṛkṣāmlayavānīcavyasaindhavaiḥ | hiṅgvamlavetasājājīdīpyakaiśca samāṃśikaiḥ ||32||
siddhaṃ gulmagrahaṇyarśaḥśvāsonmādakṣayajvarān | kāsāpasmāramandāgniplīhaśūlānilāñjayet ||33||
dadhi sauvīrakaṃ sarpiḥ kvāthau mudgakulatthajau | pañcāḍhakāni vipacedāvāpya dvipalānyatha ||34||
sauvarcalaṃ sarjikāṃ ca devadārvatha saindhavam | vātagulmāpahaṃ sarpiretaddīpanameva ca ||35||

div.ab: tṛṇamūlakaṣāye tu jīvanīyaiḥ pacedghṛtam | nyagrodhādigaṇe vā'pi gaṇe vā'pyutpalādike ||36|| raktapittotthitaṃ ghnanti ghṛtānyetānyasaṃśayam |37|

ab.seg: āragvadhādau vipaceddīpanīyayutaṃ ghṛtam ||37||
kṣāravarge paceccānyat pacenmūtragaṇe'param | ghnanti gulmaṃ kaphodbhūtaṃ ghṛtānyetānyasaṃśayam ||38||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchrayaṃ cāpi cikitsetsānnipātikam |39|
cūrṇaṃ hiṅgvādikaṃ vā'pi ghṛtaṃ vā plīhanāśanam ||39|| pibedgulmāpahaṃ kāle sarpistailvakameva vā |40|

ab.seg: tilekṣurakapālāśasārṣapaṃ yāvanālajam ||40||
bhasma mūlakajaṃ cāpi gojāvikharahastinām | mūtreṇa mahiṣīṇāṃ ca pālikaiścāvacūrṇitaiḥ ||41||
kuṣṭhasaindhavayaṣṭyāhvanāgarakṛmighātibhiḥ | sājamodaiśca daśabhiḥ sāmudrācca palairyutam ||42||
ayaḥpātre'gninā'lpena paktvā lehya(ha)mathoddharet | tasya mātrāṃ pibeddadhnā surayā sarpiṣā'pi vā ||43||
dhānyāmlenoṣṇatoyena kaulatthena rasena vā | gulmān vātavikārāṃśca kṣāro'yaṃ hantyasaṃśayam ||44||
svarjikākuṣṭhasahitaḥ kṣāraḥ ketakijo'pi vā | tailena śamayet pīto gulmaṃ pavanasambhavam ||45||

div.ab: pītaṃ sukhāmbunā vā'pi svarjikākuṣṭhasaindhavam |46|

vṛścīva(ra)murubūkaṃ `pṛthvīkāmurubūkaṃ ca' iti pā. ca varṣābhūrbṛhatīdvayam ||46|| citrakaṃ ca jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitam | māgadhīcitrakakṣaudralipte kumbhe nidhāpayet ||47|| madhunaḥ prasthamāvāpya pathyācūrṇārdhasaṃyutam | busoṣitaṃ `tuṣoṣikaṃ iti pā. daśāhaṃ tu jīrṇabhaktaḥ pibennaraḥ ||48|| ariṣṭo'yaṃ jayedgulmamavipākamarocakam |49|

pāṭhānikumbharajanītrikaṭutriphalāgnikam ||49|| lavaṇaṃ vṛkṣabījaṃ ca tulyaṃ syādanavo guḍaḥ | pathyābhirvā yutaṃ `pathyābhiḥ sahitaṃ cūrṇaṃ' iti pā. cūrṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtrayutaṃ pacet ||50|| guṭikāstadghanībhūtaṃ kṛtvā khādedabhuktavān | gulmaplīhāgnisādāṃstā nāśayeyuraśeṣataḥ ||51|| hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīdoṣaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca dāruṇam |52|
saśūle sonnate'spande dāhapākaruganvite ||52|| gulme raktaṃ jalaukobhiḥ sirāmokṣeṇa vā haret |53|
sukhoṣṇā jāṅgalarasāḥ susnigdhā vyaktasaindhavāḥ ||53|| kaṭutrikasamāyuktā hitāḥ pāne tu gulminām |54|
peyā vātaharaiḥ siddhāḥ kaulatthā saṃskṛtā rasāḥ ||54|| khalāḥ sapañcamūlāśca gulmināṃ bhojane hitāḥ |55|

ab.seg: baddhavarconilānāṃ tu sārdrakaṃ kṣīramiṣyate ||55||

div.ab: kumbhīpiṇḍeṣṭakāsvedān kārayet kuśalo bhiṣak |56|
gulminaḥ sarva evoktā durvirecyatamā bhṛśam ||56|| ataścaitāṃstu susvinnān sraṃsanenopapādayet |57|

vimlāpanābhyañjanāni `vilepanābhyañjanāni' iti pā. tathaiva dahanāni ca ||57|| upanāhāśca kartavyāḥ sukhoṣṇāḥ sālvaṇādayaḥ | udaroktāni sarpīṃṣi mūtravartikriyāstathā `cūrṇavartikriyāstathā' iti pā.||58|| lavaṇāni ca yojyāni yānyuktānyanilāmaye |59|
vātavarconirodhe tu sāmudrārdrakasarṣapaiḥ ||59|| kṛtvā pāyau vidhātavyā vartayo maricottarāḥ |60|
dantīcitrakamūleṣu tathā vātahareṣu ca ||60|| kuryādariṣṭān sarvāṃśca ślokasthāne yatheritān |61|

ab.seg: svādedvā'pyaṅkurān bhṛṣṭān pūtīkanṛpavṛkṣayoḥ ||61||

div.ab: ūrdhvavātaṃ manuṣyaṃ ca gulminaṃ na nirūhayet |62|

ab.seg: pibettrivṛnnāgaraṃ vā saguḍāṃ vā harītakīm ||62||
gugguluṃ trivṛtāṃ dantīṃ dravantīṃ saindhavaṃ vacām | mūtramadyapayodrākṣārasairvīkṣya balābalam ||63||

div.ab: evaṃ pīlūni bhṛṣṭāni `piṣṭāni' iti pā. pibet salavaṇāni tu |64|
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakasaindhavaiḥ ||64|| yuktā hanti surā gulmaṃ śīghraṃ kāle prayojitā |65|
baddhaviṇmāruto gulmī bhuñjīta payasā yavān ||65|| kulmāṣān vā bahusnehān bhakṣayellavaṇottarān |66|
athāsyopadravaḥ śūlaḥ `śūlaṃ' iti pā. kathañcidupajāyate ||66|| śūlaṃ `śūlaṃ nikhānitamiva sukhaṃ yena na vettyasau' iti pā. nikhānitamivāsukhaṃ yena tu vettyasau |67|

tatra viṇmūtrasaṃrodhaḥ kṛcchrocchvāsaḥ sthirāṅgatā ||67|| tṛṣṇā dāho bhramo'nnasya vidagdhaparivṛddhitā | romaharṣo'ruciśchardirbhuktavṛddhirjaḍāṅgatā ||68|| vāyvādibhiryathāsaṅkhyaṃ miśrairvā... |69|

...vīkṣya yojayet | pathyātrilavaṇaṃ kṣāraṃ hiṅgutumburupauṣkaram ||69|| yavānīṃ ca haridrāṃ ca viḍaṅgānyamlavetasam | vidārītriphalā'bhīruśṛṅgāṭīguḍaśarkarāḥ ||70|| kāśmarīphalayaṣṭyāhvaparūṣakahimāni ca | ṣaḍgranthātiviṣādārupathyāmaricavṛkṣajān ||71|| kṛṣṇāmūlakacavyaṃ ca nāgarakṣāracitrakān | uṣṇāmlakāñjikakṣīratoyaiḥ ślokasamāpanān ||72|| yathākramaṃ vimiśrāṃśca dvandve sarvāṃśca sarvaje |73|
tathaiva sekāvagāhapradehābhyaṅgabhojanam ||73|| śiśirodakapūrṇānāṃ bhājanānāṃ ca dhāraṇam | vamanonmardanasvedalaṅghanakṣapaṇakriyāḥ ||74|| snehādiśca kramaḥ sarvo viśeṣeṇopadiśyate |75|
vallūraṃ mūlakaṃ matsyān śuṣkaśākāni vaidalam ||75|| na khādedālukaṃ gulmī madhurāṇi phalāni ca |76|
vinā gulmena yacchūlaṃ gulmasthāneṣu jāyate ||76|| nidānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ ca sacikitsitam |77|

ab.seg: vātamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ nigrahādatibhojanāt ||77||
ajīrṇādhyaśanāyāsaviruddhānnopasevanāt | pānīyapānāt kṣutkāle virūḍhānāṃ ca sevanāt ||78||
piṣṭānnaśuṣkamāṃsānāmupayogāttathaiva ca | evaṃvidhānāṃ dravyāṇāmanyeṣāṃ copasevanāt ||79||
vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ koṣṭhe śūlaṃ sañjanayedbhṛśam | nirucchvāsī bhavettena vedanāpīḍito naraḥ ||80||
śaṅkusphoṭanavattasya `śaṅkvāsphoṭanavat' iti pā. yasmāttīvrāśca vedanāḥ | śūlāsaktasya lakṣyante tasmācchūlamihocyate ||81||
nirāhārasya yasyaiva tīvraṃ śūlamudīryate | prastabdhagātro bhavati kṛcchreṇocchvasitīva ca ||82||
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi kṛcchreṇa kurute naraḥ | etairliṅgairvijānīyācchūlaṃ vātasamudbhavam ||83||

div.ab: tṛṣṇā dāho mado mūrcchā tīvraṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca | śītābhikāmo bhavati śītenaiva praśāmyati ||84|| etairliṅgairvijānīyācchūlaṃ pittasamudbhavam |85|

ab.seg: śūlenotpīḍyamānasya hṛllāsa upajāyate ||85||
atīva pūrṇakoṣṭhatvaṃ tathaiva gurugātratā | etacchleṣmasamutthasya śūlasyoktaṃ nidarśanam ||86||

div.ab: sarvāṇi dṛṣṭvā rūpāṇi nirdiśetsānnipātikam | sannipātasamutthānamasādhyaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet ||87|| śūlānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ... |88|
...cikitsāṃ tu nibodha me | āśukārī hi pavanastasmāttaṃ tvarayā jayet ||88|| tasya śūlābhipannasya sveda eva sukhāvahaḥ |89|

ab.seg: pāyasaiḥ kṛśarāpiṇḍaiḥ snigdhairvā piśitairhitaḥ ||89||
trivṛcchākena vā snigdhamuṣṇaṃ bhuñjīta bhojanam | cirabilvāṅkurān vāpi tailabhṛṣṭāṃstu bhakṣayet ||90||
vaihaṅgāṃśca rasān snigdhān jāṅgalān śūlapīḍitaḥ | yathālābhaṃ niṣeveta māṃsāni bilaśāyinām ||91||
surā sauvīrakaṃ cukraṃ mastūdaśvittathā dadhi | sakālalavaṇaṃ peyaṃ śūle vātasamudbhave ||92||
kulatthayūṣo yuktāmlo lāvakīyūṣasaṃskṛtaḥ | sasaindhavaḥ samarico vātaśūlavināśanaḥ ||93||

div.ab: viḍaṅgaśigrukampillapathyāśyāmāmlavetasān | surasāmaśvamūtrīṃ `surasāmaśvakarṇaṃ ca' iti pā. ca sauvarcalayutān pibet ||94|| madyena vātajaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva praśāmyati |95|

pṛthvīkājājicavikāyavānīvyoṣacitrakāḥ ||95|| pippalyaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ saindhavaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | tāni cūrṇāni payasā pibet kāmbalikena vā ||96|| madhvāsavena cukreṇa surāsauvīrakeṇa vā | athavai(cai)tāni cūrṇāni mātuluṅgarasena vā ||97|| tathā badarayūṣeṇa bhāvitāni punaḥ punaḥ | tāni hiṅgupragāḍhāni saha śarkarayā pibet ||98|| saha dāḍimasāreṇa vartiḥ kāryā bhiṣagjitā | sā vartirvātikaṃ śūlaṃ kṣiprameva vyapohati ||99|| guḍatailena vā līḍhā pītā madyena vā punaḥ |100|
bubhukṣāprabhave śūle laghu santarpaṇaṃ hitam ||100|| uṣṇaiḥ kṣīrairyavāgūbhiḥ snigdhairmāṃsarasaistathā |101|

vātaśūle samutpanne rūkṣaṃ snigdhena bhojayet ||101|| susaṃskṛtāḥ pradeyāḥ syurghṛtapūrā viśeṣataḥ | vāruṇīṃ ca pibejjantustathā sampadyate sukhī ||102|| etadvātasamutthasya śūlasyoktaṃ cikitsitam |103|

ab.seg: atha pittasamutthasya kriyāṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param ||103||
sa sukhaṃ chardayitvā tu pītvā śītodakaṃ naraḥ | śītalāni ca seveta sarvāṇyuṣṇāni varjayet ||104||
maṇirājatatāmrāṇi bhājanāni ca sarvaśaḥ | vāripūrṇāni tānyasya śūlasyopari nikṣipet ||105||
guḍaḥ śāliryavāḥ kṣīraṃ sarpiḥpānaṃ virecanam | jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni bheṣajaṃ pittaśūlinām ||106||
rasān seveta pittaghnān pittalāni vivarjayet | pālāśaṃ dhānvanaṃ vā'pi pibedyūṣaṃ saśarkaram ||107||
paruṣakāṇi mṛdvīkākharjūrodakajānyapi | tat pibeccharkarāyuktaṃ pittaśūlanivāraṇam ||108||
aśane bhuktamātre tu prakopaḥ ślaiṣmikasya ca | vamanaṃ kārayettatra pippalīvāriṇā bhiṣak ||109||
rūkṣaḥ svedaḥ prayojyaḥ syādanyāścoṣṇāḥ kriyā hitāḥ | pippalī śṛṅgaveraṃ ca śleṣmaśūle bhiṣagjitam ||110||
pāṭhāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ tathā kaṭukarohiṇīm | citrakasya ca niryūhe `niryūhaṃ' iti pā. pibedyūṣaṃ sahārjakam ||111||
eraṇḍaphalamūlāni mūlaṃ gokṣurakasya ca | śālaparṇīṃ pṛśniparṇīṃ `śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī' iti pā. bṛhatīṃ kaṇṭakārikām ||112||
dadyācchṛgālavinnāṃ ca sahadevāṃ tathaiva ca | mahāsahāṃ kṣudrasahāṃ mūlamikṣurakasya ca ||113||
etat sambhṛtya sambhāraṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet | caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu yavakṣārayutaṃ pibet ||114||
vātikaṃ paittikaṃ vā'pi ślaiṣmikaṃ sānnipātikam | prasahya nāśayecchūlaṃ chinnābhramiva mārutaḥ ||115||

div.ab: pippalī svarjikākṣāro yavāścitraka eva ca | sevyaṃ caitat samānīya bhasma kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||116|| taduṣṇavāriṇā pītaṃ śleṣmaśūle bhiṣagjitam |117|

ab.seg: ruṇaddhi mārutaṃ śleṣmā kukṣipārśvavyavasthitaḥ ||117||
sa saṃruddhaḥ karotyāśu sādhmānaṃ `dhmānaṃ guḍaguḍāyanam' iti pā. guḍguḍāyanam | sūcībhiriva nistodaṃ kṛcchrocchvāsī tadā naraḥ ||118||
nānnaṃ vāñchati no nidrāmupaityartinipīḍitaḥ | pārśvaśūlaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kaphānilasamudbhavaḥ ||119||

div.ab: tatra puṣkaramūlāni hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam | saindhavaṃ tumburuṃ pathyāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu pāyayet ||120|| pārśvahṛdbastiśūleṣu yavakvāthena saṃyutam | sarpiḥ plīhodaroktaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ vā hiṅgusaṃyutam ||121|| bījapūrakasāraṃ vā payasā saha sādhitam | eraṇḍatailamathavā madyamastupayorasaiḥ ||122|| bhojayeccāpi payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā |123|

ab.seg: prakupyati yadā kukṣau vahnimākramya mārutaḥ ||123||
tadā'sya bhojanaṃ bhuktaṃ sopastambhaṃ na pacyate | ucchvasityāmaśakṛtā śūlenāhanyate muhuḥ ||124||
naivāsane na śayane tiṣṭhan `tiṣṭhan sa' iti `tiṣṭhanna' iti ca pā. vā labhate sukham | kukṣiśūla iti khyāto vātādāmasamudbhavaḥ ||125||
vamanaṃ kārayettatra laṅghayedvā yathābalam | saṃsargapācanaṃ kuryādamlairdīpanasaṃyutaiḥ ||126||

div.ab: nāgaraṃ dīpyakaṃ cavyaṃ hiṅgu sauvarcalaṃ viḍam | mātuluṅgasya bījāni tathā śyāmorubūkayoḥ ||127|| bṛhatyāḥ kaṇṭakāryāśca kvāthaṃ śūlaharaṃ pibet |128|

ab.seg: vacā sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kuṣṭhaṃ sātiviṣā'bhayā ||128||
kuṭajasya ca bījāni sadyaḥśūlaharāṇi tu | virecane `virecanaṃ' iti pā. prayuñjīta jñātvā doṣabalābalam ||129||

div.ab: snehabastīnnirūhāṃśca kuryāddoṣanibarhaṇān |130|
upanāhāḥ snehasekā dhānyāmlapariṣecanam ||130|| avagāhāśca śasyante yaccānyadapi taddhitam |131|

ab.seg: kaphapittāvaruddhastu māruto rasamūrcchitaḥ ||131||
hṛdisthaḥ kurute śūlamucchvāsārodhakaṃ `ucchvāsarodhakaṃ' iti pā. param | sa hṛcchūla iti khyāto rasamārutasambhavaḥ ||132||

div.ab: tatrāpi karmābhihitaṃ yaduktaṃ hṛdvikāriṇām |133|

ab.seg: saṃrodhāt kupito vāyurbastimāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||133||
bastivaṅkṣaṇanābhīṣu tataḥ śūlo'sya jāyate | viṇmūtravātasaṃrodhī bastiśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||134||
nābhyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśveṣu kukṣau meḍhrāntramardakaḥ | mūtramāvṛtya gṛhṇāti mūtraśūlaḥ sa mārutāt `sañjñitaḥ' iti pā.||135||
vāyuḥ prakupito yasya rūkṣāhārasya dehinaḥ | malaṃ ruṇaddhi koṣṭhasthaṃ mandīkṛtya tu pāvakam ||136||
śūlaṃ sañjanayaṃstīvraṃ srotāṃsyāvṛtya tasya hi | dakṣiṇaṃ yadi vā vāmaṃ kukṣimādāya jāyate ||137||
sarvatra vardhate kṣipraṃ bhramannatha `śūlaṃ tatra saghoṣavat' iti pā. saghoṣavān | pipāsā vardhate tīvrā bhramo mūrcchā ca jāyate ||138||
