uccārito mūtritaśca na śāntimadhigacchati | viṭśūlametajjānīyādbhiṣak paramadāruṇam ||139||
kṣipraṃ doṣaharaṃ kāryaṃ bhiṣajā sādhu jānatā | svedanaṃ śamanaṃ caiva nirūhāḥ snehabastayaḥ ||140||
pūrvoddiṣṭān pāyayeta yogān koṣṭhaviśodhanān | udāvartaharāścāsya kriyāḥ sarvāḥ sukhāvahāḥ ||141||
atimātraṃ yadā bhuktaṃ pāvake mṛdutāṃ gate | sthirībhūtaṃ tu tatkoṣṭhe vāyurāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ||142||
avipākagataṃ hyannaṃ śūlaṃ tīvraṃ karotyati | mūrcchā''dhmānaṃ vidāhaśca hṛdutkleśo vilambikā ||143||
viricyate chardayati kampate'tha vimuhyati | avipākādbhavecchūlastvannadoṣasamudbhavaḥ ||144||
vamanaṃ laṅghanaṃ svedaḥ pācanaṃ phalavartayaḥ | kṣārāścūrṇāni `kṣāracūrṇāni' iti pā. guṭikāḥ śasyante śūlanāśanāḥ ||145||
gulmāvasthāḥ kriyāḥ kāryā yathāvat sarvaśūlinām ||146||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāya cikitsātantre gulmapratiṣedho nāma (caturtho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42||

div.head: hṛdrogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto hṛdrogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vegāghātoṣṇarūkṣānnairatimātropasevitaiḥ | viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇairasātmyaiścāpi(ti) bhojanaiḥ ||3||
dūṣayitvā rasaṃ doṣā viguṇā hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ | kurvanti hṛdaye bādhāṃ hṛdrogaṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||4||
caturvidhaḥ sa doṣaiḥ syāt kṛmibhiśca `pañcamaḥ krimibhistathā| pṛthagliṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi' iti pā. pṛthak pṛthak | lakṣaṇaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi cikitsitamanantaram ||5||
āyamyate mārutaje hṛdayaṃ tudyate pīḍyate' iti pā. tathā | nirmathyate dīryate ca sphoṭyate pāṭyate'pi ca ||6||
tṛṣṇoṣādāhacoṣāḥ syuḥ paittike hṛdayaklamaḥ | dhūmāyanaṃ mūrcchā ca svedaḥ śoṣo mukhasya ca ||7||
gauravaṃ kaphasaṃsrāvo'ruciḥ stambho'gnimārdavam | mādhuryamapi cā''syasya balāsāvatate hṛdi ||8||
utkleśaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlo hṛllāsakastamaḥ | aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaśca kṛmije bhavet ||9||

div.ab: bhramaklamau sādaśoṣau jñeyāsteṣāmupadravāḥ |10|

ab.seg: kṛmije kṛmijātīnāṃ ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ ca ye matāḥ ||10||
vātopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye vāmayet snigdhamāturam | dvipañcamūlakvāthena sasnehalavaṇena tu ||11||
pippalyelāvacāhiṅguyavabhasmāni saindhavam | sauvarcalamatho śuṇṭhīmajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitam ||12||
phaladhānyāmlakaulatthadadhimadyāsavādibhiḥ | pāyayeta viśuddhaṃ ca snehenānyatamena vā ||13||
bhojayejjīrṇaśālyannaṃ jāṅgalaiḥ saghṛtai rasaiḥ | vātaghnasiddhaṃ tailaṃ ca dadyādbastiṃ pramāṇataḥ ||14||

div.ab: śrīparṇīmadhukakṣaudrasitotpalajalairvamet | pittopasṛṣṭe hṛdaye seveta madhuraiḥ śṛtam ||15|| ghṛtaṃ kaṣāyāṃścoddiṣṭān pittajvaravināśanān |16|
tṛptasya ca rasairmukhyairmadhuraiḥ `jāṅgalaiḥ' iti pā. saghṛtairbhiṣak ||16|| sakṣaudraṃ vitaredbastau `vitaredbasti' iti pā. tailaṃ madhukasādhitam |17|

ab.seg: vacānimbakaṣāyābhyāṃ vāntaṃ hṛdi kaphātmake ||17||
cūrṇaṃ tu pāyayetoktaṃ vātaje bhojayecca bhojayeddhṛtam' iti pā. tam | phalādimatha mustādiṃ triphalāṃ vā pibennaraḥ ||18||
śyāmātrivṛtkalkayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'pi virecanam | balātailairvidadhyācca `balatailaṃ vidadhyāt' iti pā. bastiṃ bastiviśāradaḥ ||19||
kṛmihṛdrogiṇaṃ snigdhaṃ bhojayet piśitaudanam | dadhnā ca palalopetaṃ tryahaṃ, paścādvirecayet ||20||
sugandhibhiḥ salavaṇairyogaiḥ sājājiśarkaraiḥ | viḍaṅgagāḍhaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ pāyayetāpyanantaram ||21||
hṛdayasthāḥ patantyevamadhastāt krimayo nṛṇām | yavānnaṃ vitareccāsya saviḍaṅgamataḥ param ||22||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hṛdrogapratiṣedho nāma (pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43||

div.head: pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pāṇḍurogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vyavāyamamlaṃ lavaṇāni madyaṃ mṛdaṃ divāsvapnamatīva tīkṣṇam | niṣevamāṇasya vidūṣya raktaṃ kurvanti doṣāstvaci pāṇḍubhāvam ||3||

div.ab: pāṇḍvāmayo'ṣṭārdhavidhaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ pṛthaksamastairyugapacca doṣaiḥ |4|

ab.seg: sarveṣu caiteṣviha pāṇḍubhāvo yato'dhiko'taḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaḥ ||4||
tvaksphoṭanaṃ ṣṭhīvanagātrasādau mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ prekṣaṇakūṭaśothaḥ | viṇmūtrapītatvamathāvipāko bhaviṣyatastasya puraḥsarāṇi ||5||

sa kāmalāpānakipāṇḍurogaḥ kumbhāhvayo lāghara(va)ko'lasākhyaḥ | vibhāṣyate lakṣaṇamasya kṛtsnaṃ nibodha vakṣyāmyanupūrvaśastat `tam' iti pā.| `atra kāmaleti kāmaśabdo'yaṃ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣātsvalpe bhaktādyabhilāṣe pravartate, taṃ lātīti kāmalā| duṣṭatvena kutsito'pāno'pānakaḥ, so'syāstīti apānakī, kāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogaḥ kāmalāpānakipāṇḍurogaḥ| kumbhakāmalakākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastvatra kumbhāhvaya ucyate, bhīmo bhīmasena itivat| rogasyāsya kumbhakāmaleti sañjñā tantrāntare upadiśyate| sa eva punarjvarādibhirlāghavaṃ karoti, satyapi sāmarthyo karmasvanutsāhaṃ ca janayatītyalasākhyo'pānakipāṇḍurogastu lāghavaka ucyate’ iti hārāṇacandraḥ||6||
kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | vātena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||7||
pītekṣaṇaṃ pītasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | pittena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||8||
śuklekṣaṇaṃ śuklasirāvanaddhaṃ tadvarṇaviṇmūtranakhānanaṃ ca | kaphena pāṇḍuṃ manujaṃ vyavasyedyuktaṃ tathā'nyaistadupadravaiśca ||9||

div.ab: sarvātmake sarvamidaṃ vyavasyed... |10|

... vakṣyāmi liṅgānyatha kāmalāyāḥ | yo hyāmayānte sahasā'nnamamlamadyādapathyāni ca tasya pittam ||10|| karoti pāṇḍuṃ vadanaṃ viśeṣāt pūrveritau `tandrāvilatvaṃ prathamoditāṃśca' iti pā. tandribalakṣayau ca |11|

ab.seg: bhedastu tasyāḥ khalu kumbhasāhvaḥ śopho mahāṃstatra ca parvabhedaḥ ||11||

div.ab: jvarāṅgamardabhramasādatandrākṣayānvito lāghara(va)ko'lasākhyaḥ |12|

ab.seg: taṃ vātapittāddharipītanīlaṃ `vāta pittābhiparītaliṅga' iti pā. halīmakaṃ nāma vadanti tajjñāḥ ||12||
upadravāsteṣvaruciḥ pipāsā chardirjvaro mūrdharujā'gnisādaḥ | śophastathā kaṇṭhagato'balatvaṃ mūrcchā klamo hṛdyavapīḍanaṃ ca ||13||
sādhyaṃ tu pāṇḍvāmayinaṃ samīkṣya snigdhaṃ ghṛtenordhvamadhaśca śuddham | sampādayet kṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhairharītakīcūrṇayutaiḥ prayogaiḥ ||14||
pibedghṛtaṃ vā rajanīvipakvaṃ yattraiphalaṃ tailvakameva vā'pi | virecanadravyakṛtaṃ pibedvā yogāṃśca vairecanikān ghṛtena ||15||
mūtre nikumbhārdhapalaṃ vipācya pibedabhīkṣṇaṃ kuḍavārdhamātram | khādedguḍaṃ vā'pyabhayāvipakvamāragvadhādikvathitaṃ `abhayāvimiśraṃ' iti pā. pibedvā ||16||
ayorajovyoṣaviḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ lihyāddharidrāṃ triphalānvitāṃ vā | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vidadhīta vā'pi śāstrapradeśābhihitāṃśca yogān ||17||

div.ab: harecca doṣān bahuśo'lpamātrān śvayeddhi doṣeṣvatinirhṛteṣu |18|

ab.seg: dhātrīphalānāṃ rasamikṣujaṃ ca manthaṃ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī ||18||

div.ab: ume bṛhatyau rajanīṃ śukākhyāṃ kākādanīṃ cāpi sakākamācīm | ādāribimbīṃ sakadambapuṣpīṃ vipācya sarpirvipacet kaṣāye ||19|| tat pāṇḍutāṃ hantyupayujyamānaṃ kṣīreṇa vā māgadhikā yathāgni |20|

ab.seg: hitaṃ ca yaṣṭīmadhujaṃ `yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ' iti pā. kaṣāyaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||20||
gomūtrayuktaṃ triphalādalānāṃ dattvā''yasaṃ cūrṇamanalpakālam | pravālamuktāñjanaśaṅkhacūrṇaṃ lihyāttathā kāñcanagairikottham ||21||
ājaṃ śakṛtsyāt `śakṛddhara' iti pā. kuḍavapramāṇaṃ viḍaṃ haridrā lavaṇottamaṃ ca | pṛthak palāṃśāni samagrametaccūrṇaṃ hitāśī madhunā'valihyāt ||22||
maṇḍūralohāgniviḍaṅgapathyāvyoṣāṃśakaḥ sarvasamānatāpyaḥ | mūtrāsuto'yaṃ `mūtrāyuto'yaṃ' iti pā. madhunā'valehaḥ pāṇḍvāmayaṃ hantyacireṇa ghoram ||23||
bibhītakāyomalanāgarāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ tilānāṃ ca guḍaśca mukhyaḥ | takrānupāno `takrānupānaṃ vaṭakāprayuktaṃ' iti pā. vaṭakaḥ prayuktaḥ kṣiṇoti ghorānapi pāṇḍurogān ||24||
sauvarcalaṃ hiṅgu kirātatiktaṃ kalāyamātrāṇi sukhāmbunā vā | mūrvāharidrāmalakaṃ ca lihyāt sthitaṃ gavāṃ saptadināni mūtre ||25||
mūlaṃ balācitrakayoḥ pibedvā pāṇḍvāmayārto'kṣasamaṃ hitāśī | sukhāmbunā vā lavaṇena tulyaṃ śigroḥ phalaṃ kṣīrabhujopayojyam ||26||
nyagrodhavargasya pibet kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ hitāśī | śālādikaṃ cāpyatha sāracūrṇaṃ dhātrīphalaṃ vā madhunā'valihyāt ||27||

div.ab: viḍaṅgamustatriphalājamodaparūṣakavyoṣavinirdahanyaḥ | cūrṇāni kṛtvā guḍaśarkare ca tathaiva sarpirmadhunī śubhe ca ||28|| sambhārametadvipacennidhāya sārodake sāravato gaṇasya | jātaṃ ca lehyaṃ matimān viditvā nidhāpayenmokṣakaje samudge ||29|| hantyeṣa lehaḥ khalu pāṇḍurogaṃ saśothamugrāmapi kāmalāṃ ca |30|

ab.seg: saśarkarā kāmalināṃ tribhaṇḍī hitā gavākṣī saguḍā ca śuṇṭhī ||30||

div.ab: kāleyake cāpi ghṛtaṃ vipakvaṃ hitaṃ ca tat syādrajanīvimiśram |31|

ab.seg: dhātuṃ nadījaṃ jatu śailajaṃ vā kumbhāhvaye mūtrayutaṃ `kṣaudrayutam' iti pā. pibedvā ||31||

div.ab: mūtre sthitaṃ saindhavasamprayuktaṃ māsaṃ pibedvā'pi hi lohakiṭṭam |32|

ab.seg: dagdhvā'kṣakāṣṭhairmalamāyasaṃ vā gomūtranirvāpitamaṣṭavārān ||32||
vicūrṇya līḍhaṃ madhunā'cireṇa kumbhāhvayaṃ pāṇḍugadaṃ nihanyāt | sindhūdbhavaṃ vā'gnisamaṃ ca kṛtvā kṣiptvā ca mūtre sakṛdeva taptam ||33||
lauhaṃ ca kiṭṭaṃ bahuśaśca taptvā nirvāpya mūtre bahuśastathaiva | ekīkṛtaṃ gojalapiṣṭametadaikadhyamāvāpya pacedukhāyām ||34||
yathā na dahyeta tathā viśuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ peyamudaśvitā tat | takraudanāśī vijayeta rogaṃ pāṇḍuṃ tathā dīpayate'nalaṃ ca ||35||

div.ab: drākṣāguḍūcyāmalakīrasaiśca siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ lāghara(va)ke hitaṃ ca |36|

ab.seg: gauḍānariṣṭān madhuśarkarāśca mūtrāsavān kṣārakṛtāṃstathaiva ||36||
snigdhān rasānāmalakairupetān kolānvitān vā'pi hi jāṅgalānām | seveta śophābhihitāṃśca yogān pāṇḍvāmayī śāliyavāṃśca nityam ||37||
śvāsātisārārucikāsamūrcchātṛṭchardi śūlajvaraśophadāhān | tathā'vipākasvarabhedasādān jayedyathāsvaṃ prasāmīkṣya śāstram ||38||
anteṣu śūnaṃ parihīnamadhyaṃ mlānaṃ tathā'nteṣu ca madhyaśūnam | gude ca śephasyatha muṣkaśūnaṃ `muṣkayośca śūnaṃ, pratāmyantamasañjñakalpam' iti pā. pratāmyamānaṃ ca visañjñakalpam ||39||
vivarjayet pāṇḍukinaṃ yaśo'rthī tathā'tisārajvarapīḍitaṃ ca ||40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre pāṇḍurogapratiṣedho nāma (ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||44||

div.head: raktapittapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto raktapittapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: krodhaśokabhayāyāsaviruddhānnātapānalān | kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāratīkṣṇoṣṇātividāhinaḥ ||3|| nityamabhyasato duṣṭo rasaḥ pittaṃ prakopayet | vidagdhaṃ svaguṇaiḥ pittaṃ vidahatyāśu śoṇitam ||4|| tataḥ pravartate raktamūrdhvaṃ cādho dvidhā'pi vā |5|

ab.seg: āmāśayādvrajedūrdhvamadhaḥ pakvāśayādvrajet ||5||
vidagdhayordvayoścāpi `vidagdhayoścāpyubhayoḥ' iti pā. dvidhābhāgaṃ `dvidhāmārga' iti pā. pravartate | kecit sayakṛtaḥ plīhnaḥ pravadantyasṛjo gatim ||6||

div.ab: ūrdhvaṃ sādhyamadhoyāpyamasādhyaṃ yugapadgatam `yugapadgatiḥ' iti pā.|7|
sadanaṃ śītakāmitvaṃ kaṇṭhadhūmāyanaṃ vamiḥ ||7|| lohagandhiśca niḥśvāso bhavatyasmin bhaviṣyati |8|

ab.seg: bāhyāsṛglakṣaṇaistasya saṅkhyādoṣocchritīrviduḥ ||8||

daurbalyaśvāsakāsajvaravamathumadāstandritādāhamūrcchā bhukte cānne vidāhastvadhṛtirapi sadā hṛdyatulyā ca pīḍā | tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhasya bhedaḥ śirasi ca davanaṃ `tapanaṃ' iti pā. pūtiniṣṭhīvanaṃ ca dveṣo bhakte'vipāko viratirapi rate raktapittopasargāḥ ||9||

māṃsaprakṣālanābhaṃ kvathitamiva ca yat kardamāmbhonibhaṃ vā medaḥpūyāsrakalpaṃ `medaḥpūyāsthikalpaṃ' iti pā. yakṛdiva yadi vā pakvajambūphalābham | yat kṛṣṇaṃ yacca nīlaṃ bhṛśamatikuṇapaṃ yatra coktā vikārāstadvarjyaṃ raktapittaṃ surapatidhanuṣā yacca tulyaṃ vibhāti ||10||
nādau saṅgrāhyamudriktaṃ yadasṛgbalino'śnataḥ | tat pāṇḍugrahaṇīkuṣṭhaplīhagulmajvarāvaham ||11||
adhaḥpravṛttaṃ vamanairūrdhvagaṃ ca virecanaiḥ | jayedanyataradvā'pi kṣīṇasya śamanairasṛk ||12||
atipravṛddhadoṣasya pūrvaṃ lohitapittinaḥ | akṣīṇabalamāṃsāgneḥ kartavyamapatarpaṇam ||13||
laṅghitasya tataḥ peyāṃ vidadhyāt svalpataṇḍulām | rasayūṣau pradātavyau surābhisnehasaṃskṛtau | tarpaṇaṃ pācanaṃ lehān sarpīṃṣi vividhāni ca ||14||
drakṣāmadhukakāśmaryasitāyuktaṃ virecanam | yaṣṭīmadhukayuktaṃ ca sakṣaudraṃ vamanaṃ hitam ||15||
payāṃsi śītāni rasāśca jāṅgalāḥ satīnayūṣāśca saśāliṣaṣṭikāḥ | paṭolaśelūsuniṣaṇṇayūthikāvaṭātimuktāṅkurasinduvārajam ||16||
hitaṃ ca śākaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtaṃ sadā tathaiva dhātrīphaladāḍimānvitam | rasāśca pārāvataśaṅkhakūrmajāstathā yavāgvo vihitā ghṛtottarāḥ ||17||
santānikāścotpalavargasādhite kṣīre praśastā madhuśarkarottarāḥ | himāḥ pradehā madhurā gaṇāśca ye ghṛtāni pathyāni raktapittinām ||18||
madhūkaśobhāñjanakovidārajaiḥ priyaṅgukāyāḥ kusumaiśca cūrṇitaiḥ | bhiṣagvidadhyāccaturaḥ samākṣikān hitāya lehānasṛjaḥ praśāntaye ||19||
lihyācca dūrvāvaṭajāṃśca pallavān madhudvitīyān sitakarṇikasya 'śṛtasya' iti pā. ca | hitaṃ ca kharjūraphalaṃ samākṣikaṃ phalāni cānyānyapi tadguṇānyatha ||20||

div.ab: raktātisāraproktāṃśca yogānatrāpi yojayet |21|

ab.seg: śuddhekṣukāṇḍamāpothya nave kumbhe himāmbhasā ||21||
yojāyitvā kṣipedrātrāvākāśe sotpalaṃ tu tat | prātaḥ srutaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibecchoṇitapittavān ||22||
pibecchītakaṣāyaṃ vā jambvāmrārjunasambhavam | udumbaraphalaṃ piṣṭvā pibettadrasameva vā ||23||
trapuṣīmūlakalkaṃ vā sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā | pibedakṣasamaṃ kalkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukameva vā ||24||
candanaṃ madhukaṃ rodhramevameva samaṃ pibet | karañjabījamevaṃ vā sitākṣaudrayutaṃ pibet ||25||
majjānamiṅgudayasyaivaṃ pibenmadhukasaṃyutam | sukhoṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ bījaṃ kārañjaṃ dadhimastunā ||26||
pibedvā'pi tryahaṃ martyo raktapittābhipīḍitaḥ | raktapittaharāḥ śastāḥ ṣaḍete yogasattamāḥ ||27||

div.ab: pathyāścaivāvapīḍeṣu ghrāṇataḥ prasrute'sṛji |28|

ab.seg: atinisrutarakto vā kṣaudrayuktaṃ pibedasṛk | yakṛdvā bhakṣayedājamāmaṃ pittasamāyutam ||28||

div.ab: palāśavṛkṣasvarase vipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pibet kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītam | vanaspatīnāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā saśarkaraṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā ||29|| drākṣāmuśīrāṇyatha padmakaṃ sitā pṛthakpalāṃśānyudake samāvapet | sthitaṃ niśāṃ tadrudhirāmayaṃ jayet pītaṃ payo vā'mbusamaṃ hitāśinaḥ ||30|| turaṅgavarcaḥsvarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet sitākṣaudrayutaṃ vṛṣasya vā | lihettathā vāstukabījacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrānvitaṃ taṇḍulasāhvayaṃ vā ||31|| lihyācca lājāñjanacūrṇamekamevaṃ sitākṣaudrayutāṃ tugākhyām | drākṣāṃ sitāṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca himāmbunā vā madhukena yuktām ||32|| pathyāmahiṃsrāṃ rajanīṃ ghṛtaṃ ca lihyāttathā śoṇitapittarogī |33|
vāsākaṣāyotpalamṛtpriyaṅgurodhrāñjanāmbhoruhakeśarāṇi ||33|| pītvā sitākṣaudrayutāni jahyāt pittāsṛjo vegamudīrṇamāśu |34|
gāyatrijambvarjunakovidāraśirīṣarodhrāśanaśālmalīnām ||34|| puṣpāṇi śigrośca vicūrṇya leho madhvanvitaḥ śoṇitapittaroge |35|
sakṣaudramindīvarabhasmavāri karañjabījaṃ madhusarpiṣī `madhu śarkarā ca' iti pā. ca ||35|| jambvarjunāmrakvathitaṃ ca toyaṃ ghnanti trayaḥ pittamasṛk ca yogāḥ |36|
mūlāni puṣpāṇi ca mātuluṅgyāḥ piṣṭvā pibettaṇḍuladhāvanena ||36|| ghrāṇapravṛtte jalamāśu deyaṃ saśarkaraṃ nāsikayā payo vā |37|

ab.seg: drākṣārasaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ pibedvā saśarkaraṃ cekṣurasaṃ himaṃ vā ||37||

div.ab: śītopacāraṃ madhuraṃ ca kuryādviśeṣataḥ śoṇitapittaroge |38|
drākṣāghṛtakṣaudrasitāyutena vidārigandhādivipācitena ||38|| kṣīreṇa cāsthāpanamagryamuktaṃ hitaṃ ghṛtaṃ cāpyanuvāsanārtham |39|

priyaṅgurodhrāñjanagairikotpalaiḥ suvarṇakālīyakaraktacandanaiḥ ||39|| sitāśvagandhāmbudayaṣṭikāhvayairmṛṇālasaugandhikatulyapeṣitaiḥ | nirūhya cainaṃ payasā samākṣikairghṛtaplutaiḥ śītajalāvasecitam ||40|| kṣīraudanaṃ bhuktamathānuvāsayedghṛtena yaṣṭīmadhusādhitena ca | adhovahaṃ śoṇitameṣa nāśayettathā'tisāraṃ rudhirasya dustaram ||41|| virekayoge tvati caiva śasyate... |42|

ab.seg: ... vāmyaśca rakte vijite balānvitaḥ ||42||

div.ab: evaṃvidhā uttarabastayaśca mūtrāśayasthe rudhire vidheyāḥ |43|

ab.seg: pravṛttarakteṣu ca pāyujeṣu kuryādvidhānaṃ khalu raktapaittam ||43||
vidhiścāsṛgdare'pyeṣa strīṇāṃ kāryo vijānatā | śastrakarmaṇi raktaṃ ca yasyātīva pravartate ||44||
trayāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ śoṇite'pi ca sarvaśaḥ | liṅgānyālokya kartavyaṃ cikitsitamanantaram ||45||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre raktapittapratiṣedho nāma (saptamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||45||

div.head: mūrcchāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūrcchāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
kṣīṇasya bahudoṣasya viruddhāhārasevinaḥ | vegāghātādabhīghātāddhīnasattvasya vā punaḥ ||3||
karaṇāyataneṣūgrā bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca | niviśante yadā doṣāstadā mūrcchanti mānavāḥ ||4||
hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ sañjñānāśo balasya ca | sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi, yathāsvaṃ `yathāsvamupalakṣayet' iti pā. tā vibhāvayet ||5||

div.ab: sañjñāvahāsu nāḍīṣu pihitāsvanilādibhiḥ | tamo'bhyupaiti sahasā sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt ||6|| sukhaduḥkhavyapohācca naraḥ patati kāṣṭhavat | moho mūrccheti tāṃ prāhuḥ... |7|

ab.seg: ... ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā ||7||
vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca | ṣaṭsvapyetāsu 'tāsu ṣaṭsvapi' iti pā. pittaṃ hi prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||8||

div.ab: apasmāroktaliṅgāni tāsāmuktāni tattvataḥ |9|
pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhaśca `raktagandhastadanvayaḥ' iti pā. tanmayaḥ ||9|| tasmādraktasya gandhena mūrcchanti bhuvi mānavāḥ |10|

ab.seg: dravyasvabhāva ityeke dṛṣṭvā yadabhimuhyati ||10||
guṇāstīvrataratvena `tīvratamatvena' iti pā. sthitāstu viṣamadyayoḥ | ta eva tasmājjāyeta mohastābhyāṃ yatheritaḥ ||11||

div.ab: stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭistvasṛjā gūḍhocchvāsaśca mūrcchitaḥ |12|

ab.seg: madyena vilapaṃśchete naṣṭavibhrāntamānasaḥ | gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat ||12||
vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syuḥ stambhaśca viṣamūrcchite | veditavyaṃ tīvrataraṃ yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||13||
sekāvagāhau maṇayaḥ sahārāḥ śītāḥ pradehā vyajanānilāśca | śītāni pānāni ca gandhavanti sarvāsu mūrcchāsvanivāritāni ||14||
sitāpriyālekṣurasaplutāni drākṣāmadhūkasvarasānvitāni | kharjūrakāśmaryarasaiḥ śṛtāni pānāni sarpīṃṣi ca jīvanāni ||15||
siddhāni varge madhure payāṃsi sadāḍimā jāṅgalajā rasāśca | tathā yavā lohitaśālayaśca mūrcchāsu pathyāśca sadā satīnāḥ ||16||
bhujaṅgapuṣpaṃ maricānyuśīraṃ kolasya madhyaṃ ca pibet samāni | śītena toyena `satīnatoyena' iti pā. bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ kṣaudreṇa kṛṣṇāṃ sitayā ca pathyām ||17||
kuryācca nāsāvadanāvarodhaṃ kṣīraṃ pibedvā'pyatha mānuṣīṇām | mūrcchāṃ prasaktāṃ tu śirovirekairjayedabhīkṣṇaṃ vamanaiśca tīkṣṇaiḥ ||18||

div.ab: harītakīkvāthaśṛtaṃ `harītakīkvāthaghṛtaṃ pibedvā' iti pā. ghṛtaṃ vā dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā | drākṣāsitādāḍimalājavanti śītāni nīlotpalapadmavanti ||19|| pibet kaṣāyāṇi ca gandhavanti pittajvaraṃ yāni śamaṃ nayanti |20|
prabhūtadoṣastamaso'tirekāt sammūrcchito naiva vibudhyate yaḥ ||20|| sannyastasañjño bhṛśaduścikitsyo jñeyastadā buddhimatā manuṣyaḥ |21|
yathā''maloṣṭaṃ salile niṣiktaṃ samuddharedāśvavilīnameva ||21|| tadvaccikitsettvarayā bhiṣaktamasvedanaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ prayātam |22|
tīkṣṇāñjanābhyañjanadhūmayogaistathā nakhābhyantaratotrapātaiḥ ||22|| vāditragītānunayairapūrvairvighaṭṭanairguptaphalāvagharṣaiḥ |23|

ab.seg: ābhiḥ kriyābhiśca na labdhasañjñaḥ sānāhalālāśvasanaśca varjyaḥ ||23||

prabuddhasañjñaṃ vamanānulomyaistīkṣṇairviśuddhaṃ laghupathyabhuktam | phalatrikaiścitrakanāgarāḍhyaistathā'śmajātājjatunaḥ prayogaiḥ | saśarkarairmāsamupakrameta viśeṣato jīrṇaghṛtaṃ sa pāyyaḥ ||24||
yathāsvaṃ ca jvaraghnāni kaṣāyāṇyupayojayet | sarvamūrcchāparītānāṃ viṣajāyāṃ viṣāpaham ||25||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre mūrcchāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||46||

div.head: pānātyayapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ pānātyayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
madyamuṣṇaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva ca | rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca ||3||
auṣṇyācchītopacāraṃ tattaikṣṇyāddhanti manogatim | viśatyavayavān saukṣmyādvaiśadyātkaphaśukranut ||4||
mārutaṃ kopayedraukṣyādāśutvāccāśukarmakṛt `āśukāri tat' iti pā.| harṣadaṃ ca vyavāyitvādvikāśitvādvisarpati ||5||
tadamlaṃ rasataḥ proktaṃ laghu rocanadīpanam | kecillavaṇavarjyāṃstu rasānatrādiśanti hi ||6||
snigdhaistadannairmāṃsaiśca bhakṣyaiśca saha sevitam | bhavedāyuḥprakarṣāya balāyopacayāya ca ||7||
kāmyatā manasastuṣṭirdhairyaṃ tejo'tivikramaḥ | vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ ||8||
tadevānannamajñena sevyamānamamātrayā | kāyāgninā hyagnisamaṃ sametya kurute madam ||9||
madena karaṇānāṃ tu bhāvānyatve kṛte sati | nigūḍhamapi bhāvaṃ svaṃ prakāśīkurute'vaśaḥ ||10||

div.ab: tryavasthaśca mado jñeyaḥ pūrvo madhyo'tha paścimaḥ |11|

ab.seg: pūrve vīryaratiprītiharṣabhāṣyādivardhanam ||11||

div.ab: pralāpo madhyame moho `harṣaḥ' iti pā. yuktāyuktakriyāstathā |12|

ab.seg: visañjñaḥ paścime śete naṣṭakarmakriyāguṇaḥ ||12||
ślaiṣmikānalpapittāṃśca snigdhānmātropasevinaḥ `māṃsopasevinaḥ' iti pā.| pānaṃ na bādhate'tyarthaṃ viparītāṃstu bādhate ||13||
nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam | utpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārānāpādayeccāpi śarīramedam ||14||
kruddhena bhītena pipāsitena śokābhitaptena bubhukṣitena | vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣatena vegāvarodhābhihatena cāpi ||15||
atyamlabhakṣyāvatatodareṇa sājīrṇabhuktena tathā'balena | uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān ||26||
pānātyayaṃ paramadaṃ pānājīrṇamathāpi vā | pānavibhramamugraṃ ca teṣāṃ vakṣyami lakṣaṇam ||17||

div.ab: stambhāṅgamardahṛdayagrahatodakampāḥ pānātyaye'nilakṛte śiraso rujaśca | svedapralāpamukhaśoṣaṇadāhamūrcchāḥ pittātmake vadanalocanapītatā ca ||18|| śleṣmātmake vamathuśītakaphaprasekāḥ sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampat |19|
ūṣmāṇamaṅgagurutāṃ virasānanatvaṃ śleṣmādhikatvamaruciṃ malamūtrasaṅgam ||19|| liṅgaṃ parasya tu madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇāṃ rujāṃ śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedam |20|
ādhmānamudgiraṇamamlaraso vidāho'jīrṇasya pānajanitasya vadanti liṅgam ||20|| jñeyāni tatra bhiṣajā suviniścitāni pittaprakopajanitāni ca kāraṇāni |21|
hṛdgātratodavamathujvarakaṇṭhadhūmamūrcchākaphasravaṇamūrdharujo vidāhaḥ ||21|| dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣu ca teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ |22|
hīnottarauṣṭhamatiśītamamandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyamati(pi)pānahataṃ vijahyāt ||22|| jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavā'pi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe ca |23|

ab.seg: hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ bhajante ||23||

div.ab: teṣāṃ nivāraṇamidaṃ hi mayocyamānaṃ vyaktābhidhānamakhilena vidhiṃ nibodha |24|
madyaṃ tu cukramaricārdrakadīpyakuṣṭhasauvarcalāyutamalaṃ `dīpyakāḍhyaṃ' iti pā. pavanasya śāntyai ||24|| pṛthvīkadīpyakamahauṣadhahiṅgubhirvā sauvarcalena ca yutaṃ vitaret sukhāya |25|
āmrātakāmraphaladāḍimamātuluṅgaiḥ kuryācchubhānyapi ca ṣāḍavapānakāni ||25|| seveta vā phalarasopahitān rasādīnānūpavargapiśitānyapi gandhavanti |26|

ab.seg: pittātmake madhuravargakaṣāyamiśraṃ madyaṃ hitaṃ samadhuśarkaramiṣṭagandham ||26||
pītvā ca madyamapi cekṣurasapragāḍhaṃ niḥśeṣataḥ kṣaṇamavasthitamullikhecca | lāvaiṇatittirirasāṃśca pibedanamlān maudgān sukhāya saghṛtān sasitāṃśca yūṣān ||27||
pānātyaye kaphakṛte kaphamullikhecca madyena bimbividulodakasaṃyutena | seveta tiktakaṭukāṃśca rasānudārān yūṣāṃśca tiktakaṭukopahitān hitāya ||28||

div.ab: pathyaṃ yavānnavikṛtāni ca jāṅgalāni śleṣmaghnamanyadapi yacca niratyayaṃ syāt |29|

ab.seg: kuryācca sarvamatha sarvabhave vidhānaṃ dvandvodbhave dvayamavekṣya yathāpradhānam ||29||

div.ab: sāmānyamanyadapi yacca samagramagryaṃ vakṣyāmi yacca manaso madakṛt sukhaṃ ca |30|

tvaṅgāgapuṣpamagadhailamadhūkadhānyaiḥ ślakṣṇairajājimaricaiśca kṛtaṃ samāṃśaiḥ ||30|| pānaṃ kapittharasavāriparūṣakāḍhyaṃ pānātyayeṣu vidhivatsrutamambarānte | hrīverapadmaparipelavasamprayuktaiḥ puṣpairvilipya karavīrajalodbhavaiśca ||31|| piṣṭaiḥ sapadmakayutairapi sārivādyaiḥ sekaṃ jalaiśca vitaredamalaiḥ suśītaiḥ | tvakpatracocamaricailabhujaṅgapuṣpaśleṣmātakaprasavavalkaguḍairupetam ||32|| drākṣāyutaṃ hṛtamalaṃ madirāmayārtaistatpānakaṃ śuci sugandhi narairniṣevyam | piṣṭvā pibecca madhukaṃ kaṭurohiṇīṃ ca drākṣāṃ ca mūlamasakṛt trapuṣībhavaṃ yat ||33|| kārpāsinīmatha `kārpāsamūlamatha' iti pā. ca nāgabalāṃ ca tulyāṃ pītvā sukhī bhavati sādhu suvarcalāṃ ca |34|
kāśmaryadāruviḍadāḍimapippalīṣu drākṣānvitāsu kṛtamambuni pānakaṃ yat ||34|| tadbījapūrakarasāyutamāśu pītaṃ śāntiṃ parāṃ paramade tvacirāt karoti |35|

ab.seg: drākṣāsitāmadhukajīrakadhānyakṛṣṇāsvevaṃ kṛtaṃ trivṛtayā ca pibettathaiva ||35||
sauvarcalāyutamudārarasaṃ phalāmlaṃ bhārgīśṛtena ca jalena hito'vasekaḥ ||36||
ikṣvākudhāmārgavavṛkṣakāṇi kākāhvayodumbarikāśca dugdhe | vipācya tasyāñjalinā vameddhi madyaṃ pibeccāhni gate tvajīrṇe ||37||

div.ab: tvakpippalībhujagapuṣpaviḍairupetaṃ seveta hiṅgumaricailayutaṃ phalāmlam | uṣṇāmbusaindhavayutāstvathavā viḍatvakcavyailahiṅgumagadhāphalamūlaśuṇṭhīḥ ||38|| hṛdyaiḥ khaḍairapi ca bhojanamatra śastaṃ... |39|

ab.seg: ... drākṣākapitthaphaladāḍimapānakaṃ yat | tat pānavibhramaharaṃ madhuśarkarāḍhyamāmrātakolarasapānakameva cāpi ||39||
kharjūravetrakakarīraparūṣakeṣu `kharjūravetrakaravīraparūṣakeṣu' iti pā. drākṣātrivṛtsu ca kṛtaṃ sasitaṃ himaṃ vā | śrīparṇiyuktamathavā tu pibedimāni yaṣṭyāhvayotpalahimāmbuvimiśritāni ||40||
kṣīripravālabisajīrakanāgapuṣpapatrailavālusitasārivapadmakāni | āmrātabhavyakaramardakapitthakolavṛkṣāmlavetraphalajīrakadāḍimāni ||41||
seveta vā maricajīrakanāgapuṣpatvakpatraviśvacavikailayutān rasāṃśca | sūkṣmāmbarasrutahimāṃśca sugandhigandhān pānodbhavānnudati saptagadānaśeṣān ||42||
pañcendriyārthaviṣayā mṛdupānayogā hṛdyāḥ sukhāśca manasaḥ satataṃ niṣevyāḥ `niyojyāḥ' iti pā.| pānātyayeṣu vikaṭorunitambavatyaḥ pīnonnatastanabharānatamadhyadeśāḥ ||43||
prauḍhāḥ striyo'bhinavayauvanapīnagātryaḥ sevyāśca pañcaviṣayātiśayasvabhāvāḥ ||44||
pibedrasaṃ puṣpaphalodbhavaṃ vā sitāmadhūkatrisugandhiyuktam | sañcūrṇya saṃyojya ca nāgapuṣpairajājikṛṣṇāmaricaiśca tulyaiḥ ||45||
varṣābhūyaṣṭyāhvamadhūkalākṣātvakkarbudārāṅkurajīrakāṇi | drākṣāṃ ca kṛṣṇāmatha keśaraṃ ca kṣīre samāloḍya pibet sukhepsuḥ `sukhoṣṇam' iti pā.||46||
bhavecca madyena tu yena pātitaḥ prakāmapītena surāsavādinā | tadeva tasmai vidhivat pradāpayedviparyaye bhraṃśamavaśyamṛcchati `bhraṃśamasau ca gacchati' iti pā.||47||
yathā narendropahatasya kasyacidbhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ | dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ ||48||
vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo'timadyaṃ niṣevate | tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ sambhavanti hi ||49||
madyasyāgneyavāyavyau guṇāvambu(mbho)vahāni tu | srotāṃsi śoṣayeyātāṃ tena tṛṣṇopajāyate ||50||
pāṭalotpalakandeṣu mudgaparṇyāṃ ca sādhitam | pibenmāgadhikonmiśraṃ tatrāmbho himaśītalam ||51||

div.ab: sarpistailavasāmajjadadhibhṛṅgarasairyutam | kvāthena bilvayavayoḥ sarvagandhaiśca peṣitaiḥ ||52|| pakvamabhyañjane śreṣṭhaṃ... |53|
...seke kvāthaśca śītalaḥ |53|
rasavanti ca bhojyāni yathāsvamavacārayet ||53|| pānakāni suśītāni hṛdyāni surabhīṇi ca |54|

ab.seg: tvacaṃ prāptastu pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrcchitaḥ | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavattatra bheṣajam ||54||
śītaṃ vidhānamata ūrdhvamahaṃ pravakṣye dāhapraśāntikaramṛddhimatāṃ narāṇām | tatrādito malayajena hitaḥ pradehaścandrāṃśuhāratuhinodakaśītalena ||55||
śītāmbuśītalataraiśca śayānamenaṃ `śayānamevaṃ' iti pā. hārairmṛṇālavalayairabalāḥ spṛśeyuḥ | bhinnotpalojjvalahime śayane śayīta patreṣu vā sajalabinduṣu padminīnām ||56||

āsādayan pavanamāhṛtamaṅganābhiḥ `pavanamāhṛtamiṣṭagandhaṃ' iti pā. kahlārapadmadalaśaivalasañcayeṣu | kāntairvanāntapavanaiḥ `śītairvanāntapavanaiḥ' iti pā. parimṛśyamānaḥ śaktaścaredbhavanakānanadīrghikāsu `prītaḥ' iti pā.||57||

div.ab: dāhābhibhūtamathavā pariṣecayettu `pariṣecayettaṃ' iti pā. lāmajjakāmburuhacandanatoyatoyaiḥ `lāmajjakāmburuhacandanatoyatoyraiḥ' iti, `śītairuśīrajalacandanavāribhistam' iti ca pā.| visrāvitāṃ hṛtamalāṃ navavāripūrṇāṃ padmotpalākulajalāmadhivāsitāmbum `adhivāsitāṃ ca' iti pā.||58|| vāpīṃ bhajeta haricandanabhūṣitāṅgaḥ kāntākaraspṛśanakarkaśaromakūpaḥ |59|

tatrainamamburuhapatrasamaiḥ spṛśantyaḥ śītaiḥ karoruvadanaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ stanaiśca ||59|| toyāvagāhakuśalā madhurasvabhāvāḥ saṃharṣayeyurabalāḥ sukalaiḥ `madhuraiḥ' iti `kuśalaiḥ' iti ca pā. pralāpaiḥ |60|

dhārāgṛhe pragalitodakadurdinābhe klāntaḥ śayīta salilānilaśītakukṣau ||60|| gandhodakaiḥ sakusumairupasiktabhūmau patrāmbucandanarasairupaliptakuḍye | jātyutpalapriyakakeśarapuṇḍarīkapunnāganāgakaravīrakṛtopacāre `...kṛtopakāre' iti pā.||61|| tasmin gṛhe kamalareṇvaruṇe śayīta yatnāhṛtānilavikampitapuṣpadāmni |62|

ab.seg: hemantavindhyahimavanmalayācalānāṃ śītāmbhasāṃ sakadalīharitadrumāṇām ||62||
udbhinnanīlanalināmburuhākarāṇāṃ candrodayasya ca kathāḥ śṛṇuyānmanojñāḥ | mlānaṃ pratāntamanasaṃ manaso'nukūlāḥ pīnastanorujaghanā haricandanāṅgyaḥ `ghanasāradigdhāḥ' iti pā.||63||
tā enamārdravasanāḥ saha saṃviśeyuḥ śliṣṭvā'balāḥ śithilamekhalahārayaṣṭyaḥ ||64||
harṣayeyurnaraṃ nāryaḥ svaguṇai rahasi sthitāḥ | tāḥ śaityācchamayeyuśca pittapānātyayāntaram `pittapānātyayaṃ striyaḥ' iti pā.||65||

div.ab: tṛḍdāharaktapitteṣu raktapittatṛṣādāheṣvayameva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ' iti pā. kāryo'yaṃ bheṣajakramaḥ | sāmānyato... |66|

ab.seg: ... viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇu dāheṣvaśeṣataḥ ||66||
kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktamudriktaṃ `raktaṃ' iti hastali. pu.pā. dahati hyati | sañcūṣyate dahyate ca tāmrābhastāmralocanaḥ ||67||
lohagandhāṅgavadano vahninevāvakīryate | taṃ vilaṅghya vidhānena saṃsṛṣṭāhāramācaret ||68||
apraśāmyati dāhe ca rasaistṛptasya jāṅgalaiḥ | śākhāśrayā yathānyāyaṃ rohiṇīrvyadhayet sirāḥ ||69||

div.ab: pittajvarasamaḥ pittāt sa cāpyasya vidhirhitaḥ |70|

ab.seg: tṛṣṇānirodhādabdhātau kṣīṇe tejaḥ samuddhatam `samutthitam' iti pā.||70||
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ dahedvai mandacetasaḥ | saṃśuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya ceṣṭate `vepate' iti pā.||71||

div.ab: tatropaśamayettejastvabdhātuṃ ca vivardhayet | pāyayet kāmamambhaśca `icchayā'mbhaśca' iti 'icchāyā'mbhastaṃ' iti pā. śarkarāḍhyaṃ payo'pi vā ||72|| śītamikṣurasaṃ manthaṃ vitarecceritaṃ `vitarattvaritaṃ' iti pā. vidhim |73|
asṛjā pūrṇakoṣṭhasya dāho bhavati `dāho'nyaḥ syātsudustaraḥ' iti pā. duḥsahaḥ ||73|| vidhiḥ sadyovraṇīyoktastasya lakṣaṇameva ca |74|

ab.seg: dhātukṣayokto yo dāhastena mūrcchātṛṣānvitaḥ ||74||
kṣāmasvaraḥ kriyāhīno bhṛśaṃ `sa sīdedbhṛśapīḍitaḥ' iti pā. sīdati pīḍitaḥ | raktapittavidhistasya hitaḥ snigdho'nilāpahaḥ ||75||
kṣatajenāśnataścānyaḥ śocato vā'pyanekadhā | tenāntardahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrcchāpralāpavān ||76||
tamiṣṭaviṣayopetaṃ suhṛdbhirabhisaṃvṛtam | kṣīramāṃsarasāhāraṃ vidhinoktena sādhayet ||77||

div.ab: marmābhighātajo'pyasti sa `so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ' iti pā. cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ |78|
sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātreṣu dehiṣu ||78|| (evaṃvidho bhavedyastu madirāmayapīḍitaḥ `ayamardhaśloko hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate||) |

ab.seg: praśāntopadrave cāpi śodhanaṃ prāptamācaret ||79||
sajīrakāṇyārdrakaśṛṅgaverasauvarcalānyardhajalaplutāni | madyāni hṛdyānyatha gandhavanti pītāni sadyaḥ śamayanti tṛṣṇām ||80||
jalaplutaścandanabhūṣitāṅgaḥ sragvī sabhaktāṃ piśitopadaṃśām | piban surāṃ naiva labheta rogān manonuvighnaṃ `manomatighnaṃ ca' iti pā. ca madaṃ na yāti ||81||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre madātyayapratiṣedho nāma (navamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||47||

div.head: tṛṣṇāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātastṛṣṇāpratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
satataṃ yaḥ pibedvāri na tṛptimadhigacchati | punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet ||3||
saṅkṣobhaśokaśramamadyapānādrūkṣāmlaśuṣkoṣṇakaṭūpayogāt `kaṣāyayogān' iti pā.| dhātukṣayāllaṅghanasūryatāpāt pittaṃ ca vātaśca bhṛśaṃ pravṛddhau ||4||
srotāṃsi sandūṣayataḥ sametau yānyambuvāhīni śarīriṇāṃ hi | srotaḥsvapāṃvāhiṣu dūṣiteṣu jāyeta tṛṣṇā'tibalā `tṛṣṇā pratibalā' iti pā. tatastu ||5||
tisraḥ smṛtāstāḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāttathā'nyā''masamudbhavā ca | syāt saptamī bhaktanimittajā tu nibodha `liṅgāni tāsāṃ śṛṇu cauṣadhāni' iti pā. liṅgānyanupūrvaśastu ||6||
tālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhāsyaviśoṣadāhāḥ `... vitodadāhāḥ' iti pā. santāpamohabhramavipralāpāḥ | pūrvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti tāsāmutpattikāleṣu viśeṣatastu ||7||
śuṣkāsyatā mārutasambhavāyāṃ todastathā śaṅkhaśiraḥsu `śaṅkhaśirogaleṣu' iti pā. cāpi | srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītābhiradbhiśca vivṛddhimeti ||8||
mūrcchāpralāpārucivaktraśoṣāḥ pītekṣaṇatvaṃ pratataśca dāhaḥ | śītābhikāṅkṣā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridhūpanaṃ ca ||9||

kaphāvṛtābhyāmanilānalābhyāṃ kapho'pi śuṣkaḥ prakaroti tṛṣṇām `bāṣpāvarodhātkaphasaṃvṛte'gnau tṛṣṇā balāsena bhavettu tatra' iti pā.| nidrā gurutvaṃ madhurāsyatā ca tayā'rditaḥ `tṛṣṇārditaḥ' iti pā. śuṣyati cātimātram ||10||
kaṇṭhopalepo mukhapicchilatvaṃ śītajvaraśchardirarocakaśca | kaphātmikāyāṃ gurugātratā ca śākhāsu śophastvavipāka eva | etāni rūpāṇi bhavanti tasyāṃ tayā'rditaḥ kāṅkṣati nāti cāmbhaḥ ||11||
kṣatasya rukśoṇitanirgamābhyāṃ tṛṣṇā caturthī kṣatajā matā `bhavetsā' iti pā. tu | tayā'bhibhūtasya niśādināni gacchanti duḥkhaṃ pibato'pi toyam ||12||

div.ab: rasakṣayādyā `rasakṣayādyā kṣayasambhavā sā tayā'bhibhūtastu niśādineṣu| pepīyate'mbhaḥ sa sukhaṃ na yāti tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ' iti pā. kṣayajā matā sā tayā'rditaḥ śuṣyati dahyate ca | atyarthamākāṅkṣati cāpi toyaṃ tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ ||13|| rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyāmaśeṣeṇa bhiṣagvyavasyet |14|

ab.seg: tridoṣaliṅgā''masamudbhavā ca hṛcchūlaniṣṭhīvanasādayuktā ||14||

div.ab: snigdhaṃ tathā'mlaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ gurvannamevātitṛṣāṃ `gurvannamevāśu' iti pā. karoti |15|

ab.seg: kṣīṇaṃ vicittaṃ badhiraṃ tṛṣārtaṃ vivarjayennirgatajihvamāśu ||15||

div.ab: tṛṣṇābhivṛddhāvudare ca pūrṇe taṃ vāmayenmāgadhikodakena | vilobhanaṃ `vilepanaṃ cātra hitaṃ vadanti' iti pā. cātra hitaṃ vidheyaṃ syāddāḍimāmrātakamātuluṅgaiḥ ||16|| tisraḥ `tṛṣṇā prayogairiha sā nivāryā' iti pā. prayogairiha sannivāryāḥ śītaiśca samyagrasavīryajātaiḥ |17|

ab.seg: gaṇḍūṣamamlairvirase ca vaktre kuryācchubhairāmalakasya cūrṇaiḥ ||17||
suvarṇarūpyādibhiragnitaptairloṣṭaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā sikatādibhirvā `sikatopalairvā' iti pā.| jalaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ śamayettu tṛṣṇāṃ saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ himaṃ vā ||18||
pañcāṅgikāḥ pañcagaṇā ya uktāsteṣvambu `tairambu' iti pā. siddhaṃ prathame gaṇe vā | pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ manujo'cireṇa `manujo'lpaśastu' iti pā. tṛṣo vimucyeta hi vātajāyāḥ ||19||
pittaghnavargaistu kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ saśarkaraḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ suśītaḥ | pītastṛṣāṃ pittakṛtāṃ nihanti kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ vā'pyatha jīvanīyaiḥ ||20||

bilvāḍhakīkanyakapañcamūlīdarbheṣu `... kaṇṭakapañcamūlī ...' iti pā.`bilvāḍhakīkaccakapañcakoladarbheṣu' iti pā. siddhaṃ kaphajāṃ nihanti | hitaṃ bhavecchardanameva cātra taptena nimbaprasavodakena ||21||

div.ab: sarvāsu tṛṣṇāsvathavā'pi paittaṃ kuryādvidhiṃ tena `tena vinā na śāntiḥ' iti pā. hi tā na santi |22|
paryāgatodumbarajo rasastu saśarkarastatkvathitodakaṃ vā ||22|| vargasya siddhasya ca sārivādeḥ pātavyamambhaḥ śiśiraṃ tṛṣārtaiḥ |23|

ab.seg: kaśeruśṛṅgāṭakapadmamocabisekṣusiddhaṃ `viseṣu siddham' iti pā. kṣatajāṃ nihanti ||23||

div.ab: lājotpalośīrakucandanāni dattvā pravāte niśi vāsayettu | taduttamaṃ toyamudāragandhi sitāyutaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ vadanti `tathaiva' iti pā.||24|| drākṣāpragāḍhaṃ ca hitāya vaidyastṛṣṇārditebhyo vitarennarebhyaḥ |25|
sasārivādau tṛṇapañcamūle tathotpalādau prathame `madhure' iti pā. gaṇe ca ||25|| kuryāt kaṣāyaṃ ca yatheritena `yathaiva yuktaṃ' iti pā.... |26|

ab.seg: ... madhūkapuṣpādiṣu cāpareṣu | rājādanakṣīrikapītaneṣu ṣaṭ pānakānyatra hitāni ca syuḥ ||26||

div.ab: satuṇḍikerāṇyathavā pibettu piṣṭāni kārpāsasamudbhavāni |27|

ab.seg: kṣatodbhavāṃ rugvinivāraṇena jayedrasānāmasṛjaśca pānaiḥ ||27||

div.ab: kṣayotthitāṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ nihanyānmāṃsodakaṃ vā madhukodakaṃ vā |28|
āmodbhavāṃ bilvavacāyutaistu jayet kaṣāyairatha dīpanīyaiḥ `dīpanānām' iti pā.||28|| āmrātabhallātabalāyutāni pibet kaṣāyāṇyatha dīpanāni |29|

ab.seg: gurvannajātāṃ vamanairjayecca kṣayādṛte sarvakṛtāṃ ca tṛṣṇām ||29||

div.ab: śramodbhavāṃ māṃsaraso nihanti guḍodakaṃ vā'pyathavā'pi manthaḥ |30|

ab.seg: bhaktoparodhāttṛṣito yavāgūmuṣṇāṃ pibenmanthamatho himaṃ ca ||30||

div.ab: yā snehapītasya bhavecca tṛṣṇā tatroṣṇamambhaḥ prapibenmanuṣyaḥ |31|

ab.seg: madyodbhavāmardhajalaṃ nihanti madyaṃ tṛṣāṃ yā'pi ca madyapasya ||31||

div.ab: tṛṣṇodbhavāṃ `uṣṇodbhavaṃ' iti pā. hanti jalaṃ suśītaṃ saśarkaraṃ sekṣurasaṃ tathā'mbhaḥ |32|

ab.seg: svaiḥ svaiḥ kaṣāyairvamanāni tāsāṃ tathā jvaroktāni ca pācanāni ||32||
lepāvagāhau pariṣecanāni kuryāttathā śītagṛhāṇi cāpi | saṃśodhanaṃ kṣīrarasau ghṛtāni sarvāsu lehānmadhurān himāṃśca ||33||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre (daśamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||48||

div.head: chardipratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaśchardipratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
atidravairatisnigdhairahṛdyairlavaṇairati | akāle cātimātraiśca tathā'sātmyaiśca bhojanaiḥ ||3||
śramāt kṣayāttathodvegādajīrṇāt kṛmidoṣataḥ | nāryāścāpannasattvāyāstathā'tidrutamaśnataḥ ||4||
atyantāmaparītasya chardervai sambhavo dhruvam | (bībhatsairhetubhiścānyairdrutamutkleśito balāt ayamardhaśloko hārāṇacandreṇa na paṭhitaḥ ) ||5||
chādayannānanaṃ vegairardayannaṅgabhañjanaiḥ | nirucyate chardiriti doṣo vaktrādviniścaran `vaktraṃ pradhāvitaḥ' iti pā.||6||
doṣānudīrayan vṛddhānudāno vyānasaṅgataḥ | ūrdhvamāgacchati bhṛśaṃ viruddhāhārasevanāt `viruddhāhārasevinām' iti pā.||7||

div.ab: praseko `hṛllāsodgārarodhau ca praseko lavaṇastanuḥ| dveṣo'nnapāne ca bhṛśaṃ vamīnāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam' iti pā. hṛdayotkleśo bhaktasyānabhinandanam | pūrvarūpaṃ mataṃ chardyā... |8|

ab.seg: ... yathāsvaṃ ca vibhāvayet ||8||
pracchardayet `yaśchardayet' iti pā. phenilamalpamalpaṃ śūlārdito'bhyarditapārśvapṛṣṭhaḥ | śrāntaḥ saghoṣaṃ bahuśaḥ kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe'dhikaṃ sā'nilajā vamistu ||9||
yo'mlaṃ bhṛśaṃ vā kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā | sadāhacoṣajvaravaktraśoṣo mūrcchānvitaḥ `mūrcchānvitā' iti pā. pittanimittajā sā ||10||
yo hṛṣṭaromā madhuraṃ prabhūtaṃ śuklaṃ himaṃ sāndrakaphānuviddham | abhaktaruggauravasādayukto `...gauravasādayuktaṃ' iti pā. vamedvamī sā kaphakopajā syāt ||11||

div.ab: sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti yasyāṃ sā sarvadoṣaprabhavā matā tu |12|

ab.seg: bībhatsajā dauhṛdajā''majā ca sātmyaprakopāt `yā'sātmyato vā' iti pā. kṛmijā ca yā `yā syāt' iti pā. hi | sā pañcamī tāṃ `tāśca' iti pā. ca vibhāvayettu doṣocchrayeṇaiva yathoktamādau ||12||
śūlahṛllāsabahulā `śūlahṛllāsabhūyiṣṭhā' iti pā. kṛmijā ca viśeṣataḥ | kṛmihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena ca lakṣitā ||13||
kṣīṇasyopadravairyuktāṃ sāsṛkpūyāṃ sacandrikām | chardi prasaktāṃ kuśalo nārabheta cikitsitum ||14||
āmāśayotkleśabhavā hi sarvāstasmāddhitaṃ laṅghanameva tāsu `tābhyaḥ' iti pā.||15||
vamīṣu bahudoṣāsu chardanaṃ hitamucyate | virecanaṃ vā kurvīta yathādoṣocchrayaṃ bhiṣak ||16||

div.ab: saṃsargaścānupūrveṇa `saṃsargāścānupūrveṇa yathāsvaṃ bheṣajāsutān' iti pā. yathāsvaṃ bheṣajāyutaḥ |17|

ab.seg: laghūni pariśuṣkāṇi sātmyānyannāni cācaret ||17||

div.ab: yathāsvaṃ ca kaṣāyāṇi jvaraghnāni prayojayet |18|

ab.seg: hanyāt kṣīraghṛtaṃ pītaṃ chardiṃ pavanasambhavām ||18||
sasaindhavaṃ pibet sarpirvātacchardinivāraṇam | mudgāmalakayūṣo vā sasarpiṣkaḥ sasaindhavaḥ | yavāgūṃ madhumiśrāṃ vā pañcamūlīkṛtāṃ pibet ||19||
pibedvā vyaktasindhūtthaṃ phalāmlaṃ vaiṣkiraṃ rasam | sukhoṣṇalavaṇaṃ cātra hitaṃ snehavirecanam ||20||
pittopaśamanīyāni pākyāni `pānāni' iti pā. śiśirāṇi ca | kaṣāyāṇyupayuktāni ghnanti pittakṛtāṃ vamīm ||21||
śodhanaṃ madhuraiścātra drākṣārasasamāyutaiḥ | balavatyāṃ praśaṃsanti sarpistailvakameva ca ||22||
āragvadhādiniryūhaṃ `āragvadhādibhiryūṣaṃ' iti pā. daśāṅgayogameva vā | pāyayetātha sakṣaudraṃ kaphajāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ ||23||
kṛtaṃ guḍūcyā vidhivat kaṣāyaṃ himasañjñitam | tisṛṣvapi bhavet pathyaṃ mākṣikeṇa samanvitam ||24||

div.ab: bībhatsajāṃ hṛdyatamairdauhṛdīṃ kāṅkṣitaiḥ phalaiḥ | laṅghanairvamanaiścāmāṃ sātmyaiḥ `sātmyaiścāsātmyakopajām' iti pā. sātmyaprakopajām ||25|| kṛmihṛdrogavaccāpi kṛmijāṃ sādhayedvamīm |26|

ab.seg: vitarecca yathādoṣaṃ śastaṃ vidhimanantaram ||26||
dadhittharasasaṃsaktāṃ pippalīṃ mākṣikānvitām | muhurmuhurnaro līḍhvā chardibhyaḥ pravi(ti)mucyate ||27||
samākṣikā madhurasā pītā vā taṇḍulāmbunā | tarpaṇaṃ vā madhuyutaṃ tisṛṇāmapi bheṣajam ||28||
svayaṅguptāṃ sayaṣṭyāhvāṃ taṇḍulāmbumadhudravām | pibedyavāgūmathavā siddhāṃ patraiḥ karañjajaiḥ ||29||
yuktāmlalavaṇāḥ piṣṭāḥ kustumburyo'thavā hitāḥ | taṇḍulāmbuyutaṃ khādet kapitthaṃ tryūṣaṇena vā ||30||
sitācandanamadhvāktaṃ lihyādvā makṣikāśakṛt | pibet payo'gnitaptaṃ ca nirvāpya gṛhagodhikām `gṛhagopikām' iti pā.||31||
sarpiḥkṣaudrayutān vā'pi lājaśaktūn pibettathā | sarpiḥkṣaudrasitopetāṃ māgadhīṃ vā lihettathā ||32||
dhātrīrase candanaṃ vā ghṛṣṭaṃ mudgadalāmbunā | kolāmalakamajjānaṃ lihyādvā trisugandhikam ||33||
sakṣaudrāṃ śālilājānāṃ yavāgūṃ vā pibennaraḥ | ghreyāṇyupahareccāpi manoghrāṇasukhāni ca ||34||
jāṅgalāni ca māṃsāni śubhāni `svāduvatpānakāni' iti pā. pānakāni ca | bhojanāni vicitrāṇi kuryātsarvāsvatandritaḥ ||35||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre chardipratiṣedho nāma (ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||49||

div.head: hikkāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto hikkāpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vidāhiguruviṣṭambhirūkṣābhiṣyandibhojanaiḥ | śītapānāsanasthānarajodhūmānilānalaiḥ ||3||
vyāyāmakarmabhārādhvavegāghātāpatarpaṇaiḥ | āmādoṣābhighātastrīkṣayadoṣaprapīḍanaiḥ `... kṣayarogaprapīḍanaiḥ' iti pā.||4||
viṣamāśanādhyanaśanaistathā samaśanairapi | hikkā śvāsaśca kāsaśca nṛṇāṃ samupajāyate ||5||
muhurmuhurvāyarudeti sasvano yakṛtplihāntrāṇi mukhādivākṣipan | sa ghoṣavānāśu hinastyasūn yatastatastu hikketi bhiṣagbhirucyate ||6||
annajāṃ yamalāṃ kṣudrāṃ gambhīrāṃ mahatīṃ tathā | vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi ||7||
mukhaṃ kaṣāyamaratirgauravaṃ kaṇṭhavakṣasoḥ | pūrvarūpāṇi hikkānāmāṭopo jaṭharasya ca ||8||

div.ab: tvaramāṇasya cāhāraṃ bhuñjānasyāthavā ghanam | vāyurannairavastīrṇaḥ kaṭukairardito bhṛśam `pānānnairatisaṃyuktaiḥ sahasā pīḍito'nilaḥ' iti pā.||9|| hikkayatyūrdhvago bhūtvā tāṃ vidyādannajāṃ bhiṣak |10|
cireṇa yamalairvegairyā hikkā sampravartate ||10|| kampayantī śirogrīvaṃ yamalāṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet |11|
vikṛṣṭakālairyā vegairmandaiḥ samabhivartate ||11|| kṣudrikā nāma sā hikkā jatrumūlāt pradhāvitā |12|

ab.seg: nābhipravṛttā yā hikkā ghorā gambhīranādinī ||12||
śuṣkauṣṭhakaṇṭhajihvāsyaśvāsapārśvarujākarī | anekopadravayutā gambhīrā nāma sā smṛtā ||13||
marmāṇyāpīḍayantīva satataṃ yā pravartate | dehamāyamya vegena ghoṣayatyatitṛṣyataḥ `tṛṣṇārtasya mahāsvanā' iti pā.| mahāhikketi sā jñeyā sarvagātraprakampinī ||14||
āyamyate hikkā'toṅgāni yasya dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ tāmyate yasya gāḍham | kṣīṇo'nnadviṭ kāsate `kṣauti yaścātimātraṃ' iti pā. yaśca hikkī tau dvāvantyau varjayeddhikkamānau ||15||

div.ab: prāṇāyāmodvejanatrāsanāni sūcītodaiḥ sambhramaścātra śastaḥ |16|

ab.seg: yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vā mākṣikeṇāvapīḍe pippalyo vā śarkarācūrṇayuktāḥ ||16||

div.ab: sarpiḥ koṣṇaṃ kṣīramikṣo raso vā nātikṣīṇe chardanaṃ śāntihetoḥ `sraṃsanaṃ ca' iti pā.|17|
nārīpayaḥpiṣṭamaśuklacandanaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sasaindhavaṃ tathā ||17|| cūrṇīkṛtaṃ saindhavamambhasā'thavā nihanti hikkāṃ ca hitaṃ ca nasyataḥ |18|
yuñjyāddhūmaṃ śālaniryāsajātaṃ naipālaṃ vā goviṣāṇodbhavaṃ vā ||18|| sarpiḥsnigdhaiścarmabālaiḥ kṛtaṃ vā hikkāsthāne svedanaṃ cāpi kāryam |19|

kṣaudropetaṃ gairikaṃ kāñcanāhvaṃ lihyādbhasma grāmyasattvāsthijaṃ vā ||19|| tadvacchvāvinmeṣagośalya(lla)kānāṃ romāṇyantardhūmadagdhāni cātra | madhvājyāktaṃ barhipatraprasūtamevaṃ bhasmaudumbaraṃ tailvakaṃ vā ||20|| svarjikṣāraṃ bījapūrādrasena kṣaudropetaṃ hanti līḍhvā''śu hikkām |21|

ab.seg: sarpiḥsnigdhā ghnanti hikkāṃ yavāgvaḥ koṣṇagrāsāḥ pāyaso vā sukhoṣṇaḥ ||21||
śuṇṭhītoye sādhitaṃ kṣīramājaṃ tadvat pītaṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ vā | ātṛptervā sevyamānaṃ nihanyād ghrātaṃ hikkāmāśu mūtraṃ tvajāvyoḥ ||22||

div.ab: sapūtikīṭaṃ laśunogragandhāhiṅgvabjamācūrṇya `hiṅgvambunā''cūrṇya' iti pā. subhāvitaṃ tat |23|

ab.seg: kṣaudraṃ sitāṃ vāraṇakeśaraṃ ca pibedrasenekṣumadhūkajena ||23||

div.ab: pibet palaṃ vā lavaṇottamasya dvābhyāṃ palābhyāṃ haviṣaḥ samagram |24|

ab.seg: harītakīṃ koṣṇajalānupānāṃ pibedghṛtaṃ kṣāramadhūpapannam ||24||
rasaṃ kapitthānmadhupippalībhyāṃ śuktipramāṇaṃ `picupramāṇaṃ' iti pā. prapibet sukhāya ||25||
kṛṣṇāṃ sitāṃ cāmalakaṃ ca līḍhaṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhunā'thavā'pi | kolāsthimajjāñjanalājacūrṇaṃ hikkā nihanyānmadhunā'valīḍham ||26||
pāṭalāyāḥ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ gairikaṃ kaṭurohiṇī | kharjūramadhyaṃ māgadhyaḥ kāśīśaṃ dadhināma ca ||27||
catvāra ete yogāḥ syuḥ pratipādapradarśitāḥ | madhudvitīyāḥ kartavyāste hikkāsu vijānatā ||28||
kapotapārāvatalāvaśa(lla)kaśvadaṃṣṭragodhāvṛṣadaṃśajān rasān | pibet phalāmlānahimān sasaindhavān snigdhāṃstathaivarṣyamṛgadvijodbhavān ||29||
virecanaṃ pathyatamaṃ sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ ca sitopalāyutam | sadāgatāvūrdhvagate'nuvāsanaṃ vadanti kecicca hitāya hikkinām ||30||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hikkāpratiṣedho nāma (dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||50||

div.head: śvāsapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śvāsapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
yaireva kāraṇairhikkā bahubhiḥ sampravartate | taireva kāraṇaiḥ śvāso ghoro bhavati dehinām ||3||
vihāya prakṛtiṃ vāyuḥ prāṇo'tha kaphasaṃyutaḥ | śvāsayatyūrdhvago bhūtvā taṃ śvāsaṃ paricakṣate ||4||
kṣudrakastamakaśchinno mahānūrdhvaśca pañcadhā | bhidyate sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsa eko viśeṣataḥ ||5||
prāgrūpaṃ tasya hṛtpīḍā bhaktadveṣo'ratiḥ parā | ānāhaḥ pārśvayoḥ śūlaṃ vairasyaṃ vadanasya ca ||6||
kiñcidārabhamāṇasya yasya śvāsaḥ pravartate | niṣaṇṇasyaiti śāntiṃ ca sa kṣudra iti sañjñitaḥ ||7||
tṛṭsvedavamathuprāyaḥ kaṇṭhaghurghurikānvitaḥ | viśeṣāddurdine tāmyecchvāsaḥ sa tamako mataḥ ||8||
ghoṣeṇa mahatā''viṣṭaḥ sakāsaḥ sakapho naraḥ | yaḥ śvasityabalo'nnadviṭ suptastamakapīḍitaḥ `sa vai tamakapīḍitaḥ' iti pā.||9||
sa śāmyati kaphe hīne svapataśca vivardhate | mūrcchājvarābhibhūtasya jñeyaḥ pratamakastu saḥ ||10||
ādhmāto dahyamānena bastinā sarujaṃ naraḥ | sarvaprāṇena vicchinnaṃ śvasyācchinnaṃ tamādiśet ||11||
niḥsañjñaḥ pārśvaśūlārtaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho'tighoṣavān | saṃrabdhanetrastvāyamya yaḥ śvasyāt sa mahān smṛtaḥ ||12||
marmasvāyamyamāneṣu śvasanmūḍho muhuśca yaḥ | ūrdhvaprekṣī hataravastamūrdhvaśvāsamādiśet ||13||
kṣudraḥ sādhyatamasteṣāṃ tamakaḥ kṛcchra ucyate | trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti tamako durbalasya ca ||14||
snehabastiṃ vinā `snehabastimṛte iti pā. kecidūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca śodhanam | mṛdu prāṇavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvāsināmādiśanti hi ||15||
śvāse kāse ca hikkāyāṃ hṛdroge cāpi pūjitam | ghṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ saṃsiddhamabhayāviḍarāmaṭhaiḥ ||16||

div.ab: sauvarcalābhayābilvaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ `saṃyojyaṃ' iti pā. vā'navaṃ ghṛtam | pippalyādipratīvāpaṃ siddhaṃ vā prathame gaṇe ||17|| sapañcalavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ śvāsakāsau vyapohati |18|

hiṃsrāviḍaṅgapūtīkatriphalāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ ||18|| dvikṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpiścaturguṇajalāplutam | kolamātraiḥ pibettaddhi `pacettaddhi' iti pā. śvāsakāsau vyapohati ||19|| arśāṃsyarocakaṃ gulmaṃ śakṛdbhedaṃ kṣayaṃ tathā | kṛtsne vṛṣakaṣāye vā pacet sarpiścaturguṇe ||20|| tanmūlakusumāvāpaṃ śītaṃ kṣaudreṇa yojayet |21|

śṛṅgīmadhūlikābhārgīśuṇṭhītārkṣyasitāmbudaiḥ ||21|| saharidraiḥ sayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ samairāvāpya yogataḥ | ghṛtaprasthaṃ paceddhīmān śītatoye caturguṇe ||22|| śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ tathā hikkāṃ sarpiretanniyacchati |23|
suvahā kālikā bhārgī śukākhyā naiculaṃ phalam ||23|| kākādanī śṛṅgaveraṃ varṣābhūrbṛhatīdvayam | kolamātrairghṛtaprasthaṃ pacedebhirjaladvikam ||24|| kaṭūṣṇaṃ pītametaddhi śvāsāmayavināśanam |25|

ab.seg: sauvarcalayavakṣārakaṭukāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ ||25||
vacābhayāviḍaṅgaiśca `ghṛtaṃ vacāviḍaṅgaiśca' iti pā. sādhitaṃ śvāsaśāntaye | gopavallyudake siddhaṃ syādanyaddviguṇe ghṛtam ||26||

div.ab: pañcaitāni havīṃṣyāhurbhiṣajaḥ śvāsakāsayoḥ |27|

ab.seg: tālīśatāmalakyugrājīvantīkuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ ||27||
bilvapuṣkarabhūtīkasauvarcalakaṇāgnibhiḥ | pathyātejovatīyuktaiḥ sarpirjalacaturguṇam ||28||
hiṅgupādayutaṃ siddhaṃ sarvaśvāsaharaṃ param | vāsāghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ cātra hitaṃ bhavet ||29||
tailaṃ daśaguṇe siddhaṃ bhṛṅgarājarase śubhe | sevyamānaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śvāsakāsau vyapohati ||30||

div.ab: phalāmlā viṣkirarasāḥ snigdhāḥ pravyaktasaindhavāḥ | eṇādīnāṃ śirobhirvā kaulatthā vā susaṃskṛtāḥ ||31|| hanyuḥ śvāsaṃ ca kāsaṃ ca saṃskṛtāni payāṃsi ca |32|

ab.seg: timirasya `tiniśasya' iti pā. ca bījāni karkaṭākhyā ca cūrṇitā ||32||
durālabhā'tha pippalyaḥ kaṭukākhyā harītakī | śvāvinmayūraromāṇi kolā māgadhikākaṇāḥ ||33||
bhārgītvak śṛṅgaveraṃ ca śarkarā śallakāṅgajam | nṛttakauṇḍakabījāni `trikaṇṭakasya bījāni' iti pā. cūrṇitāni tu kevalam ||34||
pañca ślokārdhikāstvete lehā ye samyagīritāḥ | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ te lehyāḥ kāsaśvāsārditairnaraiḥ ||35||
saptacchadasya puṣpāṇi pippalīścāpi mastunā | pibet sañcūrṇya madhunā dhānāścāpyatha bhakṣayet ||36||
arkāṅkurairbhāvitānāṃ yavānāṃ sādhvanekaśaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ vā pibedeṣāṃ sakṣaudraṃ śvāsapīḍitaḥ ||37||
śirīṣakadalīkundapuṣpaṃ māgadhikāyutam | taṇḍulāmbuyutaṃ pītvā jayecchvāsānaśeṣataḥ ||38||

div.ab: kolamajjāṃ tālamūlamṛṣyacarmamasīmapi | lihyāt kṣaudreṇa bhārgīṃ vā sarpirmadhusamāyutām ||39|| nīcaiḥkadambabījaṃ vā sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbunā |40|
drākṣāṃ harītakīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ durālabhām ||40|| sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihan hanti śvāsān sudāruṇān |41|
haridrāṃ maricaṃ drākṣāṃ guḍaṃ rāsnāṃ kaṇāṃ śaṭīm ||41|| lihyāttailena `tailena vilihan hanyācchvāsān pāṇaharānapi' iti pā. tulyāni śvāsārto hitabhojanaḥ |42|
gavāṃ purīṣasvarasaṃ madhusarpiḥkaṇāyutam `madhumāgadhikāyutam' iti pā.||42|| lihyācchvāseṣu kāseṣu vājināṃ vā śakṛdrasam |43|
pāṇḍurogeṣu śotheṣu ye yogāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ ||43|| śvāsakāsāpahāste'pi kāsaghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ |44|
bhārgītvak tryūṣaṇaṃ tailaṃ haridrāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ||44|| pippalīṃ maricaṃ caṇḍāṃ gośakṛdrasameva ca |45|
talakoṭasya bījeṣu pacedutkārikāṃ śubhām ||45|| sevyamānā nihantyeṣā śvāsānāśu sudustarān |46|

ab.seg: purāṇasarpiḥ pippalyaḥ kaulatthā jāṅgalā rasāḥ ||46||
surā sauvīrakaṃ hiṅguḥ mātuluṅgaraso madhu | drākṣāmalakabilvāni śastāni śvāsihikkinām ||47||

div.ab: śvāsahikkāparigataṃ snigdhaiḥ svedairupācaret | āktaṃ `yuktaiḥ' iti `yuktaṃ' iti ca pā. lavaṇatailābhyāṃ tairasya grathitaḥ kaphaḥ ||48|| khastho vilayanaṃ yāti mārutaśca praśāmyati |49|

svinnaṃ `snigdhaṃ' iti pā. jñātvā tataścaiva bhojayitvā rasaudanam ||49|| vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā bhiṣag dhūmaṃ prayojayet | manaḥśilādevadāruharidrācchadanāmiṣaiḥ ||50|| lākṣorubūkamūlaiśca kṛtvā vartīrvidhānataḥ |51|

ab.seg: sarpiryavamadhucchiṣṭaśālaniryāsajaṃ `sarpirnavamadhūcchiṣṭa ...' iti pā. tathā ||51||

div.ab: śṛṅgabālakhurasnāyutvak samastaṃ gavāmapi |52|

ab.seg: turuṣkaśallakīnāṃ ca gugguloḥ padmakasya ca ||52||

div.ab: ete sarve sasarpiṣkā dhūmāḥ kāryā vijānatā |53|

ab.seg: balīyasi kaphagraste vamanaṃ savirecanam ||53||
durbale caiva rūkṣe ca tarpaṇaṃ hitamucyate | jāṅgalorabhrajairmāṃsairānūpairvā susaṃskṛtaiḥ ||54||
nidigdhikāṃ cāmalakapramāṇāṃ hiṅgvardhayuktāṃ madhunā suyuktām | lihannaraḥ śvāsanipīḍito hi śvāsaṃ jayatyeva balātryaheṇa ||55||
yathā'gniriddhaḥ pavanānuviddho `khalu kāṣṭhasaṅghaiḥ' iti pā. vajraṃ yathā vā surarājamuktam | rogāstathaite khalu durnivārāḥ śvāsaśca kāsaśca vilambikā ca ||56||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre hikkāśvāsapratiṣedho nāma (trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||51||

div.head: kāsapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kāsapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
uktā ye hetavo nṝṇāṃ rogayoḥ śvāsahikkayoḥ | kāsasyāpi ca vijñeyāsta evotpattihetavaḥ ||3||
dhūmopaghātādrajasastathaiva vyāyāmarūkṣānnaniṣevaṇācca | vimārgagatvādapi bhojanasya vegāvarodhāt kṣavathostathaiva ||4||
prāṇo hyudānānugataḥ praduṣṭaḥ sambhinnakāṃsyasvanatulyaghoṣaḥ | nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣaḥ kāsaḥ sa vidvadbhirudāhṛtastu ||5||
sa vātapittaprabhavaḥ kaphācca kṣatāttathā'nyaḥ kṣayajo'paraśca | pañcaprakāraḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirvivardhito yakṣmavikārakṛt syāt ||6||
bhaviṣyatastasya tu kaṇṭhakaṇḍūrbhojyoparodho galatālulepaḥ | svaśabdavaiṣamyamarocako'gnisādaśca `saśabdavaiṣamya...' iti pā. liṅgāni bhavantyamūni ||7||
hṛcchaṅkhamūrdhodarapārśvaśūlī kṣāmānanaḥ kṣīṇabalasvaraujāḥ | prasaktamantaḥkaphamīraṇena `prasaktavegaśca samīraṇeva' iti pā. kāsettu śuṣkaṃ svarabhedayuktaḥ ||8||
urovidāhajvaravaktraśoṣairabhyarditastiktamukhastṛṣārtaḥ | pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sa pāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ ||9||
pra(vi)lipyamānena mukhena sīdan śirorujārtaḥ kaphapūrṇadehaḥ | abhaktaruggauravasādayuktaḥ kāseta `kāsedbhṛśaṃ' iti pā. nā sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena ||10||
vakṣo'timātraṃ vihataṃ tu yasya vyāyāmabhārādhyayanābhighātaiḥ | viśliṣṭavakṣāḥ sa naraḥ saraktaṃ ṣṭhīvatyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣatajaṃ `kṣatajaḥ sa uktaḥ' iti pā. tamāhuḥ ||11||

div.ab: sa gātraśūlajvaradāhamohān prāṇakṣayaṃ copalabheta kāsī | śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam ||12|| sasarvaliṅgaṃ `taṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ' iti pā. bhṛśaduścikitsyaṃ cikitsitajñāḥ kṣayajaṃ vadanti `tamāhuḥ' iti pā.|13|

ab.seg: vṛddhatvamāsādya bhavettu `bhavatyatho vai' iti pā. yo vai yāpyaṃ tamāhurbhiṣajastu kāsam ||13||
śṛṅgīvacākaṭphalakattṛṇābdadhānyābhayābhārgyamarāhvaviśvam | uṣṇāmbunā hiṅguyutaṃ tu pītvā baddhāsyamapyāśu jahāti kāsam ||14||
phalatrikavyoṣaviḍaṅgaśṛṅgīrāsnāvacāpadmakadevakāṣṭhaiḥ `rāsnābalāpadmakadevakāṣṭhaiḥ' iti pā.| lehaḥ samaiḥ kṣaudrasitāghṛtāktaḥ kāsaṃ nihanyādacirādudīrṇam ||15||
pathyāṃ sitāmāmalakāni lājāṃ samāgadhīṃ cāpi vicūrṇya śuṇṭhīm | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ vilihīta kāsī sasaindhavāṃ voṣṇajalena kṛṣṇām ||16||
khādedguḍaṃ nāgarapippalībhyāṃ drākṣāṃ ca sarpirmadhunā'valihyāt | drākṣāṃ sitāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ saśṛṅgaveraṃ madhukaṃ tugāṃ ca ||17||
lihyādghṛtakṣaudrayutāṃ samāṃśāṃ sitopalāṃ vā maricāṃśayuktām | dhātrīkaṇāviśvasitopalāśca sañcūrṇya maṇḍena pibecca dadhnaḥ ||18||
hareṇukāṃ māgadhikāṃ ca tulyāṃ `mukhyaṃ' iti pā. dadhnā pibet kāsagadābhibhūtaḥ | ubhe haridre suradāruśuṇṭhīṃ gāyatrisāraṃ ca pibet samāṃśam ||19||
bastasya mūtreṇa sukhāmbunā vā dantīṃ dravantīṃ ca satilvakākhyām `sātilvakāṃśām' iti pā.| bhṛṣṭāni sarpīṃṣyatha bādarāṇi khādet palāśāni sasaindhavāni ||20||

div.ab: kolapramāṇaṃ prapibeddhi hiṅgu sauvīrakeṇāmlarasena vā'pi |21|
kṣaudreṇa lihyānmaricāni vā'pi bhārgīvacāhiṅgukṛtā ca vartiḥ ||21|| dhūme praśastā ghṛtasamprayuktā veṇutvagelālavaṇaiḥ kṛtā vā |22|
musteṅgudītvaṅmadhukāhvamāṃsīmanaḥśilālaiśchagalāmbupiṣṭaiḥ ||22|| vidhāya vartīśca payo'nupānaṃ dhūmaṃ pibedvātabalāsakāsī |23|

ab.seg: pibecca sīdhuṃ maricānvitaṃ vā tenāśu kāsaṃ jayati prasahya ||23||

div.ab: drākṣāmbumañjiṣṭhapurāhvayābhiḥ kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ māhiṣasamprayuktam' iti pā. mākṣikasamprayuktam |24|

ab.seg: nidigdhikānāgarapippalībhiḥ khādecca mudgānmadhunā susiddhān ||24||
utkārikāṃ sarpiṣi nāgarāḍhyāṃ paktvā samūlaistruṭikolapatraiḥ | ebhirniṣeveta kṛtāṃ ca peyāṃ tanvīṃ suśītāṃ madhunā vimiśrām ||25||
yat plīhni sarpirvihitaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ tadvātakāsaṃ jayati prasahya | vidārigandhādikṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā rasena vā vāsakajena pakvam ||26||

div.ab: virecanaṃ snaihikamatra coktamāsthāpanaṃ cāpyanuvāsanaṃ ca | dhūmaṃ pibet snaihikamapramattaḥ pibet sukhoṣṇaṃ ghṛtameva cātra ||27|| hitā yavāgvaśca raseṣu siddhāḥ payāṃsi lehāḥ saghṛtāstathaiva |28|

pracchardanaṃ kāyaśirovirekāstathaiva dhūmāḥ kavalagrahāśca ||28|| uṣṇāśca lehāḥ kaṭukā nihanyuḥ kaphaṃ viśeṣeṇa viśoṣaṇaṃ ca | kaṭutrikaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṛmighnasvarase vipakvam ||29|| nirguṇḍipatrasvarase ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ kaphotthaṃ vinihanti kāsam | pāṭhāviḍavyoṣaviḍaṅgasindhutrikaṇṭarāsnāhutabhugbalābhiḥ ||30|| śṛṅgīvacāmbhodharadevadārudurālabhābhārgyabhayāśaṭībhiḥ | samyagvipakvaṃ dviguṇena sarpirnidigdhikāyāḥ svarasena caitat ||31|| śvāsāgnisādasvarabhedabhinnānnihantyudīrṇānapi `jayati' iti pā. pañca kāsān |32|

ab.seg: vidārigandhotpalasārivādīn niṣkvāthya vargaṃ `vargān' iti pā. madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam ||32||
ghṛtaṃ pacedikṣurasāmbudugdhaiḥ kākolivarge ca saśarkaraṃ tat | prātaḥ pibet pittakṛte ca kāse ratiprasūte kṣataje ca kāse ||33||
kharjūrabhārgīmagadhāpriyālamadhūlikailāmalakaiḥ samāṃśaiḥ | cūrṇaṃ sitākṣaudraghṛtapragāḍhaṃ trīn hanti kāsānupayujyamānam ||34||
raktāharidrāñjanavahnipāṭhāmūrvopakulyā vilihet samāṃśāḥ | kṣaudreṇa kāse kṣataje kṣayotthe pibedghṛtaṃ cekṣurase vipakvam ||35||

div.ab: cūrṇaṃ pibedāmalakasya vā'pi kṣīreṇa pakvaṃ saghṛtaṃ hitāśī |36|
cūrṇāni godhūmayavodbhavāni kākolivargaśca kṛtaḥ susūkṣmaḥ ||36|| kāseṣu peyastriṣu kāsavadbhiḥ kṣīreṇa sakṣaudraghṛtena vā'pi |37|

ab.seg: guḍodakaṃ vā kvathitaṃ pibeddhi kṣaudreṇa śītaṃ maricopadaṃśam ||37||
prasthatrayeṇāmalakīrasasya śuddhasya dattvā'rdhatulāṃ guḍasya | cūrṇīkṛtairgranthikacavyajīravyoṣebhakṛṣṇāhapuṣājamodaiḥ ||38||
viḍaṅgasindhutriphalāyavānīpāṭhāgnidhānyaiśca picupramāṇaiḥ | dattvā trivṛccūrṇapalāni cāṣṭāvaṣṭau ca tailasya pacedyathāvat ||39||
taṃ bhakṣayedakṣaphalapramāṇaṃ yatheṣṭaceṣṭastrisugandhiyuktam | anena sarve grahaṇīvikārāḥ saśvāsakāsasvarabhedaśothāḥ ||40||
śāmyanti cāyaṃ ciramantaragnerhatasya puṃstvasya ca vṛddhihetuḥ | strīṇāṃ ca vandhyāmayanāśanaḥ syāt kalyāṇako nāma guḍaḥ pratītaḥ ||41||
dvipañcamūlebhakaṇātmaguptābhārgīśaṭīpuṣkaramūlaviśvān | pāṭhāmṛtāgranthikaśaṅkhapuṣpīrāsnāgnyapāmārgabalāyavāsān ||42||
dvipālikān nyasya `dvipālikāṃśāṃśca' iti pā. yavāḍhakaṃ ca harītakīnāṃ ca śataṃ gurūṇām | droṇe jalasyāḍhakasaṃyute ca kvāthe kṛte pūtacaturthabhāge ||43||
pacettulāṃ śuddhaguḍasya dattvā pṛthak ca tailāt kuḍavaṃ ghṛtācca | cūrṇaṃ ca tāvanmagadhodbhavāyā deyaṃ ca tasminmadhu siddhaśīte ||44||
rasāyanāt karṣamato vilihyāddve cābhaye nityamathāśu hanyāt | tadrājayakṣmagrahaṇīpradoṣaśophāgnimāndyasvarabhedakāsān ||45||
pāṇḍvāmayaśvāsaśirovikārān hṛdrogahikkāviṣamajvarāṃśca | medhābalotsāhamatipradaṃ ca cakāra caitadbhagavānagastyaḥ ||46||
kulīraśuktīcaṭakaiṇalāvānniṣkvāthya vargaṃ madhuraṃ ca kṛtsnam | pacedghṛtaṃ tattu niṣevyamāṇaṃ hanyāt kṣatotthaṃ kṣayajaṃ ca kāsam ||47||
śatāvarīnāgabalāvipakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidheyaṃ ca hitāya kāsinām ||48||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre kāsapratiṣedho nāma (caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||52||

div.head: svarabhedapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ svarabhedapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
atyuccabhāṣaṇaviṣādhyayanātigītaśītādibhiḥ `... viṣādhyayanābhighāta ...' iti pā. prakupitāḥ pavanādayastu | srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ ||3||

div.ab: vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanairvadati gadgadavat svaraṃ ca |4|

ab.seg: pittena pītavadanākṣipurīṣamūtro brūyādgalena paridāhasamanvitena `ca vidāhasamanvitena' iti pā.||4||

div.ab: kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanairvadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ `viśeṣāt' iti pā.|5|

ab.seg: sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampadavyaktatā ca vacasastamasādhyamāhuḥ ||5||

div.ab: dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa cā(vā)pi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ |6|

ab.seg: antargalaṃ `antargatasvaraṃ' iti pā. svaramalakṣyapadaṃ cireṇa medaścayādvadati `medo'nvayāt' iti pā. digdhagalauṣṭhatāluḥ ||6||
kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ | medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti ||7||
snigdhān svarāturanarānapakṛṣṭadoṣān nyāyena tān `saṃyojayet' iti pā. vamanarecanabastibhiśca | nasyāvapīḍamukhadhāvanadhūmalehaiḥ sampādayecca vividhaiḥ kavalagrahaiśca ||8||

div.ab: yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta |9|

ab.seg: vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha ||9||

div.ab: svaropaghāte'nilaje bhuktopari ghṛtaṃ pibet | kāsamardakavārtākamārkavasvarase śṛtam ||10|| pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ hantyanilaṃ siddhamārtagale rase |11|
yavakṣārājamodābhyāṃ citrakāmalakeṣu vā ||11|| devadārvagnikābhyāṃ vā siddhamājaṃ samākṣikam |12|

ab.seg: sukhodakānupāno vā sasarpiṣko guḍaudanaḥ ||12||

div.ab: kṣīrānupānaṃ pitte tu pibet sarpiratandritaḥ |13|

ab.seg: aśnīyācca sasarpiṣkaṃ yaṣṭīmadhukapāyasam ||13||
lihyānmadhurakāṇāṃ vā cūrṇaṃ madhughṛtāplutam | śatāvarīcūrṇayogaṃ balācūrṇamathāpi vā ||14||
pibet kaṭūni mūtreṇa kaphaje svarasaṅkṣaye | lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā ||15||

div.ab: svaropaghāte medoje kaphavadvidhiriṣyate |16|

ab.seg: sarvaje kṣayaje cāpi pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām ||16||
śarkarāmadhumiśrāṇi śṛtāni madhuraiḥ saha | pibet payāṃsi yasyoccairvadato'bhihataḥ svaraḥ ||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre chardipratiṣedho nāma (pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||53||

div.head: kṛmirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛmirogapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
ajīrṇādhyaśanāsātmyaviruddhamalināśanaiḥ | avyāyāmadivāsvapnagurvatisnigdhaśītalaiḥ ||3||
māṣapiṣṭānnavidalabisaśālūkaserukaiḥ | parṇaśākasurāśuktadadhikṣīraguḍekṣubhiḥ ||4||
palalānūpapiśitapiṇyākapṛthukādibhiḥ | svādvamladravapānaiśca śleṣmā pittaṃ ca kupyati ||5||
kṛmīn bahuvidhākārān karoti vividhāśrayān | āmapakvāśaye teṣāṃ kaphaviḍjanmanāṃ punaḥ | dhamanyāṃ raktajānāṃ ca prasavaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6||
viṃśateḥ kṛmijātīnāṃ trividhaḥ sambhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | purīṣakapharaktāni, tāsāṃ vakṣyāmi vistaram ||7||
ajavā vijavāḥ `ayavā viyavāḥ' iti pā. kipyāścipyā gaṇḍūpadāstathā | cūravo dvimukhāścaiva jñeyāḥ sapta purīṣajāḥ ||8||
śvetāḥ sūkṣmāstudantyete gudaṃ pratisaranti ca | teṣāmevāpare pucchaiḥ pṛthavaśca bhavanti hi ||9||
śūlāgnimāndyapāṇḍutvaviṣṭambhabalasaṅkṣayāḥ | prasekārucihṛdrogaviḍbhedāstu purīṣajaiḥ ||10||
raktā gaṇḍūpadā dīrghā gudakaṇḍūnipātinaḥ | śūlāṭopaśakṛdbhedapaktināśakarāśca te ||11||
darbhapuṣpā mahāpuṣpāḥ pralūnāścipiṭāstathā | pipīlikā dāruṇāśca kaphakopasamudbhavāḥ ||12||
romaśā romamūrdhānaḥ sapucchāḥ śyāvamaṇḍalāḥ | rūḍhadhānyāṅkurākārāḥ śuklāste tanavastathā ||13||

div.ab: majjādā netraleḍhārastāluśrotrabhujastathā |14|

ab.seg: śirohṛdrogavamathupratiśyāyakarāśca te ||14||
keśaromanakhādāśca dantādāḥ kikkiśāstathā | kuṣṭhajāḥ saparīsarpā jñeyāḥ śoṇitasambhavāḥ ||15||

div.ab: te saraktāśca kṛṣṇāśca snigdhāśca pṛthavastathā |16|

ab.seg: raktādhiṣṭhānajān prāyo vikārān janayanti te ||16||

div.ab: māṣapiṣṭānnavidalaparṇaśākaiḥ purīṣajāḥ | māṃsamāṣaguḍakṣīradadhitailaiḥ kaphodbhavāḥ ||17|| viruddhājīrṇaśākādyaiḥ śoṇitotthā bhavanti hi | jvaro vivarṇatā śūlaṃ hṛdrogaḥ sadanaṃ bhramaḥ ||18|| bhaktadveṣo'tisāraśca sañjātakṛmilakṣaṇam |19|
dṛśyāstrayodaśādyāstu kṛmīṇāṃ parikīrtitāḥ ||19|| keśādādyāstvadṛśyāste dvāvādyau parivarjayet |20|
eṣāmanyatamaṃ jñātvā jighāṃsuḥ snigdhamāturam ||20|| surasādivipakvena sarpiṣā vāntamāditaḥ | virecayettīkṣṇatarairyogai ... |21|

ab.seg: ... rāsthāpayecca tam ||21||
yavakolakulatthānāṃ surasādergaṇasya ca | viḍaṅgasnehayuktena kvāthena lavaṇena ca ||22||

div.ab: pratyāgate nirūhe tu naraṃ snātaṃ sukhāmbunā | yuñjyāt kṛmighnairaśanaistataḥ śīghraṃ bhiṣagvaraḥ ||23|| snehenoktena cainaṃ tu yojayet snehabastinā |24|

ab.seg: tataḥ śirīṣakiṇihīrasaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet ||24||

div.ab: kevūkasvarasaṃ vā'pi pūrvavattīkṣṇabhojanaḥ |25|

ab.seg: palāśabījasvarasaṃ kalkaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā ||25||
pāribhadrakapatrāṇāṃ kṣaudreṇa svarasaṃ pibet | pattūrasvarasaṃ vā'pi pibedvā surasādijam ||26||

div.ab: lihyādaśvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ vaiḍaṅgaṃ vā samākṣikam |27|
patrairmūṣikaparṇyā vā supiṣṭaiḥ piṣṭamiśritaiḥ ||27|| khādet pūpalikāḥ pakvā dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibedanu |28|
surasādigaṇe pakvaṃ tailaṃ vā pānamiṣyate ||28|| viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktairvā piṣṭairbhakṣyāṃstu kārayet `viḍaṅgacūrṇapiṣṭābhyāṃ tasmin bhakṣyaṃ tu kārayet' iti pā.|29|

ab.seg: tatkaṣāyaprapītānāṃ tilānāṃ snehameva vā ||29||

div.ab: śvāvidhaḥ śakṛtaścūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ subhāvitam | viḍaṅgānāṃ kaṣāyeṇa traiphalena tathaiva ca ||30|| kṣaudreṇa līḍhvā'nupibedrasamāmalakodbhavam | akṣābhayārasaṃ vā'pi... |31|

ab.seg: ... vidhireṣo'yasāmapi ||31||

div.ab: pūtīkasvarasaṃ vā'pi pibedvā madhunā saha | pibedvā pippalīmūlamajāmūtreṇa saṃyutam ||32|| saptarātraṃ pibeddhṛṣṭaṃ trapu vā dadhimastunā |33|

ab.seg: purīṣajān kaphotthāṃśca hanyādevaṃ kṛmīn bhiṣak ||33||
śirohṛdghrāṇakarṇākṣisaṃśritāṃśca pṛthagvidhān | viśeṣeṇāñjanairnasyairavapīḍaiśca sādhayet ||34||
śakṛdrasaṃ turaṅgasya suśuṣkaṃ bhāvayedati | niṣkvāthena viḍaṅgānāṃ cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ tu tat ||35||
ayaścūrṇānyanenaiva vidhinā yojayedbhiṣak | sakāṃsyanīlaṃ tailaṃ ca nasyaṃ syātsurasādike ||36||

div.ab: indraluptavidhiścāpi vidheyo romabhojiṣu |37|

ab.seg: dantādānāṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ vidhānaṃ mukharogikam ||37||

div.ab: raktajānāṃ pratīkāraṃ kuryāt kuṣṭhacikitsite |38|

ab.seg: surasādiṃ tu sarveṣu sarvathaivopayojayet ||38||

div.ab: pravyaktatiktakaṭukaṃ bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ bhavet |39|

ab.seg: kulatthakṣārasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣārapānaṃ ca pūjitam `kulatthakvāthasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṣīrapānaṃ ca pūjitam' iti pā.||39||
kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtāni caiva dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti | samāsato'mlānmadhurān himāṃśca kṛmīn jighāṃsuḥ parivarjayettu ||40||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre kṛmipratiṣedho nāma (ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||54||

div.head: udāvartapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta udāvartapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
adhaścordhvaṃ ca bhāvānāṃ pravṛttānāṃ svabhāvataḥ | na vegān dhārayet prājño vātādīnāṃ jijīviṣuḥ ||3||
vātaviṇmūtrajṛmbhāśrukṣavodgāravamīndriyaiḥ | vyāhanyamānairuditairudāvarto nirucyate ||4||

div.ab: kṣuttṛṣṇāśvāsanidrāṇāmudāvarto vidhāraṇāt |5|

ab.seg: tasyābhidhāsye vyāsena lakṣaṇaṃ ca cikitsitam ||5||

div.ab: trayodaśavidhaścāsau bhinna etaistu kāraṇaiḥ |6|

ab.seg: apathyabhojanāccāpi vakṣyate ca tathā'paraḥ ||6||

div.ab: ādhmānaśūlau hṛdayoparodhaṃ śirorujaṃ śvāsamatīva hikkām | kāsapratiśyāyagalagrahāṃśca balāsapittaprasaraṃ ca ghoram ||7|| kuryādapāno'bhihataḥ svamārge hanyāt purīṣaṃ mukhataḥ kṣipedvā |8|
āṭopaśūlau parikartanaṃ ca saṅgaḥ purīṣasya tathordhvavātaḥ ||8|| purīṣamāsyādapi vā nireti purīṣavege'bhihate narasya |9|

ab.seg: mūtrasya vege'bhihate narastu kṛcchreṇa mūtraṃ kurute'lpamalpam ||9||
meḍhre gude vaṅkṣaṇabastimuṣkanābhipradeśeṣvathavā'pi vaṅkṣaṇamuṣkayośca' iti pā. mūrdhni | ānaddhabastiśca `ānaddhabasteḥ' iti pā. bhavanti tīvrāḥ śūlāśca śūlairiva bhinnamūrteḥ ||10||
manyāgalastambhaśirovikārā jṛmbhopaghātāt pavanātmakāḥ syuḥ | śrotrānanaghrāṇavilocanotthā bhavanti tīvrāśca tathā vikārāḥ ||11||
ānandajaṃ śokasamudbhavaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptamamuñcato hi | śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena ||12||
bhavanti gāḍhaṃ kṣavathorvighātācchirokṣināsāśravaṇeṣu rogāḥ | kaṇṭhāsyapūrṇatvamatīva todaḥ kūjaśca vāyoruta vā'pravṛttiḥ ||13||

div.ab: udgāravege'bhihate bhavanti ghorā vikārāḥ pavanaprasūtāḥ |14|

ab.seg: chardervighātena bhavecca kuṣṭhaṃ yenaiva doṣeṇa vidagdhamannam ||14||
mūtrāśaye pāyuni `vā gudamuṣkayośca' iti pā. muṣkayośca śopho rujo mūtravinigrahaśca | śukrāśmarī tatsravaṇaṃ bhavedvā te te vikārā vihate tu śukre ||15||

div.ab: tandrāṅgamardārucivibhramāḥ syuḥ `tandrāṅgamardāvaruciḥ śramaśca' iti pā. kṣudho'bhighātāt kṛśatā ca dṛṣṭeḥ |16|

ab.seg: kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śravaṇāvarodhastṛṣṇābhighātaddhṛdaye vyathā ca ||16||

div.ab: śrāntasya niḥśvāsavinigraheṇa hṛdrogamohāvathavā'pi gulmaḥ |17|

ab.seg: jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo'ṅgaśirokṣijāḍyaṃ nidrābhighātādathavā'pi tandrā ||17||
tṛṣṇārditaṃ parikliṣṭaṃ kṣīṇaṃ śūlairabhidrutam | śakṛdvamantaṃ matimānudāvartinamutsṛjet ||18||

div.ab: sarveṣveteṣu vidhivadudāvarteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ | vāyoḥ kriyā vidhātavyāḥ svamārgapratipattaye ||19|| sāmānyataḥ pṛthaktvena kriyāṃ bhūyo nibodha me |20|

ab.seg: āsthāpanaṃ mārutaje snigdhasvinne viśiṣyate ||20||

div.ab: purīṣaje tu kartavyo vidhirānāhiko bhavet |21|

sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirāṃ mūtre tvabhihate pibet ||21|| elāṃ vā'pyatha madyena kṣīraṃ vā'pi pibennaraṃ | dhātrīphalānāṃ svarasaṃ sajalaṃ vā pibettryaham ||22|| rasamaśvapurīṣasya gardabhasyāthavā pibet | māṃsopadaṃśaṃ madhu vā pibedvā sīdhu gauḍikam ||23|| bhadradāru ghanaṃ mūrvā haridrā madhukaṃ tathā | kolapramāṇāni pibedāntarikṣeṇa vāriṇā ||24|| duḥsparśāsvarasaṃ vā'pi kaṣāyaṃ kuṅkumasya ca | ervārubījaṃ toyena pibedvā'lavaṇīkṛtam ||25|| pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ drākṣārasamathāpi vā |26|

ab.seg: yogāṃśca vitaredatra pūrvoktānaśmarībhidaḥ ||26||
mūtrakṛcchrakramaṃ cāpi kuryānniravaśeṣataḥ | bhūyo vakṣyāmi yogān yān mūtrāghātopaśāntaye ||27||

div.ab: snaihaiḥ svedairudāvartaṃ jṛmbhājaṃ samupācaret |28|

ab.seg: aśrumokṣo'śruje kāryaḥ snigdhasvinnasya dehinaḥ ||28||

div.ab: tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍābhyāṃ tīkṣṇagandhopaśiṅghanaiḥ | vartiprayogairathavā kṣavasaktiṃ pravartayet ||29|| (tīkṣṇauṣadhapradhamanairathavā''dityaraśmibhiḥ||) |
udgāraje kramopetaṃ snaihikaṃ dhūmamācaret ||30|| surāṃ sauvarcalavatīṃ bījapūrarasānvitām |31|
chardyāghātaṃ yathādoṣaṃ samyak snehādibhirjayet ||31|| sakṣāralavaṇopetamabhyaṅgaṃ cātra dāpayet |32|

ab.seg: bastiśuddhikarāvāpaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ payaḥ ||32||
āvārināśāt kvathitaṃ pītavantaṃ prakāmataḥ | ramayeyuḥ ramayeran' iti pā. priyā nāryaḥ śukrodāvartinaṃ naram ||33||

div.ab: kṣudvighāte hitaṃ snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam |34|

ab.seg: tṛṣṇāghāte pibenmanthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā'pi śītalām ||34||

div.ab: bhojyo rasena viśrāntaḥ śramaśvāsāturo naraḥ |35|

ab.seg: nidrāghāte pibet kṣīraṃ svapyācceṣṭakathā `svapyācceṣṭakathārataḥ' iti pā. naraḥ ||35||
ādhmānādyeṣu rogeṣu yathāsvaṃ prayateta hi | yacca yatra bhavetprāptaṃ tacca tasmin prayojayet ||36||

div.ab: vāyuḥ koṣṭhānugo rūkṣaiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaiḥ | bhojanaiḥ kupitaḥ sadya udāvartaṃ karoti hi ||37|| vātamūtrapurīṣāsṛkkaphamedovahāni vai | srotāṃsyudāvartayati purīṣaṃ cātivartayet ||38|| tato hṛdbastiśūlārto gauravārucipīḍitaḥ | vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi kṛcchreṇa kurute naraḥ ||39|| śvāsakāsapratiśyāyadāhamohavamijvarān | tṛṣṇāhikkāśirorogamanaḥśravaṇavibhramān ||40|| labhate ca bahūnanyān vikārān vātakopajān |41|
taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ snigdhaṃ svinnaṃ nirūhayet ||41|| doṣato bhinnavarcaskaṃ bhuktaṃ cāpyanuvāsayet |42|
na cecchāntiṃ vrajatyevamudāvartaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||42|| athainaṃ bahuśaḥ svinnaṃ yuñjyāt snehavirecanaiḥ |43|

ab.seg: pāyayeta trivṛtpīluyavānīramlapācanaiḥ ||43||
hiṅgukuṣṭhavacāsvarjiviḍaṅgaṃ vā dviruttaram | yogāvetāvudāvartaṃ śūlaṃ cānilajaṃ `cāpi niyacchataḥ' iti pā. hataḥ ||44||

div.ab: devadārvagnikau kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ `vacāṃ' iti pā. pathyāṃ palaṅkaṣām | pauṣkarāṇi ca mūlāni toyasyardhāḍhake pacet ||45|| pādāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pītamudāvartamapohati |46|

ab.seg: mūlakaṃ śuṣkamārdraṃ ca varṣābhūḥ pañcamūlakam ||46||
ārevataphalaṃ cāpsu paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet | tat pīyamānaṃ śāstyugramudāvartamaśeṣataḥ `śamayedudāvartamaśeṣataḥ' iti pā.||47||
vacāmativiṣāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yavakṣāraṃ harītakīm | kṛṣṇāṃ nirdahanīṃ cāpi pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā ||48||

div.ab: ikṣvākumūlaṃ madanaṃ viśalyātiviṣe vacām | kuṣṭhaṃ kiṇvāgnikau caiva pibettulyāni pūrvavat ||49|| mūtreṇa devadārvagnitriphalābṛhatīḥ pibet |50|
yavaprasthaṃ phalaiḥ sārdhaṃ kaṇṭakāryā jalāḍhake ||50|| paktvā'rdhaprasthaśeṣaṃ tu pibeddhiṅgusamanvitam |51|
madanālābubījāni pippalīṃ sanidigdhikām ||51|| sañcūrṇya pradhamennāḍyā viśatyetadyathā gudam |52|

ab.seg: cūrṇaṃ nikumbhakampillaśyāmekṣvākvagnikodbhavam ||52||
kṛtavedhanamāgadhyorlavaṇānāṃ ca sādhayet | gavāṃ mūtreṇa tā vartīḥ kārayettu gudānugāḥ | sadyaḥ śarmakarāvetau yogāvamṛtasammatau ||53||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātentre udāvartapratiṣedho nāma (saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||55||

div.head: visūcikāpratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto visūcikāpratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
ajīrṇamāmaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vidagdhaṃ ca yadīritam | visūcyalasakau tasmādbhaveccāpi vilambikā ||3||
sūcībhiriva gātrāṇi tudan santiṣṭhate'nilaḥ | yasyājīrṇena sā vaidyairucyate ti `tu' iti pā. visūcikā ||4||
na tāṃ parimitāhārā labhante viditāgamāḥ | mūḍhāstāmajitātmāno labhante kaluṣāśayāḥ `'śanalolupāḥ' iti pā.||5||
mūrcchātisārau vamathuḥ pipāsā śūlaṃ bhramodveṣṭanajṛmbhadāhāḥ | vaivarṇyakampau hṛdaye rujaśca bhavanti tasyāṃ śirasaśca bhedaḥ ||6||
kukṣirānahyate'tyarthaṃ pratāmyati vikūjati | niruddho mārutaścāpi kukṣau `kukṣāvupari dhāvati' iti pā. viparidhāvati ||7||
vātavarconirodhaśca kukṣau yasya bhṛśaṃ bhavet | tasyālasakamācaṣṭe tṛṣṇodgārāvarodhakau `tṛṣṇodgārau tu yasya tu' iti pā.||8||
duṣṭaṃ tu bhuktaṃ kaphamārutābhyāṃ pravartate nordhvamadhaśca yasya | vilambikāṃ tāṃ bhṛśaduścikitsyāmācakṣate `tu vivarjanīyāṃ' iti pā. śāstravidaḥ purāṇāḥ ||9||
yatrasthamāmaṃ virujettameva deśaṃ viśeṣeṇa vikārajātaiḥ | doṣeṇa yenāvatataṃ svaliṅgaistaṃ `śarīraṃ tallakṣaṇairāmasamudbhavaiśca' iti pā. lakṣayedāmasamudbhavaiśca ||10||
yaḥ śyāvadantauṣṭhanakho'lpasañjñaśchardyardito'bhyantarayātanetraḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ sarvavimuktasandhiryāyānnaraḥ so'punarāgamāya ||11||
sādhyāsu pārṣṇyordahanaṃ praśastamagnipratāpo vamanaṃ ca tīkṣṇam | pakve tato'nne tu vilaṅghanaṃ syāt sampācanaṃ cāpi virecanaṃ ca ||12||

div.ab: viśuddhadehasya hi sadya eva mūrcchātisārādirupaiti śāntim |13|

ab.seg: āsthāpanaṃ cāpi vadanti pathyaṃ sarvāsu yogānaparānnibodha ||13||
pathyāvacāhiṅgukaliṅgagṛñjasauvarcalaiḥ sātiviṣaiśca cūrṇam | sukhāmbupītaṃ vinihantyajīrṇaṃ śūlaṃ visūcīmaruciṃ ca sadyaḥ ||14||
kṣārāgadaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ viḍaṃ vā guḍapragāḍhānatha sarṣapān vā | amlena vā saindhavahiṅguyuktau sabījapūrṇau saghṛtau trivargau ||15||
kaṭutrikaṃ vā lavaṇairupetaṃ pibet snuhīkṣīravimiśritaṃ tu | kalyāṇakaṃ vā lavaṇaṃ pibetu yaduktamādāvanilāmayeṣu ||16||

div.ab: kṛṣṇājamodakṣavakāṇi vā'pi tulyau pibedvā magadhānikumbhau | dantīyutaṃ vā magadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibet koṣavatīrasena ||17|| uṣṇābhiradbhirmagadhodbhavānāṃ kalkaṃ pibennāgarakalkayuktam |18|
vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ haridre mūlaṃ samaṃ cāpyatha mātuluṅgyāḥ ||18|| chāyāviśuṣkā guṭikāḥ kṛtāstā hanyurvisūcīṃ nayanāñjanena |19|
suvāmitaṃ sādhuvirecitaṃ vā sulaṅghitaṃ manujaṃ viditvā ||19|| peyādibhirdīpanapācanīyaiḥ samyakkṣudhārtaṃ samupakrameta |20|
āmaṃ śakṛdvā nicitaṃ krameṇa bhūyo vibaddhaṃ viguṇānilena ||20|| pravartamānaṃ na yathāsvamenaṃ vikāramānāhamudāharanti |21|
tasmin bhavantyāmasamudbhave tu tṛṣṇāpratiśyāyaśirovidāhāḥ ||21|| āmāśaye śūlamatho gurutvaṃ hṛllāsa udgāravighātanaṃ ca |22|
stambhaḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhapurīṣamūtre śūlo'tha mūrcchā sa `ca śakṛdvamiśca' iti pā. śakṛdvamecca ||22|| śvāsaśca pakvāśayaje bhavanti liṅgāni cātrālasakodbhavāni |23|

ab.seg: āmodbhave vāntamupakrameta saṃsargabhaktakramadīpanīyaiḥ ||23||

div.ab: athetaraṃ yo na śakṛdvamettamāmaṃ jayet svedanapācanaiśca |24|

ab.seg: visūcikāyāṃ parikīrtitāni dravyāṇi vairecanikāni yāni ||24||
tānyeva vartīrviracedvicūrṇya mahiṣyajāvībhagavāṃ tu mūtraiḥ | svinnasya pāyau viniveśya tāśca cūrṇāni caiṣāṃ pradhamettu nāḍyā ||25||

div.ab: mūtreṣu saṃsādhya yathāvidhānaṃ dravyāṇi yānyūrdhvamadhaśca yānti | kvāthena tenāśu niruhayecca mūtrārdhayuktena samākṣikeṇa ||26|| tribhaṇḍiyuktaṃ lavaṇaprakuñcaṃ dattvā viriktakramamācarecca |27|

ab.seg: eṣveva tailena ca sādhitena prāptaṃ yadi syādanuvāsayecca ||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre visūcikāpratiṣedho nāma (aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ ) ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||56||

div.head: arocakapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'rocakapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
doṣaiḥ pṛthak saha ca cittaviparyayācca bhaktāyaneṣu hṛdi cāvatate pragāḍham | nānne rucirbhavati taṃ bhiṣajo vikāraṃ bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti ||3||

div.ab: hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ virasānanatvaṃ vātātmake bhavati liṅgamarocake tu |4|

ab.seg: hṛddāhacoṣabahutā mukhatiktatā ca mūrcchā satṛḍ bhavati pittakṛte tathaiva ||4||

div.ab: kaṇḍūgurutvakaphasaṃsravasādatandrāḥ śleṣmātmake madhuramāsyamarocake tu |5|

ab.seg: sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā bahūni rūpāṇyathāsya hṛdaye samudīrayanti ||5||

div.ab: saṃrāgaśokabhayaviplutacetasastu cintākṛto bhavati so'śucidarśanācca |6|
vāte vacāmbuvamanaṃ kṛtavān pibecca snehaiḥ surābhirathavoṣṇajalena cūrṇam ||6|| kṛṣṇāviḍaṅgayavabhasmahareṇubhārgīrāsnailahiṅgulavaṇottamanāgarāṇām |7|

ab.seg: pitte guḍāmbumadhurairvamanaṃ praśastaṃ snehaḥ sasaindhavasitāmadhusarpiriṣṭaḥ ||7||

div.ab: nimbāmbuvāmitavataḥ kaphaje'nupānaṃ rājadrumāmbu madhunā tu sadīpyakaṃ syāt |8|
cūrṇaṃ yaduktamathavā'nilaje tadeva... |8|

ab.seg: ...sarvaiśca sarvakṛtamevamupakrameta ||8||
drākṣāpaṭolaviḍavetrakarīranimbamūrvābhayākṣabadarāmalakendravṛkṣaiḥ | bījaiḥ karañjanṛpavṛkṣabhavaiśca piṣṭairlehaṃ pacet surabhimūtrayutaṃ yathāvat ||9||
mustāṃ vacāṃ trikaṭukaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca bhārgīṃ ca kuṣṭhamatha nirdahanīṃ ca piṣṭvā | mūtre'vije dviradamūtrayute pacedvā pāṭhāṃ tugāmativiṣāṃ rajanīṃ ca mukhyām ||10||
maṇḍūkimarkamamṛtāṃ ca salāṅgalākhyāṃ mūtre pacettu mahiṣasya vidhānavidvā | etānna santi caturo lihatastu lehān gulmāruciśvasanakaṇṭhahṛdāmayāśca ||11||
sātmyān svadeśaracitān `sadeśaracitān' iti pā. vividhāṃśca bhakṣyān pānāni mūlaphalaṣāḍavarāgayogān | adyādrasāṃśca vividhān vividhaiḥ prakārairbhuñjīta cāpi laghurūkṣamanaḥsukhāni ||12||

div.ab: āsthāpanaṃ vidhivadatra virecanaṃ ca kuryānmṛdūni śirasaśca virecanāni |13|
trīṇyūṣaṇāni rajanītriphalāyutāni cūrṇīkṛtāni yavaśūkavimiśritāni ||13|| kṣaudrāyutāni vitarenmukhabodhanārtha `mukhadhāvanārtham' iti pā.... |14|

... manyāni tiktakaṭukāni ca bheṣajāni | mustādirājataruvargadaśāṅgasiddhaiḥ kvāthairjayenmadhuyutairvividhaiśca lehaiḥ ||14|| mūtrāsavairguḍakṛtaiśca tathā tvariṣṭaiḥ kṣārāsavaiśca madhumādhavatulyagandhaiḥ |15|

ab.seg: syādeṣa eva kaphavātahate vidhiśca śāntiṃ gate hutabhuji praśamāya tasya ||15||

icchābhighātabhayaśokahate'ntaragnau bhāvān bhavāya vitaret khalu śakyarūpān | artheṣu cāpyapaciteṣu `cātipatiteṣu' iti pā. punarbhavāya paurāṇikaiḥ śrutiśatairanumānayettam `anubhāvayettam' iti pā.||16||
dainyaṃ gate manasi bodhanamatra śastaṃ yadyat priyaṃ tadupasevyamarocake tu ||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre'rocakapratiṣedho nāma (ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||57||

div.head: mūtrāghātapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūtrāghātapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātakuṇḍalikā'ṣṭhīlā vātabastistathaiva ca | mūtrātītaḥ sajaṭharo mūtrotsaṅgaḥ kṣayastathā ||3||
mūtragranthirmūtraśukramuṣṇavātastathaiva ca | mūtraukasādau dvau cāpi rogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ ||4||
raukṣyādvegavighātādvā vāyurantaramāśritaḥ `vāyurbastau savedanam' iti pā.| mūtraṃ carati saṅgṛhya viguṇaḥ kuṇḍalīkṛtaḥ ||5||
sṛjedalpālpamathavā sarujaskaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | vātakuṇḍalikāṃ taṃ tu vyādhiṃ vidyāt sudāruṇam ||6||
śakṛnmārgasya basteśca vāyurantaramāśritaḥ | aṣṭhīlāvaddhanaṃ granthiṃ karotyacalamunnatam ||7||
viṇmūtrānilasaṅgaśca tatrādhmānaṃ ca jāyate | vedanā ca parā bastau vātāṣṭhīleti tāṃ viduḥ ||8||
vegaṃ vidhārayedyastu mūtrasyākuśalo naraḥ | niruṇaddhi mukhaṃ tasya basterbastigato'nilaḥ ||9||
mūtrasaṅgo bhavettena bastikukṣinipīḍitaḥ | vātabastiḥ sa vijñeyo vyādhiḥ kṛcchraprasādhanaḥ ||10||
vegaṃ sandhārya mūtrasya yo bhūyaḥ sraṣṭumicchati | tasya nābhyeti yadi vā kathañcitsampravartate ||11||
pravāhato mandarujamalpamalpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | mūtrātītaṃ tu taṃ vidyānmūtravegavighātajam ||12||
mūtrasya vihate vege tadudāvartahetunā | apānaḥ kupito vāyurudaraṃ pūrayedbhṛśam ||13||
nābheradhastādādhmānaṃ janayettīvravedanam | taṃ mūtrajaṭharaṃ vidyādadhaḥsrotonirodhanam ||14||
bastau vā'pyathavā nāle maṇau vā yasya dehinaḥ | mūtraṃ pravṛttaṃ sajjeta saraktaṃ `saktaṃ cāpi pravāhataḥ' iti pā. vā pravāhataḥ ||15||
sravecchanairalpamalpaṃ sarujaṃ vā'tha nīrujam | viguṇānilajo vyādhiḥ sa mūtrotsaṅgasañjñitaḥ ||16||
rūkṣasya klāntadehasya bastisthau pittamārutau | sadāhavedanaṃ kṛcchraṃ kuryātāṃ mūtrasaṅkṣayam ||17||
abhyantare bastimukhe vṛtto'lpaḥ sthira eva ca | vedanāvānati sadā `vedanāvānabhiṣyandī' iti pā. mūtramārganirodhanaḥ ||18||
jāyate sahasā yasya granthiraśmarilakṣaṇaḥ | sa mūtragranthirityevamucyate vedanādibhiḥ `vedavādibhiḥ' iti pā.||19||
pratyupasthitamūtrastu maithunaṃ yo'bhinandati | tasya mūtrayutaṃ retaḥ sahasā sampravartate ||20||
purastādvā'pi mūtrasya paścādvā'pi kadācana | bhasmodakapratīkāśaṃ mūtraśukraṃ taducyate ||21||
vyāyāmādhvātapaiḥ pittaṃ bastiṃ prāpyānilāvṛtam | bastiṃ meḍhraṃ gudaṃ caiva pradahan srāvayedadhaḥ ||22||
mūtraṃ hāridramathavā saraktaṃ raktameva vā | kṛcchrāt pravartate jantoruṣṇavātaṃ vadanti tam ||23||
viśadaṃ pītakaṃ mūtraṃ sadāhaṃ bahalaṃ tathā | śuṣkaṃ bhavati yaccāpi rocanācūrṇasannibham ||24||
mūtraukasādaṃ taṃ vidyādrogaṃ pittakṛtaṃ budhaḥ | picchilaṃ saṃhataṃ śvetaṃ tathā kṛcchrapravartanam ||25||
śuṣkaṃ bhavati yaccāpi śaṅkhacūrṇaprapāṇḍuram | mūtraukasādaṃ taṃ vidyādāmayaṃ dvādaśaṃ `cāparaṃ' iti pā. kaphāt ||26||

div.ab: kaṣāyakalkasarpīṃṣi bhakṣyān lehān payāṃsi ca | kṣāramadyā(dhvā)savasvedān bastīṃścottarasañjñitān ||27|| vidadhyānmatimāṃstatra vidhiṃ cāśmarināśanam |28|

ab.seg: mūtrodāvartayogāṃśca kārtsnyenātra `kārtsnyeneha' iti pā. prayojayet ||28||
kalkamervārubījānāmakṣamātraṃ sasaindhavam | dhānyāmlayuktaṃ pītvaiva mūtrakṛcchrāt pramucyate ||29||
surāṃ sauvarcalavatīṃ mūtrakṛcchrī pibennaraḥ | madhu māṃsopadaṃśaṃ vā pibedvā'pyatha gauḍikam ||30||
pibet kuṅkumakarṣaṃ vā madhūdakasamāyutam | rātriparyuṣitaṃ prātastathā sukhamavāpnuyāt ||31||
dāḍimāmlāṃ yutāṃ `dāḍimāmlayutāṃ' iti pā. mukhyāmelājīrakanāgaraiḥ | pītvā surāṃ salavaṇāṃ mūtrakṛcchrāt pramucyate ||32||
pṛthakparṇyādivargasya mūlaṃ gokṣurakasya ca | ardhaprasthena toyasya pacet kṣīracaturguṇam ||33||
kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tacchītaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ `sitāghṛtayutaṃ' iti pā. pibet | naro mārutapittotthamūtrāghātanivāraṇam ||34||
niṣpīḍya vāsasā samyagvarco rāsabhavājinoḥ | rasasya kuḍavaṃ tasya pibenmūtrarujāpaham ||35||
