mustābhayādevadārumūrvāṇāṃ madhukasya ca | pibedakṣasamaṃ kalkaṃ mūtradoṣanivāraṇam ||36||
abhayāmalakākṣāṇāṃ kalkaṃ badarasammitam | ambhasā'lavaṇopetaṃ pibenmūtrarujāpaham ||37||
udumbarasamaṃ kalkaṃ drākṣāyā jalasaṃyutam | pibet paryuṣitaṃ rātrau `vāri' iti pā. śītaṃ mūtrarujāpaham ||38||

div.ab: nidigdhikāyāḥ svarasaṃ pibet kuḍavasammitam | mūtradoṣaharaṃ kalya ... |39|

ab.seg: ... mathavā kṣaudrasaṃyutam ||39||
prapīḍyāmalakānāṃ tu rasaṃ kuḍavasammitam | pītvā'gadī bhavejjanturmūtradoṣarujāturaḥ ||40||

div.ab: dhātrīphalarasenaivaṃ sūkṣmailāṃ vā pibennaraḥ |41|

ab.seg: piṣṭvā'thavā suśītena śālitaṇḍulavāriṇā ||41||
tālasya taruṇaṃ mūlaṃ trapusasya rasaṃ tathā | śvetaṃ karkaṭakaṃ caiva prātastu payasā pibet ||42||
śṛtaṃ vā madhuraiḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirmiśraṃ pibennaraḥ | mūtradoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ tathaivāśmarināśanam `śukradoṣaharaṃ param' iti pā.||43||
balāśvadaṃṣṭrākrauñcāsthikokilākṣakataṇḍulān | śataparvakamūlaṃ ca devadāru sacitrakam ||44||
akṣabījaṃ ca surayā kalkīkṛtya pibennaraḥ | mūtradoṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ tathaivāśmarināśanam `tathaivāśmariśodhanam' iti pā.||45||
pāṭalākṣāramāhṛtya saptakṛtvaḥ parisrutam | pibenmūtravikāraghnaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ tailamātrayā ||46||
nalāśmabhedadarbhekṣutrapusairvārubījakān | kṣīre pariśṛtān tatra pibet sarpiḥsamāyutān ||47||

div.ab: pāṭalyā yāvaśūkācca pāribhadrāttilādāpi | kṣārodakena matimān tvageloṣaṇacūrṇakam ||48|| pibedguḍena miśraṃ vā lihyāllehān pṛthak pṛthak |49|

ab.seg: ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi mūtradoṣe kramaṃ hitam ||49||
snehasvedopapannānāṃ hitaṃ teṣu virecanam | tataḥ saṃśuddhadehānāṃ hitāścottarabastayaḥ ||50||
sttrīṇāmatiprasaṅgena śoṇitaṃ yasya dṛśyate `sicyate' iti pā.| maithunoparamastasya bṛṃhaṇaśca vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||51||
tāmracūḍavasā tailaṃ hitaṃ cottarabastiṣu | vidhānaṃ tasya pūrvaṃ hi vyāsataḥ parikīrtitam ||52||
kṣaudrārdhapātraṃ dattvā ca pātraṃ tu kṣīrasarpiṣaḥ | śarkarāyāśca cūrṇaṃ ca drākṣācūrṇaṃ ca tatsamam ||53||
svayaṅguptāphalaṃ caiva tathaivekṣurakasya ca | pippalīcūrṇasaṃyuktamardhabhāgaṃ prakalpayet ||54||
tadaikadhyaṃ samānīya khajenābhipramanthayet | tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ cūrṇaṃ līḍhvā kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet ||55||
etat sarpiḥ prayuñjānaḥ śuddhadeho naraḥ sadā | mūtradoṣāñjayet sarvānanyayogaiḥ `sarvān ye ca syurbhṛśadurjayāḥ' iti pā. sudurjayān ||56||
jayecchoṇitadoṣāṃśca vandhyā garbhaṃ labheta ca | nārī caitat prayuñjānā yonidoṣāt pramucyate ||57||

div.ab: balā kolāsthi madhukaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrā'tha śatāvarī | mṛṇālaṃ ca kaśeruśca bījānīkṣurakasya ca ||58|| sahasravīryāṃ'śumatī payasyā saha kālayā | śṛgālavinnā'tibalā bṛṃhaṇīyo gaṇastathā ||59|| etāni samabhāgāni matimān saha sādhayet | caturguṇena payasā guḍasya tulayā saha ||60|| droṇāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pūtaṃ pacettena ghṛtāḍhakam | tat siddhaṃ kalaśe sthāpyaṃ kṣaudraprasthena saṃyutam ||61|| sarpiretat prayuñjāno mūtradoṣāt pramucyate | tugākṣīryāśca cūrṇāni śarkarāyāstathaiva ca ||62|| kṣaudreṇa tulyānyāloḍya praśaste'hani lehayet | tasya khādedyathāśakti mātrāṃ kṣīraṃ tataḥ pibet ||63|| śukradoṣāñjayenmartyaḥ prāśya samyak suyantritaḥ | vyavāyakṣīṇaretāstu sadyaḥ saṃlabhate sukham ||64|| ojasvī balavānmartyaḥ pibanneva ca hṛṣyati |65|

ab.seg: citrakaḥ sārivā caiva balā kālānusārivā ||65||
drākṣā viśālā pippalyastathā citraphalā bhavet | tathaiva madhukaṃ pathyāṃ dadyādāmalakāni ca ||66||
ghṛtāḍhakaṃ pacedebhiḥ kalkaiḥ `kalkairikṣusamanvitaiḥ' iti pā. karṣasamanvitaiḥ | kṣīradroṇe jaladroṇe tatsiddhamavatārayet ||67||
śītaṃ parisrutaṃ caiva śarkarāprasthasaṃyutam | tugākṣīryāśca tat sarvaṃ matimān parimiśrayet ||68||
tato mitaṃ pibetkāle yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam | vātaretāḥ śleṣmaretāḥ pittaretāstu yo bhavet ||69||
raktaretā granthiretāḥ pibedicchannarogatām | jīvanīyaṃ ca vṛṣyaṃ ca sarpiretadbalāvaham ||70||
prajñāhitaṃ `prajāhitaṃ' iti pā. ca dhanyaṃ ca sarvarogāpahaṃ śivam | sarpiretat prayuñjānā strī garbhaṃ labhate'cirāt ||71||
asṛgdoṣāñjayeccāpi yonidoṣāṃśca saṃhatān | mūtradoṣeṣu sarveṣu kuryādetaccikitsitam ||72||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre mūtrāghātapratiṣedho nāma (viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||58||

div.head: mūtrakṛcchrapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto mūtrakṛcchrapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
vātena pittena kaphena sarvaistathā'bhighātaiḥ śakṛdaśmarībhyām | tathā'paraḥ śarkarayā sukaṣṭo mūtropaghātaḥ kathito'ṣṭamastu ||3||
alpamalpaṃ samutpīḍya muṣkamehanabastibhiḥ | phaladbhiriva kṛcchreṇa vātāghātena mehati ||4||
hāridramuṣṇaṃ raktaṃ vā muṣkamehanabastibhiḥ | agninā dahyāmānābhaiḥ pittaghātena mehati ||5||
snigdhaṃ śuklamanuṣṇaṃ ca muṣkamehanabastibhiḥ | saṃhṛṣṭaromā gurubhiḥ śleṣmāghātena mehati ||6||
dāhaśītarujāviṣṭo nānāvarṇaṃ mahurmuhuḥ | tāmyamānastu kṛcchreṇa sānnipātena mehati ||7||

div.ab: mūtravāhiṣu śalyena kṣateṣvabhihateṣu ca | srotaḥsu mūtrāghātastu jāyate bhṛśavedanaḥ `bhṛśadāruṇaḥ' iti pā.||8|| vātabastestu tulyāni tasya liṅgāni lakṣayet | śakṛtastu pratīghātādvāyurviguṇatāṃ gataḥ ||9|| ādhmānaṃ ca saśūlaṃ ca mūtrasaṅgaṃ karoti hi |10|

ab.seg: aśmarīhetukaḥ pūrvaṃ mūtrāghāta udāhṛtaḥ ||10||

div.ab: aśmarī śarkarā caiva tulye ‘tulyasambhavalakṣaṇā' iti pā. sambhavalakṣaṇaiḥ | śarkarāyā viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇu kīrtayato mama ||11|| pacyamānasya pittena bhidyamānasya vāyunā | śleṣamaṇo'vayavā bhinnāḥ śarkarā iti sañjñitāḥ ||12|| hṛtpīḍā vepathuḥ śūlaṃ kukṣau `kukṣāvagniśca durbalaḥ' iti pā. vahniḥ sudurbalaḥ | tābhirbhavati mūrcchā ca mūtrāghātaśca dāruṇaḥ ||13|| mūtraveganirastāsu tāsu śāmyati vedanā | yāvadanyā `yāvadasyāḥ' iti pā. punarnaiti guḍikā srotaso mukham ||14|| śarkarāsambhavasyaitanmūtrāghātasya lakṣaṇam |15|

ab.seg: cikitsitamathaiteṣāmaṣṭānāmapi vakṣyate ||15||
aśmarīṃ ca samāśritya yaduktaṃ prasamīkṣya tat | yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta snehādimapi ca kramam ||16||

div.ab: śvadaṃṣṭrāśmabhidau kumbhīṃ hapuṣāṃ kaṇṭakārikām | balāṃ śatāvarīṃ rāsnāṃ varuṇaṃ girikarṇikām ||17|| tathā vidārigandhādiṃ saṃhṛtya traivṛtaṃ pacet | tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tat peyaṃ tena vā'pyanuvāsanam ||18|| dadyāduttarabastiṃ ca vātakṛcchropaśāntaye |19|
śvadaṃṣṭrāsvarase tailaṃ saguḍakṣīranāgaram ||19|| paktvā tat pūrvavadyojyaṃ tatrānilarujāpaham |20|
tṛṇotpalādikākolīnyagrodhādigaṇaiḥ kṛ(śṛ)tam ||20|| pītaṃ ghṛtaṃ pittakṛcchraṃ nāśayeta kṣīrameva vā |21|

ab.seg: dadyāduttarabastiṃ ca pittakṛcchropaśāntaye ||21||
ebhireva kṛtaḥ snehastrividheṣvapi bastiṣu | hitaṃ virecanaṃ cekṣukṣīradrākṣārasairyutam ||22||
surasoṣakamustādau varuṇādau ca yat `saṃskṛtam' iti pā. kṛtam | tailaṃ tathā yavāgvādi kaphāghāte `kaphakṛcchre' iti pā. praśasyate ||23||

div.ab: yathādoṣocchryaṃ kuryādetāneva ca sarvaje |24|
phalguvṛścīradarbhāśmasāracūrṇaṃ ca vāriṇā ||24|| surekṣurasadarbhāmbupītaṃ kṛcchrarujāpaham |25|

ab.seg: tathā'bhighātaje kuryāt sadyovraṇacikitsitam ||25||
mūtrakṛcchre śakṛjjāte kāryā vātaharī kriyā | svedāvagāhāvabhyaṅgabasticūrṇakriyāstathā ||26||
ye tvanye tu tathā kṛcchre tayo proktaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ ||27||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate kāyacikitsātantre mūtrakṛcchrapratiṣedho nāma (ekaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekonaṣaṣṭhatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||59||

div.head: amānuṣopasargapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'mānuṣopasargapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
niśācarebhyo rakṣyastu nityameva kṣatāturaḥ | iti yat prāgabhihitaṃ vistarastasya vakṣyate ||3||
guhyānāgatavijñānamanavasthā'sahiṣṇutā | kriyā vā'mānuṣī yasmin sagrahaḥ parikīrtyate ||4||
aśuciṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ kṣataṃ va yadi vā'kṣatam | hiṃsyurhiṃsāvihārārthaṃ satkārārthamathāpi vā ||5||
asaṅkhyeyā grahagaṇā grahādhipatayastu ye | vyajyante vividhākārā bhidyante te tathā'ṣṭadhā ||6||
devāstathā śatrugaṇāśca teṣāṃ gandharvayakṣāḥ pitaro bhujaṅgāḥ | rakṣāṃsi yā cāpi piśācajātireṣo'ṣṭako devagaṇo grahākhyaḥ ||7||
santuṣṭaḥ śucirapi ceṣṭagandhamālyo nistandrī hyavitathasaṃskṛtaprabhāṣī | tejasvī sthiranayano varapradātā brahyaṇyo bhavati naraḥ sa devajuṣṭaḥ ||8||
saṃsvedī dvijagurudevadoṣavaktā jihmākṣo vigatabhayo vimārgadṛṣṭiḥ | santuṣṭo bhavati na cānnapānajātairduṣṭātmā bhavati ca devaśatrujuṣṭaḥ ||9||
hṛṣṭātmā pulinavanāntaropasevī svācāraḥ priyaparigītagandhamālyaḥ | nṛtyan vai prahasati cāru cālpaśabdaṃ gandharvagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ ||10||
tāmrākṣaḥ priyatanuraktavastradhārī gambhīro drutamatiralpavāk `drutagatiḥ' iti pā. sahiṣṇuḥ | tejasvī vadati ca kiṃ dadāmi kasmai yo yakṣagrahaparipīḍito manuṣyaḥ ||11||
pretebhyo visṛjati saṃstareṣu piṇḍān śāntātmā jalamapi cāpasavyavastraḥ | māṃsepsustilaguḍapāyasābhikāmastadbhukto `tadbhaktaḥ' iti pā. bhavati pitṛgrahābhibhūtaḥ ||12||
bhūmau yaḥ prasarati sarpavat kadācit sṛkkiṇyau vilikhati `vilihati' iti pā. jihvayā tathaiva | nidrālurgaḍamadhudugdhapāyasepsurvijñeyo bhavati bhujaṅgamena juṣṭaḥ ||13||
māṃsāsṛgvividhasurāvikāralipsurnirlajjo bhṛśamatiniṣṭhuro'tiśūraḥ | krodhālurvipulabalo niśāvihārī śaucadviḍ bhavati ca rakṣasā gṛhītaḥ ||14||
uddhastaḥ kṛśaparuṣaścirapralāpī durgandho bhṛśamaśucistathā'tilolaḥ | bahvāśī vijanahimāmburātrisevī vyāvigno ‘vyāceṣṭaṃ’ iti pā. bhramati rudan piśācajuṣṭaḥ ||15||
sthūlākṣastvaritagatiḥ svaphenalehī nidrāluḥ patati ca kampate ca yo'ti | yaścādridviradanagādivicyutaḥ san saṃsṛṣṭo na bhavati vārdhakena juṣṭaḥ ||16||
devagrahāḥ paurṇamāsyāmasurāḥ sandhyayorapi | gandharvāḥ prāyaśo'ṣṭamyāṃ yakṣāśca pratipadyatha ||17||
kṛṣṇakṣaye ca pitaraḥ pañcamyāmapi coragāḥ | rakṣāṃsi niśi paiśācāścaturdaśyāṃ viśanti ca ||18||
darpaṇādīn yathā chāyā śītoṣṇaṃ prāṇino yathā | svamaṇiṃ bhāskarasyosrā yathā dehaṃ ca dehadhṛk | viśanti ca na dṛśyante grahāstadvaccharīriṇam ||19||
tapāṃsi tīvrāṇi tathaiva dānaṃ vratāni dharmo niyamāśca satyam | guṇāstathā'ṣṭāvapi teṣu nityā vyastāḥ samastāśca yathāprabhāvam ||20||
na te manuṣyaiḥ saha saṃviśanti na vā manuṣyān kvacidāviśanti | ye tvāviśantīti vadanti mohātte bhūtavidyāviṣayādapohyāḥ ||21||
teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ paricārakā ye koṭīsahasrāyutapahmasaṅkhyāḥ | asṛgvasāmāṃsabhujaḥ subhīmā niśāvihārāśca tamāviśanti ||22||
niśācarāṇāṃ teṣāṃ hi ye devagaṇamāśritāḥ | te tu tatsattvasaṃsargādvijñeyāstu tadañjanāḥ ||23||
devagrahā iti punaḥ procyante'śucayaśca śucayaśca ye' iti pā. ye | devavacca namasyante pratyarthyante ca devavat ||24||

svāmiśīlakriyācārāḥ `svāmiśīlakriyācārakramā eva surādīṣu| niṛuteryā duhitarastāsāṃ saprasavāḥ smṛtāḥ' iti hārāṇacandasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ krama eṣa surādiṣu | niṛuteryā duhitarastāsāṃ sa prasavaḥ smṛtaḥ ||25||

div.ab: satyatvādapavṛtteṣu vṛttisteṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ kṛtā |26|
hiṃsāvihārā ye keciddevabhāvamupāśritāḥ `divyaṃ bhāvamupāśritāḥ' iti pā.||26|| bhūtānīti kṛtā sañjñā teṣāṃ sañjñāpravaktṛbhiḥ |27|
grahasañjñāni bhūtāni yasmadvettyanayā bhiṣak ||27|| vidyayā bhūtavidyātvamata eva nirucyate |28|
teṣāṃ śāntyarthamanvicchan vaidyastu susamāhitaḥ ||28|| japaiḥ saniyamairhomairārabheta cikitsitum |29|
raktāni gandhamālyāni bījāni madhusarpiṣī ||29|| bhakṣyāśca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhirucyate |30|

ab.seg: vastrāṇi gandhamālyāni māṃsāni `vastrāṇi madyamāṃsāni kṣīrāṇi iti pā. rudhirāṇi ca yāni yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭāni tāni tebhyaḥ pradāpayet ||30||

div.ab: hiṃsanti manujān yeṣu prāyaśo divaseṣu tu ||31|| dineṣu teṣu deyāni tadbhūtavinivṛttaye |32|
devagrahe devagṛhe hutvā'gniṃ prā(dā) payedvalim ||32|| kuśasvastikapūpājyacchatrapāyasasambhṛtam |33|

ab.seg: asurāya yathākālaṃ vidadhyāccatvarādiṣu ||33||

div.ab: gandharvasya gavāṃ madhye madyamāṃsāmbujāṅgalam `madyaṃ māsaṃ ca jāṅgalam' iti pā.|34|
hṛdye veśmani yakṣasya kulmāṣāsṛksurādibhiḥ ||34|| atimuktakakundābjaiḥ puṣpaiśca vitaredvalim |35|

ab.seg: nadyāṃ pitṛgrahāyeṣṭaṃ kuśāstaraṇabhūṣitam ||35||

div.ab: tatraivopahareccāpi nāgāya vividhaṃ balim |36|

ab.seg: catuṣpathe rākṣasasya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu vā ||36||

div.ab: śūnyāgāre piśācasya tīvraṃ balimupāharet |37|
pūrvamācaritairmantrairbhūtavidyānidarśitaiḥ ||37|| na śakyā balibhirjetuṃ yogaistān samupācaret |38|

ab.seg: ajarkṣacarmaromāṇi śalyakolūkayostathā ||38||
hiṅgu mūtraṃ ca bastasya dhūmamasya prayojayet | etena śāmyati kṣipraṃ balavānapi yo grahaḥ ||39||

div.ab: gajāhvapippalīmūlavyoṣāmalakasarṣapān | godhānakulamārjāraṛṣyapittaprapeṣitān `ṛṣyapittaprabhāvitān' iti pā.||40|| nasyābhyañjanasekeṣu vidadhyādyogatattvavit |41|

ab.seg: kharāśvāśvatarolūkakarabhaśvaśṛgālajam ||41||
purīṣaṃ gṛdhrakākānāṃ `gṛdhrajaṃ ka(nya)ṅkorvarāhasya' iti pā. varāhasya ca peṣayet | bastamūtreṇa tatsiddhaṃ tailaṃ syāt pūrvavaddhitam ||42||

div.ab: śirīṣabījaṃ laśunaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ siddhārthakaṃ vacām | mañjiṣṭhāṃ rajanīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ bastamūtreṇa peṣayet ||43|| vartyaśchāyāviśuṣkāstāḥ sapittā nayanāñjanam |44|
naktamālaphalaṃ vyoṣaṃ mūlaṃ śyonākabilvayoḥ ||44|| haridre ca kṛtā vartyaḥ pūrvavannayanāñajanam |45|
saindhavaṃ kaṭukāṃ hiṅgaṃ vayaḥsthāṃ ca vacāmapi | bastamūtreṇa sampiṣṭaṃ matsyapittena pūrvavat ||45|| ye ye grahā na sidhyanti sarveṣāṃ nayanāñjanam |46|

purāṇasarpirlaśunaṃ hiṅga siddhārthakaṃ vacā ||46|| golomī cājalomī ca bhūtakeśī jaṭā tathā | kukkuṭā sarpagandhā ca tathā kāṇavikāṇike ||47|| vajraproktā ṛṣyaproktā' iti pā. vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavallikā | arkamūlaṃ trikaṭukaṃ latā srotojamañjanam ||48|| naipālī haritālaṃ ca rakṣoghnā ye ca kīrtitāḥ | siṃhavyāghrarkṣamārjāradvīpivājigavāṃ tathā ||49|| śvāvicchalyakagodhānāmuṣṭrasya nakulasya ca | viṭtvagromavasāmūtraraktapittanakhādayaḥ `viṭtvagromavasāmajjaraktamūtranakhatvacaḥ' iti pā.||50|| asmin varge bhiṣak kuryāttailāni ca ghṛtāni ca | pānābhyañjananasyeṣu tāni yojyāni jānatā ||51|| avapīḍe'ñjane caiva vidadhyādguṭikīkṛtam | vidadhīta parīṣeke kvathitaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ tathā ||52|| uddhūlane, ślakṣṇapiṣṭaṃ pradehe cāvacārayet | eṣa sarvavikārāṃstu mānasānaparājitaḥ ||53|| hanyādalpena kālena snehādirapi ca kramaḥ `kramāt' iti pā.|54|

ab.seg: na cācaukṣaṃ ‘na cāyuktaṃ’ iti pā. prayuñjīta prayogaṃ devatāgrahe ||54||

div.ab: ṛte piśācādanyatra pratikūlaṃ na cācaret |55|

ab.seg: vaidyāturau nihanyuste dhruvaṃ kruddhā mahaujasaḥ ||55||

div.ab: hitāhitīye yaccoktaṃ nityameva samācaret |56|

ab.seg: tataḥ prāpsyati siddhiṃ ca yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhiṣak ||56||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate bhūtavidyātantre'mānuṣopasargapratiṣedho nāma (prathamo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||60||

div.head: apasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto'pasmārapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
smṛtirbhūtārthavijñānamapaśca parivarjane | apasmāra iti proktastato'yaṃ vyādhirantakṛt ||3||
mithyātiyogendriyārthakarmaṇāmabhisevanāt | viruddhamalināhāravihārakupitairmalaiḥ ||4||
veganigrahaśīlānāmahitāśucibhojinām | rajastamobhibhūtānāṃ gacchatāṃ ca rajasvalām ||5||
tathā kāmabhayodvegakrodhaśokādibhirbhṛśam | cetasyabhihate puṃsāmapasmāro'bhijāyate ||6||
hṛtkampaḥ śūnyatā svedo dhyānaṃ mūrcchā pramūḍhatā | nidrānāśaśca tasmiṃstu bhaviṣyati bhavantyatha ||7||

div.ab: sañjñāvaheṣu srotaḥsu doṣavyāpteṣu mānavaḥ | rajastamaḥparīteṣu mūḍho bhrāntena cetasā ||8|| vikṣipan hastapādaṃ ca vijihmabhrūrvilocanaḥ | dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ vivṛtākṣaḥ patet kṣitau ||9|| alpakālāntaraṃ cāpi punaḥ sañjñāṃ labheta saḥ | so'pasmāra iti proktaḥ... |10|
... sa ca dṛṣṭaścaturvidhaḥ ||10|| vātapittakaphairnṝṇāṃ caturthaḥ sannipātataḥ |11|

ab.seg: vepamāno daśan dantān śvasan phenaṃ vamannapi ||11||
yo brūyādvikṛtaṃ sattvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māmanudhāvati | tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt so'pasmāro'nilātmakaḥ ||12||

div.ab: tṛṭtāpasvedamūrcchārto dhunvannaṅgāni vihvalaḥ | yo brūyādvikṛtaṃ sattvaṃ pītaṃ māmanudhāvati ||13|| tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt sa pittabhava ucyate |14|

ab.seg: śītahṛllāsanidrārtaḥ patan bhūmau vaman kapham ||14||
yo brūyādvikṛtaṃ sattvaṃ śuklaṃ māmanudhāvati | tato me cittanāśaḥ syāt so'pasmāraḥ kaphātmakaḥ ||15||

div.ab: hṛdi todastṛḍutkledastriṣvapyeteṣu saṅkhyayā |16|

ab.seg: pralāpaḥ kūjanaṃ kleśaḥ pratyekaṃ tu bhavediha ||16||

div.ab: sarvaliṅgasamavāyaḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaje |17|
animittāgamādvyādhergamanādakṛte'pi ca ||17|| āgamāccāpyapasmāraṃ vadantyanye na doṣajam |18|

ab.seg: kramopayogāddoṣāṇāṃ kṣaṇikatvāttathaiva ca ||18||
āgamādvaiśvarūpyācca sa tu nirvarṇyate budhaiḥ | deve varṣatyapi yathā bhūmau bījāni kānicit ||19||
śaradi pratirohanti tathā vyādhisamudbhavaḥ | sthāyinaḥ kecidalpena kālenābhipravardhitāḥ ||20||
darśayanti vikārāṃstu viśvarūpānnisargataḥ | apasmāro mahāvyādhistasmāddoṣaja eva tu ||21||

div.ab: tasya kāryo vidhiḥ sarvo ya unmādeṣu vakṣyate | purāṇasarpiṣaḥ pānamabhyaṅgaścaiva pūjitaḥ ||22|| upayogo grahoktānāṃ yogānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | tataḥ sidhyanti te sarve yogairanyaiśca sādhayet | śigrukaṭvaṅgakiṇvāhinimbatvagrasasādhitam ||23|| caturguṇe gavāṃ mūtre tailamabhyañjane hitam |24|
godhānakulanāgānāṃ pṛṣatarkṣagavāmapi ||24|| pitteṣu siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pānābhyaṅgeṣu pūjitam |25|

ab.seg: tīkṣṇairubhayatobhāgaiḥ śiraścāpi viśodhayet ||25||

div.ab: pūjāṃ rudrasya kurvīta tadgaṇānāṃ ca nityaśaḥ |26|
vātikaṃ bastibhiścāpi paittikaṃ tu virecanaiḥ ||26|| kaphajaṃ vamanairdhīmānapasmāramupācaret |27|

ab.seg: kulatthayavakolāni śaṇabījaṃ palaṅkaṣām ||27||
jaṭilāṃ pañcamūlyau dve pathyāṃ cotkvāthya yatnataḥ | bastamūtrayutaṃ sarpiḥ pacettadvātike hitam ||28||
kākolyādipratīvāpaṃ siddhaṃ ca prathame gaṇe | payomadhusitāyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ tat paittike hitam ||29||
kṛṣṇāvacāmustakādyairyuktamāragvadhādike | pakvaṃ ca mūtravarge tu śleṣmāpasmāriṇe hitam ||30||
suradrumavacākuṣṭhasiddhārthavyoṣahiṅgubhiḥ | mañjiṣṭhārajanīyugmasamaṅgātriphalāmbudaiḥ ||31||
karañjabījaśairīṣagirikarṇīhutāśanaiḥ | siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma sarpirmūtracaturguṇam ||32||
kṛmikuṣṭhagaraśvāsabalāsaviṣamajvarān | sarvabhūtagrahonmādānapasmārāṃśca nāśayet ||33||
daśamūlendravṛkṣatvaṅmūrvābhārgīphalatrikaiḥ | śampākaśreyasīsaptaparṇāpāmārgaphalgubhiḥ ||34||
śṛtaiḥ kalkaiśca bhūnimbapūtīkavyoṣacitrakaiḥ | trivṛtpāṭhāniśāyugmasārivādvayapauṣkaraiḥ ||35||
kaṭukāyāsadantyugrānīlinīkrimiśatrubhiḥ `kaṭukāmadayantyugrāḥ' iti pā.| sarpirebhiśca gokṣīradadhimūtraśakṛdrasaiḥ ||36||
sādhitaṃ pañcagavyākhyaṃ sarvāpasmārabhūtanut | cāturthakakṣayaśvāsānunmādāṃśca niyacchati ||37||

div.ab: bhārgīśṛte pacet kṣīre śālitaṇḍulapāyasam | tryahaṃ śuddhāya taṃ bhoktuṃ varāhāyopakalpayet ||38|| jñātvā ca madhurībhūtaṃ taṃ viśasyānnamuddharet | trīn bhāgāṃstasya cūrṇasya kiṇvabhāgena saṃsṛjet ||39|| maṇḍodakārthe deyaśca bhārgīkvāthaḥ suśītalaḥ | śuddhe kumbhe nidadhyācca sambhāraṃ taṃ surāṃ tataḥ ||40|| jātagandhāṃ jātarasāṃ pāyayedāturaṃ bhiṣak |41|

ab.seg: sirāṃ vidhyedatha prāptāṃ maṅgalyāni ca dhārayet ||41||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate bhūtavidyātantre'pasmārapratiṣedho nāma (dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||61||

div.head: unmādapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta unmādapratiṣedhamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
madayantyuddha(dga)tā doṣā yasmādunmārgamāśritāḥ `unmārgamāśritāḥ' iti pā.| mānaso'yamato vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtitaḥ `kīrtyate' iti pā.||3||
ekaikaśaḥ `ekaśo'tha' iti pā. samastaiśca doṣairatyarthamūrcchitaiḥ | mānasenā ca duḥkhena sa pañcavidha ucyate ||4||
viṣādbhavati ṣaṣṭhaśca yathāsvaṃ tatra bheṣajam | sa cāpravṛddhastaruṇo madasañjñāṃ bibharti ca ||5||
mohodvegau svanaḥ śrotre gātrāṇāmapakarṣaṇam | atyutsāho'ruciścānne svapne kaluṣabhojanam `kaluṣamajjanam' iti pā.||6||
vāyunonmathanaṃ cāpi bhramaścakragatasya `bhramaśca kramatastathā' iti pā. vā | yasya syādacireṇaiva unmādaṃ so'dhigacchati ||7||
rūkṣacchaviḥ paruṣavāgdhamanītato vā śītāturaḥ `śvāsāturaḥ' iti pā. kṛśatanuḥ sphuritāṅgasandhiḥ | āsphoṭayatyaṭati gāyati nṛtyaśīlo vikrośati bhramati cāpyanilaprakopāt ||8||
tṛṭsvedadāhabahulo bahubhugvinidraśchāyāhimānilajalāntavihārasevī | tīkṣṇo himāmbunicaye'pi sa vahniśaṅkī pittāddivā nabhasi paśyati tārakāśca ||9||
chardyagnisādasadanārucikāsayukto yoṣidviviktaratiralpamatipracāraḥ | nidrāparo'lpakathano'lpabhuguṣṇasevī rātrau bhṛśaṃ bhavati cāpi kaphaprakopāt ||10||
sarvātmake pavanapittakaphā yathāsvaṃ saṃharṣitā iva ca liṅgamudīrayanti ||11||
caurairnarendrapuruṣairaribhistathā'nyairvitrāsitasya dhanabāndhavasaṅkṣayādvā | gāḍhaṃ kṣate manasi ca priyayā riraṃsorjāyeta cotkaṭataro manaso vikāraḥ ||12||

div.ab: citraṃ sa jalpati manonugataṃ visañjño gāyatyatho hasati roditi mūḍhasañjñaḥ `cāpi mūḍhaḥ' iti pā.|13|

ab.seg: raktekṣaṇo hatabalendriyabhāḥ sudīnaḥ śyāvānano viṣakṛte'tha `viṣakṛte ca bhavedvisañjñaḥ' iti pā. bhavet parāsuḥ ||13||
snigdhaṃ svinnaṃ tu manujamunmādārtaṃ viśodhayet | tīkṣṇairubhayatobhāgaiḥ śirasaśca virecanaiḥ ||14||
vividhairavapīḍaiśca sarṣapasnehasaṃyutaiḥ | yojayitvā tu taccūrṇaṃ ghrāṇe tasya `nasyaṃ' iti pā. prayojayet ||15||
satataṃ dhūpayeccainaṃ śvagomāṃsaiḥ supūtibhiḥ | sarṣapānāṃ ca tailena nasyābhyaṅgau hitau sadā ||16||

div.ab: darśayedadbhutānyasya vadennāśaṃ priyasya vā | bhīmākārairnarairnāgairdāntairvyālaiśca nirviṣaiḥ ||17|| bhīṣayet saṃyataṃ pāśaiḥ kaśābhirvā'tha tāḍayet | yantrayitvā suguptaṃ vāṃ trāsayettaṃ tṛṇāgninā ||18|| jalena tarjayedvā'pi rajjughātairvibhāvayet | balavāṃścāpi saṃrakṣet jale'ntaḥ parivāsayet | pratudedārayā cainaṃ marmāghātaṃ vivarjayet | veśmano'ntaḥ praviśyainaṃ rakṣaṃstadveśma dīpayet ||19|| sāpidhāne jaratkūpe `kūpe cakrapidhāne vā' iti pā. satataṃ vā nivāsayet |20|

ab.seg: tryahāttryahādyavāgūśca tarpaṇān `dadyātsaktūñjalena vā' iti pā. vā pradāpayet ||20||
kevalānambuyuktān vā kulmāṣān vā bahuśrutaḥ | hṛdyaṃ yaddīpanīyaṃ ca tatpathyaṃ tasya bho(yo)jayet | (viḍaṅgatriphalāmustamañjiṣṭhādāḍimotpalaiḥ | śyāmailavālukailābhiścandanāmaradārubhiḥ ||22||
barhiṣṭharajanīkuṣṭhaparṇinīsārivādvayaiḥ | hareṇukātrivṛddantīvacātālīsakeśaraiḥ ||23||
dvikṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ sarpirmālatīkusumaiḥ saha | gulmakāsajvaraśvāsakṣayonmādanivāraṇam ||24||
etadeva hi sampakvaṃ jīvanīyopasambhṛtam | caturguṇena dugdhena mahākalyāṇamucyate ||25||
apasmāraṃ grahaṃ śoṣaṃ klaibyaṃ kārśyamabījatām | ghṛtametannihantyāśu ye cādau gaditā gadāḥ ||26||
barhiṣṭhakuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhākaṭukailāniśāhvayaiḥ | tagaratriphalāhiṅguvājigandhāmaradrumaiḥ ||27||
vacā'jamodākākolīmedāmadhukapadmakaiḥ | saśarkaraṃ hitaṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ kṣīracaturguṇam ||28||
bālānāṃ grahajuṣṭānāṃ puṃsā duṣṭālparetasām | khyātaṃ phalaghṛtaṃ strīṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ cāśu garbhadam) ||29||
brāhmīmaindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu surāṃ jaṭām | viṣaghnīṃ laśunaṃ rāsnāṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām ||30||
jyotiṣmatīṃ nāgaraṃ `nāgavinnāṃ' iti pā. ca anantāmabhayāṃ tathā | saurāṣṭrīṃ ca samāṃśāni gajamūtreṇa `ajāmūtreṇa' iti pā. peṣayet ||31||
chāyāviśuṣkāstadvartīryojayedvidhikovidaḥ | avapīḍe'ñjane'bhyaṅge nasye dhūme pralepane ||32||

div.ab: uropāṅgalalāṭeṣu sirāścāsya vimokṣayet |33|

ab.seg: apasmārakriyāṃ cāpi grahoddiṣṭāṃ ca kārayet ||33||

div.ab: śāntadoṣaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca snehabastibhirācaret |34|

ab.seg: unmādeṣu ca sarveṣu kuryāccittaprasādanam | mṛdupūrvāṃ made'pyevaṃ kriyāṃ mṛdvīṃ prayojayeta ||34||
śokaśalyaṃ vyapanayedunmāde pañcame bhiṣak | viṣaje mṛdupūrvāṃ ca viṣaghnīṃ kārayet kriyām ||35||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantrāntargate bhūtavidyātantre unmādapratiṣedho nāma (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||62||
athāto rasabhedavikalpamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
doṣāṇāṃ pañcadaśadhā prasaro'bhihitastu yaḥ | triṣaṣṭyā rasābhedānāṃ tatprayojanamucyate ||3||
avidagdhā vidagdhāśca bhidyante te triṣaṣṭidhā | rasabhedatriṣaṣṭiṃ tu vīkṣya vīkṣyāvacārayet ||4||
ekaikenānugamanaṃ ekaikenānugamanādbhāgaśo ya udīritāḥ' iti pā. bhāgaśo yadudīritam | doṣāṇāṃ rasānāṃ iti pā., tatra matimān triṣaṣṭiṃ tu prayojayet ||5||
yathākramapravṛttānāṃ dvikeṣu madhuro rasaḥ | pañcānukramate yogānamlaścatura eva tu ||6||
trīṃścānugacchati raso lavaṇaḥ kaṭuko dvayam | tiktaḥ kaṣāyamanveti te dvikā daśa pañca ca ||7||

tadyathā- madhurāmlaḥ(1), madhuralavaṇaḥ(2), madhurakaṭukaḥ(3), madhuratiktaḥ(4), madhurakaṣāyaḥ(5), etepañcānukrāntā madhureṇa; amlalavaṇaḥ(1), amlakaṭukaḥ(2), amlatiktaḥ(3), amlakaṣāyaḥ(4), ete catvāro'nukrāntā amlena; lavaṇakaṭukaḥ(1), lavaṇatiktaḥ(2), lavaṇakaṣāyaḥ(3), ete trayo'nukrāntā lavaṇena; kaṭutiktaḥ(1), kaṭukaṣāyaḥ(2), dvāvetāvanukrāntau kaṭukena; tiktakaṣāyaḥ(1) eka evānukrāntastiktena; evamete `evamete pañcadaśa dvikāḥ' iti pā. pañcadaśa dvikasaṃyogā vyākhyātāḥ ||8||
trikān vakṣyāmaḥ- ādau prayujyamānastu madhuro daśa gacchati | ṣaḍamlo lavaṇastasmādardhamekaṃ tathā `rasaḥ' iti pā. kaṭuḥ ||9||

tadyathā- madhurāmlalavaṇaḥ(1), madhurāmlakaṭukaḥ(2), madhurāmlatiktaḥ(3), madhurāmlakaṣāyaḥ(4), madhuralavaṇakaṭukaḥ(5), madhuralavaṇatiktāḥ(6), madhuralavaṇakaṣāyaḥ(7), madhurakaṭukatiktaḥ(8), madhurakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(9), madhuratiktakaṣāyaḥ(10), evameṣāṃ daśānāṃ trikasaṃyogānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ(1), amlalavaṇatiktaḥ(2), amlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ(3), amlakaṭutiktaḥ(4), amlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(5), amlatiktakaṣāyaḥ(6), evameṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāmādāvamlaḥ prayujyate; lavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ(1), lavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(2), lavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ(3), evameṣāṃ trayāṇāmādau lavaṇaḥ prayujyate; kaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(1), evamekasyādau kaṭukaḥ prayujyate; evamete trikasaṃyogā viṃśatirvyākhyātāḥ ||10||
catuṣkān vakṣyāmaḥ | catuṣkarasasaṃyogānmadhuro daśa gacchati | caturo'mlo'nugacchecca lavaṇastvekameva tu ||11||

madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaḥ(1), madhurāmlalavaṇatiktaḥ(2), madhurāmlalavaṇakaṣāyaḥ(3), madhurāmlakaṭukatiktaḥ(4), madhurāmlakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(5), madhurāmlatiktakaṣāyaḥ(6), madhuralavaṇakaṭukatiktaḥ(7), madhuralavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(8), madhuralavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ(9), madhurakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(10), evameṣāṃ daśānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ(1), amlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(2), amlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ(3), amlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(4), evameṣāṃ caturṇāmādāvamlaḥ; lavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(1), evamekasyādau lavaṇaḥ; evamete catuṣkarasasaṃyogāḥ pañcadaśa kīrtitāḥ ||12||
pañcakān vakṣyāmaḥ | pañcakān pañca madhura ekamamlastu gacchati ||13||

madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktaḥ(1), madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭukaṣāyaḥ(2), madhurāmlalavaṇatiktakaṣāyaḥ(3), madhurāmlakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(4), madhuralavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(5), evameṣāṃ pañcānāmādau madhuraḥ prayujyate; amlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ(1), evamekasyādāvamlaḥ; evamete ṣaṭ pañcakasaṃyogā vyākhyātāḥ ||14||
ṣaṭkamekaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ; ekastu ṣaṭkasaṃyogaḥ- madhurāmlalavaṇakaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ; eṣa eka eva ṣaṭsaṃyogaḥ ||15||
ekaikaśca ṣaḍrasā bhavanti- madhuraḥ(1), amlaḥ(2), lavaṇaḥ(3), kaṭukaḥ(4), tiktaḥ(5), kaṣāyaḥ(6), iti ||16||
bhavanti `bhavati cātra' iti kvacitpustake na paṭhyate cātra- eṣā triṣaṣṭirvyākhyātā rasānāṃ rasānurasacintakaiḥ' iti pā. rasacintakaiḥ | doṣabhedatriṣaṣṭyāṃ tu prayoktavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||17||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre tantrabhūṣaṇādhyāyeṣu rasabhedavikalpādhyāyo nāma (prathamaḥ, āditaḥ) triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||63||

div.head: svasthavṛttādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ svasthavṛttamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||
sūtrasthāne samuddiṣṭaḥ svastho bhavati yādṛśaḥ | tasya `tasyādito rakṣaṇaṃ hi cikitsāyāṃ mayoditam' iti pā. yadrakṣaṇaṃ taddhi cikitsāyāḥ prayojanam ||3||
tasya yadvṛttamuktaṃ hi rakṣaṇaṃ ca mayā''ditaḥ | tasminnarthāḥ samāsoktā vistareṇeha vakṣyate ||4||
yasmin yasminnṛtau ye ye doṣāḥ kupyanti dehinām | teṣu teṣu pradātavyāḥ rasāste te vijānatā ||5||

div.ab: praklinnatvāccharīrāṇāṃ varṣāsu bhiṣajā khalu varṣāsu khalu dehinām' iti pā.| mande'gnau kopamāyānti sarveṣāṃ `saṅgha(ha)rṣāt' iti pā. mārutādayaḥ ||6|| tasmāt kledaviśuddhyarthaṃ doṣasaṃharaṇāya `doṣasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca' iti pā. ca | kaṣāyatiktakaṭukai rasairyuktamapadravam ||7|| nātisnigdhaṃ nātirūkṣamuṣṇaṃ dīpanameva ca | deyamannaṃ nṛpataye yajjalaṃ coktamāditaḥ ||8|| taptāvaratamambho vā pibenmadhusamāyutam | ahni meghānilāviṣṭe'tyarthaśītāmbusaṅkule ||9|| taruṇatvādvidāhaṃ ca gacchantyoṣadhayastadā | matimāṃstannimittaṃ ca nātivyāyāmamācaret ||10|| atyambupānāvaśyāyagrāmyadharmātapāṃstyajet | bhūbāṣpaparihārārthaṃ śayīta ca vihāyasi ||11|| śīte sāgnau nivāte ca guruprāvaraṇe gṛhe | yāyānnāgavadhūbhiśca praśastāgurubhūṣitaḥ ||12|| divāsvapnamajīrṇaṃ ca varjayettatra yatnataḥ |13|

sevyāḥ śaradi yatnena kaṣāyasvādutiktakāḥ ||13|| kṣīrekṣuvikṛtikṣaudraśālimudgādijāṅgalāḥ | śvetasrajaścandrapādāḥ pradoṣe laghu cāmbaram ||14|| salilaṃ ca prasannatvāt sarvameva tadā hitam | saraḥsvāplavanaṃ caiva kamalotpalaśāliṣu ||15|| pradoṣe śaśinaḥ pādāścandanaṃ cānulepanam | tiktasya sarpiṣaḥ pānairasṛksrāvaiśca yuktitaḥ ||16|| varṣāsūpacitaṃ pittaṃ hareccāpi virecanaiḥ | nopeyāttīkṣṇamamloṣṇaṃ kṣāraṃ svapnaṃ divā''tapam ||17|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caiva maithunaṃ cāpi varjayet | (svāduśītajalaṃ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate medhyaṃ śucisphaṭikanirmalam ||18|| śaraccandrāṃśunirdhautamagastyodayanirviṣam | prasannatvācca salilaṃ sarvameva tadā hitam ||19|| sacandanaṃ sakarpūraṃ vāsaścāmalinaṃ laghu | bhajecca śāradaṃ mālyaṃ sīdhoḥ pānaṃ ca yuktitaḥ ||20|| pittapraśamanaṃ yacca tacca sarvaṃ samācaret) |21|

ab.seg: (hemantaḥ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate śītalo rūkṣo mandasūryo'nilākulaḥ ||21||
tatastu śītamāsādya vāyustatra prakupyati | koṣṭhasthaḥ śītasaṃsparśādantaḥpiṇḍīkṛto'nalaḥ ||22||
rasamucchoṣayatyāśu tasmāt snigdhaṃ tadā hitam) | hemante lavaṇakṣāratiktāmlakaṭukotkaṭam ||23||
sasarpistailamahimamaśanaṃ hitamucyate | tīkṣṇānyapi ca pānāni pibedagurubhūṣitaḥ pibedagururūpitaḥ' iti pā.||24||
tailāktasya sukhoṣṇe ca vārikoṣṭhe'vagāhanam | sāṅgārayāne mahati kauśeyāstaraṇāstṛte ||25||
śayīta śayane taistairvṛto garbhagṛhodare | strīḥ śliṣṭvā'gurudhūpāḍhyāḥ pīnorujaghanastanīḥ ||26||
prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ tarpito nṛpaḥ | (madhuraṃ ayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake nopalabhyate tiktakaṭukamamlaṃ lavaṇameva ca ||27||
annapānaṃ tilān māṣāñchākāni ca dadhīni ca | tathekṣuvikṛtīḥ śālīn sugandhāṃśca navānapi ||28||
prasahānūpamāṃsāni kravyādabilaśāyinām | audakānāṃ plavānāṃ ca pādināṃ copasevayet ||29||
madyāni ca prasannāni yacca kiñcit balapradam | kāmatastanniṣeveta puṣṭimicchan himāgame ||30||
divāsvapnamajīrṇaṃ ca varjayettatra yatnataḥ) | eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire samudāhṛtaḥ ||31||

div.ab: (hemante ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacit pustake na paṭhyate nicitaḥ śleṣmā śaityācchītaśarīriṇām | auṣṇyādvasante kupitaḥ kurute ca gadān bahūn ||32|| tato'mlamadhurasnigdhalavaṇāni gurūṇi ca | varjayedvamanādīni karmāṇyapi ca kārayet ||33|| ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ yavāñchītān mudgān nīvārakodravān | lāvādiviṣkirarasairdadyādyūṣaiśca yuktitaḥ ||34|| paṭolanimbavārtākatiktakaiśca himātyaye | sevenmadhvāsavāriṣṭān sīdhumādhvīkamādhavān ||35|| vyāyāmamañjanaṃ dhūmaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca kavalagraham | sukhāmbunā ca sarvārthān seveta kusumāgame) ||36|| tīkṣṇarūkṣakaṭukṣārakaṣāyaṃ koṣṇamadravam | yavamudgamadhuprāyaṃ vasante bhojanaṃ hitam ||37|| vyāyamo'tra niyuddhādhvaśilānirghātajo hitaḥ | utsādanaṃ tathā snānaṃ vanitāḥ kānanāni ca ||38|| seveta nirhareccāpi hemantopacitaṃ kapham | śirovirekavamananirūhakavalādibhiḥ ||39|| varjayenmadhurasnigdhadivāsvapnagurudravān |40|
vyāyāmamuṣṇamāyāsaṃ maithunaṃ pariśoṣi ca ||40|| rasāṃścāgniguṇodriktān nidāghe parivarjayet |41|

sarāṃsi sarito vāpīrvanāni rucirāṇi ca ||41|| candanāni parārdhyāni srajaḥ sakamalotpalāḥ | tālavṛntānilāhārāṃstathā śītagṛhāṇi ca ||42|| gharmakāle niṣeveta vāsāṃsi sulaghūni ca | śarkarākhaṇḍadigdhāni `śarkarākhaṇḍadugdhāni' iti pā. sugandhīni himāni ca ||43|| pānakāni ca seveta manthāṃścāpi saśarkarān | bhojanaṃ ca hitaṃ śītaṃ saghṛtaṃ madhuradravam ||44|| śṛtena payasā rātrau śarkarāmadhureṇa ca | pratyagrakusumākīrṇe śayane harmyasaṃsthite ||45|| śayīta candanārdrāṅgaḥ spṛśyamāno'nilaiḥ sukhaiḥ |46|

tāpātyaye hitā nityaṃ rasā ye guravastrayaḥ ||46|| payo māṃsarasāḥ koṣṇāstailāni ca ghṛtāni ca | bṛṃhaṇaṃ cāpi yatkiñcidabhiṣyandi tathaiva ca ||47|| nidāghopacitaṃ caiva prakupyantaṃ samīraṇam | nihanyādanilaghnena vidhinā vidhikovidaḥ ||48|| nadījalaṃ rūkṣamuṣṇamudamanthaṃ tathā''tapam | vyāyāmaṃ ca divāsvapnaṃ vyavāyaṃ cātra varjayet ||49|| navānnarūkṣaśītāmbusaktūṃścāpi vivarjayet | yavaṣaṣṭikagodhūmān śālīṃścāpyanavāṃstathā ||50|| harmyamadhye nivāte ca bhajecchayyāṃ mṛdūttarām | saviṣaprāṇiviṇmūtralālādiṣṭhīvanādibhiḥ ||51|| samāplutaṃ tadā toyamāntarīkṣaṃ viṣopamam | vāyunā viṣaduṣṭena prāvṛṣeṇyena dūṣitam ||52|| taddhi sarvopayogeṣu tasmin kāle vivarjayet | ariṣṭāsavamaireyān sopadaṃśāṃstu yuktitaḥ ||53|| pibet prāvṛṣi jīrṇāṃstu rātrau tānapi varjayet | nirūhairbastibhiścānyaistabhā'nyairmārutāpahaiḥ ||54|| kupitaṃ śamayedvāyuṃ vārṣikaṃ cācaredvidhim |55|
ṛtāvṛtau ya etena vidhinā vartate naraḥ ||55|| ghorānṛtukṛtān rogānnāpnoti sa kadācana |56|

ab.seg: ata ūrdhvaṃ dvādaśāśanapravicārān vakṣyāmḥ | tatra śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣadravaśuṣkaikakālikadvikālikauṣadhayuktamātrāhīnadoṣapraśamanavṛttyarthāḥ ||56||
tṛṣṇoṣṇamadadāhārtān raktapittaviṣāturān | mūrcchārtān strīṣu ca kṣīṇān śītairannairupācaret ||57||
kaphavātāmayāviṣṭān viriktān snehapāyinaḥ | aklinnakāyāṃśca `praklinnadehāṃśca' iti pā. narānuṣṇairannairupācaret ||58||
vātikān rūkṣadehāṃśca vyavāyopahatāṃstathā | vyāyāminaścāpi narān snigdhairannairupācaret ||59||
medasā'bhiparītāṃstu snigdhānmehāturānapi `sthūlān' iti pā.| kaphābhipannadehāṃśca rūkṣairannairupācaret ||60||

div.ab: śuṣkadehān pipāsārtān durbalānapi ca dravaiḥ |61|

ab.seg: praklinnakāyān vraṇinaḥ śuṣkairmehina eva ca ||61||

div.ab: ekakālaṃ bhaveddeyo durbalāgnivivṛddhaye |62|

ab.seg: samāgnaye tathā''hāro dvikālamapi `deyaḥ kālamathobhayam' iti pā. pūjitaḥ ||62||

div.ab: auṣadhadveṣiṇe deyastathauṣadhasamāyutaḥ |63|

ab.seg: mandāgnaye rogiṇe ca mātrāhīnaḥ praśasyate ||63||

div.ab: yathartudattastvāhāro doṣapraśamanaḥ smṛtaḥ |64|

ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ tu svasthānāṃ vṛttyarthaṃ sarva eva ca | pravicārānimānevaṃ dvādaśātra prayojayet `dvādaśānnapravicārānetāneva pracakṣate' iti pā.||64||

ata ūrdhvaṃ daśauṣadhakālān vakṣyāmaḥ | tatrābhaktaṃ `tatranirbhaktaṃ' iti pā. prāgbhaktamadhobhaktaṃ madhyebhaktamantarābhaktaṃ sabhaktaṃ sāmudgaṃ muhurmuhurgrāsaṃ grāsāntaraṃ ceti daśauṣadhakālāḥ ||65||
tatrābhaktaṃ tu yat kevalamevauṣadhamupayujyate ||66||

vīryādhikaṃ bhavati bheṣajamannahīnaṃ hanyāttathā''mayamasaṃśayamāśu `tadāmayama...' iti pā. caiva | tadbālavṛddhavanitāmṛdavastu `tadvālavṛddhayuvatīmṛdavo'tha pītvā' iti pā. pītvā glāniṃ parāṃ samupayānti balakṣayaṃ ca ||67||
prāgbhaktaṃ nāma yat prāgbhaktasyopayujyate ||68||
śīghraṃ vipākamupayāti balaṃ na hiṃsyādannāvṛtaṃ na ca muhurvadanānnireti | prāgbhaktasevitamathauṣadhametadeva dadyācca vṛddhaśiśubhīrukṛśāṅganābhyaḥ ||69||
adhobhaktaṃ nāma- yadadho `yadbhuktvā pīyate' iti pā. bhaktasyeti ||70||
madhyebhaktaṃ nāma- yanmadhye bhaktasya pīyate ||71||
pītaṃ yadannamupayujya tadūrdhvakāye hanyādgadān bahuvidhāṃśca balaṃ dadāti | madhye tu pītamapahantyavisāribhāvādye madhyadehamabhibhūya bhavanti rogāḥ ||72||
antarābhaktaṃ nāma `tu yat pūrvāparayorbhaktayorantare' iti pā. - yadantarā pīyate pūrvāparayorbhaktayoḥ ||73||
sabhaktaṃ nāma ‘sabhaktaṃ nāma auṣadheṣu yat sādhyate bhaktam' iti pā. - yat saha bhaktena ||74||
pathyaṃ sabhaktamabalābalayorhi nityaṃ taddveṣiṇāmapi tathā śiśuvṛddhayośca | hṛdyaṃ manobalakaraṃ tvatha dīpanaṃ ca pathyaṃ sadā bhavati cāntarabhaktakaṃ yat ||75||
sāmudgaṃ nāma `tu' iti pā. - yadbhaktasyādāvante ca pīyate ||76||
doṣe dvidhā pravisṛte tu samudgasañjñamādyantayoryadaśanasya niṣevyate tu ||77||
muhurmuhurnāma `muhurmuhuryat sabhaktamabhaktaṃ vā tanmuhurmuhuḥ' iti pā. - sabhaktamabhaktaṃ vā yadauṣadhaṃ muhurmuhurupayujyate ||78||
śvāse muhurmuhuratiprasṛte ca kāse hikkāvamīṣu sa vadantyupayojyametat ||79||
grāsaṃ tu- yatpiṇḍavyāmiśram ||80||
grāsāntaraṃ `grāsāntaraṃ nāma yadubhayorgrāsayormadhye prayujyate' iti pā. tu yadgrāsāntareṣu ||81||

grāseṣu `grāseṣu pītamupayāti vipakvamāśu vṛddhe'baleṣu ca hitaṃ pravadanti santaḥ' iti pā. cūrṇamabalāgniṣu dīpanīyaṃ vājīkarāṇyapi tu yojayituṃ yateta | grāsāntareṣu vitaredvamanīyadhūmān śvāsādiṣu prathitadṛṣṭaguṇāṃśca lehān ||82||
evamete daśauṣadhakālāḥ ||83||

visṛṣṭe viṇmūtre viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau viśuddhe codgāre hṛdi suvimale vāte ca sarati | tathā'nnaśraddhāyāṃ klamaparigame kukṣau ca śithile pradeyastvāhāro bhavati bhiṣajāṃ kālaḥ sa tu mataḥ ||84||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre tantrabhūṣaṇādhyāyeṣu svasvavṛttādhyāyo nāma(dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||64||
athātastantrayuktimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

dvātriṃśattantrayuktayo bhavanti śāstre | tadyathā- adhikaraṇaṃ(1), yogaḥ(2), padārthaḥ(3), hetvarthaḥ(4), uddeśaḥ(5), nirdeśaḥ(6), upadeśaḥ(7), apadeśaḥ(8), pradeśaḥ(9), atideśaḥ(10), apavarjaḥ(11), vākyaśeṣaḥ(12), arthāpattiḥ(13), viparyayaḥ(14), prasaṅgaḥ(15), ekāntaḥ(16), anekāntaḥ(17), pūrvapakṣaḥ(18), nirṇayaḥ(19), anumataṃ(20), vidhānam(21), anāgatāvekṣaṇam(22), atikrāntāvekṣaṇaṃ(23), saṃśayaḥ(24), vyākhyānaṃ(25), svasañjñā(26), nirvacanaṃ(27), nidarśanaṃ(28), niyogaḥ(29), vikalpaḥ(30), samuccayaḥ(31), ūhyam(32) iti ||3||
atrāsāṃ tantrayuktīnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam? ucyate- vākyayojanamarthayojanaṃ ca ||4||
bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ- asadvādiprayuktānāṃ vākyānāṃ pratiṣedhanam | svavākyasiddhirapi ca kriyate tantrayuktitaḥ `tantrayuktibhiḥ' iti pā.||5||
vyaktā `vyatyāsoktāśca' iti pā. noktāstu ye hyārthā līnā ye cāpyanirmalāḥ | leśoktā ye ca `kvacittantre’ iti pā. kecitsyusteṣāṃ cāpi prasādhanam ||6||
yathā'mbujavanasyārkaḥ pradīpo veśmano yathā | prabodhasya `pravodhyasya' iti pā. prakāśārthaṃ tathā tantrasya yuktayaḥ ||7||
tatra yamarthamadhikṛtyocyate tadadhikaraṇaṃ; yathā rasaṃ doṣaṃ vā ||8||

yena vākyaṃ yujyate sa yogaḥ | yathā- ‘tailaṃ pibeccāmṛtavallinimbahiṃsrābhayāvṛkṣakapippalībhiḥ | siddhaṃ balābhyāṃ ca sadevadāru hitāya nityaṃ galagaṇḍaroge’ | ityatra tailaṃ siddhaṃ pibediti prathamaṃ vaktavye tṛtīyapāde siddhamiti prayuktaṃ, evaṃ dūrasthānāmapi padānāmekīkaraṇaṃ yogaḥ ||9||

yo'rtho'bhihitaḥ sūtre pade vā `asyāyamarthaḥ- yamarthamadhikṛtya ye'rthā amidhīyante tadadhikaraṇasañjñaṃ sarvasyāmidheyasyeti| tamevārthamāha- yathā- rasaṃ doṣaṃ ceti, rasavijñāne rasamadhikṛtya dauṣavijñāne doṣamadhikṛtya cocyata iti' iti pā. sa padārthaḥ padasya padayoḥ padānāṃ vā'rthaḥ padārthaḥ; aparimitāśca padārthāḥ | yathā- snehasvedāñjaneṣu nirdiṣṭeṣu dvayostrayāṇāṃ vā'rthānāmupapattirdṛśyate, tatra yo'rthaḥ pūrvāparayogasiddho bhavati sa grahītavyaḥ; yathā- ‘vedotpattimadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāma’ ityukte sandihyate buddhiḥ- katamasya vedasyotpattiṃ `vedasyāyamutpattiṃ vivakṣuriti' iti pā. vakṣyatīti, yataḥ ṛgvedādayastu vedāḥ; ‘vida vicāraṇe, vidlṛ lābhe,’ ityetayośca dhātvoranekārthayoḥ prayogāt, tatra pūrvāparayogamupalabhya pratipattirbhavati- āyurvedotpattimayaṃ vivakṣuriti; eṣa padārthaḥ ||10||
yadanyaduktamanyārthasādhakaṃ `yaduktamubhayārthasādhakaṃ' iti pā. bhavati sa hetvarthaḥ | yathā- mṛtpiṇḍo'dbhiḥ praklighate tathā māṣadugdhaprabhṛtibhirvraṇaḥ praklighata iti ||11||
samāsavacanamuddeśaḥ | yathā- śalyamiti ||12||
vistaravacanaṃ nirdeśaḥ | yathā- śārīramāgantukaṃ ceti ||13||
evamityupadeśaḥ | yathā- ‘tathā na jāgṛyādrātrau divāsvapnaṃ ca varjayet’ iti ||14||
anena kāraṇenetyapadeśaḥ, yathā'padiśyate- madhuraḥ śleṣmāṇamabhivardhayatīti ||15||
prakṛtasyātikrāntena sādhanaṃ pradeśaḥ | yathā- devadattasyānena śalyamuddhṛtaṃ tathā ‘tasmāt’ iti pā. yajñadattasyāpyayamuddhariṣyatīti ||16||

prakṛtasyānāgatasya hārāṇacandrastu `itaratra vihitasya vidheritaratra prayogāyopadeśo'tideśaḥ| yathā- `eṣa eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire samudāhṛtaḥ' iti paṭhati, ayameva sādhupāṭhaḥ sādhanamatideśaḥ | yathā- yato'sya vāyururdhvamuttiṣṭhate tenodāvartī syāditi ||17||
abhivyāpyāpakarṣaṇamapavargaḥ | yathā- asvedyā viṣopasṛṣṭāḥ, anyatra kīṭaviṣāditi ||18||
yena padenānuktena vākyaṃ samāpyeta sa vākyaśeṣaḥ | yathā- śiraḥ pāṇipādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarorasāmityukte puruṣagrahaṇaṃ vinā'pi gamyate puruṣasyeti ||19||
yadakīrtitamarthādāpadyate sā'rthāpattiḥ | yathā- odanaṃ bhokṣye ityukte'rthādāpannaṃ bhavati- nāyaṃ pipāsuryavāgūmiti ||20||
yadyatrābhihitaṃ `yadvihitaṃ' iti pā. tasya prātilomyaṃ viparyayaḥ | yathā- kṛśālpaprāṇabhīravo duścikitsyā ityukte viparītaṃ gṛhyate dṛḍhādayaḥ sucikitsyā iti ||21||

prakaraṇāntareṇa samāpanaṃ `samānaṃ' iti pā. prasaṅgaḥ, yadvā prakaraṇāntarito yo'rtho'sakṛduktaḥ `yo'rthaḥ punaruktaḥ' iti pā. samāpyate sa prasaṅgaḥ | yathā- pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ puruṣastasmin kriyā so'dhiṣṭhānamiti vedotpattāvabhidhāya, bhūtacintāyāṃ punaruktaṃ- yato'bhihitaṃ pañcamahābhūtaśarīrisamavāyaḥ purūṣa iti, sa khalveṣa karmapuruṣaścikitsādhikṛta iti ||22||
(sarvatra ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kacitpustake nopalabhyate )yadavadhāraṇenocyate sa ekāntaḥ | yathā- trivṛdvirecayati, madanaphalaṃ vāmayati(eva) ||23||
kvacittathā kvacidanyatheti yaḥ so'nekāntaḥ | yathā- kecidācāryā bruvate dravyaṃ pradhānaṃ, kecidrasaṃ, kecidvīryaṃ kecidvipākamiti ||24||
ākṣepapūrvakaḥ praśnaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ | yathā- kathaṃ vātanimittāścatvāraḥ prameha asādhyā bhavantīti ||25||
tasyottaraṃ nirṇayaḥ | yathā- śarīraṃ prapīḍya paścādadho gatvā vasāmedomajjānuviddhaṃ mūtraṃ visṛjati vātaḥ evamasādhyā vātajā iti ||26||
tathā coktam- kṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ niṣpīḍya medomajjāvasāyutaḥ | adhaḥ prakupyate vāyustenāsādhyāstu vātajāḥ ||27||
paramatamapratiṣiddhamanumatam | yathā- anyo brūyāt- sapta rasā iti, taccāpratiṣedhādanumanyate kathañciditi ||28||
prakaraṇānupūrvyā'bhihitaṃ vidhānam | yathā- sakthimarmāṇyekādaśa prakaraṇānupūrvyā'bhihitāni ||29||
evaṃ vakṣyatītyanāgatāvekṣaṇam | yathā- ślokasthāne brūyāt- cikitsiteṣu vakṣyāmīti ||30||
yatpūrvamuktaṃ tadatikrāntāvekṣaṇam | yathā- cikitsiteṣu brūyāt- ślokasthāne yadīritamiti ||31||
ubhayahetudarśanaṃ saṃśayaḥ | yathā `ubhayathā darśanaṃ yathā- kiṃ pittavyatirekādanyo'gniḥ āhosvit pittamevāgniriti' iti pā. - talahṛdayābhighātaḥ prāṇaharaḥ, pāṇipādacchedanamaprāṇaharamiti ||32||

tantre'tiśayopavarṇanaṃ vyākhyānam | yathā- iha pañcaviṃśatikaḥ purūṣo vyākhyāyate, anyeṣvāyurvedatantreṣu bhūtādiprabhṛtyārabhya cintā `bhūtā dimārabhya cinteti' iti, `bhūtādiprakṛtivikṛtyārabdhacintaḥ' iti ca pā.||33||

anyaśāstrāsāmānyā svasañjñā | yathā- mithunamiti madhusarpiṣorgragaṇaṃ; lokaprasiddhamudāharaṇaṃ vā `yathā mithunībhūtayorvātapittayorvātaśleṣmaṇoḥ pittaśleṣmaṇośca dvamdvaśabdena grahaṇaṃ, tathābhūtayośca tailasarpiṣoryamakaśabdeneti' iti pā.||34||
niścitaṃ vacanaṃ nirvacanam | yathā- āyurvidyate'sminnanena vā āyurvindatītyāyurvedaḥ ||35||

dṛṣṭāntavyaktirnidarśanam `dṛṣṭāntena darśanaṃ nidarśanam' iti, `dṛṣṭāntenārthaḥ prasādhyate yatra tannidarśanam' iti ca pā.| yathā- agnirvāyunā sahitaḥ kakṣe `koṣṭhe' iti pā. vṛrddhi gacchati tathā vātapittakaphaduṣṭo vraṇa iti ||36||
idameva kartavyamiti niyogaḥ | yathā- pathyameva bhoktavyamiti ||37||
idaṃ cedaṃ ceti samuccayaḥ | yathā- māṃsavarge eṇahariṇādayo lāvatittiriśāraṅgaśca pradhānānīti ||38||
idaṃ vedaṃ veti vikalpaḥ | yathā- rasaudanaḥ saghṛtā yavāgūrvā (bhavatviti) ||39||

yadanirdiṣṭaṃ buddhayā'vagamyate buddhigamyaṃ tadūhyam' iti, `buddhimatā tadūhyam' iti ca pā. tadūhyam | yathā- abhihitamannapānavidhau caturvidhaṃ cānnamupadiśyate- bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyaṃ peyamiti, evaṃ caturvidhe vaktavye dvividhamabhihitam; idamatrohyam- annapāne viśiṣṭayordvayorgrahaṇe kṛte caturṇāmapi grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti; caturvidhaścāhāraḥ `kiñcānyat annena bhakṣyamavaruddhamannasādharmyāt, peyena lehyaṃ, dravasādharmyāt| caturvidhaścāhāraḥ prāyeṇa dvividhaḥ prasiddha iti' iti pā. praviralaḥ, prāyeṇa dvividha eva; ato dvitvaṃ prasiddhamiti | kiñcānyat- annena bhakṣyamavaruddhaṃ, ghanasādharmyāt; peyena lehyaṃ, dravasādharmyāt ||40||
bhavanti cātra- sāmānyadarśanenāsāṃ `sāmānyalakṣaṇenaitā vyāsataḥ sampradarśitāḥ' iti pā. vyavasthā sampradarśitā | viśeṣastu yathāyogamupadhāryo vipaścitā ||41||
dvātriṃśadyuktayo hyetāstantrasāragaveṣaṇe | mayā samyagvinihitāḥ śabdārthanyāyasaṃyutāḥ `śabdanyāyārthasaṃyutāḥ' iti pā.||42||
yo hyotā vidhivadvetti dīpībhūtāstu buddhimān | sa pūjārho bhiṣakśreṣṭha iti dhanvantarermatam ||43||
iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre tantrabhūṣaṇādhyāyeṣu tantrayuktirnāma (tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ, āditaḥ) pañcaṣaṣṭimo'dhyāyaḥ ||65||

div.head: doṣabhedavikalpādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto doṣabhedavikalpamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ||1||
yathovāca bhagavān dhanvantariḥ ||2||

div.ab: aṣṭāṅgavedavidvāṃsaṃ `aṣṭāṅgāyurvedavidaṃ' iti pā. divodāsaṃ mahaujasam | chinnaśastrārthasandehaṃ sūkṣmāgādhāgamodadhim ||3|| viśvāmitrasutaḥ śrīmān suśrutaḥ paripṛcchati |4|
dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedā ye purastātparikīrtitāḥ ||4|| kati tatraikaśo jñeyā dviśo vā'pyathavā triśaḥ |5|
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃśayacchinmahātapāḥ ||5|| prītātmā nṛpaśārdūlaḥ `naraśārdūlaḥ' iti pā. suśrutāyāha tattvataḥ |6|
trayo doṣā dhātavaśca purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca ||6|| dehaṃ sandhārayantyete hyavyāpannā rasairhitaiḥ |7|

puruṣaḥ ṣoḍaśakalaḥ prāṇāścaikādaśaiva ye ||7|| rogāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ yacchataṃ viṃśatireva ca | śataṃ `śatāni pañca dravyṇāṃ trisaptatyadhikāni ca' iti pā. ca pañca dravyāṇāṃ trisaptatyadhikottaram ||8|| vyāsataḥ kīrtitaṃ taddhi... |9|

ab.seg: ... bhinnā doṣāstrayo guṇāḥ | dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavantyete bhūyiṣṭhamiti niścayaḥ ||9||

div.ab: traya eva pṛthak doṣā dviśo nava samādhikaiḥ | trayodaśādhikaikadvisamamadhyolbaṇaistriśaḥ ||10|| pañcāśadevaṃ tu saha bhavanti kṣayamāgataiḥ | kṣīṇamadhyādhikakṣīṇakṣīṇavṛddhaistathā'paraiḥ `kṣīṇamadhyādhikadvyekakṣīṇavṛddhāstathā'pare' iti pā.||11|| dvādaśaivaṃ samākhyātāstrayo doṣā dviṣaṣṭidhā |12|

ab.seg: miśrā dhātumalairdoṣā yāntyasaṅkhyeyatāṃ punaḥ ||12||
tasmāt prasaṅgaṃ saṃyamya doṣabhedavikalpanaiḥ | rogaṃ viditvopacaredrasabhedairyathairitaiḥ ||13||
bhiṣak kartā'tha karaṇaṃ rasā doṣāstu kāraṇam | kāryamārogyamevaikamanārogyamato'nyathā ||14||
adhyāyānāṃ tu ṣaṭṣaṣṭyā grathitārthapadakramam | evametadaśeṣeṇa tantramuttaramṛddhimat ||15||
spaṣṭagūḍhārthavijñānamagāḍhamandacetasām | yathāvidhi yathāpraśnaṃ bhavatāṃ parikīrtitam ||16||
sahottaraṃ tvetadadhītya sarvaṃ brāhmaṃ vidhānena yathoditena | na hīyate'rthānmanaso'bhyupetādetadvaco brāhmamatīva satyam ||17||

div.ab: iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantre doṣabhedavikalpo nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||66|| iti suśrutasaṃhitāyāmuttaratantraṃ samāptam | samāpteyaṃ suśrutasaṃhitā |
